translation: 老师们告诉我特雷西的行为大有改善。

meaning: n. 信息，资料；知识；情报；通知
example: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information.
translation: 房间很安静，无人主动提供更多的信息。

meaning: adj. 最初的；字首的; v. 用姓名的首字母签名; n. 词首大写字母
example: They learnt a lot from the initial market testing exercise.
translation: 他们从最初的市场测试中了解了许多信息。

meaning: v. 伤害，损害
example: I can say, with absolute truthfulness, that I did not injure her.
translation: 我可以绝对坦率地说，我没有伤害她。

meaning: v. 签署；涂墨水于; n. 墨水，墨汁；油墨
example: printing ink
translation: 印刷用油墨

meaning: n. 内地；内陆; adj. 内陆的；内地的；国内的; adv. 在内地；向内地；向内陆；在内陆
example: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
translation: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

meaning: n. 客栈；旅馆; vi. 住旅馆
example: I always feel at home at Ye Olde Starre Inn.
translation: 在昨日星辰客栈，我总有种宾至如归的感觉。

meaning: adj. 无辜的；无罪的；无知的; n. 天真的人；笨蛋
example: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
translation: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

meaning: n. 昆虫；卑鄙的人
example: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.
translation: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。

meaning: v. 插入；嵌入; n. 插入物；管芯；镶块；[机械]刀片
example: Insert coins into the slot and press for a ticket.
translation: 把硬币放进投币口，按钮取票。

meaning: n. 里面；内部；内情；内脏; adj. 里面的；内部的；秘密的; adv. 在里面; prep. 少于；在…之内
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: v. 坚持，强调
example: They insist on tastier chocolate than the anaemic British stuff.
translation: 他们坚持要比淡而无味的英国货味道更好的巧克力。

meaning: v. 检查；视察；检阅
example: They have the right to come in and inspect the meter.
translation: 他们有权进来查表。

meaning: v. 激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感
example: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
translation: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

meaning: adj. 立即的；紧急的；紧迫的; n. 瞬间；立即；片刻
example: In the same instant he flung open the car door.
translation: 与此同时，他猛地推开了车门。

meaning: adv. 代替；反而；相反
example: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
translation: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

meaning: v. 开始（调查）；制定；创立；提起（诉讼）; n. 学会，协会；学院
example: The Institute of Export now fears that 100,000 jobs will go.
translation: 现在出口协会担心将失去10万个工作机会。

meaning: n. 制度；建立；（社会或宗教等）公共机构；习俗
example: Congress as an institution scores low in public opinion polls.
translation: 作为一个公共机构，国会在公众民意调查中得分很低。

meaning: v. 指导；通知；命令；教授
example: We should instruct the passengers what customs regulations are.
translation: 我们应该向乘客说明海关规则是什么.

meaning: n. 指令，命令；指示；教导；用法说明
example: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
translation: 这一方法给教学带来了活力，也使知识的吸收变得容易了。

meaning: n. 仪器；工具；乐器；手段；器械
example: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
translation: 一种叫做套管针的工具在腹壁上刺了一个孔。

meaning: n. 保险；保险费；保险契约；赔偿金
example: Police investigating a £10 million car insurance fiddle arrested 16 people yesterday.
translation: 调查涉及1,000万英镑的汽车保险诈骗案的警察昨天逮捕了16人。

meaning: v. 确保，保证；给…保险
example: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
translation: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

meaning: n. 智力；情报工作；情报机关；理解力；才智，智慧；天分
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: n. 意图；目的；意向；愈合
example: The president said he had no intention of deploying ground troops.
translation: 总统称并不打算部署地面部队。

meaning: n. 兴趣，爱好；利息；趣味；同行; v. 使……感兴趣；引起……的关心；使……参与
example: We have the interest of 500,000 customers to think of.
translation: 我们得为50万名顾客的利益着想。

meaning: adj. 有趣的；引起兴趣的，令人关注的
example: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
translation: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

meaning: n. 国际组织；国际体育比赛；外国居留者；国际股票; adj. 国际的；两国（或以上）国家的；超越国界的；国际关系的；世界的
example: International investors have become jittery about the country's economy.
translation: 国际投资者已对该国的经济状况感到紧张不安。

meaning: n. 因特网
example: Surfing the Internet is fun, but it's also a time waster.
translation: 上网很有意思，但也很浪费时间。

meaning: n. 解释者；口译者；注释器
example: He was an official interpreter to the government of Nepal.
translation: 他曾是尼泊尔政府的官方译员。

meaning: v. 中断；打断；插嘴；妨碍; n. 中断
example: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. "Sorry to interrupt, Colonel."
translation: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下，上校。”

meaning: n. 间隔；间距；幕间休息
example: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years.
translation: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。

meaning: n. 接见，采访；面试，面谈; v. 采访；接见；对…进行面谈；对某人进行面试
example: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
translation: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

meaning: prep. 到…里；深入…之中；成为…状况；进入到…之内; n. (Into)人名；(芬、英)因托
example: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
translation: 我尽量言简意赅。

meaning: v. 介绍；引进；提出；采用
example: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
translation: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

meaning: n. 介绍；引进；采用；入门；传入
example: Millions of words have been written about the introduction of the euro.
translation: 有关采用欧元的文章已经有很多。

meaning: v. 发明；创造；虚构
example: His father had helped invent a whole new way of doing business.
translation: 他父亲帮助创造了一套全新的生意经。

meaning: n. 发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能
example: The new invention ensures the beer keeps a full, frothy head.
translation: 这项新发明能保证啤酒始终保持丰富的泡沫。

meaning: n. 发明家；[专利] 发明人；创造者
example: The royalties enabled the inventor to re-establish himself in business.
translation: 专利使用费让这位发明家得以再次立足于商界。

meaning: n. 邀请；引诱；请帖；邀请函
example: "I can't pass this up." She waved the invitation.
translation: “我不能错过这个机会，”她挥舞着请帖说。

meaning: v. 邀请，招待；招致; n. 邀请
example: "Let's invite her to dinner." — "Over my dead body!"
translation: “我们请她来吃晚饭吧。”——“除非我死了！”

meaning: n. 爱尔兰
example: That programme will include live commentary on the England-Ireland game.
translation: 那个节目将包括英格兰与爱尔兰比赛的实况报道。

meaning: adj. 爱尔兰的；爱尔兰人的; n. 爱尔兰人；爱尔兰语；爱尔兰
example: "Kathleen" was, as its 1892 subtitle asserted, "An Irish Drama".
translation: 正如1892年剧本的副标题所强调的，《凯瑟琳》是一部“爱尔兰戏剧”。

meaning: n. 熨斗；烙铁；坚强; v. 熨；用铁铸成; adj. 铁的；残酷的；刚强的
example: The small churchyard was surrounded by a rusted wrought-iron fence.
translation: 不大的教堂墓地周边围着一圈生锈的熟铁栅栏。

meaning: v. 灌溉；冲洗；使清新
example: He also wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
translation: 他也想用这些水灌溉荒漠。

meaning: n. 灌溉；[临床] 冲洗；冲洗法
example: The rivers merge just north of a vital irrigation system.
translation: 就在一个重要的灌溉系统的北边，这些河流交汇在一起。

meaning: n. 岛；岛屿；安全岛；岛状物; adj. 岛的; vt. 孤立；使成岛状
example: They were going to sail around the little island, against the tide.
translation: 他们打算绕着小岛逆潮航行。

meaning: pron. [指无生命的东西、动物、植物]它；这；那; abbr. 信息技术information technology
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: adj. 意大利的；意大利文化的；意大利语的; n. 意大利人；意大利语
example: They ate in an Italian restaurant in Forth Street.
translation: 他们在第四大街的一家意大利餐馆吃了饭。

meaning: n. 意大利（欧洲南部国家）
example: The annual slaughter of wildlife in Italy is horrific.
translation: 在意大利，每年大量捕杀野生动物的现象令人震惊。

meaning: pron. 它的; n. (Its)人名；(俄)伊茨
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: pron. 它自己；它本身
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: n. 羽绒滑雪衫；西装短外套；短上衣，夹克；土豆皮；书籍的护封；文件套，公文夹; v. 给…穿夹克；给…装护套；给…包上护封；〈口〉打
example: Will you lend me your jacket for a little while?
translation: 你能把上衣借给我穿一会儿吗？

meaning: n. 果酱；拥挤；困境；扣篮; v. 使堵塞；挤进，使塞满；混杂；压碎
example: They were in a real jam, Bob thought glumly.
translation: 他们确实遇上麻烦了，鲍勃闷闷不乐地想。

meaning: n. 一月
example: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd.
translation: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。

meaning: n. 日本（东亚国家名）
example: Prior to his Japan trip, he went to New York.
translation: 在去日本之前，他去了纽约。

meaning: adj. 日本（人）的；日语的; n. 日本人；日语
example: New Japanese cars averaged 13 km to the litre in 1981.
translation: 1981年，新型的日产汽车平均每升汽油能跑13千米。

meaning: n. 罐；广口瓶；震动；刺耳声; v. 冲突；不一致；震惊；发刺耳声
example: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
translation: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

meaning: n. 颌；下巴；狭窄入口；唠叨; v. 教训；唠叨
example: His jaw was broken after he was hit on the head.
translation: 他的头部受重击之后下颌骨折了。

meaning: n. 爵士乐，爵士舞；喧闹; v. 奏爵士乐，跳爵士舞；游荡; adj. 爵士乐的；喧吵的
example: Page is well versed in many styles of jazz.
translation: 佩奇精通多种风格的爵士乐。

meaning: n. 牛仔裤；工装裤
example: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger.
translation: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。

meaning: n. 吉普车
example: The two men leaped into the jeep and roared off.
translation: 两名男子跳上吉普车，疾驰而去。

meaning: n. 喷射，喷嘴；喷气式飞机；黑玉; adj. 墨黑的; v. 射出
example: As he talked, an airforce jet screamed over the town.
translation: 他谈话时，一架军用喷气式飞机在镇子上空呼啸而过。

meaning: n. 宝石；珠宝; v. 镶以宝石；饰以珠宝
example: Alan, you're a jewel.
translation: 艾伦，你真是出类拔萃呀。

meaning: n. 珠宝；珠宝类
example: I spend a lot on expensive jewelry and clothing.
translation: 我花很多钱购买昂贵的首饰和衣服。

meaning: n. 工作；职业; v. 承包；代客买卖
example: He was hand-picked for this job by the Admiral.
translation: 他是由海军上将精心挑选出来担任这项工作的。

meaning: v. 慢跑；轻推；蹒跚行进；使颠簸; n. 慢跑；轻推，轻撞
example: They set off at a jog up one street and down another.
translation: 他们开始沿着一条又一条的街道慢跑。

meaning: v. 参加；结合；连接; n. 结合；连接；接合点
example: I know you will join me in wishing them Godspeed.
translation: 我知道你会同我一起祝愿他们诸事顺遂的。

meaning: n. 玩笑，笑话；笑柄; v. 开…的玩笑
example: His friends say he was always quick to tell a joke.
translation: 他的朋友们说，以前他讲笑话总是张嘴就来。

meaning: n. 新闻工作者；报人；记日志者
example: A journalist all his life, he's now brought out a book.
translation: 他当了一辈子新闻记者，如今已出了一本书。

meaning: n. 旅行；行程; v. 旅行
example: The average commuter journey there is five hours long.
translation: 那里的通勤一族平均上下班要花5个小时。

meaning: n. 欢乐，快乐；乐趣；高兴; v. 欣喜，欢喜
example: It was a joy to see. It really made my day.
translation: 这太有趣了，真的把我高兴坏了。

meaning: v. 判断；审判; n. 法官；裁判员
example: judge of
translation: 判断；评价

meaning: n. 意见；判断力；[法] 审判；评价
example: A tide of emotion rose and clouded his judgement.
translation: 心头涌起一阵强烈的感情，模糊了他的判断力。

meaning: n. （水果）汁，液；果汁
example: Lemon and lime juice were both temporarily out of stock.
translation: 柠檬汁和酸橙汁暂时都缺货。

meaning: adj. 多汁的；利润多的；生动的
example: It provided some juicy gossip for a few days.
translation: 这制造了一些非常八卦的流言蜚语，足够说上几天的。

meaning: n. 跳跃；暴涨；惊跳; v. 跳跃；使跳跃；跳过；突升
example: His team-mates opened hotel windows, shouting "Jump!" and somewhat less printable banter.
translation: 他的队友打开了酒店的窗户，大叫着“跳！”，还开了一些上不了台面的玩笑。

meaning: n. 六月；琼（人名，来源于拉丁语，含义是“年轻气盛的六月”）
example: June always rhymes with moon in old love songs.
translation: 在老情歌中June总是和moon成韵。

meaning: n. 丛林，密林；危险地带; adj. 丛林的；蛮荒的
example: "Orchards would take the place of the jungle," he rhapsodized.
translation: “要让这片丛林成为果园，”他无比兴奋地说。

meaning: adj. 年少的；后进的；下级的; n. 年少者，晚辈；地位较低者；大学三年级学生
example: She now lives with actor Denis Lawson, 10 years her junior.
translation: 她现在与比她小10岁的演员丹尼斯·劳森同居。

meaning: n. 垃圾，废物；舢板
example: The truth is that junk bonds were misnamed, and therefore misunderstood.
translation: 事实上人们对垃圾债券的称谓有误，所以产生了误解。

meaning: adv. 只是，仅仅；刚才，刚刚；正好，恰好；实在；刚要; adj. 公正的，合理的；正直的，正义的；正确的；公平的；应得的; n. (Just)人名；(英)贾斯特；(法)朱斯特；(德、匈、波、捷、挪)尤斯特；(西)胡斯特
example: If you're not satisfied with the life you're living, don't just complain. Do something about it.
translation: 对于现况的不满，不能只是抱怨，要有作出改变。

meaning: n. 司法，法律制裁；正义；法官，审判员
example: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

meaning: n. 袋鼠
example: Australia is the province of the kangaroo.
translation: 澳大利亚是袋鼠生长活动的地区.

meaning: v. 保持；经营；遵守；饲养; n. 保持；生计；生活费
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. 监护人；饲养员；看守人；管理人
example: I drove out of the gates, past the keeper's lodge.
translation: 我驶出大门，经过守门人的小屋。

meaning: n. 壶；[化工] 釜；罐；鼓
example: I filled the kettle while she was talking and plugged it in.
translation: 她说话间，我把水壶灌满并插上了电源。

meaning: n. （打字机等的）键；关键；钥匙; v. 键入；锁上；调节…的音调；提供线索; adj. 关键的
example: The key issue was whether the four defendants acted dishonestly.
translation: 关键问题是4名被告是否存在欺诈行为。

meaning: n. 键盘; v. 键入；用键盘式排字机排字
example: To close your document, press CTRL+W on your keyboard.
translation: 关闭文件时要同时按键盘上的CTRL键和W键。

meaning: v. 踢；反冲，朝后座; n. 踢；反冲，后座力
example: Dave pulled a back muscle and could barely kick the ball.
translation: 戴夫背部拉伤，几乎没法踢球。

meaning: n. 小孩；小山羊; v. 欺骗；取笑；戏弄; adj. 小山羊皮制的；较年幼的
example: He told us to get stuffed so we leaned on his kid.
translation: 他叫我们滚蛋，于是我们威胁他的孩子。

meaning: v. 杀死；扼杀；使终止；抵消; n. 杀戮；屠杀; adj. 致命的；致死的
example: Don't try and double-cross me, Taylor, because I'll kill you.
translation: 别跟我耍花招，泰勒，要不我会杀了你。

meaning: n. 千克
n. 公斤；千克
example: Apple costs five dollars a kilogram.
translation: 苹果每千克5美元.

meaning: n. [计量] 公里；[计量] 千米
example: Moreau took gold in the five-kilometre individual pursuit competition.
translation: 莫罗在个人五公里追逐赛中获得金牌。

meaning: n. 种类；性质; adj. 和蔼的；宽容的；令人感激的
example: There is good news of a kind for the Prime Minister.
translation: 对总理来说也算是有个好消息。

meaning: n. 幼儿园；幼稚园
example: Children graduate to the kindergarten, then pre-school, and then school.
translation: 孩子们先上幼儿园，然后上学前班，再接着上小学。

meaning: n. 仁慈；好意；友好的行为
example: Build her up with kindness and a sympathetic ear.
translation: 用友善和富有同情心的倾听来重拾她的信心。

meaning: n. 国王；最有势力者；王棋; vi. 统治；做国王; vt. 立…为王; adj. 主要的，最重要的，最大的
example: The King made major concessions to end the confrontation with his people.
translation: 为了结束与其臣民的冲突，国王作出了很大的让步。

meaning: n. 王国；界；领域
example: It was infamous as a kingdom of brigands, scoundrels, and slave-traders.
translation: 该地区因土匪、无赖和奴隶贩子猖獗而声名狼藉。

meaning: v. 吻；（风等）轻拂; n. 吻；轻拂
example: She planted a kiss on each of his leathery cheeks.
translation: 她在他粗糙的面颊上左右各吻了一下。

meaning: n. 厨房；炊具；炊事人员
example: The study links the main living area to the kitchen.
translation: 书房把主要的生活区与厨房连在一起。

meaning: n. 风筝; v. 使用空头支票；像风筝一样飞；轻快地移动
example: Kite is undoubtedly a class player.
translation: 凯特绝对是个一流选手。

meaning: n. 膝盖，膝; v. 用膝盖碰
example: A stiff knee following surgery forced her to walk with a limp.
translation: 手术后她的膝盖活动不便，走路时被迫跛行。

meaning: n. 刀；匕首; v. 用刀切；（口）伤害
example: She produced the knife during arguments with her friends.
translation: 在和朋友争吵的时候，她掏出了刀。

meaning: v. 敲；打；敲击; n. 敲；敲打；爆震声
example: Find Bernie and get him to knock an agreement together.
translation: 找到伯尼，让他尽快拟好一份协议。

meaning: v. 知道；认识；懂得
example: I know it's nothing serious and I feel quite unemotional about it.
translation: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

meaning: n. 知识，学问；知道，认识；学科
example: Father had no more than a superficial knowledge of music.
translation: 父亲对音乐只懂一点皮毛。

meaning: n. 实验室，研究室
example: "He went back to the lab", Iris exclaimed impatiently.
translation: “他回实验室去了，”艾里斯不耐烦地大声说。

meaning: n. 劳动力，人工；分娩; v. 劳动；分娩；费力地前进
example: It was the uncommitted that Labour needed to reach.
translation: 工党需要拉拢的是未表态者。

meaning: n. 劳动者；劳工
example: He has worked as a labourer in factories and on building sites.
translation: 他在工厂和建筑工地干过苦工。

meaning: v. 缺乏；不足；没有；需要; n. 缺乏；不足
example: Lack of exercise can lead to feelings of depression and exhaustion.
translation: 缺乏锻炼会导致抑郁和疲劳。

meaning: n. 阶梯；途径；梯状物; v. 成名；发迹
example: Her whole body began to buckle, unbalancing the ladder.
translation: 她整个身体开始弯曲，搞得梯子倾侧起来。

meaning: n. 女士，夫人；小姐；妻子
example: Listen here, young lady. Don't you call me that!
translation: 你给我听着，小姐。别那样叫我！

meaning: n. 湖；深红色颜料；胭脂红; vt. （使）血球溶解; vi. （使）血球溶解
example: west lake
translation: 杭州西湖

meaning: n. 羔羊，小羊；羔羊肉; v. 生小羊，产羔羊
example: Allow an extra 10-15 min if you prefer lamb well done.
translation: 如果想让羊羔肉完全熟透还需要再煮10到15分钟。

meaning: adj. 跛足的；僵痛的；不完全的；无说服力的；差劲的，蹩脚的; v. 变跛
example: He mumbled some lame excuse about having gone to sleep.
translation: 他含含糊糊地找了个蹩脚的借口，想要解释自己为什么睡着了。

meaning: n. 灯；照射器; vt. 照亮; vi. 发亮
example: I used my thumbnail to tighten the screw on my lamp.
translation: 我用拇指指甲把台灯上的螺钉拧紧了。

meaning: n. 国土；陆地；地面; v. 使…登陆；使…陷于；将…卸下
example: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
translation: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

meaning: n. 语言；语言文字；表达能力
example: The Ukrainians speak a Slavonic language similar to Russian.
translation: 乌克兰人所说的那种斯拉夫语系的语言类似于俄语。

meaning: n. 灯笼；提灯；灯笼式天窗
example: I've been thinking I'd better have asked for a lantern.
translation: 我一直认为我还不如要一个灯笼呢.

meaning: n. 一圈；膝盖；下摆；山坳; v. 使重叠；拍打；包围
example: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
translation: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

meaning: adj. 大的；多数的；广博的; adv. 大大地；夸大地; n. 大
example: These large institutions make — and change—the rules to suit themselves.
translation: 这些大机构总是随意制定规定，而且说变就变。

meaning: n. 激光
example: He made contact with someone with an idea for reconditioning laser copiers.
translation: 他联系了一个会修理激光复印机的人。

meaning: n. 末尾，最后；上个；鞋楦（做鞋的模型）; adj. 最后的；最近的，最新的；仅剩的；最不可能…的; v. 持续；维持，够用；持久; adv. 最后地；上次，最近；最后一点
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；最近的; adv. 晚；迟；最近；在晚期
example: He defected from the party in the late 1970s.
translation: 他在20世纪70年代后期叛出了该党。

meaning: adv. 后来；稍后；随后; adj. 更迟的；更后的; n. (Later)人名；(德)拉特
example: At a later news conference, he said differences should not be dramatized.
translation: 在后来的新闻发布会上，他说不应夸大分歧。

meaning: adv. 最迟地；最后地; n. 最新的事物; adj. 最新的，最近的；最迟的，最后的
example: I use the short-wave radio to get the latest war news.
translation: 我用短波收音机收听最新的战事新闻。

meaning: adj. 后者的；近来的；后面的；较后的; n. (Latter)人名；(英、德、捷)拉特
example: He holds the belief that he is a latter-day prophet.
translation: 他深信自己是当代先知。

meaning: n. 笑；引人发笑的事或人; v. 笑
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: n. 笑；笑声
example: Behind the mocking laughter lurks a growing sense of unease.
translation: 嘲笑声的背后潜伏着一种越来越强烈的不安。

meaning: n. 洗衣店，洗衣房；要洗的衣服；洗熨；洗好的衣服
example: She could ring for food and drink, laundry and sundry services.
translation: 她可以打电话点餐，叫人来取要洗的衣服以及叫其他各种服务。

meaning: n. 厕所，盥洗室
example: There's a bathroom and a lavatory upstairs.
translation: 楼上有浴室和卫生间。

meaning: n. 法律；规律；法治；法学；诉讼；司法界; vi. 起诉；控告; vt. 控告；对…起诉
example: by law
translation: n. 根据法律，在法律上；附则

meaning: n. 律师；法学家
example: "He was a lawyer before that," Mary Ann put in.
translation: “在那之前他是个律师，”玛丽·安补充道。

meaning: v. 躺下；产卵；搁放；放置；铺放；涂，敷; adj. 世俗的；外行的；没有经验的; n. 位置；短诗；花纹方向；叙事诗；性伙伴
example: On Sunday Cohen lay around the house all day.
translation: 科恩星期天一整天都在家无所事事。

meaning: adj. 懒惰的；懒洋洋的；怠惰的；慢吞吞的; n. (Lazy)人名；(德)拉齐
example: Lazy and incompetent police officers are letting the public down.
translation: 懒惰兼无能的警官令公众失望。

meaning: n. 领导；铅；导线；榜样; v. 领导；致使；引导；指挥; adj. 带头的；最重要的
example: Politicians say it could lead to a dissolution of parliament.
translation: 政客们说这可能会导致议会解散。

meaning: n. 领导者；首领；指挥者
example: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
translation: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

meaning: adj. 领导的；主要的; n. 领导；铅板；行距; v. 领导（lead的ing形式）
example: The Democratic candidate is still leading in the polls.
translation: 民主党候选人的得票数依然领先。

meaning: n. 叶子；（书籍等的）一张；扇页; v. 生叶；翻书页
example: I was shaking all over, trembling like a leaf.
translation: 我像风中的落叶一样浑身发抖。

meaning: n. 联盟；社团；范畴; v. 使…结盟；与…联合
example: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

meaning: n. 泄漏；漏洞，裂缝; v. 使渗漏，泄露
example: The yacht has sprung a leak in the hull.
translation: 帆船的船体上出现了一条裂缝。

meaning: v. 学习；得知；认识到
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 博学的；有学问的；学术上的; n. (Learned)人名；(英)勒尼德
example: She's kicked her drug habit and learned that her life has value.
translation: 她已经戒了毒，并且认识到了生命可贵。

meaning: adj. 最小的；最少的（little的最高级）; adv. 最小；最少; n. 最小；最少
example: Try to eat at least four slices of bread a day.
translation: 每天尽量至少吃4片面包。

meaning: n. 皮革；皮革制品; v. 用皮革包盖；抽打; adj. 皮的；皮革制的
example: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger.
translation: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。

meaning: v. 离开；留下；遗忘；委托; n. 许可，同意；休假
example: It got to the point where he had to leave.
translation: 到了他不得不走的地步。

meaning: n. 演讲；讲稿；教训; v. 演讲；训诫
example: Chuck would lecture me, telling me to get a haircut.
translation: 查克就会数落我，让我去理一下发。

meaning: adj. 左边的；左派的；剩下的; adv. 在左面; n. 左边；左派；激进分子; v. 离开（leave的过去式）
example: As I sidestepped, the bottle hit me on the left hip.
translation: 我侧一步要躲闪的时候，瓶子打中了我的左髋部。

meaning: n. 残留物；吃剩的饭菜；剩余物; adj. 残余的；吃剩的
example: Leftover food and unwashed dishes cover the dirty counters.
translation: 台面上又脏又乱，尽是残羹剩菜和未洗的盘子。

meaning: n. 腿；支柱
example: He had to have one leg amputated above the knee.
translation: 他的一条腿不得不从膝部以上截断。

meaning: adj. 法律的；合法的；法定的；依照法律的; n. (Legal)人名；(法)勒加尔
example: But legal experts are not sure if such a charge can stick.
translation: 但法律专家们不能肯定这一指控是否成立。

meaning: adj. 柠檬色的; n. 柠檬
example: Lemon and lime juice were both temporarily out of stock.
translation: 柠檬汁和酸橙汁暂时都缺货。

meaning: n. 柠檬水
example: I wonder if there's any fizz left in the lemonade.
translation: 我琢磨着柠檬汁里不知道还有没有嘶嘶作响的气泡.

meaning: v. 贷；增添，提供；把……借给; n. (Lend)人名；(德)伦德
example: Will you lend me your jacket for a little while?
translation: 你能把上衣借给我穿一会儿吗？

meaning: n. 长度，长；时间的长短；（语）音长
example: Strangely enough, you will automatically wake up after this length of time.
translation: 奇怪的是，过了这样一段时间你就会自己醒来。

meaning: adv. 较少地；较小地；更小地; adj. 较少的；较小的; prep. 减去; n. 较少；较小
example: These files have been zipped up to take up less disk space.
translation: 这些文档已经进行了压缩，以节省磁盘空间。

meaning: n. 教训；课; vt. 教训；上课
example: He learned this lesson the hard way from his own personal experience.
translation: 吃一堑长一智，他这个教训来之不易——是从他自己的亲身经历中得来的。

meaning: v. 允许，让；出租；假设；妨碍; n. 障碍；出租屋
example: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
translation: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

meaning: n. 信；字母，文字；证书；文学，学问；字面意义; v. 写字母于
example: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
translation: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

meaning: n. 水平；标准；水平面; adj. 水平的；平坦的；同高的; v. 瞄准；拉平；变得平坦
example: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
translation: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

meaning: v. 解放；放出；释放
example: They did their best to liberate slaves.
translation: 他们尽最大能力去解放奴隶.

meaning: n. 释放，解放
example: Dawkins ends his discussion with a call for liberation.
translation: 道金斯以呼吁解放结束了他的论述。

meaning: n. 自由；许可；冒失
example: He firmly believes liberty is inseparable from social justice.
translation: 他坚信自由与社会正义是不可分的。

meaning: n. 图书馆员；图书管理员
example: The old librarian illuminated some old books and manuscripts.
translation: 这个老图书馆员把一些古书和旧抄稿加上各种装饰.

meaning: n. 图书馆，藏书室；文库
example: Other amenities, less commonly available, include a library and exercise room.
translation: 还有一些不太常有的设施，包括图书馆和健身房。

meaning: n. 执照，许可证；特许; v. 许可；特许；发许可证给
example: The government revoked her husband's license to operate migrant labor crews.
translation: 政府撤销了她丈夫管理外来打工人群的许可证。

meaning: n. 盖子；眼睑；限制; vt. 给…盖盖子
example: As we drew near, I saw that the boot lid was up.
translation: 我们靠近时,我看见汽车行李箱的盖子翘了起来.

meaning: v. 躺；说谎；位于；展现; n. 谎言；位置
example: The blame for the Charleston fiasco did not lie with him.
translation: 查尔斯顿惨败错不在他。

meaning: n. 生活，生存；寿命
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 一生；寿命；终生；使用期; adj. 一生的；终身的
example: I want to take advantage of your lifetime of scholarship.
translation: 我希望能够用到您一生的学识。

meaning: v. 举起；提升；鼓舞；空运；抄袭; n. 电梯；举起；起重机；搭车
example: I gave her a lift back out to her house.
translation: 我让她搭我的便车回家。

meaning: n. 光；光线；灯；打火机；领悟；浅色；天窗; adj. 轻的；浅色的；明亮的；轻松的；容易的；清淡的; v. 点着；变亮；着火; adv. 轻地；清楚地；轻便地
example: The light went out, and the room was plunged into darkness.
translation: 灯熄了，屋里陷入一片漆黑。

meaning: adj. 闪电的；快速的; n. 闪电; vi. 闪电
example: It was unbelievably dramatic as lightning crackled all round the van.
translation: 闪电在货车周围炸开时，情景异常壮观。

meaning: v. 喜欢；想；愿意; prep. 像；如同; adj. 同样的；相似的; n. 爱好；同样的人或物; adv. 可能; conj. 好像
example: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
translation: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

meaning: adj. 很可能的；合适的；有希望的; adv. 很可能；或许
example: Very likely he'd told them he had American business interests.
translation: 很可能他已经告诉他们自己拥有美国商业利益.

meaning: n. 限制；限度；界线; v. 限制；限定
example: In some cases there is a mini-mum age limit.
translation: 有些情况下有最低年龄限制。

meaning: n. 路线，航线；排；绳; v. 排成一行；划线于；以线条标示；使…起皱纹
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: n. [计] 链环，环节；联系，关系; v. 连接，连结；联合，结合
example: He suggested a link between class size and test results of seven-year-olds.
translation: 他认为7岁大的学生的测试分数和班级的规模有关系。

meaning: n. 狮子；名人；勇猛的人；社交场合的名流
example: A man-eating lion is on the loose somewhere in England.
translation: 英格兰有一头吃人的狮子跑出来了。

meaning: n. 嘴唇；边缘; vt. 以嘴唇碰; adj. 口头上的; vi. 用嘴唇
example: She had quite severe bruising and a cut lip.
translation: 她身上有严重的淤伤，嘴唇也破了。

meaning: adj. 液体的；清澈的；明亮的；易变的; n. 液体，流体；流音
example: We found a cyst and I suctioned off the liquid within.
translation: 我们发现了一个囊肿，我把其中的液体吸了出来。

meaning: n. [计] 列表；清单；目录; v. 列于表上
example: A list of items is repeatedly flashed up on the screen.
translation: 一个选项列表反复出现在屏幕上。

meaning: v. 听，倾听；听从，听信; n. 听，倾听
example: When I asked him to stop, he would not listen.
translation: 我叫他停下，可他不听。

meaning: adj. 文学的；书面的；精通文学的
example: Her literary criticism focuses on the way great literature suggests ideas.
translation: 她的文学批评集中关注的是伟大的文学作品表达思想的方式。

meaning: n. 文学；文献；文艺；著作
example: He was well acquainted with the literature of France, Germany and Holland.
translation: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

meaning: n. [计量] 公升（米制容量单位）
example: New Japanese cars averaged 13 km to the litre in 1981.
translation: 1981年，新型的日产汽车平均每升汽油能跑13千米。

meaning: n. 垃圾；轿，担架；一窝（动物的幼崽）；凌乱; v. 乱丢；给…垫褥草；把…弄得乱七八糟
example: On Wednesday we cleared a beach and woodland of litter.
translation: 星期三我们清理了一块海滨林地的垃圾。

meaning: adj. 小的；很少的；短暂的；小巧可爱的; adv. 完全不; n. 少许；没有多少；短时间
example: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
translation: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

meaning: adj. 活的；生动的；实况转播的；精力充沛的; v. 经历；度过; n. (Live)人名；(法)利夫
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: adj. 活泼的；生动的；真实的；生气勃勃的; n. (Lively)人名；(英)莱夫利
example: Their 4-1 win in Honduras was a particularly lively affair.
translation: 他们在洪都拉斯以4比1获胜的那场比赛尤其激动人心。

meaning: adj. 活的；现存的；活跃的；逼真的; n. 生活；生存；生计; v. 生活；居住（live的ing形式）；度过
example: If you're not satisfied with the life you're living, don't just complain. Do something about it.
translation: 对于现况的不满，不能只是抱怨，要有作出改变。

meaning: n. 负载，负荷；工作量；装载量; v. [力] 加载；装载；装货
example: His people came up with a load of embarrassing information.
translation: 他的部下亮出一大堆令人尴尬的资料来。

meaning: n. 条，一条面包；块；游荡; v. 游荡；游手好闲；虚度光阴
example: The proposal could put 3p on a loaf of bread.
translation: 这项提议会使每个面包的成本增加3便士。

meaning: n. [计] 局部；当地居民；本地新闻; adj. 当地的；局部的；地方性的；乡土的
example: There has been a busy start to polling in today's local elections.
translation: 今天地方选举的投票一开始就人头攒动。

meaning: v. 锁，锁上；隐藏; n. 锁；水闸；刹车
example: She shrugged a stray lock of hair out of her eyes.
translation: 她把一缕散发从眼前甩开。

meaning: n. [植保] 蝗虫，[昆] 蚱蜢
example: This illustration shows a vertical section through the locust.
translation: 本图所示为蝗虫的纵剖面.

meaning: n. 伦敦
example: Their ears were still attuned to the sounds of the London suburb.
translation: 他们依然很熟悉伦敦市郊的喧闹声。

meaning: adj. 寂寞的；偏僻的; n. 孤独者
example: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
translation: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

meaning: n. 长时间；[语] 长音节；（服装的）长尺寸；长裤; adj. 长的；过长的；做多头的；长时间的；冗长的，长音; v. 渴望；热望; adv. 长期地；始终
example: The road to peace will be long and drawn-out.
translation: 通往和平的道路将很漫长。

meaning: v. 看；期待；注意；面向；看上去像; n. 看；样子；面容
example: It was just then that I chanced to look round.
translation: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。

meaning: adj. 宽松的；散漫的；不牢固的；不精确的; v. 释放；开船；放枪; adv. 松散地; n. 放纵；放任；发射
example: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
translation: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

meaning: n. （英）卡车；[车辆] 货车；运料车
example: He looked straight ahead and overtook a lumbering lorry.
translation: 他眼睛直视前方，加速超过了前面一辆慢吞吞行进的大卡车。

meaning: v. 浪费；使沉溺于；使迷路；遗失；错过; n. (Lose)人名；(英)洛斯；(德)洛泽
example: Some battles you win, some battles you lose.
translation: 胜败乃兵家常事。

meaning: n. 减少；亏损；失败；遗失
example: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
translation: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

meaning: adj. 失去的；丧失的；迷惑的; v. 遗失（lose的过去分词）；失败
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: n. 份额；许多；命运；阄; adv. （与形容词和副词连用）很，非常；（与动词连用）非常; pron. 大量，许多; v. 分组，把…划分（常与out连用）；把（土地）划分成块
example: I got quite a lot of ribbing from my team-mates.
translation: 队友们经常开我的玩笑。

meaning: adj. 大声的，高声的；不断的；喧吵的; adv. 大声地，高声地，响亮地; n. (Loud)人名；(英)劳德
example: There was a loud thump as the horse crashed into the van.
translation: 马撞在货车上发出砰的一声巨响。

meaning: adv. 大声地，响亮地
example: Sue screamed, not loudly, more in surprise than terror.
translation: 休尖叫起来，声音不大，吃惊多于恐惧。

meaning: n. 喇叭，扬声器；扩音器
example: I distinctly heard the loudspeaker calling passengers for the Turin-Amsterdam flight.
translation: 我清楚地听到扩音器里在请都灵至阿姆斯特丹航班的旅客登机。

meaning: n. 休息室；闲逛；躺椅；（英）酒吧间; v. 闲逛；懒洋洋地躺卧；闲混
example: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
translation: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

meaning: n. 恋爱；亲爱的；酷爱；喜爱的事物；爱情，爱意；疼爱；热爱；爱人，所爱之物; v. 爱，热爱；爱戴；赞美，称赞；喜爱；喜好；喜欢；爱慕
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: adj. 可爱的；令人愉快的；爱恋的；秀丽的，优美的; n. 美女；可爱的东西
example: Sweden is lovely in summer— cold beyond belief in winter.
translation: 瑞典的夏天非常宜人——冬天却冷得让人难以置信。

meaning: adj. 低的，浅的；卑贱的；粗俗的；消沉的; adv. 低声地；谦卑地，低下地; n. 低；低价；低点；牛叫声; v. 牛叫
example: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
translation: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

meaning: n. 运气；幸运；带来好运的东西; v. 靠运气，走运；凑巧碰上
example: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
translation: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

meaning: adj. 幸运的；侥幸的
example: Chantal was lucky to be able to salvage her career.
translation: 尚塔尔能保住她的事业算是走了运。

meaning: n. 行李；皮箱
example: He waited until all the luggage was cleared, but Paula's never appeared.
translation: 他一直等到所有的行李都拿走了，但始终没看见葆拉的。

meaning: n. 午餐; v. 吃午餐；供给午餐
example: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
translation: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

meaning: n. 肺；呼吸器
example: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
translation: 吸烟导致每年有1万人死于慢性肺病。

meaning: n. 机械，机器；机构；机械般工作的人; v. 用机器制造
example: Planes dropped bombs and raked the beach with machine gun fire.
translation: 飞机投下炸弹，并用机关枪扫射海滩。

meaning: adj. 疯狂的；发疯的；愚蠢的；着迷的; n. 狂怒
example: There are certain things he does that drive me mad.
translation: 他的某些举动让我很生气。

meaning: n. 夫人；女士；鸨母
example: Sue is a thoroughly precocious little madam if ever there was one.
translation: 休确实是个少见的早熟的小丫头。

meaning: n. 杂志；弹药库；胶卷盒
example: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
translation: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

meaning: n. 巫术；魔法；戏法; adj. 不可思议的；有魔力的；魔术的
example: It infected them with some of the magic of a lost age.
translation: 逝去的岁月让他们平添了几分魅力。

meaning: n. 女仆；少女; vt. 侍候；做新娘的女傧相; vi. 当女仆
example: The maid looked at him, a nervous smile on her face.
translation: 女服务员看着他，脸上带着一丝局促不安的微笑。

meaning: n. 邮件；邮政，邮递；盔甲; v. 邮寄；给…穿盔甲
example: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
translation: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

meaning: n. 邮箱；邮筒
example: An old mailbox has been padlocked shut.
translation: 一个旧信箱被挂锁锁着。

meaning: n. 主要部分，要点；体力；总管道; adj. 主要的，最重要的；全力的
example: The study links the main living area to the kitchen.
translation: 书房把主要的生活区与厨房连在一起。

meaning: n. 大陆；本土; adj. 大陆的；本土的
example: The island may be reached by boat from the mainland.
translation: 这个岛屿可以从大陆乘小船到达。

meaning: adj. 主要的；重要的；主修的；较多的; n. [人类] 成年人；主修科目；陆军少校; v. 主修
example: The seven major industrial countries will have their yearly meeting in London.
translation: 7个主要工业国家将在伦敦举行一年一度的会议。

meaning: n. 多数；成年
example: Independent candidates won the majority of seats on the local council.
translation: 无党派候选人在地方议会选举中赢得了多数席位。

meaning: v. 使得；进行；布置，准备，整理；制造；认为；获得；形成；安排；引起；构成; n. 制造；构造；性情
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: adj. 男性的；雄性的；有力的; n. 男人；雄性动物
example: The army is still one of the last male bastions.
translation: 军队仍然是男人占据的最后堡垒之一。

meaning: n. 人；男人；人类；丈夫；雇工; v. 操纵；给…配置人员；使增强勇气；在…就位
example: She ran away with a man called McTavish last year.
translation: 去年，她和一个叫麦克塔维什的男人私奔了。

meaning: v. 管理；经营；控制；设法
example: We'll manage somehow, you and me. I know we will.
translation: 我和你，我们总能应付过去的。我知道我们会的。

meaning: n. 经理；管理人员
example: I want the manager'sjob when he calls it a day.
translation: 等到经理不干了之后，我想接替他的位子。

meaning: n. 人类；男性
example: Mankind's knowledge of the universe has increased beyond measure.
translation: 人类对于宇宙的了解已经大为增加。

meaning: n. 方式；习惯；种类；规矩；风俗
example: There was much curiosity about what manner of man he was.
translation: 他究竟是什么样的人，大家都十分好奇。

meaning: pron. 许多；许多人; adj. 许多的; n. (Many)人名；(法)马尼
example: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: v. 映射；计划；绘制地图；确定基因在染色体中的位置; n. 地图；示意图；染色体图
example: We drove east to Rostock, where my map led me astray.
translation: 我们驱车向东去罗斯托克，但地图却给我指错了方向。

meaning: n. 枫树；淡棕色
example: Early settlers built frames of spruce, maple and pine.
translation: 早期的定居者用云杉木、枫木和松木建造屋架。

meaning: n. 马拉松赛跑；耐力的考验; adj. 马拉松式的；有耐力的; vi. 参加马拉松赛跑
example: Rodgers can also claim four victories in the New York Marathon.
translation: 罗杰斯也能在纽约马拉松比赛中4次夺冠。

meaning: n. 大理石；大理石制品；弹珠; adj. 大理石的；冷酷无情的
example: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.
translation: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。

meaning: n. 三月
example: The unevenly matched armies met at Guilford on 15 March 1781.
translation: 1781年3月15日，力量悬殊的两支队伍在吉尔福德狭路相逢。

meaning: v. （坚定地向某地）前进；行军，进军；游行示威；进展，进行; n. 行进，前进；行军；游行示威；进行曲
example: The unevenly matched armies met at Guilford on 15 March 1781.
translation: 1781年3月15日，力量悬殊的两支队伍在吉尔福德狭路相逢。

meaning: n. 标志；马克；符号；痕迹；分数; v. 作记号
example: Mark had for some time been making advances towards her.
translation: 马克追她已经有一段时间了。

meaning: n. 市场；行情；股票市场；市面；集市；销路；商店; v. 在市场上出售
example: Like a good businessman, Stewart identified a gap in the market.
translation: 像精明的商人一样，斯图尔特发现了市场上的一个空白。

meaning: n. 结婚；婚姻生活；密切结合，合并
example: After a three-weekend courtship, Pamela accepted Randolph's proposal of marriage.
translation: 经过3个周末的追求之后，帕梅拉接受了伦道夫的求婚。

meaning: adj. 已婚的，有配偶的；婚姻的，夫妇的；密切结合的; n. 已婚者; v. 结婚，与…结婚（marry的过去式）
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: v. 嫁；娶；与……结婚; n. (Marry)人名；(阿拉伯)马雷；(法)马里
example: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
translation: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

meaning: n. 面具；口罩；掩饰; v. 掩饰；戴面具；化装
example: But as with other charitable bodies, these figures mask the true picture.
translation: 但和其他慈善机构一样，这些数字掩盖了实情。

meaning: n. 块，团；群众，民众；大量，众多；质量; adj. 群众的，民众的；大规模的，集中的; v. 聚集起来，聚集
example: On his desk is a mass of books and papers.
translation: 他的书桌上有大堆的书籍和文件。

meaning: v. 控制；精通；征服; n. 硕士；主人；大师；教师; adj. 主人的；主要的；熟练的
example: I fell under the influence of a history master.
translation: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

meaning: n. 垫；垫子；衬边; v. 缠结；铺席于……上; adj. 无光泽的
example: She touched the thick mat of sandy hair on his chest.
translation: 她摸着他那浓密的淡棕色胸毛。

meaning: v. 使比赛；使相配；敌得过，比得上；相配；与…竞争; n. 比赛，竞赛；匹配；对手；火柴
example: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
translation: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

meaning: adj. 重要的；物质的，实质性的；肉体的; n. 材料，原料；物资；布料
example: The material consisted only of already published, unclassified information.
translation: 这份材料里只有一些已公开的、非保密性质的信息。

meaning: n. 数学；数学运算
example: The degree provides a thorough grounding in both mathematics and statistics.
translation: 该学位课程将为数学和统计学打下扎实的基础。

meaning: n. 物质；事件; v. 有关系；要紧
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 成熟的；充分考虑的；到期的；成年人的; v. 成熟；到期
example: These plants are then pollinated and allowed to mature and produce seed.
translation: 然后，这些植物就被授粉，从而成熟结籽。

meaning: n. [数] 极大，最大限度；最大量; adj. 最高的；最多的；最大极限的
example: Twelve hours is the minimum, sixty hours the maximum.
translation: 12小时为下限,60小时为上限.

meaning: n. 五月
example: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
translation: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

meaning: aux. 可以，能够；可能，也许；祝，愿；会，能
example: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
translation: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

meaning: adv. 也许；可能；大概; n. 可能性；不确定性
example: Maybe I eat too much and that's what makes me dozy.
translation: 也许我吃得太多了，所以昏昏欲睡。

meaning: pron. 我（宾格）; n. 自我；极端自私的人；自我的一部分
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: n. 一餐，一顿饭；膳食; vi. 进餐
example: We had a nice meal with a bottle of champagne.
translation: 我们美餐了一顿，还喝了一瓶香槟。

meaning: adj. 平均的；卑鄙的；低劣的；吝啬的; v. 意味；想要；意欲; n. 平均值
example: "What do you mean?" I asked, offended on Liddie's behalf.
translation: “你什么意思啊？”我问，替利迪感到愤愤不平。

meaning: n. 意义；含义；意图; adj. 意味深长的; v. 意味；意思是（mean的ing形式）
example: Politicians have debased the meaning of the word "freedom"
translation: 政客们贬低了“自由”一词的意义。

meaning: n. 手段；方法；财产; v. 意思是；打算（mean的第三人称单数） [ 复数means ]
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: adv. 同时，其间; n. 其间，其时
example: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water.
translation: 同时，把碗置于微沸的水上，将白巧克力放入碗中使其熔化。

meaning: n. 测量；措施；程度；尺寸; v. 测量；估量；权衡
example: The colonies were claiming a larger measure of self-government.
translation: 殖民地正要求获得更大程度上的自治。

meaning: n. 肉，肉类（食用）
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. 勋章，奖章；纪念章
example: It was an unbelievable moment when Chris won the gold medal.
translation: 克里斯赢得金牌的那一刻令人不可思议。

meaning: n. 媒体；媒质（medium的复数）；血管中层；浊塞音；中脉
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: adj. 医学的；药的；内科的; n. 医生；体格检查
example: Ann Bradley dispels the old wives' tales and gives the medical facts.
translation: 安·布拉德利破除迷信，给出了医学事实。

meaning: n. 药；医学；内科；巫术; v. 用药物治疗；给…用药
example: Traditionally young Asians in Britain have gravitated towards medicine, law and engineering.
translation: 英国的亚裔年轻人通常被吸引到医学、法律及工程专业。

meaning: adj. 中间的，中等的；半生熟的; n. 方法；媒体；媒介；中间物
example: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

meaning: v. 满足；遇见；对付; n. 集会; adj. 合适的；适宜的
example: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
translation: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

meaning: n. 会议；会见；集会；汇合点; v. 会面；会合（meet的ing形式）
example: We'll go to a meeting in Birmingham and come straight back.
translation: 我们将去伯明翰参加会议，然后马上回来。

meaning: n. 瓜；甜瓜；大肚子；圆鼓鼓像瓜似的东西
example: Next, she disembowelled a melon with a quiet fury.
translation: 接着，她闷着头愤愤地掏空瓜瓤。

meaning: n. 成员；会员；议员
example: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
translation: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

meaning: n. 纪念碑，纪念馆；纪念仪式；纪念物; adj. 记忆的；纪念的，追悼的
example: The Memorial seems almost ugly, dominating the landscape for miles around.
translation: 那座纪念碑耸立在方圆数英里景致之中显得近乎难看。

meaning: v. 记住，背熟；记忆
example: I don't try to memorize speeches word for word.
translation: 我不会试图一字不落地记住讲话要说的内容。

meaning: n. 记忆，记忆力；内存，[计] 存储器；回忆
example: "His memory must be completely back, then?" — "Just about."
translation: “这么说，他的记忆一定是完全恢复了？”——“差不多。”

meaning: v. 修理，修补；改善；修改; n. 好转，改进；修补处
example: I felt that might well mend the rift between them.
translation: 我觉得那样做也许可以让他们冰释前嫌。

meaning: adj. 精神的；脑力的；疯的; n. 精神病患者
example: The woman will be confined to a mental institution.
translation: 这个女人将被关进精神病院。

meaning: adv. 精神上，智力上；心理上
example: Bears are very inquisitive and must be kept mentally stimulated.
translation: 熊非常好奇，必须不断地给予其智力上的刺激。

meaning: v. 提到，谈到；提及，论及；说起; n. 提及，说起
example: His immediate superior has singled him out for a special mention.
translation: 他的顶头上司特别提到了他。

meaning: n. 菜单
example: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
translation: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

meaning: n. 商人，批发商；店主; adj. 商业的，商人的
example: The ride was smooth until they got into the merchant ship's wake.
translation: 航行一直很顺利，直到他们碰上了商船的尾流。

meaning: adj. 仁慈的；慈悲的；宽容的
example: Eventually the session came to a merciful end.
translation: 这次开庭的最终结果令人庆幸。

meaning: n. 仁慈，宽容；怜悯；幸运；善行
example: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
translation: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

meaning: adv. 仅仅，只不过；只是
example: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
translation: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

meaning: adj. 愉快的；微醉的；嬉戏作乐的; n. 甜樱桃
example: I just wanted to wish you a merry Christmas.
translation: 我只想祝福你圣诞快乐。

meaning: n. 混乱；食堂，伙食团；困境；脏乱的东西; v. 弄乱，弄脏；毁坏；使就餐
example: England's European Championship plans are in a right mess.
translation: 英格兰队的欧洲锦标赛作战计划乱七八糟。

meaning: n. 消息；差使；启示；预言；广告词; v. 报信，报告；[通信] 报文
example: The delegation was carrying a message of thanks to President Mubarak.
translation: 代表团向穆巴拉克总统转达了谢意。

meaning: adj. 凌乱的，散乱的；肮脏的，污秽的；麻烦的
example: Applying the dye can be messy, particularly on long hair.
translation: 涂抹染发剂可能会搞得一团糟，特别是长发。

meaning: n. 金属；合金; v. 以金属覆盖; adj. 金属制的
example: Light fittings with metal parts should always be earthed.
translation: 有金属部件的照明装置都应该走地线。

meaning: n. 方法；条理；类函数; adj. 使用体验派表演方法的
example: He succeeded with the aid of a completely new method he discovered.
translation: 借助于自己发现的一种全新的方法，他获得了成功。

meaning: n. 米；公尺；韵律
example: Prices start at £13.95 a metre for printed cotton.
translation: 印花棉布以每米13.95英镑的价格起售。

meaning: adj. 墨西哥的；墨西哥人的; n. 墨西哥人；墨西哥语
example: Mexican cookery is economical, she says. Nothing goes to waste.
translation: “墨西哥的烹调注重俭省，”她说，“任何东西都不会浪费。”

meaning: n. 墨西哥
example: In New Mexico all kinds of cuisines are represented.
translation: 在新墨西哥州，有各种各样的烹饪方法。

meaning: n. 微电脑；[计] 微型计算机
example: Status flags represent one of the simplest forms of microcomputer logic.
translation: 状态标志是微计算机逻辑中的一种最简单的形式之一.

meaning: n. 显微镜
example: We aimed the microscope at a likely looking target.
translation: 我们把显微镜对准了一个看起来合适的目标。

meaning: n. 微波
example: In a large microwave-proof dish, melt butter for 20 seconds.
translation: 让黄油在微波适用的大盘子里熔化20秒钟。

meaning: n. 中午；正午; adj. 正午的
example: The brothers usually roll into their studio around midday.
translation: 兄弟几个总是要到正午前后才姗姗来到工作室。

meaning: adj. 中间的，中部的；中级的，中等的; n. 中间，中央；腰部
example: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday.
translation: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。

meaning: n. 午夜，半夜12点钟; adj. 半夜的；漆黑的
example: He fell asleep just past midnight with tolerable ease.
translation: 他刚过午夜就睡着了，睡得还算安稳。

meaning: n. 力量；威力；势力; v. 可以；或许（may的过去式）；应该; aux. 可能；也许
example: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
translation: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

meaning: adj. 温和的；轻微的；淡味的；文雅的；不含有害物质的的; n. （英国的一种）淡味麦芽啤酒
example: His captaincy of the team was ended by mild eye trouble.
translation: 他由于患轻度眼疾而不再担任队长一职。

meaning: n. 英里；一英里赛跑；较大的距离
example: The President is determined "to go the extra mile for peace".
translation: 总统决心“为实现和平而加倍努力”。

meaning: n. 牛奶；乳状物; v. 榨取；挤…的奶
example: As the baby suckles, a further supply of milk is generated.
translation: 婴儿吮吸时，会有更多的奶水流出来。

meaning: n. 百万；无数; adj. 百万的；无数的; num. 百万
example: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
translation: 3亿美元远远不够。

meaning: n. 百万富翁；大富豪; adj. 100万以上人口的
example: His catering business made him a millionaire at 41.
translation: 他的饮食服务公司使他在41岁成了百万富翁。

meaning: n. 理智，精神；意见；智力；记忆力; v. 介意；专心于；照料
example: The opportunity had gone. His mind scrabbled for alternatives.
translation: 机会已经失去。他苦苦思索别的方案。

meaning: n. 矿，矿藏；矿山，矿井；地雷，水雷; v. 开采，采掘；在…布雷; pron. 我的
example: I shall have words with these stupid friends of mine!
translation: 我真应该跟我这些愚蠢的朋友理论理论！

meaning: n. 矿物；（英）矿泉水；无机物；苏打水（常用复数表示）; adj. 矿物的；矿质的
example: The mineral is weakly magnetic.
translation: 这种矿物带有轻微的磁性。

meaning: n. 面包车（等于microbus）；小型公共汽车；中客车; vi. 乘中客车
example: He was then taken by minibus to the military base.
translation: 他随后被一辆中巴车带到了军事基地。

meaning: n. 最小值；最低限度；最小化；最小量; adj. 最小的；最低的
example: Many of Britain's beaches fail to meet minimum standards of cleanliness.
translation: 英国许多海滩连最起码的卫生标准都达不倒。

meaning: n. 超短裙；迷你短裙
example: She walked off the plane in a miniskirt and tight top.
translation: 她身穿迷你裙和紧身上衣走下了飞机。

meaning: n. 部长；大臣；牧师; v. 执行牧师职务；辅助或伺候某人
example: The Prime Minister has been briefed by her parliamentary aides.
translation: 首相已听取了她议会助手的简要汇报。

meaning: n. （政府的）部门
example: The Ministry desperately tried to hush up the whole affair.
translation: 部里拼命想隐瞒整个事件。

meaning: n. 少数民族；少数派；未成年; adj. 少数的；属于少数派的
example: A minority of officers were prepared to bend the rules.
translation: 少数官员准备篡改规则。

meaning: prep. 减，减去; n. 负号，减号；不足；负数; adj. 减的；负的
example: The star's surface temperature is reckoned to be minus 75 degrees Celsius.
translation: 这颗恒星的表面温度估计在零下75摄氏度左右。

meaning: n. 分，分钟；片刻，一会儿；备忘录，笔记；会议记录; v. 将…记录下来; adj. 微小的，详细的 [maɪˈnjuːt; US -ˈnuːt; maɪˋnut]
example: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
translation: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

meaning: n. 镜子；真实的写照；榜样; v. 反射；反映
example: Light colours provide an effective backdrop for pictures or a mirror.
translation: 浅色是挂放图画或镜子很有效果的衬托。

meaning: n. 女士，小姐，年轻未婚女子
example: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
translation: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

meaning: n. 女士，小姐，年轻未婚女子
example: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
translation: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

meaning: n. 导弹；投射物; adj. 导弹的；可投掷的；用以发射导弹的
example: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.
translation: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。

meaning: n. 薄雾；视线模糊不清；模糊不清之物; v. 下雾；变模糊
example: I stepped outside and pulled up my collar against the cold mist.
translation: 我走出门，竖起衣领抵御冷雾。

meaning: n. 错误；误会；过失; v. 弄错；误解
example: make a mistake
translation: 犯错误

meaning: adj. 错误的；弄错的；被误解的; v. 弄错（mistake的过去分词）
example: You couldn't be more mistaken, Alex. You've utterly misread the situation.
translation: 亚历克斯，你真是大错特错，你对局势的判断根本不对。

meaning: v. 误解；误会
example: I'm not saying what he did was good, don't misunderstand me.
translation: 别误会，我并不是说他所做的是好事。

meaning: v. 配制；混淆；使混和；使结交; n. 混合；混合物；混乱
example: Stewart has developed a tendency to mix it verbally with the opposition.
translation: 斯图尔特现在变得只要和别人意见不合，就准备大吵一架。

meaning: n. 混合；混合物；混合剂
example: Liquidize the mixture and then pass it through a sieve.
translation: 将混合物打成泥状，然后用滤网滤一下。

meaning: abbr. 毫米（millimeter）; n. 缅甸的域名
example: Riyadh got 25 mm of rain in just 12 hours.
translation: 利雅得在12小时内降水就达25毫米。

meaning: adj. 可移动的；机动的；易变的；非固定的; n. 运动物体
example: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
translation: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。

meaning: n. 模型；典型；模范；模特儿；样式; v. 模拟；塑造；模仿; adj. 模范的；作模型用的
example: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: n. 调制解调器（等于modulator-demodulator）
example: He sent his work to his publishers by modem.
translation: 他通过网络把作品发给了出版商。

meaning: adj. 现代的，近代的；时髦的; n. 现代人；有思想的人
example: We are in one of the most severe recessions in modern times.
translation: 我们正在经历现代最严重的一段经济衰退。

meaning: adj. 谦虚的，谦逊的；适度的；端庄的；羞怯的; n. (Modest)人名；(罗)莫代斯特；(德)莫德斯特；(俄)莫杰斯特
example: Though his background was modest, it was in no sense deprived.
translation: 尽管他家境一般，但也并不贫穷。

meaning: n. 妈妈
example: soccer mom
translation: n. 足球妈妈；非常重视小孩休闲活动，亲自开车接送小孩参加运动，活动的母亲

meaning: n. 片刻，瞬间，时刻；重要，契机
example: I'll report back the moment I have located him.
translation: 我一找到他就马上汇报。

meaning: n. 妈咪
example: Mommy, you don't need to stay while we talk.
translation: 妈妈,我们谈话时你不必陪着.

meaning: n. 星期一
example: Wendy popped in for a quick bite to eat on Monday night.
translation: 温迪周一晚上过来匆匆吃了点儿饭。

meaning: n. 钱；货币；财富
example: I spent lots of money on smart new outfits for work.
translation: 我花大笔钱购置了上班时穿的漂亮新套装。

meaning: n. 监视器；监听器；监控器；显示屏；班长; v. 监控
example: Officials had not been allowed to monitor the voting.
translation: 以前不允许官员监督投票。

meaning: n. 猴子；顽童; v. 胡闹；捣蛋
example: The woolly spider monkey is the largest primate in the Americas.
translation: 绒毛蛛猴是美洲最大的灵长类动物。

meaning: n. 月，一个月的时间
example: One month before the deadline we see the hollowness of these promises.
translation: 离最后期限只有一个月时，我们认识到了这些许诺都是空头支票。

meaning: n. 纪念碑；历史遗迹；不朽的作品; vt. 为…树碑
example: As Wren's epitaph famously declares, the cathedral itself is his monument.
translation: 众所周知，雷恩的墓志铭中写道，大教堂本身就是他的纪念碑。

meaning: n. 月亮；月球；月光；卫星; v. 闲荡；出神
example: June always rhymes with moon in old love songs.
translation: 在老情歌中June总是和moon成韵。

meaning: v. 擦干；用拖把拖洗; n. 拖把；蓬松的头发；鬼脸
example: He was long-limbed and dark-eyed, with a mop of tight, dark curls.
translation: 他四肢修长、眼睛乌黑发亮，留着一头蓬乱浓密的黑色卷发。

meaning: adj. 道德的；精神上的；品性端正的; n. 道德；寓意
example: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: adv. 更多；此外；更大程度地; adj. 更多的；附加的; pron. 更多的数量; n. 更多
example: I don't want any more of that heavy stuff.
translation: 我再也不想碰那种麻烦事了。

meaning: n. 早晨；黎明；初期
example: A Delta II rocket was launched from Cape Canaveral early this morning.
translation: 今天一早，一枚“德尔塔”Ⅱ型火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。

meaning: n. 莫斯科（俄罗斯首都）
example: Lithuania is heavily reliant on Moscow for almost all its oil.
translation: 立陶宛的石油供应几乎完全依赖莫斯科。

meaning: adj. 穆斯林的；伊斯兰教的；回教的; n. 穆斯林；穆罕默德信徒；伊斯兰
example: Moslem women used to veil their faces before going into public.
translation: 信奉伊斯兰教的妇女出门之前往往用面纱把脸遮起来.

meaning: n. 蚊子
example: I threw aside my mosquito net and jumped out of bed.
translation: 我把蚊帐甩到一边，跳下床来。

meaning: adv. 最；非常，极其；最多；几乎; adj. 大部分的，多数的；最多的; n. 大部分，大多数
example: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
translation: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

meaning: n. 母亲；大娘；女修道院院长; v. 生下；养育；像母亲般关怀或照管; adj. 母亲的；出生地的
example: Mrs Allen's style of cooking owes much to her mother-in-law.
translation: 艾伦太太的烹饪风格很大程度上承传于她的婆婆。

meaning: n. 祖国；母国
example: He devoted his life to the educational cause of the motherland.
translation: 他为祖国的教育事业贡献了一生.

meaning: n. 动机；积极性；推动
example: He admitted a lack of motivation and a feeling of sloth.
translation: 他承认自己缺乏动力，总想犯懒。

meaning: n. 发动机，马达；汽车; adj. 汽车的；机动的; v. 乘汽车
example: Many motor accidents are the result of unthinkingly mixing speed and alcohol.
translation: 许多机动车事故都是不计后果地酒后开快车造成的。

meaning: n. 摩托车
example: Richardson severed his right foot in a motorbike accident.
translation: 理查森在一次摩托车事故中失去了他的右脚。

meaning: n. 摩托车；机动车; v. 骑摩托车
example: The gunman escaped on a motorcycle being ridden by an accomplice.
translation: 持枪歹徒坐上一辆由同伙驾驶的摩托车逃逸。

meaning: n. 座右铭，格言；箴言
example: Our motto is "Plan for the worst and hope for the best".
translation: 我们的格言是“做最坏的打算，抱最大的希望”。

meaning: n. 山；山脉
example: I'll run over to Short Mountain and check on Mrs Adams.
translation: 我会开车去肖特山看看亚当斯夫人。

meaning: adj. 多山的；巨大的；山一般的
example: The plan is designed to reduce some of the company's mountainous debt.
translation: 该计划旨在减少公司堆积如山的债务。

meaning: v. 哀悼；忧伤；服丧
example: When the government is finally brought down, no one will mourn its passing.
translation: 当政府最终垮台之日，将不会有人为它的消亡而悲哀。

meaning: n. 鼠标；老鼠；胆小羞怯的人; v. 探出
example: Use your mouse to drag the pictures to their new size.
translation: 用鼠标拖动图片，将其调整为新的尺寸。

meaning: n. 小胡子；髭；触须
example: He was short and bald and had a moustache.
translation: 他个头不高，秃顶，留着八字胡。

meaning: n. 口，嘴；河口; v. 做作地说，装腔作势地说；喃喃地说出
example: A thorough brushing helps to freshen up your mouth.
translation: 彻底刷牙有助于口气清新。

meaning: n. 一口，满口
example: Savour the flavour of each mouthful, and chew your food well.
translation: 细细品尝每一口的味道，充分咀嚼。

meaning: n. 移动；步骤；迁居；策略; v. 移动；搬家，迁移；离开
example: So, if we could just move onto something else?
translation: 那么我们可不可以干脆谈点别的？

meaning: n. 运动；活动；运转；乐章
example: Monks shave their heads, as do devotees of the Hare Krishna movement.
translation: 和尚要剃度，克利须那派教徒也一样。

meaning: n. 电影；电影院；电影业; adj. 电影的
example: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.
translation: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。

meaning: adv. 非常，很; adj. 大量的; n. 许多，大量; pron. 许多，大量
example: Mrs Allen's style of cooking owes much to her mother-in-law.
translation: 艾伦太太的烹饪风格很大程度上承传于她的婆婆。

meaning: v. 弄脏；用泥涂; n. 泥；诽谤的话；无价值的东西
example: red mud
translation: 赤泥；红泥

meaning: adj. 泥泞的；模糊的；混乱的; v. 使污浊；使沾上泥；把…弄糊涂
example: The recent rain had churned up the waterfall into a muddy whirlpool.
translation: 最近的一场雨把瀑布搅成了泥水漩涡。

meaning: v. 乘；使增加；使繁殖；使相乘; adv. 多样地；复合地; adj. 多层的；多样的
example: Take the time in seconds, square it, and multiply by 5.12.
translation: 记下用了多少秒时间，将其平方，再乘以5.12。

meaning: v. 谋杀，凶杀; n. 谋杀，凶杀
example: 13 men have been questioned in connection with the murder.
translation: 有13名男子因谋杀案受到盘问。

meaning: n. 博物馆
example: The museum will have a permanent exhibition of 60 vintage cars.
translation: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

meaning: n. 蘑菇，伞菌；蘑菇形物体；暴发户; adj. 蘑菇的；蘑菇形的；迅速生长的; v. 迅速增加；采蘑菇；迅速生长
example: cream of mushroom soup
translation: 奶油蘑菇汤

meaning: n. 音乐，乐曲
example: He once told an interviewer that he didn't even like rock music.
translation: 他曾告诉一位采访者，他甚至都不喜欢摇滚乐。

meaning: adj. 音乐的；悦耳的; n. 音乐片
example: London's musical life might become as exciting as Berlin's.
translation: 伦敦的音乐生活可能会变得像柏林的一样令人兴奋。

meaning: n. 音乐家
example: He feels that he was destined to become a musician.
translation: 他觉得自己注定会成为一名音乐家。

meaning: aux. 必须，一定；可以，应当；很可能; n. 绝对必要的事物；未发酵葡萄汁
example: You must have noticed how tired he sometimes looks.
translation: 你一定注意到他有时候显得特别疲惫。

meaning: n. 芥末；芥菜；深黄色；强烈的兴趣
example: A little mustard is served on the side to add further piquancy.
translation: 边上备有一点芥末，可增加辣味。

meaning: n. 羊肉
example: He likes to eat mutton which was seasoned with garlic.
translation: 他喜欢吃用大蒜调味的羊肉.

meaning: pron. 我的; int. 哎呀（表示惊奇等）；喔唷; n. (My)人名；(越)美；(老、柬)米
example: The vowel in words like "my" and "thigh" is not very difficult.
translation: 单词my和thigh中的元音并不难发。

meaning: pron. 我自己；我亲自；我的正常的健康状况和正常情绪
example: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend'swife.
translation: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

meaning: v. 钉；使固定；揭露; n. [解剖] 指甲；钉子
example: He fought tooth and nail to keep his job.
translation: 他竭尽全力保住自己的工作。

meaning: n. 名称，名字；姓名；名誉; v. 命名，任命；指定；称呼；提名；叫出; adj. 姓名的；据以取名的
example: She has had many credits and name-checks in American Vogue.
translation: 美国版《时尚》多次对她进行赞扬或是提到她的名字。

meaning: adj. 狭窄的，有限的；勉强的；精密的；度量小的; n. 海峡；狭窄部分，隘路; v. 使变狭窄
example: Sailing boats lay at anchor in the narrow waterway.
translation: 帆船停泊在狭窄的水道上。

meaning: n. 国家；民族；国民
example: Albania is a small nation state of around 3 million people.
translation: 阿尔巴尼亚是一个大约有300万人口的单一民族独立国家。

meaning: adj. 国家的；国民的；民族的；国立的; n. 国民
example: Do you always have a bet on the Grand National?
translation: 你总是对全国赛马大会下点注吗？

meaning: n. 国籍，国家；民族；部落
example: Discrimination by employers on the grounds of race and nationality was illegal.
translation: 雇主以种族或国籍为由歧视员工是非法的。

meaning: adj. 全国范围的；全国性的; adv. 在全国
example: The ANC is about to launch a nationwide recruitment drive.
translation: 非洲国民大会打算在全国范围内发起招募运动。

meaning: adj. 本国的；土著的；天然的；与生俱来的；天赋的; n. 本地人；土产；当地居民
example: We were forbidden, under pain of imprisonment, to use our native language.
translation: 我们被禁止使用母语，违者将被关进监狱。

meaning: adj. 自然的；物质的；天生的；不做作的; n. 自然的事情；白痴；本位音
example: The ball is made of rattan — a natural fibre.
translation: 这个球是由一种天然纤维——省藤制成的。

meaning: n. 自然；性质；本性；种类
example: The nature of the polymer is currently a trade secret.
translation: 这一聚合物的性质目前是个商业机密。

meaning: n. 海军
example: The Navy is to carry out an examination of the wreck tomorrow.
translation: 海军明天将对失事船只进行细查。

meaning: adj. 近的；亲近的；近似的; adv. 近；接近; prep. 靠近；近似于
example: She is not herself. She came near to a breakdown.
translation: 她身体不舒服，简直要崩溃了。

meaning: adj. 附近的，邻近的; adv. 在附近; prep. 在…附近
example: At a nearby table a man was complaining in a loud voice.
translation: 邻桌的一位男士当时正高声地抱怨着。

meaning: adv. 差不多，几乎；密切地
example: It is nearly always women who are the primary care givers.
translation: 从事初级保健护理工作的几乎都是女性。

meaning: adj. 灵巧的；整洁的；优雅的；齐整的；未搀水的；平滑的
example: Neat solutions are not easily found to these issues.
translation: 很难找到解决这些问题的巧妙办法。

meaning: adj. 必要的；必需的；必然的; n. 必需品
example: For her, books were as necessary to life as bread.
translation: 对她来说，书就像面包一样，是生活必需品。

meaning: n. 脖子；衣领；海峡; v. 搂著脖子亲吻；变狭窄
example: He shouted at his brother, his neck veins bulging.
translation: 他朝他的兄弟吼叫，脖子上青筋暴突。

meaning: n. 项链
example: She was wearing the obligatory sweater and pearl necklace.
translation: 她穿着那件经常穿的毛衣，戴着那串惯常戴的珍珠项链。

meaning: n. 领带
example: He bought a fancy necktie.
translation: 他买了一条别致的领带.

meaning: n. 需要，要求；缺乏；必要之物; v. 需要
example: Do not wait for good things to happen to you. You need to walk towards happiness.
translation: 不要等待好事降临，你要向幸福进发。

meaning: n. 针；指针；刺激；针状物; v. 缝纫；做针线
example: She passed the needle through the rough cloth, back and forth.
translation: 她一针一针地缝那块粗布。

meaning: v. 谈判，商议；转让；越过
example: The driver failed to negotiate a bend and ran into a tree.
translation: 司机没能顺利拐弯，撞到了树上。

meaning: n. n邻居;同胞；仁慈的人; v. 邻接; adj. 邻居的；邻近的
example: The treaty binds them to respect their neighbour's independence.
translation: 条约规定他们必须尊重其邻国的独立。

meaning: n. 邻近；周围；邻居关系；附近一带
example: He was born and grew up in the Flatbush neighbourhood of Brooklyn.
translation: 他出生在布鲁克林的弗拉特布什一带，并在那儿长大成人。

meaning: conj. 也不；既不; adv. 两个都不；既不……也不; adj. 两者都不的; pron. 两者都不
example: The report concludes that I acted neither fraudulently nor improperly.
translation: 报告最后认为我的行为既没有欺骗性也没有任何不妥。

meaning: n. 侄子；外甥
example: "Cut her out of your will," urged his nephew.
translation: “把她从你的遗嘱中删去，”他的侄子催促道。

meaning: adj. 神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: n. 巢，窝；安乐窝；温床; v. 筑巢；嵌套
example: As soon as the two chicks hatch, they leave the nest burrow.
translation: 两只小鸟一出壳就离开了巢穴。

meaning: n. 网；网络；净利；实价; v. 编网; adj. 纯粹的；净余的
example: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net.
translation: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。

meaning: n. 网络；广播网；网状物
example: This film is the first British animation sold to an American network.
translation: 这是第一部出售给美国电视网的英国动画片。

meaning: adv. 从未；决不
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: adj. 新的，新鲜的；更新的；初见的; adv. 新近; n. (New)人名；(英)纽
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 新闻，消息；新闻报导
example: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities.
translation: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

meaning: n. 报纸
example: Under the newspaper, atop a sheet of paper, lay an envelope.
translation: 在报纸下面的一张纸上放着一个信封。

meaning: adv. 然后；下次；其次; adj. 下一个的；其次的；贴近的; n. 下一个; prep. 靠近；居于…之后
example: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
translation: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

meaning: adj. 精密的；美好的；细微的；和蔼的; n. (Nice)人名；(英)尼斯
example: "Ah, Captain Fox," Martin McGuinness said affably. "Nice to see you again."
translation: “啊，福克斯上尉，”马丁·麦吉尼斯亲切地说，“很高兴再次见到您。”

meaning: n. 外甥女，侄女
example: He looked affectionately at his niece.
translation: 他慈爱地看着他的侄女。

meaning: n. 夜晚，晚上；黑暗，黑夜; adj. 夜晚的，夜间的
example: Two men were helping police with their inquiries at Salisbury last night.
translation: 两名男子昨天夜里在索尔兹伯里接受了警方盘问。

meaning: n. 九，九个; num. 九；九个; adj. 九的，九个的
example: Seventy-nine voted in the affirmative, and none in the negative.
translation: 79人投赞成票，没有人投反对票。

meaning: num. 十九
example: He set off for a nineteen-day moose hunt in Nova Scotia.
translation: 他动身前往新斯科舍参加为时19天的驼鹿捕猎活动。

meaning: n. 九十; adj. 九十的；九十岁的; num. 九十
example: Almost ninety per cent of all rapes and violent assaults went unreported.
translation: 几乎90%的强奸案和暴力侵害案都没有报案。

meaning: num. 第九; adj. 第九的；九分之一的; n. 九分之一
example: By the ninth hour the car was running in eighth position.
translation: 到第9个小时的时候，这辆车位列第8。

meaning: adv. 不; adj. 没有；不是; n. 不；否决票; abbr. 数字（number）；元素锘（nobelium）的符号
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 高尚的；贵族的；惰性的；宏伟的; n. 贵族; vt. 抓住；逮捕
example: He had implicit faith in the noble intentions of the Emperor.
translation: 他对皇帝陛下高尚的动机深信不疑。

meaning: pron. 无人，没有人；没有任何人; n. 无名小卒；小人物
example: "Wait a damn minute," Mindy spat. "Nobody said anything about staying overnight."
translation: “该死的，等一下”，明迪愤愤地说道，“谁也没说过要过夜。”

meaning: n. 点头；打盹；摆动; v. 点头；点头表示
example: He turned with a little nod and I watched him walk away.
translation: 他边点了点头边转过身，我看着他走了。

meaning: n. [环境] 噪音；响声；杂音; v. 谣传
example: Sightseers may be a little overwhelmed by the crowds and noise.
translation: 拥挤的人群和喧闹的噪音可能会让游客有些茫然不知所措。

meaning: adv. 吵闹地，喧闹地
example: A pigeon emerges, wings flapping noisily, from the tower.
translation: 一只鸽子从塔里钻出来，扑扑地拍打着翅膀。

meaning: adj. 嘈杂的；喧闹的；聒噪的
example: Wind turbines are large and noisy and they disfigure the landscape.
translation: 风力涡轮机个头大、噪音响，还会破坏周边风景。

meaning: pron. 没有人；一个也没有；没有任何东西; adj. 没有的，一点没有的; adv. 决不，一点也不; n. (None)人名；(葡、罗)诺内；(日)野根(姓)
example: Seventy-nine voted in the affirmative, and none in the negative.
translation: 79人投赞成票，没有人投反对票。

meaning: n. 面条；笨蛋
example: They have two restaurants that purvey dumplings and chicken noodle soup.
translation: 他们那里有两家供应饺子和鸡肉汤面的餐馆。

meaning: n. 中午；正午；全盛期
example: There is a ceaseless struggle from noon to night.
translation: 从中午到夜晚，争斗没有停歇。

meaning: conj. 也不；也不是; adv. 也不；也没有; n. (Nor)人名；(中)挪(广东话·威妥玛)；(马来、俄)诺尔；(柬)诺
example: The report concludes that I acted neither fraudulently nor improperly.
translation: 报告最后认为我的行为既没有欺骗性也没有任何不妥。

meaning: adj. 正常的；正规的，标准的; n. 正常；标准；常态
example: Life has not yet returned to normal but we are getting there.
translation: 生活还没有恢复正常，不过就快了。

meaning: n. 北，北方; adj. 北方的；朝北的; adv. 在北方，向北方
example: Two trains collided head-on in north-eastern Germany early this morning.
translation: 今天早上德国东北部两列火车迎面相撞。

meaning: adj. 东北的；向东北的；来自东北的; n. 东北; adv. 向东北；来自东北
example: Snow in October is nothing strange in northeast China.
translation: 10月下雪在东北不是什么希罕的事.

meaning: adj. 北部的；北方的; n. 北部方言
example: The film takes no position on the politics of Northern Ireland.
translation: 这部电影未在北爱尔兰政治问题上选择站边。

meaning: adv. 向北
example: The path angled downhill and northwards.
translation: 小路向山下伸展，然后向北延伸。

meaning: adj. 西北的；向西北的；来自西北的; n. 西北; adv. 在西北；向西北；来自西北
example: The address is 2025 M Street, Northwest, Washington, DC, 20036.
translation: 地址为华盛顿特区，西北区，M大街2025号，邮政编码20036。

meaning: n. 鼻子；嗅觉；突出的部分；探问; v. 嗅；用鼻子触
example: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
translation: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

meaning: adv. 表示否定，不; n. “非”（计算机中逻辑运算的一种）
example: Success is not guaranteed. It is not handed to you. Success is earned.
translation: 成功无法保证，并非唾手可得。成功必须靠自己去争取。

meaning: n. 笔记；音符；票据；注解；纸币；便笺；照会；调子; v. 注意；记录；注解
example: Somehow he tells these stories without a note of horror.
translation: 不知为什么他讲这些故事时一点都不害怕。

meaning: n. 笔记本，笔记簿；手册
example: Tamsin materialized at her side, notebook at the ready.
translation: 塔姆辛从她身旁冒了出来，且备好了笔记本。

meaning: neg. 没什么；毫不; n. 无；零；不关紧要之事; adv. 毫不；决不; pron. 无事；无物; int. 什么也没有
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: n. 通知，布告；注意；公告; v. 通知；注意到；留心
example: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
translation: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

meaning: adj. 新奇的；异常的; n. 小说
example: The various elements of the novel fail to cohere.
translation: 这部小说的各部分之间缺乏连贯性。

meaning: n. 小说家
example: Faulkner has been hailed as the greatest American novelist of his generation.
translation: 福克纳被誉为他那一代人中最伟大的美国小说家。

meaning: n. 十一月
example: Troops were sent to the islands to restore order last November.
translation: 去年11月，军队被派往这些岛屿以恢复秩序。

meaning: adv. 现在；如今；立刻; adj. 现在的; n. 现在；目前; conj. 由于；既然
example: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
translation: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

meaning: adv. 现今；时下; n. 当今
example: You're miles better than most of the performers we see nowadays.
translation: 你比当下我们见到的大多数表演者都强多了。

meaning: adv. 无处；任何地方都不；毫无结果; n. 无处；任何地方；无名之地; adj. 不存在的；毫无结果的；不知名的
example: These rootless young people have nowhere else to go.
translation: 这些漂泊不定的年轻人没有其他地方可去。

meaning: adj. 原子能的；[细胞] 细胞核的；中心的；原子核的
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: v. 使麻木；使发愣；使失去感觉; adj. 麻木的；发愣的
example: He could feel his fingers growing numb at their tips.
translation: 他能感到指尖正在变得麻木。

meaning: n. 数；（杂志等的）期；号码；数字；算术; v. 计入；总数达到
example: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net.
translation: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。

meaning: v. 看护，护理；照顾；培养；给…喂奶; n. 护士；奶妈，保姆
example: "Can you walk all right?" the nurse asked him.
translation: “你走路有困难吗？”护士问他。

meaning: n. 苗圃；托儿所；温床
example: We have started a campaign for better nursery and school services.
translation: 我们已发起一场要求改善幼儿园和中小学教育服务的运动。

meaning: n. 护理；看护；养育; v. 看护；养育（nurse的ing形式）
example: He died in a nursing home at the age of 87.
translation: 他在一家养老院去世，享年87岁。

meaning: n. 螺母，螺帽；坚果；难对付的人，难解的问题; v. 采坚果
example: The Daily Express describes Dr Carey as a pretty tough nut.
translation: 《每日快报》把凯里医生说成是特别难对付的家伙。

meaning: n. 营养，营养学；营养品
example: advice on diet and nutrition
translation: 有关饮食和增加营养的建议

meaning: n. 尼龙，[纺] 聚酰胺纤维；尼龙袜
example: I slowly zipped and locked the heavy black nylon bags.
translation: 我慢慢地把那些沉重的黑色尼龙袋的拉链拉上并锁好。

meaning: v. 服从，听从；按照……行动; n. (Obey)人名；(英、法)奥贝
example: Clifford's only stipulation is that his clients obey his advice.
translation: 克利福德唯一的要求就是客户必须听从他的建议。

meaning: n. 目标；物体；客体；宾语; v. 提出…作为反对的理由
example: He thought of the baby almost as an inanimate object.
translation: 他认为婴儿几乎就是毫无生命的物体。

meaning: v. 庆祝
example: The Royal Greenwich Observatory was founded to observe and catalogue the stars.
translation: 当初创立皇家格林尼治天文台就是为了观察星体并对其进行编目。

meaning: v. 获得；流行
example: Only with mass direct action will we obtain such change.
translation: 只有采取大规模直接行动，我们才会取得这样的改变。

meaning: adj. 明显的；显著的；平淡无奇的
example: The ideological divisions between the parties aren't always obvious.
translation: 政党之间的意识形态界线并不总是泾渭分明的。

meaning: n. 职业；占有；消遣；占有期
example: Intellectual life in France was smothered by the occupation.
translation: 在被占领期间法国思想界受到了压制。

meaning: v. 发生；出现；存在
example: If these drugs are stopped abruptly then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
translation: 如果突然停服这些药，则可能出现一些戒断症状。

meaning: n. 大洋洲
example: Oceania is mainly made up of Australia and New Zealand.
translation: 大洋洲主要是由澳大利亚和新西兰组成的.

meaning: n. [天] 十月
example: By October 1990, when arrested, he was hopelessly in debt.
translation: 到1990年10月被捕时，他已经负债累累。

meaning: prep. 关于；属于；…的；由…组成的
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: prep. 离开；脱落; adv. 切断；走开; adj. 远离的；空闲的
example: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
translation: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

meaning: n. 犯罪；违反；过错；攻击
example: I didn't mean any offence. It was a flippant, off-the-cuff remark.
translation: 我本无意冒犯，那不过是句脱口而出的冒失话。

meaning: v. 提供；出价；试图; n. 提议；出价；意图；录取通知书
example: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
translation: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

meaning: n. 办公室；政府机关；官职；营业处
example: One of the office girls was down with the flu.
translation: 一位女职员得了流感。

meaning: n. 军官，警官；公务员，政府官员；船长; v. 指挥
example: He was returned to prison in 1977 for impersonating a police officer.
translation: 他1977年因冒充警官而再次入狱。

meaning: adj. 离岸的；[海洋] 近海的；吹向海面的; adv. 向海面，向海
example: When they hit the rocks, they were just 500 yards offshore.
translation: 他们触礁时离海岸仅有500码。

meaning: adv. 常常，时常
example: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
translation: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

meaning: int. 哦；哎呀（表示惊讶或恐惧等）
example: He goes to me: "Oh, what do you want?"
translation: 他问我：“哦，你想要什么？”

meaning: n. 油；石油；油画颜料; v. 加油；涂油；使融化
example: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

meaning: n. 油田
adj. 好的；不错的; adv. 行；很好; int. 好；可以; v. 对…表示同意; n. 同意
example: OK. Now, let's talk some business.
translation: 好了，我们现在言归正传吧。

meaning: adj. 陈旧的，古老的；年老的; n. 古时
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 煎蛋卷
example: Place the omelette under a gentle grill until the top is set.
translation: 将煎蛋饼放在烤架下用文火烘烤，直到表面凝固。

meaning: adv. 向前地；作用中，行动中；继续着; prep. 向，朝……；关于；在……之上；在……时候; adj. 开着的；发生着的，正在进行中; n. (On)人名；(日)温(姓、名)；(缅、柬、印)翁
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: adv. 一次；曾经; conj. 一旦; n. 一次，一回
example: It had once been the home of a wealthy nobleman.
translation: 这里曾是一个有钱贵族的宅邸。

meaning: pron. 一个人；任何人; adj. 一的；唯一的; n. 一; num. 一；一个
example: I have $100m hidden away where no one will ever find it.
translation: 我把1亿美元藏到了一个永远没人会找到的地方。

meaning: pron. 自己；亲自
example: The doll-like figures in these stories are unlike anybody, let alone oneself.
translation: 这些故事中的玩偶形象跟谁都不像，更不用说像自己了。

meaning: n. 洋葱；洋葱头
example: Fry for about 4 minutes, until the onion has softened.
translation: 煎4分钟左右，直到洋葱变软。

meaning: adv. 只，仅仅；不料; adj. 唯一的，仅有的；最合适的; conj. 但是；不过；可是
example: His house was the only settled home I had as a child.
translation: 他的房子是我儿时唯一固定的家。

meaning: prep. 在…之上；对…了解；映射到…上; adj. 映射的；自身的；映成的
example: Drop the dough onto a baking sheet with a teaspoon.
translation: 用茶匙把生面团舀到烤盘上。

meaning: adj. 公开的；敞开的；空旷的；坦率的；营业着的; v. 开始；展现; n. 公开；空旷；户外
example: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

meaning: n. [五金] 开启工具；开启的人
example: Travelling around India was a real eye-opener for me.
translation: 周游印度真让我开了眼界。

meaning: n. 开始；机会；通路；空缺的职位; adj. 开始的; v. 开放（open的ing形式）；打开；公开
example: He flipped through the post without opening any of it.
translation: 他飞快地翻了一下邮件，但一封也没有打开。

meaning: n. 歌剧；歌剧院；歌剧团
example: The following year she joined the Royal Opera House.
translation: 次年她加入了皇家歌剧院。

meaning: v. 运转；动手术；起作用
example: Hotels operate a collection service for their guests from the airports.
translation: 宾馆为客人提供机场接机服务。

meaning: n. 操作；经营；[外科] 手术；[数][计] 运算
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: n. 经营者；操作员；话务员；行家
example: A blade guard is fitted to protect the operator.
translation: 为保证操作人员的人身安全安装了桨叶保护罩。

meaning: n. 意见；主张
example: And what of the effect on U.S domestic opinion?
translation: 对美国国内的舆论有什么影响？

meaning: v. 反对；对抗，抗争
example: It is illogical to oppose the repatriation of economic migrants.
translation: 反对把经济移民遣送归国是不合逻辑的。

meaning: adj. 相反的；对面的；对立的; n. 对立面；反义词; prep. 在…的对面; adv. 在对面
example: The argument contained herein takes exactly the opposite point of view.
translation: 本文所持的论点恰恰是站在相反的立场。

meaning: adj. 乐观的；乐观主义的
example: Before his first round of discussions, Mr Baker sounded an optimistic note.
translation: 第一轮讨论前，贝克先生听上去还比较乐观。

meaning: adj. 可选择的，随意的; n. 选修科目
example: We also recommend a full day optional excursion to the Upper Douro.
translation: 我们还推荐去杜罗河上游的短途自选一日游。

meaning: conj. 或，或者；还是; n. (Or)人名；(中)柯(广东话·威妥玛)；(柬)奥；(土、匈、土库、阿塞、瑞典)奥尔
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 口头的，口述的; n. 口试
example: The story of King Arthur became part of oral tradition.
translation: 亚瑟王的故事成为口头传说的一部分。

meaning: adj. 橙色的；橘色的; n. 橙；橙色；桔子
example: Hybridising the two species will reduce the red to orange.
translation: 将这两个物种杂交后颜色会由红色淡化成橙色。

meaning: n. 轨道；眼眶；势力范围；生活常规; v. 盘旋；绕轨道运行
example: The planet is probably in orbit around a small star.
translation: 这颗行星可能正环绕着一颗小恒星运行。

meaning: n. 命令；顺序；规则；[贸易] 定单; v. 命令；整理；定购
example: The waiter returned with their order and Graham signed the bill.
translation: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。

meaning: adj. 普通的；平凡的；平常的; n. 普通；平常的人（或事）
example: It was just an ordinary voice, but he sang in tune.
translation: 他声音很一般，但唱得都在调子上。

meaning: n. [生物] 器官；机构；风琴；管风琴；嗓音
example: The patient'simmune system would reject the transplanted organ as a foreign object.
translation: 病人的免疫系统会对移植器官产生异质排斥反应。

meaning: v. 组织起来；组织工会
example: Zip drives help people to organise their important information.
translation: 压缩磁盘驱动器有助于人们管理重要信息。

meaning: n. 组织者；发起人；形成体（等于organizer）
n. 组织；机构；体制；团体
example: The term "organization" often connotes a sense of neatness.
translation: organization这个词常常让人想到整洁。

meaning: n. 起源；原点；出身；开端
example: There are some areas of wetland which are of ancient origin.
translation: 有一些湿地在古代就形成了。

meaning: adj. 其他的，另外的; pron. 另外一个
example: You can chat to other people who are online.
translation: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。

meaning: adv. 否则；另外；在其他方面; adj. 另外的；其他方面的；原本，本来; conj. 其他；如果不；然后
example: Was it just a temporary blip on an otherwise healthy growth curve?
translation: 这是否是原本良好的增长曲线中暂时的偏离？

meaning: n. 渥太华（加拿大首都）
example: A fast train does the journey to Ottawa in three hours.
translation: 快车在3小时以内走完去渥太华的旅程.

meaning: n. 扣环; int. 哎哟（突然疼痛时发出的声音）
example: Ouch. That hurt.
translation: 哎哟，好痛。

meaning: aux. 应该，应当；大概; vi. 应该，应当；大概
example: The money to build the power station ought to have been sufficient.
translation: 建设电站的资金本该足够了。

meaning: pron. 我们的
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: pron. 我们的; n. (Ours)人名；(法)乌尔斯
example: The world of the gods is anthropomorphic, an imitative projection of ours.
translation: 神界是拟人化的，是模仿我们人类世界的一个投影。

meaning: pron. 我们自己；我们亲自
example: We sat round the fire to keep ourselves warm.
translation: 我们围坐在火边取暖。

meaning: adv. 出现；在外；出局；出声地；不流行地; adj. 外面的；出局的；下台的; n. 出局; prep. 向；离去; v. 出来；暴露
example: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
translation: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

meaning: n. 结果，结局；成果
example: Jockeys are forbidden to bet on the outcome of races.
translation: 职业赛马骑师禁止对赛马结果下注。

meaning: adv. 在户外; n. 户外; adj. 户外的（等于outdoor）
example: Life in the great outdoors isn't supposed to be luxurious.
translation: 美好的户外活动不必很奢侈。

meaning: adj. 外面的，外部的；远离中心的; n. 环外命中
example: There is room for infill between the new outer suburbs.
translation: 在新建的远郊住宅区之间还有空地可以盖房。

meaning: adj. 对人友好的，开朗的；出发的，外出的；即将离职的；乐于助人的; n. 外出；流出；开支; v. 超过；优于（outgo的ing形式）
example: She arrived to receive the sash of office from the outgoing president.
translation: 她走上前去从即将离职的总统手中接过了就职腰带。

meaning: n. 远足；短途旅游；体育比赛; adj. 远足适用的; v. 出来；暴露（out的ing形式）
example: The gay and lesbian rights group, Stonewall, sees outing as completely unhelpful.
translation: 男女同性恋权益组织“石墙”认为公开揭露同性恋者身份毫无益处。

meaning: n. 轮廓；大纲；概要；略图; v. 概述；略述；描画…轮廓
example: He could see only the hazy outline of the goalposts.
translation: 他只能看见球门柱模糊的轮廓。

meaning: n. 输出，输出量；产量；出产; v. 输出
example: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.
translation: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

meaning: adj. 外面的，外部的；外来的; n. 外部；外观; adv. 在外面，向外面；在室外; prep. 在…范围之外
example: The President's unescorted vehicle was ambushed just outside the capital.
translation: 刚出首都，总统无人护卫的汽车就遭到了伏击。

meaning: adj. 坦率的，直言不讳的
example: She has made outspoken remarks about the legalisation of cannabis in Britain.
translation: 她对英国关于大麻的立法进行了大胆评论。

meaning: adj. 杰出的；显著的；未解决的；未偿付的; n. 未偿贷款
example: You have to pay your outstanding bill before joining the scheme.
translation: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。

meaning: adj. 向外的；外面的；公开的；外服的；肉体的; adv. 向外（等于outwards）；在外；显而易见地; n. 外表；外面；物质世界
example: Normally, such an outward display of affection is reserved for his mother.
translation: 通常，只有在母亲面前他的情感才会如此外露。

meaning: adj. 椭圆的；卵形的; n. 椭圆形；卵形
example: Congress is waiting to see how the Oval Office will react.
translation: 国会正观望总统方面的反应。

meaning: adv. 结束；越过；从头到尾; prep. 越过；在…之上；遍于…之上; adj. 结束的；上面的; vt. 越过; n. (Over)人名；(俄、西、土)奥韦尔
example: When the right woman comes along, this bad dream will be over.
translation: 当有合适的女人出现时，这种胡思乱想就会停止了。

meaning: n. 大衣，外套
example: It was freezing out there even in his buttoned-up overcoat.
translation: 外面非常冷，即使穿上大衣扣上扣子也不顶事。

meaning: v. 克服；胜过
example: Having identified the problem, the question arises of how to overcome it.
translation: 发现问题后，如何克服它的问题又出现了。

meaning: v. 忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上; n. 忽视；眺望
example: The owners don't want to overlook any opportunity to make a buck.
translation: 老板们不想错过任何可以赚钱的机会。

meaning: adj. 超重的；过重的; vt. 使负担过重; n. 超重
example: Classically, overweight people underestimate the volume of food that they consume.
translation: 一般来说，超重的人往往低估自己摄入食物的量。

meaning: v. 欠；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于; n. (Owe)人名；(瑞典、挪)奥弗
example: I'm broke, Livy, and I owe a couple of million dollars.
translation: 我破产了，莉薇，而且我欠了几百万美元的债。

meaning: v. 拥有；承认; adj. 自己的；特有的; n. 自己的
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: n. [经] 所有者；物主
example: The former owner had not left any forwarding address.
translation: 以前的房主没有留下任何转递地址。

meaning: n. 所有权；物主身份
example: Brazil says its constitution forbids the private ownership of energy assets.
translation: 巴西称其宪法禁止个人占有能源资产。

meaning: n. 牛；公牛
example: Seize a horse by the mane, and lead an ox by the nose.
translation: 马儿抓鬃牛牵鼻.

meaning: n. [化学] 氧气，[化学] 氧
example: Ozone is a highly reactive form of oxygen gas.
translation: 臭氧是一种非常活跃的氧气形态。

meaning: n. 一步；步速；步伐；速度; v. 踱步；缓慢而行
example: Interest rates would come down as the recovery gathered pace.
translation: 随着复苏的加速，利率会降下来。

meaning: adj. 太平洋的; n. 太平洋
example: pacific ocean
translation: n. 太平洋

meaning: n. 包装；一群；背包；包裹；一副; v. 包装；压紧；捆扎；挑选；塞满
example: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
translation: 我尽量言简意赅。

meaning: n. 包，包裹；套装软件，[计] 程序包; adj. 一揽子的; v. 打包；将…包装
example: Investors can apply for a package of shares at a set price.
translation: 投资者可以申购固定价格的股票组合。

meaning: n. 数据包，信息包；小包，小捆; vt. 包装，打包
example: You could save yourself a packet.
translation: 你能为自己省一大笔钱。

meaning: n. 划桨；明轮翼; v. 拌；搅；用桨划
example: We might be able to push ourselves across with the paddle.
translation: 我们也许可以用桨把自己推过去。

meaning: n. 页；记录；大事件，时期；男侍者; v. 给…标页码
example: The correct answers can be found at the bottom of page 8.
translation: 正确答案在第8页末尾。

meaning: n. 疼痛；努力; v. 使…痛苦；使…烦恼
example: I felt a sharp pain in my lower back.
translation: 我感觉到后腰一阵剧痛。

meaning: adj. 痛苦的；疼痛的；令人不快的
example: Economic reform will continue to be painful and ineffective.
translation: 经济改革仍将举步维艰，毫无成效。

meaning: v. 油漆；绘画；装饰；涂色于；描绘；（用语言，文字等）描写；擦脂粉等; n. 油漆；颜料，涂料；绘画作品；胭脂等化妆品；色彩，装饰
example: The walls have been horribly vandalized with spray paint.
translation: 墙上被人用喷漆涂得乱七八糟。

meaning: n. 画家；油漆匠
example: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
translation: 画家可能会对线条和形状进行夸大或扭曲。

meaning: n. 绘画；油画；着色; v. 绘画（paint的ing形式）；涂色于
example: Visitors see the painting from behind a plate glass window.
translation: 参观者隔着平板玻璃橱窗欣赏那幅画。

meaning: n. 一对，一双，一副; v. 把…组成一对
example: On the mantelpiece are a pair of bronze Ming vases.
translation: 壁炉台上是一对明代的青铜花瓶。

meaning: n. 宫殿；宅邸；豪华住宅
example: He recounted how heavily armed soldiers forced him from the presidential palace.
translation: 他讲述了自己是怎样被全副武装的士兵从总统官邸里赶出来的。

meaning: n. 平底锅；盘状的器皿；淘盘子，金盘，秤盘; v. 淘金；在浅锅中烹调（食物）；[非正式用语]严厉的批评
example: Put a pan of salted water on to boil.
translation: 将一锅盐水放上去煮。

meaning: n. 薄烤饼；粉饼；平降（全称pancake landing）; vi. 平坠着陆；平展; vt. 使平坠著陆；使平展
example: I started with the Viennese speciality frittatensuppe, or pancake soup.
translation: 我吃的第一道菜是维也纳特色菜鸡蛋饼汤，也叫炒饼汤。

meaning: n. 熊猫；猫熊
