translation: 我必须证明自己是个正派、稳重的人。

meaning: n.  祖国
example: The exiles had been cut off from all contact with their homeland.
translation: 流亡者被切断了与家乡的所有联系。

meaning: vt.  影响
example: Poor housing and family stress can affect both physical and mental health.
translation: 住房条件差、家庭压力大会影响身心两方面的健康。

meaning: adj.  聋的
example: I hope that our appeals will not fall on deaf ears.
translation: 我希望我们的呼吁不会没人理睬。

meaning: vt.  钦佩； 羡慕
example: I had to admire David's vow that he would leave the programme.
translation: 戴维发誓要离开这个项目，我不得不对他表示钦佩。

meaning: n.  病毒
example: influenza virus
translation: 流感病毒

meaning: vt.  使快乐， 逗乐
example: Their antics never fail to amuse.
translation: 他们滑稽的举止总是让人发笑。

meaning: v.   看见， 看到； 领会
example: Same faction players in stealth are seeable by any other player of that faction.
translation: 潜行玩家对同阵营的其它玩家可见.

meaning: n&v.  搜寻， 搜查
example: He's not a real searcher after truth.
translation: 他不是一个真正探求真理的人。

meaning: adj.  配备了家具的
example: be furnished with
translation: 提供，备有

meaning: n.  责任
example: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: adj.  突然的
example: Family values are suddenly the name of the game.
translation: 家庭价值观突然变得重要起来。

meaning: v.  欺骗； 做蠢事； 游手好闲; n. 傻子，蠢人，白痴
example: People always think I'm a fool, and I dare say they're right.
translation: 人们总认为我是个傻瓜，想必他们是对的。

meaning: adj.  国内的； 平民的； 民事的
example: The strike has taken on overtones of a civil rights campaign.
translation: 罢工带上了民权运动的意味。

meaning: prep.  靠近； 到…时； 被； 由； 以…的标准
example: Doctors are complaining about being barraged by drug-company salesmen.
translation: 医生们抱怨他们疲于应付医药公司的销售人员。

meaning: pron&conj.  谁
example: He was free to marry whomever he chose.
translation: 他看上了谁就可以和谁结婚。

meaning: vt.  指出， 显示
example: Ballpark estimates indicate a price tag of $90 million a month.
translation: 大致的估计费用为每月9,000万美元。

meaning: vt. 设置，调整；树立；摆放；日落; n.  一套； 设备
example: Old Tone Bao's daughter - in - law examined their fine seta of eggs.
translation: 四大娘看自家的五张“布子”.

meaning: v. 收费；指控；索价；充电; n.  费用， 价钱
example: But legal experts are not sure if such a charge can stick.
translation: 但法律专家们不能肯定这一指控是否成立。

meaning: vt.  包含； 包括
example: Our range of herbal teas contain no preservatives, colourings or artificial flavourings.
translation: 我们这一系列的药草茶不含防腐剂、色素以及人工调味品。

meaning: adj.  突出的， 显著的； 杰出的
example: You have to pay your outstanding bill before joining the scheme.
translation: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。

meaning: v.  乱丢杂物
example: On Wednesday we cleared a beach and woodland of litter.
translation: 星期三我们清理了一块海滨林地的垃圾。

meaning: adv. 椭圆
example: Congress is waiting to see how the Oval Office will react.
translation: 国会正观望总统方面的反应。

meaning: n.  程序， 手续
example: British Parliamentary procedure is perplexing at the best of times.
translation: 即使在最好情况下，英国议会的程序也很费解。

meaning: adj.  熟悉的
example: Rose heard the familiar voice, but tuned out the words.
translation: 罗斯听到了熟悉的声音，但没注意听说的是什么。

meaning: n.  传记
example: He has written a speculative biography of Christopher Marlowe.
translation: 他写了一篇关于克里斯托弗·马洛的推测性传记。

meaning: v.  呼吸
example: Breathe out and ease your knees in toward your chest.
translation: 呼气，膝部放松向胸部靠拢。

meaning: n.  申请人
example: Not every applicant had a degree.
translation: 不是所有的求职者都有学位。

meaning: n.  战斗； 战役
example: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
translation: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

meaning: adj.  可怕的； 引起敬畏的
example: Graf looked in awesome form as she cruised to an easy victory.
translation: 格拉芙轻松取胜，看上去状态极佳。

meaning: n.  搭档， 合作者
example: Your partner should then pass the ball back to you.
translation: 然后你的搭档应该将球回传给你。

meaning: adj.  有天赋的， 有才华的
example: He was witty, amusing and gifted with a sharp business brain.
translation: 他机智诙谐，具有敏锐的商业头脑。

meaning: n.  签证
example: The town has a desolate visage.
translation: 这个镇子呈现出一片荒凉.

meaning: n.  拉链
example: zipper pocket
translation: 拉链口袋

meaning: n.  北极
example: TV pictures showed the arctic conditions.
translation: 电视画面显示了严寒的环境。

meaning: adj.  不适宜的， 不相宜的
example: The judges agreed on his unfitness for the appointment.
translation: 评委们就他不适合那项任命的意见达成了一致.

meaning: n&v.  采访； 会见； 面试
example: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
translation: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

meaning: v.  澄清， 阐明
example: The aim of this initial meeting is to clarify the issues.
translation: 本次初步会议的目标是澄清这些问题。

meaning: n.  美， 美丽； 美人
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: v.  请求， 乞求
example: We beg the Government on bended knees not to cut this budget.
translation: 我们恳求政府不要削减这项预算。

meaning: v.  惊吓， 威吓； 受惊
example: Then he took a poke at my hair, telling me I looked like a scarecrow!
translation: 然后他开始嘲笑我的头发, 说我看起来像个稻草人!

meaning: v.  用以构成疑问句及否定句; vt. 做，干
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: v.  观察； 遵守
example: The Royal Greenwich Observatory was founded to observe and catalogue the stars.
translation: 当初创立皇家格林尼治天文台就是为了观察星体并对其进行编目。

meaning: adj.  幽默的
example: John Lennon found time to publish two books of his humorous prose.
translation: 约翰·列侬抽时间出版了两本幽默散文。

meaning: n.  衣服， 外衣
example: She stood up and began to disrobe, folding each garment neatly.
translation: 她站起来开始脱衣服，并把每件衣服叠整齐。

meaning: adj.  罕见的， 稀有的
example: It remained an exceptionally rare book until it was reprinted in 1918.
translation: 在1918年再版之前，这本书一直非常罕见。

meaning: adj.  无用的
example: Uselessly, he checked the same pockets he'd checked before.
translation: 他把先前检查过的那些口袋又查了一遍，毫无收获。

meaning: pron.  哪一个； 哪一些
example: Fishing is from 6 am to dusk or 10.30pm, whichever is sooner.
translation: 钓鱼时间从上午6点到黄昏或是到晚上10点半，以较早者为准。

meaning: n.  不利条件； 弱点
example: Depression is the third thing that works to my patients' disadvantage.
translation: 抑郁是威胁我的病人健康的第三大杀手。

meaning: n.  垃圾
example: A bomb planted in a garbage can exploded early today.
translation: 今天早些时候，安放在垃圾箱里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

meaning: n.  大陆
example: The island may be reached by boat from the mainland.
translation: 这个岛屿可以从大陆乘小船到达。

meaning: adv.  在楼下， 到楼下
example: Sounds of voices and commotion could be heard downstairs now.
translation: 现在能听见楼下人声鼎沸。

meaning: n.  大理石
example: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.
translation: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。

meaning: adv.  决不， 从来没有
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: n.  忧虑； 焦急
example: He has exhibited symptoms of anxiety and overwhelming worry.
translation: 他表现出焦躁不安和过度忧虑的症状。

meaning: n.  一块  ； 小的部分
example: How very thoughtless. I'll give him a piece of my mind.
translation: 真是太没头脑了，我要告诉他我很生气。

meaning: v.  适应； 调整， 调节
example: Adjust the aerial's position and direction for the best reception.
translation: 调整天线的位置和方向以达到最佳接收效果。

meaning: v.  携带； 搬运； 背
example: The indisputable fact is that computers carry out logical operations.
translation: 不容置疑的事实是，电脑执行逻辑操作指令。

meaning: v.   突然发生； 爆炸
example: A brilliant shaft of sunlight burst through the doorway.
translation: 一束耀眼的阳光从门口照射进来。

meaning: adj.  西方的； 西部的
example: No westerner could fly in without a visa.
translation: 没有签证的西方人不能乘飞机入境。

meaning: n.  债务， 欠款
example: The plan is designed to reduce some of the company's mountainous debt.
translation: 该计划旨在减少公司堆积如山的债务。

meaning: adj.   小的； 少的
example: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
translation: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

meaning: adv.  可是， 然而， 尽管如此； 无论如何
example: The mechanics of the job, however, have changed little since then.
translation: 不过，工作流程从那以后就几乎没有任何变化。

meaning: adv.  深深地； 在深处; adj. 深的；深厚的；沉睡的；渊博的
example: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
translation: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

meaning: n.   鹅
example: He said that what they were up to would cook Krasky's goose.
translation: 他说他们暗中进行的阴谋可能会使克拉斯基的计划流产。

meaning: vt.   原谅， 宽恕
example: I can never, ever forgive him. I despise him.
translation: 我永远不会原谅他。我鄙视他。

meaning: n.  起源； 由来
example: There are some areas of wetland which are of ancient origin.
translation: 有一些湿地在古代就形成了。

meaning: conj.  因为， 由于; prep. 为了；在…期间；对于
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: adj.  错误的
example: You couldn't be more mistaken, Alex. You've utterly misread the situation.
translation: 亚历克斯，你真是大错特错，你对局势的判断根本不对。

meaning: adj.  满意的; n.  内容； 含量
example: There are reports of widespread dis-content in the capital.
translation: 有报道称首都弥漫着不满的情绪。

meaning: n.  行为， 事迹
example: The perpetrators of this evil deed must be brought to justice.
translation: 必须将参与这一恶行的凶手绳之以法。

meaning: n.  担子， 负担
example: I wouldn't call it a burden; I call it a responsibility.
translation: 我不觉得这是负担；我觉得它是一种责任。

meaning: n&v.  敬礼； 问候
example: As a second lieutenant, he had to salute damned near everybody.
translation: 身为少尉，他几乎是逢人便得敬礼。

meaning: adj.  随意的， 任意的
example: Three people were killed by shots fired at random from a minibus.
translation: 3个人被从一辆面包车中发射的乱弹打死了。

meaning: adv.  可能， 或许
example: The horrors he experienced are imprinted, perhaps indelibly, in his brain.
translation: 他经历的恐怖事件在他脑海中刻下了深深的，或许是难以磨灭的印记。

meaning: vt. 密谋; n.  情节
example: Sadly, the film is let down by an excessively simple plot.
translation: 遗憾的是，过于简单的情节使得这部电影差强人意。

meaning: v.  估价； 认为; n. 比率；价格；速度
example: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
translation: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

meaning: n.  技能， 技巧
example: Computers and electronics are growth industries and need skilled technicians.
translation: 计算机与电子行业属于蓬勃发展的产业，需要娴熟的技术人员。

meaning: n. 问题；疾病；麻烦; vt.  使苦恼； 使忧虑； 使麻烦
example: in trouble
translation: 在监禁中；处于不幸中；处困难中

meaning: adj.  不公平的， 不公正的
example: He vowed to wreak vengeance on his unfaithful, thieving wife.
translation: 他发誓要报复对自己不忠、爱偷东西的妻子。

meaning: v.  分， 划分； 除以
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: adj.  相反的; n. 反面
example: Several of those present, including Weinberger, had contrary information.
translation: 几个在场的人，包括温博格，所掌握的信息截然不同。

meaning: vi.  坐
example: sit down
translation: 坐下；扎营

meaning: adj.  数字的， 数码的
example: The BBC has just successfully demonstrated a new digital radio transmission system.
translation: 英国广播公司刚刚成功地演示了一套新的数字无线电传输系统。

meaning: adv. 越过; adj.  完了， 结束了; prep. 在…之上；超过
example: When the right woman comes along, this bad dream will be over.
translation: 当有合适的女人出现时，这种胡思乱想就会停止了。

meaning: adj.  闪耀的； 有才气的
example: A brilliant shaft of sunlight burst through the doorway.
translation: 一束耀眼的阳光从门口照射进来。

meaning: adj.  实际的； 适用的； 实用的； 应用的
example: After half an hour's commis-eration, we turned to more practical matters.
translation: 惺惺相惜了半个小时后，我们转而讨论一些更为实际的问题。

meaning: n.  杀虫剂
example: pesticide residues in fruit and vegetables
translation: 残留在水果和蔬菜中的杀虫剂

meaning: adj. 被束缚的；有义务的; v.  跳跃
example: They are bound to take time to readjust after a holiday.
translation: 他们肯定需要时间重新适应假期结束后的生活。

meaning: adj.  假的； 不正确的
example: I was wearing false eyelashes and a sweater two sizes too small.
translation: 我戴着假睫毛，穿着小了两号的毛衣。

meaning: v. 去，走；进行；进展； 变得， 变成
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: v.  取笑， 嘲弄
example: European teasel with white to pink flowers; naturalized in United States.
translation: 欧洲川续断,花白色粉色; 已经引入美国.

meaning: n.  叉； 餐叉
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: v.  形成， 组建; n. 表格；形式；结构
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: v.  出版， 发行
example: My object was to publish a scholarly work on Peter Mourne.
translation: 我的目标是出版一本关于彼得·莫恩的学术著作。

meaning: n.  角锥形； 金字塔
example: There rose before us the great pyramid of Gaza.
translation: 雄伟的加沙金字塔矗立在我们面前。

meaning: n.  支票
example: We went straight to the estate agent and wrote out a cheque.
translation: 我们径直到房地产经纪人那里开了一张支票。

meaning: vt.  避免， 躲开， 逃避
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: v&n.  出价， 投标
example: He certainly wasn't going to bid $18 billion for this company.
translation: 他肯定不会出180亿美元来收购这家公司。

meaning: adj.  新鲜的； 不熟练的
example: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.
translation: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很重要，麦麸也是。

meaning: vt.  使惊讶
example: A matter of repeated occurrence like this will not astonish people.
translation: 这样司空见惯的事,不会使人吃惊.

meaning: v.   缩回， 撤回
example: If these drugs are stopped abruptly then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
translation: 如果突然停服这些药，则可能出现一些戒断症状。

meaning: adj&adv.  正直的， 坦率的
example: The policy of the annually balanced budget represents a rigid straightjacket.
translation: 年度平衡预算的政策是一种刻板的束缚.

meaning: adv. 很，非常; adj.  恰好的， 正好的
example: thank you very much
translation: 非常感谢

meaning: n.  十年
example: These developments were foreseen in embryo more than a decade ago.
translation: 这些发展早在十多年前的萌芽阶段就已预见到。

meaning: n.  专家， 能手
example: You'll also get expert advice on keeping your hair in good condition.
translation: 你还会获得有关如何保持良好发质的专家建议。

meaning: n.  实践； 练习； 惯例， 常规
example: His hands were rough and calloused, from years of karate practice.
translation: 由于多年练习空手道，他的双手粗糙不平，布满老茧。

meaning: adj.  精选的; vt. 选择，挑选，选拔
example: She selected a low gear and started down the track carefully.
translation: 她选了低速挡小心翼翼地沿小径下行。

meaning: v.  拥挤， 群聚; n. 人群；堆
example: The crowd in Robinson's Coffee-House was thinning, but only by degrees.
translation: 鲁宾逊咖啡屋里的人正在变少，但也只是渐少而已。

meaning: adj.  有病的， 患病的， 不舒服的；  呕吐的
example: Michael left his sickbed to entertain his house guests.
translation: 迈克尔走下病床去招待客人。

meaning: n.  一点， 一些， 少量
example: Things might have been different if I'd talked a bit more.
translation: 如果当时我再多说一点的话，结果或许会不一样。

meaning: n.  福利； 安宁， 幸福
example: In truth, this is not socialism, but an extension of long standing corporate welfarism.
translation: 实际上, 这不是社会主义, 而是长期的公司福利主义的延伸.

meaning: n.  产量， 输出量
example: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.
translation: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

meaning: n.  角； 角落； 拐角
example: Claire stared after him until he disappeared around a corner.
translation: 克莱尔一直注视着他，直到他消失在拐角。

meaning: adv.  别的， 其他的
example: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else.
translation: 我和父亲断绝了关系，因为我想成为一个不一样的自己。

meaning: n.   调制解调器
example: He sent his work to his publishers by modem.
translation: 他通过网络把作品发给了出版商。

meaning: n.  多数
example: Independent candidates won the majority of seats on the local council.
translation: 无党派候选人在地方议会选举中赢得了多数席位。

meaning: prep.  在…旁边； 靠近
example: He lay beside her awkwardly, propped on an elbow.
translation: 他用一只胳膊肘支着身体，别扭地躺在她旁边。

meaning: v.  参加， 加入； 连接； 会合
example: I know you will join me in wishing them Godspeed.
translation: 我知道你会同我一起祝愿他们诸事顺遂的。

meaning: v.   拖， 拽
example: Use your mouse to drag the pictures to their new size.
translation: 用鼠标拖动图片，将其调整为新的尺寸。

meaning: vt.  减少， 缩减
example: The job losses will reduce the total workforce to 7,000.
translation: 职位减少后，在职工人总数将减至7,000人。

meaning: adj.  很可能的
example: Very likely he'd told them he had American business interests.
translation: 很可能他已经告诉他们自己拥有美国商业利益.

meaning: adj.  大的； 巨大的
example: These large institutions make — and change—the rules to suit themselves.

example: Derek is now the proud father of a bouncing baby girl.
translation: 德里克现在为有一个健康活泼的女宝宝而骄傲。

meaning: v.  喜欢， 喜爱; prep. 像，跟…一样; n. 爱好
example: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
translation: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

meaning: adj.  丑陋的， 难看的
example: ugly duckling
translation: 丑小鸭；小时难看长大后变得才貌出众的人

meaning: n.  地震
example: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population.
translation: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

meaning: n.  税， 税款
example: income tax
translation: 所得税

meaning: prep.  向， 朝， 对于
adj.  乱七八糟的
example: Applying the dye can be messy, particularly on long hair.
translation: 涂抹染发剂可能会搞得一团糟，特别是长发。

meaning: n.  大使馆
example: Embassy security personnel refused to admit him or his wife.
translation: 使馆保安人员不允许他和夫人进入。

meaning: adj.  长方形的; n. 长方形
example: Suppose the width of a rectangle is x metres.
translation: 设长方形的宽是x米.

meaning: adj.  易碎的， 脆的
example: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
translation: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

meaning: n.  离开； 背离； 违反
example: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
translation: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

meaning: v. 快跑，猛撞; n.  快跑， 猛撞； 少量
example: The Prince was driving with great fire and dash.
translation: 王子潇洒威猛地驱车而行。

meaning: vt.   打发， 派遣； 送， 邮寄
example: The Tanabata Festival in Sendai is among the most famous in Japan.
translation: 仙台的七夕庆典是日本最有名的庆典之一.

meaning: adj.  具体的； 有形的
example: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
translation: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

meaning: n. 便条，笔记，注释; vt.  记录， 注意
example: Somehow he tells these stories without a note of horror.
translation: 不知为什么他讲这些故事时一点都不害怕。

meaning: pron.  每人， 人人
example: The minute that the war started, everybody was glued to the television.
translation: 战事一起，所有人都盯紧了电视报道。

meaning: v. 航行，开航; n.  帆； 航行
example: They were going to sail around the little island, against the tide.
translation: 他们打算绕着小岛逆潮航行。

meaning: n.  出租车； 驾驶室
example: The cab pulled up and the driver jumped out.
translation: 出租车减速停下，司机跳了出来。

meaning: n.  目的， 意图
example: Most of them are destroyed because they've served their purpose.
translation: 它们中大多数在完成使命后被销毁。

meaning: n. 遗憾，懊悔；令人遗憾的事; vt.   遗憾； 后悔
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: v.  画线于，  成行; n. 直线；排
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: adj.  结实的， 矮胖的
v. 连接，联合; n.  链环， 链接
example: He suggested a link between class size and test results of seven-year-olds.
translation: 他认为7岁大的学生的测试分数和班级的规模有关系。

meaning: v.   逃走， 逃跑
example: A trickle of refugees began to flee the country.
translation: 难民开始三五成群地陆续逃离该国。

meaning: v.   哭泣， 流泪
example: weep for
translation: 为…而哭泣

meaning: n.  曲调， 调子
example: out of tune
translation: 走调；不协调；（对某事）没有兴趣

meaning: adj.  知道的， 意识到的
example: He became more aware of the things that started that tension off.
translation: 他越来越清楚地认识到引起紧张局势的原因。

meaning: n.  罐头； 铁罐； 垃圾桶
example: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
translation: 最幸福的人们并不一定什么都是最好，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

meaning: n.  安全
example: social security
translation: 社会保险，社会保障

meaning: n.  奖品， 奖励
example: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
translation: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

meaning: adj.  准备就绪的
example: Fraud squad officers had bugged the phone and were ready to pounce.
translation: 反诈骗小组的警员们已在电话上安装了窃听器，并随时准备突击。

meaning: n.  警报
example: Any escape, once it's detected, sets off the alarm.
translation: 一旦发现有泄漏，警报就会响起来。

meaning: n.  野草， 杂草
example: weed control
translation: 除草；杂草防除；野草控制

meaning: n.  草药
example: The herb has been used for centuries to curdle milk.
translation: 那种香草几个世纪以来都被用来制作酸乳。

meaning: adj.  不省人事的， 无意识的
example: Unconsciously, by force of habit, she plugged the coffee pot in.
translation: 下意识地，她习惯性地把咖啡壶的插头插上了。

meaning: n.  一场雨； 降雨量
example: Victoria Falls has had above average levels of rainfall this year.
translation: 维多利亚瀑布今年的降雨量超过了平均水平。

meaning: n. 成本；代价; vt.   花费； 使付出
example: Companies are moving jobs to towns with a lower cost of living.
translation: 各公司正在把工作岗位转移至生活费用较低的城镇。

meaning: n.  意志； 遗嘱
example: Indeed, there is a succession here, from Mrs Stowe to Jewett and then to Willa Cather.
translation: 说真的, 我们在这里可以看到, 从斯托夫人到朱厄特,再到威拉·凯瑟是一脉相承的.

meaning: v.  满足， 使满意
example: His only experience of gardening so far proved immensely satisfying.
translation: 到目前为止他唯一的一次园艺经历非常令人满意。

meaning: v.  冒烟； 吸烟; n. 烟
example: like smoke
translation: [俚语]

meaning: v. 相配，相称; n.  比赛； 火柴
example: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
translation: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

meaning: adj.  武断的； 任意的
example: The choice of players for the team seemed completely arbitrary.
translation: 看来这个队的队员完全是随意选定的。

meaning: n.  烹饪， 烹饪术
example: Elizabeth David enthuses about the taste, fragrance and character of Provencal cuisine.
translation: 伊丽莎白·戴维对普罗旺斯菜肴的色香味津津乐道。

meaning: n.  过错， 缺点， 毛病
example: The aircraft made an unscheduled landing after developing an electrical fault.
translation: 飞机由于发生电力故障而作了临时降落。

meaning: v.  跟随； 遵循； 仿效
example: "Wait there!" Kathryn rose. "No, on second thought, follow me."
translation: “在那儿等着！”凯瑟琳站起身来，“不，我改主意了。跟我来。”

meaning: adj.  被动的； 消极的
example: Even passive acceptance of the regime was a kind of collaboration.
translation: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。

meaning: adj.  勤劳的， 辛勤工作的
n.  搬运者；  置物架
example: He had returned to England in an aircraft carrier no less.
translation: 他竟然坐航空母舰回的英格兰。

meaning: n.  尊严； 高贵
example: It's an affront to human dignity to keep someone alive like this.
translation: 如此维持一个人的生命是对人类尊严的冒犯。

meaning: n. 挑战；挑战性; vt.  挑战
example: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 school-children for an afternoon.
translation: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。

meaning: n.  种类
example: The judges could not decide which category it belonged in.
translation: 评委们无法判定它属于哪一类。

meaning: adj.  暖和舒服的； 舒适的
example: In the cosy consulting room the children are surrounded by familiar objects.
translation: 在温馨的诊疗室里，孩子们周围摆满了亲切熟悉的东西。

meaning: v.  想要， 打算
example: England intend fielding their strongest team in next month's World Youth Championship.
translation: 英格兰意欲在下月的世界青年锦标赛中推出他们的最强阵容。

meaning: adj.  野生的
example: A pattern can include regular characters and wildcard characters.
translation: 模式可以包含常规字符和通配符.

meaning: adv. 突然地
example: If these drugs are stopped abruptly then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
translation: 如果突然停服这些药，则可能出现一些戒断症状。

meaning: v. 吸收（液体、气体等）
example: The material can absorb outward-going radiation from the Earth.
translation: 该物质可以吸收地球向外辐射的能量。

meaning: v. 滥用，虐待
example: West was wilfully blind to the abuse that took place.
translation: 韦斯特对发生的虐待行为故意视而不见。

meaning: adj. 学校(院)的，学术的
example: Henry generally stayed ahead of the others in the academic subjects.
translation: 亨利的文化课成绩通常都优于其他学生。

meaning: v. 获取; n. 接近，入口
example: The home is situated within easy access of shops and other facilities.
translation: 房子位置便利，距离商店及其他设施都不远。

meaning: adj. 易接近的
example: The legal aid system should be accessible to more people.
translation: 法律援助制度应该面向更多人。

meaning: v. 适合， 提供住宿
example: He has never put an arm around his wife to accommodate photographers.
translation: 他从未为了迎合摄影师而搂住妻子。

meaning: v. 完成
example: He exhorted his companions, "Try to accomplish your aim with diligence".
translation: 他劝诫同伴说：“要通过勤奋努力实现自己的目标。”

meaning: v. 积累，增加
example: How can I accumulate enough cash to get out of debt?
translation: 我怎么才能攒足钱还清债务呢？

meaning: adj. 精确的，准确的
example: Schools were told their exam information had to be spot-on and accurate.
translation: 各学校接到通知，要求考试信息必须准确无误。

meaning: v. 完成，实现
example: I asked McKeown if the reunion was meant to achieve closure.
translation: 我问麦基翁重聚是不是为了寻求解脱。

meaning: v. 承认(…的权威)
example: You have to acknowledge that we live in a racist society.
translation: 你得承认我们生活在一个有种族偏见的社会中。

meaning: v. 获得
example: Perhaps we did acquire a somewhat fuddy-duddy image in the later years.
translation: 可能在后来的几年里我们真的让人感到有些古板。

meaning: adj. 敏锐的
example: I was laid up in bed with acute rheumatism.
translation: 我染上了急性风湿，卧病在床。

meaning: v. 适应于
example: The scriptwriter helped him to adapt his novel for the screen.
translation: 编剧帮助他将其所著小说改编成电影。

meaning: n. 上瘾
example: We must concentrate our energies on treating addiction first.
translation: 我们必须首先集中精力治疗毒瘾。

meaning: adj. 额外的
example: Shares and bonds can bring one quite a considerable additional income.
translation: 股票和债券能给人带来不菲的额外收入。

meaning: v. 解决
example: Someone cranked up the volume of the public address system.
translation: 有人调大了公共广播系统的音量。

meaning: adj. 足够的
example: adequate for
translation: 胜任……的；对……是足够的；适合……的

meaning: n. 管理，政府
example: The administration has now endorsed the bill and can't turn back.
translation: 政府部门如今已经签署了那项法案，没有挽回的余地。

meaning: adj. 管理的
example: She used the day to catch up with administrative tasks.
translation: 她白天忙着处理行政工作。

meaning: v. 钦佩，称赞
example: I had to admire David's vow that he would leave the programme.
translation: 戴维发誓要离开这个项目，我不得不对他表示钦佩。

meaning: n. 钦佩，称赞
example: She is full of admiration for the head and teachers.
translation: 她对校长和教师们满心钦佩。

meaning: n. 准许进(加)入；入场费；承认
example: By his own admission, he evaded taxes as a Florida real-estate speculator.
translation: 他亲口承认自己在佛罗里达从事房地产投机生意时逃过税。

meaning: v. 承认，容许
example: You have to admit that you are, in fact, in difficulties.
translation: 你不得不承认，你事实上是陷入了困境。

meaning: v & n. 前进，提前
example: It is a good idea to place your order well in advance.
translation: 早早就提前下单是个好主意。

meaning: adj. 高级的
example: The way Swedes integrate immigrants is, she feels, 100% more advanced.
translation: 她觉得瑞典人帮助移民适应当地生活的方式百分百地更为先进。

meaning: n. 进步，提升
example: He secretly tried to block her advancement in the Party.
translation: 他暗地里设法阻挠她在党内的晋升。

meaning: n. 建议
example: Substantial numbers of rank and file members ignored their union's advice.
translation: 有相当一部分普通员工不理睬工会的建议。

meaning: n. 报告
example: Get hold of the company list from your careers advisory service.
translation: 到就业指导处领取企业名录。

meaning: n & v. 倡导
example: He is a keen advocate of park-and-ride schemes.
translation: 他是“停车再换乘”计划的热情拥护者。

meaning: n. 主张者，倡导者
example: Liszt is both the theme music creator, and its enthusiastic advocator.
translation: 李斯特是标题音乐的创始者, 也是热情的倡导者.

meaning: adj. 深情的，柔情的
example: They seemed devoted to each other and were openly affectionate.
translation: 他们看起来非常恩爱，柔情蜜意溢于言表。

meaning: n. 断言，肯定
example: The ministers issued an affirmation of their faith in the system.
translation: 部长们表示了对该体制坚定的信心。

meaning: v. 断言，声明
example: This report is positively denied in official circles, who affirm that nothing of the kind occurred , but that the story is made out of whole cloth.
translation: 这篇报导为官方人士所断然否认, 他们断言根本没有这回事, 其内容纯属捏造.

meaning: v. 负担得起
example: They could not afford to spoil those maps by careless colouring.
translation: 若是上色的时候不小心弄坏了那些地图，他们可承担不起。

meaning: n. 机构
example: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: adj. 挑衅的，好斗的；有上进心的
example: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive.
translation: 他是一位锐意进取、竞争意识很强的主管，颇受尊敬。

meaning: n. 粘贴簿，集邮簿，像册
example: The group's debut album was immediately acclaimed a hip hop classic.
translation: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

meaning: n. 酒精
example: In 1985, he began to show signs of alcohol and drug dependency.
translation: 在1985年，他开始表现出酗酒嗜毒的迹象。

meaning: v. 提醒；; adj. 机警的
example: The armed forces were on high alert to guard against any retaliation.
translation: 武装部队保持高度戒备，以防发生任何报复行动。

meaning: v. 改变
example: She is, first and foremost, her husband's alter ego.
translation: 她首先是丈夫的知己。

meaning: n. 海拔, 高度
example: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
translation: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

meaning: adj. 有雄心的，野心勃勃的
example: Chris is so ambitious, so determined to do it all.
translation: 克里斯踌躇满志，决心要将它都做完。

meaning: v. 分析
example: They will take that problem apart and analyze it in great detail.
translation: 他们会认真分析那个问题，指出其症结所在。

meaning: adj. 古代的
example: The journey ends in the ancient city of Marrakesh.
translation: 旅行的终点是马拉喀什古城。

meaning: v. 宣布，声称
example: She was planning to announce her engagement to Peter.
translation: 她正计划宣布她和彼得订婚一事。

meaning: adj. 每年的
adv. 每年，一年一次
example: A formal contract is signed which is renewable annually.
translation: 正式签订了每年可续签的合同。

meaning: v. 预感
example: What Jeff did was to anticipate my next question.
translation: 杰夫预先回答了我的下一个问题。

meaning: n. 古玩，古董
example: He finds material at auctions, antique shops and flea markets.
translation: 他在拍卖行、古玩店和跳蚤市场中寻宝。

meaning: n. 公寓
example: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
translation: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

meaning: n &v. 吸引，呼吁
example: Its new title was meant to give the party greater public appeal.
translation: 新的党名意在使该党对公众具有更强的吸引力。

meaning: n. 外表, 出现
example: Marilyn made her last public appearance at Madison Square Garden.
translation: 玛丽莲最后一次公开亮相是在麦迪逊广场花园。

meaning: n. 欲望, 胃口
example: There is nothing like a long walk to arouse the appetite.
translation: 没有什么比走很长的路更能激起食欲的了。

meaning: n. 申请人
example: Not every applicant had a degree.
translation: 不是所有的求职者都有学位。

meaning: n. 申请，应用
example: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

meaning: v. 应用, 申请
example: Investors can apply for a package of shares at a set price.
translation: 投资者可以申购固定价格的股票组合。

meaning: v. 任命，委派；约定，确定，指定
example: "Why didn't you appoint Ron twelve months ago?"—"Good question."
translation: “你为什么12个月前不任命罗恩呢？”——“问得好。”

meaning: n. 约会
example: make an appointment
translation: 约会，预约

meaning: v. 感激，欣赏
example: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
translation: 最幸福的人们并不一定什么都是最好，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

meaning: n. 评价，感激
example: You have to take capital appreciation of the property into account.
translation: 你必须将该处房产的资本增值考虑在内。

meaning: v. 靠近; n. 接近，方法
example: We have a very communicative approach to teaching languages.
translation: 我们在语言教学中非常强调交际教学法。

meaning: v. 赞成，同意
example: The council is considering whether to approve of the use of firearms.
translation: 政务委员会正在考虑是否要批准动用武器。

meaning: n. 批准，认可，赞成
example: A reformed party would have to win the approval of the people.
translation: 一个革新的政党需要赢得人民的认可。

meaning: adv. 大约
example: In the course of the 1930s steel production in Britain approximately doubled.
translation: 在20世纪30年代，英国的钢铁产量几乎翻了一番。

meaning: n. 建筑师
example: Today's complex buildings require close teamwork between the architect and the builders.
translation: 如今的建筑结构复杂，需要建筑师和施工人员密切协作。

meaning: n. 档案文件
example: This vast archive has been indexed and made accessible to researchers.
translation: 这个存量巨大的档案室的所有文件都已编了索引，可供研究人员使用。

meaning: v. 把…（系统地）分类
example: It is not for me to arrange such matters.
translation: 我无权安排这些事情。

meaning: v. 逮捕
example: Some magistrates have abused their powers of arrest to extort confessions.
translation: 有些地方执法官滥用逮捕权进行逼供。

meaning: adj. 害羞的
example: I felt incredibly ashamed of myself for getting so angry.
translation: 我对自己发那么大的火而深感惭愧。

meaning: v. 组装；集合
example: Greenpeace managed to assemble enough boats to waylay the ship at sea.
translation: 绿色和平组织设法聚集起足够数量的小船在海上拦截该船。

meaning: n. 装配
example: Several proposals are under consideration by the state assembly.
translation: 有几个提案州议会正在讨论中。

meaning: n. 有价值的人(或物)资产
example: From day one he's been a great asset to the company.
translation: 从入职第一天开始，他就是公司难得的人才。

meaning: v. 分配，布置
example: It had been a monumental blunder to give him the assign-ment.
translation: 当时把这项任务给他是大错特错了。

meaning: n. 作业
example: Characteristically, he worked hard at the assignment.
translation: 他一如既往地认真完成分派的任务。

meaning: v. 交往；把……联系起来
example: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
translation: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

meaning: v. 假定，认为
example: Don't assume your baby automatically needs feeding if she's fretful.
translation: 不要想当然地认为你的宝宝一闹就是要吃奶。

meaning: n. 假定，假设
example: We are working on the assumption that it was a gas explosion.
translation: 我们假设这是一场燃气爆炸事故。

meaning: v. 使惊讶，使大为吃惊
example: A matter of repeated occurrence like this will not astonish people.
translation: 这样司空见惯的事,不会使人吃惊.

meaning: n. 气氛；大气；空气
example: He sets the atmosphere and shapes the scenes pleasingly.
translation: 他把气氛和场面调动得轻松愉快。

meaning: n & v. 尝试，试图
example: An attempt by anti-abortionists to tighten the rules was defeated.
translation: 反堕胎者所作的加强法规的尝试失败了。

meaning: adj. 自动的
example: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle.
translation: 他们用自动步枪近距离开枪射杀了他。

meaning: adj. 可利用的，现有的；可获得的
example: They have only a vague idea of the amount of water available.
translation: 他们只是大概知道可用水的总量。

meaning: v. 有益, 有帮助
example: His efforts were to no avail.
translation: 他徒劳无功。

meaning: adj. 平常的
example: The average commuter journey there is five hours long.
translation: 那里的通勤一族平均上下班要花5个小时。

meaning: n. 航空
example: The civil aviation minister ordered all the planes to be grounded.
translation: 民航部长下令所有飞机不得起飞。

meaning: v. 驾驶飞机
v. 避免
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: v. 授予；判给; n. 奖(金)
example: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
translation: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

meaning: n. 意识
example: He introduced radio to the school to increase the children's awareness.
translation: 他在学校开通广播，以提高孩子们的警觉性。

meaning: n. 背景
example: Though his background was modest, it was in no sense deprived.
translation: 尽管他家境一般，但也并不贫穷。

meaning: adv. 向后的
example: The car passed over the body twice, once backward and then forward.
translation: 那辆车把那人来回轧了两次，先是倒着轧的，再是往前开着轧的。

meaning: v. 禁止
example: The Partial Test-Ban Treaty bans nuclear testing in the atmosphere.
translation: 《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止在大气层中进行核试验。

meaning: adj. 破产的，倒闭的
example: It was touch and go whether we'd go bankrupt.
translation: 我们是否会破产还很难说。

meaning: n. 讨价还价
example: They prefer to bargain with individual clients, for cash.
translation: 在现款方面，他们更愿意同散户打交道。

meaning: n. 战争，战役
example: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
translation: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

meaning: v. 表现
example: The aim of discipline is to teach children to behave acceptably.
translation: 纪律的目的是教育儿童举止得体。

meaning: adj. 有利的，有益的
example: It can be beneficial to share your feelings with someone you trust.
translation: 向自己信任的人倾诉感情是很有益处的。

meaning: v. 有益于，有助于
example: It is certainly worth checking up on your benefit entitlements.
translation: 查清楚你可以享受哪些福利是绝对有必要的。

meaning: n & v. 出价，投标
example: He certainly wasn't going to bid $18 billion for this company.
translation: 他肯定不会出180亿美元来收购这家公司。

meaning: v. 指责，责怪
example: The blame for the Charleston fiasco did not lie with him.
translation: 查尔斯顿惨败错不在他。

meaning: v. 祝福
example: During his visit, the Pope will also bless the new hospital.
translation: 在访问期间，教皇还将为新医院祈福。

meaning: v. 阻碍；街区
example: A block up the street I found a parking lot.
translation: 沿着街道往北过了一个街区，我找到了一个停车场。

meaning: adj. 假冒的
example: He said these figures were bogus and totally inaccurate.
translation: 他说这些数字都是捏造的，完全不准确。

meaning: n. 推动,宣扬; v. 促使，促进
example: It did give me a boost to win such a big event.
translation: 赢得如此重大的比赛确实使我信心倍增。

meaning: v. 打扰；麻烦
example: Mr Brooke is undoubtedly in a spot of bother.
translation: 布鲁克先生肯定遇到了点小麻烦。

meaning: adj. 宽的
example: The hills rise green and sheer above the broad river.
translation: 这些小山碧绿陡峭，矗立在这条宽阔的河流之上。

meaning: n. 预算; v. 编预算
example: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

meaning: n. 负担，包袱
example: I wouldn't call it a burden; I call it a responsibility.
translation: 我不觉得这是负担；我觉得它是一种责任。

meaning: n. 局
example: the Federal Bureau of Investigation
translation: 联邦调查局

meaning: v. 计算
example: Take a hundred and twenty values and calculate the mean.
translation: 取120个值计算平均数。

meaning: n. 活动
example: The strike has taken on overtones of a civil rights campaign.
translation: 罢工带上了民权运动的意味。

meaning: v. 取消
example: He wonders if the different influences might not cancel each other out.
translation: 他在想，各种影响能不能相互抵消。

meaning: n. 申请求职者；投考者；候选人
example: The Democratic candidate is still leading in the polls.
translation: 民主党候选人的得票数依然领先。

meaning: n. 食堂
example: Rennie had eaten his tea in the canteen.
translation: 伦尼已经在餐厅吃过茶点了。

meaning: adj. 能干的，有能力的
example: I believe I am capable of calculating the political consequences accurately.
translation: 我觉得我能准确预料此事的政治后果。

meaning: n. 照料者
adj. 粗心的
example: They could not afford to spoil those maps by careless colouring.
translation: 若是上色的时候不小心弄坏了那些地图，他们可承担不起。

meaning: adj. 偶然的，随便的
example: I was wrong about it being a casual meeting.
translation: 我误以为这是个非正式会议。

meaning: v. 把……编入目录
example: Their full catalogue costs $5, redeemable against a first order.
translation: 他们的完整目录售价5美元，第一次订购时可返还这5美元。

meaning: v & n. 小心，谨慎
example: Television broadcasters were warned to exercise caution over depicting scenes of violence.
translation: 电视台受到警告，要求对暴力场面的描绘采取谨慎态度。

meaning: adj. 谨慎的
example: Australia, put in to bat, made a cautious start.
translation: 轮到澳大利亚队出场击球，他们开始打得很谨慎。

meaning: n. 典礼，仪式
example: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
translation: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

meaning: n & v. 挑战；质疑
example: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 school-children for an afternoon.
translation: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。

meaning: n. 小伙子，小家伙，家伙
example: old chap
translation: [主英国口语][用作招呼语]老兄，老伙计，老弟[亦称作 old boy， old fellow]

meaning: n. 角色
example: I didn't know Ron had that much strength of character.
translation: 我当时不知道罗恩有那么坚强的个性。

meaning: v. 以……特点
example: the rolling hills that characterize this part of England
translation: 成为英格兰这一地区特征的绵延起伏的丘陵地

meaning: n. 慈善（行为）
example: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
translation: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

meaning: n. 脸颊
example: She knelt and brushed her lips softly across Michael's cheek.
translation: 她跪了下来，轻吻迈克尔的脸颊。

meaning: n. 厨师
example: Rabbit stew is one of chef Giancarlo Moeri's signature dishes.
translation: 炖野兔是厨师詹卡洛·莫里的招牌菜之一。

meaning: adj. 化学的 n. 化学制品
example: Some of the companies illegally sent the wherewithal for making chemical weapons.
translation: 有些公司非法为制造化学武器提供所需的资金和设备等。

meaning: v. 使窒息
example: It's enough to make them choke with apoplectic rage.
translation: 足以气得让他们说不出话来。

meaning: n. 环境，境遇
example: You might say that we've been victims of circumstance.
translation: 你可以说我们一直不走运吧。

meaning: v. 引用
example: His position does not empower him to cite our views without consultation.
translation: 他的地位并没有给予他不经许可就引用我们观点的权力。

meaning: n. 公民
example: I invite every citizen to carefully study the document.
translation: 我请每位市民都仔细研读该文件。

meaning: n. 平民，百姓
example: He is in charge of the civilian side of the UN mission.
translation: 他在联合国使团中负责平民方面的事务。

meaning: adj. 文明的
example: Yesterday's testimony began on a note of passionate but civilized disagreement.
translation: 昨天的作供是在激烈但文明地表达分歧的氛围中开始的。

meaning: v. 把…分类，把…分级
example: It is necessary initially to classify the headaches into certain types.
translation: 首先，必须将头痛分为几个类型。

meaning: n. 分类，级别
example: These things belong in a different classification.
translation: 这些东西属于不同的类别.

meaning: n. 客户
example: Enviros Consulting has a client base of more than 2,000 organisations worldwide.
translation: EnvirosConsulting公司在全世界拥有逾2,000家组织机构的客户群。

meaning: n. 诊所
example: Charles was at the clinic recovering from an operation on his arm.
translation: 查尔斯的胳膊动了手术，正在这家诊所进行康复治疗。

meaning: adj. 笨拙的，不圆滑的
example: The action seemed a clumsy attempt to topple the Janata Dal government.
translation: 这一试图推翻人民党政府的行动似乎缺乏策略。

meaning: v & n. 教练
example: head coach
translation: 主教练；总教练

meaning: n. 同事
example: He was fired from his job after roughing up a colleague.
translation: 他因为对一位同事动粗而被开除了。

meaning: n. 撞击；冲突
example: He heard tires squeal as the car braked to avoid a collision.
translation: 为避免相撞而刹车时，他听到了轮胎与地面刺耳的摩擦声。

meaning: v. 联合，结合
example: I am partial to desserts that combine fresh fruit with fine pastry.
translation: 我偏爱加有新鲜水果的精致油酥甜点。

meaning: n. 评论
example: It was just a passing comment, he didn't go on about it.
translation: 那只是一笔带过的评论，他没有继续论述。

meaning: v. 犯罪，承担义务
example: He should not commit American troops without the full consent of Congress.
translation: 没有国会的完全同意，他不应该调遣美国军队。

meaning: n. 承诺，保证
example: Have they, for example, demonstrated a commitment to democracy?
translation: 例如，他们是否已表现出会致力于民主？

meaning: n. 委员会
example: This committee will enable decisions to be made democratically.
translation: 该委员会将实现民主决议过程。

meaning: v. 比较，对照
example: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
translation: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

meaning: v. 强迫
example: The law can compel fathers to make regular payments for their children.
translation: 这项法律可强制父亲定期支付子女费用。

meaning: v. 弥补，补偿
example: The hospital staff were very apologetic but that couldn't really compensate.
translation: 医院的工作人员深表歉意，但这真的于事无补。

meaning: n. 弥补，补偿
example: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay compensation.
translation: 他被有条件地释放了，被责令支付赔偿款。

meaning: v. 竞争
example: They are now trying to compete on an equal footing.
translation: 他们现在想要公平竞争。

meaning: n. 竞争力
example: core competitiveness
translation: 核心竞争力

meaning: n. 竞争者，对手
example: She was the only British competitor apart from Richard Meade.
translation: 她是除了理查德·米德之外唯一的英国参赛者。

meaning: n. 自满，满足
example: She warned that there was no room for complacency on inflation.
translation: 她警告说对待通货膨胀不能有一丝的懈怠。

meaning: v. 抱怨
example: complain about
translation: 抱怨

meaning: n. 抱怨; 投诉
example: Eczema is a common skin complaint which often runs in families.
translation: 湿疹是一种常见的皮肤病，通常具遗传性。

meaning: v. 完成; adj. 完整的，彻底的
example: It'll be two years before the process is complete.
translation: 这个过程需要两年才能完成。

meaning: adj. 复杂的，难懂的
example: Though off-puttingly complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
translation: 虽然地税在细节上复杂得要命，但在本质上却很简单。

meaning: v. 遵从
example: Some beaches had failed to comply with European directives on bathing water.
translation: 有些海滩未能遵守欧洲有关浴场的指令。

meaning: n. 成分
example: The menu is all-important. Every component of every meal should create contrasts.
translation: 饭菜的安排至关重要。每一顿饭的每一道菜都应该有所不同。

meaning: n. 集中
example: We lacked concentration and it cost us the goal and the game.
translation: 我们注意力不够集中，结果丢了球，输了比赛。

meaning: n. 观点，观念
example: The snowcoach concept in Yellowstone provides low-impact, low-pollution access.
translation: 在黄石公园里使用雪车这一想法，为人们提供了一种对环境低影响、低污染的游览方式。

meaning: v & n. 涉及，关系到
example: Issues such as these were not really his concern.
translation: 他其实并不关心诸如此类的问题。

meaning: n. 结论
example: It's almost a foregone conclusion that you'll get what you want.
translation: 你将得到你想要的，这几乎是确定无疑的。

meaning: n. 信心
example: He has never exhibited the self-confidence, bordering on arrogance, of his predecessor.
translation: 他从未表现出他前任的那种近乎傲慢的自信。

meaning: v. 确认；证实；批准
example: His new role could confirm him as one of our leading actors.
translation: 他的新角色会确保他跻身我们的一流演员之列。

meaning: v. 冲突
example: The ethnic populations are so intermingled that there's bound to be conflict.
translation: 各民族人口如此杂居，肯定会发生冲突。

meaning: v. 相一致，遵守
example: Taxis must conform to the rigorous standards laid down by the police.
translation: 出租车必须遵守警方的严格规定。

meaning: v. 面对
example: She had decided to confront Kathryn with what she had learnt.
translation: 她决定拿自己了解的事实与凯瑟琳当面对证。

meaning: n. 连接，联系
example: ISDN connectivity allows computers to communicate over a network.
translation: 综合业务数字网连接实现了计算机网络通讯。

meaning: n. 良心
example: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
translation: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

meaning: n. 一致意见
example: I realize there's no consensus on what are male or female values.
translation: 我意识到人们对什么是男性价值观和什么是女性价值观并无共识。

meaning: v. 允许，同意; n. 同意，一致
example: At approxi-mately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search.
translation: 大概晚上11点半的时候，波拉德最终同意进行搜查。

meaning: n. 结果，成果
example: as a consequence
translation: 因此，结果

meaning: adj. 保守的，传统的
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: adj. 相当大(或多)的
example: He brought to the job not just considerable experience but passionate enthusiasm.
translation: 他不仅给这一工作带来了不少经验，而且倾注了极大的热情。

meaning: adv. 相当地，非常地
example: The river widens considerably as it begins to turn east.
translation: 河流转向东流时河道大幅度变宽。

meaning: adj. 体贴的；考虑周到的
example: The patient has the right to considerate and respectful care.
translation: 病人有权得到周到而礼貌的照顾。

meaning: v. 由……组成
example: The division will consist of two tank companies and one infantry company.
translation: 这个师的组成部队将包括两个坦克连和一个步兵连。

meaning: adj. 一致的
example: consistent with
translation: 符合；与…一致

meaning: adj. 显著地
example: You may feel tearful in situations where you feel conspicuous.
translation: 觉得自己身处众目睽睽之下时，你可能会有想哭的感觉。

meaning: adj. 不断的，持续的
example: There was constant jeering and interruption from the floor.
translation: 议员席上不断有人在嘲讽和打岔.

meaning: adv. 不断地，时常地
example: He is being constantly monitored with regular checks on his blood pressure.
translation: 他被实时监测，定时量血压。

meaning: n. 建筑
example: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: adj. 建设的，建设性的
example: The Prime Minister has promised that Israel will play a constructive role.
translation: 首相承诺以色列将发挥积极的作用。

meaning: v. 咨询
example: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
translation: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

meaning: n. 顾问
example: Shirley's brother is now a consultant heart surgeon in Sweden.
translation: 雪利的兄弟现在在瑞典做心脏外科高级顾问医师。

meaning: n. 消费，消耗
example: Most of the wine was unfit for human consumption.
translation: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。

meaning: v & n. 联系，接触
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: adj. 当代的，现代的
n. 内容
example: There are reports of widespread dis-content in the capital.
translation: 有报道称首都弥漫着不满的情绪。

meaning: n. 背景，环境
example: I would qualify that by putting it into context.
translation: 我会将它放入上下文中进行具体解释。

meaning: n. 合同
example: A formal contract is signed which is renewable annually.
translation: 正式签订了每年可续签的合同。

meaning: n. 对比，反差; v. 对比
example: The boy's room is a complete contrast to the guest room.
translation: 这个男孩的房间和客房截然不同。

meaning: v. 捐款，贡献
example: Heat, cold, tactile and other sensations contribute to flavour.
translation: 热、冷、触觉和其他感觉构成了食物风味的一部分。

meaning: n. 贡献；捐献
example: His contribution is immeasurable.
translation: 他居功至伟。

meaning: adj. 方便的
example: There wasn't even a convenient place for students to assemble between classes.
translation: 在课间，学生们连一个方便凑在一起的地方都没有。

meaning: adj. 传统的
example: He hates the wheeling and dealing associated with conventional political life.
translation: 他对传统政治生活中的权术钻营深恶痛绝。

meaning: v. 传达，传递
example: Euclid was trying to convey his idea of a geometrical point.
translation: 欧几里得试图表达他的一个几何学观点。

meaning: adj. 合作的
example: Cooperative activity is essential to effective community work.
translation: 要把社区工作做好，协作活动是必不可少的。

meaning: adj. 法人的；团体的；社团的
example: Increasingly, corporate clients are seeking to outsource the management of their facilities.
translation: 越来越多的公司客户寻求将设施的管理外包出去。

meaning: v. 忠告，建议
example: The defence counsel warned that the judge should stop the trial.
translation: 被告辩护律师强烈建议法官应该休庭。

meaning: n. 夫妻，情侣
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: adj. 有勇气的
example: It was a courageous decision, and one that everybody admired.
translation: 那是一个勇敢的决定，也是一个为所有人赞赏的决定。

meaning: n & v. 坠落;坠毁;撞击
example: A light aircraft crash-landed on a putting green yesterday.
translation: 一架轻型飞机昨天在一个高尔夫球场的球洞区紧急降落了。

meaning: n. 创造力
example: How can faculty improve their teaching so as to encourage creativity?
translation: 教师们如何才能改进教学以激发创造性呢？

meaning: n. 危机
example: The Kremlin is still insisting on a diplomatic solution to the crisis.
translation: 俄罗斯中央政府依然坚持通过外交方式解决危机。

meaning: n. 批评家，评论家
example: He was a stern critic but an extremely kindly man.
translation: 他是个苛刻的批评家，但却是个非常善良的人。

meaning: adj. 批评的，爱挑剔的
example: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
translation: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

meaning: v. 批评；评论
example: They would criticize me, or worse yet, pay me no attention.
translation: 他们会指责我，或者更糟糕的是，干脆对我毫不理睬。

meaning: n. 批评
v. 培养
example: Estonia has done much to cultivate the friendship of western European countries.
translation: 爱沙尼亚努力发展与西欧国家的友谊。

meaning: v & n. 控制
example: Wade released the hand brake and pulled away from the curb.
translation: 韦德松开手刹驶离路边。

meaning: n. 好奇心
example: She also stimulated his curiosity and opened his mind to other cultures.
translation: 她还激发了他的好奇心，使他愿意了解其他文化。

meaning: adj. 好奇的
example: The interior was shielded from the curious gaze of passersby.
translation: 屋子内部被挡住了，以防路人好奇地张望。

meaning: adj. 当前的
example: The tidal stream or current gradually decreases in the shallows.
translation: 浅滩上的潮水逐渐退去。

meaning: adv. 当前；一般地
example: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
translation: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

meaning: n. 债务
example: The plan is designed to reduce some of the company's mountainous debt.
translation: 该计划旨在减少公司堆积如山的债务。

meaning: adj. 正派的，体面的
example: I went to Brooks Brothers and bought myself a decent shirt.
translation: 我去布鲁克斯兄弟专卖店给自己买了一件体面的衬衫。

meaning: v. 下降，减少；拒绝
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: v. 装饰
example: Use shells to decorate boxes, trays, mirrors or even pots.
translation: 用贝壳来装点盒子、托盘、镜子甚至是花盆。

meaning: n. 定义
example: It all depends on your definition of punk, doesn'tit?
translation: “这全视乎你对朋克摇滚乐的定义，不是吗？”

meaning: n. 程度
example: degree of
translation: …的程度；…的学位

meaning: v. 推迟，延期
example: How much delay should we build into the plan?
translation: 我们应该为这个计划预留多少富余的时间？

meaning: adj. 故意的
example: He got sent off for deliberate handball in the 32nd minute.
translation: 他在第32分钟时因故意手球犯规被罚下场。

meaning: adj. 高兴的
example: It was the most delightful garden I had ever seen.
translation: 这是我所见过的最惹人喜爱的花园。

meaning: v. 发表
example: I have orders to deliver it to Mr Demiris personally.
translation: 我奉命要把它送给德米里斯先生本人。

meaning: v & n. 需求，要求
example: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: adj. 民主的
example: The Democratic candidate is still leading in the polls.
translation: 民主党候选人的得票数依然领先。

meaning: v. 证明；展示
example: The best and the brightest pupils competed to demonstrate their intellectual prowess.
translation: 最出色、最聪明的学生们竞相展示他们的才智。

meaning: n. 密度
example: the density of a gas
translation: 一种气体的密度

meaning: n. 部门
example: She was the only woman in Shell's legal department.
translation: 她是壳牌公司法律事务部唯一的女性。

meaning: adj. 沮丧的；萧条的
example: When depressed, they dramatically overindulge in chocolate and sweets.
translation: 情绪低落的时候，她们就疯狂地猛吃巧克力和糖果。

meaning: adj. 令人沮丧的
example: He always woke with a sense of deep sorrow and depressing loss.
translation: 他醒来时总是满怀哀愁，抑郁惆怅。

meaning: v. 剥夺，夺去，使丧失
example: This law will deprive us of our most basic rights.
translation: 这条法律将剥夺我们最基本的权利.

meaning: v. 得到，导出
example: Most patients derive enjoyment from leafing through old picture albums.
translation: 大多数病人都很喜欢翻看旧相册。

meaning: v. 值得
example: He does deserve some good luck after so much wretchedness.
translation: 经过这么多苦难之后，他应该行点好运了。

meaning: n. 渴望，欲望
example: The desire to be a mother may creep up on you unexpectedly.
translation: 你会不知不觉地产生想当母亲的渴望。

meaning: prep. 不管
example: despite of
translation: 不管；不顾

meaning: n. 甜点
example: Scott was obviously inebriated by the time the dessert was served.
translation: 到了上甜点的时候，斯科特显然已经喝醉了。

meaning: n. 细节
example: No detail was too small to escape her attention.
translation: 再小的细节都逃不过她的眼睛。

meaning: adj. 细节的，详细的
example: He gave a detailed account of what happened on the fateful night.
translation: 他详细描述了那个灾难性夜晚所发生的事。

meaning: v. 觉察;检测
example: He conjectured that some individuals may be able to detect major calamities.
translation: 他猜测说有些人也许能够察觉重大灾难。

meaning: n. 侦查；察觉
example: The detection rate for racial crimes is appallingly low.
translation: 种族罪案的侦破率之低让人震惊。

meaning: n. 侦探
example: "Once a detective, always a detective," he said lightly.
translation: “一日为侦探，终生为侦探，”他满不在意地说。

meaning: v. 决定；下决心
example: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
translation: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

meaning: n. 意志
example: It must have reinforced my determination to blend into my surroundings.
translation: 这势必让我更加下定决心融入周围环境。

meaning: n. 装置，设备
example: The device had been used operationally some months previously.
translation: 该设备几个月之前曾投入运行。

meaning: v. 奉献，致力于
example: Faculty members devote most of their time to scholarly research.
translation: 全院教师大部分时间都用来从事学术研究。

meaning: n. 独裁者；专制者
example: They believe that the country needs a benevolent dictator.
translation: 他们认为国家需要一位仁爱的独裁者。

meaning: adj. 勤奋的
example: He was careful and diligent. I was all over the place.
translation: 他细心且勤奋，我则稀里糊涂。

meaning: n. 文凭
example: a BTEC Higher National Diploma in Public Service Studies
translation: BTEC公共服务科高等国家证书

meaning: n. 不利情况，缺点
example: Depression is the third thing that works to my patients' disadvantage.
translation: 抑郁是威胁我的病人健康的第三大杀手。

meaning: v. 不见，消失
example: She stood watching the car's tail-lights disappear down the drive.
translation: 她站在那儿，望着小汽车的尾灯消失在车道尽头。

meaning: v. 释放；排出 解雇
example: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay compensation.
translation: 他被有条件地释放了，被责令支付赔偿款。

meaning: n. 折扣
example: I'll sell at a discount in return for a speedy sale.
translation: 为了尽快售出，我会打折销售。

meaning: v. 发现
example: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
translation: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

meaning: adj. 杂乱的
example: In most of the residence halls we visited, rules prohibit disorderly conduct.
translation: 在我们走访的学生宿舍里，大多明令禁止胡作非为。

meaning: n & v. 展览
example: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
translation: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

meaning: n & v. 辩论，争论
v. 不满意
example: It is our belief to further expand markets and dissatisfy with existing achievements.
translation: 进一步开拓市场，不满足于现有成绩是我们的信念。

meaning: n. 距离
example: Jay had always tended to keep his girlfriends at a distance.
translation: 杰伊一贯和他的女朋友们保持距离。

meaning: adj. 遥远的
example: From somewhere distant he heard the clatter of a typewriter.
translation: 他听见从远处什么地方传来打字机的嗒嗒声。

meaning: v. 区别，区分
example: It is common to distinguish between personal and social ethics.
translation: 个人道德准则和社会道德准则常常不一致。

meaning: adj. 显著的，杰出的
example: All objects are vetted by a distinguished panel of experts.
translation: 所有物品都交由一个著名的专家小组检查鉴定。

meaning: v. 分心
example: There was nothing at all in this miserable place to distract him.
translation: 这个鬼地方根本没有什么东西可以让他分心。

meaning: adj. 分心的
example: Few things distracted the Pastor from the preparation of his weekly sermons.
translation: 几乎没有什么事情能使牧师在准备每周的布道时分神。

meaning: n. 消遣；分心
example: Driven to distraction, he murdered the woman who jilted him.
translation: 他被逼得发狂，于是杀死了抛弃他的那个女人。

meaning: v. 分发
example: We didn't understand how difficult it was to distribute a national paper.
translation: 我们不了解分销一份全国发行的报纸有多难。

meaning: n. 区
example: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
translation: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

meaning: adj. 各种各样的
example: India has always been one of the most religiously diverse countries.
translation: 印度一直都是宗教信仰最多元的国家之一。

meaning: n. 多样性；差异
v. 分开
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. 除法；部门
example: Villa had just been relegated from the First Division.
translation: 维拉队刚刚从甲级联赛中降级。

meaning: n. 文件
example: To close your document, press CTRL+W on your keyboard.
translation: 关闭文件时要同时按键盘上的CTRL键和W键。

meaning: adj. 占优势的
example: Japan is Asia's dominant supplier of imports and technology.
translation: 日本是亚洲进口货物和技术的最大供应国。

meaning: n. 主导
example: Her experience of men was of domination and brutality.
translation: 男人给她的感受是支配一切，野蛮残暴。

meaning: n. 捐赠
example: Return the enclosed Donation Form today in the prepaid envelope provided.
translation: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。

meaning: v. 捐赠
example: Pictures of starving children have sent many people scurrying to donate money.
translation: 看到一张张忍饥挨饿的孩子们的照片，许多人赶忙捐钱。

meaning: n. 宿舍
example: The students have barricaded themselves into their dormitory building.
translation: 学生们把自己关在了宿舍楼里。

meaning: n. （雨等的）大下特下
example: His pride may still be his downfall.
translation: 他的傲慢可能还会毁了他。

meaning: v. 下载
example: Users can download their material to a desktop PC.
translation: 用户可以把资料下载到台式机上。

meaning: adv. 戏剧性地，引人注目地
example: When depressed, they dramatically overindulge in chocolate and sweets.
translation: 情绪低落的时候，她们就疯狂地猛吃巧克力和糖果。

meaning: n. 辍学
example: a university with a high dropout rate
translation: 退学率高的大学

meaning: adj. 到期的
example: Council members are due to have informal discussions later on today.
translation: 委员会成员定于今日晚些时候进行非正式讨论。

meaning: v. 倾倒；倾销
example: I thought he was going to dump me for another girl.
translation: 我以为他要为了另一个女孩而和我分手。

meaning: adj. 持久的，耐用的
example: The durable high-impact plastic case is water resistant to 100 feet.
translation: 这种结实的高强度塑料盒子在水下100英尺以内是防水的。

meaning: n. 轻松，舒适
example: They agreed to work co-operatively to ease tensions wherever possible.
translation: 他们同意互相配合尽一切努力缓解紧张局势。

meaning: adj. 脾气随和的，温和的
example: an easygoing, uncomplicated young man
translation: 一个随和、率直的男青年

meaning: n. 影响
example: effect on
translation: 对…的作用

meaning: adj. 有效地
v. 消除
example: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it.
translation: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

meaning: v. 尴尬
example: I did not embarrass her with my effusions.
translation: 我并没有太过热情而让她为难。

meaning: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的
example: feel embarrassed
translation: 感到尴尬

meaning: v. 拥抱；接受；采纳
example: I couldn't find it in me to embrace him.
translation: 我打心眼里不想拥抱他。

meaning: n. 出现，发生
example: the emergence of a fully fledged market economy
translation: 成熟市场经济的出现

meaning: n. 紧急情况
example: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

meaning: n. 排放，辐射
example: the emission of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
translation: 向大气排放二氧化碳

meaning: v. 发出，排出
example: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.
translation: 金属容器开始发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。

meaning: adj. 情绪的；容易激动的；感动人的
example: "Tired and emotional" is a code word for being drunk.
translation: “又累又激动”是形容人喝醉酒的一种委婉说法。

meaning: v. 强调
example: I tried to emphasize my good points without sounding boastful.
translation: 我在强调自己的优点时尽量不让人觉得是在自我吹嘘。

meaning: v. 鼓励
example: The idea is to encourage people to get to know their neighbours.
translation: 其目的是促使人们结识邻居。

meaning: n. 耐力
example: He showed remarkable endurance throughout his illness.
translation: 他在整个生病期间表现出非凡的忍耐力。

meaning: v. 忍耐；容忍
example: Then something seemed to snap in me. I couldn't endure any more.
translation: 这时候，我的心里像有个东西突然绷断了——我再也忍受不了啦。

meaning: v. 忙于，从事；吸引
example: You can engage in croquet on the south lawn.
translation: 你可以参加南边草坪上的槌球游戏。

meaning: n. 约会
example: The constitution prohibits them from military engagement on foreign soil.
translation: 宪法禁止他们在外国采取军事行动。

meaning: v. 提高；加强；增加
example: Large paintings can enhance the feeling of space in small rooms.
translation: 大型油画可以增加小房间的宽敞感。

meaning: adj. 巨大的
example: She was a shy, delicately pretty girl with enormous blue eyes.
translation: 她是一个害羞、娇美的女孩，长着一双大大的蓝眼睛。

meaning: v. 丰富；使富有
example: People with disabilities are now doing many things to enrich their lives.
translation: 残疾人士如今做很多事情来丰富他们的生活。

meaning: v. 注册
example: I should like to enroll all my children in the swimming class.
translation: 我愿意让我的孩子们都参加游泳班.

meaning: n. 入学人数
example: You will be given a reading list at enrollment.
translation: 注册时你会收到一份阅读书目.

meaning: v. 确保
example: The drill should be slowly rotated to ensure a clean hole.
translation: 钻头必须缓慢转动，以保证钻孔平整光滑。

meaning: adj. 有趣的，使人愉快的
example: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 school-children for an afternoon.
translation: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。

meaning: adj. 相等的，平等的
example: In many respects Asian women see themselves as equal to their men.
translation: 在很多方面，亚洲女性都认为自己和丈夫是平等的。

meaning: n. 平等
example: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
translation: 迄今为止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

meaning: adj. 相等的，相当的
example: His party has just suffered the equivalent of a near-fatal heart attack.
translation: 他所在的政党刚刚经历了一次类似心脏病突发般几近致命的打击。

meaning: n. 等值，相等
example: Nuclear physics has provided extensive experimental support for the mass - energy equivalence.
translation: 原子核物理学已经为质能等效性提供了广泛的实验证据.

meaning: n. 纪元，年代
example: As the era wore on, she switched her attention to films.
translation: 随着这个时代慢慢过去，她把目光投向了电影业。

meaning: n. 散文，文章
example: essay test
translation: n. 申论方式测验

meaning: adv. 本质上地；必须的
example: Many other surveys have produced results essentially in agreement with these figures.
translation: 许多其他调查已经得出了与这些数据基本一致的结果。

meaning: v. 建立，创办，设立
example: We're trying to establish linkages between these groups and financial institutions.
translation: 我们正努力在这些团体和金融机构之间建立联系。

meaning: n. 确立，制定；公司；设施
example: The fusty old establishment refused to recognise the demand for popular music.
translation: 这一古板的老旧机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

meaning: n. 自尊
example: It was so humiliating, a terrible blow to my self-esteem.
translation: 这件事如此丢脸，深深地挫伤了我的自尊心。

meaning: v. 估计
example: Its own estimate of three hundred tallies with that of another survey.
translation: 其估计数目300与另一项调查的结果相吻合。

meaning: n. 根据，证据，迹象
example: He found evidence of mutated forms of the gene.
translation: 他找到了该基因出现了变异形式的证据。

meaning: adj. 明显的
example: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
translation: 通货膨胀的危险在证券价格上已经表现得很明显。

meaning: n. 邪恶，罪恶
v. 使发展
example: We can evolve the truth from a mass of confused evidence.
translation: 我们可以从庞杂的证据中推断事实真相.

meaning: v. 夸张
example: There could be more unrest, but I wouldn't exaggerate the problems.
translation: 可能会有更大的动荡，不过我想也不必夸大问题。

meaning: adj. 卓越的，杰出的，极好的
example: The regions are interconnected by an excellent highway system.
translation: 那些地区通过完善的公路系统相互连接。

meaning: n. 例外
example: Almost without exception those convicted were our friends and colleagues.
translation: 那些被判有罪的人几乎无一例外都是我们的朋友和同事。

meaning: adj. 过度的
example: The police vigorously denied that excessive force had been used.
translation: 警方坚决否认曾经滥用武力。

meaning: n & v. 交换，交流
example: This could intensify the risk of a nuclear exchange.
translation: 这可能会加剧爆发核战争的危险。

meaning: v. 排除，不包括
example: The first task was to fence the wood to exclude sheep.
translation: 第一项任务就是把树林围起来不让羊进去。

meaning: v. 扩大
example: The ultimate aim is to expand the network further.
translation: 最终目的是为了进一步拓展该网络。

meaning: v. 开采
example: I even began to exploit him in subtle ways.
translation: 我甚至开始巧妙地利用他。

meaning: v. 探索
example: I would creep in and with stealthy footsteps explore the second-floor.
translation: 我会偷偷溜进去，轻手轻脚地查看一下二楼。

meaning: n. 爆炸
example: A violent explosion seemed to jolt the whole ground.
translation: 剧烈的爆炸好像要把整个地面都掀起来。

meaning: v. 暴露
example: When Myra told Karp she'd expose his past, he blew up.
translation: 当迈拉告诉卡普她会把他的过去全抖搂出去时，卡普大为光火。

meaning: n. 暴露；揭露
example: Their sporting reputation has suffered enormously from Johnson's exposure.
translation: 由于约翰逊东窗事发，他们的体育声誉受到了严重损害。

meaning: n. 表达
example: Crying is part of our natural expressiveness.
translation: 哭泣是自然情感的一种表现。

meaning: n. 分机
example: After a further four-month extension of her probation period, she was sacked.
translation: 在又试用了4个月后，她被开除了。

meaning: adj. 课外的
example: Each child had participated in extracurricular activities at school.
translation: 每个孩子都参加了学校的课外活动。

meaning: n. 设施
example: Your camcorder should have these basic features: autofocus, playback facility, zoom lens.
translation: 你的便携式摄像机应该具备以下基本功能：自动聚焦、回放功能、变焦镜头。

meaning: n. 信任
example: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

meaning: adj. 熟悉的
example: Rose heard the familiar voice, but tuned out the words.
translation: 罗斯听到了熟悉的声音，但没注意听说的是什么。

meaning: v. 想象，幻想
example: Research has shown that men are likely to fantasize far more frequently than women.
translation: 研究表明男人性幻想的频率要比女人高得多。

meaning: v. 强烈地吸引，迷住
example: I believed devoutly in her power to fascinate him, in her dazzling loveliness.
translation: 我由衷地相信她有使他神魂颠倒的力量, 相信她有令人眼花缭乱的姿色.

meaning: n. 魅力；入迷
example: I've had a lifelong fascination with the sea and with small boats.
translation: 我一生都对大海和小船着迷。

meaning: adj. 致命的，攸关的
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: n. 命运
example: They held his fate in the palms of their ancient hands.
translation: 他们这些老人将他的命运掌握在手心里。

meaning: n. 疲劳，疲乏
example: She continued to have severe stomach cramps, aches, fatigue, and depression.
translation: 她仍然患有严重的胃痉挛，感觉疼痛、疲乏、抑郁。

meaning: adj. 赞同的
adj. 可行的；可能的；可用的
example: It's just not feasible to manage the business on a part-time basis.
translation: 兼职管理业务是搞不好的。

meaning: n. 特点
example: The most arresting feature is the painted wall decoration.
translation: 最醒目的特点是绘有图画的墙面装饰。

meaning: n. 反馈
example: It would monitor traffic flows and provide feedback to motorists.
translation: 它能监控交通状况，然后给司机提供反馈信息。

meaning: n. 小说，虚构的文学作品
example: Fiction takes up a large slice of the publishing market.
translation: 小说在出版市场上占了很大的份额。

meaning: n. 人物；数字
example: public figure
translation: 社会名人

meaning: adj. 财政的，经济的
example: The enquiry dug deeper into the alleged financial misdeeds of his government.
translation: 这一调查对其政府涉嫌的财政违规行为展开了进一步深究。

meaning: n. 财政; v. 筹集资金
example: The finance minister will continue to mastermind Poland's economic reform.
translation: 财政部长将继续策划波兰的经济改革。

meaning: v. 罚款
example: "I want to send a telegram." — "Fine, to whom?"
translation: “我想发份电报。”——“好的，发给谁？”

meaning: n. 健康
example: The emphasis is on developing fitness through exercises and training.
translation: 重点在于通过锻炼促进健康。

meaning: adj. 灵活的
example: Times become more flexible off-season, especially in the smaller provincial museums.
translation: 尤其是在规模较小的地方博物馆，开放时间在旅游淡季更加灵活。

meaning: n. 立足处（攀登时脚踩的地方）
example: I hung there, scrabbling with my feet to find a foothold.
translation: 我吊在那儿，两脚乱蹬着寻找落脚点。

meaning: v. 规定，制定
example: He took care to formulate his reply very clearly.
translation: 他字斟句酌,清楚地做了回答.

meaning: adv. 幸运地
example: Fortunately for me, my friend saw that something was seriously wrong.
translation: 对我来说幸运的是，我的朋友发现了非常严重的错误。

meaning: n. 地基；基础；基金会
example: She dug the foundation with a pick and shovel.
translation: 她用镐和平锹挖地基。

meaning: v. 使惊恐，使恐慌
example: Fairground rides are intended to frighten the life out of you.
translation: 露天游乐场的飞车就是想把人吓丢了魂儿。

meaning: n. 边境
example: A "frontier-free" Europe implies a greatly increased market for all economic operators.
translation: “无国界的”欧洲对所有经营者来说都意味着一个大大扩展了的市场。

meaning: v & n. 功能，运行
example: His function is vital to the accomplishment of the agency's mission.
translation: 要完成该机构的使命，他的作用至关重要。

meaning: n. 基金，储备；; v. 提供资金
example: He's accused of misusing $17.5 million from a secret government slush fund.
translation: 他被指控滥用秘密的政府行贿基金，金额达1,750万美元。

meaning: n. 大惊小怪
example: Auntie Hilda and Uncle Jack couldn't fuss over them enough.
translation: 希尔达姨妈和杰克姨父对他们宠爱有加。

meaning: n. 赌博
example: Gambling and tourism pay roughly half the entire state budget.
translation: 博彩业和旅游业支撑着整个国家约一半的财政预算。

meaning: n. 差距;缝隙缺口
example: Like a good businessman, Stewart identified a gap in the market.
translation: 像精明的商人一样，斯图尔特发现了市场上的一个空白。

meaning: n. 车库
example: Ben drove past them, nosing his car into the garage.
translation: 本小心翼翼地把车开进车库时从他们身边经过。

meaning: n. 齿轮; v. 使合适
example: There wasn't enough room in the baggage compartment for all the gear.
translation: 行李舱没有足够的空间放下所有的工具。

meaning: n. 性别
example: Dara challenges our stereotypical ideas about gender and femininity.
translation: 达拉对我们老一套的性别和女性特质观念提出了异议。

meaning: n. 一般化
example: The evaluation of conduct involves some amount of generalization.
translation: 对操行的评价会含有一些泛泛之论。

meaning: n. 一代人，产生
example: A new generation of scientists became fascinated by dinosaurs.
translation: 新一代科学家对恐龙研究着了迷。

meaning: n. 慷慨，大方
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: adj. 慷慨的
example: Not everyone thinks that the government is being particularly generous.
translation: 并非所有人都认为政府特别慷慨。

meaning: adj. 真正的
example: genuine leather
translation: 真皮

meaning: n. 礼物；天赋
example: Her grandmother had the gift of making people happy.
translation: 她奶奶有逗人开心的本事。

meaning: adj. 阴沉的，沮丧的
example: Some good might come of all this gloomy business.
translation: 生意不景气也未必全是坏事。

meaning: adj. 辉煌的
example: We opened the windows and let in the glorious evening air.
translation: 我们打开窗户，让傍晚那沁人心脾的空气流进室内。

meaning: v. 抢先，抢占，抢夺
example: He made a grab for her but she sidestepped him.
translation: 他想要抓住她，但她侧步闪开了。

meaning: n. 杂货店
example: I worked stocking shelves in a grocery store.
translation: 我在一家杂货店工作，负责为货架上货。

meaning: adv. 无缘无故地，无根据地
n & v. 保证，担保
example: He argues strongly for retention of NATO as a guarantee of peace.
translation: 他强烈要求保留北大西洋公约组织以维护和平。

meaning: n. 指导原则
example: A written IQ test is merely a guideline.
translation: 书面智商测试仅供参考。

meaning: n. 有罪，犯罪行为
example: The drinking and the guilt fed on each other.
translation: 酗酒和犯罪彼此助长。

meaning: n. 体育馆，健身房
example: The gym can be used by both able-bodied and disabled people.
translation: 这家健身房健全和残障人士都可使用。

meaning: v. 控制，处理
example: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

meaning: adj. 苦干的，不辞辛劳的
example: He was hardworking and energetic.
translation: 他工作努力，精力充沛。

meaning: n & v. 有害
example: Nudism, the council decided, was doing the resort more harm than good.
translation: 委员会认定在休闲胜地的裸体行为弊大于利。

meaning: adj. 有害的
example: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
translation: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

meaning: n. 和谐
example: As they smiled at each other, harmony was restored again.
translation: 他们彼此微笑的时候，又恢复了往日的和睦。

meaning: adj. 严酷的
example: His voice was harsh as he enunciated each word carefully.
translation: 他一字一顿，听上去很生硬。

meaning: n. 危险
example: Catching colds is unfortunately an occupational hazard in this profession.
translation: 不幸的是，容易感冒是这个行业的职业性风险。

meaning: v & n. 照亮；突出；强调
example: Once again, the "Free Press" prefers not to highlight these facts.
translation: “自由新闻”组织再次故意不去突出强调这些事实。

meaning: v. 雇佣
example: Child car seats only cost about £10 a week to hire.
translation: 儿童汽车坐椅一周的租金才10英镑。

meaning: n. 主妇
example: Emma is a price - conscious homemaker.
translation: 埃玛是个节省的家庭主妇.

meaning: n. 诚实
example: We like him for his honesty, his lack of pretension.
translation: 我们喜欢他的诚实、不浮夸。

meaning: v. 纪念
example: The Chinese make a point of their personal honor.
translation: 中国人特别重视个人荣誉.

meaning: v. 就医
example: The employee must hospitalize in the appointed hospital by the employer.
translation: 受聘方须在聘方指定的医院就医,在非指定医院就医费用自理.

meaning: n. 家庭，一家人
example: Some barbecues can be plugged into a household electricity supply.
translation: 有一些烧烤炉能直接插到家用电源上。

meaning: n. 人类，总称人(性)
example: We admire her dedication to the cause of humanity.
translation: 我们敬佩她对人类事业的献身精神。

meaning: adj. 相同的
example: The identical treatment of such dissimilar items is totally illogical.
translation: 对如此不同的东西用一模一样的处理方法是完全不合逻辑的。

meaning: v. 认出，识别；视为
example: The new technique has been used to identify the sex of foetuses.
translation: 这一新技术已经被用来鉴别胎儿的性别。

meaning: n. 鉴定，识别；认同；身份证明
example: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
translation: 稍稍停顿了一下，他问道，“你有任何身份证明吗？”

meaning: n. 身份
example: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
translation: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

meaning: n. 无知，愚昧
example: Ignorance of people brings fear, fear of the unknown.
translation: 人们的无知会带来恐惧，对未知事物的恐惧。

meaning: v. 忽视，不顾
example: The movie industry had chosen to ignore the encroaching competition of television.
translation: 电影业故意无视电视业的侵犯性竞争。

meaning: adj. 非法的
example: By-laws are to make it illegal to smoke in public.
translation: 地方法规将规定在公共场合抽烟为非法。

meaning: v. 说明,阐明
example: He quoted some old Chinese sayings to illustrate his points.
translation: 他援用了一些中国话来解释他的论点.

meaning: n. 形象，声誉，印象
example: The European Parliament badly needs a president who can burnish its image.
translation: 欧洲议会急需一位能改善其声望的主席。

meaning: adj. 虚构的，想象的
example: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
translation: 精神分裂症的最常见的一个症状就是幻听。

meaning: adj. 稳定的，不变的
example: A riding accident left him immobile.
translation: 一场骑马意外事故导致他瘫痪。

meaning: n. 影响
example: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
translation: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

meaning: adj. 非永久（性）的；不持久的，暂时的
example: We are reminded just how small and how impermanent we are.
translation: 它让我们意识到我们有多么渺小，我们的生命是何其短暂。

meaning: n. 非永久性
v. 实施，执行
example: Leadership is about the ability to implement change.
translation: 领导才能就是要有实施变革的能力。

meaning: v. 意味；暗示
example: Cheerfulness doesn't always imply happiness.
translation: 快活并不总是意味着幸福.

meaning: n & v. 进口
example: We import an incredible amount of cheese from the Continent.
translation: 我们从欧洲大陆进口数量惊人的奶酪。

meaning: v. 强加
example: I didn't want to impose myself on my married friends.
translation: 我不想打扰自己已婚的朋友。

meaning: adj. 不合适的，不适当的
example: He would never be improper, he is always the perfect gentleman.
translation: 他总是举止得体，一直是个完美的绅士。

meaning: adj. 不足的，不够的
example: Regrettably we have to house families in these inadequate flats.
translation: 很遗憾，我们不得不让住户挤在这些狭小的公寓里。

meaning: adj. 不合适的
example: There is no suggestion that clients have been sold inappropriate policies.
translation: 无迹象表明向客户售出了不适用的保险。

meaning: v. 包含
example: The unemployed executives include former sales managers, directors and accountants.
translation: 被解雇的管理人员包括前销售经理、主管和会计。

meaning: adj. 不可思议的
example: It was an incredible display of motherly love and forgiveness.
translation: 那是慈母般关爱与宽容的了不起的表现。

meaning: v. 表明
example: Ballpark estimates indicate a price tag of $90 million a month.
translation: 大致的估计费用为每月9,000万美元。

meaning: adj. 必不可少的
example: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.
translation: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

meaning: n. 个人
example: Tourism is up, jobs are up, individual income is up.
translation: 旅游火了，工作机会多了，个人收入涨了。

meaning: v. 引诱
example: He might decide that it is best to induce labour.
translation: 他也许决定最好引产。

meaning: adj. 不可避免的
example: Most unions see privatisation as an inevitable prelude to job losses.
translation: 大多数工会认为私有化会不可避免地导致失业。

meaning: adj. 无限的
example: The most amazing thing about nature is its infinite variety.
translation: 大自然最让人惊叹的是它的无限多样性。

meaning: n. 通货膨胀
example: Specialists see various reasons for the recent surge in inflation.
translation: 专家们认为目前通货膨胀加剧有多种原因。

meaning: v. 膨胀
example: The promotion of a big release can inflate a film'sfinal cost.
translation: 大规模发行所需的广告宣传会增加一部电影的最终成本。

meaning: v & n. 影响
example: I fell under the influence of a history master.
translation: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

meaning: adj. 有影响力的
example: The West has gradually relaxed its hostile attitude to this influential state.
translation: 西方对这个颇具影响力的国家的敌视态度已逐渐缓和。

meaning: n. 成分，原料
example: The active ingredient in some of the mouthwashes was simply detergent.
translation: 某些漱口剂中的有效成分只不过是洗涤剂而已。

meaning: v. 继承
example: Princess Alexandra was to inherit the title of Duchess of Fife.
translation: 亚历山德拉公主将会继承法夫女公爵的爵位。

meaning: v. 开始，发起
example: Chen was an initiate of a Chinese spiritual discipline.
translation: 陈是某个中国神学领域的新入门者。

meaning: n. 主动权，自主权
example: He proposed a new diplomatic initiative to try to stop the war.
translation: 他提出了一项新的外交计划以尽力阻止这场战争。

meaning: v. 使受伤
example: I can say, with absolute truthfulness, that I did not injure her.
translation: 我可以绝对坦率地说，我没有伤害她。

meaning: adj. 无辜的，天真的；
example: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
translation: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

meaning: n. 改革，创新
example: The vegetarian burger was an innovation which was rapidly exported to Britain.
translation: 素食汉堡是一种迅速传到了英国的新开发食品。

meaning: adj. 不安全的
example: People feel pinched in their pocketbooks and insecure about their futures.
translation: 人们感到荷包拮据，对未来缺乏安全感。

meaning: n. 洞察力，洞悉
example: He got his first insight into how inhumane employers can be.
translation: 他对雇主的冷酷无情第一次有了深刻认识。

meaning: n. 灵感
example: Powell's unusual journey to high office is an inspiration to millions.
translation: 鲍威尔升任高官的不寻常历程对数以百万计的人都是一个激励。

meaning: v. 激发；鼓舞；使产生灵感
example: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
translation: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

meaning: v. 安装
example: Another change that Sue made was to install central heating.
translation: 休所作的另一个改变是安装中央供暖系统。

meaning: n. 安装，就任
example: Installation of the new system will take several days.
translation: 新系统的安装需要几天时间。

meaning: n. 安装，分期付款
example: His car was repossessed because of default of monthly installment.
translation: 因为拖欠按月应付的分期付款,他的汽车被收回了.

meaning: adj. 立即的；紧急的；速溶的，方便的
example: In the same instant he flung open the car door.
translation: 与此同时，他猛地推开了车门。

meaning: n & v. 建立
example: The Institute of Export now fears that 100,000 jobs will go.
translation: 现在出口协会担心将失去10万个工作机会。

meaning: n. 社会公共机构；制度，习俗；设立，制定
example: Congress as an institution scores low in public opinion polls.
translation: 作为一个公共机构，国会在公众民意调查中得分很低。

meaning: n. 命令，指示，用法说明
example: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
translation: 这一方法给教学带来了活力，也使知识的吸收变得容易了。

meaning: v. 指导；通知；命令；教授
example: We should instruct the passengers what customs regulations are.
translation: 我们应该向乘客说明海关规则是什么.

meaning: n. 仪器，器械，工具
example: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
translation: 一种叫做套管针的工具在腹壁上刺了一个孔。

meaning: n. 摄入
example: We are constantly being reminded to cut down our fat intake.
translation: 不断有人提醒我们要减少脂肪的摄入量。

meaning: n. 完整，综合
example: He inspires affection and respect as a man of unquestionable integrity.
translation: 他无可争议的忠诚正直赢得了人们的爱戴和尊敬。

meaning: n. 智力，智慧，理解力
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: adj. 智能的
example: She was thin and spare, with a sharply intelligent face.
translation: 她又高又瘦，一副精明过人的模样。

meaning: v. 打算
example: England intend fielding their strongest team in next month's World Youth Championship.
translation: 英格兰意欲在下月的世界青年锦标赛中推出他们的最强阵容。

meaning: v. 相互联系
example: Their lives interconnect with those of celebrated figures of the late eighteenth-century.
translation: 他们的生活与18世纪晚期的名人联系在一起。

meaning: n. 相互依靠
example: By the same token , the everlasting interdependence is actually an everlasting love.
translation: 正如, 永远的依存,也是永远的爱.

meaning: v. 解释
example: They could interpret it that way if they'd a mind to.
translation: 如果他们愿意的话，可以那样理解。

meaning: adj. 种族间的
example: Facts: A Virgina statute prohibits interracial marriages between whites and blacks.
translation: 弗吉尼亚州某法禁止白人和黑人的种族间通婚.

meaning: n. 干涉
example: The council recently drew fire for its intervention in the dispute.
translation: 委员会最近因为介入该起争端而遭到批评。

meaning: n. 会见；面谈（试）; v. 采访
example: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
translation: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

meaning: v. 侵入，侵略
example: The press invade people's privacy unfairly and unjustifiably every day.
translation: 新闻媒体每天都在不公正地且没有正当理由地侵犯人们的隐私。

meaning: adj. 无效的
example: Margaret resides with her invalid mother in a London suburb.
translation: 玛格丽特同她病弱的母亲住在伦敦郊区。

meaning: v. 投资
example: They would have to offer cast-iron guarantees to invest in long-term projects.
translation: 他们需提供绝对可靠的担保，才能投资长期项目。

meaning: v. 卷入，包含
example: The £85m programme will involve an extensive rebranding of the airline.
translation: 这个8,500万英镑的项目将包括全面重塑该航空公司的形象。

meaning: adv. 不合理地，无理性地
