meaning: n. 地震；大震荡
example: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population.
translation: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

meaning: n. 容易，舒适; v. 缓和
example: They agreed to work co-operatively to ease tensions wherever possible.
translation: 他们同意互相配合尽一切努力缓解紧张局势。

meaning: adv. 容易地；舒适的
example: Stan Dean, easily identifiable by his oddly-shaped hat, sat in a doorway.
translation: 斯坦·迪安坐在门口，他那顶奇形怪状的帽子一下子就让人认出他来。

meaning: n. 东；东部; adv. 在东方
example: Big credits were given to East Germany by successive West German governments.
translation: 历届西德政府给予东德大量的贷款。

meaning: adj. 东方的；朝东的
example: Physical and ideological barriers had come down in Eastern Europe.
translation: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

meaning: adj. 容易的；安逸的
example: It is easy to appreciate the craftsmanship of Armani.
translation: 阿玛尼的精致工艺很容易博得人们的赞誉。

meaning: v. 吃，喝; v. 吃饭
example: It makes sense to eat a reasonably balanced diet when slimming.
translation: 在减肥过程中保持饮食的营养相对均衡是明智的。

meaning: n. 回声，反响; v. 重复
example: Pinks and beiges were chosen to echo the colours of the ceiling.
translation: 选用了粉红色和米色，以跟从天花板的颜色。

meaning: adj. 经济的，经济学的
example: The United States plans to tighten the economic sanctions currently in place.
translation: 美国计划加大现有经济制裁的力度。

meaning: adj. 节约的；经济学的
example: Mexican cookery is economical, she says. Nothing goes to waste.
translation: “墨西哥的烹调注重俭省，”她说，“任何东西都不会浪费。”

meaning: n. 经济；节约，节省
example: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
translation: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

meaning: n. 边缘，边；刀口
example: McGregor's effort was enough to edge Johnson out of the top spot.
translation: 麦格雷戈奋力一搏，成功地将约翰逊从第一的位置上挤了下来。

meaning: n. 版，版本，版次
n. 编辑，编者，校订者
example: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
translation: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

meaning: v. 教育；培养；训练
example: Ruth's parents opted to educate her intensively at home.
translation: 露丝的父母选择了在家对她进行集中教育。

meaning: n. 教育；训导；教育学
example: Sex education is also expected to help check the spread of AIDS.
translation: 人们还希望性教育有助于控制艾滋病的蔓延。

meaning: n. 结果；效果，效力
example: effect on
translation: 对…的作用

meaning: adj. 有效的；有影响的
example: Condoms are an effective method of birth control if used with care.
translation: 如果使用得当，避孕套是很有效的避孕手段。

meaning: n. 效率；功效，效能
example: The spa is the last word in luxury and efficiency.
translation: 这家矿泉疗养浴场极尽奢华，功效极高。

meaning: adj. 效率高的，有能力的
example: The pill is the most efficient method of birth control.
translation: 服用避孕药是最有效的避孕方法。

meaning: n. 努力；努力的成果
example: McGregor's effort was enough to edge Johnson out of the top spot.
translation: 麦格雷戈奋力一搏，成功地将约翰逊从第一的位置上挤了下来。

meaning: n. 蛋，鸡蛋，卵
example: As the egg whites cook, they coagulate and rise to the surface.
translation: 蛋白一煮就会凝结，并且浮起来。

meaning: num. 八，八个，第八
example: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
translation: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

meaning: num. 十八，十八个
example: Their two faces were hardly more than eighteen inches apart.
translation: 他俩的脸相隔还不到18英寸。

meaning: num. 第八; n. 八分之一
example: This will be his eighth title bout in 19 months.
translation: 这将是他19个月里的第8次卫冕赛。

meaning: num. 八十，八十个
example: The poll canvassed the views of almost eighty economists.
translation: 民意调查征询了将近80位经济学家的意见。

meaning: pron. (两者)任何一个
example: She had met both sons and did not care for either.
translation: 两个儿子她都见了，一个都不喜欢。

meaning: adj. 复杂的；精心制作的
n. 松紧带; adj. 有弹性的
example: Pull the elastic tight and knot the ends.
translation: 把橡皮筋拽紧，两头打上结。

meaning: n. 肘，肘部；弯管
example: When you are sitting, keep your elbow on the arm rest.
translation: 坐立时，把胳膊肘靠在扶手上。

meaning: adj. 年龄较大的; n. 长者
example: She made liberal use of her elder sister's make-up and clothes.
translation: 她随便把姐姐的化妆品和衣服拿来用。

meaning: v. 选举，推选；选择
example: Councils should be answerable to the people who elect them.
translation: 市政会成员应对推选他们的人负责。

meaning: n. 选举，选择权；当选
example: He won last month's presidential election by a landslide.
translation: 他以压倒性多数赢得上月的总统选举。

meaning: adj. 电的，电动的
example: All Dreamland's electric blankets are guaranteed for three years.
translation: 所有的梦乡牌电热毯质保3年。

meaning: adj. 电的，电气科学的
example: This degree programme is fully accredited by the Institution of Electrical Engineers.
translation: 这门学位课程经电气工程师学院鉴定完全合格。

meaning: n. 电，电学；电流
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: n. 电子
example: The structure of molecules can be seen under an electron microscope.
translation: 分子的结构可在电子显微镜下观察到.

meaning: adj. 电子的
example: All the royal cars are fitted with electronic homing devices.
translation: 所有的皇家轿车都装有电子自导引装置。

meaning: n. 电子学
example: Computers and electronics are growth industries and need skilled technicians.
translation: 计算机与电子行业属于蓬勃发展的产业，需要娴熟的技术人员。

meaning: n. 成分；要素；元素
example: In order to make it safe, the element is electrically insulated.
translation: 为安全起见，该元件作了电绝缘处理。

meaning: adj. 基本的；初级的
example: He expressed the hope that on Monday elementary schools would be reopened.
translation: 他表示希望各小学星期一能复课。

meaning: n. 象
example: The pavilion has become a £4 million steel and glass white elephant.
translation: 这个耗资400万英镑、用钢与玻璃所构筑起的亭子已经成了一个华而不实的摆设。

meaning: n. 电梯；升降机
num. 十一，十一个
example: The Appeal Court has quashed the convictions of all eleven people.
translation: 上诉法庭已经撤销对所有11人的判决。

meaning: num. 第十一(个)
example: He raised the binoculars again and zeroed in on an eleventh-floor room.
translation: 他再一次举起双筒望远镜，瞄准了11层的一个房间。

meaning: v. 消灭，消除，排除
example: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it.
translation: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

meaning: n. 消灭，排除，消除
example: The best way to proceed is by a process of elimination.
translation: 继续进行下去的最佳方式是实行淘汰制。

meaning: adv. 其它，另外; adj. 别的
example: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else.
translation: 我和父亲断绝了关系，因为我想成为一个不一样的自己。

meaning: adv. 在别处，向别处
example: Almost 80 percent of the state's residents were born elsewhere.
translation: 该州居民中几乎有80%出生在异地。

meaning: v. 使窘迫，使为难
example: I did not embarrass her with my effusions.
translation: 我并没有太过热情而让她为难。

meaning: v. 拥抱；包括；包围
example: I couldn't find it in me to embrace him.
translation: 我打心眼里不想拥抱他。

meaning: v. 出现，涌现；冒出
example: emerge from
translation: 自…出现；从…显露出来

meaning: n. 紧急情况，突然事件
example: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

meaning: v. 散发；发射；发表
example: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.
translation: 金属容器开始发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。

meaning: n. 情感，感情；激动
adj. 感情的，情绪的
example: "Tired and emotional" is a code word for being drunk.
translation: “又累又激动”是形容人喝醉酒的一种委婉说法。

meaning: n. 皇帝
example: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
translation: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

meaning: n. 强调，重点，重要性
example: The emphasis is on developing fitness through exercises and training.
translation: 重点在于通过锻炼促进健康。

meaning: v. 强调，着重
example: I tried to emphasize my good points without sounding boastful.
translation: 我在强调自己的优点时尽量不让人觉得是在自我吹嘘。

meaning: n. 帝国
example: The Roman Empire was divided in the fourth century AD.
translation: 罗马帝国于公元4世纪分裂。

meaning: v. 雇用；用；使忙于
example: The organisers have to employ performers to pull a crowd.
translation: 组织者不得不雇些演员来聚拢人气。

meaning: n. 受雇者，雇员，雇工
example: There is a substantial payback in terms of employee and union relations.
translation: 雇员和工会关系大有改观。

meaning: n. 雇佣者，雇主
example: An employer can demand written certification that the relative is really ill.
translation: 雇主可以要求出具书面证明，证实员工的亲人确实病了。

meaning: n. 工业；雇用；使用
example: Current employment laws will be changed to reward effort and punish laziness.
translation: 现行雇佣法要变，要奖勤罚懒。

meaning: adj. 空的；空洞的
example: Empty the contents of the pan into the sieve.
translation: 将锅里的东西倒到筛子上。

meaning: v. 使能够，使可能
example: This committee will enable decisions to be made democratically.
translation: 该委员会将实现民主决议过程。

meaning: v. 围住，圈起；附上
example: Please enclose your remittance, making cheques payable to Thames Valley Technology.
translation: 请附上汇款，支票收款人为泰晤士河谷科技公司。

meaning: v. 遭遇，遇到; n. 遭遇
example: You'll have little patience with the hypocrisy and double standards you encounter.
translation: 你将会无法忍受所遭遇的伪善和双重标准。

meaning: v. 鼓励，支持，助长
example: The idea is to encourage people to get to know their neighbours.
translation: 其目的是促使人们结识邻居。

meaning: n. 末端；目标; v. 结束
example: The agreement has raised hopes that the war may end soon.
translation: 那项协议使人们感到战争有望很快结束。

meaning: n. 结尾，结局；死亡
example: I nearly died when I learned where I was ending up.
translation: 得知自己到了哪里时，我简直要晕过去了。

meaning: adj. 无止境的
example: We hear endless injunctions to build a sense of community among staff.
translation: 我们听到上面没完没了地讲要在员工中培养一种集体归属感。

meaning: v. 忍受；容忍
example: Then something seemed to snap in me. I couldn't endure any more.
translation: 这时候，我的心里像有个东西突然绷断了——我再也忍受不了啦。

meaning: n. 敌人；仇敌；敌兵
example: The President spoke of the treacherous intentions of the enemy.
translation: 总统谈及了敌人的奸诈用心。

meaning: n. 活力；精力；能
v. 实施，执行；强制
example: Game wardens were appointed to enforce hunting laws in New Hampshire.
translation: 狩猎监督官被派到新罕布什尔州去执行狩猎法令。

meaning: v. 使从事于；聘用
example: You can engage in croquet on the south lawn.
translation: 你可以参加南边草坪上的槌球游戏。

meaning: n. 发动机，引擎；机车
example: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
translation: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管抽走。

meaning: n. 工程师，技师
example: The RAF recognized him as an out-standingly able engineer.
translation: 英国皇家空军表彰他是一名非常能干的机械师。

meaning: n. 工程，工程学
example: Traditionally young Asians in Britain have gravitated towards medicine, law and engineering.
translation: 英国的亚裔年轻人通常被吸引到医学、法律及工程专业。

meaning: n. 英格兰；英国
example: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
translation: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

meaning: n. 英语; adj. 英国人的
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: n. 英国男子
example: She had married a charming but rather vague Englishman.
translation: 她嫁给了一个外表迷人实际却很迷糊的英国人。

meaning: v. 享受；欣赏，喜爱
example: I enjoy pleasure as much as the next person.
translation: 我和别人一样愉快。

meaning: v. 扩大，扩展；放大
example: Workmen were hired to remodel and enlarge the farm buildings.
translation: 雇用了工人来改造和扩建农场建筑。

meaning: adj. 巨大的，庞大的
example: She was a shy, delicately pretty girl with enormous blue eyes.
translation: 她是一个害羞、娇美的女孩，长着一双大大的蓝眼睛。

meaning: adj. 足够的; adv. 足够地
example: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
translation: 3亿美元远远不够。

meaning: v. 保证；保护；赋予
example: The drill should be slowly rotated to ensure a clean hole.
translation: 钻头必须缓慢转动，以保证钻孔平整光滑。

meaning: v. 走进，进入；参加
example: Two men answer-ing the description of the suspects tried to enter Switzerland.
translation: 与描述的疑犯样子相符的两名男子试图进入瑞士。

meaning: v. 使欢乐；招待
n. 热情，热心，热忱
example: She radiates an infectious enthusiasm for everything she does.
translation: 她做任何事情都充满一种极富感染力的热情。

meaning: adj. 热情的，热心的
example: Bob Dole seemed less than enthusiastic about the proposed move.
translation: 鲍勃·多尔似乎对提议的这项行动不太感兴趣。

meaning: adj. 全部的，整个的
example: If the Commission has its way, the entire deal will be scuppered.
translation: 如果委员会我行我素的话，整个交易将化为泡影。

meaning: v. 给…权利(或资格)
example: They lose their entitle-ment to benefit when they start work.
translation: 他们一开始工作就失去了获得救济金的资格。

meaning: n. 入口，门口；进入
example: The entrance hall is littered with toys and wellington boots.
translation: 门厅里到处乱扔着玩具和雨靴。

meaning: n. 入口处；登记；进入
example: Entry to this prize draw is limited to UK residents.
translation: 这次抽奖只限英国公民参加。

meaning: n. 信封；封套；封皮
example: Return the enclosed Donation Form today in the prepaid envelope provided.
translation: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。

meaning: n. 环境，外界；围绕
example: Outside the protected environment of institutional care he could not survive.
translation: 离开福利机构的照顾，离开这种受保护的环境，他将难以生存下去。

meaning: vt&n. 妒忌；羡慕
example: Unconscious envy manifests itself very often as this kind of arrogance.
translation: 潜意识里的嫉妒常表现为这种傲慢自大。

meaning: adj. 相等的；平等的
example: In many respects Asian women see themselves as equal to their men.
translation: 在很多方面，亚洲女性都认为自己和丈夫是平等的。

meaning: n. 等同，平等；相等
example: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
translation: 迄今为止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

meaning: n. 方程(式)；等式
example: The party fears the equation between higher spending and higher taxes.
translation: 该党担心难以平衡更多支出和更高税率之间的综合关系。

meaning: v. 装备，配备
example: Owners of restaurants would have to equip them to admit disabled people.
translation: 餐厅老板将必须在餐厅里配备能够接纳残疾人的设施。

meaning: n. 装备，设备，配备
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: adj. 相等的；等量的
example: His party has just suffered the equivalent of a near-fatal heart attack.
translation: 他所在的政党刚刚经历了一次类似心脏病突发般几近致命的打击。

meaning: n. 时代，年代；纪元
example: As the era wore on, she switched her attention to films.
translation: 随着这个时代慢慢过去，她把目光投向了电影业。

meaning: v. 建造；使竖立
example: Her legs were long and fine, her hips slender, her carriage erect.
translation: 她长腿细臀，身姿笔直。

meaning: n. 错误，谬误；差错
example: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.
translation: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。

meaning: v. 逃跑；逸出; n. 逃跑
example: No detail was too small to escape her attention.
translation: 再小的细节都逃不过她的眼睛。

meaning: adv. 特别，尤其，格外
example: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
translation: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

meaning: n. 短文，散文，小品文
example: essay test
translation: n. 申论方式测验

meaning: adj. 必要的，本质的
example: Jordan promised to trim the city budget without cutting essential services.
translation: 乔丹承诺在不减少基本服务的前提下，缩减市政预算。

meaning: v. 建立，设立；确立
example: We're trying to establish linkages between these groups and financial institutions.
translation: 我们正努力在这些团体和金融机构之间建立联系。

meaning: n. 建立，设立，确立
example: The fusty old establishment refused to recognise the demand for popular music.
translation: 这一古板的老旧机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

meaning: v. 估计，评价; n. 估计
example: Its own estimate of three hundred tallies with that of another survey.
translation: 其估计数目300与另一项调查的结果相吻合。

meaning: n. 欧洲
example: Kaspar had spoken know-ledgeably about the state of agriculture in Europe.
translation: 卡斯帕对欧洲农业状况发表了一番颇有见地的见解。

meaning: adj. 欧洲的; n. 欧洲人
example: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: v. 评价，估…的价
example: Our research attempts to evaluate the effectiveness of the different drugs.
translation: 我们的研究试图对不同药物的疗效进行评估。

meaning: v. 使蒸发; v. 蒸发
example: Blasting cold air over it makes the water evaporate.
translation: 向它喷射冷空气可以使水蒸发。

meaning: n. 前夜，前夕，前一刻
example: Richard had turned up on Christmas Eve with Tony.
translation: 理查德和托尼在圣诞夜一道露面了。

meaning: adv. 甚至；甚至更，还
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: n. 傍晚，黄昏，晚上
example: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
translation: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

meaning: n. 事件，大事；事变
example: The birth of a live healthy baby is a truly blessed event.
translation: 一个健康活泼的婴儿的出生真是一件可喜的事情。

meaning: adv. 终于；最后
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: adv. 在任何时候；曾经
example: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
translation: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

meaning: adj. 每一的；每隔…的
example: Someone comes in every day to check all is in order.
translation: 每天都有人来检查是否一切都井然有序。

meaning: pron. 每人，人人
example: The minute that the war started, everybody was glued to the television.
translation: 战事一起，所有人都盯紧了电视报道。

meaning: adj. 每天的，日常的
example: One in five young adults was struggling with everyday mathematics.
translation: 1/5的年轻人做日常的数学计算都费劲。

meaning: pron. 每人，人人
example: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: pron. 每件事，事事
example: You have to do everything you can. You have to work your hardest. And if you do, if you stay positive, then you have a shot at a silver lining.
translation: 你需要尽你所能，最大限度地去努力。只要你这么做，只要你能保持乐观，你就会看见乌云背后的幸福线。

meaning: adv. 到处，处处
example: Stars appeared everywhere, spinning round and round, faster and faster.
translation: 满眼金星乱转，而且越转越快。

meaning: n. 根据；证据，证人
example: He found evidence of mutated forms of the gene.
translation: 他找到了该基因出现了变异形式的证据。

meaning: adj. 明显的，明白的
example: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
translation: 通货膨胀的危险在证券价格上已经表现得很明显。

meaning: n. 邪恶；祸害; adj. 坏的
n. 进化，演化；发展
example: the evolution of the human species
translation: 人类的进化

meaning: v. 使进化；使发展
example: We can evolve the truth from a mass of confused evidence.
translation: 我们可以从庞杂的证据中推断事实真相.

meaning: adj. 确切的；精确的
example: The exact locations are being kept secret for reasons of security.
translation: 确切地点因为安全原因要保密。

meaning: adv. 确切地；恰恰正是
example: They found their computers producing different results from exactly the same calculation.
translation: 他们发现他们的计算机进行完全相同的计算会得出不同的结果。

meaning: vt&vi. 夸大，夸张
example: There could be more unrest, but I wouldn't exaggerate the problems.
translation: 可能会有更大的动荡，不过我想也不必夸大问题。

meaning: n. 考试；检查，细查
example: Schools were told their exam information had to be spot-on and accurate.
translation: 各学校接到通知，要求考试信息必须准确无误。

meaning: n. 考试；检查，细查
example: The Navy is to carry out an examination of the wreck tomorrow.
translation: 海军明天将对失事船只进行细查。

meaning: v. 检查，仔细观察
example: I'll start with some generalities and then examine a few specific examples.
translation: 我首先进行概述，然后会分析几个实例。

meaning: n. 例子，实例；模范
example: Have they, for example, demonstrated a commitment to democracy?
translation: 例如，他们是否已表现出会致力于民主？

meaning: v. 超过，胜过；超出
example: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day.
translation: 每天的饮酒量不应超过两个计量单位。

meaning: adv. 极端地，非常
example: Physical perfection in a human being is exceedingly rare.
translation: 体貌完美的人极为罕见。

meaning: adj. 优秀的，杰出的
example: The regions are interconnected by an excellent highway system.
translation: 那些地区通过完善的公路系统相互连接。

meaning: prep. 除…之外
example: He hadn't eaten a thing except for one forkful of salad.
translation: 除了一餐叉色拉，他什么都没吃。

meaning: n. 例外，除外
example: Almost without exception those convicted were our friends and colleagues.
translation: 那些被判有罪的人几乎无一例外都是我们的朋友和同事。

meaning: n. 超越；过量；过度
example: Polyunsaturated oils are essential for health. Excess is harmful, however.
translation: 多不饱和油对健康很重要。但是，食用过量就会有害。

meaning: adj. 过多的，极度的
example: The police vigorously denied that excessive force had been used.
translation: 警方坚决否认曾经滥用武力。

meaning: v. 交换；交流; n. 交换
example: This could intensify the risk of a nuclear exchange.
translation: 这可能会加剧爆发核战争的危险。

meaning: v. 使激动；引起
example: Reports of the plot of this unusual film tend to excite revulsion.
translation: 有关这部不同寻常电影的情节的报道常常令人生厌。

meaning: adj. 令人兴奋的
example: The chase is always much more exciting than the conquest anyway.
translation: 不管怎么说，追求的过程总比得手更为刺激。

meaning: v. 呼喊；惊叫
example: The Munroe girls rushed up to exclaim over her dress.
translation: 孟家的女孩子都跑过来为她的衣服喝彩.

meaning: v. 把…排除在外
example: The first task was to fence the wood to exclude sheep.
translation: 第一项任务就是把树林围起来不让羊进去。

meaning: adv. 专门地
example: Randolph's work was exclusively concerned with the effects of pollution on health.
translation: 伦道夫的著作专门论述污染对健康的影响。

meaning: n. 远足；短途旅行
example: We unwisely chose not to go on a coach excursion to Trondheim.
translation: 我们作出了不明智的选择，没有乘旅游大巴去特隆赫姆。

meaning: v. 原谅；免除; n. 借口
example: He'd telephoned with some phoney excuse she didn't believe for a minute.
translation: 他找了某个她根本不会相信的借口给她打电话。

meaning: v. 将…处死；实施
example: Make sure that you execute all movements smoothly and without jerking.
translation: 一定要保证所有动作自然流畅，不要一顿一顿的。

meaning: adj. 执行的; n. 执行者
example: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
translation: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

meaning: n. 锻炼，训练; v. 练习
example: His exercise books were full of well deserved red ticks.
translation: 他的练习本上尽是些红钩钩，都是他应得的。

meaning: v. 尽(力)，运用
example: We all know that when we exert ourselves our heart rate increases.
translation: 我们都知道太卖命了会导致心跳加速。

meaning: v. 使筋疲力尽；用尽
example: The city's streets are filthy and choked with exhaust fumes.
translation: 那座城市的街道肮脏不堪，弥漫着令人窒息的废气。

meaning: v. 显示；陈列，展览
example: Two cats or more in one house will also exhibit territorial behaviour.
translation: 一家若有两只或更多的猫，也会表现出争夺地盘的行为。

meaning: n. 展览，陈列；展览会
example: exhibition hall
translation: 展览厅

meaning: v. 存在；生存，生活
example: I would have to learn, little by little, to exist alone.
translation: 我得慢慢学会独自生活。

meaning: n. 存在，实在；生存
example: He had been a rock in the shifting sands of her existence.
translation: 他一直是她曲折坎坷的生活中的主心骨。

meaning: n. 出口；退场; v. 退出
example: Go north on I-15 to the exit just past Barstow.
translation: 沿着15号州际公路一直向北，一过巴斯托就从出口驶出。

meaning: v. 扩大；使膨胀
example: The ultimate aim is to expand the network further.
translation: 最终目的是为了进一步拓展该网络。

meaning: n. 扩大，扩充；扩张
example: This revolutionary expansion required energetic nation-building policies.
translation: 这种跨越式的扩张需要有活力的国家建设政策。

meaning: v. 预料，预期；等待
example: Don't expect me to come and visit you there.
translation: 别指望我会去那儿看你。

meaning: n. 期待，期望，预期
example: The weight of expectation was getting to them.
translation: 他们逐渐感觉到了期望带来的压力。

meaning: n. 花费，消费；费用
example: Owen was against it, on the grounds of expense.
translation: 欧文因费用问题对此表示反对。

meaning: adj. 昂贵的，花钱多的
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: n. 经验，感受；经历
example: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
translation: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

meaning: n. 实验；试验
example: He is always eager for new experiences and ever-willing to experiment.
translation: 他总是渴望拥有新的经历，而且永远愿意尝试。

meaning: adj. 实验的，试验的
example: For the time being, however, immunotherapy is still in its experimental stages.
translation: 但免疫疗法目前仍处于实验阶段。

meaning: n. 专家; adj. 熟练的
example: You'll also get expert advice on keeping your hair in good condition.
translation: 你还会获得有关如何保持良好发质的专家建议。

meaning: v. 解释；为…辩解
example: Her aggressiveness made it difficult for him to explain his own feelings.
translation: 她咄咄逼人的态度让他难以解释自己的感情。

meaning: n. 解释，说明；辩解
example: Their water was turned off weeks ago without explanation.
translation: 他们的水在几周以前就毫无理由地被切断了。

meaning: v. 使爆炸; v. 爆炸
example: Catherine was ready to explode. "I think you're contemptible!"
translation: 凯瑟琳气得快要炸了。“我觉得你真是可鄙！”

meaning: v. 剥削；利用；开拓
example: I even began to exploit him in subtle ways.
translation: 我甚至开始巧妙地利用他。

meaning: vt&vi. 探险，探索
example: I would creep in and with stealthy footsteps explore the second-floor.
translation: 我会偷偷溜进去，轻手轻脚地查看一下二楼。

meaning: n. 爆炸，爆发，炸裂
example: A violent explosion seemed to jolt the whole ground.
translation: 剧烈的爆炸好像要把整个地面都掀起来。

meaning: n. 炸药; adj. 爆炸的
example: The strategy was too dangerous in the explosive circumstances of the times.
translation: 在当时那种一触即发的形势下，采取那样的策略太危险了。

meaning: v. 输出，出口；运走
example: There is nothing sinister or conspiratorial about the export licensing system.
translation: 这种出口许可制度没有任何阴险或者见不得人的东西。

meaning: v. 使暴露；揭露
example: When Myra told Karp she'd expose his past, he blew up.
translation: 当迈拉告诉卡普她会把他的过去全抖搂出去时，卡普大为光火。

meaning: n. 暴露；揭露；曝光
example: Their sporting reputation has suffered enormously from Johnson's exposure.
translation: 由于约翰逊东窗事发，他们的体育声誉受到了严重损害。

meaning: v. 表示; n. 快车，快递
example: He ran a newspaper stand outside the American Express office.
translation: 他在美国运通公司办公大楼外经营一家报摊。

meaning: n. 词句；表达；表情
example: gene expression
translation: [化]基因表达；基因表现

meaning: v. 延长；扩大；致
example: The new territory would extend over one-fifth of Canada's land mass.
translation: 这块新领土将会使加拿大陆地面积扩展1/5以上。

meaning: n. 延长部分；伸展
example: After a further four-month extension of her probation period, she was sacked.
translation: 在又试用了4个月后，她被开除了。

meaning: adj. 广阔的；广泛的
example: He has received extensive corrective surgery to his skull.
translation: 他的头骨做过大面积的矫形手术。

meaning: n. 广度；范围；程度
example: To an extent, that is the reason for the meeting.
translation: 在某种程度上，那就是召开这次会议的原因。

meaning: adj. 外部的；对外的
example: His gruff exterior concealed one of the kindest hearts.
translation: 他粗暴的外表下藏着一颗非常善良的心。

meaning: adj. 外部的，外面的
example: External broadcasting soaks up more resources in Britain than elsewhere.
translation: 英国花费在对外广播上的财力高于其他国家。

meaning: adj. 额外的; adv. 特别地
example: She gave him an extra scoop of clotted cream.
translation: 她多给他加了一勺浓缩奶油。

meaning: adj. 非同寻常的，特别的
example: They testify to the extraordinary potency of his personality.
translation: 这些事情证明了他非凡的人格魅力。

meaning: adj. 极度的；尽头的
example: The extreme right reared its ugly head in the 1980s.
translation: 极右势力在20世纪80年代有所抬头。

meaning: adv. 极端，极其，非常
example: He was a stern critic but an extremely kindly man.
translation: 他是个苛刻的批评家，但却是个非常善良的人。

meaning: n. 眼睛；眼力；鉴赏力
example: He has a visual impairment in the right eye.
translation: 他右眼视力有损伤。

meaning: n. 视力，目力
example: He was not a particularly good shot because of his eyesight.
translation: 他视力不好，算不上是一个出色的射手。

meaning: n. 寓言；虚构的故事
example: The old fable continues to echo down the centuries.
translation: 这则古老的寓言流传了数个世纪。

meaning: n. 织物，纺织品；结构
example: He noticed that fabric was tearing away from the plane's wing.
translation: 他注意到机翼在一块一块地断裂。

meaning: n. 脸；表面；外表
example: They have maintained their optimism in the face of desolating subjugation.
translation: 面对遭征服的悲惨命运，他们保持了乐观的态度。

meaning: n. 设备；容易；便利
example: Your camcorder should have these basic features: autofocus, playback facility, zoom lens.
translation: 你的便携式摄像机应该具备以下基本功能：自动聚焦、回放功能、变焦镜头。

meaning: n. 事实；实际，实情
n. 因素；因子，系数
example: Stress, both human and mechanical, may also be a contributing factor.
translation: 来自人的和机械方面的压力可能也是一个因素。

meaning: n. 工厂，制造厂
example: Nora was deflowered by a man who worked in a soda-water factory.
translation: 在汽水厂工作的一个男子夺去了诺拉的童贞。

meaning: n. 才能，能力；系，科
example: Faculty members complain that their students are unprepared to do college-level work.
translation: 学院的老师们抱怨说他们的学生还很不适应大学的课业。

meaning: v. 褪色；逐渐消失
n. 华氏温度计
example: By mid-morning, the temperature was already above 100 degrees Fahrenheit.
translation: 到早上10点钟，温度已经超过100华氏度了。

meaning: v. 失败；失灵；不能
example: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
translation: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

meaning: n. 失败；失败的人
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: adj. 微弱的；虚弱的
example: It's a film about a serial killer and not for the faint-hearted.
translation: 这部电影是讲一个连环杀手的，不适合胆小的人看。

meaning: adj. 公平的；相当的
example: I have a fair idea of how difficult things can be.
translation: 我大致了解情况会有多困难。

meaning: adv. 相当；公平地
example: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views.
translation: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

meaning: n. 信任，信心；信仰
example: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

meaning: adj. 忠诚的；如实的
example: She insisted that she had remained faithful to her husband.
translation: 她坚持说自己对丈夫一直是忠诚的。

meaning: v. 落下；跌倒；陷落
example: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
translation: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

meaning: adj. 不真实的；伪造的
example: I was wearing false eyelashes and a sweater two sizes too small.
translation: 我戴着假睫毛，穿着小了两号的毛衣。

meaning: n. 名声，名望
adj. 熟悉的；冒昧的
example: Rose heard the familiar voice, but tuned out the words.
translation: 罗斯听到了熟悉的声音，但没注意听说的是什么。

meaning: n. 家，家庭；家族
example: The family was often in flight, hiding out in friends' houses.
translation: 这一家人常常东躲西藏，在朋友家里避风头。

meaning: n. 饥荒；严重的缺乏
example: The civil war is obstructing distribution of famine relief by aid agencies.
translation: 内战阻碍着救援机构对饥荒赈济物资的配给。

meaning: adj. 著名的，出名的
example: The chalky soil around Saumur produces the famous Anjou wines.
translation: 索米尔周围的白垩质土壤出产著名的安茹葡萄酒。

meaning: n. (运动等)狂热爱好者
example: As a boy he was a Manchester United fan.
translation: 小时候，他是曼联队的球迷。

meaning: n. 想象力；设想；爱好
example: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
translation: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

meaning: adj. 远的; adv. 远，遥远
n. 车费，船费，票价
example: The round-trip fare to Havana is 550 Irish punts ($673).
translation: 去哈瓦那的往返票价是550爱尔兰镑（673美元）。

meaning: int. 再会; n. 告别
example: She bade farewell to her son.
translation: 她和儿子道了别。

meaning: n. 农场，农庄；饲养场
example: His most prized time, though, will be spent quietly on his farm.
translation: 不过，他最宝贵的时光将在自己的农场里平静地度过。

meaning: n. 农民，农夫；农场主
example: Mr Farmer and Mrs Jones both admitted conspiring to murder her husband.
translation: 法默先生和琼斯太太都承认密谋杀死了琼斯先生。

meaning: adv. 更远地; adj. 更远的
example: Both of my sisters moved even farther away from home.
translation: 我的两个姐姐都搬得离家更远了。

meaning: n. 样子，方式；风尚
example: Many of the clothes come from the world's top fashion houses.
translation: 这些服装中有很多出自世界顶级时装设计公司。

meaning: adj. 流行的，时髦的
example: It's fashionable but wearable, and it's easy to look after.
translation: 它既时尚又耐穿，而且容易打理。

meaning: adj. 快的；偏快的; adv. 快
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: v. 扎牢，扣住
example: Builders must fasten down roofs of newly-built homes more securely.
translation: 建造工人必须把新建房屋的屋顶固定得更牢靠些。

meaning: adj. 致命的；命运的
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: n. 命运，天数
example: They held his fate in the palms of their ancient hands.
translation: 他们这些老人将他的命运掌握在手心里。

meaning: n. 父亲；神父；创始人
example: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else.
translation: 我和父亲断绝了关系，因为我想成为一个不一样的自己。

meaning: n. 疲劳，劳累
example: She continued to have severe stomach cramps, aches, fatigue, and depression.
translation: 她仍然患有严重的胃痉挛，感觉疼痛、疲乏、抑郁。

meaning: n. 缺点；过失；故障
example: The aircraft made an unscheduled landing after developing an electrical fault.
translation: 飞机由于发生电力故障而作了临时降落。

meaning: adj. 有错误的，有缺点的
example: faulty line
translation: [计]故障线路

meaning: n. 好感；赞同；恩惠
example: You did us a great favour by disposing of that problem.
translation: 你解决了那个问题，可算是帮了我们一个大忙。

meaning: adj. 有利的；赞成的
example: That improved Mrs Goole's already favourable opinion of him.
translation: 那件事更加深了古尔太太对他的好印象。

meaning: adj. 特别受喜爱的
example: "It's not one of my favourite forms of music." — "No."
translation: “这不是我喜欢的音乐形式。”——“对，这不是。”

meaning: n. 害怕；担心; v. 害怕
example: His mind was a haze of fear and confusion.
translation: 由于害怕和困惑，他当时处于一种混沌状态。

meaning: adj. 害怕的，可怕的
example: "It sounds the most fearful hard work," Sybil said later.
translation: “这听起来是极为令人生畏的艰苦工作。”西比尔后来说。

meaning: adj. 可行的；可能的
example: It's just not feasible to manage the business on a part-time basis.
translation: 兼职管理业务是搞不好的。

meaning: n. 盛宴，筵席；节日
example: The feast was served by his mother and sisters.
translation: 这顿美餐是他母亲和他的姐妹们准备的。

meaning: n. 羽毛；翎毛；羽状物
example: The feather must be removed with a straight, firm pull.
translation: 拔羽毛必须干净利落。

meaning: n. 特征，特色；面貌
example: The most arresting feature is the painted wall decoration.
translation: 最醒目的特点是绘有图画的墙面装饰。

meaning: n. 二月
example: He was jailed in February 1992 and could be released next year.
translation: 他于1992年2月入狱，可能明年获释。

meaning: adj. 联邦的；联盟的
example: The federal government hiked the tax on hard liquor.
translation: 联邦政府提高了烈性酒的税率。

meaning: n. 费，酬金；赏金
example: He finally corrected his misstatement and offered to reduce the fee.
translation: 他终于纠正了自己的错误说法，提出要减少费用。

meaning: adj. 虚弱的；微弱的
example: He gave a feeble shrug and tried to squirm free.
translation: 他无力地耸耸肩，扭动身体想要挣脱。

meaning: v. 喂(养); v. 吃饲料
n. 回授，反馈，反应
example: It would monitor traffic flows and provide feedback to motorists.
translation: 它能监控交通状况，然后给司机提供反馈信息。

meaning: v. 有知觉; v. 触，摸
example: I know it's nothing serious and I feel quite unemotional about it.
translation: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

meaning: n. 感情；感觉，知觉
example: Try to support each other when one of you is feeling down.
translation: 当有人觉得情绪低落时，要努力相互打气。

meaning: n. 人，家伙；伙伴
example: By all accounts, Rodger would appear to be a fine fellow.
translation: 据说，罗杰是个好小伙。

meaning: n. 雌性的动物；女子
example: Valentino was virtually deified by legions of female fans.
translation: 瓦伦蒂诺几乎被众多的女性崇拜者奉若神明。

meaning: n. 栅栏
example: He squeezed through a narrow opening in the fence.
translation: 他从围栏上的狭窄缺口里挤了过去。

meaning: adj. 肥沃的；多产的
example: They used force to banish the natives from the more fertile land.
translation: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。

meaning: n. 肥料
example: The organic fertilizer shall keep the soil in good heart.
translation: 这有机肥一定会使土壤保持肥沃.

meaning: n. 节日；音乐节
example: The Jamaica Festival is planning a series of workshops and business seminars.
translation: 牙买加节正在筹划一系列研习班和商务研讨会。

meaning: v. 拿来；请来，接去
example: The painting is expected to fetch between two and three million pounds.
translation: 预计这幅画将售得两三百万英镑。

meaning: n. 发热，发烧；狂热
example: During fever a large quantity of fluid is lost in perspiration.
translation: 发烧时，大量水分会通过排汗而丧失。

meaning: adj. 很少的；少数的
example: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
translation: 我尽量言简意赅。

meaning: n. 纤维，纤维质
example: The ball is made of rattan — a natural fibre.
translation: 这个球是由一种天然纤维——省藤制成的。

meaning: n. 小说；虚构，杜撰
example: Fiction takes up a large slice of the publishing market.
translation: 小说在出版市场上占了很大的份额。

meaning: n. 田野；田；运动场
example: He was the fastest thing I ever saw on a baseball field.
translation: 他是我在棒球场上见过的跑得最快的家伙。

meaning: adj. 凶猛的，狂热的
example: The area has been the scene of fierce fighting for three months.
translation: 这一地区3个月以来不断发生激战。

meaning: num. 十五；十五个
example: Fifteen-year-old Danny is on the run from a local authority home.
translation: 15岁的丹尼从地方当局的收容所逃跑了。

meaning: num. 第五; n. 五分之一
example: He was the fifth person to be killed in sectarian violence.
translation: 他是宗派暴力中的第5个罹难者。

meaning: num. 五十，五十个
example: The village is a settlement of just fifty houses.
translation: 这个村子里只住了50户人。

meaning: v. 打(仗)；斗争
example: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

meaning: n. 数字；外形；人物
example: public figure
translation: 社会名人

meaning: n. 档案; v. 把…归档
example: Substantial numbers of rank and file members ignored their union's advice.
translation: 有相当一部分普通员工不理睬工会的建议。

meaning: v. 装满，盛满；占满
example: You don't need green fingers to fill your home with lush leaves.
translation: 不是园艺大师也可以把自己的家里装点得绿意盎然。

meaning: n. 影片；胶卷；薄层
example: The criticisms will not stop people flocking to see the film.
translation: 批评的声音不会阻止人们涌到影院观看这部电影。

meaning: v. 过滤; n. 滤纸
example: Children should have glasses which filter out UV rays.
translation: 儿童应该戴上滤除紫外线的眼镜。

meaning: adj. 最后的；决定性的
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: adv. 最后；不可更改的
example: At approxi-mately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search.
translation: 大概晚上11点半的时候，波拉德最终同意进行搜查。

meaning: n. 财政，金融；财源
example: The finance minister will continue to mastermind Poland's economic reform.
translation: 财政部长将继续策划波兰的经济改革。

meaning: adj. 财政的，金融的
example: The enquiry dug deeper into the alleged financial misdeeds of his government.
translation: 这一调查对其政府涉嫌的财政违规行为展开了进一步深究。

meaning: v. 找到；发觉；找出
example: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
translation: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

meaning: n. 发现；调查的结果
example: Bosses have a way of always finding out about such things.
translation: 老板总喜欢把这类事情搞清楚。

meaning: adj. 美好的；纤细的
example: "I want to send a telegram." — "Fine, to whom?"
translation: “我想发份电报。”——“好的，发给谁？”

meaning: n. 手指；指状物
example: Isn't it about time that you pulled your finger out?
translation: 现在到了你该赶紧动起来的时候了吧？

meaning: v. 完成，结束; n. 结束
example: Elliott crossed the finish line just half a second behind his adversary.
translation: 埃利奥特跨过终点线时仅比对手落后半秒钟。

meaning: n. 火；火灾; v. 开火
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: n. 消防队员；司炉工
example: The fireman evacuated the guests from the burning hotel.
translation: 消防队员把客人们从燃烧着的旅馆中撤出来.

meaning: n. 商行，商号，公司
example: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

meaning: num. 第一; adv. 最初
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: n. 鱼，鱼肉; v. 钓鱼
example: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
translation: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

meaning: n. 渔民，渔夫，打鱼人
example: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean.
translation: 斯皮罗斯·拉齐斯的第一份职业是爱琴海上一名地位卑贱的渔夫。

meaning: n. 拳(头)
example: Without warning, Bardo smacked his fist into his open hand.
translation: 巴多没有任何预兆地一拳砸在自己摊开的手掌上.

meaning: v. 适合；安装; v. 适合
example: Police have released an E-fit picture of the suspected gunman.
translation: 警方已公布持枪嫌犯的电子画像。

meaning: num. 五，五个，第五
example: It was five long miles to the nearest pub.
translation: 离最近的酒吧有长长的5英里的路程。

meaning: v. 使固定；决定
example: I wrote back to Meudon at once to fix up a meeting.
translation: 我马上给缪顿回信安排会面。

meaning: n. 旗，旗帜；旗舰旗
example: On top of the gantry the American flag flew.
translation: 台架顶上飞舞着美国国旗。

meaning: n. 火焰；光辉；热情
example: Intense balls of flame rose up into the sky.
translation: 炽热的火球冲上天空。

meaning: v. 闪耀; v. 使闪亮
example: Don'tspill too much fat on the barbecue as it could flare up.
translation: 不要在烤肉上浇太多的油，会烧起来的。

meaning: n. 闪光; v. 闪，闪烁
example: She had heard the news-flash on a TV channel's news update.
translation: 她在一家电视台的新闻快讯中听到了这则简明新闻。

meaning: adj. 平的，扁平的
example: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
translation: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

meaning: n. 味，味道；风味
example: The 1985 vintage has a stronger bouquet and slight caramelly flavour.
translation: 这种1985年酿制的陈年佳酿味道更醇厚，带有一种淡淡的焦糖甜味。

meaning: n. 舰队；船队，机群
example: A fleet of ambulances took the injured to hospital.
translation: 一队救护车把伤者送往医院。

meaning: n. 肉，肌肉；肉体
example: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.
translation: 我正要执行一项让我心惊肉跳的秘密任务。

meaning: adj. 易弯曲的；灵活的
example: Times become more flexible off-season, especially in the smaller provincial museums.
translation: 尤其是在规模较小的地方博物馆，开放时间在旅游淡季更加灵活。

meaning: n. 航班；飞行；逃跑
example: She made her first and only space flight last September.
translation: 她第一次也是唯一一次宇宙飞行是在去年9月。

meaning: v. 漂浮; v. 使漂浮
example: A fresh egg will sink and an old egg will float.
translation: 新鲜鸡蛋会沉下去而不新鲜的会浮在上面。

meaning: n. 羊群，群；大量
example: A flock of birds flew towards us slowly from far away.
translation: 一群鸟儿从远处朝我们缓缓飞来。

meaning: n. 洪水; v. 淹没
example: Infectious diseases are spreading among many of the flood victims.
translation: 传染病正在遭受洪灾的很多灾民中蔓延。

meaning: n. 地板；楼层
example: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
translation: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

meaning: n. 面粉，粉；粉状物质
example: Just how much kneading is required depends on the sort of flour.
translation: 需要揉多久取决于用哪种面。

meaning: v. 繁荣，茂盛，兴旺
example: Keep the soil moist. That way, the seedling will flourish.
translation: 保持土壤湿润，那样幼苗就能茁壮成长。

meaning: v. 流动；飘垂；涨潮
example: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
translation: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

meaning: n. 花，花卉；开花
example: She now makes wonderful dried flower arrangements to order.
translation: 现在她为顾客定做漂亮的干花插花。

meaning: n. 流行性感冒
example: swine flu
translation: 猪流感

translation: 你常出汗或是脸上常发烫吗？

translation: 他想开飞机的念头在参军之前就有了。

meaning: v. 聚焦，注视; n. 焦点

meaning: v. 折叠；合拢; n. 褶

meaning: n. 人们，家属，亲属

translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: n. 蠢人，傻子; v. 欺骗

translation: 人们总认为我是个傻瓜，想必他们是对的。

meaning: adj. 愚蠢的；鲁莽的

translation: 基于如此不完整的证据采取的任何行动都是愚蠢的。

meaning: n. 脚；最下部；英尺

meaning: n. 足球比赛；足球

translation: 还有其他形式的民众骚乱，最出名的是足球流氓行为。

meaning: n. 脚步；脚步声；足迹

meaning: prep. 为；给；因为
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: v. 禁止，不许；阻止

translation: 但愿他不会因为我而离开！

meaning: v. 强迫; n. 力，力量

translation: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。

meaning: n. 预测，预报; v. 预示

translation: 天气预报上说多云并伴有阵雨。

meaning: n. 额头，前部
example: She has a poor complexion and pock marks on her forehead.
translation: 她满面菜色，额头上有些麻子。

meaning: adj. 外国的；外来的

translation: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

meaning: n. 外国人
example: You don't sound like a foreigner talking English.
translation: 听你讲英语，不像是外国人。

meaning: adj. 最初的；第一流的
example: She is, first and foremost, her husband's alter ego.
translation: 她首先是丈夫的知己。

meaning: n. 森林；森林地带

translation: 他的身体不能适应森林的潮湿。

meaning: adv. 永远，总是，老是
example: Although they're expensive, they last forever and never go out of style.
translation: 尽管价格昂贵，但它们经久耐用，永不过时。

meaning: v. 忘记，遗忘

translation: 如果你曾经跟他作过对，就别想了，你没戏了。

translation: 我永远不会原谅他。我鄙视他。

meaning: n. 餐叉；叉；分叉

translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. 形式；形状; v. 形成
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

translation: 他们看见15名警察骑着摩托车排成V字形前行。

meaning: adj. 在前的; n. 前者

meaning: n. 公式，式

translation: 她一针一针地缝那块粗布。

meaning: n. 两星期，十四天

translation: 在两周的时间内

meaning: adj. 幸运的，侥幸的

translation: 好在她有很多选择。

meaning: adv. 幸运地，幸亏

translation: 对我来说幸运的是，我的朋友发现了非常严重的错误。

meaning: n. 命运，运气；财产

translation: 她炒股有方，发了大财。

translation: 四五十个女人盘腿坐在地上。

meaning: adv. 向前；今后，往后

translation: 那辆车把那人来回轧了两次，先是倒着轧的，再是往前开着轧的。

translation: 他们发现了一处迷宫似的地道。

translation: 我大约有4年时间沉迷在电子游戏中。

translation: “14分钟,”克里斯瞥了一眼他的手表说道.

translation: 她那时正坐在5楼的窗前织东西。

translation: 画面中一只狐狸正被一群猎狗撕咬得肠子外流。

meaning: n. 小部分；片断；分数

translation: 如果有陌生人拦你的车，把车窗摇下一点点就行。

meaning: n. 碎片，破片，碎块

translation: 这仅仅是与约翰长谈的一个片断.

translation: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

meaning: n. 框架，构架，结构

translation: 该杂志的宗旨是在基督教框架下讨论时下的热门话题。

translation: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

meaning: adj. 坦白的，直率的

translation: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

meaning: adj. 自由的；空闲的

translation: 我并没有指望你白干。

translation: 政客们贬低了“自由”一词的意义。

translation: 这些花自由杂交后会产生各种各样的颜色。

meaning: v. 冻；结冻; v. 使结冰

translation: 这个月早些时候，所有员工的工资都被冻结了。

meaning: n. 货运；货物；运费

translation: 在报关单上，寄货人将货物列为农用机械。

meaning: adj. 法国的; n. 法国人

translation: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

meaning: n. 屡次；次数；频率

translation: 他们的仪器检测到一个3千赫的微弱无线电波。

translation: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

translation: 发言人说信函的语气非常友好。

meaning: n. 友谊，友好

meaning: n. 蛙

translation: 他们逮捕了这些人，并把他们押送到当地警察局。

meaning: prep. 从…来；离开

translation: 他14岁起就知道自己日后干什么了。

translation: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

meaning: n. 边境；边疆；新领域

translation: 空气稀薄清新，其间日光蒙眬，寒气逼人。

translation: 笑容消失了，取而代之的是哀伤的蹙眉。

translation: 我一直坚持用新鲜水果做甜点。

meaning: adj. 多产的；肥沃的

meaning: v. 油煎，油炸，油炒

translation: 用油炸一下剩下的辣椒，如果需要再加点调味汁。

translation: 他的话必将为争论推波助澜。

translation: 《编辑家》无法保证他们会履行职责.

meaning: adj. 满的；完全的
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 乐趣，娱乐；玩笑

translation: 上网很有意思，但也很浪费时间。

meaning: n. 功能；职务；函数

translation: 他被指控滥用秘密的政府行贿基金，金额达1,750万美元。

translation: 国际特赦组织称他们的军事司法体系存在着根本性的缺陷。

meaning: n. 葬礼，丧礼，丧葬

translation: 出席葬礼的人大多都面无表情地静静站着。

meaning: adj. 古怪的；滑稽的

translation: 女人不读这种东西是有原因的，它并不好笑。

meaning: n. 软毛；毛皮，裘皮

translation: 看着这只动物如此认真地梳理自己的毛，我们被逗乐了。

meaning: adj. 狂怒的；狂暴的

translation: 他为了娶她而和我离婚，我愤怒至极。

meaning: n. 炉子，熔炉；鼓风炉

translation: 可以通过有色眼镜观看高炉内的火焰.

meaning: v. 供应，提供；装备
example: Can you furnish the committee with statements of the costs?
translation: 你能把开支清单提交委员会 吗 ?

meaning: n. 家具；装置，设备
example: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

meaning: adv. 更远地; adj. 更远的

translation: 进一步的发展

meaning: adv. 而且，此外
example: Furthermore, as Gervaise was quick to point out, Mr Scully was not a detective.
translation: 而且，正如热尔韦斯毫不犹豫地指出来的那样，斯库利先生并不是一名侦探。

meaning: n. 将来，未来；前途

translation: 全国各地学生前途未卜。

meaning: v. 获得；增加; n. 增进
example: This is a cynical manipulation of the situation for short-term political gain.
translation: 这是为了获取短期政治利益而损人利己地对局势进行操纵。

example: Laura landed a plum job with a smart art gallery.
translation: 劳拉在一家时尚画廊找到了份美差。

meaning: n. 加仑
example: The price of petrol is coming down by four pence a gallon.
translation: 汽油的价格每加仑降了4便士。

meaning: n. 游戏；比赛；猎物

translation: 狩猎监督官被派到新罕布什尔州去执行狩猎法令。

meaning: n. 一帮，一伙

translation: 过来吧，好多老朋友都在这儿。

meaning: n. 缺口；间隔；差距
example: Like a good businessman, Stewart identified a gap in the market.
translation: 像精明的商人一样，斯图尔特发现了市场上的一个空白。

meaning: n. 车库；加油站
example: Ben drove past them, nosing his car into the garage.
translation: 本小心翼翼地把车开进车库时从他们身边经过。

meaning: n. 垃圾，污物，废料
example: A bomb planted in a garbage can exploded early today.
translation: 今天早些时候，安放在垃圾箱里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

meaning: n. 花园，菜园；公园
example: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
translation: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

meaning: n. 园丁，花匠
example: He is a hard worker and a skilled gardener.
translation: 他工作很努力，对园艺很在行。

meaning: n. 煤气；气体；汽油

translation: 天然气

meaning: adj. 气体的，气态的
example: Air whether in the gaseous or liquid state is a fluid.
translation: 空气,无论是气态的或是液态的,都是一种流体.

meaning: n. (美)汽油
example: Unleaded gasoline rose more than a penny a gallon.
translation: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了1分多。

meaning: v. 气喘，喘息
example: I heard myself gasp and cry out.
translation: 我听到自己一边喘一边喊。

meaning: n. 大门；篱笆门
example: He reached the garden gate and thrust his way through it.
translation: 他来到花园门口，挤了进去。

meaning: v. 聚集；集合vt收集
example: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
translation: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

meaning: v. 量，测量; n. 量器
example: The index is the government's chief gauge of future economic activity.
translation: 这一指数是政府判断未来经济活动的主要依据。

meaning: adj. 快乐的；鲜明的
example: Curiously, the word "gay" does not occur in the index.
translation: 奇怪的是，gay这个词没有出现在索引当中。

meaning: v. 凝视，盯，注视

translation: 盖尔镇定地注视着哈里，沉默了片刻。

meaning: adj. 总的；一般的n将军
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: adv. 一般地；通常地
example: Henry generally stayed ahead of the others in the academic subjects.
translation: 亨利的文化课成绩通常都优于其他学生。

meaning: v. 发生；引起；生殖
example: The company, New England Electric, burns coal to generate power.
translation: 新英格兰电力公司用煤发电。

meaning: n. 一代，一代人；产生
example: A new generation of scientists became fascinated by dinosaurs.
translation: 新一代科学家对恐龙研究着了迷。

meaning: n. 发电机；发生者
example: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.
translation: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

meaning: adj. 慷慨的；宽厚的
example: Not everyone thinks that the government is being particularly generous.
translation: 并非所有人都认为政府特别慷慨。

meaning: n. 天才，天赋，天资
example: I was hoping some of his genius might rub off.
translation: 我希望他的才华也可以影响他人。

meaning: adj. 和蔼的；轻柔的
example: The blustery winds of spring had dropped to a gentle breeze.
translation: 呼啸的春风已经减弱，成了习习的微风。

meaning: n. 绅士；有教养的人
example: A gentleman should always be civil, even to his inferiors.
translation: 绅士应该总是彬彬有礼,即便是对地位不及自己者.

meaning: adv. 有礼貌地；柔和地
example: If your child's temperature rises, sponge her down gently with tepid water.
translation: 如果你孩子的体温上升，就用海绵蘸上温水轻轻地擦拭她的身体。

meaning: adj. 真的；真正的
example: genuine leather
translation: 真皮

meaning: n. 地理，地理学
example: Why are Geography, Drama, Art and English in the ascendant?
translation: 为什么地理、戏剧、艺术和英语逐渐受宠？

meaning: n. 几何，几何学
example: His idea was to apply geometry to dynamics.
translation: 他的想法就是将几何学应用在力学上。

meaning: n. 微生物，细菌，幼芽
example: The germ of an idea took root in Rosemary's mind.
translation: 罗斯玛丽心里萌生了一个念头。

meaning: adj. 德国的; n. 德国人
example: Big credits were given to East Germany by successive West German governments.
translation: 历届西德政府给予东德大量的贷款。

meaning: n. 德意志，德国
example: He was well acquainted with the literature of France, Germany and Holland.
translation: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

meaning: n. 姿势，手势；姿态
example: Their handshake appeared to be a gesture of reconciliation.
translation: 他们的握手似乎是和解的表示。

meaning: v. 变得，成为；到达
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 鬼，灵魂；鬼魂
example: They stumble across a ghost town inhabited by a rascally gold prospector.
translation: 他们偶然来到一个居住着一位狡诈的淘金者的废墟之城。

meaning: n. 巨人；巨物
example: A giant wildcat is being hunted after 58 lambs were butchered.
translation: 一只大野猫在捕杀了58只羊羔后遭到猎捕。

meaning: n. 礼物，赠品；天赋
example: Her grandmother had the gift of making people happy.
translation: 她奶奶有逗人开心的本事。

meaning: n. 女孩子，姑娘；女儿
example: She was a shy, delicately pretty girl with enormous blue eyes.
translation: 她是一个害羞、娇美的女孩，长着一双大大的蓝眼睛。

meaning: v. 做，作；送给
example: "I can't give you an answer now," he hedged.
translation: “我现在不能回答你，”他闪避道。

meaning: adj. 高兴的；乐意的
example: I'm so glad to see you back where you belong.
translation: 我真高兴看到你又回到了属于你自己的天地。

meaning: v. 看一下; n. 一瞥
example: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
translation: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

meaning: v. 瞪眼; n. 瞪眼
example: Norma is said to dislike the glare of publicity.
translation: 据说诺尔玛不喜欢被人过多关注。

meaning: n. 玻璃；玻璃杯
example: The theatre is a futuristic steel and glass structure.
translation: 这家剧院是钢筋和玻璃结构的未来派建筑。

meaning: v. 滑动；消逝; n. 滑行
example: Waiters glide between tightly packed tables bearing trays of pasta.
translation: 侍者们端着一盘盘意大利面在拥挤的餐桌之间自如穿行。

meaning: v. 瞥见; n. 一瞥，一看
example: Several thousand supporters strained to catch a glimpse of the new president.
translation: 几千名支持者翘首企盼能一睹新总统的风采。

meaning: v. 闪闪发光; n. 闪光
example: Gary Glitter, 48, revealed the secret of his youthful looks.
translation: 48岁的加里·格利特透露了他青春永驻的秘密。

meaning: n. 地球，世界；地界仪
example: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.
translation: 现在，顶灯已装上了一个白色球状罩子。

meaning: adj. 黑暗的；令人沮丧的
example: Some good might come of all this gloomy business.
translation: 生意不景气也未必全是坏事。

meaning: adj. 光荣的；壮丽的
example: We opened the windows and let in the glorious evening air.
translation: 我们打开窗户，让傍晚那沁人心脾的空气流进室内。

meaning: n. 光荣；荣誉的事
example: The glory of the idea blossomed in his mind.
translation: 在他的脑海中这一想法变得越来越宏大。

meaning: n. 手套
example: The UN inspectors work hand in glove with the Western intelligence agencies.
translation: 联合国观察员和西方情报机构之间密切合作。

meaning: n. 白热光; v. 发白热光
example: Give yourself a healthy glow on our detox diet.
translation: 我们的解毒食谱将会让您容光焕发。

meaning: n. 胶，胶水; v. 胶合
example: Stick them on using a small amount of glue.
translation: 用少许胶水把它们贴上。

meaning: v. 去；走；变为
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 球门；得分；目的
example: They were still arguing the toss about the first goal.
translation: 他们仍在为第一个进球争论不休。

meaning: n. 山羊
example: Sheep's milk is produced in much the same way as goat's milk.
translation: 绵羊奶和山羊奶的生产过程差不多。

meaning: n. 神，神像；上帝
example: Thank God they're not on my manor any more.
translation: 谢天谢地，他们再也不在我的辖区里了。

meaning: n. 金；钱财; adj. 金制的
example: They stumble across a ghost town inhabited by a rascally gold prospector.
translation: 他们偶然来到一个居住着一位狡诈的淘金者的废墟之城。

meaning: adj. 金色的；极好的
example: Imagine long golden beaches where you can wander in solitude.
translation: 想象一下那长长的金色海滩吧，在那里你可以独自徜徉。

meaning: n. 高尔夫球
example: Walking and golf increased in popularity during the 1980s.
translation: 在20世纪80年代越来越多的人喜欢上了远足或是打高尔夫球。

meaning: adj. 好的；有本事的
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. 优良，德性，仁慈
example: She had an unshakeable faith in human goodness and natural honesty.
translation: 她坚信人的本性是善良诚实的。

meaning: n. 货物，商品
example: Purchase tax was not payable on goods for export.
translation: 出口商品不需要交购买税。

meaning: n. 鹅，雌鹅
example: He said that what they were up to would cook Krasky's goose.
translation: 他说他们暗中进行的阴谋可能会使克拉斯基的计划流产。

meaning: v. 统治，治理；支配
example: The republics began asserting their right to govern themselves.
translation: 各加盟共和国开始要求获得自治权。

meaning: n. 政府；治理；政治
example: He admitted that the government was in "a dreadful hole".
translation: 他承认政府目前“处境极为尴尬”。

meaning: n. 州长；主管人员
example: Duke was soundly defeated in this month's Louisiana governor's race.
translation: 杜克在本月的路易斯安那州长竞选中大败而归。

meaning: n. 长袍，长外衣
example: She crept from the bed and fumbled for her dressing gown.
translation: 她从床上蹑手蹑脚地爬起来，摸索着自己的晨衣。

meaning: n. 优美，文雅；雅致
example: Grace tapped on the bedroom door and went in.
translation: 格雷丝轻轻敲了敲卧室的门，走了进去。

meaning: adj. 优美的，优雅的
example: His handwriting, from earliest young manhood, was flowing and graceful.
translation: 他的字从小就写得流畅优美。

meaning: adj. 有礼貌的；仁慈的
example: Good gracious, look at that specimen will you?
translation: 哎呀，你快来瞧瞧那个标本！

meaning: v. 给…分等级; n. 等级
example: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.
translation: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

meaning: adj. 逐渐的；渐进的
example: The roads are built to accommodate gradual temperature changes.
translation: 修建这些道路时考虑到了温度的逐渐变化。

meaning: adv. 逐渐地，逐步地
example: I gradually got rather disillusioned with the whole setup of the university.
translation: 渐渐地，我对大学的整个体制感到相当失望。

meaning: n. 毕业生; v. 大学毕业
example: My first job was as a graduate trainee with a bank.
translation: 我的第一份工作是在一家银行做大学毕业实习生。

meaning: n. 谷物，谷粒；颗粒
example: The firemen unwrapped their hoses and began dousing the scorched grain silos.
translation: 消防员展开水龙带，开始冲着烧焦的谷仓喷水。

meaning: n. 语法；语法书
example: He was known for his poor grammar and punctuation.
translation: 他不通语法和乱用标点是出了名的。

meaning: adj. 语法上的
example: Grammatical errors are always obvious to me, spelling mistakes stand out.
translation: 语法错误对我来说总是非常明显，而拼写错误也很显眼。

meaning: n. 克(重量单位)
example: The pro-gramme's researchers are guilty of bias and misrepresentation.
translation: 该项目的研究者们对心存偏见和误解感到非常内疚。

meaning: adj. 宏伟的；重大的
example: Do you always have a bet on the Grand National?
translation: 你总是对全国赛马大会下点注吗？

meaning: n. 孙女，外孙女
example: Her granddaughter lives abroad.
translation: 她的孙女住在国外.

meaning: n. 祖父；外祖父
example: He sat listening to the tick of the grandfather clock.
translation: 他坐在那儿，听着落地式大摆钟嘀嗒作响。

meaning: n. 祖母，外祖母
example: She looks disconcertingly like a familiar aunt or grandmother.
translation: 令人疑惑的是，她看上去就像一位面熟的邻家阿姨或是祖母。

meaning: n. 孙子，外孙子
example: I hadn't been far wrong in my estimate of his grandson's capabilities.
translation: 我对他孙子的能力的判断还不算太离谱。

meaning: n. 授给物; v. 授予
example: She won a grant to develop her own business.
translation: 她赢得了一笔拨款，用以扩展自己的企业。

meaning: n. 葡萄；葡萄藤
example: He put a grape into his mouth and swallowed it whole.
translation: 他把一粒葡萄放入嘴里,整个吞了下去.

meaning: n. (曲线)图，图表
example: We plot about eight points on the graph.
translation: 我们在图表上绘制出大约8个点的曲线。

meaning: v. 抓紧；掌握; n. 抓
example: He let the ball slip through his grasp and into the net.
translation: 球从他的掌中滑出，钻进了球门。

meaning: n. 草；牧草；草地
example: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
translation: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

meaning: adj. 感激的；令人愉快的
example: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
translation: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

meaning: adj. 感激，感谢，感恩
example: I owe a big debt of gratitude to her.
translation: 我对她万分感激。

meaning: n. 坟墓; adj. 严重的
example: Universities are facing grave problems because of diminishing resources.
translation: 由于资源的减少，大学正面临严峻的问题。

meaning: n. 重力，引力；严重性
example: Anything with strong gravity attracts other things to it.
translation: 任何有较强重力的物体都会对其他物体产生引力。

meaning: adj. 灰色的; n. 灰色
example: His hair was disheveled, and his face was unshaven and gray.
translation: 他头发凌乱，没刮胡子，脸色苍白。

meaning: adj. 大的；伟大的
example: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
translation: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

meaning: adv. 大大地，非常
example: Any assistance you could give the police will be greatly appreciated.
translation: 您提供的任何帮助警方都将万分感谢。

meaning: adj. 贪吃的；贪婪的
example: Edith was seen as a conniving, greedy woman.
translation: 人们认为伊迪丝是一个诡计多端的贪婪女人。

meaning: adj. 希腊的; n. 希腊人
example: Latin and Greek will be squeezed out of school timetables.
translation: 拉丁语和希腊语将退出学校的课程表。

meaning: adj. 绿色的; n. 绿色
example: Revenues from "green taxes" could then be channelled back into energy efficiency.
translation: 从“绿色税收”得来的收入便可回过头来用于提高能效。

meaning: n. 温室，玻璃暖房
example: Leonard pottered round the greenhouse, tying up canes for the tomatoes.
translation: 伦纳德在温室里悠然自得地给西红柿绑上撑杆。

meaning: v. 问候，招呼；反应
example: He looked at Livy and Mark, who had risen to greet him.
translation: 他看着站起来跟他打招呼的莉薇和马克。

meaning: n. 问候，招呼，致敬
example: He took her hand in greeting and asked solicitously how everything was.
translation: 他握着她的手表示问候，关切地问她一切是否都好。

meaning: adj. 灰色的; n. 灰色
example: I undid the bottom two buttons of my yellow and grey shirt.
translation: 我解开了自己黄灰相间的衬衫上最下面的两个纽扣。

meaning: v. 使悲痛; v. 悲痛
example: I didn't have any time to grieve.
translation: 我没有时间伤心。

meaning: v. 磨(碎)；磨快
example: The daily grind of government is done by Her Majesty's Civil Service.
translation: 枯燥的日常政务都由女王陛下的政府行政部门来处理。

meaning: v. 握紧，抓牢; n. 紧握
example: How much can the President relax his grip over the nation?
translation: 总统可以对国家的控制放松到什么样的程度？

meaning: v. 哼，呻吟; n. 呻吟
example: She heard him let out a pitiful, muffled groan.
translation: 她听到他发出一声令人悲悯的低沉的呻吟声。

meaning: n. 食品商；杂货商
example: Go down to the grocer's and get some sugar.
translation: 去杂货店给我买点糖来.

meaning: n. 食品杂货店
example: I worked stocking shelves in a grocery store.
translation: 我在一家杂货店工作，负责为货架上货。

meaning: adj. 总的；严重的
example: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.
translation: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

meaning: n. 地；场地；根据
example: They found a labyrinth of tunnels under the ground.
translation: 他们发现了一处迷宫似的地道。

meaning: n. 小组，群; v. 聚集
example: I thought I'd enrol you with an art group at the school.
translation: 我想我会吸收你参加学校的一个艺术团。

meaning: v. 生长；变得；增长
example: The mother provides the embryo with nourishment and a place to grow.
translation: 母亲为胎儿提供营养和成长的空间。

meaning: n. 增长；增长量；生长
example: Last year, economic growth tailed off to below four percent.
translation: 去年，经济增长率下降到4%以下。

meaning: n. 保证；担保物
example: He argues strongly for retention of NATO as a guarantee of peace.
translation: 他强烈要求保留北大西洋公约组织以维护和平。

meaning: v. 守卫；看守; n. 卫兵
example: He rang for the guard to let him out.
translation: 他按铃叫保安放他出去。

meaning: vt&vi&n. 猜测，推测
example: Guess what? I'm going to dinner at Mrs. Combley's tonight.
translation: 你猜怎么着？今晚我要去康伯利夫人家里赴宴。

meaning: n. 客人，宾客；旅客
example: The duke was surprised by his wife's omission from the guest list.
translation: 公爵对他的夫人未在获邀宾客之列感到意外。

meaning: n. 引导，指导，领导
example: I went down on my knees and prayed for guidance.
translation: 我跪了下来，祈求得到指引。

meaning: n. 导游者; v. 给…导游
example: This is it, folks: the best record guide in the business.
translation: 就是这个，伙计们，业内最好的唱片指南。

meaning: adj. 内疚的；有罪的
example: Striker Alan Smith was guilty of two glaring misses.
translation: 前锋艾伦·史密斯两次严重失误，将球射偏。

meaning: n. 海湾
example: These issues were brought into sharp focus by the Gulf crisis.
translation: 海湾危机让这些问题备受关注。

meaning: n. 口香糖；树胶
example: When not removed, plaque causes tooth decay and gum disease.
translation: 牙斑如果不清除就会导致牙齿蛀蚀和牙龈疾病。

meaning: n. 枪，炮，手枪
example: Planes dropped bombs and raked the beach with machine gun fire.
translation: 飞机投下炸弹，并用机关枪扫射海滩。

meaning: n. 黑色火药；有烟火药
example: The barrel of gunpowder blew up with a terrible noise.
translation: 火药桶爆炸了,发出轰然一声巨响.

meaning: n. 体育馆，健身房
example: Our school has a big gymnasium.
translation: 我们学校有座大型体育馆.

meaning: n. 习惯；习性
example: She's kicked her drug habit and learned that her life has value.
translation: 她已经戒了毒，并且认识到了生命可贵。

meaning: adj. 习惯性的，惯常的
example: Other countries retained their traditional and habitual ways of doing things.
translation: 其他国家仍然保持着他们做事的传统和习惯。

meaning: n. 头发，毛发；毛
example: She walked forward and embraced him and stroked his tousled white hair.
translation: 她走上前拥抱他并轻抚他凌乱的白发。

meaning: n. 理发
example: Now politics is all about the right haircut and a sharp suit.
translation: 现在政界讲究的无非是合适的发型和时髦的衣着。

meaning: n. 半，一半; adj. 一半的
example: Elliott crossed the finish line just half a second behind his adversary.
translation: 埃利奥特跨过终点线时仅比对手落后半秒钟。

meaning: n. 门厅；过道；会堂
example: The entrance hall is littered with toys and wellington boots.
translation: 门厅里到处乱扔着玩具和雨靴。

meaning: v. 停止；立定; n. 停住
example: The elevator creaked to a halt at the ground floor.
translation: 电梯嘎吱一声停在了一层。

meaning: n. 汉堡包，牛肉饼
example: Avoid unhealthy foods such as hamburger and chips.
translation: 不要吃不健康食品，如汉堡和薯条。

meaning: n. 锤，榔头; v. 锤击
example: To avoid damaging the tree, hammer a wooden peg into the hole.
translation: 为了不毁坏树，用锤子将一个木栓钉进洞里。

meaning: n. 手；人手；指针
example: He was hand-picked for this job by the Admiral.
translation: 他是由海军上将精心挑选出来担任这项工作的。

meaning: n. 一把；少数，一小撮
example: Only a handful had returned to work in the immediate vicinity.
translation: 仅有几个人回到临近地区工作。

meaning: n. 手帕
example: She balled the handkerchief up and threw it at his feet.
translation: 她把手绢揉成一团，丢在了他的脚边。

meaning: n. 柄，把手; v. 拿，触
example: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

meaning: adj. 英俊的；相当大的
example: The opposition won a handsome victory in the election.
translation: 反对党在竞选中以高票获胜。

meaning: n. 笔迹，手迹，书法
example: I have to admit that I have bad handwriting.
translation: 我不得不承认自己的字写得不好看。

meaning: adj. 手边的；便于使用的
example: Keep a pad handy to jot down queries as they occur.
translation: 手边放一本便笺簿，以便有问题时随时记下。

meaning: v. 挂，悬；吊死
example: The King has merely given the politicians enough rope to hang themselves.
translation: 国王只不过是给了这些政客自缚的绳子。

meaning: v. 发生；碰巧，恰好
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. 幸福，幸运；快乐
example: for your happiness
translation: 祝你幸福；为你的幸福

meaning: adj. 快乐的；幸福的
example: She has now changed into a happy, self-confident woman.
translation: 如今她已经变成一个快乐、自信的女人。

meaning: n. 海港，港口; v. 庇护
example: Sewage nutrients do increase algal growth in the harbour.
translation: 污水中的营养物确实会加快港口的海藻生长。

meaning: adj. 硬的；困难的
example: Talent, hard work and sheer tenacity are all crucial to career success.
translation: 事业要成功，才能、勤奋和顽强的意志都至关重要。

meaning: v. 使变硬; v. 变硬
example: Give the cardboard two or three coats of varnish to harden it.
translation: 在纸板上涂两三层清漆使其变硬。

meaning: adv. 几乎不，简直不
example: The ward was busy and Amy hardly had time to talk.
translation: 病房里非常忙碌，埃米几乎没有时间说话。

meaning: n. 艰难，困苦
example: Many people are suffering economic hardship.
translation: 很多人正处于经济困难之中。

meaning: n. 五金器具；硬件
example: Hardware stores have sold out of water pumps and tarpaulins.
translation: 五金店内水泵和防水油布已经卖光了。

meaning: n. 野兔
example: Monks shave their heads, as do devotees of the Hare Krishna movement.
translation: 和尚要剃度，克利须那派教徒也一样。

meaning: n. 伤害，损害; v. 损害
example: Nudism, the council decided, was doing the resort more harm than good.
translation: 委员会认定在休闲胜地的裸体行为弊大于利。

meaning: adj. 有害的
example: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
translation: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

meaning: n. 调合，协调，和谐
example: As they smiled at each other, harmony was restored again.
translation: 他们彼此微笑的时候，又恢复了往日的和睦。

meaning: v. 治理; n. 马具，挽具
example: He was almost strangled by his parachute harness straps.
translation: 他差点被自己的降落伞吊带勒死。

meaning: adj. 严厉的；刺耳的
example: His voice was harsh as he enunciated each word carefully.
translation: 他一字一顿，听上去很生硬。

meaning: n. 收获，收成; v. 收割
example: Comet also sired the champion foal out of Spinway Harvest.
translation: “彗星”还跟“斯平威·哈维斯特”生下了这匹出类拔萃的小马驹。

meaning: n. 急速，急忙；草率
example: The pilot wisely decided to return to Farnborough post haste.
translation: 飞行员明智地决定尽快返回法恩伯勒。

meaning: v. 催促; v. 赶紧
example: Naturally, it'll go back. But without Murray's little note, I hasten to add.
translation: 很自然，它会返回。但没有默里的便条，我急忙补充道。

meaning: adj. 急速的；仓促的
example: So let's not be hasty. After all, he can't run away.
translation: 所以我们不要鲁莽行事。毕竟他是跑不掉的。

meaning: n. 帽子(一般指有边的)
example: Stan Dean, easily identifiable by his oddly-shaped hat, sat in a doorway.
translation: 斯坦·迪安坐在门口，他那顶奇形怪状的帽子一下子就让人认出他来。

meaning: v. 孵出; v. (蛋)孵化
example: As soon as the two chicks hatch, they leave the nest burrow.
translation: 两只小鸟一出壳就离开了巢穴。

meaning: v. 恨，憎恨；不喜欢
example: I hate it when people accuse us of that.
translation: 我讨厌别人就那件事指责我们。

meaning: adj. 可恨的，可恶的
example: I'm sorry. That was a hateful thing to say.
translation: 对不起，我不该说那么难听的话。

meaning: n. 憎恶，憎恨，仇恨
example: The war sweeps up everyone in hatred and recrimination.
translation: 战争让大家充满仇恨并相互指责。

meaning: v. aux已经; v. 有；吃
example: You have to do everything you can. You have to work your hardest. And if you do, if you stay positive, then you have a shot at a silver lining.
translation: 你需要尽你所能，最大限度地去努力。只要你这么做，只要你能保持乐观，你就会看见乌云背后的幸福线。

meaning: n. 鹰，隼
example: The hawk swooped and soared away carrying something.
translation: 那只鹰向下猛冲，抓住东西后又展翅高飞了。

meaning: n. 干草
example: make hay
translation: 利用机会去赚钱

meaning: n. 危险；公害
example: Catching colds is unfortunately an occupational hazard in this profession.
translation: 不幸的是，容易感冒是这个行业的职业性风险。

meaning: pron. (主格)他
example: He was well acquainted with the literature of France, Germany and Holland.
translation: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

meaning: n. 头；上端; v. 率领
example: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
translation: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

meaning: n. 头痛；头痛的事
example: Symptoms are a slight fever, headache and loss of appetite.
translation: 症状包括低烧、头痛和食欲不振。

meaning: n. 标题，题词，题名
example: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.
translation: 我正要执行一项让我心惊肉跳的秘密任务。

meaning: n. 大字标题；新闻提要
example: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
translation: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

meaning: n. 校长
example: He was headmaster of a public school in the West of England.
translation: 他是英格兰西部一所公学的校长。

meaning: n. 司令部；总部
example: Its headquarters will soon be relocated from Westminster to the Greenwich site.
translation: 其总部很快将从威斯敏斯特迁往格林尼治。

meaning: v. 治愈；使和解
example: They hope to heal the rift with their father.
translation: 他们希望能够弥合和父亲之间的裂痕。

meaning: n. 健康，健康状况
example: His wife Cheryl said she had no worries about his health.
translation: 他的妻子谢里尔说她并不担心他的健康。

meaning: adj. 健康的；有益健康的
example: The birth of a live healthy baby is a truly blessed event.
translation: 一个健康活泼的婴儿的出生真是一件可喜的事情。

meaning: n. (一)堆；大量
example: Clothes were thrown in the luggage in an untidy heap.
translation: 衣服被乱糟糟地扔进旅行箱里。

meaning: v. 听见；审讯；听说
example: "I'm afraid he's ill." — "I'm sorry to hear that."
translation: “恐怕他生病了。”——“真是遗憾。”

meaning: n. 心，内心；勇气
example: Bob died of a heart attack, brought on by his lifestyle.
translation: 鲍勃死于由他的生活方式引起的心脏病突发。

meaning: n. 热，炎热; v. 变热
example: heat transfer
translation: 热传递，传热

meaning: n. 加热，供暖
example: The central heating's been turned off. I've turned it on again.
translation: 中央供暖系统已经关上。我又将它打开了。

meaning: n. 天堂；天，天空
example: They would move heaven and earth to stop me if they could.
translation: 可能的话，他们会千方百计地阻止我。

meaning: adv. 重重地；大量地
example: Nuclear weapons plants across the country are heavily contaminated with toxic wastes.
translation: 全国的核武器工厂均受到了有毒废弃物的严重污染。

meaning: adj. 重的；大的；充满的
example: I don't want any more of that heavy stuff.
translation: 我再也不想碰那种麻烦事了。

meaning: n. 篱笆，树篱；障碍物
example: Hawker Siddeley tried to hedge its bets by diversifying into other fields.
translation: 霍克·西德利试图通过在其他领域进行多样化发展来规避风险。

meaning: n. 脚后跟，踵，后跟
example: With a snarl, the second dog made a dive for his heel.
translation: 伴着一声嗥叫，第二只狗扑向了他的脚后跟。

meaning: n. 高，高度；高处
example: The sudden height dizzied her and she clung tightly.
translation: 突然上升的高度让她晕头转向，她抓得紧紧的。

meaning: n. 后嗣，继承人
example: His heir sold the painting to the London art dealer Agnews.
translation: 他的继承人把这幅画卖给了伦敦艺术品经销商阿格纽斯。

meaning: n. 直升机
example: A helicopter crashed in a fiery explosion in Vallejo.
translation: 一架直升机在瓦列霍爆炸起火并坠毁。

meaning: n. 地狱；极大的痛苦
example: Whatever the outcome, it's going to be one hell of a fight.
translation: 不管结果如何，这都会是场艰苦的战斗。

meaning: int. 喂
example: I answered the phone and this voice went, "Hello? Is that Alison?"
translation: 我拿起电话，就听到这个声音：“喂？是艾利森吗？”

meaning: n. 头盔，钢盔
example: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorbike.
translation: 一位戴头盔的男子正跨上摩托车。

meaning: v. 帮助；援助; n. 帮手
example: Ellery's return will help to chase away some of the gloom.
translation: 埃勒里的归来可以驱散一些抑郁的情绪。

meaning: adj. 给予帮助的；有用的
example: Having the right equipment at hand will be enormously helpful.
translation: 手头上有合适的设备将会帮上大忙。

meaning: adj. 无助的；无能的
example: Children are dying, and I am helpless to do anything.
translation: 孩子们已奄奄一息，而我却无力做任何事情。

meaning: n. 母鸡，雌禽
example: The pheasant is a close relative of the Guinea hen.
translation: 雉与珍珠鸡有很近的亲缘关系。

meaning: adv. 因此，所以；今后
example: Everyone wanted to bowl, hence everyone wanted to open a bowling alley.
translation: 大家都想玩保龄球，因此大家都想开保龄球馆。

meaning: pron. (宾格)她；她的
example: Somehow Karin managed to cope with the demands of her career.
translation: 卡琳设法达到了其职业的要求。

meaning: n. 兽群，牧群; v. 放牧
example: Stefano used a motor cycle to herd the sheep.
translation: 斯特凡诺骑一辆摩托车放羊。

meaning: adv. 这里；向这里
example: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
translation: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

meaning: n. 男主角；英雄；勇士
example: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
translation: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

meaning: adj. 英雄的；英勇的
example: The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction.
translation: 公司在降低成本方面付出了艰苦卓绝的努力。

meaning: n. 女主角；女英雄
example: The film concludes with the heroine's death.
translation: 影片以女主角之死结束.

meaning: pron. 她的(所有物)
example: Hers was a minor part, but she played it with gusto.
translation: 她演的是个小角色，但是演得很投入。

meaning: pron. 她自己；她亲自
example: She dusted herself down and left to build her own career.
translation: 她重振旗鼓去开创自己的事业了。

meaning: v. 犹豫，踌躇；含糊
example: I might today hesitate to turn in a burglar.
translation: 现在让我把入室窃贼送交警方，我可能会有所顾虑。

meaning: int. 嗨(表示问候等)
example: All this equipment has received international acclaim from the specialist hi-fi press.
translation: 这套设备受到全球高保真音响专业报刊的赞誉。

meaning: v. 把…藏起来；隐瞒
example: You feel an animal panic to run and hide.
translation: 你会感到一种本能的恐惧而想要去逃避。

meaning: adj. 高的；高级的; adv. 高
example: Powell's unusual journey to high office is an inspiration to millions.
translation: 鲍威尔升任高官的不寻常历程对数以百万计的人都是一个激励。

meaning: adv. 高度地，很，非常
example: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
translation: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

meaning: n. 公路；大路
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: n. 小山，山岗；丘陵
example: A girl in a red smock tripped down the hill.
translation: 一个身穿红色罩衫的女孩迈着轻快的步子下山。

meaning: n. (小山)山腰，山坡
example: A gust of breeze moved down the hillside, ruffling the grass.
translation: 一阵微风吹下山坡，使青草如波浪起伏。

meaning: pron. (宾格)他
example: She studied him for the longest time, looking wryly amused.
translation: 她面带苦笑，盯着他看了很长时间。

meaning: pron. 他自己；他亲自
example: He sees himself going right to the top of the tree.
translation: 他预见自己在同行中将无人可及。

meaning: n. 暗示，示意；建议
example: "I think I hear the telephone ringing."—"Okay, I can take a hint."
translation: “我想我听到电话铃在响。”——“好的，我明白你的意思了。”

meaning: v. 租借; n. 租用，雇用
example: Child car seats only cost about £10 a week to hire.
translation: 儿童汽车坐椅一周的租金才10英镑。

meaning: pron. 他的，他的东西
example: His hands were too weak to cock his revolver.
translation: 他的手没劲儿，扳不动左轮手枪的扳机。

meaning: adj. 历史的，有关历史的
example: Two historical questions — you can answer them how you like.
translation: 两个历史问题——你可以随便回答。

meaning: n. 历史；个人经历
example: I fell under the influence of a history master.
translation: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

meaning: v. 打；碰撞; n. 击
example: As I sidestepped, the bottle hit me on the left hip.
translation: 我侧一步要躲闪的时候，瓶子打中了我的左髋部。

meaning: n. 业余爱好，癖好
example: It is only a hobby, not a life or death struggle.
translation: 这只是一项爱好，不需要拼死拼活地努力。

meaning: v. 拿住；掌握；拥有
example: He struggled to hold the bike down on the banked corners.
translation: 拐过斜弯时他竭力将自行车把稳。

meaning: n. 洞；孔眼，裂开处
example: He admitted that the government was in "a dreadful hole".
translation: 他承认政府目前“处境极为尴尬”。

meaning: n. 假日，节日；假期
example: People are having to think hard about their holiday plans.
translation: 人们现在得仔细地琢磨自己的度假计划。

meaning: adj. 空的；空洞的
example: Bake some big red peppers and hollow them out.
translation: 将几个大红甜椒烤一烤，再把它们掏空。

meaning: adj. 神圣的；圣洁的
example: The discovery is being hailed as The Holy Grail of astronomy.
translation: 这一发现圆了天文学界的一个梦想。

meaning: n. 家；家乡; adj. 家庭的
example: It had once been the home of a wealthy nobleman.
translation: 这里曾是一个有钱贵族的宅邸。

meaning: adj. 诚实的；可敬的
example: To be honest the house is not quite our style.
translation: 说实话，这所房子不太适合我们。

meaning: n. 诚实，正直
example: We like him for his honesty, his lack of pretension.
translation: 我们喜欢他的诚实、不浮夸。

meaning: n. 蜜，蜂蜜；甜，甜蜜
example: Add more honey if you have a sweet tooth.
translation: 如果你喜欢吃甜的就多加点蜂蜜。

meaning: n. 蜜月
example: Brett is enjoying a honeymoon period with both press and public.
translation: 布雷特和报界及公众之间都正处在蜜月期。

meaning: n. 光荣；尊敬，敬意
example: I impressed on him what a huge honour he was being offered.
translation: 我让他铭记他当时被授予了多么大的荣誉。

meaning: adj. 诚实的；光荣的
example: My title, by courtesy only, is the Honourable Amalia Lovell.
translation: 人们称我为，当然只是出于礼貌，尊敬的阿马利娅·洛弗尔夫人。

meaning: n. 钩，挂钩; v. 钩住
example: Water and electric hook-ups are available and facilities are good.
translation: 水和电都可以接通，设施也很不错。

meaning: n&vt&vi. 希望
example: The arteries are diseased and a transplant is the only hope.
translation: 动脉已经发生病变，移植是唯一的希望。

meaning: adj. 有希望的
example: They are hopeful of bringing the siege to a peaceful conclusion.
translation: 他们希望能和平结束这次围困。

meaning: adj. 没有希望的，绝望的
example: I don't drive and the buses are quite hopeless.
translation: 我不开车，公共汽车条件又太糟糕。

meaning: n. 地平线；眼界，见识
example: She stared dreamily out of the small window at the blue horizon.
translation: 她出神地看着小窗子外面的蓝色地平线。

meaning: adj. 地平的；水平的
example: The frames are secured by horizontal rails to the back wall.
translation: 框架用横杆牢牢固定在后墙上。

meaning: n. 号角；警报器；角
example: The storms had abated by the time they rounded Cape Horn.
translation: 他们绕过合恩角时，暴风雨已经减弱。

meaning: n. 恐怖；战栗；憎恶
example: Somehow he tells these stories without a note of horror.
translation: 不知为什么他讲这些故事时一点都不害怕。

meaning: n. 马；马科动物
example: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
translation: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

meaning: n. 马力
example: a powerful car with a 170 horsepower engine
translation: 发动机为170马力的大功率汽车

meaning: n. 医院
example: You are welcome to visit the hospital at any time.
translation: 你可以随时来医院。

meaning: n. 主人；东道主
example: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.
translation: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。

meaning: n. 女主人；空姐
example: An air hostess was arrested and charged with drug smuggling.
translation: 一名空姐被捕，并被控以走私毒品的罪名。

meaning: adj. 敌方的；不友善的
example: The West has gradually relaxed its hostile attitude to this influential state.
translation: 西方对这个颇具影响力的国家的敌视态度已逐渐缓和。

meaning: adj. 热的；刺激的；辣的
example: Wash your hands thoroughly with hot soapy water before handling any food.
translation: 在拿吃的之前，用热肥皂水把手好好地洗干净。

meaning: n. 旅馆
example: The hotel is set plumb in the middle of the high street.
translation: 宾馆正好坐落在商街的中段。

meaning: n. 小时；时间，时刻
example: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair.
translation: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。

meaning: n. 房屋，住宅；商号
example: The house seemed muted, hushed as if it had been deserted.
translation: 房子里似乎悄然无声，安静得好像已经没人在住一样。

meaning: n. 家庭，户；家务
example: Some barbecues can be plugged into a household electricity supply.
translation: 有一些烧烤炉能直接插到家用电源上。

meaning: n. 家庭主妇
example: She seemed less like a poetess than a distracted housewife.
translation: 她似乎不像个女诗人，更像一个心烦意乱的家庭主妇。

meaning: adv. 怎么；怎样；多少
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adv. 然而；不管怎样
example: The mechanics of the job, however, have changed little since then.
translation: 不过，工作流程从那以后就几乎没有任何变化。

meaning: adj. 巨大的，庞大的
example: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

meaning: adj. 人的，人类的; n. 人
example: Most of the wine was unfit for human consumption.
translation: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。

meaning: adj. 谦逊的；地位低下的
example: Now experts are extolling the virtues of the humble potato.
translation: 现在专家们都在赞美其貌不扬的马铃薯的种种好处。

meaning: adj. 湿的，湿气重的
example: Visitors can expect hot and humid condi-tions.
translation: 游客会遇到炎热潮湿的天气状况。

meaning: adj. 富于幽默的，诙谐的
example: John Lennon found time to publish two books of his humorous prose.
translation: 约翰·列侬抽时间出版了两本幽默散文。

meaning: n. 幽默，诙谐，幽默感
example: There is a wry sense of humour in his work.
translation: 他的作品带有一种讽刺意味的幽默。

meaning: num. 百，百个; n. 许多
example: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
translation: 3亿美元远远不够。

meaning: n. 饿，饥饿；渴望
example: The meat they'd managed to procure assuaged their hunger.
translation: 他们把搞到手的肉拿来充饥。

meaning: adj. 饥饿的；渴望的
example: Come on now. You know you must be hungry.
translation: 好，来吧，你肯定已经饿了。

meaning: n. 打猎；搜寻; v. 追猎
example: The couple had helped in the hunt for the toddlers.
translation: 这对夫妇曾帮着搜寻那些幼童。

meaning: v. 赶紧; v. 催促
example: Dave was in a hurry to get back to work.
translation: 戴夫急于回到工作岗位。

meaning: v. 使受伤；使痛心
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: n. 丈夫
example: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
translation: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

meaning: n. 小屋，棚屋
example: The hut suddenly seemed strangely silent.
translation: 小屋突然似乎安静得出奇。

meaning: n. 氢
example: Hydrogen is used extensively in industry for the production of ammonia.
translation: 氢气在工业上广泛用于制氨。

meaning: pron. (主格)我
example: For more information concerning the club contact I. Coldwell.
translation: 咨询俱乐部详情，请与I.科德维尔联系。

meaning: n. 冰，冰块; v. 冰镇
example: His mother's voice was one he knew; ice cold and deadly.
translation: 母亲的声音是他很熟悉的：冰冷、无情。

meaning: n. 想法；思想；意见
example: I have a fair idea of how difficult things can be.
translation: 我大致了解情况会有多困难。

meaning: adj. 理想的；观念的
example: The reality of mothering is frequently very different from the romantic ideal.
translation: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

meaning: adj. 完全相同的；同一的
example: The identical treatment of such dissimilar items is totally illogical.
translation: 对如此不同的东西用一模一样的处理方法是完全不合逻辑的。

meaning: v. 认出，识别，鉴定
example: The new technique has been used to identify the sex of foetuses.
translation: 这一新技术已经被用来鉴别胎儿的性别。

meaning: n. 习语，成语
example: It was an old building in the local idiom.
translation: 这是一座具有当地特色的古建筑.

meaning: adj. 空闲的；懒散的
example: Brian kept up the idle chatter for another five minutes.
translation: 布赖恩又絮絮地唠叨了5分钟。

meaning: conj. 假如，如果
example: If you wait, all that happens is that you get older.
translation: 如果你等待，发生的只有变老。

meaning: adj. 不知道的；无知的
example: Authors are famously ignorant about the realities of publishing.
translation: 作者们不了解出版界的实际情况，这是人所共知的。

meaning: v. 不顾，不理，忽视
example: The movie industry had chosen to ignore the encroaching competition of television.
translation: 电影业故意无视电视业的侵犯性竞争。

meaning: adj. 有病的；坏的; adv. 坏
example: "I'm afraid he's ill." — "I'm sorry to hear that."
translation: “恐怕他生病了。”——“真是遗憾。”

meaning: adj. 不合法的，非法的
example: By-laws are to make it illegal to smoke in public.
translation: 地方法规将规定在公共场合抽烟为非法。

meaning: n. 病，疾病
example: Attitudes to mental illness have shifted in recent years.
translation: 最近几年对精神病的态度已有所改变。

meaning: v. (用图等)说明
example: He quoted some old Chinese sayings to illustrate his points.
translation: 他援用了一些中国话来解释他的论点.

meaning: n. 说明，图解；例证
example: The illustration shows a cluster of five roses coloured apricot orange.
translation: 插图上是一簇杏橙色的玫瑰，一共5朵。

meaning: n. 像；形象；映象
example: The European Parliament badly needs a president who can burnish its image.
translation: 欧洲议会急需一位能改善其声望的主席。
