meaning: adj. 想象中的，假想的
example: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
translation: 精神分裂症的最常见的一个症状就是幻听。

meaning: n. 想象；想象力；空想
example: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world.
translation: 儿童可能无法将自己的幻想与真实世界区分开来。

meaning: v. 想象，设想；料想
example: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
translation: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

meaning: v. 模仿，仿效；仿制
example: He could imitate in speech or writing most of those he admired.
translation: 他能模仿大多数自己崇拜的偶像的讲话和写作风格。

meaning: adj. 立即的；直接的
example: Only a handful had returned to work in the immediate vicinity.
translation: 仅有几个人回到临近地区工作。

meaning: adv. 立即；直接地
example: Many areas in the country'sinterior are unable to report Aids cases immediately.
translation: 该国内地的很多地区无法即时报告艾滋病病例。

meaning: adj. 巨大的；极好的
example: I'd seen it before in people who held immense power.
translation: 我以前曾在掌握大权的人身上看到过这种情况。

meaning: n. 移民; adj. 移民的
example: In recent months many conservative politicians have jumped on the anti-immigrant bandwagon.
translation: 最近几个月，很多保守政客都搭上了“反移民”这班车。

meaning: n. 影响，作用；冲击
example: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
translation: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

meaning: adj. 不耐烦的，急躁的
example: He is impatient as the first hour passes and then another.
translation: 一个小时、两个小时过去了，他不耐烦了。

meaning: n. 含义，暗示，暗指
example: The implication that marital infidelity enhances a leader's credibility is preposterous.
translation: 婚姻不忠会提升领导人可信度的暗示荒谬之极。

meaning: v. 暗示，意指
example: Cheerfulness doesn't always imply happiness.
translation: 快活并不总是意味着幸福.

meaning: vt&n. 输入，进口
example: We import an incredible amount of cheese from the Continent.
translation: 我们从欧洲大陆进口数量惊人的奶酪。

meaning: n. 重要；重要性
example: My great-grandfather was a person of some importance here.
translation: 我曾祖父曾是这儿的头面人物。

meaning: adj. 重要的；有势力的
example: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.
translation: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很重要，麦麸也是。

meaning: v. 把…强加；征(税)
example: I didn't want to impose myself on my married friends.
translation: 我不想打扰自己已婚的朋友。

meaning: adj. 不可能的，办不到的
example: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
translation: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

meaning: v. 给…深刻印象
example: A style consultant will demonstrate how to dress to impress.
translation: 时尚顾问将示范如何穿着以给人留下深刻印象。

meaning: n. 印；印象；印记
example: My visit to India in 1986 left an indelible impression on me.
translation: 1986年的印度之行给我留下了难忘的印象。

meaning: adj. 给人印象深刻的
example: India while not racking up such an impressive score beat Japan 3-0.
translation: 印度尽管没有大胜，却也以3比0击败了日本。

meaning: v. 关押，监禁；限制
example: You can lock up a person physically, but you cannot imprison his heart.
translation: 人的身体可以被囚禁, 人的心却不可以.

meaning: v. 使更好; v. 改善
example: You can improve your chances of profit by sensible planning.
translation: 你可以通过合理计划来提高盈利的机会。

meaning: n. 改进，改善；改进处
example: CBS's ratings again showed huge improvement over the previous year.
translation: 与前一年相比，哥伦比亚广播公司的收视率再次大幅提高。

meaning: prep. 在…里ad进，入
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 英寸
example: We are prepared to fight for every inch of territory.
translation: 我们时刻准备着为每一寸领土而战。

meaning: n. 发生的事；事件
example: A member of the security forces was killed in a sniping incident.
translation: 有一名安全部队成员在一场狙击战中被打死。

meaning: n. 斜坡; v. 使倾斜
example: Those who fail incline to blame the world for their failure.
translation: 那些失败者往往将他们的失败归咎于社会。

meaning: v. 包括，包含
example: The unemployed executives include former sales managers, directors and accountants.
translation: 被解雇的管理人员包括前销售经理、主管和会计。

meaning: n. 收入；收益；进款
example: Tourism is up, jobs are up, individual income is up.
translation: 旅游火了，工作机会多了，个人收入涨了。

meaning: adj. 不正确的，错误的
example: Receding gums can be the result of disease or simply incorrect brushing.
translation: 牙龈萎缩可能是疾病导致的，也可能仅仅是错误的刷牙方式引起的。

meaning: vt&vi&n. 增加
example: He introduced radio to the school to increase the children's awareness.
translation: 他在学校开通广播，以提高孩子们的警觉性。

meaning: adv. 日益，越来越多地
example: Increasingly, corporate clients are seeking to outsource the management of their facilities.
translation: 越来越多的公司客户寻求将设施的管理外包出去。

meaning: adv. 真正地；确实
adj. 不明确的；不定的
example: He was transferred to Shoal Creek Mental Institution for an indefinite period.
translation: 他被转到了肖尔溪精神病院，要在那里无限期地呆下去。

meaning: n. 独立，自主，自立
example: The pull-out of the army paves the way for independence.
translation: 军队的撤出为独立铺平了道路。

meaning: adj. 独立的；自主的
example: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
translation: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

meaning: n. 索引；指数；指标
example: The FT 30 share index was up 16.4 points to 1,599.6.
translation: 《金融时报》30股指上涨16.4点，收于1,559.6点。

meaning: n. 印度
example: India has always been one of the most religiously diverse countries.
translation: 印度一直都是宗教信仰最多元的国家之一。

meaning: adj. 印度的; n. 印度人
example: Sri Lankans share a common ancestry with their Indian brethren.
translation: 斯里兰卡人和他们的印度兄弟有共同的祖先。

meaning: v. 标示，表示；表明
example: Ballpark estimates indicate a price tag of $90 million a month.
translation: 大致的估计费用为每月9,000万美元。

meaning: n. 指示；表示；表明
example: If she had noticed her father's entrance, she gave no indication.
translation: 就算她已经注意到了父亲的到来，她也会不动声色。

meaning: adj. 冷漠的；不积极的
example: Of all the lazy, indifferent, unbusinesslike attitudes to have!
translation: 这是多么懒惰、冷漠、不敬业的态度！

meaning: adj. 愤慨的，义愤的
example: MPs were indignant that the government had not consulted them.
translation: 政府没有事先征求他们的意见，下院议员们感到很愤怒。

meaning: adj. 间接的；不坦率的
example: Businesses are feeling the indirect effects from the recession that'sgoing on elsewhere.
translation: 企业感受到了别处经济衰退带来的间接影响。

meaning: adj. 必不可少的，必需的
example: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.
translation: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

meaning: adj. 个别的；独特的
example: Tourism is up, jobs are up, individual income is up.
translation: 旅游火了，工作机会多了，个人收入涨了。

meaning: adv. 在室内，在屋里
example: The crowd moved indoors for what were deemed the most desirable items.
translation: 人群为了被视为最值得拥有的物品涌入屋里。

meaning: adj. 工业的；产业的
example: The seven major industrial countries will have their yearly meeting in London.
translation: 7个主要工业国家将在伦敦举行一年一度的会议。

meaning: v. 使工业化
example: The southern part of the country was slow to industrialize.
translation: 这个国家的南部工业化进程缓慢。

meaning: n. 工业，产业；勤劳
example: We are becoming one of the market leaders in the fashion industry.
translation: 我们正在成为时装业的领军者之一。

meaning: adj. 效率低的，无能的
example: Overall, barter is a very inefficient means of organizing transactions.
translation: 总之，易货贸易是一种效率很低的交易形式。

meaning: adj. 不可避免的，必然的
example: Most unions see privatisation as an inevitable prelude to job losses.
translation: 大多数工会认为私有化会不可避免地导致失业。

meaning: adj. 花费不多的，廉价的
example: Fish is inexpensive, easy to cook and very digestible.
translation: 鱼价格便宜，容易烹调，且味美可口。

meaning: n. 婴儿; adj. 婴儿的
example: The United States ranks 20th in its infant mortality rate.
translation: 美国在婴儿死亡率方面排名第20。

meaning: v. 传染；感染
example: He thought they might infect others with their bourgeois ideas.
translation: 他认为他们可以用他们的资产阶级思想去影响别人。

meaning: v. 推论，推断；猜想
example: People usually infer an unknown fact from a known fact.
translation: 人们通常从已知的事实中推断未知的事实.

meaning: adj. 下等的；劣等的
example: He preferred the company of those who were intellectually inferior to himself.
translation: 他喜欢与那些智力水平不如他的人共处。

meaning: adj. 无限的；无数的
example: The most amazing thing about nature is its infinite variety.
translation: 大自然最让人惊叹的是它的无限多样性。

meaning: n. 影响；势力; v. 影响
example: I fell under the influence of a history master.
translation: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

meaning: adj. 有影响的；有权势的
example: The West has gradually relaxed its hostile attitude to this influential state.
translation: 西方对这个颇具影响力的国家的敌视态度已逐渐缓和。

meaning: v. 通知，向…报告
example: Teachers inform me that Tracey's behaviour has improved no end.
translation: 老师们告诉我特雷西的行为大有改善。

meaning: n. 消息，信息；通知
example: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information.
translation: 房间很安静，无人主动提供更多的信息。

meaning: v. 居住于，栖息于
example: some of the rare species that inhabit the area
translation: 生活在这个地区的一些罕见物种

meaning: n. 居民，住户
example: Cairo has only thirteen square centimetres of green space for each inhabitant.
translation: 开罗居民的人均绿地面积仅13平方厘米。

meaning: v. 继承(传统等)
example: Princess Alexandra was to inherit the title of Duchess of Fife.
translation: 亚历山德拉公主将会继承法夫女公爵的爵位。

meaning: adj. 最初的；词首的
example: They learnt a lot from the initial market testing exercise.
translation: 他们从最初的市场测试中了解了许多信息。

meaning: n. 注射，注入；充满
example: Execution by lethal injection is scheduled for July 30th.
translation: 定于7月30日执行注射死刑。

meaning: v. 伤害，损害，损伤
example: I can say, with absolute truthfulness, that I did not injure her.
translation: 我可以绝对坦率地说，我没有伤害她。

meaning: n. 损害，伤害；受伤处
example: The victim suffered a dreadful injury and lost a lot of blood.
translation: 受害者受了重伤，大量失血。

meaning: n. 墨水，油墨
example: printing ink
translation: 印刷用油墨

meaning: n. 小旅店；小酒店
example: I always feel at home at Ye Olde Starre Inn.
translation: 在昨日星辰客栈，我总有种宾至如归的感觉。

meaning: adj. 内部的；内心的
example: It is a neighborhood beset by all the usual inner-city problems.
translation: 这是个为各种内城常见问题所困扰的社区。

meaning: adj. 清白的，幼稚的
example: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
translation: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

meaning: n. 输入；投入的资金
example: The Ministry of Agriculture commissioned a study into low-input farming.
translation: 农业部委托对低投入耕作进行研究。

meaning: v. 打听，询问；调查
example: Inspectors were appointed to inquire into the affairs of the company.
translation: 督查员受委派调查该公司的事务。

meaning: n. 询问，打听；调查
example: The government ordered an independent inquiry into the affair.
translation: 政府下令对该事件进行独立调查。

meaning: n. 昆虫，虫
example: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.
translation: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。

meaning: v. 插入；嵌入；登载
example: Insert coins into the slot and press for a ticket.
translation: 把硬币放进投币口，按钮取票。

meaning: prep. 在…里面; n. 内部
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: v. 坚持；坚持要求
example: They insist on tastier chocolate than the anaemic British stuff.
translation: 他们坚持要比淡而无味的英国货味道更好的巧克力。

meaning: v. 检查，审查；检阅
example: They have the right to come in and inspect the meter.
translation: 他们有权进来查表。

meaning: n. 检查，审查；检阅
example: After an inspection, the inspectors must publish a report.
translation: 在视察之后，视察者必须发表一份报告。

meaning: v. 鼓舞；给…以灵感
example: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
translation: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

meaning: v. 安装，设置
example: Another change that Sue made was to install central heating.
translation: 休所作的另一个改变是安装中央供暖系统。

meaning: n. 安装；装置；设施
example: Installation of the new system will take several days.
translation: 新系统的安装需要几天时间。

meaning: n. 例子，实例，事例
example: The rally was organised at the instance of two senior cabinet ministers.
translation: 集会是应两位资深内阁大臣的要求组织的。

meaning: n. 瞬间; adj. 立即的
example: In the same instant he flung open the car door.
translation: 与此同时，他猛地推开了车门。

meaning: adv. 立即，即刻
example: He instantly grasped that Stephen was talking about his wife.
translation: 他马上就明白斯蒂芬在说他的妻子。

meaning: adv. 代替，顶替；反而
example: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
translation: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

meaning: n. 本能；直觉；生性
example: His instinct would be to seek a new accommodation with the nationalists.
translation: 他本能的反应会是寻求与民族主义者取得新的和解。

meaning: n. 研究所；学院
example: The Institute of Export now fears that 100,000 jobs will go.
translation: 现在出口协会担心将失去10万个工作机会。

meaning: n. 协会；制度，习俗
example: Congress as an institution scores low in public opinion polls.
translation: 作为一个公共机构，国会在公众民意调查中得分很低。

meaning: v. 教；指示；通知
example: We should instruct the passengers what customs regulations are.
translation: 我们应该向乘客说明海关规则是什么.

meaning: n. 命令；教学；教训
example: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
translation: 这一方法给教学带来了活力，也使知识的吸收变得容易了。

meaning: n. 仪器；工具；乐器
example: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
translation: 一种叫做套管针的工具在腹壁上刺了一个孔。

meaning: adj. 不足的；不适当的
example: The judge finally concluded there was insufficient evidence of premeditation.
translation: 法官最终作出判定，没有足够证据证明那是有预谋的。

meaning: vt&n. 侮辱，凌辱
example: She spat the name out like an insult.
translation: 她像骂人似的说出了那个名字。

meaning: n. 保险；保险费
example: Police investigating a £10 million car insurance fiddle arrested 16 people yesterday.
translation: 调查涉及1,000万英镑的汽车保险诈骗案的警察昨天逮捕了16人。

meaning: v. 给…保险；确保
example: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
translation: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

meaning: n. 知识分子; adj. 智力的
example: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
translation: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

meaning: n. 智力；理解力；情报
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: adj. 聪明的；理智的
example: She was thin and spare, with a sharply intelligent face.
translation: 她又高又瘦，一副精明过人的模样。

meaning: vt. 想要，打算；意指
example: England intend fielding their strongest team in next month's World Youth Championship.
translation: 英格兰意欲在下月的世界青年锦标赛中推出他们的最强阵容。

meaning: adj. 强烈的；紧张的
example: I felt so self-conscious under Luke's mother's intense gaze.
translation: 在卢克母亲审视的目光下，我感到极不自在。

meaning: n. 强烈，剧烈；强度
example: The most visible sign of the intensity of the crisis is unemployment.
translation: 预示危机严重程度的一个最显著的迹象就是失业情况。

meaning: adj. 加强的；精耕细作的
example: She spent the night in intensive care after the operation.
translation: 手术后的那个夜晚她在重症监护病房度过。

meaning: n. 意图，意向，目的
example: The president said he had no intention of deploying ground troops.
translation: 总统称并不打算部署地面部队。

meaning: adj. 故意的，有意识的
example: Civil disobedience, violent or non-violent, is intentional law breaking.
translation: 公民抗命，不管是暴力还是非暴力的，都是故意犯法。

meaning: n. 相互作用；干扰
example: The following excerpt is illustrative of her interaction with students.
translation: 接下来的节选部分可以说明她与学生的互动情况。

meaning: n. 兴趣；利益；利息
example: We have the interest of 500,000 customers to think of.
translation: 我们得为50万名顾客的利益着想。

meaning: adj. 有趣的，引人入胜的
example: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
translation: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

meaning: v. 干涉，干预；妨碍
example: He knew when to leave well alone and when to interfere.
translation: 他知道什么时候该适可而止，什么时候该插手干预。

meaning: n. 干涉，干预；阻碍
example: The parliament described the decree as interference in the republic's internal affairs.
translation: 议会形容此法令为对共和国内政的干涉。

meaning: adj. 内的；内地的n内部
example: Interior decoration by careful coordination seems to have had its day.
translation: 精心搭配的室内装饰似乎已不再受欢迎了。

meaning: adj. 中间的；中级的
example: You should consider breaking the journey with intermediate stopovers at airport hotels.
translation: 你应该考虑将旅程分为几段，中途在机场旅馆稍作停留。

meaning: adj. 内的；国内的
example: It took internal whistle-blowing and investigative journalism to uncover the rot.
translation: 是内部检举和调查性报道揭露了这一腐败事实。

meaning: adj. 国际的，世界(性)的
example: International investors have become jittery about the country's economy.
translation: 国际投资者已对该国的经济状况感到紧张不安。

meaning: v. 解释，说明；口译
example: They could interpret it that way if they'd a mind to.
translation: 如果他们愿意的话，可以那样理解。

meaning: n. 解释；口译
example: The opposition Conservative Party put a different interpretation on the figures.
translation: 反对党保守党对这些数字提出一番不同的解释。

meaning: n. 译员，口译者
example: He was an official interpreter to the government of Nepal.
translation: 他曾是尼泊尔政府的官方译员。

meaning: v. 打断，打扰；中止
example: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. "Sorry to interrupt, Colonel."
translation: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下，上校。”

meaning: n. 中断，打断；障碍物
example: There was constant jeering and interruption from the floor.
translation: 议员席上不断有人在嘲讽和打岔.

meaning: n. 间隔；休息；间距
example: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years.
translation: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。

meaning: n. 接见；会见；面谈
example: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
translation: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

meaning: adj. 亲密的；个人的
example: Mr Black went for the jugular, asking intimate sexual questions.
translation: 布莱克先生直攻要害，问起了性方面的隐私问题。

meaning: prep. 进，入；进入到
example: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
translation: 我尽量言简意赅。

meaning: v. 介绍；引进，传入
example: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
translation: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

meaning: n. 介绍；引进；引言
example: Millions of words have been written about the introduction of the euro.
translation: 有关采用欧元的文章已经有很多。

meaning: v. 入侵，侵略；侵袭
example: The press invade people's privacy unfairly and unjustifiably every day.
translation: 新闻媒体每天都在不公正地且没有正当理由地侵犯人们的隐私。

meaning: n. 入侵，侵略；侵犯
example: When the invasion occurred he ruled as a puppet of the occupiers.
translation: 外敌入侵时，他作为占领者的傀儡行使统治。

meaning: v. 发明，创造；捏造
example: His father had helped invent a whole new way of doing business.
translation: 他父亲帮助创造了一套全新的生意经。

meaning: n. 发明，创造；捏造
example: The new invention ensures the beer keeps a full, frothy head.
translation: 这项新发明能保证啤酒始终保持丰富的泡沫。

meaning: n. 发明者；发明家
example: The royalties enabled the inventor to re-establish himself in business.
translation: 专利使用费让这位发明家得以再次立足于商界。

meaning: v. 投资；投入
example: They would have to offer cast-iron guarantees to invest in long-term projects.
translation: 他们需提供绝对可靠的担保，才能投资长期项目。

meaning: vt&vi. 调查
example: We were asked to investigate the alleged inconsistencies in his evidence.
translation: 我们被要求对他证词中的前后矛盾之处进行调查。

meaning: n. 调查，调查研究
example: The allegations are serious enough to warrant an investigation.
translation: 这些指控很严重，有必要进行一番调查。

meaning: n. 投资，投资额，投入
example: Investment could dry up and that could cause the economy to falter.
translation: 投资可能会中断，而这会引起经济衰退。

meaning: adj. 看不见的，无形的
example: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel.
translation: 一名办事员会感到如此受人忽视，令人觉得不可思议。

meaning: n. 邀请，招待；请柬
example: "I can't pass this up." She waved the invitation.
translation: “我不能错过这个机会，”她挥舞着请帖说。

meaning: v. 邀请，聘请；招待
example: "Let's invite her to dinner." — "Over my dead body!"
translation: “我们请她来吃晚饭吧。”——“除非我死了！”

meaning: v. 使卷入；牵涉
example: The £85m programme will involve an extensive rebranding of the airline.
translation: 这个8,500万英镑的项目将包括全面重塑该航空公司的形象。

meaning: adj. 里面的; adv. 向内
example: A model of good manners, he has conquered any inward fury.
translation: 作为一个非常懂礼貌的人，他已经学会了克制内心的任何愤怒情绪。

meaning: n. 铁；烙铁; v. 烫(衣)
example: The small churchyard was surrounded by a rusted wrought-iron fence.
translation: 不大的教堂墓地周边围着一圈生锈的熟铁栅栏。

meaning: adj. 不规则的；不整齐的
example: She was taken to hospital suffering from an irregular heartbeat.
translation: 她因心律不齐被送往医院。

meaning: n. 岛，岛屿
example: They were going to sail around the little island, against the tide.
translation: 他们打算绕着小岛逆潮航行。

meaning: v. 使隔离，使孤立
example: Political influence is being used to shape public opinion and isolate critics.
translation: 政治影响正被用来左右公众舆论，使批评家们陷于孤立。

meaning: n. 问题；发行; v. 发行
example: The key issue was whether the four defendants acted dishonestly.
translation: 关键问题是4名被告是否存在欺诈行为。

meaning: pron. 这，那，它
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: adj. 意大利的n意大利人
example: They ate in an Italian restaurant in Forth Street.
translation: 他们在第四大街的一家意大利餐馆吃了饭。

meaning: n. 条，条款；一条
example: The most valuable item on show will be a Picasso drawing.
translation: 展览会上最贵重的展品是毕加索的一幅素描。

meaning: pron. 它的
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: pron. 它自己；自身
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: n. 短上衣，茄克衫
example: Will you lend me your jacket for a little while?
translation: 你能把上衣借给我穿一会儿吗？

meaning: n. 监狱; v. 监禁
example: Last night he was being held in solitary confinement in Douglas jail.
translation: 昨晚他被单独监禁在道格拉斯的监狱里。

meaning: n. 果酱
example: They were in a real jam, Bob thought glumly.
translation: 他们确实遇上麻烦了，鲍勃闷闷不乐地想。

meaning: n. 一月
example: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd.
translation: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。

meaning: n. 日本，日本国
example: Prior to his Japan trip, he went to New York.
translation: 在去日本之前，他去了纽约。

meaning: adj. 日本的; n. 日本人
example: New Japanese cars averaged 13 km to the litre in 1981.
translation: 1981年，新型的日产汽车平均每升汽油能跑13千米。

meaning: n. 罐子，坛子，广口瓶
example: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
translation: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

meaning: n. 颌，颚
example: His jaw was broken after he was hit on the head.
translation: 他的头部受重击之后下颌骨折了。

meaning: n. 爵士音乐，爵士舞曲
example: Page is well versed in many styles of jazz.
translation: 佩奇精通多种风格的爵士乐。

meaning: adj. 妒忌的；猜疑的
example: I worked myself into frenzy plotting ways to make him jealous.
translation: 我绞尽脑汁，处心积虑，就是为了让他嫉妒。

meaning: n. 喷气式飞机；喷嘴
example: As he talked, an airforce jet screamed over the town.
translation: 他谈话时，一架军用喷气式飞机在镇子上空呼啸而过。

meaning: n. 宝石；宝石饰物
example: Alan, you're a jewel.
translation: 艾伦，你真是出类拔萃呀。

meaning: adj. 犹太人的
example: Tomorrow night at sundown, the Jewish holiday of Passover begins.
translation: 明天晚上太阳下山的时候，犹太人的逾越节便开始了。

meaning: n. 职业；工作；零活
example: He was hand-picked for this job by the Admiral.
translation: 他是由海军上将精心挑选出来担任这项工作的。

meaning: v. 参加；连接
example: I know you will join me in wishing them Godspeed.
translation: 我知道你会同我一起祝愿他们诸事顺遂的。

meaning: n. 接头，接缝；关节
example: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
translation: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

meaning: n. 笑话; v. 说笑话
example: His friends say he was always quick to tell a joke.
translation: 他的朋友们说，以前他讲笑话总是张嘴就来。

meaning: adj. 快活的；令人高兴的
example: It was jolly hard luck on him, wasn't it?
translation: 他可真倒霉，不是吗？

meaning: n. 日报，杂志；日志
example: A Wall Street Journal editorial encapsulated the views of many conservatives.
translation: 《华尔街日报》的一篇社论概述了很多保守派人士的观点。

meaning: n. 记者，新闻工作者
example: A journalist all his life, he's now brought out a book.
translation: 他当了一辈子新闻记者，如今已出了一本书。

meaning: n. 旅行，旅程; n. 旅行
example: The average commuter journey there is five hours long.
translation: 那里的通勤一族平均上下班要花5个小时。

meaning: n. 欢乐，喜悦；乐事
example: It was a joy to see. It really made my day.
translation: 这太有趣了，真的把我高兴坏了。

meaning: adj. 十分喜悦的，快乐的
example: A wedding is a joyful celebration of love.
translation: 婚礼就是快乐的爱情庆典。

meaning: n. 法官；裁判员
example: judge of
translation: 判断；评价

meaning: n. 意见；审判；判断
example: A tide of emotion rose and clouded his judgement.
translation: 心头涌起一阵强烈的感情，模糊了他的判断力。

meaning: n. (水果等)汁，液
example: Lemon and lime juice were both temporarily out of stock.
translation: 柠檬汁和酸橙汁暂时都缺货。

meaning: n. 七月
example: In July 1957, we were married in New York.
translation: 我们于1957年7月在纽约举行了婚礼。

meaning: v. 跳；暴涨; v. 跳过
example: His team-mates opened hotel windows, shouting "Jump!" and somewhat less printable banter.
translation: 他的队友打开了酒店的窗户，大叫着“跳！”，还开了一些上不了台面的玩笑。

meaning: n. 六月
example: June always rhymes with moon in old love songs.
translation: 在老情歌中June总是和moon成韵。

meaning: n. 丛林，密林，莽丛
example: "Orchards would take the place of the jungle," he rhapsodized.
translation: “要让这片丛林成为果园，”他无比兴奋地说。

meaning: adj. 年少的; n. 晚辈
example: She now lives with actor Denis Lawson, 10 years her junior.
translation: 她现在与比她小10岁的演员丹尼斯·劳森同居。

meaning: n. 陪审团；评奖团
example: The jury found that the NFL had violated antitrust laws.
translation: 陪审团裁决全国橄榄球联盟触犯了反垄断法。

meaning: adv. 刚才；只是；正好
example: If you're not satisfied with the life you're living, don't just complain. Do something about it.
translation: 对于现况的不满，不能只是抱怨，要有作出改变。

meaning: n. 正义，公正；司法
example: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

meaning: vt. 证明…是正当的
example: Domestic conditions did not justify a loosening of monetary policy.
translation: 国内的情况并不足以成为放松货币政策的正当理由。

meaning: adj. 热心的；激烈的
example: He's been a keen supporter of the Labour Party all his life.
translation: 他一生都是工党的热情拥护者。

meaning: v. 保持；坚持
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. 看护人；饲养员
example: I drove out of the gates, past the keeper's lodge.
translation: 我驶出大门，经过守门人的小屋。

meaning: n. 水壶，水锅
example: I filled the kettle while she was talking and plugged it in.
translation: 她说话间，我把水壶灌满并插上了电源。

meaning: n. 钥匙；键；答案
example: The key issue was whether the four defendants acted dishonestly.
translation: 关键问题是4名被告是否存在欺诈行为。

meaning: n. 键盘
example: To close your document, press CTRL+W on your keyboard.
translation: 关闭文件时要同时按键盘上的CTRL键和W键。

meaning: vi&vt&n. 踢
example: Dave pulled a back muscle and could barely kick the ball.
translation: 戴夫背部拉伤，几乎没法踢球。

meaning: n. 小孩，儿童，少年
example: He told us to get stuffed so we leaned on his kid.
translation: 他叫我们滚蛋，于是我们威胁他的孩子。

meaning: v. 杀死；扼杀；消磨
example: Don't try and double-cross me, Taylor, because I'll kill you.
translation: 别跟我耍花招，泰勒，要不我会杀了你。

meaning: n. 千克，公斤
example: Apple costs five dollars a kilogram.
translation: 苹果每千克5美元.

meaning: n. 千米，公里
example: Moreau took gold in the five-kilometre individual pursuit competition.
translation: 莫罗在个人五公里追逐赛中获得金牌。

meaning: n. 种类
example: There is good news of a kind for the Prime Minister.
translation: 对总理来说也算是有个好消息。

meaning: n. 仁慈，好意
example: Build her up with kindness and a sympathetic ear.
translation: 用友善和富有同情心的倾听来重拾她的信心。

meaning: n. 国王，君主
example: The King made major concessions to end the confrontation with his people.
translation: 为了结束与其臣民的冲突，国王作出了很大的让步。

meaning: n. 王国；领域，界
example: It was infamous as a kingdom of brigands, scoundrels, and slave-traders.
translation: 该地区因土匪、无赖和奴隶贩子猖獗而声名狼藉。

meaning: v. 吻; v. 接吻; n. 吻
example: She planted a kiss on each of his leathery cheeks.
translation: 她在他粗糙的面颊上左右各吻了一下。

meaning: n. 厨房，灶间
example: The study links the main living area to the kitchen.
translation: 书房把主要的生活区与厨房连在一起。

meaning: n. 风筝
example: Kite is undoubtedly a class player.
translation: 凯特绝对是个一流选手。

meaning: n. 膝，膝盖，膝关节
example: A stiff knee following surgery forced her to walk with a limp.
translation: 手术后她的膝盖活动不便，走路时被迫跛行。

meaning: v. 跪，跪下，跪着
example: The workers kneel on the ground and hammer the small stones in.
translation: 工人们跪在地上，将小石子锤进去。

meaning: n. 小刀，刀，餐刀
example: She produced the knife during arguments with her friends.
translation: 在和朋友争吵的时候，她掏出了刀。

meaning: v. 把…编结; v. 编织
example: During the war, Joan helped her mother knit scarves for soldiers.
translation: 战争期间，琼帮妈妈给战士们织围巾。

meaning: n. 门把，拉手；旋纽
example: Top the steaming hot potatoes with a knob of butter.
translation: 在冒热气的马铃薯上放一小块黄油。

meaning: vi&vt&n. 敲，击，打
example: Find Bernie and get him to knock an agreement together.
translation: 找到伯尼，让他尽快拟好一份协议。

meaning: n. (绳的)结，(树的)节
example: She wore a checked shirt tied in a knot above the navel.
translation: 她身穿一件格子衬衫，衣角在肚脐上方打了个结。

meaning: v. 知道；认识；通晓
example: I know it's nothing serious and I feel quite unemotional about it.
translation: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

meaning: n. 知识，学识；知道
example: Father had no more than a superficial knowledge of music.
translation: 父亲对音乐只懂一点皮毛。

meaning: n. 实验室，研究室
example: "He went back to the lab", Iris exclaimed impatiently.
translation: “他回实验室去了，”艾里斯不耐烦地大声说。

meaning: n. 标签；标记，符号
example: "Eat before Jul 14" was stamped on the label.
translation: 标签上印着“请于7月14日前食用”。

meaning: n. 实验室，研究室
example: This was demonstrated in a laboratory experiment with rats.
translation: 在实验室用老鼠进行的实验证明了这一点。

meaning: n. 劳动；工作；劳工
example: It was the uncommitted that Labour needed to reach.
translation: 工党需要拉拢的是未表态者。

meaning: n. 鞋带，系带；花边
example: I am wearing a plaid nightgown trimmed with white lace.
translation: 我穿着一件带有白色蕾丝花边的格子呢睡衣。

meaning: vi&vi&n. 缺乏，不足
example: Lack of exercise can lead to feelings of depression and exhaustion.
translation: 缺乏锻炼会导致抑郁和疲劳。

meaning: n. 梯子，梯状物
example: Her whole body began to buckle, unbalancing the ladder.
translation: 她整个身体开始弯曲，搞得梯子倾侧起来。

meaning: n. 女士，夫人；贵妇人
example: Listen here, young lady. Don't you call me that!
translation: 你给我听着，小姐。别那样叫我！

meaning: v. 走得慢; n. 落后
example: There's a time lag between infection with HIV and developing AIDS.
translation: 从感染艾滋病病毒到病发有一段滞后期。

meaning: n. 湖
example: west lake
translation: 杭州西湖

meaning: n. 羔羊，小羊；羔羊肉
example: Allow an extra 10-15 min if you prefer lamb well done.
translation: 如果想让羊羔肉完全熟透还需要再煮10到15分钟。

meaning: adj. 跛的；瘸的，残废的
example: He mumbled some lame excuse about having gone to sleep.
translation: 他含含糊糊地找了个蹩脚的借口，想要解释自己为什么睡着了。

meaning: n. 灯
example: I used my thumbnail to tighten the screw on my lamp.
translation: 我用拇指指甲把台灯上的螺钉拧紧了。

meaning: n. 陆地；土地; v. 上岸
example: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
translation: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

meaning: n. 上岸，登陆，着陆
example: The plane had been cleared for landing at Brunswick's Glynco Airport.
translation: 飞机获准降落于不伦瑞克的格林科机场。

meaning: n. 女房东；女地主
example: The landlady sighed contentedly.
translation: 房东太太心满意足地叹了口气。

meaning: n. 地主；房东，店主
example: The landlord refused to serve him because he considered him too drunk.
translation: 酒吧老板觉得他已经喝多了，拒绝再给他添酒。

meaning: n. (乡间)小路；跑道
example: The lorry was travelling at 20mph in the slow lane.
translation: 卡车在慢车道上以20英里的时速行驶。

meaning: n. 语言，语言课程
example: The Ukrainians speak a Slavonic language similar to Russian.
translation: 乌克兰人所说的那种斯拉夫语系的语言类似于俄语。

meaning: n. 提灯，灯笼
example: I've been thinking I'd better have asked for a lantern.
translation: 我一直认为我还不如要一个灯笼呢.

meaning: n. 膝部；一圈
example: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
translation: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

meaning: adj. 大的；巨大的
example: These large institutions make — and change—the rules to suit themselves.
translation: 这些大机构总是随意制定规定，而且说变就变。

meaning: adv. 大部分；大量地
example: It is a part of Britain as yet largely unaccustomed to tourists.
translation: 英国的这一块地方还很不为游客所熟悉。

meaning: n. 激光
example: He made contact with someone with an idea for reconditioning laser copiers.
translation: 他联系了一个会修理激光复印机的人。

meaning: adj. 最后的; adv. 最后
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: adj. 迟的; adv. 迟，晚
example: He defected from the party in the late 1970s.
translation: 他在20世纪70年代后期叛出了该党。

meaning: adv. 最近，不久前
example: Lately, the president has been sacking and picking new ministers at whim.
translation: 最近，总统一时兴起频频解雇旧部长，选任新部长。

meaning: adv. 后来；过一会儿
example: At a later news conference, he said differences should not be dramatized.
translation: 在后来的新闻发布会上，他说不应夸大分歧。

meaning: adj. 拉丁的; n. 拉丁语
example: Carol is a tall, dark, Latin type of woman.
translation: 卡萝尔身材高大，黑发棕肤，是个有着拉丁风情的女子。

meaning: adj. (两者中)后者的
example: He holds the belief that he is a latter-day prophet.
translation: 他深信自己是当代先知。

meaning: v. 笑，发笑; n. 笑
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: n. 笑，笑声
example: Behind the mocking laughter lurks a growing sense of unease.
translation: 嘲笑声的背后潜伏着一种越来越强烈的不安。

meaning: v. 发射，投射；发动
example: A series of technical foul-ups delayed the launch of the new product.
translation: 一系列技术问题延误了新产品的上市。

meaning: n. 洗衣房，洗衣店
example: She could ring for food and drink, laundry and sundry services.
translation: 她可以打电话点餐，叫人来取要洗的衣服以及叫其他各种服务。

meaning: n. 盥洗室，厕所
example: There's a bathroom and a lavatory upstairs.
translation: 楼上有浴室和卫生间。

meaning: n. 法律，法令；法则
example: by law
translation: n. 根据法律，在法律上；附则

meaning: n. 草地，草坪，草场
example: The windows overlooked a lawn of tall waving grass.
translation: 窗户外边是一块草地，高高的草随风摇摆。

meaning: n. 律师；法学家
example: "He was a lawyer before that," Mary Ann put in.
translation: “在那之前他是个律师，”玛丽·安补充道。

meaning: v. 置放；铺设；设置
example: On Sunday Cohen lay around the house all day.
translation: 科恩星期天一整天都在家无所事事。

meaning: n. 层，层次；铺设者
example: Sensitive Cream will not strip away the skin's protective layer.
translation: 敏感肌肤专用面霜不会破坏皮肤表面的保护层。

meaning: n. 布局，安排，设计
example: This boat has a good deck layout making everything easy to operate.
translation: 这艘船的甲板布局合理，使得所有操控都很方便。

meaning: adj. 懒惰的，懒散的
example: Lazy and incompetent police officers are letting the public down.
translation: 懒惰兼无能的警官令公众失望。

meaning: n. 铅，铅制品
example: Politicians say it could lead to a dissolution of parliament.
translation: 政客们说这可能会导致议会解散。

meaning: n. 领袖，领导人；首领
example: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
translation: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

meaning: n. 领导
example: Yet it is feared the Republican leadership could split over the agreement.
translation: 但有人担心，共和党的领导层可能会在该协议上出现意见分歧。

meaning: adj. 指导的；最主要的
example: The Democratic candidate is still leading in the polls.
translation: 民主党候选人的得票数依然领先。

meaning: n. 叶，叶子
example: I was shaking all over, trembling like a leaf.
translation: 我像风中的落叶一样浑身发抖。

meaning: n. 同盟，联盟；联合会
example: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

meaning: v. 漏；泄露; n. 漏洞
example: The yacht has sprung a leak in the hull.
translation: 帆船的船体上出现了一条裂缝。

meaning: v. 倾斜，屈身；靠
example: She was feeling tired and was glad to lean against him.
translation: 她正感到有些疲倦，因此很高兴可以靠在他身上。

meaning: v. 跳，跃; n. 跳跃
example: Warwicks leap to third in the table, 31 points behind leaders Essex.
translation: 沃里克队在排名中蹿升至第3名，落后领先的埃塞克斯队31分。

meaning: vi&vt. 学，学习
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 有学问的；学术上的
example: She's kicked her drug habit and learned that her life has value.
translation: 她已经戒了毒，并且认识到了生命可贵。

meaning: n. 学习；学问，知识
example: He's still learning and when he hits his stride, he'll be unstoppable.
translation: 他仍旧处在学习阶段，一旦驾轻就熟后将势不可挡。

meaning: adj. 最少的; adv. 最少
example: Try to eat at least four slices of bread a day.
translation: 每天尽量至少吃4片面包。

meaning: n. 皮革；皮革制品
example: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger.
translation: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。

meaning: v. 离去; v. 离开
example: It got to the point where he had to leave.
translation: 到了他不得不走的地步。

meaning: n&vi. 演讲，讲课
example: Chuck would lecture me, telling me to get a haircut.
translation: 查克就会数落我，让我去理一下发。

meaning: adj. 左边的; adv. 在左边
example: As I sidestepped, the bottle hit me on the left hip.
translation: 我侧一步要躲闪的时候，瓶子打中了我的左髋部。

meaning: n. 腿，腿部
example: He had to have one leg amputated above the knee.
translation: 他的一条腿不得不从膝部以上截断。

meaning: adj. 法律的；合法的
example: But legal experts are not sure if such a charge can stick.
translation: 但法律专家们不能肯定这一指控是否成立。

meaning: n. 传说，传奇
example: His pitching was a legend among major league hitters.
translation: 他的投球在大联盟的击球员中是个传奇。

meaning: n. 空闲时间；悠闲
example: The leisure facilities are there for the use of guests.
translation: 这些休闲设施是供客人使用的。

meaning: n. 柠檬，柠檬树
example: Lemon and lime juice were both temporarily out of stock.
translation: 柠檬汁和酸橙汁暂时都缺货。

meaning: v. 把…借给，贷(款)
example: Will you lend me your jacket for a little while?
translation: 你能把上衣借给我穿一会儿吗？

meaning: n. 长，长度；一段
example: Strangely enough, you will automatically wake up after this length of time.
translation: 奇怪的是，过了这样一段时间你就会自己醒来。

meaning: n. 透镜，镜片；镜头
example: Why aren't all lenses supplied with a lens hood?
translation: 为什么不给所有的镜头都配上遮光罩呢？

meaning: adj. 更少的; adv. 更少地
example: These files have been zipped up to take up less disk space.
translation: 这些文档已经进行了压缩，以节省磁盘空间。

meaning: v. 减少，减轻；缩小
example: Toolbelts free both hands and lessen the risk of dropping hammers.
translation: 工具腰带解放了双手，还减少了锤子掉落的风险。

meaning: n. 功课，课；课程
example: He learned this lesson the hard way from his own personal experience.
translation: 吃一堑长一智，他这个教训来之不易——是从他自己的亲身经历中得来的。

meaning: conj. 惟恐，以免
example: He gripped his brother's arm lest he be trampled by the mob.
translation: 他紧抓着他兄弟的胳膊，怕他让暴民踩着。

meaning: v. 允许，让；使
example: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
translation: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

meaning: n. 信；证书；字母
example: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
translation: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

meaning: n. 水平面; adj. 水平的
example: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
translation: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

meaning: n. 杆，杠杆；控制杆
example: An elevator mechanic can work the machinery directly by turning this lever.
translation: 电梯修理工可以转动这根杠杆直接操作机器。

meaning: adj. 易于…的；可能的
example: Offenders will be liable to a seven-year prison term.
translation: 违犯者可判处7年监禁。

meaning: n. 说谎的人
example: He was a congenital liar and usually in debt.
translation: 他生性爱说谎，而且通常债务缠身。

meaning: adj. 心胸宽大的；慷慨的
example: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
translation: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

meaning: v. 解放；释放
example: They did their best to liberate slaves.
translation: 他们尽最大能力去解放奴隶.

meaning: n. 解放
example: Dawkins ends his discussion with a call for liberation.
translation: 道金斯以呼吁解放结束了他的论述。

meaning: n. 自由；释放；许可
example: He firmly believes liberty is inseparable from social justice.
translation: 他坚信自由与社会正义是不可分的。

meaning: n. 图书馆馆长
example: The old librarian illuminated some old books and manuscripts.
translation: 这个老图书馆员把一些古书和旧抄稿加上各种装饰.

meaning: n. 图书馆；藏书
example: Other amenities, less commonly available, include a library and exercise room.
translation: 还有一些不太常有的设施，包括图书馆和健身房。

meaning: n. 许可；执照; v. 准许
example: The government revoked her husband's license to operate migrant labor crews.
translation: 政府撤销了她丈夫管理外来打工人群的许可证。

meaning: v. 舔；舔吃
example: You'll have four months in which to lick the recruits into shape.
translation: 你将有4个月的时间把这些新兵训练出来。

meaning: n. 盖子，盖，囊盖
example: As we drew near, I saw that the boot lid was up.
translation: 我们靠近时,我看见汽车行李箱的盖子翘了起来.

meaning: v. 躺，平放；位于
example: The blame for the Charleston fiasco did not lie with him.
translation: 查尔斯顿惨败错不在他。

meaning: n. 陆军中尉；副职官员
example: I'm a novice at these things, Lieutenant. You're the professional.
translation: 中尉，做这些事情我是新手，你是行家。

meaning: n. 生命；一生；寿命
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 一生，终身
example: I want to take advantage of your lifetime of scholarship.
translation: 我希望能够用到您一生的学识。

meaning: v. 提起，提高; n. 电梯
example: I gave her a lift back out to her house.
translation: 我让她搭我的便车回家。

meaning: adj. 轻的，少量的
example: The light went out, and the room was plunged into darkness.
translation: 灯熄了，屋里陷入一片漆黑。

meaning: v. 照亮，使明亮
example: He managed to lighten the generally lifeless debate at times.
translation: 他让这场总体很沉闷的辩论时不时迸出了些火花。

meaning: adv. 轻轻地，轻松地
example: Put the onions in the pan and cook until lightly browned.
translation: 将洋葱放入平底锅内，炒至略呈棕色。

meaning: n. 闪电，闪电放电
example: It was unbelievably dramatic as lightning crackled all round the van.
translation: 闪电在货车周围炸开时，情景异常壮观。

meaning: v. 喜欢；喜爱；希望
example: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
translation: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

meaning: adj. 可能的; adv. 很可能
example: Very likely he'd told them he had American business interests.
translation: 很可能他已经告诉他们自己拥有美国商业利益.

meaning: adv. 同样地；也，又
example: These requests are ignored. His requests for rent are likewise sometimes ignored.
translation: 这些要求被置之不理。他关于支付租金的要求有时也同样未被理睬。

meaning: n. 肢，臂，翼；树枝
example: Try to rest the injured limb as much as possible.
translation: 尽量不要活动受伤的手臂。

meaning: n. 石灰
example: Lemon and lime juice were both temporarily out of stock.
translation: 柠檬汁和酸橙汁暂时都缺货。

meaning: n. 限度；限制；范围
example: In some cases there is a mini-mum age limit.
translation: 有些情况下有最低年龄限制。

meaning: n. 限制；限度，局限
example: This drug has one important limitation. Its effects only last six hours.
translation: 这种药有一个严重缺陷：它的药力只能持续6个小时。

meaning: adj. 有限的
example: So far we have had ringing declarations, but only limited action.
translation: 目前，我们已经发表了一些有力的声明，但只采取了有限的行动。

meaning: n. 线；排；路线；线条
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: n. 亚麻布；亚麻织物
example: We're a bit low on bed linen. You'll have to make do.
translation: 我们的床单有些次，您将就着用吧。

meaning: n. 班船，班机
example: It became impractical to make a business trip by ocean liner.
translation: 乘坐远洋班轮进行商务旅行变得不合时宜了。

meaning: v. 有环连接; n. 环
example: He suggested a link between class size and test results of seven-year-olds.
translation: 他认为7岁大的学生的测试分数和班级的规模有关系。

meaning: n. 狮子；勇猛的人
example: A man-eating lion is on the loose somewhere in England.
translation: 英格兰有一头吃人的狮子跑出来了。

meaning: n. 嘴唇
example: She had quite severe bruising and a cut lip.
translation: 她身上有严重的淤伤，嘴唇也破了。

meaning: n. 液体; adj. 液体的
example: We found a cyst and I suctioned off the liquid within.
translation: 我们发现了一个囊肿，我把其中的液体吸了出来。

meaning: n. 酒；溶液，液剂
example: The federal government hiked the tax on hard liquor.
translation: 联邦政府提高了烈性酒的税率。

meaning: n. 表，目录; n. 列举
example: A list of items is repeatedly flashed up on the screen.
translation: 一个选项列表反复出现在屏幕上。

meaning: v. 听，留神听；听从
example: When I asked him to stop, he would not listen.
translation: 我叫他停下，可他不听。

meaning: n. 听者，听众之一
example: They raised $630,000 through listener donations, and then called it quits.
translation: 他们通过听众捐款的方式筹集了63万美元后宣告结束。

meaning: n. 升(容量单位)
example: Add 20 mg. of diatomaceous earth filter aid per liter of solution.
translation: 对每升溶液加入20毫克硅藻土助滤剂.

meaning: adj. 文学(上)的
example: Her literary criticism focuses on the way great literature suggests ideas.
translation: 她的文学批评集中关注的是伟大的文学作品表达思想的方式。

meaning: n. 文学；文献
example: He was well acquainted with the literature of France, Germany and Holland.
translation: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

meaning: adj. 小的；少；幼小的
example: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
translation: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

meaning: v. 居住；活; adj. 活的
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: adj. 活泼的；逼真的
example: Their 4-1 win in Honduras was a particularly lively affair.
translation: 他们在洪都拉斯以4比1获胜的那场比赛尤其激动人心。

meaning: n. 肝；肝脏
example: Liver and kidney are particularly rich in vitamin A.
translation: 肝脏和肾脏的维生素A含量尤其丰富。

meaning: adj. 活的; n. 生活，生计
example: If you're not satisfied with the life you're living, don't just complain. Do something about it.
translation: 对于现况的不满，不能只是抱怨，要有作出改变。

meaning: v. 装；装满; n. 负载
example: His people came up with a load of embarrassing information.
translation: 他的部下亮出一大堆令人尴尬的资料来。

meaning: n. 一条面包，一个面包
example: The proposal could put 3p on a loaf of bread.
translation: 这项提议会使每个面包的成本增加3便士。

meaning: n. 贷款；暂借; vt. 借出
example: Now is the time to touch him for a loan.
translation: 现在是向他借笔钱的时候了。

meaning: adj. 地方的；局部的
example: There has been a busy start to polling in today's local elections.
translation: 今天地方选举的投票一开始就人头攒动。

meaning: v. 探明，找出，查出
example: Try to locate exactly where the smells are entering the room.
translation: 找找看气味具体是从什么地方散入房间的。

meaning: n. 位置，场所
example: The first duty of a director is to recce his location.
translation: 主管的第一项任务是熟悉所在地区的情况。

meaning: n. 锁; v. 锁上，锁住
example: She shrugged a stray lock of hair out of her eyes.
translation: 她把一缕散发从眼前甩开。

meaning: n. 火车头，机车
example: The Locomotive Construction Company Ltd is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Trust.
translation: 机车建筑有限公司是该托拉斯的全资子公司。

meaning: v. 暂住，借宿，投宿
example: Authorities requisitioned hotel rooms to lodge more than 3,000 stranded Christmas vacationers.
translation: 当局征用旅馆房间安顿了3,000多名无处落脚的圣诞度假者。

meaning: n. 原木，木料
example: In the evening a log fire would provide cosiness.
translation: 晚上点起篝火会让人感到温暖舒适。

meaning: n. 逻辑，推理；逻辑性
example: By now all logic had gone out of the window.
translation: 到这时根本就不讲什么逻辑了。

meaning: adj. 逻辑的；符合逻辑的
example: The indisputable fact is that computers carry out logical operations.
translation: 不容置疑的事实是，电脑执行逻辑操作指令。

meaning: adj. 孤独的；荒凉的
example: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
translation: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

meaning: v. 渴望，极想念
example: The road to peace will be long and drawn-out.
translation: 通往和平的道路将很漫长。

meaning: v. 看，显得; n. 看
example: It was just then that I chanced to look round.
translation: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。

meaning: n. 圈，环，环孔
example: I think that the vice president was in the loop.
translation: 我认为副总统是局内人。

meaning: adj. 松的；宽松的
example: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
translation: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

meaning: v. 解开；使松驰
example: Relax, smile; loosen up in mind and body and behaviour.
translation: 放松，微笑。精神、身体和行为上都要放轻松。

meaning: n. 贵族；上帝
example: "Good lord, that's what he is: he's a policeman."
translation: “我的天哪，他原来是警察呀。”

meaning: n. 运货汽车，卡车
example: He looked straight ahead and overtook a lumbering lorry.
translation: 他眼睛直视前方，加速超过了前面一辆慢吞吞行进的大卡车。

meaning: v. 失去；迷失；输掉
example: Some battles you win, some battles you lose.
translation: 胜败乃兵家常事。

meaning: n. 遗失；损失；失败
example: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
translation: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

meaning: n. 许多，大量；签，阄
example: I got quite a lot of ribbing from my team-mates.
translation: 队友们经常开我的玩笑。

meaning: adj. 响亮的；吵闹的
example: There was a loud thump as the horse crashed into the van.
translation: 马撞在货车上发出砰的一声巨响。

meaning: n. 扬声器，喇叭
example: I distinctly heard the loudspeaker calling passengers for the Turin-Amsterdam flight.
translation: 我清楚地听到扩音器里在请都灵至阿姆斯特丹航班的旅客登机。

meaning: v. 爱，喜欢; n. 爱
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: adj. 可爱的；令人愉快的
example: Sweden is lovely in summer— cold beyond belief in winter.
translation: 瑞典的夏天非常宜人——冬天却冷得让人难以置信。

meaning: n. 爱好者；情人；情侣
example: She was dumped by her long-term lover after five years.
translation: 5年后她被相恋多年的恋人抛弃了。

meaning: adj. 低的，矮的；低下的
example: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
translation: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

meaning: adj. 较低的; v. 放下
example: I felt a sharp pain in my lower back.
translation: 我感觉到后腰一阵剧痛。

meaning: adj. 忠诚的，忠心的
example: I thanked them for their long and loyal service.
translation: 我感谢他们长期以来忠诚的效力。

meaning: n. 忠诚，忠心
example: Loyalty and support became the bywords of the day.
translation: 忠诚和支持成了那个时代人们时常挂在嘴边的词儿。

meaning: n. 运气；好运，幸运
example: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
translation: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

meaning: adj. 幸运的；吉祥的
example: Chantal was lucky to be able to salvage her career.
translation: 尚塔尔能保住她的事业算是走了运。

meaning: n. 行李；皮箱，皮包
example: He waited until all the luggage was cleared, but Paula's never appeared.
translation: 他一直等到所有的行李都拿走了，但始终没看见葆拉的。

meaning: n. 木材；木料；制材
example: It was made of soft lumber, spruce by the look of it.
translation: 其制作材料是软木，看起来像是云杉。

meaning: n. 团，块；肿块
example: They used to buy ten kilos of beef in one lump.
translation: 他们过去常买10公斤重的整块牛肉。

meaning: n. 午餐，(美)便餐
example: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
translation: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

meaning: n. 肺脏，肺
example: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
translation: 吸烟导致每年有1万人死于慢性肺病。

meaning: n. 奢侈，奢华；奢侈品
example: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
translation: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

meaning: n. 机器；机械
example: Planes dropped bombs and raked the beach with machine gun fire.
translation: 飞机投下炸弹，并用机关枪扫射海滩。

meaning: adj. 发疯的；恼火的
example: There are certain things he does that drive me mad.
translation: 他的某些举动让我很生气。

meaning: n. 夫人，女士，太太
example: Sue is a thoroughly precocious little madam if ever there was one.
translation: 休确实是个少见的早熟的小丫头。

meaning: n. 杂志，期刊
example: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
translation: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

meaning: n. 魔法，巫术；戏法
example: It infected them with some of the magic of a lost age.
translation: 逝去的岁月让他们平添了几分魅力。

meaning: n. 磁铁，磁石，磁体
example: Open wounds act like a magnet to flies.
translation: 裸露的伤口很招苍蝇。

meaning: adj. 磁的，有吸引力的
example: The secondary current sets up a magnetic field inside the tube.
translation: 二次电流在管子内部会产生磁场。

meaning: n. 壮丽的；华丽的
example: At 54 years old her energy and looks are magnificent.
translation: 她54岁了，精力和气色都非常好。

meaning: n. 女佣，女仆；少女
example: The maid looked at him, a nervous smile on her face.
translation: 女服务员看着他，脸上带着一丝局促不安的微笑。

meaning: n. 邮件; v. 邮寄
example: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
translation: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

meaning: adj. 主要的，最重要的
example: The study links the main living area to the kitchen.
translation: 书房把主要的生活区与厨房连在一起。

meaning: n. 大陆
example: The island may be reached by boat from the mainland.
translation: 这个岛屿可以从大陆乘小船到达。

meaning: adv. 主要地，大体上
example: Thousands of people, mainly Zulus, assembled in a stadium in Thokoza.
translation: 数以千计的人，主要是祖鲁族人，聚集在托考查的一个体育场里。

meaning: v. 维持；赡养；维修
example: In New Zealand, the Maori people maintain a strong cultural tradition.
translation: 在新西兰，毛利人保持着深厚的文化传统。

meaning: n. 维持，保持；维修
example: In the future the machines will need spare parts and maintenance.
translation: 这些机器将来会需要备件和维修保养。

meaning: adj. 较大的; n. 专业
example: The seven major industrial countries will have their yearly meeting in London.
translation: 7个主要工业国家将在伦敦举行一年一度的会议。

meaning: n. 多数，大多数
example: Independent candidates won the majority of seats on the local council.
translation: 无党派候选人在地方议会选举中赢得了多数席位。

meaning: v. 使；做，制造
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: adj. 男的，雄的; n. 男子
example: The army is still one of the last male bastions.
translation: 军队仍然是男人占据的最后堡垒之一。

meaning: n. 男人；人；人类
example: She ran away with a man called McTavish last year.
translation: 去年，她和一个叫麦克塔维什的男人私奔了。

meaning: v. 管理；设法；对付
example: We'll manage somehow, you and me. I know we will.
translation: 我和你，我们总能应付过去的。我知道我们会的。

meaning: n. 管理；经营，处理
example: The governors were joined by Mr Hunter and his management team.
translation: 亨特先生及他率领的管理小组加入了州长们的队伍。

meaning: n. 经理，管理人
example: I want the manager'sjob when he calls it a day.
translation: 等到经理不干了之后，我想接替他的位子。

meaning: n. 人类
example: Mankind's knowledge of the universe has increased beyond measure.
translation: 人类对于宇宙的了解已经大为增加。

meaning: adj. 男子气概的，果断的
example: He set himself manly tasks and expected others to follow his example.
translation: 他给自己定下了男子汉的任务，并希望别人效之。

meaning: n. 方式；态度；礼貌
example: There was much curiosity about what manner of man he was.
translation: 他究竟是什么样的人，大家都十分好奇。

meaning: adj. 体力的; n. 手册
example: Too often he only absorbs half the information in the manual.
translation: 他对于说明书上所说的经常是一知半解。

meaning: v. 制造; n. 制造；产品
example: They manufacture the class of plastics known as thermoplastic materials.
translation: 他们生产这类被称为热塑材料的塑料制品。

meaning: n. 制造商；制造厂
example: A manufacturer negligently made and marketed a car with defective brakes.
translation: 某厂家由于疏忽，制造并销售了一款刹车系统存在缺陷的汽车。

meaning: adj. 许多的; pron. 许多人
example: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: n. 地图；图；天体图
example: We drove east to Rostock, where my map led me astray.
translation: 我们驱车向东去罗斯托克，但地图却给我指错了方向。

meaning: n. 大理石
example: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.
translation: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。

meaning: n. 三月
example: The unevenly matched armies met at Guilford on 15 March 1781.
translation: 1781年3月15日，力量悬殊的两支队伍在吉尔福德狭路相逢。

meaning: n. 页边的空白；边缘
example: The group had a net profit margin of 30% last year.
translation: 去年，这个集团的纯利润率为30%。

meaning: adj. 海的；海上的
example: The phosphate was deposited by the decay of marine microorganisms.
translation: 海洋微生物腐烂后沉积形成磷酸盐。

meaning: n. 斑点；记号; v. 标明
example: Mark had for some time been making advances towards her.
translation: 马克追她已经有一段时间了。

meaning: n. 市场；集市；销路
example: Like a good businessman, Stewart identified a gap in the market.
translation: 像精明的商人一样，斯图尔特发现了市场上的一个空白。

meaning: n. 结婚，婚姻；婚礼
example: After a three-weekend courtship, Pamela accepted Randolph's proposal of marriage.
translation: 经过3个周末的追求之后，帕梅拉接受了伦道夫的求婚。

meaning: adj. 已婚的；婚姻的
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: v. 娶，嫁; v. 结婚
example: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
translation: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

meaning: adj. 奇迹般的；了不起的
n. 马克思主义
example: Marxism possesses the theoretical character of keeping pace with the times.
translation: 马克思主义具有与时俱进的理论品格.

meaning: adj. 马克思主义的
example: He applies the Marxist world view dogmatically to all social phenomena.
translation: 他将马克思主义的世界观教条地应用到所有的社会现象中去。

meaning: n. 面具；伪装; v. 掩饰
example: But as with other charitable bodies, these figures mask the true picture.
translation: 但和其他慈善机构一样，这些数字掩盖了实情。

meaning: n. 众多；团；群众
example: On his desk is a mass of books and papers.
translation: 他的书桌上有大堆的书籍和文件。

meaning: n. 主人；能手；硕士
example: I fell under the influence of a history master.
translation: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

meaning: n. 杰作，名著
example: The whole thing was a masterpiece of crowd management.
translation: 整件事情就是人群管理的典范。

meaning: n. 席子；草席；垫子
example: She touched the thick mat of sandy hair on his chest.
translation: 她摸着他那浓密的淡棕色胸毛。

meaning: n. 比赛，竞赛；对手
example: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
translation: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

meaning: n. 伙伴，同事；配偶
example: "How are you, mate?" — "Not bad, mate, how's yourself?"
translation: “最近怎么样，老兄？”——“还不错，你呢？”

meaning: n. 材料；素材a物质的
example: The material consisted only of already published, unclassified information.
translation: 这份材料里只有一些已公开的、非保密性质的信息。

meaning: n. 唯物主义
example: It taught only materialism, the gospel of mammon.
translation: 它只是宣扬金钱至上的物欲主义。

meaning: adj. 数学的，数学上的
example: With mathematical problems, you can save time by approximating.
translation: 对于数学题，可以用取近似值的办法节约时间。

meaning: n. 数学
example: The degree provides a thorough grounding in both mathematics and statistics.
translation: 该学位课程将为数学和统计学打下扎实的基础。

meaning: n. (英)数学
example: The papers in maths and English are very testing.
translation: 数学试卷和英语试卷很难。

meaning: n. 事情；物质; v. 要紧
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 成熟的; v. 使成熟
example: These plants are then pollinated and allowed to mature and produce seed.
translation: 然后，这些植物就被授粉，从而成熟结籽。

meaning: n. 最大量; adj. 最大的
example: Twelve hours is the minimum, sixty hours the maximum.
translation: 12小时为下限,60小时为上限.

meaning: v. aux可能；可以，祝
example: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
translation: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

meaning: adv. 大概，或许；也许
example: Maybe I eat too much and that's what makes me dozy.
translation: 也许我吃得太多了，所以昏昏欲睡。

meaning: n. 市长
example: The person who embodies democracy at the local level is the mayor.
translation: 在地方上代表民主的人是市长。

meaning: pron. (宾格)我
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: n. 草地，牧草地
example: In the spring, the meadow is a mass of daffodils.
translation: 春天，草地上开满了黄水仙。

meaning: n. 膳食，一餐
example: We had a nice meal with a bottle of champagne.
translation: 我们美餐了一顿，还喝了一瓶香槟。

meaning: v. 作…解释；意指
example: "What do you mean?" I asked, offended on Liddie's behalf.
translation: “你什么意思啊？”我问，替利迪感到愤愤不平。

meaning: n. 意义，意思；意图
example: Politicians have debased the meaning of the word "freedom"
translation: 政客们贬低了“自由”一词的意义。

meaning: n. 方法，手段，工具
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: n. 其时，其间; adv. 当时
example: In the meantime the war of nerves seems likely to continue.
translation: 与此同时，心理战似乎还可能继续。

meaning: adv. 同时，当时
example: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water.
translation: 同时，把碗置于微沸的水上，将白巧克力放入碗中使其熔化。

meaning: adj. 可测量的
example: So far the effect is barely measurable.
translation: 迄今为止，效果微乎其微。

meaning: v. 量，测量; n. 分量
example: The colonies were claiming a larger measure of self-government.
translation: 殖民地正要求获得更大程度上的自治。

meaning: n. 衡量，测量；尺寸
example: the metric system of measurement
translation: 公制度量衡

meaning: n. 肉
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. 技工，机械，机修工
example: An elevator mechanic can work the machinery directly by turning this lever.
translation: 电梯修理工可以转动这根杠杆直接操作机器。

meaning: adj. 机械的；力学的
example: The company undertakes mechanical work on all types of cars.
translation: 该公司承接各类汽车的修理工作。

meaning: adv. 机械地
n. 力学；技术性细节
example: The mechanics of the job, however, have changed little since then.
translation: 不过，工作流程从那以后就几乎没有任何变化。

meaning: n. 奖章，勋章，纪念章
example: It was an unbelievable moment when Chris won the gold medal.
translation: 克里斯赢得金牌的那一刻令人不可思议。

meaning: adj. 医学的；内科的
example: Ann Bradley dispels the old wives' tales and gives the medical facts.
translation: 安·布拉德利破除迷信，给出了医学事实。

meaning: n. 内服药；医学
example: Traditionally young Asians in Britain have gravitated towards medicine, law and engineering.
translation: 英国的亚裔年轻人通常被吸引到医学、法律及工程专业。

meaning: n. 地中海; adj. 地中海的
example: Britain bakes in a Mediterranean heatwave.
translation: 地中海的热浪炙烤着英国。

meaning: n. 媒质；中间a中等的
example: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

meaning: v. 遇见; v. 相遇
example: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
translation: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

meaning: n. 聚集，会合，会见
example: We'll go to a meeting in Birmingham and come straight back.
translation: 我们将去伯明翰参加会议，然后马上回来。

meaning: n. 瓜，甜瓜
example: Next, she disembowelled a melon with a quiet fury.
translation: 接着，她闷着头愤愤地掏空瓜瓤。

meaning: vi. 融化; vt. 使融化
example: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water.
translation: 同时，把碗置于微沸的水上，将白巧克力放入碗中使其熔化。

meaning: n. 成员，会员
example: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
translation: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

meaning: adj. 纪念的；记忆的
example: The Memorial seems almost ugly, dominating the landscape for miles around.
translation: 那座纪念碑耸立在方圆数英里景致之中显得近乎难看。

meaning: n. 记忆；回忆；存储
example: "His memory must be completely back, then?" — "Just about."
translation: “这么说，他的记忆一定是完全恢复了？”——“差不多。”

meaning: v. 修理，修补，缝补
example: I felt that might well mend the rift between them.
translation: 我觉得那样做也许可以让他们冰释前嫌。

meaning: adj. 智力的；精神的
example: The woman will be confined to a mental institution.
translation: 这个女人将被关进精神病院。

meaning: vt&n. 提及，说起
example: His immediate superior has singled him out for a special mention.
translation: 他的顶头上司特别提到了他。

meaning: n. 菜单；饭菜，菜肴
example: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
translation: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

meaning: n. 商人；零售商
example: The ride was smooth until they got into the merchant ship's wake.
translation: 航行一直很顺利，直到他们碰上了商船的尾流。

meaning: n. 水银，汞
example: That night the mercury fell to thirty degrees below zero.
translation: 那天晚上温度计显示气温降到了零下30度。

meaning: n. 仁慈，慈悲，恩惠
example: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
translation: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

meaning: adj. 仅仅的；纯粹的
example: The mere mention of John had touched a very raw nerve indeed.
translation: 提到约翰就真的让人心痛。

meaning: adv. 仅仅，只不过
example: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
translation: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

meaning: n. 长处，优点；功过
example: Surely such weighty matters merit a higher level of debate?
translation: 这样重大的事件谅必应进行更高级别的讨论吧？

meaning: adj. 欢乐的，愉快的
example: I just wanted to wish you a merry Christmas.
translation: 我只想祝福你圣诞快乐。

meaning: n. 混乱，混杂，肮脏
example: England's European Championship plans are in a right mess.
translation: 英格兰队的欧洲锦标赛作战计划乱七八糟。

meaning: n. 信息，消息；启示
example: The delegation was carrying a message of thanks to President Mubarak.
translation: 代表团向穆巴拉克总统转达了谢意。

meaning: n. 送信者，信使
example: The messenger bent and scratched at his knee where the strapping chafed.
translation: 送信人弯下腰来，挠着膝部被绑腿磨红的地方。

meaning: n. 金属，金属制品
example: Light fittings with metal parts should always be earthed.
translation: 有金属部件的照明装置都应该走地线。

meaning: n. 计量器，计，表
example: Only a third of these households thought it reasonable to meter water.
translation: 这些家庭当中只有三分之一认为用水表计量是合理的。

meaning: n. 方法，办法；教学法
example: He succeeded with the aid of a completely new method he discovered.
translation: 借助于自己发现的一种全新的方法，他获得了成功。

meaning: n. 米，公尺
example: Prices start at £13.95 a metre for printed cotton.
translation: 印花棉布以每米13.95英镑的价格起售。

meaning: adj. 公制的，米制的
example: The Wall Street Journal uses 220,000 metric tons of newsprint each year.
translation: 《华尔街日报》每年用去22万公吨新闻纸。

meaning: n. 微型计算机，微机
example: Status flags represent one of the simplest forms of microcomputer logic.
translation: 状态标志是微计算机逻辑中的一种最简单的形式之一.

meaning: n. 话筒，麦克风
example: He wore a hidden microphone to secretly tape-record conversations.
translation: 他身上藏了一个传声器，打算偷偷录下谈话内容。

meaning: n. 显微镜
example: We aimed the microscope at a likely looking target.
translation: 我们把显微镜对准了一个看起来合适的目标。

meaning: n. 正午，中午
example: The brothers usually roll into their studio around midday.
translation: 兄弟几个总是要到正午前后才姗姗来到工作室。

meaning: n. 中部; adj. 中部的
example: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday.
translation: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。

meaning: n. 午夜，子夜，夜半
example: He fell asleep just past midnight with tolerable ease.
translation: 他刚过午夜就睡着了，睡得还算安稳。

meaning: n. 中部，中间，当中
example: She stood preening in their midst, delighted with the attention.
translation: 她得意洋洋地站在他们中间，为受人瞩目而高兴。

meaning: v. aux可能，会，也许
example: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
translation: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

meaning: adj. 和缓的；温柔的
example: His captaincy of the team was ended by mild eye trouble.
translation: 他由于患轻度眼疾而不再担任队长一职。

meaning: n. 英里
example: The President is determined "to go the extra mile for peace".
translation: 总统决心“为实现和平而加倍努力”。

meaning: adj. 军事的；军人的
example: The military regime in power was unpopular and repressive.
translation: 当权的军政府压制人民，不得人心。

meaning: n. 乳，牛奶; v. 挤(奶)
example: As the baby suckles, a further supply of milk is generated.
translation: 婴儿吮吸时，会有更多的奶水流出来。

meaning: n. 磨坊；制造厂
example: I was just a very average run-of-the-mill kind of student.
translation: 我只是一个普普通通的学生。

meaning: n. 毫米
example: 6-millimetre film was used because it offered clearer freeze frames than video tape.
translation: 采用6毫米胶片是因为它的定格图像要比录像带更加清晰。

meaning: num. 百万; n. 许多
example: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
translation: 3亿美元远远不够。

meaning: n. 头脑；理智；记忆
example: The opportunity had gone. His mind scrabbled for alternatives.
translation: 机会已经失去。他苦苦思索别的方案。

meaning: pron. 我的
example: I shall have words with these stupid friends of mine!
translation: 我真应该跟我这些愚蠢的朋友理论理论！

meaning: n. 矿工
example: The young miner was confident of winning the girl's heart.
translation: 这个年轻的矿工坚信能赢得那位姑娘的心.

meaning: n. 矿物; adj. 矿物的
example: The mineral is weakly magnetic.
translation: 这种矿物带有轻微的磁性。

meaning: n. 最小量; adj. 最小的
example: Many of Britain's beaches fail to meet minimum standards of cleanliness.
translation: 英国许多海滩连最起码的卫生标准都达不倒。

meaning: n. 部长，大臣；公使
example: The Prime Minister has been briefed by her parliamentary aides.
translation: 首相已听取了她议会助手的简要汇报。

meaning: n. (政府的)部
example: The Ministry desperately tried to hush up the whole affair.
translation: 部里拼命想隐瞒整个事件。

meaning: adj. 较小的；较次要的
example: He had a minor stroke in 1987, which left him partly paralysed.
translation: 他1987年曾患轻度中风，之后就半身不遂了。

meaning: n. 少数；少数民族
example: A minority of officers were prepared to bend the rules.
translation: 少数官员准备篡改规则。

meaning: adj. 负的; prep. 减(去)
example: The star's surface temperature is reckoned to be minus 75 degrees Celsius.
translation: 这颗恒星的表面温度估计在零下75摄氏度左右。

meaning: n. 分，分钟；一会儿
example: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
translation: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

meaning: n. 奇迹，令人惊奇的人
example: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
translation: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

meaning: n. 镜子; v. 反映，反射
example: Light colours provide an effective backdrop for pictures or a mirror.
translation: 浅色是挂放图画或镜子很有效果的衬托。

meaning: adj. 痛苦的，悲惨的
example: Miserable, and unexpectedly lonely, she went in search of Jean-Paul.
translation: 内心痛苦、突感寂寞的她去寻找琼－保罗。

meaning: v. 使误入岐途
example: Ministers must not knowingly mislead Parliament and the public.
translation: 大臣们不应该故意地误导议会与公众。

meaning: n. 小姐
example: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
translation: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

meaning: n. 发射物；导弹
example: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.
translation: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。

meaning: adj. 缺掉的，失去的
example: Ah yes, but think of all the family life they're missing.
translation: 是这样，不过别忘了他们错过了多少天伦之乐。

meaning: n. 使命，任务；使团
example: Their mission is simply to scout out places where helicopters can land.
translation: 他们的任务只是找到能够让直升机着陆的地方。

meaning: n. 薄雾
example: I stepped outside and pulled up my collar against the cold mist.
translation: 我走出门，竖起衣领抵御冷雾。

meaning: n. 错误; v. 误解，弄错
example: make a mistake
translation: 犯错误

meaning: n. 先生
example: Mister, can we 'elp to carry yer stuff in?
translation: 先生，要我们帮您把行李拿进去吗？

meaning: n. 女主人；夫人
example: Anthony sometimes felt that his mistress was his superior in will-power.
translation: 有时安东尼感觉他的情妇比他更有意志力。

meaning: v. 误解，误会，曲解
example: I'm not saying what he did was good, don't misunderstand me.
translation: 别误会，我并不是说他所做的是好事。

meaning: v. 使混合，混淆
example: Stewart has developed a tendency to mix it verbally with the opposition.
translation: 斯图尔特现在变得只要和别人意见不合，就准备大吵一架。

meaning: n. 混合；混合物
example: Liquidize the mixture and then pass it through a sieve.
translation: 将混合物打成泥状，然后用滤网滤一下。

meaning: n. 呻吟声; v. 呻吟
example: You can go see him and have a good old moan.
translation: 你可以去看看他，好好地诉诉苦。

meaning: adj. 运动的；流动的
example: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
translation: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。

meaning: n. 方式，样式
example: The bicycle reigned supreme as Britain's most popular mode of transport.
translation: 当时自行车是英国最流行的交通工具。

meaning: n. 模型；模式；模特儿
example: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: adj. 温和的；有节制的
example: Futures prices recovered from sharp early declines to end with moderate losses.
translation: 期货价格在早盘深幅下跌后出现反弹，收盘时未见严重损失。

meaning: adj. 现代的，近代的
example: We are in one of the most severe recessions in modern times.
translation: 我们正在经历现代最严重的一段经济衰退。

meaning: adj. 有节制的；谦虚的
example: Though his background was modest, it was in no sense deprived.
translation: 尽管他家境一般，但也并不贫穷。

meaning: v. 更改，修改；修饰
example: Established practices are difficult to modify.
translation: 既定的惯例是很难更改的.

meaning: adj. 湿润的；多雨的
example: The outside air was heavy and moist and sultry.
translation: 外面的空气沉滞、潮湿而闷热。

meaning: n. 潮湿，湿气；温度
example: A thin, glistening thread of moisture ran along the rough concrete sill.
translation: 在粗糙不平的水泥窗台上有一条细细的发光水印。

meaning: n. 分子，克分子
example: So tell me what this molecule does that makes it special.
translation: 那么告诉我这个分子有何作用而使其与众不同。

meaning: n. 片刻，瞬间，时刻
example: I'll report back the moment I have located him.
translation: 我一找到他就马上汇报。

meaning: n. 星期一
example: Wendy popped in for a quick bite to eat on Monday night.
translation: 温迪周一晚上过来匆匆吃了点儿饭。

meaning: n. 货币；金钱，财富
example: I spent lots of money on smart new outfits for work.
translation: 我花大笔钱购置了上班时穿的漂亮新套装。

meaning: n. 班长；监视器
example: Officials had not been allowed to monitor the voting.
translation: 以前不允许官员监督投票。

meaning: n. 猴子，猿
example: The woolly spider monkey is the largest primate in the Americas.
translation: 绒毛蛛猴是美洲最大的灵长类动物。

meaning: n. 月，月份
example: One month before the deadline we see the hollowness of these promises.
translation: 离最后期限只有一个月时，我们认识到了这些许诺都是空头支票。

meaning: adj. 每月的; adv. 每月
example: She presents a monthly magazine programme on the BBC.
translation: 她在英国广播公司主持一个月刊节目。

meaning: n. 纪念碑；纪念馆
example: As Wren's epitaph famously declares, the cathedral itself is his monument.
translation: 众所周知，雷恩的墓志铭中写道，大教堂本身就是他的纪念碑。

meaning: n. 心情，情绪；语气
example: He faced the press, initially, in a somewhat subdued mood.
translation: 他最初面对媒体时情绪有点忧郁。

meaning: n. 月球，月亮；卫星
example: June always rhymes with moon in old love songs.
translation: 在老情歌中June总是和moon成韵。

meaning: adj. 道德的；合乎道德的
example: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: adj. 更多的; adv. 更
example: I don't want any more of that heavy stuff.
translation: 我再也不想碰那种麻烦事了。

meaning: adv. 再者，加之，此外
example: Moreover, Ramsay was no mean thinker himself.
translation: 而且拉姆齐自己也是一位出色的思想家。

meaning: n. 早晨，上午
example: A Delta II rocket was launched from Cape Canaveral early this morning.
translation: 今天一早，一枚“德尔塔”Ⅱ型火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。

meaning: adj. 终有一死的；致死的
example: When self-esteem is high, we lose our mortal fear of jealousy.
translation: 自信心很强时，我们不再对妒忌感到极度惧怕。

meaning: n. 蚊子
example: I threw aside my mosquito net and jumped out of bed.
translation: 我把蚊帐甩到一边，跳下床来。

meaning: adj. 最多的; adv. 最，很
example: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
translation: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

meaning: adv. 主要的，大部分
example: Timothy was crying, mostly from exhaustion, and his nose was running.
translation: 蒂莫西正在哭泣，主要是因为太累了，而且他还流着鼻涕。

meaning: n. 母亲，妈妈
example: Mrs Allen's style of cooking owes much to her mother-in-law.
translation: 艾伦太太的烹饪风格很大程度上承传于她的婆婆。

meaning: n. 运动；手势；提议
example: She made a fanning motion, pretending to cool herself off.
translation: 她做了个扇风的动作，假装想让自己凉快一点。

meaning: v. 促动；激励，激发
example: How do you motivate people to work hard and efficiently?
translation: 你是怎样激励大家奋发高效地工作的？

meaning: n. 动机，目的
example: Sheila had an ulterior motive for trying to help Stan.
translation: 希拉想帮助斯坦是另有所图的。

meaning: n. 发动机；机动车
example: Many motor accidents are the result of unthinkingly mixing speed and alcohol.
translation: 许多机动车事故都是不计后果地酒后开快车造成的。

meaning: n. 模子，模型; v. 浇铸
example: If damp, musty buildings make you ill, mould is probably the cause.
translation: 如果潮湿发霉的建筑令你生病了，霉菌很可能是病因。

meaning: v. 登上，爬上; n. …山
example: America has enough firepower in the area to mount sustained air strikes.
translation: 美国在该地区拥有足够的火力发动持续的空中打击。

meaning: n. 山，山岳；山脉
example: I'll run over to Short Mountain and check on Mrs Adams.
translation: 我会开车去肖特山看看亚当斯夫人。

meaning: v. 哀痛，哀悼
example: When the government is finally brought down, no one will mourn its passing.
translation: 当政府最终垮台之日，将不会有人为它的消亡而悲哀。

meaning: n. 鼠，耗子
example: Use your mouse to drag the pictures to their new size.
translation: 用鼠标拖动图片，将其调整为新的尺寸。

meaning: n. 嘴，口，口腔
example: A thorough brushing helps to freshen up your mouth.
translation: 彻底刷牙有助于口气清新。

meaning: n. 满口，一口，少量
example: Savour the flavour of each mouthful, and chew your food well.
translation: 细细品尝每一口的味道，充分咀嚼。

meaning: v. 移动；感动; n. 动
example: So, if we could just move onto something else?
translation: 那么我们可不可以干脆谈点别的？

meaning: n. 动作，活动；移动
example: Monks shave their heads, as do devotees of the Hare Krishna movement.
translation: 和尚要剃度，克利须那派教徒也一样。

meaning: n. 电影；电影院
example: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.
translation: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。

meaning: adv. 非常，很; adj. 许多的
example: Mrs Allen's style of cooking owes much to her mother-in-law.
translation: 艾伦太太的烹饪风格很大程度上承传于她的婆婆。

meaning: n. 软泥，泥浆
example: red mud
translation: 赤泥；红泥

meaning: adj. 多泥的，泥泞的
example: The recent rain had churned up the waterfall into a muddy whirlpool.
translation: 最近的一场雨把瀑布搅成了泥水漩涡。

meaning: n. 大杯
example: mug shot
translation: 面部照片

meaning: adj. 复合的；并联的
example: He gave the cause of death as multiple injuries.
translation: 他说多处受伤导致了死亡。

meaning: v. 使增加；乘
example: Take the time in seconds, square it, and multiply by 5.12.
translation: 记下用了多少秒时间，将其平方，再乘以5.12。

meaning: n&vi. 谋杀，凶杀
example: 13 men have been questioned in connection with the murder.
translation: 有13名男子因谋杀案受到盘问。

meaning: n. 杀人犯，凶手
example: Now the murderer has two deaths on his conscience.
translation: 现在，这个杀人犯背着两条人命，受到了良心的谴责。

meaning: n. 肌肉，肌；体力
example: Eisenhower used his muscle to persuade Congress to change the law.
translation: 艾森豪威尔用他的影响力说服国会修改了该项法律。

meaning: n. 博物馆；展览馆
example: The museum will have a permanent exhibition of 60 vintage cars.
translation: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

meaning: n. 蘑菇，菌类植物
example: cream of mushroom soup
translation: 奶油蘑菇汤

meaning: n. 音乐，乐曲，乐谱
example: He once told an interviewer that he didn't even like rock music.
translation: 他曾告诉一位采访者，他甚至都不喜欢摇滚乐。

meaning: adj. 音乐的；和谐的
example: London's musical life might become as exciting as Berlin's.
translation: 伦敦的音乐生活可能会变得像柏林的一样令人兴奋。

meaning: n. 音乐家；作曲家
example: He feels that he was destined to become a musician.
translation: 他觉得自己注定会成为一名音乐家。

meaning: v. aux必须；必然要
example: You must have noticed how tired he sometimes looks.
translation: 你一定注意到他有时候显得特别疲惫。

meaning: adj. 缄默的; n. 哑巴
example: He sat mute, speechless with ecstasy, gazing into the sky.
translation: 他静静坐着，凝视天空，一言不发，心驰神往。

meaning: v. 轻声低语；抱怨
example: They make no more than a mutter of protest.
translation: 他们只不过是低声抗议了一下。

meaning: n. 羊肉
example: He likes to eat mutton which was seasoned with garlic.
translation: 他喜欢吃用大蒜调味的羊肉.

meaning: adj. 相互的；共同的
example: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
translation: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

meaning: pron. 我的
example: The vowel in words like "my" and "thigh" is not very difficult.
translation: 单词my和thigh中的元音并不难发。

meaning: pron. 我自己；我亲自
example: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend'swife.
translation: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

meaning: adj. 神秘的；难以理解的
example: Soon they were dead, victims of a mysterious poisoner.
translation: 不久他们就死了，是一个神秘的投毒者下的手。

meaning: n. 神秘；神秘的事物
example: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
translation: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

meaning: n. 钉；指甲; v. 钉
example: He fought tooth and nail to keep his job.
translation: 他竭尽全力保住自己的工作。

meaning: adj. 裸体的；无遮敝的
example: The worms cannot be seen by the naked eye.
translation: 这些虫子用肉眼看不见。

meaning: n. 名字；名誉; v. 说出
example: She has had many credits and name-checks in American Vogue.
translation: 美国版《时尚》多次对她进行赞扬或是提到她的名字。

meaning: adv. 即，也就是
example: The book was inspired by a real person, namely Tamara de Treaux.
translation: 那本书的灵感源于一个真实人物，即塔玛拉·德特罗。

meaning: n. 小睡，打盹，瞌睡
example: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair.
translation: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。

meaning: adj. 狭的，狭窄的
example: Sailing boats lay at anchor in the narrow waterway.
translation: 帆船停泊在狭窄的水道上。

meaning: adj. 龌龊的；淫猥的
example: They've picked up a really nasty infection from something they've eaten.
translation: 他们因吃错东西而得了很严重的感染症。

meaning: n. 民族；国家
example: Albania is a small nation state of around 3 million people.
translation: 阿尔巴尼亚是一个大约有300万人口的单一民族独立国家。

meaning: adj. 民族的；国家的
example: Do you always have a bet on the Grand National?
translation: 你总是对全国赛马大会下点注吗？

meaning: n. 国籍；民族，族
example: Discrimination by employers on the grounds of race and nationality was illegal.
translation: 雇主以种族或国籍为由歧视员工是非法的。

meaning: adj. 本土的; n. 本地人
example: We were forbidden, under pain of imprisonment, to use our native language.
translation: 我们被禁止使用母语，违者将被关进监狱。

meaning: adj. 自然界的；天然的
example: The ball is made of rattan — a natural fibre.
translation: 这个球是由一种天然纤维——省藤制成的。

meaning: adv. 自然地；天然地
example: It was imperative that he act as naturally as possible.
translation: 最重要的是他要做到尽可能自然。

meaning: n. 大自然；本性；性质
example: The nature of the polymer is currently a trade secret.
translation: 这一聚合物的性质目前是个商业机密。

meaning: adj. 顽皮的，淘气的
example: I've even seen her shake Zara when she's been naughty.
translation: 我甚至见过她在扎拉淘气的时候使劲摇晃她。

meaning: adj. 海军的，军舰的
example: In a naval battle your aim is to sink the enemy's ship.
translation: 在海战中目标就是击沉敌船。

meaning: n. 航行；航海术；导航
example: The expedition was wrecked by bad planning and poor navigation.
translation: 这次探险因计划不周和导航不利而失败。

meaning: n. 海军
example: The Navy is to carry out an examination of the wreck tomorrow.
translation: 海军明天将对失事船只进行细查。

meaning: adv. 近，接近; adj. 近的
example: She is not herself. She came near to a breakdown.
translation: 她身体不舒服，简直要崩溃了。

meaning: adj. 附近的; adv. 在附近
example: At a nearby table a man was complaining in a loud voice.
translation: 邻桌的一位男士当时正高声地抱怨着。

meaning: adv. 差不多；密切地
example: It is nearly always women who are the primary care givers.
translation: 从事初级保健护理工作的几乎都是女性。

meaning: adj. 整洁的；熟练的
example: Neat solutions are not easily found to these issues.
translation: 很难找到解决这些问题的巧妙办法。

meaning: adv. 必然，必定
example: He is not attempting necessarily to reproduce the cadence of speech.
translation: 他不想刻意重复那种讲话的语调。

meaning: adj. 必要的；必然的
example: For her, books were as necessary to life as bread.
translation: 对她来说，书就像面包一样，是生活必需品。

meaning: n. 必要性；必然性
example: Some people have to lead stressful lifestyles out of necessity.
translation: 一些人迫于生计不得不过着紧张忙碌的生活。

meaning: n. 颈，脖子
example: He shouted at his brother, his neck veins bulging.
translation: 他朝他的兄弟吼叫，脖子上青筋暴突。

meaning: n. 项链，项圈
example: She was wearing the obligatory sweater and pearl necklace.
translation: 她穿着那件经常穿的毛衣，戴着那串惯常戴的珍珠项链。

meaning: v. 需要; v. aux需要
example: Do not wait for good things to happen to you. You need to walk towards happiness.
translation: 不要等待好事降临，你要向幸福进发。

meaning: n. 针，缝补，编织针
example: She passed the needle through the rough cloth, back and forth.
translation: 她一针一针地缝那块粗布。

meaning: adj. 不需要的
example: All this, needless to say, had been culled second-hand from radio reports.
translation: 不用说，所有这些都是从电台报道中采集来的二手材料。

meaning: adj. 否定的；消极的
example: So far 57 have taken the test and all have been negative.
translation: 到目前为止，参加测试的有57人，测试结果均呈阴性。

meaning: v. 忽视，忽略；疏忽
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: n. 黑人
example: The Negro minstrel is touring the country.
translation: 那个黑人歌舞团正在全国各地巡回演出.

meaning: n. 邻居，邻国，邻人
example: The treaty binds them to respect their neighbour's independence.
translation: 条约规定他们必须尊重其邻国的独立。

meaning: n. 邻居关系；邻近
example: He was born and grew up in the Flatbush neighbourhood of Brooklyn.
translation: 他出生在布鲁克林的弗拉特布什一带，并在那儿长大成人。

meaning: adj. (两者)都不的
example: The report concludes that I acted neither fraudulently nor improperly.
translation: 报告最后认为我的行为既没有欺骗性也没有任何不妥。

meaning: n. 侄子，外甥
example: "Cut her out of your will," urged his nephew.
translation: “把她从你的遗嘱中删去，”他的侄子催促道。

meaning: n. 神经；勇敢，胆量
example: Nerve cells have limited ability to regenerate if destroyed.
translation: 如果受到损伤，神经细胞再造的能力有限。

meaning: adj. 神经的；易激动的
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: n. 巢，窝，穴
example: As soon as the two chicks hatch, they leave the nest burrow.
translation: 两只小鸟一出壳就离开了巢穴。

meaning: n. 网，网状物；通信网
example: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net.
translation: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。

meaning: n. 网状物；网络
example: This film is the first British animation sold to an American network.
translation: 这是第一部出售给美国电视网的英国动画片。

meaning: adj. 中立的；中性的
example: "I know you," he said flatly, matter-of-fact, neutral in tone.
translation: “我认识你。”他平淡地说道，就事论事，不带任何感情。

meaning: adv. 永不，决不；不
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: conj. 然而; adv. 仍然
example: The opening day of the battle was, nevertheless, accounted a success.
translation: 不过，开战的首日仍被认为是成功的。

meaning: adj. 新的；新近出现的
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adv. 新近，最近
example: Builders must fasten down roofs of newly-built homes more securely.
translation: 建造工人必须把新建房屋的屋顶固定得更牢靠些。

meaning: n. 新闻，消息
example: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities.
