translation: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

meaning: n. 报纸，报
example: Under the newspaper, atop a sheet of paper, lay an envelope.
translation: 在报纸下面的一张纸上放着一个信封。

meaning: adj. 紧接的；贴近的
example: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
translation: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

meaning: adj. 美好的，令人愉快的
example: "Ah, Captain Fox," Martin McGuinness said affably. "Nice to see you again."
translation: “啊，福克斯上尉，”马丁·麦吉尼斯亲切地说，“很高兴再次见到您。”

meaning: n. 侄女，外甥女
example: He looked affectionately at his niece.
translation: 他慈爱地看着他的侄女。

meaning: n. 夜，夜间
example: Two men were helping police with their inquiries at Salisbury last night.
translation: 两名男子昨天夜里在索尔兹伯里接受了警方盘问。

meaning: num. 九，九个
example: Seventy-nine voted in the affirmative, and none in the negative.
translation: 79人投赞成票，没有人投反对票。

meaning: num. 十九，十九个
example: He set off for a nineteen-day moose hunt in Nova Scotia.
translation: 他动身前往新斯科舍参加为时19天的驼鹿捕猎活动。

meaning: num. 九十，九十个
example: Almost ninety per cent of all rapes and violent assaults went unreported.
translation: 几乎90%的强奸案和暴力侵害案都没有报案。

meaning: num. 第九；九分之一
example: By the ninth hour the car was running in eighth position.
translation: 到第9个小时的时候，这辆车位列第8。

meaning: n. 氮
example: The atmosphere consist of more than 70 % of nitrogen.
translation: 大气中含有70%以上的氮气.

meaning: adv. 不；并不; adj. 没有
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 贵族的；高尚的
example: He had implicit faith in the noble intentions of the Emperor.
translation: 他对皇帝陛下高尚的动机深信不疑。

meaning: pron. 谁也不；无人
example: "Wait a damn minute," Mindy spat. "Nobody said anything about staying overnight."
translation: “该死的，等一下”，明迪愤愤地说道，“谁也没说过要过夜。”

meaning: v. 点(头)；点头表示
example: He turned with a little nod and I watched him walk away.
translation: 他边点了点头边转过身，我看着他走了。

meaning: n. 喧闹声；响声；噪声
example: Sightseers may be a little overwhelmed by the crowds and noise.
translation: 拥挤的人群和喧闹的噪音可能会让游客有些茫然不知所措。

meaning: adj. 嘈杂的；喧闹的
example: Wind turbines are large and noisy and they disfigure the landscape.
translation: 风力涡轮机个头大、噪音响，还会破坏周边风景。

meaning: pron. 没有人; adv. 毫不
example: Seventy-nine voted in the affirmative, and none in the negative.
translation: 79人投赞成票，没有人投反对票。

meaning: n. 胡说，废话
example: He had been unwittingly deluded by their mystical nonsense.
translation: 他不知不觉被他们故弄玄虚的胡说八道给骗了。

meaning: n. 正午，中午
example: There is a ceaseless struggle from noon to night.
translation: 从中午到夜晚，争斗没有停歇。

meaning: conj. 也不；不
example: The report concludes that I acted neither fraudulently nor improperly.
translation: 报告最后认为我的行为既没有欺骗性也没有任何不妥。

meaning: adj. 正常的，普通的
example: Life has not yet returned to normal but we are getting there.
translation: 生活还没有恢复正常，不过就快了。

meaning: adv. 通常，正常地
example: We gained a rich supply of data which would normally be inaccessible.
translation: 我们得到了通常难以获取的大量数据。

meaning: n. 北，北方; adj. 北方的
example: Two trains collided head-on in north-eastern Germany early this morning.
translation: 今天早上德国东北部两列火车迎面相撞。

meaning: n. 东北; adj. 位于东北的
example: Snow in October is nothing strange in northeast China.
translation: 10月下雪在东北不是什么希罕的事.

meaning: adj. 北方的，北部的
example: The film takes no position on the politics of Northern Ireland.
translation: 这部电影未在北爱尔兰政治问题上选择站边。

meaning: n. 西北; adj. 位于西北的
example: The address is 2025 M Street, Northwest, Washington, DC, 20036.
translation: 地址为华盛顿特区，西北区，M大街2025号，邮政编码20036。

meaning: n. 鼻子；突出部分
example: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
translation: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

meaning: adv. 不，没有
example: Success is not guaranteed. It is not handed to you. Success is earned.
translation: 成功无法保证，并非唾手可得。成功必须靠自己去争取。

meaning: n. 笔记；便条；注释
example: Somehow he tells these stories without a note of horror.
translation: 不知为什么他讲这些故事时一点都不害怕。

meaning: n. 笔记本，期票簿
example: Tamsin materialized at her side, notebook at the ready.
translation: 塔姆辛从她身旁冒了出来，且备好了笔记本。

meaning: n. 没有东西; adv. 毫不
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: v. 注意; n. 通知；注意
example: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
translation: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

meaning: adj. 显而易见的；重要的
example: There's also been a noticeable rise in the political temperature.
translation: 政治气氛也明显升温了。

meaning: n. 名词
example: The noun " mouse " is the singular form of " mice " .
translation: 名词mouse是 mice 的单数形式.

meaning: n. 小说; adj. 新的
example: The various elements of the novel fail to cohere.
translation: 这部小说的各部分之间缺乏连贯性。

meaning: n. 十一月
example: Troops were sent to the islands to restore order last November.
translation: 去年11月，军队被派往这些岛屿以恢复秩序。

meaning: adv. 现在；立刻；于是
example: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
translation: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

meaning: adv. 现今，现在
example: You're miles better than most of the performers we see nowadays.
translation: 你比当下我们见到的大多数表演者都强多了。

meaning: adv. 任何地方都不
example: These rootless young people have nowhere else to go.
translation: 这些漂泊不定的年轻人没有其他地方可去。

meaning: adj. 原子核的；核心的
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: n. 核，核心；(原子)核
example: The repulsive force within the nucleus is enormous.
translation: 核子内部的斥力是巨大的。

meaning: n. 讨厌的东西
example: He spent three days making an absolute nuisance of himself.
translation: 他3天时间就把自己变成了个地地道道的“讨人嫌”。

meaning: n. 数，数字；号码
example: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net.
translation: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。

meaning: adj. 为数众多的；许多
example: The doctors gave numerous examples of patients being expelled from hospital.
translation: 医生们列举了大量病人被逐出医院的实例。

meaning: n. 保姆；护士; v. 看护
example: "Can you walk all right?" the nurse asked him.
translation: “你走路有困难吗？”护士问他。

meaning: n. 托儿所；苗圃
example: We have started a campaign for better nursery and school services.
translation: 我们已发起一场要求改善幼儿园和中小学教育服务的运动。

meaning: n. 坚果，干果；螺母
example: The Daily Express describes Dr Carey as a pretty tough nut.
translation: 《每日快报》把凯里医生说成是特别难对付的家伙。

meaning: n. 尼龙，耐纶
example: I slowly zipped and locked the heavy black nylon bags.
translation: 我慢慢地把那些沉重的黑色尼龙袋的拉链拉上并锁好。

meaning: n. 栎属植物；栎木
example: The wind was bouncing the branches of the big oak trees.
translation: 一棵棵高大橡树的枝条随风摇摆。

meaning: n. 浆，橹
example: An oar often acts as rudder.
translation: 桨常可起舵的作用.

meaning: v. 顺从; v. 服从
example: Clifford's only stipulation is that his clients obey his advice.
translation: 克利福德唯一的要求就是客户必须听从他的建议。

meaning: n. 物，物体；目的
example: He thought of the baby almost as an inanimate object.
translation: 他认为婴儿几乎就是毫无生命的物体。

meaning: n. 反对，异议；不喜欢
example: I no longer have any objection to your going to see her.
translation: 我不会再因为你去见她而不高兴。

meaning: adj. 客观的；无偏见的
example: I believe that a journalist should be completely objective.
translation: 我认为新闻记者不应当有丝毫偏见。

meaning: v. 迫使；施恩惠于
example: Mr Oakley always has been ready to oblige journalists with information.
translation: 奥克利先生总是乐于向记者透露消息。

meaning: n. 注意；观察；观察力
example: The diaries are a mixture of confession, work in progress and observation.
translation: 这些日记里既有自白，也有当下工作记录，还有见闻评论。

meaning: v. 遵守；看到；说
example: The Royal Greenwich Observatory was founded to observe and catalogue the stars.
translation: 当初创立皇家格林尼治天文台就是为了观察星体并对其进行编目。

meaning: n. 观察员，观测者
example: The current sole superpower is far from being a disinterested observer.
translation: 当前唯一的超级大国远不是一个公正的旁观者。

meaning: n. 障碍，障碍物，妨害
example: A further obstacle has presented itself, however.
translation: 然而，突然又出现了一个障碍。

meaning: v. 获得，得到，买到
example: Only with mass direct action will we obtain such change.
translation: 只有采取大规模直接行动，我们才会取得这样的改变。

meaning: adj. 明显的，显而易见的
example: The ideological divisions between the parties aren't always obvious.
translation: 政党之间的意识形态界线并不总是泾渭分明的。

meaning: adv. 明显地，显然地
example: Now, erm, obviously some of our listeners may have some ideas.
translation: 嗯，对了，显然我们的一些听众可能会有些想法。

meaning: n. 场合，时刻；时机
example: On one occasion, his father threw a radio at his mother.
translation: 他父亲曾有一次拎起收音机砸向他的母亲。

meaning: adj. 偶然的；临时的
example: She saw the occasional glimmer of a moth's wings.
translation: 她看见蛾子的翅膀偶尔会泛光。

meaning: adv. 偶然；非经常地
example: His prose is vigorous and dense, occasionally to the point of obscurity.
translation: 他的散文文笔有力、内容庞杂，有时几近晦涩。

meaning: n. 占领，占据；职业
example: Intellectual life in France was smothered by the occupation.
translation: 在被占领期间法国思想界受到了压制。

meaning: v. 占领；占，占有
example: U.S. forces now occupy a part of the country.
translation: 美国军队现在占领了该国的一部分。

meaning: v. 发生；出现，存在
example: If these drugs are stopped abruptly then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
translation: 如果突然停服这些药，则可能出现一些戒断症状。

meaning: n. 发生，出现；事件
example: The greatest occurrence of coronary heart disease is in those over 65.
translation: 65岁以上者是冠心病的最高发人群。

meaning: n. 海洋；洋
example: It became impractical to make a business trip by ocean liner.
translation: 乘坐远洋班轮进行商务旅行变得不合时宜了。

meaning: n. 大洋洲
example: Oceania is mainly made up of Australia and New Zealand.
translation: 大洋洲主要是由澳大利亚和新西兰组成的.

meaning: n. 十月
example: By October 1990, when arrested, he was hopelessly in debt.
translation: 到1990年10月被捕时，他已经负债累累。

meaning: adj. 奇数的；单只的
example: He smiled, an odd, dreamy smile that sent chills up my back.
translation: 他笑了，笑容古怪迷离，叫我后背发凉。

meaning: n. 气味，香气；味道
example: The plant has an unpleasant odour and an acrid taste.
translation: 这种植物闻着刺鼻，吃着辣口。

meaning: prep. …的；由于
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adv. (离)开；(停)止
example: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
translation: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

meaning: v. 冒犯; v. 犯过错
example: There can be little doubt that he will offend again.
translation: 毋庸置疑他还会再犯的。

meaning: v. 提供；提出; n. 提供
example: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
translation: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

meaning: n. 办公室；处，局，社
example: One of the office girls was down with the flu.
translation: 一位女职员得了流感。

meaning: n. 官员；干事；军官
example: He was returned to prison in 1977 for impersonating a police officer.
translation: 他1977年因冒充警官而再次入狱。

meaning: adj. 官员的；官方的
example: You simply can't get a ticket through official channels.
translation: 通过官方渠道是压根儿搞不到票的.

meaning: adv. 经常，常常
example: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
translation: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

meaning: int. 嗬，哦，唉呀
example: He goes to me: "Oh, what do you want?"
translation: 他问我：“哦，你想要什么？”

meaning: n. 油；石油; v. 加油于
example: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

meaning: (缩作OK)a&ad. 对，好
example: "I think I hear the telephone ringing."—"Okay, I can take a hint."
translation: “我想我听到电话铃在响。”——“好的，我明白你的意思了。”

meaning: adj. 老的；…岁的
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: v. 省略，省去；遗漏
example: Please don't omit to lock the door when you leave.
translation: 离开时不要忘了锁门.

meaning: prep. 在…上；在…旁
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: adv. 一次；曾经; n. 一次
example: It had once been the home of a wealthy nobleman.
translation: 这里曾是一个有钱贵族的宅邸。

meaning: num. 一; pron. 一个人
example: I have $100m hidden away where no one will ever find it.
translation: 我把1亿美元藏到了一个永远没人会找到的地方。

meaning: pron. 自己；亲自
example: The doll-like figures in these stories are unlike anybody, let alone oneself.
translation: 这些故事中的玩偶形象跟谁都不像，更不用说像自己了。

meaning: n. 洋葱，洋葱头
example: Fry for about 4 minutes, until the onion has softened.
translation: 煎4分钟左右，直到洋葱变软。

meaning: adv. 只，仅仅; adj. 唯一的
example: His house was the only settled home I had as a child.
translation: 他的房子是我儿时唯一固定的家。

meaning: prep. 到…上
example: Drop the dough onto a baking sheet with a teaspoon.
translation: 用茶匙把生面团舀到烤盘上。

meaning: adj. 开的；开放的; v. 开
example: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

meaning: adj. 开始的; n. 开始
example: He flipped through the post without opening any of it.
translation: 他飞快地翻了一下邮件，但一封也没有打开。

meaning: n. 歌剧
example: The following year she joined the Royal Opera House.
translation: 次年她加入了皇家歌剧院。

meaning: v. 操作；施行手术
example: Hotels operate a collection service for their guests from the airports.
translation: 宾馆为客人提供机场接机服务。

meaning: n. 操作；手术；运算
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: adj. 操作上的；可使用的
example: Exports have not been halted completely because another line is operational.
translation: 出口并没有完全停止，因为另一条生产线还能运转。

meaning: n. 操作人员，接线员
example: A blade guard is fitted to protect the operator.
translation: 为保证操作人员的人身安全安装了桨叶保护罩。

meaning: n. 意见，看法，主张
example: And what of the effect on U.S domestic opinion?
translation: 对美国国内的舆论有什么影响？

meaning: n. 对手，敌手；对抗者
example: Young and old saw in him an implacable opponent of apartheid.
translation: 无论老少都看出他是种族隔离制度的坚决反对者。

meaning: n. 机会，良机
example: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
translation: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

meaning: v. 反对；反抗
example: It is illogical to oppose the repatriation of economic migrants.
translation: 反对把经济移民遣送归国是不合逻辑的。

meaning: adj. 对面的; n. 对立物
example: The argument contained herein takes exactly the opposite point of view.
translation: 本文所持的论点恰恰是站在相反的立场。

meaning: v. 压迫，压制；压抑
example: He states uncompromisingly that he is opposed to any practices which oppress animals.
translation: 他坚决声明反对任何虐待动物的行为。

meaning: adj. 眼的；光学的
example: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
translation: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

meaning: adj. 乐观的；乐观主义的
example: Before his first round of discussions, Mr Baker sounded an optimistic note.
translation: 第一轮讨论前，贝克先生听上去还比较乐观。

meaning: n. 选择，选择权
example: It is not an unattractive option to make programmes for other companies.
translation: 为其他公司制作节目也不失为一个好的选择。

meaning: adj. 可以任意选择的
example: We also recommend a full day optional excursion to the Upper Douro.
translation: 我们还推荐去杜罗河上游的短途自选一日游。

meaning: conj. 或，或者；即
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 口头的；口的
example: The story of King Arthur became part of oral tradition.
translation: 亚瑟王的故事成为口头传说的一部分。

meaning: n. 橙(树)；柑(树)
example: Hybridising the two species will reduce the red to orange.
translation: 将这两个物种杂交后颜色会由红色淡化成橙色。

meaning: n. 运行轨道; v. 环绕
example: The planet is probably in orbit around a small star.
translation: 这颗行星可能正环绕着一颗小恒星运行。

meaning: n. 管弦乐队
example: The orchestra gave its first performance on Whit Monday.
translation: 乐团在周一的圣灵降临节举行了首场演出。

meaning: n. 次序；整齐; v. 命令
example: The waiter returned with their order and Graham signed the bill.
translation: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。

meaning: adj. 整洁的；有秩序的
example: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
translation: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

meaning: adj. 平常的；平凡的
example: It was just an ordinary voice, but he sang in tune.
translation: 他声音很一般，但唱得都在调子上。

meaning: n. 矿，矿石，矿砂
example: We dowse oil and ore in South America for big companies.
translation: 我们在南美洲为一些大公司探测石油和矿石。

meaning: n. 器官；机构；管风琴
example: The patient'simmune system would reject the transplanted organ as a foreign object.
translation: 病人的免疫系统会对移植器官产生异质排斥反应。

meaning: adj. 有机体的；器官的
example: Today's organic wine producer is typically a small, quality-conscious family concern.
translation: 现今的有机葡萄酒生产商一般是注重品质的小型家族企业.

meaning: n. 生物体；有机体
example: The human organism learns partly by nature, partly by nurture.
translation: 人的学习能力部分是天生的，部分是后天培养的。

meaning: n. 组织；团体，机构
example: The term "organization" often connotes a sense of neatness.
translation: organization这个词常常让人想到整洁。

meaning: v. 组织，编组
example: In the end, we all decided to organize a concert for Easter.
translation: 最终，我们一致决定组织一场复活节音乐会。

meaning: adj. 东方的；东方国家的
example: It sells everything from hair ribbons to oriental rugs.
translation: 这里出售各种商品，从发带到东方小地毯应有尽有。

meaning: n. 起源，由来；出身
example: There are some areas of wetland which are of ancient origin.
translation: 有一些湿地在古代就形成了。

meaning: adj. 最初的；新颖的
example: The new town would have been unrecognisable to the original inhabitants.
translation: 原来的居民可能会认不出这个崭新的城镇了。

meaning: n. 装饰物；装饰
example: The clock is simply for ornament; it doesn't work any more.
translation: 这架时钟纯属摆设，它再也不走了。

meaning: n. 孤儿
example: I'm an orphan and pretty much grew up on my own.
translation: 我是个孤儿，差不多是靠自己长大的。

meaning: adj. 另外的；其余的
example: You can chat to other people who are online.
translation: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。

meaning: adv. 另外；要不然
example: Was it just a temporary blip on an otherwise healthy growth curve?
translation: 这是否是原本良好的增长曲线中暂时的偏离？

meaning: v. aux应当，应该
example: The money to build the power station ought to have been sufficient.
translation: 建设电站的资金本该足够了。

meaning: n. 盎司，英两
example: This little ball of gold weighs a quarter of an ounce.
translation: 这个小金球重0.25盎司。

meaning: pron. 我们的
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: pron. 我们的
example: The world of the gods is anthropomorphic, an imitative projection of ours.
translation: 神界是拟人化的，是模仿我们人类世界的一个投影。

meaning: pron. 我们自己
example: We sat round the fire to keep ourselves warm.
translation: 我们围坐在火边取暖。

meaning: adv. 出，在外；现出来
example: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
translation: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

meaning: n. 结果，后果，成果
example: Jockeys are forbidden to bet on the outcome of races.
translation: 职业赛马骑师禁止对赛马结果下注。

meaning: adj. 户外的，室外的
example: There is an inviting restaurant with an outdoor terrace.
translation: 有一家诱人的带露天阳台的饭馆。

meaning: adv. 在户外，在野外
example: Life in the great outdoors isn't supposed to be luxurious.
translation: 美好的户外活动不必很奢侈。

meaning: adj. 外部的，外面的
example: There is room for infill between the new outer suburbs.
translation: 在新建的远郊住宅区之间还有空地可以盖房。

meaning: n. 出口，出路；排遣
example: Her father had found an outlet for his ambition in his work.
translation: 她父亲在工作中找到了施展抱负的机会。

meaning: n. 轮廓；略图；大纲
example: He could see only the hazy outline of the goalposts.
translation: 他只能看见球门柱模糊的轮廓。

meaning: n. 观点，看法；展望
example: He remained for some years avowedly radical in his political outlook.
translation: 他多年来保持公然激进的政治观。

meaning: n. 产量；输出量；输出
example: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.
translation: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

meaning: n. 开始，开端
example: Almost from the outset, the extravaganza was beset with difficulties.
translation: 几乎从一开始, 这一盛事就被种种困难所困扰.

meaning: n. 外部；外表a外部的
example: The President's unescorted vehicle was ambushed just outside the capital.
translation: 刚出首都，总统无人护卫的汽车就遭到了伏击。

meaning: n. 外边，郊区
example: The hotel is situated in the outskirt of the city.
translation: 这个酒店位于城市的郊区,是全城最好的酒店之一.

meaning: adj. 突出的，杰出的
example: You have to pay your outstanding bill before joining the scheme.
translation: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。

meaning: adj. 外面的；向外的
example: Normally, such an outward display of affection is reserved for his mother.
translation: 通常，只有在母亲面前他的情感才会如此外露。

meaning: adv. 向外，往海外
example: The idea is to spread social democracy and economics outwards from Europe.
translation: 其目的是将欧洲的社会民主与经济制度传播到世界各地。

meaning: n. 炉，灶；烘箱
example: You'll be amazed at the culinary creations possible in a Dutch oven.
translation: 荷兰烤箱能够做的食物之多会让你感到惊奇。

meaning: prep. 在…上方；超过
example: When the right woman comes along, this bad dream will be over.
translation: 当有合适的女人出现时，这种胡思乱想就会停止了。

meaning: n. 工装裤; adj. 全面的
example: The college has few ways to assess the quality of education overall.
translation: 总体看来,这所大学评估教育质量的方法寥寥无几.

meaning: n. 外衣，大衣
example: It was freezing out there even in his buttoned-up overcoat.
translation: 外面非常冷，即使穿上大衣扣上扣子也不顶事。

meaning: v. 战胜，克服
example: Having identified the problem, the question arises of how to overcome it.
translation: 发现问题后，如何克服它的问题又出现了。

meaning: adj. 在头顶上的；架空的
example: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.
translation: 现在，顶灯已装上了一个白色球状罩子。

meaning: v. 眺望；看漏；放任
example: The owners don't want to overlook any opportunity to make a buck.
translation: 老板们不想错过任何可以赚钱的机会。

meaning: adv. 一夜；突然
example: There were two bomb explosions in the city overnight.
translation: 一夜之间城里发生了两起炸弹爆炸事件。

meaning: adv. 海外; adj. 在海外的
example: Large overseas-based trusts are an excellent each way bet.
translation: 大型海外基金的投资前景非常好。

meaning: v. 追上，赶上；压倒
example: Pulling out to overtake, the car collided head-on with a van.
translation: 越线超车时，轿车和一辆厢式货车迎面相撞。

meaning: adj. 超时的，加班的
example: He would work overtime, without pay, to finish a job.
translation: 他会为了完成工作无偿加班。

meaning: v. 欠；应把…归功于
example: I'm broke, Livy, and I owe a couple of million dollars.
translation: 我破产了，莉薇，而且我欠了几百万美元的债。

meaning: n. 猫头鹰，枭
example: The owl is sacred for many Californian Indian people.
translation: 对于很多加利福尼亚的印第安人而言，猫头鹰是圣物。

meaning: adj. 自己的; v. 有，拥有
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: n. 物主，所有人
example: The former owner had not left any forwarding address.
translation: 以前的房主没有留下任何转递地址。

meaning: n. 所有(权)，所有制
example: Brazil says its constitution forbids the private ownership of energy assets.
translation: 巴西称其宪法禁止个人占有能源资产。

meaning: n. 牛；公牛，阉牛
example: Seize a horse by the mane, and lead an ox by the nose.
translation: 马儿抓鬃牛牵鼻.

meaning: n. 步，步速; v. 踱步
example: Interest rates would come down as the recovery gathered pace.
translation: 随着复苏的加速，利率会降下来。

meaning: adj. 和平的; n. 太平洋
example: pacific ocean
translation: n. 太平洋

meaning: v. 捆扎；挤满; n. 包
example: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
translation: 我尽量言简意赅。

meaning: n. 包裹，包，捆
example: Investors can apply for a package of shares at a set price.
translation: 投资者可以申购固定价格的股票组合。

meaning: n. 小包(裹)，小捆
example: You could save yourself a packet.
translation: 你能为自己省一大笔钱。

meaning: n. 垫；本子; v. 填塞
example: Keep a pad handy to jot down queries as they occur.
translation: 手边放一本便笺簿，以便有问题时随时记下。

meaning: n. 页
example: The correct answers can be found at the bottom of page 8.
translation: 正确答案在第8页末尾。

meaning: n. 痛，疼痛；辛苦
example: I felt a sharp pain in my lower back.
translation: 我感觉到后腰一阵剧痛。

meaning: adj. 使痛的；费力的
example: Economic reform will continue to be painful and ineffective.
translation: 经济改革仍将举步维艰，毫无成效。

meaning: v. 画；油漆; v. 绘画
example: The walls have been horribly vandalized with spray paint.
translation: 墙上被人用喷漆涂得乱七八糟。

meaning: n. 漆工，画家，绘画者
example: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
translation: 画家可能会对线条和形状进行夸大或扭曲。

meaning: n. 油画；绘画；着色
example: Visitors see the painting from behind a plate glass window.
translation: 参观者隔着平板玻璃橱窗欣赏那幅画。

meaning: n. 一对; v. 成对，配对
example: On the mantelpiece are a pair of bronze Ming vases.
translation: 壁炉台上是一对明代的青铜花瓶。

meaning: n. 宫，宫殿
example: He recounted how heavily armed soldiers forced him from the presidential palace.
translation: 他讲述了自己是怎样被全副武装的士兵从总统官邸里赶出来的。

meaning: adj. 苍白的；浅的
example: In the background, dressed in pale green, stood Eunice.
translation: 尤妮斯穿着浅绿色的衣服站在后面不起眼的地方。

meaning: n. 手掌，手心；掌状物
example: He cupped her chin in the palm of his hand.
translation: 他用手心托着她的下巴。

meaning: n. 平底锅，盘子
example: Put a pan of salted water on to boil.
translation: 将一锅盐水放上去煮。

meaning: n. 专门小组；面，板
example: All objects are vetted by a distinguished panel of experts.
translation: 所有物品都交由一个著名的专家小组检查鉴定。

meaning: n. 纸；官方文件；文章
example: He wiped away the blood with a paper napkin.
translation: 他用纸巾将血迹擦去。

meaning: n. 游行；检阅; v. 游行
example: Morning parade was in progress on the parade ground.
translation: 阅兵场正在进行早间检阅。

meaning: n. (文章的)段，节
example: Look at the information that precedes the paragraph in question.
translation: 查看正在讨论的这段文字前面的信息。

meaning: adj. 平行的；相同的
example: Parallel lines will never meet no matter how far extended.
translation: 无论延伸多长，平行线永不相交。

meaning: n. 包裹，小包，邮包
example: It's all part and parcel— just a day's work really you know.
translation: 这只是一部分——才一天的工作，你要知道。

meaning: n. 原谅；赦免; v. 原谅
example: It's enough to make you wet yourself, if you'll pardon the expression.
translation: 这足以吓得你尿裤子了，请原谅我这么说。

meaning: n. 父亲，母亲，双亲
example: Many children are now born into or raised in one-parent families.
translation: 现在很多孩子在单亲家庭中出生或成长。

meaning: n. 公园；停车场
example: The car park was absolutely packed solid with people.
translation: 停车场被人挤得水泄不通。

meaning: n. 议会，国会
example: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
translation: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

meaning: n. 一部分；零件；本份
example: These days work plays an important part in a single woman's life.
translation: 现在，工作在单身女性的生活中起着重要作用。

meaning: adj. 部分的；不公平的
example: The Partial Test-Ban Treaty bans nuclear testing in the atmosphere.
translation: 《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止在大气层中进行核试验。

meaning: v. 参与，参加；分享
example: This in effect denied them their right to participate meaningfully in elections.
translation: 这实际上是剥夺了他们正式参与选举的权利。

meaning: n. 粒子，微粒
example: A proton is an elementary particle of matter.
translation: 质子是物质的基本粒子。

meaning: adj. 特殊的；特定的
example: We are taught to construe these terms in a particular way.
translation: 我们被教导要以特定的方式理解这些词语。

meaning: adv. 特别，尤其，格外
example: Be particularly fastidious about washing your hands before touching food.
translation: 接触食物前尤其对洗手不能有半点马虎。

meaning: adv. 部分地，不完全地
example: I feel partly responsible for the problems we're in.
translation: 我觉得应为我们遭遇的问题负部分责任。

meaning: n. 伙伴；搭挡；配偶
example: Your partner should then pass the ball back to you.
translation: 然后你的搭档应该将球回传给你。

meaning: n. 党，党派；聚会
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: n. 乘客，旅客，过路人

meaning: n. 激情，热情；爱好

meaning: adj. 被动的；消极的

meaning: n. 护照

meaning: adj. 过去的; n. 过去

translation: 在肉上切出深深的口子，再把辣酱塞进切口中。

meaning: n. 忍耐，容忍，耐心

translation: 非暴力和忍耐是他们的信仰的核心原则。

meaning: n. 型，式样，模，模型

translation: 她会教你如何搭配款式和颜色。

meaning: n. 脚爪，爪子

translation: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。

meaning: n. 支付，支付的款项

meaning: n. 和平；和睦；平静

translation: 通往和平的道路将很漫长。

meaning: adj. 和平的；安静的
example: Altogether, it was a delightful town garden, peaceful and secluded.
translation: 总体上说，这是个令人愉快的城市花园，宁静而偏僻。

meaning: n. 桃子，桃树

translation: 第二年夏天桃树就结满了桃子。

meaning: n. 山顶，巅; adj. 最高的
example: The news programme goes out four times a week at peak time.
translation: 这档新闻节目每周在黄金时段播出4次。

meaning: n. 梨子，梨树

translation: 花园里，苹果树和梨树患枯枝病最明显。

meaning: n. 农民

translation: 经济改革给农民带来了相对的财富。

meaning: adj. 特有的；特别的

translation: 在1,000英尺的高度飞行时，他听到旋翼发出一种奇怪的噪音。

meaning: n. 钢笔，自来水笔

translation: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

meaning: n. 铅笔

translation: 他捡起一支铅笔，无所事事地摆弄着。

meaning: vt. 穿过; vi. 穿入
example: They are hoping to penetrate the Japanese market with their latest product.
translation: 他们希望他们的最新产品能打进日本市场.

meaning: n. (英)便士；(美)分

translation: 这家公司的主管们觉得他值得栽培。

meaning: n. 人民，民族；人
example: You can chat to other people who are online.
translation: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。

meaning: prep. 每

translation: 他像英格兰人那样将它读成Per-sha。

meaning: v. 察觉，发觉；理解
example: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader.
translation: 投票者认为他是一位坚定果断的国际领导人。

meaning: n. 百分之…
example: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
translation: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

meaning: n. 百分比，百分率

translation: 学工科的女孩的比例已经大大增加了。

meaning: adj. 完美的；完全的

translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

meaning: v. 履行，执行；演出

translation: 他能表演好几种令人惊叹的把戏，包括哑剧和玩杂耍。

meaning: n. 履行；演出；行为
example: At the highest executive levels earnings and performance aren't always correlated.
translation: 在最高管理层，收入与工作表现并不总是相关的。

meaning: adv. 也许，可能，多半
example: The horrors he experienced are imprinted, perhaps indelibly, in his brain.
translation: 他经历的恐怖事件在他脑海中刻下了深深的，或许是难以磨灭的印记。

meaning: n. 时期；学时；句号

translation: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

meaning: adj. 永久的，持久的

translation: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

meaning: n. 允许，许可，同意
example: Police said permission for the march had not been granted.
translation: 警方说游行并未得到批准。

meaning: v. 允许; n. 执照

translation: 他有权维持法庭判决，批准死刑生效。

meaning: v. 坚持，固执；持续

translation: 如果这些症状持续存在，一定要去看医生。

meaning: n. 人；人身；本人
example: She is a long way from being the richest person in Britain.
translation: 比起英国首富，她还差得远呢。

meaning: adj. 个人的；本人的
example: My personal life has had to take second place to my career.
translation: 我的私人生活不得不让位于事业。

meaning: n. 全体人员，全体职员
example: I looked your address up in the personnel file.
translation: 我在人事档案里找到了你的地址。

meaning: n. 透视；远景；观点
example: It's the collision of disparate ideas that alters one's perspective.
translation: 是迥然不同的观点之间的碰撞改变了人们的看法。

meaning: v. 说服; v. 被说服
example: Somehow, he'd managed to persuade Kay to buy one for him.
translation: 不知用了什么方法，他成功说服凯给他买了一个。

meaning: adj. 悲观的；厌世的
example: Hardy has often been criticised for an excessively pessimistic view of life.
translation: 哈代由于对生活持过度悲观的态度而常常受到批评。

meaning: n. 爱畜；宠儿a宠爱的
example: They would sell the meat off as pet food.
translation: 他们将把肉当作宠物食品卖掉。

meaning: n. (英)汽油
example: The crowds became violent and threw petrol bombs at the police.
translation: 人群变得狂暴起来，并向警察投掷汽油弹。

meaning: n. 石油
example: Petroleum engineers plan and manage the extraction of oil.
translation: 石油工程师规划并管理石油的提炼。

meaning: n. 阶段；方面；相位
example: The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.
translation: 实际上写作过程中最重要的阶段是修改。

meaning: n. 现象
example: This phenomenon is not as outrageous as it seems.
translation: 这种现象并不像它看上去那样骇人。

meaning: n. 哲学家

translation: 希腊哲学家亚里士多德

meaning: n. 哲学；哲理；人生观
example: Apart from criminal investigation techniques, students learn forensic medicine, philosophy and logic.
translation: 除罪案调查技巧外，学生们还要学习法医学、哲学和逻辑学。

meaning: n. 电话，电话机；耳机

translation: 我拿起了电话，她知趣地进了客厅。

meaning: n. 照片，相片
example: The popular papers all have photo features on their inside pages.
translation: 通俗报纸的内页都有照片专栏.

meaning: n. 照片，相片
example: He tore down the girl's photograph, and crumpled it into a ball.
translation: 他一把扯下那女孩的照片，将它揉成一团。

meaning: n. 短语；习惯用语

translation: 会上发言者的一句话让我思绪飘远。

meaning: adj. 物质的；物理的
example: Physical and ideological barriers had come down in Eastern Europe.
translation: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

meaning: n. 医生，内科医生
example: I'm a practicing physician trying to help people here and now.
translation: 我是一名此时此刻只想治病救人的执业医师。

meaning: n. 物理学家

translation: 我想他大概是物理学家或那一类的人.

meaning: n. 物理学

translation: 物理学并非只是一门不能直接运用的纯科学。

meaning: n. 钢琴

translation: 他7岁开始上钢琴课。

meaning: n. 镐，鹤嘴锄

translation: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

meaning: n. 郊游，野餐; v. 野餐

translation: 放学后我带孩子们去公园野餐。

meaning: n. 画，图片; v. 画
example: Police have released an E-fit picture of the suspected gunman.
translation: 警方已公布持枪嫌犯的电子画像。

meaning: n. (西点)馅饼

translation: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

meaning: n. 碎片，块; v. 拼合

translation: 真是太没头脑了，我要告诉他我很生气。

meaning: v. 剌穿; v. 穿入

translation: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

meaning: n. 猪，小猪，野猪

meaning: n. 鸽子

translation: 一只鸽子从塔里钻出来，扑扑地拍打着翅膀。

meaning: n. 堆; v. 堆叠，累积

translation: 桌上空盘子的旁边是一堆书。

meaning: n. 药丸，丸剂

translation: 服用避孕药是最有效的避孕方法。

meaning: n. 柱，柱子；栋梁

meaning: n. 枕头

meaning: v. 捏，拧，掐掉

meaning: n. 松树，松木

meaning: n. 粉红色; adj. 粉红色的

translation: 他正拿着一块布，布上粉红色的水滴落在地板上。

meaning: n. 品脱

translation: 再给罗杰来一杯，伊莫金，我也再来一份同样的。

meaning: n. 拓荒者；先驱者

translation: 她参加争取妇女选举权的运动，也是节育倡导者。

meaning: n. 管子，导管；烟斗

translation: 别说了，我来告诉你我想要什么。

meaning: n. 坑，地坑；煤矿

translation: 金矿并非无底的宝藏，金子终究会被采光。

meaning: n. 沥青

meaning: n. 怜悯；遗憾; v. 同情

meaning: n. 平原; adj. 清楚的

translation: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

meaning: n&vt. 计划，打算

translation: 计划不错；问题在于不够深入。

meaning: n. 平面；飞机
example: The plane has been kept in service far longer than originally intended.
translation: 这架飞机已经超期服役很长时间了。

meaning: n. 行星
example: The blue whale is the largest living thing on the planet.
translation: 蓝鲸是地球上体型最大的生物。

meaning: n. 植物；工厂; v. 栽种
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: n. 种植园；栽植
example: On the left was a plantation of almond trees.
translation: 左边是一个杏树园。

meaning: adj. 可塑的; n. 塑料
example: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
translation: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

meaning: n. 板，片，盘; v. 电镀
example: Garnish the plate with whipped cream rosettes and fresh fruits.
translation: 用玫瑰花形的掼奶油和新鲜的水果作配菜点缀盘子。

meaning: n. 平台；站台；讲台
example: PLATFORM is an alliance of more than 80 rail-user groups.
translation: PLATFORM公司是80多个铁路用户组的联盟。

meaning: v. 玩，游戏；演奏

translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: n. 游戏的人；比赛者
example: As a player he was unselfish, a true team man.
translation: 作为一名选手，他毫无私念，真正把自己摆在团队中。

meaning: n. 操场，运动场
example: There was a sandpit, a seesaw and a swing in the playground.
translation: 游乐场上有一处沙坑、一块跷跷板和一个秋千架。

meaning: adj. 令人愉快的，舒适的
example: Lloyd George was most anxious to be agreeable and pleasant.
translation: 劳埃德·乔治极力想表现得平易近人、和蔼亲切。

meaning: v. 使高兴，请vi满意
example: "Please understand this," she began, a tremble in her voice.
translation: “请理解这一点，”她开始说道，声音有些发颤。

meaning: n. 愉快，快乐；乐事
example: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

meaning: adj. 丰富的，富裕的
example: There is a plentiful supply of arms on the black market.
translation: 黑市上有大量武器出售。

meaning: n. 丰富，充足，大量
example: There were plenty of servants to wait on her.
translation: 有很多仆人服侍她。

meaning: n. 小块土地; v. 密谋
example: Sadly, the film is let down by an excessively simple plot.
translation: 遗憾的是，过于简单的情节使得这部电影差强人意。

meaning: n. 犁; vt&vi. 犁，耕
example: It would pay farmers to plough up the scrub and plant wheat.
translation: 它会出钱雇农民开垦这块低矮丛林来种植麦子。

meaning: n. 塞子；插头; v. 塞
example: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.
translation: 钻孔已塞上了塞子。

meaning: v. 使投入；使陷入
example: Take the opportunity to plunge yourself into your career.
translation: 抓住机会投身到事业中去。

meaning: adj. 复数的; n. 复数
example: What is the plural of "person"?
translation: person的复数形式是什么？

meaning: prep. 加，加上; adj. 正的
example: There are only 35 staff to serve 30,000-plus customers.
translation: 只有35名员工，却要为3万多顾客服务。

meaning: n. 衣袋; n. 袖珍的
example: He spends most of his pocket money on PlayStation games.
translation: 他大部分零花钱都用来买PS游戏了。

meaning: n. 诗，韵文，诗体文
example: At my brother's high school graduation the students recited a poem.
translation: 在我弟弟的高中毕业典礼上，学生们朗诵了一首诗。

meaning: n. 诗人
example: The concept of the Rose continued to inform the poet's work.
translation: 玫瑰的概念持续贯穿于诗人的作品中。

meaning: n. 诗，诗歌，诗作
example: I myself enjoy cinema, poetry, eating out and long walks.
translation: 我本人喜欢电影、诗歌、外出吃饭和远途散步。

meaning: n. 点；要点；细目；分

translation: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

meaning: n. 毒，毒药; v. 毒害
