translation: “这全视乎你对朋克摇滚乐的定义，不是吗？”

meaning: adj. 最终的,决定性的; n. 结局;决赛;期末考试
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: adv. 最后,最终;决定性地
example: At approxi-mately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search.
translation: 大概晚上11点半的时候，波拉德最终同意进行搜查。

meaning: n. 财政,金融; v. 为…提供资金
example: The finance minister will continue to mastermind Poland's economic reform.
translation: 财政部长将继续策划波兰的经济改革。

meaning: adj. 财政的,金融的
example: The enquiry dug deeper into the alleged financial misdeeds of his government.
translation: 这一调查对其政府涉嫌的财政违规行为展开了进一步深究。

meaning: adj. 晴朗的,美好的,细致的; v&n. 罚金,罚款
example: "I want to send a telegram." — "Fine, to whom?"
translation: “我想发份电报。”——“好的，发给谁？”

meaning: n. 手指;指状物;指针
example: Isn't it about time that you pulled your finger out?
translation: 现在到了你该赶紧动起来的时候了吧？

meaning: n. 完成;结束;磨光; v. 完成;结束;用完;毁掉
example: Elliott crossed the finish line just half a second behind his adversary.
translation: 埃利奥特跨过终点线时仅比对手落后半秒钟。

meaning: adj. 有限的；[数]有穷的,限定的
example: The fossil fuels (coal and oil) are finite resources.
translation: 化石燃料（如煤和石油）属于有限资源。

meaning: adj. 无限的,无穷的; n. 无限
example: The most amazing thing about nature is its infinite variety.
translation: 大自然最让人惊叹的是它的无限多样性。

meaning: v. 精炼,精制,提纯;使文雅,使高尚
example: We shall have to refine on our methods of advertising.
translation: 我们得进一步改进做广告的方法.

meaning: n. 碎片,小部分,一点儿;分数
example: If a stranger stops you, just wind the window down a fraction.
translation: 如果有陌生人拦你的车，把车窗摇下一点点就行。

meaning: n. 裂缝(痕);骨折; v. (使)断裂,(使)折断
example: He suffered a hairline fracture of the right index finger.
translation: 他右手食指骨裂。

meaning: adj. 易碎的，脆的，易损坏的；虚弱的，脆弱的
example: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
translation: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

meaning: n. 碎片,小部分,片断
example: This was only a fragment of a long conversation with John.
translation: 这仅仅是与约翰长谈的一个片断.

meaning: adj. 香的;芬芳的
example: It leaves your hair smelling deliciously fresh and fragrant.
translation: 它会让头发闻起来清新、芳香，令人愉悦。

meaning: adj. 凶猛的,残忍的;狂热的,强烈的
example: The area has been the scene of fierce fighting for three months.
translation: 这一地区3个月以来不断发生激战。

meaning: n. 形状,形式;表格; v. 组成,构成;形成
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: v. (to)遵守，适应；相似，一致，符合
example: Taxis must conform to the rigorous standards laid down by the police.
translation: 出租车必须遵守警方的严格规定。

meaning: adj. 正式的;形式的
example: A formal contract is signed which is renewable annually.
translation: 正式签订了每年可续签的合同。

meaning: n. (出版物的)开本,版式,格式; v. 设计;安排
example: A new format would alienate its ageing readership without attracting young readers.
translation: 新的版式会疏远上了年纪的读者群，并且也不会吸引年轻读者。

meaning: n. 形成;构成;组织;构造;编制;塑造
example: They saw a squadron of fifteen motorcycle policemen driving in V-formation.
translation: 他们看见15名警察骑着摩托车排成V字形前行。

meaning: adj. 以前的,在前的; pron. 前者
example: The unemployed executives include former sales managers, directors and accountants.
translation: 被解雇的管理人员包括前销售经理、主管和会计。

meaning: adj. 强大的;令人敬畏的;可怕的;艰难的
example: They possess a formidable arsenal of rifles, machine guns, landmines and teargas.
translation: 他们持有的步枪、机枪、地雷和催泪弹数量惊人。

meaning: n. (pl.e)公式;规则;分子式;药方
example: There is no magic formula for producing winning products.
translation: 获奖电影的制作没有捷径可取。

meaning: v. 用公式表示;规划;设计;系统地阐述
example: He took care to formulate his reply very clearly.
translation: 他字斟句酌,清楚地做了回答.

meaning: v. (of,about)通知,告诉,报告;告发,告密
example: Teachers inform me that Tracey's behaviour has improved no end.
translation: 老师们告诉我特雷西的行为大有改善。

meaning: n. 通知,报告;情报,资料,消息;信息
example: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information.
translation: 房间很安静，无人主动提供更多的信息。

meaning: v. 履行,执行;表演,演出;完成(事业)
example: He can perform an astonishing variety of acts, including mime and juggling.
translation: 他能表演好几种令人惊叹的把戏，包括哑剧和玩杂耍。

meaning: n. 履行,执行;表演,演出;性能,特性;成绩
example: At the highest executive levels earnings and performance aren't always correlated.
translation: 在最高管理层，收入与工作表现并不总是相关的。

meaning: n. 平台,台;站台,月台;政纲,党纲
example: PLATFORM is an alliance of more than 80 rail-user groups.
translation: PLATFORM公司是80多个铁路用户组的联盟。

meaning: v&n. 改革,改造,改良
example: The government wanted to reform the institutions, to shake up the country.
translation: 政府想要实施机构改革，整顿国家。

meaning: v. 改变,变换;变压;转化;改造,改造
example: fourier transform
translation: 傅里叶变换

meaning: n. 制服,军服; adj. 相同的,一律的
example: The uniformitarian principle, like any other scientific " law ", rests on the objective circumstance.
translation: 均变说原理, 象其它任何科学 “ 定律 ” 一样, 是以客观环境作为根据的.

meaning: n. 毛,毛皮
example: We were amused to see how assiduously the animal groomed its fur.
translation: 看着这只动物如此认真地梳理自己的毛，我们被逗乐了。

meaning: adj. 狂怒的,狂暴的,猛烈的
example: I am absolutely furious that he divorced me to marry her.
translation: 他为了娶她而和我离婚，我愤怒至极。

meaning: n. 炉子,熔炉
example: The flame in the furnace can be looked at through coloured glasses.
translation: 可以通过有色眼镜观看高炉内的火焰.

meaning: v. 供应,提供;装备,布置
example: Can you furnish the committee with statements of the costs?
translation: 你能把开支清单提交委员会 吗 ?

meaning: n. 家具
example: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

meaning: n. 保险丝,导火线,引信; v. 熔化,熔合
example: The fuse blew as he pressed the button to start the motor.
translation: 他按下按钮启动马达的时候保险丝烧断了。

meaning: v. 使混乱,混淆
example: I think it's a serious mistake to confuse books with life.
translation: 我认为把书本同生活混为一谈是大错特错。

meaning: n. 困惑，糊涂；混淆；混乱，骚乱
example: His mind was a haze of fear and confusion.
translation: 由于害怕和困惑，他当时处于一种混沌状态。

meaning: v. 扩散;传播; adj. (文章等)冗长的,漫无边际的
example: A cold, diffuse light filtered in through the skylight.
translation: 一道冰冷的光线透过天窗漫射进来。

meaning: n. 拒绝,回绝
example: They cited Alex's refusal to return to the marital home.
translation: 他们引证了亚历克斯拒绝回到婚后的家中一事。

meaning: v. 拒绝,谢绝; n. 废物,垃圾
example: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
translation: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

meaning: n. 基因
example: He found evidence of mutated forms of the gene.
translation: 他找到了该基因出现了变异形式的证据。

meaning: v. 衰退,堕落,蜕化; adj. 堕落的; n. 堕落者
example: Will too much freedom make them degenerate?
translation: 太多的自由会令他们堕落 吗 ?

meaning: n. (生理上的)性；(名词、代词等的)性
example: Dara challenges our stereotypical ideas about gender and femininity.
translation: 达拉对我们老一套的性别和女性特质观念提出了异议。

meaning: adj. 一般的,普通的;总的,大体的; n. 将军
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: v. (generalise)归纳,概括;推广,普及
example: It would be foolish to generalize from a single example.
translation: 仅从一个事例进行归纳的做法是愚蠢的。

meaning: v. 产生,发生;生殖
example: The company, New England Electric, burns coal to generate power.
translation: 新英格兰电力公司用煤发电。

meaning: n. 产生,发生;一代(人)
example: A new generation of scientists became fascinated by dinosaurs.
translation: 新一代科学家对恐龙研究着了迷。

meaning: n. 发电机,发生器
example: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.
translation: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

meaning: adj. 宽宏大量的,慷慨的
example: Not everyone thinks that the government is being particularly generous.
translation: 并非所有人都认为政府特别慷慨。

meaning: adj. 遗传(学)的; n. [-s]遗传学
example: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
translation: 子女身上遗传了父母双方的基因型板。

meaning: n. 天才
example: I was hoping some of his genius might rub off.
translation: 我希望他的才华也可以影响他人。

meaning: adj. 和蔼的,文雅的,有礼貌的
example: The blustery winds of spring had dropped to a gentle breeze.
translation: 呼啸的春风已经减弱，成了习习的微风。

meaning: adv. 文雅地,有礼貌地;轻轻地
example: If your child's temperature rises, sponge her down gently with tepid water.
translation: 如果你孩子的体温上升，就用海绵蘸上温水轻轻地擦拭她的身体。

meaning: adj. 真正的,名副其实的
example: genuine leather
translation: 真皮

meaning: adj. 同种类的，同性质的，有相同特征的
example: They are homogeneous people.
translation: 他们是同类人.

meaning: adj. 机敏的;有独创性的;精致的;精巧制成的
example: ingenious ways of saving energy
translation: 节约能源的巧妙方法

meaning: adj. 怀孕的；富有意义的
example: The number of women who become pregnant after adopting children is legion.
translation: 领养小孩后怀孕的妇女比比皆是。

meaning: adj. 恶性的，致命的；恶意的，恶毒的
example: She developed a malignant breast tumour.
translation: 她长了一个恶性的乳房肿瘤。

meaning: v. 诊断(疾病)；判断(问题)
example: He could diagnose an engine problem simply by listening.
translation: 他仅靠听就能判断发动机出了什么问题。

meaning: n. (举止,态度等的)庄严,端庄;尊贵,高贵
example: It's an affront to human dignity to keep someone alive like this.
translation: 如此维持一个人的生命是对人类尊严的冒犯。

meaning: adj. 愤慨的,愤慨不平的
example: MPs were indignant that the government had not consulted them.
translation: 政府没有事先征求他们的意见，下院议员们感到很愤怒。

meaning: n. 愤怒,愤慨
example: He bristled with indignation at the suggestion that he was racist.
translation: 有人暗示他是个种族主义者，他对此十分恼火。

meaning: adj. 认知的，认识能力的
example: a child's cognitive development
translation: 儿童的认知开发

meaning: n. 认出,辨认;承认
example: But by the year 2020 business computing will have changed beyond recognition.
translation: 但是到了2020年，商业计算会变得面目全非。

meaning: v. (recognise)认出,承认,公认,赏识,表扬
n. 等级,级别;年级;分数; v. 分等,分级
example: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.
translation: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

meaning: adj. n&adj摄氏温度计(的);百分度(的)
example: The number at the bottom is the recommended water temperature in Centigrade.
translation: 底部的数字就是推荐的摄氏水温。

meaning: adj. 逐渐的,逐步的
example: The roads are built to accommodate gradual temperature changes.
translation: 修建这些道路时考虑到了温度的逐渐变化。

meaning: n. 大学毕业生,研究生v.大学毕业a.毕了业的
example: My first job was as a graduate trainee with a bank.
translation: 我的第一份工作是在一家银行做大学毕业实习生。

meaning: v. 提升,使升级
example: China's press spokesman system has had three problems during its upgrowth.
translation: 中国新闻发言人制度发展中存在三大问题.

meaning: v. (on)祝贺,向…致贺词
example: He was generous enough to congratulate his successor on his decision.
translation: 他十分大度地祝贺他的继任者做出了决定。

meaning: n. (on)祝贺,(pl.)祝贺词
example: This is not a matter for self-congratulation.
translation: 你不应该为此事沾沾自喜。

meaning: n. 失宠,耻辱; v. 使失宠;玷辱,使蒙羞
example: Republican leaders called him a disgrace to the party.
translation: 共和党领导人称他是全党的耻辱。

meaning: n. 优美,文雅;恩惠,恩泽;宽限,缓刑;感恩祷告
example: Grace tapped on the bedroom door and went in.
translation: 格雷丝轻轻敲了敲卧室的门，走了进去。

meaning: adj. 优美的,文雅的,大方的
example: His handwriting, from earliest young manhood, was flowing and graceful.
translation: 他的字从小就写得流畅优美。

meaning: adj. 亲切的,客气的;宽厚的,仁慈的
example: Good gracious, look at that specimen will you?
translation: 哎呀，你快来瞧瞧那个标本！

meaning: adj. 盛大的,豪华的;重大的,主要的
example: Do you always have a bet on the Grand National?
translation: 你总是对全国赛马大会下点注吗？

meaning: n. 祖母,外祖母
example: She looks disconcertingly like a familiar aunt or grandmother.
translation: 令人疑惑的是，她看上去就像一位面熟的邻家阿姨或是祖母。

meaning: v. 同意,准予;授予; n. 授予物;津贴;转让证书
example: She won a grant to develop her own business.
translation: 她赢得了一笔拨款，用以扩展自己的企业。

meaning: adj. (to,for)感激的;感谢的
example: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
translation: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

meaning: n. 感激,感谢
example: I owe a big debt of gratitude to her.
translation: 我对她万分感激。

meaning: v. 致敬,敬意,迎接;扑(鼻),入(耳),触(目)
example: He looked at Livy and Mark, who had risen to greet him.
translation: 他看着站起来跟他打招呼的莉薇和马克。

meaning: n. 问候,致敬
example: He took her hand in greeting and asked solicitously how everything was.
translation: 他握着她的手表示问候，关切地问她一切是否都好。

meaning: adj. 伟大的；重要的；大量的；很好的；美好的
example: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
translation: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

meaning: pron. [she的宾格]她；[she的所有格]她的
example: Somehow Karin managed to cope with the demands of her career.
translation: 卡琳设法达到了其职业的要求。

meaning: n. 药草，(调味用的)香草，草本植物
example: The herb has been used for centuries to curdle milk.
translation: 那种香草几个世纪以来都被用来制作酸乳。

meaning: n. 群,兽群,牛群; v. 放牧,群集
example: Stefano used a motor cycle to herd the sheep.
translation: 斯特凡诺骑一辆摩托车放羊。

meaning: adv. 在(到，向)这里；这时；在这一点上
example: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
translation: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

meaning: n. 遗产,继承物;传统
example: Ethiopia'sart springs from her early Christian as well as her Muslim heritage.
translation: 埃塞俄比亚的艺术起源于其早期的基督教和伊斯兰教文化遗产。

meaning: n. 英雄，勇士；男主角，男主人公
example: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
translation: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

meaning: adj. 英雄的，英勇的，崇高的
example: The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction.
translation: 公司在降低成本方面付出了艰苦卓绝的努力。

meaning: n. 女英雄;女主角
example: The film concludes with the heroine's death.
translation: 影片以女主角之死结束.

meaning: pron. [she的物主代词]她的(所有物)
example: Hers was a minor part, but she played it with gusto.
translation: 她演的是个小角色，但是演得很投入。

meaning: pron. [反身代词]她自己；她亲自，她本人
example: She dusted herself down and left to build her own career.
translation: 她重振旗鼓去开创自己的事业了。

meaning: adj. 固有的,内在的,天生的
example: Mainline feminism was arguing for the inherent beauty of the natural woman.
translation: 主流女权主义思想倡导女性天生的自然美。

meaning: v. 继承(金钱等)，经遗传而得(性格、特征)
example: Princess Alexandra was to inherit the title of Duchess of Fife.
translation: 亚历山德拉公主将会继承法夫女公爵的爵位。

meaning: n. 牧民,牧羊人
example: A china statuette of a shepherdess stood on the table.
translation: 桌上有一个牧羊女的小瓷像.

meaning: v. (to)粘着；坚持，遵守；依附，追随
example: All members of the association adhere to a strict code of practice.
translation: 协会的所有成员都遵守一套严格的行为规范。

meaning: adj. 一致的，协调的；(话语等)条理清楚的
example: He appeared hardly capable of conducting a coherent conversation.
translation: 他好像连话都说不清楚。

meaning: adj. 粘合性的，有结合力的
example: "Daring Adventures" from '86 is a far more cohesive and successful album.
translation: 1986年发行的《勇于冒险》是一张风格更为统一也更为成功的专辑。

meaning: v. 犹豫,踌躇;含糊,支吾
example: I might today hesitate to turn in a burglar.
translation: 现在让我把入室窃贼送交警方，我可能会有所顾虑。

meaning: v. 喷射,排出;驱逐
example: This safety invention will eject the pilot from a burning plane.
translation: 这个安全装置会把飞行员从燃烧着的飞机中弹出.

meaning: v. 注射(药液等)；注入
example: The result might inject more sense into future bargaining.
translation: 其结果可能为未来的谈判注入更多的理性。

meaning: n. 物体;客体,对象;目标;宾语; v. (to)反对
example: He thought of the baby almost as an inanimate object.
translation: 他认为婴儿几乎就是毫无生命的物体。

meaning: n. (to)反对,异议,不喜欢,反对的理由
example: I no longer have any objection to your going to see her.
translation: 我不会再因为你去见她而不高兴。

meaning: n. 目标,目的; adj. 客观的,真实的
example: I believe that a journalist should be completely objective.
translation: 我认为新闻记者不应当有丝毫偏见。

meaning: n. 方案,工程,项目v.投射,放映;设计,规划
example: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
translation: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

meaning: n. 放映机,幻灯机,投影仪
example: You gave me back the projector.
translation: 你将幻灯机还给我了。

meaning: v. 拒绝,抵制,丢弃,排斥,退掉; n. 落选者
example: We reject any suggestion that the law needs amending.
translation: 对于任何暗示该法律需要修改的观点我们都拒绝接受。

meaning: n. 主题;学科; adj. 隶属的;易遭..的; v. 使隶属
example: on the subject of
translation: 涉及…时

meaning: adj. 主观(上)的，个人的
example: Our preliminary results suggest that people do subjectively find the speech clearer.
translation: 我们的初步结果显示，人们的确在主观上感觉演讲表达得更清晰明了了。

meaning: v. 收集,搜集;领取,接走;收(税等);聚集,堆积
example: Methane gas does collect in the mines around here.
translation: 周围的矿井里的确有沼气聚积。

meaning: n. 收藏(品),收集(物)
example: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
translation: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

meaning: n. 集体; adj. 集体的,共同的
example: They have been galvanised into collective action — militarily, politically and economically.
translation: 他们在形势驱使下已经在政治、经济和军事上采取了联合行动。

meaning: n. 方言
example: In the fifties, many Italians spoke only local dialect.
translation: 在20世纪50年代，许多意大利人只会说当地方言。

meaning: v. 选举,推选;选择,作出选择
example: Councils should be answerable to the people who elect them.
translation: 市政会成员应对推选他们的人负责。

meaning: n. 知识分子; adj. 智力的，理智的，有理解力的
example: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
translation: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

meaning: n. 智力,聪明;理解力;情报,消息,报导
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: adj. 聪明的,明智的,理智的
example: She was thin and spare, with a sharply intelligent face.
translation: 她又高又瘦，一副精明过人的模样。

meaning: adj. 可理解的，明白易懂的，清楚的
example: The language of Darwin was intelligible to experts and non-experts alike.
translation: 达尔文的语言无论对专家还是非专业人士而言都明白易懂。

meaning: n&v. 演讲,讲课
example: Chuck would lecture me, telling me to get a haircut.
translation: 查克就会数落我，让我去理一下发。

meaning: v&n. 忽视;疏忽,漏做,忽略
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: v. 回忆,想起,记起,忆起,记得
example: She could no longer recollect the details of the letter.
translation: 她想不起那封信的细节了。

meaning: v. 选择,挑选; adj. 精选的,选择的
example: She selected a low gear and started down the track carefully.
translation: 她选了低速挡小心翼翼地沿小径下行。

meaning: n. 选择,挑选;选集,精选物
example: The semantic meaning of a sentence is governed by rules called selectional restrictions.
translation: 句子在语义上是否有意义是受被称为选择限制的规则支配的.

meaning: n. 杆,杠杆,手段,途径,工具
example: An elevator mechanic can work the machinery directly by turning this lever.
translation: 电梯修理工可以转动这根杠杆直接操作机器。

meaning: v. 减轻，缓和，缓解(痛苦等)
example: Nowadays, a great deal can be done to alleviate back pain.
translation: 如今，减轻背部疼痛可以有许多方法。

meaning: v. 举起,提拔,振奋,提升...的职位
example: Democracy might elevate the common man to a position of political superiority.
translation: 民主也许能提升普通人的政治地位，让他们产生优越感。

meaning: n. 电梯,升降机
n. 水平，水准，等级; v. 弄平，铺平; adj. 水平的
example: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
translation: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

meaning: n. 征收,征税,征兵; v. 征收,征集,征用
example: It turns out Levy is talking in metaphorical terms.
translation: 利维原来说的是一种比喻。

meaning: n. 光；灯; v. 点燃；照亮; adj. 轻(快)；淡；明亮
example: The light went out, and the room was plunged into darkness.
translation: 灯熄了，屋里陷入一片漆黑。

meaning: v. 使显著,使突出;强调; n. 最精彩的部分
example: Once again, the "Free Press" prefers not to highlight these facts.
translation: “自由新闻”组织再次故意不去突出强调这些事实。

meaning: n. 日光,白昼,黎明
n. 快乐,高兴; v. (使)高兴,(使)欣喜
example: The British team did not disguise their delight at their success.
translation: 英国队毫不掩饰他们获胜的喜悦。

meaning: v. 启发,启蒙,教导
example: She didn't enlighten him about her background.
translation: 她未向他讲明自己的出身背景。

meaning: n. 闪电; adj. 闪电般的,快速的
example: It was unbelievably dramatic as lightning crackled all round the van.
translation: 闪电在货车周围炸开时，情景异常壮观。

meaning: v. 照亮，照明；用灯光装饰；说明，阐释
example: Our interesting teacher could illuminate almost any subject we studied.
translation: 我们这位有趣的老师几乎能解释清楚我们所学的所有科目.

meaning: n. 吸引力,魅力,诱惑物; v. 引诱，吸引
example: The lure of rural life is proving as strong as ever.
translation: 事实证明，乡村生活的魅力丝毫未减。

meaning: n. 幻想，错误的观念；错觉，幻觉，假象
example: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
translation: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

meaning: v. 举例说明,阐明;图解,加插图
example: He quoted some old Chinese sayings to illustrate his points.
translation: 他援用了一些中国话来解释他的论点.

meaning: n. 说明；例证，插图；举例说明
example: The illustration shows a cluster of five roses coloured apricot orange.
translation: 插图上是一簇杏橙色的玫瑰，一共5朵。

meaning: n. 奢侈,华贵;奢侈品; adj. 奢华的,豪华的
example: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
translation: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

meaning: adj. 地方的,当地的;局部的
example: There has been a busy start to polling in today's local elections.
translation: 今天地方选举的投票一开始就人头攒动。

meaning: v. 分配，分派；拨给；划归
example: Our plan is to allocate one member of staff to handle appoint-ments.
translation: 我们的计划是分派一位职员处理预约事宜。

meaning: n. 位置,地点
example: people living in the locality of the power station
translation: 居住在发电站周围地区的人

meaning: v. 查出,探出,查找…地点,使…坐落于,位于
example: Try to locate exactly where the smells are entering the room.
translation: 找找看气味具体是从什么地方散入房间的。

meaning: n. 位置,场所,定位,测位
example: The first duty of a director is to recce his location.
translation: 主管的第一项任务是熟悉所在地区的情况。

meaning: n. 机车,火车头; adj. 运动的,移动的,运载的
example: The Locomotive Construction Company Ltd is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Trust.
translation: 机车建筑有限公司是该托拉斯的全资子公司。

meaning: n. 逻辑,逻辑学
example: By now all logic had gone out of the window.
translation: 到这时根本就不讲什么逻辑了。

meaning: n. 类似物；相似体；模拟
example: The analogue signals from the video tape are converted into digital code.
translation: 采自该录像带的模拟信号被转换成数字代码。

meaning: n. 类似，相似，类比，类推
example: The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
translation: 老师打了个比喻，把人的心脏比作水泵。

meaning: n. (ue)对话,对白
example: At last there can be a reasonable dialog between our two governments.
translation: 我们两国最后终于能理智地进行对话了。

meaning: adj. 雄辩的,有说服力的;善辩的,口才流利的
n. 原木,圆木;航海日志
example: In the evening a log fire would provide cosiness.
translation: 晚上点起篝火会让人感到温暖舒适。

meaning: adj. 逻辑的,符合逻辑的
example: The indisputable fact is that computers carry out logical operations.
translation: 不容置疑的事实是，电脑执行逻辑操作指令。

meaning: n. 科学技术；工业技术；应用科学
example: science and technology
translation: 科学与技术

meaning: n. 生物学
example: An A-level pass in Biology is preferred for all courses.
translation: 不管读什么课程，生物学高级证书考试最好都要及格。

meaning: n. 生态学
example: To keep ecology in balance is our duty.
translation: 保持生态平衡是我们的职责.

meaning: n. 地质(学)
example: We went on a geology field trip.
translation: 我们去进行地质野外考察。

meaning: n. 意识形态，(政治或社会的)思想意识
example: To add spice to the debate, they disagreed about method and ideology.
translation: 他们在方法和观念上都持不同意见，这使辩论精彩了很多。

meaning: adj. 生理学的, 生理学上的
example: Thinking angry thoughts can provoke strong physiological arousal.
translation: 想着生气的事情能激起强烈的生理反应。

meaning: n. 心理,心理学,心理状态
example: Abraham Maslow described psychology as "the science of being."
translation: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛形容心理学是“存在的科学”。

meaning: n. 社会学
example: sociology of law
translation: 法律社会学

meaning: n. 遗产，遗赠；先人(或过去)留下的东西
example: She offered to settle a legacy on Katharine.
translation: 她提出要把一笔遗产留给凯瑟琳。

meaning: adj. 法律的,法定的;合法的,正当的
example: But legal experts are not sure if such a charge can stick.
translation: 但法律专家们不能肯定这一指控是否成立。

meaning: n. 传说,传奇
example: His pitching was a legend among major league hitters.
translation: 他的投球在大联盟的击球员中是个传奇。

meaning: n. 法律(规)；立法，法律的制定(或通过)
example: They think that any legislation that involved putting down dogs was wrong.
translation: 他们认为任何涉及捕杀狗的立法都是错误的。

meaning: adj. 合法的；合理的，合乎逻辑的; v. 使合法
example: Most doctors appear to recognize homeopathy as a legitimate form of medicine.
translation: 大多数医生似乎都接受顺势疗法是一种合理的医疗手段。

meaning: n. 学院,高等专科学校,大学
example: I've had the hots for him ever since he came to college.
translation: 自从他来上大学后，我就对他春心萌动。

meaning: adj. 优雅的;端庄的;雅致的
example: She produces elegant wedding gowns in a variety of sumptuous fabrics.
translation: 她用各种华贵的布料制作高雅的婚纱。

meaning: adj. 勤奋的,用功的
example: He was careful and diligent. I was all over the place.
translation: 他细心且勤奋，我则稀里糊涂。

meaning: adj. 可忽略不计的，微不足道的
example: The company says the cost of relocation will be negligible.
translation: 公司称搬迁的费用可以忽略不计。

meaning: n. 义务,责任
example: Co-operation was more than just an attractive option, it was an obligation.
translation: 合作不仅仅是诱人的选择，它也是一种责任。

meaning: v. 强迫,迫使;责成;(使)感激,施恩于
example: Mr Oakley always has been ready to oblige journalists with information.
translation: 奥克利先生总是乐于向记者透露消息。

meaning: adj. 符合条件的;(尤指婚姻等)合适(意)的
example: Millions of householders are eligible to claim the new council tax benefit.
translation: 数百万房主都有资格申请新的市政税优惠。

meaning: n. 宗教,信仰
adj. 宗教的,信教的,虔诚的
example: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views.
translation: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

meaning: n. 法律,法规,法学,规律,定律
example: by law
translation: n. 根据法律，在法律上；附则

meaning: n. 律师
example: "He was a lawyer before that," Mary Ann put in.
translation: “在那之前他是个律师，”玛丽·安补充道。

meaning: n. 界限,限度,范围; v. (to)限制,限定
example: In some cases there is a mini-mum age limit.
translation: 有些情况下有最低年龄限制。

meaning: n. 限制,局限性
example: This drug has one important limitation. Its effects only last six hours.
translation: 这种药有一个严重缺陷：它的药力只能持续6个小时。

meaning: adj. 有限的,被限制的
example: So far we have had ringing declarations, but only limited action.
translation: 目前，我们已经发表了一些有力的声明，但只采取了有限的行动。

meaning: adj. 预备的,初步的
example: The winner of each preliminary goes through to the final.
translation: 每场初赛的获胜者进入决赛。

meaning: n. 困境；进退两难；
example: Public policy on the family presents liberals with a dilemma.
translation: 有关家庭的公共政策使自由主义者陷入了进退两难的境地。

meaning: adj. 低，矮；低级的，下层的，卑贱的；低声的
example: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
translation: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

meaning: prep. 在…下面，在…以下; adv. 在下面，向下
example: Last year, economic growth tailed off to below four percent.
translation: 去年，经济增长率下降到4%以下。

meaning: v. 吹，吹气，打气；吹奏；爆炸；n.打,打击
example: His resignation was a body blow to the team.
translation: 他的辞职是对该队的沉重打击。

meaning: n. 人,家伙;伙伴,同事; adj. 同样的,同事的
example: By all accounts, Rodger would appear to be a fine fellow.
translation: 据说，罗杰是个好小伙。

meaning: n. 伙伴关系;联谊会,团体
example: There was a great deal of soldierly good fellowship.
translation: 这里充满了战友间才有的那种真挚友谊。

meaning: v. 跟随,接着;领会;沿着…前进,遵循;结果是
example: "Wait there!" Kathryn rose. "No, on second thought, follow me."
translation: “在那儿等着！”凯瑟琳站起身来，“不，我改主意了。跟我来。”

meaning: adj. 下列的，下述的，其次的，接着的
example: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

meaning: adj. 空的,中空的;空洞的,空虚的; v. 挖空,凿空
example: Bake some big red peppers and hollow them out.
translation: 将几个大红甜椒烤一烤，再把它们掏空。

meaning: adj. 较低的,下级的,下游的; v. 降下,放低
example: I felt a sharp pain in my lower back.
translation: 我感觉到后腰一阵剧痛。

meaning: adj. (to)忠诚的,忠贞的
example: I thanked them for their long and loyal service.
translation: 我感谢他们长期以来忠诚的效力。

meaning: n. 忠诚,忠心
example: Loyalty and support became the bywords of the day.
translation: 忠诚和支持成了那个时代人们时常挂在嘴边的词儿。

meaning: v. 允许，准许；承认；给予；(for)考虑到
example: They will not allow your more way-out ideas to pass unchallenged.
translation: 他们不会放过你这些古怪的念头的。

meaning: n. 补贴，津贴；零用钱；减价，折扣；允许
example: Most of our flights have a baggage allowance of 44lbs per passenger.
translation: 我们大多数航班行李限重为每位乘客44磅。

meaning: n. 枕头
example: I have a pillow with my name embroidered on it.
translation: 我有一个绣着我名字的枕头。

meaning: adj. 浅的,浅薄的; n. 浅滩,浅处
example: Software Description : About Shalom , This saver includes various religious pictures and text.
translation: 这个屏幕保护程序包括不同宗教的图画和文本.

meaning: n. 燕子;吞咽vt.吞,咽;轻信;忍受;vi.咽口水
example: A magnified shot shows the head of a tiger swallowtail butterfly larva.
translation: 这个放大的照片显示一只凶猛风蝶幼虫的头部.

meaning: adj. 黄的，黄色的; n. 黄色
example: yellow river
translation: 黄河

meaning: adj. 慢的,不活跃的; v. (down)(使)放慢,减速
example: There has been a sharp slowdown in economic growth.
translation: 经济增长的速度明显放慢。

meaning: n. (pl.men)人；人类(单数，不加冠词)；男人

translation: 去年，她和一个叫麦克塔维什的男人私奔了。

meaning: n. 主席,议长,会长,董事长
example: When the chairman of Campbell's retired, McGovern was named as his successor.
translation: 坎贝尔公司的总裁退休后，麦戈文被选定为继任者。

meaning: n. 绅士,先生
example: A gentleman should always be civil, even to his inferiors.
translation: 绅士应该总是彬彬有礼,即便是对地位不及自己者.

meaning: adj. 人的,人类的; n. 人
example: Most of the wine was unfit for human consumption.
translation: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。

meaning: n. 人类,人性,人情;(pl.)人文科学
example: We admire her dedication to the cause of humanity.
translation: 我们敬佩她对人类事业的献身精神。

meaning: n. 外行
example: These technical terms are difficult for the layman to understand.
translation: 这些专门术语是外行人难以理解的.

meaning: v. 经营,管理,处理;设法,对付;操纵,运用
example: We'll manage somehow, you and me. I know we will.
translation: 我和你，我们总能应付过去的。我知道我们会的。

meaning: n. 经营,管理;处理,操纵;管理部门
example: The governors were joined by Mr Hunter and his management team.
translation: 亨特先生及他率领的管理小组加入了州长们的队伍。

meaning: n. 经理,管理人
example: I want the manager'sjob when he calls it a day.
translation: 等到经理不干了之后，我想接替他的位子。

meaning: n. 人类
example: Mankind's knowledge of the universe has increased beyond measure.
translation: 人类对于宇宙的了解已经大为增加。

meaning: n. 方式;举止;(pl.)风度,礼貌;规矩;风俗
example: There was much curiosity about what manner of man he was.
translation: 他究竟是什么样的人，大家都十分好奇。

meaning: adj. 永久的,持久的
example: The museum will have a permanent exhibition of 60 vintage cars.
translation: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

meaning: n. 警察
example: The two policemen were joined by another policeman also carrying a pistol.
translation: 另一名持枪警察和那两名警察会合了。

meaning: n. 邮递员
example: I remembered a particular story about a postman who was a murderer.
translation: 我记得有个故事，讲的是一个邮递员杀人的事情。

meaning: n. 传奇,爱情故事
example: Producers decided to end her on-screen romance with Pierce Lawton.
translation: 制片人决定结束她在影片中与皮尔斯·劳顿的恋情。

meaning: adj. 浪漫的,传奇式的;不切实际的,好幻想的
example: The reality of mothering is frequently very different from the romantic ideal.
translation: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

meaning: n. 售货员,推销员
example: Daly was a fast-talking Irish-American who had started out as a salesman.
translation: 达利是个花言巧语的爱尔兰裔美国人，最初是干推销员的。

meaning: n. 发言人
example: Spokespeople for both campaigns did not respond to questions.
translation: 两家竞选团队的发言人均没有就此问题做出回应.

meaning: n. 爱好运动的人；运动员
n. 政治家,国务活动家
n. (pl.）women妇女，成年女子
example: She symbolised for me the best of Indian womanhood.
translation: 在我看来，她代表着最优秀的印度女性。

meaning: n. 消防队员
example: The fireman evacuated the guests from the burning hotel.
translation: 消防队员把客人们从燃烧着的旅馆中撤出来.

meaning: n. 渔夫，捕鱼人
example: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean.
translation: 斯皮罗斯·拉齐斯的第一份职业是爱琴海上一名地位卑贱的渔夫。

meaning: n. (manoeuvre)机动;运用,操作;; v. 机动
example: She tried to maneuver her body into a more comfortable position.
translation: 她试着把身子挪了挪，换了一个较为舒服的姿势。

meaning: v. 表明,证明,显示; adj. 明白的,明了的
example: Their frustration and anger will manifest itself in crying and screaming.
translation: 他们用哭泣与尖叫表达自己的沮丧和愤怒。

meaning: v. (熟练地)使用，操作；(巧妙地)处理
example: She was unable, for once, to control and manipulate events.
translation: 她仅有一次没能控制和处理好局势。

meaning: adj. 手的,手工做的,体力的; n. 手册,指南
example: Too often he only absorbs half the information in the manual.
translation: 他对于说明书上所说的经常是一知半解。

meaning: v. 制造,加工; n. 制造,制造业;产品
example: They manufacture the class of plastics known as thermoplastic materials.
translation: 他们生产这类被称为热塑材料的塑料制品。

meaning: n. 手稿,原稿
example: These odd assertions were interpolated into the manuscript some time after 1400.
translation: 这些奇怪的论断是于1400年后的某个时间被加入手稿的。

meaning: n. 腹，下腹(胸部到腿部的部分)
example: The patient is complaining of pain in the abdomen, doctor.
translation: 大夫, 病人在叫肚子疼.

meaning: n. 标本,样本
example: test specimen
translation: 试样；试棒；试块

meaning: v. 开始; v. 获得学位
example: The meeting is scheduled to commence at noon.
translation: 会议定于午间召开。

meaning: v. /n.有危险性的人(或物)；威胁，威吓
example: The European states retained a latent capability to menace Britain's own security.
translation: 欧洲国家仍具有威胁英国自身安全的潜在能力。

meaning: n. 菜单
example: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
translation: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

meaning: v. 传达,传送;交流;通讯,通话
example: Family therapy showed us how to communicate with each other.
translation: 家庭疗法指导我们彼此之间的沟通交流。

meaning: n. 通讯,传达;(pl.)通讯系统;交通
example: The vehicle that permitted both communication and acceptability was social revolution.
translation: 既能实现交流又能被广为接受的手段就是社会革命。

meaning: n. 共产主义
example: He was a politically conscious fighter for communism.
translation: 在政治上,他是个自觉的共产主义战士.

meaning: n. 同一地区全体居民,社会,社区;共同体
example: There has always been a difference between community radio and commercial radio.
translation: 社区广播电台和商业广播电台一直是有区别的。

meaning: adj. 免疫的,有免疫力的;有受影响的;豁免的
example: This discovery led on to studies of the immune system.
translation: 此发现使人们开始对免疫系统进行研究。

meaning: n. 痕迹;记号;分数; v. 标记,打分,使有特色
example: Mark had for some time been making advances towards her.
translation: 马克追她已经有一段时间了。

meaning: n. 大理石,云石
example: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.
translation: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。

meaning: v. (使)行军,(使)行进; n. 行军,行程
example: The unevenly matched armies met at Guilford on 15 March 1781.
translation: 1781年3月15日，力量悬殊的两支队伍在吉尔福德狭路相逢。

meaning: n. 三月(略作; Mar. )
example: The unevenly matched armies met at Guilford on 15 March 1781.
translation: 1781年3月15日，力量悬殊的两支队伍在吉尔福德狭路相逢。

meaning: n. 页边空白;边缘;余地;幅度
example: The group had a net profit margin of 30% last year.
translation: 去年，这个集团的纯利润率为30%。

meaning: adj. 记在页边的,旁注的;(意识)边缘的
example: For low-paid workers, the marginal tax rate is at least 75%.
translation: 对于低收入的工人来说，边际税率至少为75%。

meaning: adj. 海的,海生的;船舶的,航海的
example: The phosphate was deposited by the decay of marine microorganisms.
translation: 海洋微生物腐烂后沉积形成磷酸盐。

meaning: adj. 婚姻的,夫妻之间的
example: The implication that marital infidelity enhances a leader's credibility is preposterous.
translation: 婚姻不忠会提升领导人可信度的暗示荒谬之极。

meaning: n. 集市,市场;销路,需求(量); v. 销售
example: Like a good businessman, Stewart identified a gap in the market.
translation: 像精明的商人一样，斯图尔特发现了市场上的一个空白。

meaning: n. 结婚,婚姻;结婚仪式
example: After a three-weekend courtship, Pamela accepted Randolph's proposal of marriage.
translation: 经过3个周末的追求之后，帕梅拉接受了伦道夫的求婚。

meaning: adj. 已婚的,夫妇的;(to)与…结婚的
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: v. 结婚,嫁,娶
example: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
translation: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

meaning: adj. (marvellous)惊人的,奇迹般的,妙极的
example: "Isn't this marvelous?" she cooed.
translation: “这是不是太不可思议了？”她低声说。

meaning: n. (about,on)评语,意见; v. (on)评论;注意到
example: I didn't mean any offence. It was a flippant, off-the-cuff remark.
translation: 我本无意冒犯，那不过是句脱口而出的冒失话。

meaning: adj. 值得注意的;显著的,异常的,非凡的
example: He made a remarkable recovery from a shin injury.
translation: 他的胫骨伤恢复得相当不错。

meaning: n. 语法,语法书
example: He was known for his poor grammar and punctuation.
translation: 他不通语法和乱用标点是出了名的。

meaning: n. 恶梦；可怕的事物，无法摆脱的恐惧
example: Taking my son Peter to a restaurant was a nightmare.
translation: 带我儿子彼得外出吃饭简直糟糕透了。

meaning: n. 潜水艇; adj. 水底的,海底的
example: The submariner will stop under for two hours.
translation: 潜水员要在水下呆两个小时.

meaning: n. 超级市场
n. 商标；特征; vt. 注册的…商标
v. (summarise)概括,总结
example: What follows is a brief summary of the process.
translation: 接下来是对此流程的一个简短概括。

meaning: n. 摘要,概要; adj. 概括的,简略的
example: in summary
translation: 总之；概括起来

meaning: v. 钦佩,赞赏,羡慕；称赞,夸奖
example: I had to admire David's vow that he would leave the programme.
translation: 戴维发誓要离开这个项目，我不得不对他表示钦佩。

meaning: n. 奇迹,令人惊奇的人(或事)
example: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
translation: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

meaning: n. 镜子;反映,反射; v. 反映,反射
example: Light colours provide an effective backdrop for pictures or a mirror.
translation: 浅色是挂放图画或镜子很有效果的衬托。

meaning: n. 商业，贸易；交际，交往
example: There were notable jousts with the Secretary of Commerce.
translation: 和商业部长之间明显存在竞争。

meaning: adj. 商业的；商务的；可获利的; n. 广告节目
example: There has always been a difference between community radio and commercial radio.
translation: 社区广播电台和商业广播电台一直是有区别的。

meaning: v. 显现,浮现;暴露;形成;
example: emerge from
translation: 自…出现；从…显露出来

meaning: n. 紧急情况,突然事件,非常时刻
example: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

meaning: v. 使沉浸在;使浸没
example: Immerse the cloth in the dye for twenty minutes.
translation: 把布浸在染料里20分钟.

meaning: n. 商品,货物
example: The merchandise is reasonably priced and offers exceptionally good value.
translation: 这些商品定价合理，很是划算。

meaning: n. 商人,零售商
example: The ride was smooth until they got into the merchant ship's wake.
translation: 航行一直很顺利，直到他们碰上了商船的尾流。

meaning: n. 仁慈,怜悯,宽恕
example: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
translation: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

meaning: adj. 纯粹的;仅仅,只不过
example: The mere mention of John had touched a very raw nerve indeed.
translation: 提到约翰就真的让人心痛。

meaning: adv. 仅仅，只不过
example: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
translation: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

meaning: v. (使)结合，(使)合并，(使)合为一体
example: Like a chameleon, he could merge unobtrusively into the background.
translation: 他就像一条变色龙，可以神不知鬼不觉地隐藏在背景中间。

meaning: n. 优点,价值,功绩; v. 值得,应得
example: Surely such weighty matters merit a higher level of debate?
translation: 这样重大的事件谅必应进行更高级别的讨论吧？

meaning: adj. 欢乐的,愉快的
example: I just wanted to wish you a merry Christmas.
translation: 我只想祝福你圣诞快乐。

meaning: v. 沉没,淹没;潜入
example: Most of the mouth of the cave was submerged in the lake.
translation: 洞口大半都淹没在湖里。

meaning: n. 夏天，夏季; adj. 夏季的
example: He walked towards the summerhouse, at first furtively, then with more confidence.
translation: 他朝凉亭走去，开始还偷偷摸摸地，后来就壮大了胆子。

meaning: n. (randum)备忘录
example: The memo ends: "Please give this matter your most urgent attention."
translation: 备忘录的结尾写道：“请将此事作为亟待处理事项。”

meaning: v. 纪念，庆祝
example: A series of movies will be shown to commemorate the 30th anniversary of his death.
translation: 为纪念他逝世30周年，有一系列的电影要上映。

meaning: n. 成员,会员
example: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
translation: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

meaning: n. 会员资格,成员资格
example: The European Builders Confederation has a membership of over 350,000 building companies.
translation: 欧洲建筑商联合会拥有逾35万家建筑公司会员。

meaning: adj. 记忆的,纪念的; n. 纪念物,纪念碑,纪念馆
example: The Memorial seems almost ugly, dominating the landscape for miles around.
translation: 那座纪念碑耸立在方圆数英里景致之中显得近乎难看。

meaning: n. 记忆,记忆力;回忆;存储(器)
example: "His memory must be completely back, then?" — "Just about."
translation: “这么说，他的记忆一定是完全恢复了？”——“差不多。”

meaning: v. 记住;(to)转达问候,代…致意,代…问好
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. (meter)米，公尺；仪表，计量器
example: Prices start at £13.95 a metre for printed cotton.
translation: 印花棉布以每米13.95英镑的价格起售。

meaning: n. 算术，四则运算
example: They will concentrate on teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
translation: 他们将集中教授阅读、写作和算术基础知识。

meaning: n. 坟墓，墓地，坟场
example: We got arrested once, for singing bawdy songs in a cemetery.
translation: 我们曾经因为在公墓唱下流歌曲而被拘留过一次。

meaning: n. (centimeter)厘米
example: The snails are no larger than one centimetre across.
translation: 这些蜗牛体宽不超过1厘米。

meaning: n. 直径
example: This hole was a scant .23 inches in diameter.
translation: 这个洞眼的直径只有0.23英寸。

meaning: n. 几何(学)
example: His idea was to apply geometry to dynamics.
translation: 他的想法就是将几何学应用在力学上。

meaning: n. 头盔,钢盔
example: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorbike.
translation: 一位戴头盔的男子正跨上摩托车。

meaning: n. (kilometer) 公里，千米(略作km)
example: Moreau took gold in the five-kilometre individual pursuit competition.
translation: 莫罗在个人五公里追逐赛中获得金牌。

meaning: n. 金属,金属制品
example: Light fittings with metal parts should always be earthed.
translation: 有金属部件的照明装置都应该走地线。

meaning: n. 隐喻，暗喻
example: Despite the mixed metaphor, there is some truth in this judgement.
translation: 尽管有混用的比喻，这个判断还是有些道理的。

meaning: n. 方法,办法
example: He succeeded with the aid of a completely new method he discovered.
translation: 借助于自己发现的一种全新的方法，他获得了成功。

meaning: adj. 米制的,公制的
example: The Wall Street Journal uses 220,000 metric tons of newsprint each year.
translation: 《华尔街日报》每年用去22万公吨新闻纸。

meaning: adj. 首都的,主要都市的,大城市
example: He is currently being held in a metropolitan correctional center.
translation: 他现在被关在一个大城市的改造中心。

meaning: n. (millimetre)毫米
example: In the back of the truck was a 12.7 millimeter rapid-fire machine gun.
translation: 在卡车后面有一只12.7毫米口径的速射机关枪。

meaning: n. 参数,参量
example: It is the parameter of distribution.
translation: 这就是分布参数.

meaning: n. 对称(性);匀称,整齐
example: axial symmetry
translation: 轴对称性

meaning: n. 温度计
example: Meanwhile, the thermometric rising and the rigidity decreasing are the factors, too.
translation: 同时, 还要考虑成型零件因温度的升高及刚性不足的影响.

meaning: n. n&adj中间(的),当中(的)
example: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday.
translation: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。

meaning: prep. 在…中间，在…之中，被…围绕
example: They announced, amid much ballyhoo, that they had made a breakthrough.
translation: 在一通大吹大擂中，他们宣布自己取得了突破。

meaning: adj. 湿的,湿气重的
example: Visitors can expect hot and humid condi-tions.
translation: 游客会遇到炎热潮湿的天气状况。

meaning: n. 湿气,湿度
example: As an asthmatic, he cannot cope with the heat and humidity.
translation: 他患有哮喘病，经不起高温和潮湿。

meaning: n. 中间,当中
example: She stood preening in their midst, delighted with the attention.
translation: 她得意洋洋地站在他们中间，为受人瞩目而高兴。

meaning: n. 金字塔
example: There rose before us the great pyramid of Gaza.
translation: 雄伟的加沙金字塔矗立在我们面前。

meaning: n. 喜剧;喜剧性事件
example: Paul is a thoroughly likeable man with an unerring sense of comedy.
translation: 保罗十分讨人喜欢，开玩笑时很有分寸。

meaning: adj. 立即的,即时的;直接的,最接近的
example: Only a handful had returned to work in the immediate vicinity.
translation: 仅有几个人回到临近地区工作。

meaning: n. 奖章,勋章,纪念章
example: It was an unbelievable moment when Chris won the gold medal.
translation: 克里斯赢得金牌的那一刻令人不可思议。

meaning: adj. 医学的，医疗的，医药的；内科的
example: Ann Bradley dispels the old wives' tales and gives the medical facts.
translation: 安·布拉德利破除迷信，给出了医学事实。

meaning: n. 内服药,医药;医术;医学,内科学
example: Traditionally young Asians in Britain have gravitated towards medicine, law and engineering.
translation: 英国的亚裔年轻人通常被吸引到医学、法律及工程专业。

meaning: adj. 中世纪的,中古(时代)的,老式的,原始的
example: The house is a textbook example of medieval domestic architecture.
translation: 这所房子是典型的中世纪民居。

meaning: v. 想,考虑,(尤指宗教上的)沉思,冥想
example: That's when I try to meditate or do some deep-breathing exercises.
translation: 这时我就会试着沉思或者做些深呼吸练习。

meaning: n. 熟虑;默想,沉思;(pl.)冥想录
example: The title track is a pointed meditation on a continent gone wrong.
translation: 主打歌是对一个误入歧途的大陆的深刻沉思。

meaning: n. 媒体,方法,媒介,介质; adj. 中等的
example: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

meaning: n. 方式,式样
example: The bicycle reigned supreme as Britain's most popular mode of transport.
translation: 当时自行车是英国最流行的交通工具。

meaning: v. 向…提供住处；对...予以照顾性考虑
example: He has never put an arm around his wife to accommodate photographers.
translation: 他从未为了迎合摄影师而搂住妻子。

meaning: n. 住宿，留宿；膳宿供应
example: His instinct would be to seek a new accommodation with the nationalists.
translation: 他本能的反应会是寻求与民族主义者取得新的和解。

meaning: n. 日用品；商品；农/矿产品；有用之物
example: Many brokers were charged with cheating customers in commodity trades.
translation: 许多经纪人被指控在商品交易中欺骗顾客。

meaning: n. 样式,型;模范;模型,原型;模特; v. 模仿
example: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: adj. 有节制的,中等的,适度的,温和的,稳健的
example: Futures prices recovered from sharp early declines to end with moderate losses.
translation: 期货价格在早盘深幅下跌后出现反弹，收盘时未见严重损失。

meaning: adj. 现代的,近代的,新式的
example: We are in one of the most severe recessions in modern times.
translation: 我们正在经历现代最严重的一段经济衰退。

meaning: n. (modernisation)现代化
example: The modernization of the industry was phased over at 20 - year period.
translation: 工业现代化分20年逐步实现.

meaning: adj. 谦虚的,有节制的
example: Though his background was modest, it was in no sense deprived.
translation: 尽管他家境一般，但也并不贫穷。

meaning: n. 心情,情绪;语气
example: He faced the press, initially, in a somewhat subdued mood.
translation: 他最初面对媒体时情绪有点忧郁。

meaning: v. 更改,修改,修饰
example: Established practices are difficult to modify.
translation: 既定的惯例是很难更改的.

meaning: n. 组件，模块，模件；(航天器的)舱
example: They have docked a robot module alongside the orbiting space station.
translation: 他们已经将一个自动操作舱与沿轨道运行的空间站并行对接上了。

meaning: n. (加the)月球，月亮；卫星
example: June always rhymes with moon in old love songs.
translation: 在老情歌中June总是和moon成韵。

meaning: prep. 在…之中；在一群(组)之中；于…之间
example: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
translation: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

meaning: n. 典礼,仪式;礼节,礼仪
example: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
translation: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

meaning: adj. 普通的；共同的；一般的；n.公有地
example: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home.
translation: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。

meaning: adj. 普通的n.寻常的事物，平庸的东西
example: It's commonplace to see people collapsing from hunger in the streets.
translation: 在街上看见有人饿晕是很平常的事。

meaning: n. 共和国,联邦,共同体
example: The Commonwealth Development Corporation has agreed to reschedule Tanzania's debt.
translation: 英联邦开发公司已经同意推迟坦桑尼亚的债务偿还时间。

meaning: v. 论证,证实;演示,说明
example: The best and the brightest pupils competed to demonstrate their intellectual prowess.
translation: 最出色、最聪明的学生们竞相展示他们的才智。

meaning: n. 协调,和谐;融洽
example: As they smiled at each other, harmony was restored again.
translation: 他们彼此微笑的时候，又恢复了往日的和睦。

meaning: n. 帝王，君主，最高统治者
example: a monarch without political power
translation: 没有政治权力的君主

meaning: n. 星期一
example: Wendy popped in for a quick bite to eat on Monday night.
translation: 温迪周一晚上过来匆匆吃了点儿饭。

meaning: adj. 金融的,货币的
example: The grand design of Europe's monetary union is already agreed.
translation: 欧洲统一货币的宏伟构想已经获得认同。

meaning: n. 货币,钱
example: I spent lots of money on smart new outfits for work.
translation: 我花大笔钱购置了上班时穿的漂亮新套装。

meaning: n. 班长;监听器,监视器; v. 监控,监测
example: Officials had not been allowed to monitor the voting.
translation: 以前不允许官员监督投票。

meaning: n. 猴子
example: The woolly spider monkey is the largest primate in the Americas.
translation: 绒毛蛛猴是美洲最大的灵长类动物。

meaning: n. 垄断,专卖,专利权,专利事业
example: "Monopoly" is one of the best-selling games of all time.
translation: “大富翁”是有史以来最畅销的游戏之一。

meaning: adj. 单调的,无变化的
example: Closures and job losses are again being announced with monotonous regularity.
translation: 倒闭和失业的消息又在一次次地反复宣布着。

meaning: n. 怪物,妖怪,畸形的动植物
example: During the 1980s monster publishing houses started to swallow up smaller companies.
translation: 20世纪80年代，一些出版巨头开始吞并一些较小的公司。

meaning: n. 月,月份
example: One month before the deadline we see the hollowness of these promises.
translation: 离最后期限只有一个月时，我们认识到了这些许诺都是空头支票。

meaning: adj. 每月的; adv. 每月一次,按月; n. 月刊
example: She presents a monthly magazine programme on the BBC.
translation: 她在英国广播公司主持一个月刊节目。

meaning: n. 纪念碑,纪念馆,遗迹,不朽的业绩
example: As Wren's epitaph famously declares, the cathedral itself is his monument.
translation: 众所周知，雷恩的墓志铭中写道，大教堂本身就是他的纪念碑。

meaning: v. 召唤;传讯,传唤;鼓起(勇气),振作(精神)
example: Two Will O'the Wisp are summoned to help their summoner in battle.
translation: 在战斗中,两个鬼火将被召唤来帮助它们的召唤者.

meaning: n. 证据,证词;表明,说明
example: Testiness crept into my voice.
translation: 我的话音渐渐带上了怒气.

meaning: v. 移动,迁移;活动;感动; n. 移动,活动,行动
example: So, if we could just move onto something else?
translation: 那么我们可不可以干脆谈点别的？

meaning: n. 运动,活动;移动,迁移
example: Monks shave their heads, as do devotees of the Hare Krishna movement.
translation: 和尚要剃度，克利须那派教徒也一样。

meaning: n. 电影,电影院
example: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.
translation: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。

meaning: n. 移动,迁居;除去
v. 移动,脱掉,调动,免职
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. 乌合之众(尤指暴力者); v. 围攻，聚众闹事
example: An unruly mob broke down police barricades and stormed the courtroom.
translation: 一伙暴徒捣毁了警察设置的路障冲进法庭。

meaning: adj. 可动的,活动的,运动的
example: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
translation: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。

meaning: v. (mobilise)动员,赋予可动性
example: Sudan even threat-ened to mobilize in response to the ultima-tums.
translation: 作为对最后通牒的回应，苏丹甚至威胁说要动员军队。

meaning: n. 情绪,情感,感情
n. (附有停车场的)汽车旅馆
example: He took off at once and headed back to the motel.
translation: 他立刻离开，回到汽车旅馆。

meaning: n. 运动,动;提议,动议; v. 提议,动议
example: She made a fanning motion, pretending to cool herself off.
translation: 她做了个扇风的动作，假装想让自己凉快一点。

meaning: v. 促动；激励，鼓励，作为…的动机
example: How do you motivate people to work hard and efficiently?
translation: 你是怎样激励大家奋发高效地工作的？

meaning: n. 动机,目的; adj. 发动的,运动的
example: Sheila had an ulterior motive for trying to help Stan.
translation: 希拉想帮助斯坦是另有所图的。

meaning: n. 发动机,电动机
example: Many motor accidents are the result of unthinkingly mixing speed and alcohol.
translation: 许多机动车事故都是不计后果地酒后开快车造成的。

meaning: v. 促进,发扬;提升,提拔;增进,助长
example: They have begun dialogues to promote better understanding between both communities.
translation: 双方已经开始了对话，以增进两个社群间的彼此了解。

meaning: adj. 远的,遥远的,疏远的,偏僻的,细微的
example: Statistically our chances of being the victims of violent crime are remote.
translation: 从统计数据来看，我们成为暴力犯罪受害者的可能性微乎其微。

meaning: n. 名字(称/声/义); v. 给…取名；列举；提名
example: She has had many credits and name-checks in American Vogue.
translation: 美国版《时尚》多次对她进行赞扬或是提到她的名字。

meaning: adv. 即,也就是
example: The book was inspired by a real person, namely Tamara de Treaux.
translation: 那本书的灵感源于一个真实人物，即塔玛拉·德特罗。

meaning: n. 绰号，浑名vt.给…起绰号
example: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
translation: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

meaning: v. 装饰,美化; n. 装饰,装饰物
example: The clock is simply for ornament; it doesn't work any more.
translation: 这架时钟纯属摆设，它再也不走了。

meaning: adj. 匿名的，无名的，姓氏不明的
example: He was surprised by the venomous tone of the anonymous calls.
translation: 那些匿名电话的恶毒语气很令他吃惊。

meaning: adj. 名义上的;(金额,租金)微不足道的 name
example: All the ferries carry bicycles free or for a nominal charge.
translation: 所有的渡船都免费或以极低的收费运载自行车。

meaning: v. 提名,任命
example: I nominate Tom to make the tea.
translation: 我指派汤姆去沏茶.

meaning: n. n．天文学
example: The discovery is being hailed as The Holy Grail of astronomy.
translation: 这一发现圆了天文学界的一个梦想。

meaning: n. 自治，自治权；
example: Activists stepped up their demands for local autonomy last month.
translation: 上个月激进分子对地方自治的呼声更高了。

meaning: adj. 经济(上)的,经济学的
example: The United States plans to tighten the economic sanctions currently in place.
translation: 美国计划加大现有经济制裁的力度。

meaning: adj. 节约的,经济的
example: Mexican cookery is economical, she says. Nothing goes to waste.
translation: “墨西哥的烹调注重俭省，”她说，“任何东西都不会浪费。”

meaning: n. 经济学,经济情况
example: Ms Senatorova showed an instinctive feel for market economics.
translation: 谢纳托罗娃女士对市场经济学有一种天生的敏感。

meaning: n. 节约;经济
example: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
translation: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

meaning: n. 名词
example: The noun " mouse " is the singular form of " mice " .
translation: 名词mouse是 mice 的单数形式.

meaning: n. 代词
example: The position of the pronoun " his'shows that it is to be betoned.
translation: 代词 “ his”在句中的位置表示此词应加强调.

meaning: v. 发…的音;宣布,宣判
example: Men feel perfectly free to pronounce on the way women should look.
translation: 男人随心所欲地对女性美的标准发表看法。

meaning: n. 发音,发音方法
example: I thought a phonetic spelling might aid in pronunciation.
translation: 我想语音拼写可能有助于发音。

meaning: v. 正式宣布；发表；通告；广播（电台节目）
example: She was planning to announce her engagement to Peter.
translation: 她正计划宣布她和彼得订婚一事。

meaning: v. 公开指责,公然抨击;谴责
n. 命令;次序;整齐;定货单;等级; v. 定制,订购
example: The waiter returned with their order and Graham signed the bill.
translation: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。

meaning: adj. 同等的; n. 同等者,坐标; v. 协作，协调
example: They appointed a new manager to coordinate the work of the team.
translation: 为协调这个队的工作，他们任用了一位新经理。

meaning: n. 混乱,杂乱;骚乱;失调,疾病
example: There are other forms of civil disorder — most notably, football hooliganism.
translation: 还有其他形式的民众骚乱，最出名的是足球流氓行为。

meaning: adj. 非常的;格外的;意外的;离奇的;临时的
example: They testify to the extraordinary potency of his personality.
translation: 这些事情证明了他非凡的人格魅力。

meaning: adj. 整齐的,有秩序的,有条理的; n. 勤务兵
example: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
translation: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

meaning: adj. 普通的,平凡的,平常的;平庸的
example: It was just an ordinary voice, but he sang in tune.
translation: 他声音很一般，但唱得都在调子上。

meaning: adj. (to)次要的,从属的;下级的
example: When & quot ; in & quot ; I will come when I can & quot; is a subordinating conjunction.
translation: 在“ IwillcomewhenIcan ”中,“when”是从属连词.

meaning: adj. 苍白的,灰白的;浅的,暗淡的
example: In the background, dressed in pale green, stood Eunice.
translation: 尤妮斯穿着浅绿色的衣服站在后面不起眼的地方。

meaning: v. 使惊骇，使恐怖
example: I was appal ( l ) ed at the news.
translation: 我被这消息吓坏了.

meaning: n. 宫,宫殿
example: He recounted how heavily armed soldiers forced him from the presidential palace.
translation: 他讲述了自己是怎样被全副武装的士兵从总统官邸里赶出来的。

meaning: n. 平底锅,盘子,面板
example: Put a pan of salted water on to boil.
translation: 将一锅盐水放上去煮。

meaning: v. 陪伴，陪同；伴随，一起发生，伴奏
example: This volume of essays was designed to accompany an exhibition in Cologne.
translation: 这本文集是为配合在科隆举办的一场展览而出的。

meaning: n. 同伴,共事者;伴侣
example: He has been her constant companion for the last four months.
translation: 4个月来，他一直陪伴在她身边。

meaning: n. 公司;陪伴;宾客;连(队),(一)群,队,伙
example: Doctors are complaining about being barraged by drug-company salesmen.
translation: 医生们抱怨他们疲于应付医药公司的销售人员。

meaning: v. (使)膨胀,(使)扩张;张开,展开
example: The ultimate aim is to expand the network further.
translation: 最终目的是为了进一步拓展该网络。

meaning: n. 扩张,膨胀;张开,伸展
example: This revolutionary expansion required energetic nation-building policies.
translation: 这种跨越式的扩张需要有活力的国家建设政策。

meaning: n. 面,板;控制板,仪表盘;专门小组
example: All objects are vetted by a distinguished panel of experts.
translation: 所有物品都交由一个著名的专家小组检查鉴定。

meaning: n. n&adj恐慌(的),惊慌(的); v. 使惊慌,使害怕
example: You feel an animal panic to run and hide.
translation: 你会感到一种本能的恐惧而想要去逃避。

meaning: n. 全景,全景画,全景摄影,全景照片[装置]
example: There is a superb panorama of the mountains from the hotel.
translation: 从旅馆可饱览峰峦叠嶂的雄伟景观。

meaning: n. 部分,角色,一方,零件,地区,部,篇v.使分开
example: These days work plays an important part in a single woman's life.
translation: 现在，工作在单身女性的生活中起着重要作用。

meaning: adv. 分离，离开，隔开; adj. 分离的，分隔的
example: Don't think it hasn't torn me apart to be away from you.
translation: 不骗你，离开你让我痛苦万分。

meaning: n. [英]房间，套间；[美]公寓
example: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
translation: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

meaning: n. 卧车包房,隔间;分隔的空间
example: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
translation: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管抽走。

meaning: v. 离开,起程; adj. 过去的,逝世的
example: My connecting plane didn't depart for another six hours.
translation: 我搭乘的联运航班又过了6个小时才起飞。

meaning: n. 部,局,处,科,部门;系,学部
example: She was the only woman in Shell's legal department.
translation: 她是壳牌公司法律事务部唯一的女性。

meaning: n. 离开,起程
example: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
translation: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

meaning: v. 传授，给予；告知，通知
example: A teacher's aim is to impart knowledge.
translation: 教师的宗旨就是传授知识.

meaning: adj. 部分的,不完全的;偏袒的,不公平的,偏爱的
example: The Partial Test-Ban Treaty bans nuclear testing in the atmosphere.
translation: 《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止在大气层中进行核试验。

meaning: n. 参加者,参与者; adj. 有份的,参与的
example: A youthful teacher, he finds himself an unwilling participant in school politics.
translation: 作为一名年轻教师，他发现自己并不情愿地参与到了学校的权力争斗中。

meaning: v. (in)参与,参加;分享,分担;含有,带有
example: This in effect denied them their right to participate meaningfully in elections.
translation: 这实际上是剥夺了他们正式参与选举的权利。

meaning: n. 粒子,微粒;极小量;小品词,虚词
example: A proton is an elementary particle of matter.
translation: 质子是物质的基本粒子。

meaning: adj. 特殊的,苛求的,个别的n.详情,细节,特色
example: We are taught to construe these terms in a particular way.
translation: 我们被教导要以特定的方式理解这些词语。

meaning: adv. 部分地,不完全地,在一定程度上
example: I feel partly responsible for the problems we're in.
translation: 我觉得应为我们遭遇的问题负部分责任。

meaning: n. 合作者,合伙人,合股人,伙伴,舞伴,配偶
example: Your partner should then pass the ball back to you.
translation: 然后你的搭档应该将球回传给你。

meaning: n. 聚会,政党,当事人; v. 举行(参加)社交聚会
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: n. 降落伞; v. 跳伞
example: The Parachute Regiment could be forced to admit women.
translation: 伞兵团可能会被迫招收女性。

meaning: n&v. 游行,夸耀n.检阅,阅兵式v.使列队行进
example: Morning parade was in progress on the parade ground.
translation: 阅兵场正在进行早间检阅。

meaning: n. 典范; 范例; 示例
example: a paradigm for students to copy
translation: 供学生效法的榜样

meaning: n. 似非而是的话,自相矛盾的话,反论
example: He was a paradox—a loner who loved to chat to strangers.
translation: 他真是个矛盾人物，生性孤僻却又喜欢和陌生人闲聊。

meaning: adj. 平行的,相同的,类似的n.平行线,类似,对比
example: Parallel lines will never meet no matter how far extended.
translation: 无论延伸多长，平行线永不相交。

meaning: v. (paralyse)使瘫痪(麻痹);使丧失作用
example: The snake uses its venom to stun or paralyze its victims.
translation: 蛇用其毒液使受害者失去知觉或瘫痪.

meaning: n. 寄生虫,食客
example: One of the ways the parasite spreads is through fecal matter.
translation: 寄生虫传播的一种方式是通过排泄物。

meaning: n. 器械，器具，仪器；机构，组织
example: They lacked the scientific personnel to develop the technical apparatus much further.
translation: 他们缺少能够进一步研发这一技术装置的科研人员。

meaning: adj. 表面上的,貌似真实的；显然的,明明白白的
example: It rapidly became apparent that rock'n'roll was a very broad church indeed.
translation: 摇滚乐实际无所不包，这一点很快就显而易见了。

meaning: adj. (with,to)可比较的,比得上的
example: In other comparable countries real wages increased much more rapidly.
translation: 在其他具有可比性的国家，实际工资上涨更快。

meaning: adj. 比较的,相当的
example: The comparative of "pretty" is "prettier".
translation: pretty的比较级形式是prettier。

meaning: v. (to，with)比较；(to)把…比作vi.相比
example: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
translation: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

meaning: n. 比较,对比,比喻,比拟
example: The comparison of her life to a sea voyage simplifies her experience.
translation: 把她的人生比作一次海上航行不足以说明她丰富的经历。

meaning: n. 包裹,邮包,部分; v. 打包,捆扎,分配
example: It's all part and parcel— just a day's work really you know.
translation: 这只是一部分——才一天的工作，你要知道。

meaning: n. 原谅,宽恕;请再说一遍; v. 原谅,饶恕,赦免
example: It's enough to make you wet yourself, if you'll pardon the expression.
translation: 这足以吓得你尿裤子了，请原谅我这么说。

meaning: n. 父母,母亲;(pl.)双亲;父母

translation: 现在很多孩子在单亲家庭中出生或成长。

meaning: n. 国会,议会

translation: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

meaning: n. 准备,预备;制剂,制备品

translation: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

meaning: v. 准备,预备
example: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

meaning: adj. (from)分离的,分开的
example: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
translation: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

meaning: adj. 透明的，透光的；易理解的；明显的
example: transparent glass
translation: 透明玻璃

meaning: n. 便士,美分
example: The directors of this company feel he's worth every penny.
translation: 这家公司的主管们觉得他值得栽培。

meaning: n. 养老金,年金
example: He lived on an invalidity pension which came as a weekly giro.
translation: 他靠每周领取的作为病残养老金的直接转账救济支票过日子。

meaning: v. (for)补偿,赔偿
example: The hospital staff were very apologetic but that couldn't really compensate.
translation: 医院的工作人员深表歉意，但这真的于事无补。

meaning: n. 补偿(或赔偿)的款物；补偿，赔偿
example: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay compensation.
translation: 他被有条件地释放了，被责令支付赔偿款。

meaning: n. 花费,消费,消耗
example: Owen was against it, on the grounds of expense.
translation: 欧文因费用问题对此表示反对。

meaning: adj. 花费的,昂贵的
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: adj. (to,for)必不可少的,必需的
example: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.
translation: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

meaning: n. 爱畜,宠儿; adj. 宠爱的,表示亲昵的
example: They would sell the meat off as pet food.
translation: 他们将把肉当作宠物食品卖掉。

meaning: n. 食欲，胃口；欲望，性欲；爱好，趣味
example: There is nothing like a long walk to arouse the appetite.
translation: 没有什么比走很长的路更能激起食欲的了。

meaning: v. 比赛；竞争；对抗
example: They are now trying to compete on an equal footing.
translation: 他们现在想要公平竞争。

meaning: adj. 有能力的，能胜任的；足够的
example: I had always considered myself a strong, competent woman.
translation: 一直以来，我始终认为自己是个女强人。

meaning: n. 竞争，比赛；角逐，较量；竞争者
example: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: adj. 竞争的；好竞争的；有竞争力的
example: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive.
translation: 他是一位锐意进取、竞争意识很强的主管，颇受尊敬。

meaning: n. 推动(力),促进
example: This is the primary impetus behind the economic recovery.
translation: 这是促使经济复苏的主要动力.

meaning: adj. 永久的,永恒的,长期的
example: Little by little she lost the taut, strained air of perpetual anxiety.
translation: 长期焦虑带来的紧张而疲惫的神色从她脸上慢慢消失了。

meaning: n. 请愿书,申请书; v. (向…)请愿,正式请求
example: His lawyers filed a petition for all charges to be dropped.
translation: 他的律师提请撤销所有指控。

meaning: adj. 小(器、规模)的,不重要的,细微的,卑鄙的
example: Petty crime is having a deleteri-ous effect on community life.
translation: 轻微罪行正对社区生活产生有害影响。

meaning: n. 木偶,傀儡

translation: 外敌入侵时，他作为占领者的傀儡行使统治。

meaning: n. 重复,反复
example: Her prose style is not always felicitous; she tends to repetition.
translation: 她的行文风格并非总是恰到好处，往往爱重复。

meaning: n. 喇叭,小号
example: Trumpeter Marcus Belgrave ran a jazz workshop for young artists.
translation: 小号手马库斯·贝尔格雷夫为年轻艺术家办了一个爵士乐研习班。

meaning: n. 民意测验;(pl.)政治选举; v. 获得…选票
example: He will have been heartened by the telephone opinion poll published yesterday.
translation: 他会为昨天公布的电话民意调查结果感到鼓舞。

meaning: n. 警察,警察机关; adj. 警察的; v. 管辖
example: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
translation: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

meaning: n. 政策,方针
example: It was not the policy of the government to repatriate genuine refugees.
translation: 遣返真正的难民回国并非政府的政策。

meaning: adj. 有礼貌的,客气的;有教养的,文雅的
example: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming.
translation: 他话不多，很有礼貌，为人谦和。

meaning: adj. 政治的
example: It was time now to show more political realism.
translation: 现在是拿出更多政治务实精神的时候了。

meaning: n. 政治家,政客
example: He is widely regarded as Hungary's most skilful politician.
translation: 他是公认的匈牙利最有手腕的政治家。

meaning: n. 政治,政治学;政纲,政见
example: He closed down the business and went into politics.
translation: 他关闭公司投身政治。

meaning: v. (to,for)道歉，认错
example: I apologise if your enjoyment of the movie was spoiled.
translation: 如果破坏了你看电影的兴致，我道歉。

meaning: n. 道歉，认错，辩解，辩护

translation: 大都市的花花世界使他感到眼花缭乱.

meaning: n. 港口
example: He asked for a glass of port after dinner.
translation: 晚饭后，他要了一杯波尔图葡萄酒。

meaning: n. 机场，航空站，航空港
example: The plane had been cleared for landing at Brunswick's Glynco Airport.
translation: 飞机获准降落于不伦瑞克的格林科机场。

meaning: n. 市镇自治机关；法人；公司，企业
example: The Commonwealth Development Corporation has agreed to reschedule Tanzania's debt.
translation: 英联邦开发公司已经同意推迟坦桑尼亚的债务偿还时间。

meaning: v. 蒸发,挥发;沉淀;发射;消失
example: Blasting cold air over it makes the water evaporate.
translation: 向它喷射冷空气可以使水蒸发。

meaning: v&n. 输出,出口; n. 出口商品
example: There is nothing sinister or conspiratorial about the export licensing system.
translation: 这种出口许可制度没有任何阴险或者见不得人的东西。

meaning: v&n. 进口,输入,(pl.)进口商品;要旨,含意
example: We import an incredible amount of cheese from the Continent.
translation: 我们从欧洲大陆进口数量惊人的奶酪。

meaning: n. 重要,重要性
example: My great-grandfather was a person of some importance here.
translation: 我曾祖父曾是这儿的头面人物。

meaning: adj. 重要的,重大的;有地位的,有权力的
example: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.
translation: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很重要，麦麸也是。

meaning: n. 机会
example: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
translation: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

meaning: adj. 轻便的,手提(式)的,可移动的
example: A small-screen portable TV can be a good investment.
translation: 小屏幕的便携式电视机很值得买。

meaning: n. 守门人,门房,行李搬运工,服务员
example: A porter relieved her of the three large cases.
translation: 一个行李搬运工替她扛了3个大包。

meaning: n. 一部分,一份
example: A large portion of this cost devolves upon the patient.
translation: 这笔费用的很大一部分落在病人身上。

meaning: n. 肖像,画像
example: Today his picture goes on show at the National Portrait Gallery.
translation: 今天他的画作在国家肖像美术馆展出。

meaning: v. 描写，描述；画(人物、景象等)
example: He has worked hard in recent months to portray New York in a better light.
translation: 最近几个月里他努力从更积极的角度来描绘纽约。

meaning: n. 比例;部分;均衡,相称
example: We must keep a sense of proportion about all this.
translation: 我们对所有的这些都要有轻重缓急之分。

meaning: n&v. 报告,汇报;传说,传阅
example: I'll report back the moment I have located him.
translation: 我一找到他就马上汇报。

meaning: n. 报告人,通讯员;记者,报导者
example: She was a TV reporter and worked long hours.
translation: 她是个电视台记者，总是工作到很晚。

meaning: n. /vt.支撑;支持;赡养;维持; n. 支持者;支柱
example: Army Policy -- Supportability Co - Equal with Cost, Schedule, and Performance ( 27 February 2000 )
translation: 陆军政策 —— 保障性与费用 、 进度和性能并重 ( 2000年2月27日 )

meaning: v. 运输,运送,搬运n.运输;运输系统,运载工具
example: Determine test contents of transportability and build up an evaluation parameter system.
translation: 确定了运输性试验内容并建立了评价指标体系.

meaning: v. 合并,纳入,结合; adj. 合并的
example: Queensway Quay will incorporate shops, restaurants and other amenities.
translation: 女王道码头将会融商店、餐馆以及其他生活便利设施为一体。

meaning: adj. 现代的,当代的;同时代的 time
adj. 暂时的,临时的
example: temporary storage
translation: 暂时存储器；暂时库容；中间存储器

meaning: n. 姿势,姿态; v. 造成,提出,摆姿势,佯装
example: She turned down £1.2 million to pose nude in Playboy.
translation: 她拒绝了为《花花公子》杂志拍摄裸照的120万英镑开价。

meaning: v. 组成,构成;(of)由…组成;创作(诗歌等)
example: They must each compose a poem in strict alliterative metre.
translation: 他们必须每人作一首严格押头韵的诗。

meaning: adj. 混合成的，综合成的n.合成物，复合材料
example: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people.
translation: 西班牙是多种传统和多个民族的合成体。

meaning: n. 作品,作文,乐曲;作曲;结构,组成,成分
example: The course is designed to help students with colour and composition.
translation: 设置这门课程是为了指导学生如何运用色彩和构图。

meaning: v. 存放;使沉淀;付(保证金); n. 存款;沉积物
example: This is more like a downpayment, or a deposit, if you like.
translation: 这更像是首付，也可以说是定金。

meaning: n. 处理,处置;布置,安排
example: He has said he will use all the weapons at his disposal.
translation: 他放出话说他将使出十八般武艺。

meaning: v. (of)处理,处置;(for)布置,安排
example: He alleged that they had hired an assassin to dispose of him.
translation: 他宣称他们已雇了刺客来除掉他。

meaning: n. 排列,部署;性格倾向;倾向,意向
example: He was a nice lad — bright and with a sunny disposition.
translation: 他是个不错的小伙子——聪明伶俐而且性格开朗。

meaning: v. (to)使暴露,受到;使曝光
example: When Myra told Karp she'd expose his past, he blew up.
translation: 当迈拉告诉卡普她会把他的过去全抖搂出去时，卡普大为光火。

meaning: n. 暴露,揭露;方向;陈列;遗弃;照射量
example: Their sporting reputation has suffered enormously from Johnson's exposure.
translation: 由于约翰逊东窗事发，他们的体育声誉受到了严重损害。

meaning: v. 征(税);(on)把…强加给
example: I didn't want to impose myself on my married friends.
translation: 我不想打扰自己已婚的朋友。

meaning: adj. 不可能的；难以忍受的，很难对付的
example: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
translation: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

meaning: v. 反对,使对立,使对抗,使相对
example: It is illogical to oppose the repatriation of economic migrants.
translation: 反对把经济移民遣送归国是不合逻辑的。

meaning: adj. 对面的,相对的,相反的; n. 对立面
example: The argument contained herein takes exactly the opposite point of view.
translation: 本文所持的论点恰恰是站在相反的立场。

meaning: n. 位置;职位;姿势,姿态;见解,立场,形势
example: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
translation: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

meaning: adj. 肯定的,积极的,绝对的,无疑的,正的
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. 介词
example: The word is compounded of a preposition and a verb.
translation: 这个词是由一个介词和一个动词复合而成的.

meaning: n. 提议,建议;求婚
example: After a three-weekend courtship, Pamela accepted Randolph's proposal of marriage.
translation: 经过3个周末的追求之后，帕梅拉接受了伦道夫的求婚。

meaning: v. 提议,建议;提名,推荐;求婚
example: And where do you propose building such a huge thing?
translation: 那么你打算在哪里建这么一个庞然大物呢？

meaning: n. 主张,建议;陈述,命题
example: Making easy money has always been an attractive proposition.
translation: 轻松赚钱总是件诱人的事。

meaning: n. 目的,意图;用途,效果
example: Most of them are destroyed because they've served their purpose.
translation: 它们中大多数在完成使命后被销毁。

meaning: v. 料想,猜想;假定;conj.假使...结果会怎样
example: The government, the executive and the judi-ciary are supposed to be separate.
translation: 政府、行政部门和司法部门应该彼此分离。

meaning: n. 讨论会,专题报告会;专题论文集
example: One prominent symptom of the disease is progressive loss of memory.
translation: 这种疾病的一个显著症状就是记忆逐渐丧失。

meaning: v. 占有,拥有
example: This figure has long been held to possess miraculous power.
translation: 这个数字长时间以来都被认为拥有神奇的力量。

meaning: n. 持有,拥有;所有权;所有物;(pl.)财产,财富
example: How had this com-promising picture come into the possession of the press?
translation: 这张令人难堪的照片是怎么落到媒体手中的？

meaning: n. 可能,可能性;可能的事,希望
example: There is the possibility that hypothermia can go unrecognized.
translation: 人们有可能察觉不到体温的过低。

meaning: adj. 可能的,做得到的;合理的;可允许的
example: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
translation: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

meaning: adv. 可能地，也许；无论如何
example: Do you think that he could possibly be right?
translation: 你觉得他有可能是对的吗？

meaning: v. 请求,恳求;祈祷,祈求
example: We have a beautiful city and we pray it stays that way.
translation: 我们的城市很美丽，但愿它能保持下去。

meaning: n. 对...作出的评价；评价，鉴定，评估; v. 赞扬,歌颂;表扬; n. 称赞,赞美;赞美的话
example: Self-appraisal is never easy.
translation: 进行自我评价向来很难。

meaning: n. 祈祷,祷告,祷文
example: The Colonel bowed his head and whispered a prayer of thanksgiving.
translation: 这位上校低头轻声做感恩祈祷。

meaning: n. 价格,价钱;代价; v. 标价
example: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

meaning: adj. 适当的恰当的特有的vt.拨给,挪用,盗用
example: A sense of period was evoked by complementing pictures with appropriate furniture.
translation: 给照片配上一些合适的家具，唤起了一种年代感。

meaning: v. 包含，包括，由...组成；构成，组成
example: The funds of the association shall comprise of members'subscriptions.
translation: 协会的基金将由会员的捐款构成.

meaning: n. 事业,企(事)业单位;事业心,进取心
example: He favoured a middle course between free enterprise and state intervention.
translation: 他更倾向于在自由经营与国家干预之间走一条中庸之道。

meaning: n. 自豪;自满；引以自豪的东西; v. 使自豪
example: He wrote the word "pride" in huge letters on the blackboard.
translation: 他在黑板上写了一个大大的单词pride。

meaning: n. 教士,神父
example: The priest made the sign of the cross over him.
translation: 神父在他上方画了个十字。

meaning: adj. 最初的,初级的;首要的,主要的,基本的
example: It is nearly always women who are the primary care givers.
translation: 从事初级保健护理工作的几乎都是女性。

meaning: adj. 首要的;最好的,第一流的; n. 青春,全盛期
example: The Prime Minister has been briefed by her parliamentary aides.
translation: 首相已听取了她议会助手的简要汇报。

meaning: adj. 原始的,远古的,早期的;粗糙的,简单的
example: Duffy's primitive guitar playing is well below par.
translation: 达菲粗糙的吉他演奏技巧远不够水平。

meaning: n. 王子,亲王
example: At tea-time, Victoria sang duets with her Consort, Prince Albert.
translation: 喝下午茶的时候，维多利亚与其夫君艾伯特亲王表演了二重唱。

meaning: n. 公主,王妃
example: The Sun had captioned a picture of Princess Diana "Princess of Veils"
translation: 《太阳报》在黛安娜王妃的一张照片下写了一段说明文字——“披着面纱的王妃”。

meaning: adj. 优先的,在前的;(to)在…之前
example: Prior to his Japan trip, he went to New York.
translation: 在去日本之前，他去了纽约。

meaning: n. 先,前;优先,重点,优先权
example: Spain's top priority is the signing of an EMU treaty.
translation: 西班牙的当务之急是签署《欧洲经济和货币联盟条约》。

meaning: n. 监狱
example: He was returned to prison in 1977 for impersonating a police officer.
translation: 他1977年因冒充警官而再次入狱。

meaning: n. 囚犯
example: His men made a sortie to Guazatan and took a prisoner.
translation: 他的士兵袭击了瓜扎坦，擒获了一名俘虏。

meaning: n. (不受干扰的)独处，自由，隐私；私生活

translation: 该报违反了保护隐私的行为准则。

meaning: adj. 私人的,个人的,秘密的,私下的
example: Like their children, parents are often defensive about their private lives.
translation: 就像子女一样，父母也常常很注重保护他们的私生活。

meaning: n. 特权,优惠,特许; v. 给予优惠,给予特权

translation: 皮罗尼出身于有钱有势的豪门，这看得出来。

meaning: n. 奖赏,奖金,奖品; v. 珍视,珍惜
example: Each month the total prize kitty is £13.5 million.
translation: 每个月的彩池奖金总额达1,350万英镑。

meaning: v. 使诧异,使惊异;奇袭; n. 诧异,惊异;奇袭
example: He was surprised they had married — they had seemed so different.
translation: 他俩居然结婚了——这让他非常惊讶，因为他们实在是太不一样了。

meaning: v. 为...表示感激，感谢；欣赏，赏识，评价
example: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
translation: 最幸福的人们并不一定什么都是最好，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

meaning: adj. 珍贵的,贵重的
example: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
translation: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

meaning: adj. 精确的,准确的
example: Elgar supplied his works with precise indications of tempo.
translation: 埃尔加给自己的作品标上了精确的节奏标记。

meaning: n. 精确,精确度
example: To minimize collateral damage maximum precision in bombing was required.
translation: 为了尽量减低附带性破坏，轰炸须做到最大程度的精确。

meaning: v. 证明,证实;检验;考验;鉴定;结果是,表明是

translation: 我必须证明自己是个正派、稳重的人。

meaning: n. 批准，通过；赞成，同意
example: A reformed party would have to win the approval of the people.
translation: 一个革新的政党需要赢得人民的认可。

meaning: v. (of)赞成，赞许，同意；批准，审议，通过
example: The council is considering whether to approve of the use of firearms.
translation: 政务委员会正在考虑是否要批准动用武器。

meaning: v. 改善,改进,增进;好转,进步
example: You can improve your chances of profit by sensible planning.
translation: 你可以通过合理计划来提高盈利的机会。

meaning: n. 改进,进步,增进;改进措施
example: CBS's ratings again showed huge improvement over the previous year.
translation: 与前一年相比，哥伦比亚广播公司的收视率再次大幅提高。

meaning: adj. 防水的,耐水的
example: waterproof paint
translation: 防水涂料；防水漆

meaning: n. 证据,证明;校样,样张
example: He has had to eat his words about the company being recession-proof.
translation: 他不得不收回他说过的公司能免受经济衰退影响的话。

meaning: adj. 正确的,恰当的,端正的; v. 改正,纠正,矫正
example: "That is correct, Meg," he answered in his cold, dead voice.
translation: “没错，梅格。”他用冰冷、阴沉的声音答道。

meaning: a&ad. 径直的(地); v. 管理,指导;(at,to)指向
example: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
translation: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

meaning: n. 方向,方位;指令,说明
example: Adjust the aerial's position and direction for the best reception.
translation: 调整天线的位置和方向以达到最佳接收效果。

meaning: adv. 直接地,径直地;马上,立即
example: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
translation: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

meaning: n. 指导者,主任,导演
example: He was hauled before the managing director and fired.
translation: 他被叫去见总裁，然后就被解雇了。

meaning: n. 人名地址录,(电话)号码簿
example: Yahoo is the oldest and best-known Web directory service.
translation: 雅虎是最早且最知名的因特网目录服务网站。

meaning: v. 树立,建立,使竖立; adj. 直立的,垂直的
example: Her legs were long and fine, her hips slender, her carriage erect.
translation: 她长腿细臀，身姿笔直。

meaning: n. [数]矩形, 长方形
example: Suppose the width of a rectangle is x metres.
translation: 设长方形的宽是x米.

meaning: v. 纠正,整顿, [化]精馏
example: Only an act of Congress could rectify the situation.
translation: 只有国会法案才能矫正这种形势。

meaning: adj. 相同的; pron. 相同的人(或物); adv. 同样地
example: Driving a boat is not the same as driving a car.
translation: 驾船和开车不是一回事。

meaning: n. 样品,实例,标本,抽样检查; v. 取样,采样
example: These figures were often spuriously computed by selecting particularly favorable sample groups.
translation: 这些数字往往是用错误的方法计算出来的，所用的都是特别挑选出来的对自己有利的样本组。

meaning: n. 集合；会议；装配；(美)洲议会的众议院
example: Several proposals are under consideration by the state assembly.
translation: 有几个提案州议会正在讨论中。

meaning: n. 相似,相似性[点,物]
example: Our tour prices bore little resemblance to those in the holiday brochures.
translation: 我们的旅游报价和那些度假手册里的价格相去甚远。

meaning: v. 像,类似
example: Did it resemble the earth when this was destitute of an atmosphere?
translation: 它同地球上还没有大气的时候一样 吗 ?

meaning: adj. 简单的;单纯的,直率的;迟钝的,头脑简单的

translation: 耶和华保护愚人.落到卑微的地步 、 救了我.

meaning: n. 简单,简易;朴素;直率,单纯
example: Everyone favours the simplification of court procedures.
translation: 每个人都希望法庭程序能够简化。

meaning: v. 简化,使单纯
example: Division of mankind into workingman and capitalists suffers from the fallacy of simplism.
translation: 硬把人类分成工人阶级和资本阶级就犯了过分简单化的错误.

meaning: adv. 简单地;完全,简直;仅仅,只不过;朴素地
example: simply supported
translation: 简支

meaning: adj. 悲观(主义)的
example: Hardy has often been criticised for an excessively pessimistic view of life.
translation: 哈代由于对生活持过度悲观的态度而常常受到批评。

meaning: adj. (to)相似的,类似的
example: Helen is also 25 and from Birmingham, but the similarity ends there.
translation: 海伦也是25岁，也来自伯明翰，但是相同之处仅此而已。

meaning: v. 模仿,模拟;假装,冒充
example: Training includes realistic simulation of casualty procedures.
translation: 培训包括对急救过程的真实模拟。

meaning: adj. 同时的,同时存在的
example: They all babbled simultaneously.
translation: 他们同时叽里咕噜地说了起来。

meaning: adj. 近似的; v. (to)接近; adj. sim
example: approximate solution
translation: [计]近似解

meaning: v. 吸收，消化；使同化; v. 被吸收；被同化
example: His family tried to assimilate into the white and Hispanic communities.
translation: 他一家人试图融入白人和西班牙裔社区。

meaning: n. 个人简历; v. 再继续,重新开始;再用;恢复
example: They thought that he should resume his kingly duties.
translation: 他们认为他应该继续履行君主的职责。

meaning: v. 假装；假定，设想；承担；呈现，采取
example: Don't assume your baby automatically needs feeding if she's fretful.
translation: 不要想当然地认为你的宝宝一闹就是要吃奶。

meaning: n. 假定，设想；采取；承担；推测；假装
example: We are working on the assumption that it was a gas explosion.
translation: 我们假设这是一场燃气爆炸事故。

meaning: v. 消耗；吃完，喝光；(with)使着迷；烧毁
example: Classically, overweight people underestimate the volume of food that they consume.
translation: 一般来说，超重的人往往低估自己摄入食物的量。

meaning: n. 消费(量),消耗
example: Most of the wine was unfit for human consumption.
translation: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。

meaning: v. 假定,假设,认为,揣测,滥用,擅自行动
example: They're resentful that outsiders presume to meddle in their affairs.
translation: 他们对外人擅自干预他们的事务非常愤慨。

meaning: adj. 有同情心的；赞同的；n.交感神经
example: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

meaning: v. (sympathise)(with)同情;共鸣,同感;赞成
example: Sometimes a sympathizer is one step away from a lover.
translation: 有时侯,同情者与情人仅一步之遥.

meaning: n. 同情，同情心；赞同，同感；慰问
example: Is there competition between sympatric jaguar Panthera onca and puma Puma concolor?
translation: 同域栖息的美洲虎和美洲狮存在竞争 吗 ?

meaning: n. 交响乐,交响曲
example: symphony orchestra
translation: 交响乐团

meaning: n. (疾病的)症状；(不好事情的)征兆,表征
n&v. 批准,同意,支持,认可; n. 处罚,制裁
example: The Security Council will consider taking future actions against sanction-busters.
translation: 安理会将考虑未来采取措施打击破坏制裁的人。

meaning: adj. 心智健全的,神志清醒的,明智的,稳健的
example: Did he come across as a sane rational person?
translation: 他看起来是一个正常而理智的人吗？

meaning: n. 综合病征；并存特性

translation: 严重急性呼吸系统综合症

meaning: n. (pl.syntheses)综合,合成
example: There are many amino acids that the body cannot synthesise itself.
translation: 有许多种氨基酸人体自身不能合成.

meaning: adj. 合成的,人造的;综合的
example: Studying the value of science is a new and synthetical study.
translation: 科学价值的向度研究是一个崭新的综合性跨学科领域研究.

meaning: n. 剧本(原稿)；手稿，原稿；笔迹，手迹
