translation: 楷书

meaning: n. 描写,形容;种类
example: We were in a disaster situation that defies description.
translation: 我们陷入了难以言表的糟糕处境。

meaning: n. 药方,处方
example: The prescription Ackerman gave me isn't doing any good.
translation: 阿克曼给我开的药没有任何疗效。

meaning: v. 描述,形容
example: describe as
translation: v. 描述为

meaning: v. (to)订阅，订购；同意vt.捐助，赞助
example: I have been a subscriber to Railway Magazine for many years.
translation: 我订阅《铁路杂志》已有很多年了。

meaning: v. 指示,规定;处(方),开(药)
example: The law allows doctors to prescribe contraception to the under 16s.
translation: 法律允许医生给16岁以下未成年人开避孕药。

meaning: adj. 第二;次等的,二等的; n. 秒; v. 赞成,附和
example: Objective : To explore how to reduce the and mistheraphy of secondarily peritonitis.
translation: 目的: 探讨如何避免继发性腹膜炎诊治过程中的失误.

meaning: adj. 连续的；连贯的；顺序的
example: Between 1940 and 1943 he had a string of 62 consecutive victories.
translation: 他在1940年至1943年间连续62次获胜。

meaning: v. 迫害
example: They persecute those who do not conform to their ideas.
translation: 他们迫害那些不信奉他们思想的人.

meaning: v. 实行，从事; v. 起诉，告发; v. 作检察官
example: Will you be able to prosecute your responsibilities effectively?
translation: 你能有效地履行职责 吗 ?

meaning: adj. 次要的,二级的;中级的,第二的
example: secondary school
translation: 中等学校

meaning: n. 结果,后果,影响;重要性
example: as a consequence
translation: 因此，结果

meaning: adv. 结果，因此，所以
example: They had children and were consequently tied to the school holidays.
translation: 他们有孩子，当然就受学校假期的束缚。

meaning: n. 先后,次序;连续,数列
example: They are only available when playing a MIDI file by external sequencer!
translation: 他们只用时由外部音序演奏MIDI文件!

meaning: adj. 随后的,后来的
example: subsequent events
translation: 财务报表编制后发生的事项

meaning: n. 感官;感觉;判断力;意义; v. 觉得,意识到
example: She probably sensed that I wasn'ttelling her the whole story.
translation: 她可能意识到了我并没有对她全盘托出。

meaning: n. 缺乏，不存在；缺席，不在；缺席的时间
example: There has been much gossip about the possible reasons for his absence.
translation: 关于他缺席的原因有很多传言。

meaning: adj. 缺席的；缺乏的,不存在的;心不在焉的
example: Carol was absent-minded and a little slow on the uptake.
translation: 卡萝尔心不在焉，反应有点迟钝。

meaning: n. (意见等的)一致，一致同意，共识
example: I realize there's no consensus on what are male or female values.
translation: 我意识到人们对什么是男性价值观和什么是女性价值观并无共识。

meaning: v&n. (to)同意,赞成,答应
example: At approxi-mately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search.
translation: 大概晚上11点半的时候，波拉德最终同意进行搜查。

meaning: n. 本质,实质
example: Though off-puttingly complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
translation: 虽然地税在细节上复杂得要命，但在本质上却很简单。

meaning: adj. 本质的,基本的;净化的; n. 本质;要素
example: Jordan promised to trim the city budget without cutting essential services.
translation: 乔丹承诺在不减少基本服务的前提下，缩减市政预算。

meaning: n. 出席,到场,存在,在
example: We had kept its presence hidden with a strategically placed chair.
translation: 我们用一张摆放得很巧妙的椅子将它隐藏了起来。

meaning: adj. 出席的,现在的; n. 现在,礼物; v. 赠送,提出
example: The carpet was a wedding present from the Prime Minister.
translation: 这张地毯是首相送的结婚礼物。

meaning: adv. 一会儿,不久;现在,目前
example: "Just take it easy," David said. "You'll feel better presently."
translation: “放松点，”戴维说，“你很快就会觉得更舒服些。”

meaning: v. 描述,表示;代表,代理;阐明,说明
example: The two politicians represent opposite poles of the political spectrum.
translation: 这两位从政者代表了政界的两个极端。

meaning: n. 代表,代理人; adj. (of)典型的,有代表性的
example: Professor Baker is unacquainted with the idea of representative democracy.
translation: 贝克教授并不熟悉“代议制民主”这一思想。

meaning: v. 对…表示忿恨,怨恨
example: It is only natural that he should resent you.
translation: 他怨恨你是很自然的事。

meaning: n. 参议院,上院
example: He was in Georgia stumping for Senator Wyche Fowler, a Democrat.
translation: 他正在佐治亚州为民主党参议员威奇·福勒作巡回演说。

meaning: n. 参议员
example: He has senatorial experience in defence and foreign policy.
translation: 他在参议院期间有过国防和外交政策方面的经验。

meaning: adj. 年长的;地位较高的; n. (大学)四年级学生
example: He has said he will fire editorial employees without regard to seniority.
translation: 他说过不管资历如何，任何编辑人员他都有可能解雇。

meaning: n. 感觉,知觉;激动,轰动,轰动一时的事情
example: Experts agreed that this was a truly sensational performance.
translation: 专家们一致认为这的确是一场精彩绝伦的演出。

meaning: adj. 明智的,达理的;可觉察的,明显的
example: He sensibly decided to lie low for a while.
translation: 他明智地决定暂时保持低调。

meaning: adj. (to)敏感的,易受伤害的;灵敏的
example: The abuse of women needs to be treated seriously and sensitively.
translation: 虐待妇女问题需要得到严肃而认真的处理。

meaning: n. 句子;判决,宣判; v. 宣判,判决
n. 感情，柔情；看法；感觉
example: Beneath the sentimental psychobabble, there's a likeable movie trying to get out.
translation: 在多愁善感的心理学呓语之下，一部本有可能受到喜爱的电影挣扎欲出。

meaning: n. 旁边，侧面；坡，岸；一边/侧/方; v. 支持
example: Tom pulled out his Sidearm and warily moved to the fallen aliens.
translation: 汤姆拔出他的手枪,警惕地向倒地的外星人移动.

meaning: adv. 在旁边，到一边; n. 旁白；离题的话
example: I pushed the problem aside; at present it was insoluble.
translation: 我把问题抛在一边，目前它还无法解决。

meaning: adv. 在旁边; prep. 和...在一起；在...旁边
example: A variety of heavy industries grew up alongside the port.
translation: 各种重工业沿着港口逐渐发展起来。

meaning: prep. 在...旁边，在...附近；和...相比
example: He lay beside her awkwardly, propped on an elbow.
translation: 他用一只胳膊肘支着身体，别扭地躺在她旁边。

meaning: adv. 此外；并且; prep. 于…之外；除…以外
example: I think she has many good qualities besides being very beautiful.
translation: 我觉得她不但长得非常漂亮，而且还有很多优秀品质。

meaning: v. 考虑，细想；体谅，顾及；认为，把…看作
example: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

meaning: adj. 相当大(或多)的,可观的;值得考虑的
example: He brought to the job not just considerable experience but passionate enthusiasm.
translation: 他不仅给这一工作带来了不少经验，而且倾注了极大的热情。

meaning: adj. 考虑周到的,体谅的
example: The patient has the right to considerate and respectful care.
translation: 病人有权得到周到而礼貌的照顾。

meaning: n. 需要考虑的事;考虑,思考;体谅,照顾
example: Several proposals are under consideration by the state assembly.
translation: 有几个提案州议会正在讨论中。

meaning: adj. 里面的; adv. 在里面; n. 内部; prep. 在…里
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: adv. 向外面; n. 外部; adj. 外部的; prep. 在…外
example: The President's unescorted vehicle was ambushed just outside the capital.
translation: 刚出首都，总统无人护卫的汽车就遭到了伏击。

meaning: v. (at,over)主持
example: They asked if I would preside at the committee meeting.
translation: 他们问我是否会主持委员会会议。

meaning: n. 总统,校长,会长,主席
example: The President's speeches are regularly reproduced verbatim in the state-run newspapers.
translation: 总统的讲话通常会被一字不差地刊登在国有报纸上。

meaning: n. 声望,威望,威信
example: It was his responsibility for foreign affairs that gained him international prestige.
translation: 他在负责处理外交事务的过程中赢得了国际声望。

meaning: n. 住处,住宅
example: They had entered the country and had applied for permanent residence.
translation: 他们已经入境该国，并申请了永久居留权。

meaning: n. 居民,常住者; adj. 居住的
example: Similar arrangements apply to students who are ordinarily resident in Scotland.
translation: 类似的安排适用于长期居住在苏格兰的学生。

meaning: n. 海滨,海边
example: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
translation: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

meaning: adv&adj. 向旁边(的),侧身,横着(的),斜着(的)
n. 补助金；津贴费
example: Old people often subsist on very small incomes.
translation: 老人往往靠十分微薄的收入艰难度日。

meaning: n. 标记,招牌;征兆,迹象v.签名(于),署名(于)
example: sign up
translation: 签约雇用，签约参加

meaning: v. 派给，分配；选定，指定(时间、地点等)
example: It had been a monumental blunder to give him the assign-ment.
translation: 当时把这项任务给他是大错特错了。

meaning: n. 分配，指派；(指定的)作业，任务
example: Characteristically, he worked hard at the assignment.
translation: 他一如既往地认真完成分派的任务。

meaning: v. 设计;构思;绘制;图案;企图; n. 设计,图样
example: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
translation: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

meaning: v. 指明,指出;任命,指派
example: Japan'sPrime Minister-designate is completing his Cabinet today.
translation: 日本的当选首相今日将完成组阁。

meaning: v. 辞去,辞职,使听从(于),使顺从
example: He was under pressure to resign and was about to be sidelined.
translation: 他承受着被迫辞职的压力，很快就要被排挤出去了。

meaning: n. 信号,暗号; v. 发信号,用信号通知
example: " This's signaler in quality, but cheaper. "
translation: 这个质量相似, 但更便宜.

meaning: n. 签名,署名,签字
example: digital signature
translation: 数字签名，数字签字

meaning: v. 表示,意味;要紧,有重要性
example: Iago . I am very glad to see you, signior Welcome to Cyprus.
translation: 伊阿古 我很高兴看见您, 大人;欢迎您到塞浦路斯来!

meaning: v. 协助，帮助，促进; v. 帮忙，参加
example: We are here to protect and assist the weak and infirm.
translation: 我们来这里保护、帮助年迈体弱者。

meaning: n. 协作; 援助; 帮助
example: Any assistance you could give the police will be greatly appreciated.
translation: 您提供的任何帮助警方都将万分感谢。

meaning: adj. 帮助的，辅助的; n. 助手，助教；辅助物
example: Her assistant was accused of theft and fraud by the police.
translation: 她的助手被警方指控犯有盗窃和欺诈罪。

meaning: v. (in)在于,存在于;(of)由…组成,由…构成
example: The division will consist of two tank companies and one infantry company.
translation: 这个师的组成部队将包括两个坦克连和一个步兵连。

meaning: adj. (in)前后一致的；（with）一致，符合
example: consistent with
translation: 符合；与…一致

meaning: v. (on)坚持要求,坚决主张,坚持
example: They insist on tastier chocolate than the anaemic British stuff.
translation: 他们坚持要比淡而无味的英国货味道更好的巧克力。

meaning: v. (in)坚持,持续
example: If the symptoms persist, it is important to go to your doctor.
translation: 如果这些症状持续存在，一定要去看医生。

meaning: v. 抵抗,反抗;抗,忍得住,抵制
example: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.
translation: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

meaning: n. (to)抵抗,反抗;抵抗力,阻力;电阻
example: In the end the Kurds surrendered without putting up any resistance.
translation: 最后库尔德人没有作任何抵抗就投降了。

meaning: adj. (to)抵抗的,有抵抗力的
example: The body may be less resistant if it is cold.
translation: 天冷时，身体的抵抗力会下降。

meaning: n. 姐，妹；护士长；修女，女教士
example: There was a degree of solidarity and sisterhood among the women.
translation: 这些女人之间存在着一定程度的团结精神和姐妹情谊。

meaning: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
example: A transistorize radio takes no time to warm up.
translation: 晶体管收音机不需要预热时间.

meaning: n. 系统，体系；制度；方法，方式，步聚
adj. (al)系统的,有组织的
example: The way he works isn't very systematical.
translation: 他的工作方法不是很有条理.

meaning: adj. 单独的,唯一的; n. 脚垫,鞋底
example: He pads along the solebar.
translation: 他沿着车架纵梁慢慢地走.

meaning: adj. 已废弃的,过时的
example: With technological changes many traditional skills have become obsolete.
translation: 随着技术的革新，许多传统技艺已被淘汰。

meaning: adj. 坚决的,果断的
example: He described the situation as very dangerous and called for resolute action.
translation: 他将形势描述得非常危险，并号召采取果断行动。

meaning: n. 坚决,决心;决定,决议
example: "I think I'll try a hypnotist," I said with sudden resolution.
translation: “我会找催眠师试试，”我突然坚决地说。

meaning: v. 决心;(使)分解,溶解;决议; n. 解决;决心
example: This merely strengthens our resolve to win the league.
translation: 这只会更加坚定我们赢得联赛的决心。

meaning: adj. 太阳的,日光的
example: solar energy
translation: 太阳能

meaning: n. 士兵,军人
example: soldier on
translation: 继续服役；坚持着干；迎着困难干

meaning: adj. 庄严的,隆重的;严肃的
example: solemn promise
translation: 庄严承诺；誓言

meaning: adj. 固体的;结实的,稳固的,可靠的; n. 固体
example: The paper studies the alkaline cooking properties of Solidago analysis.
translation: 对加拿大一枝黄花碱法蒸煮性能进行了研究.

meaning: n. 团结；休戚相关
adj. (好)孤独的；偏僻的；单一的，唯一的
example: Imagine long golden beaches where you can wander in solitude.
translation: 想象一下那长长的金色海滩吧，在那里你可以独自徜徉。

meaning: n. 独奏; adj. &ad.单独的(地)；独唱的(地)
example: solo concert
translation: 个人演唱会

meaning: adj. 可溶的
example: water soluble
translation: 水溶性的；溶于水的

meaning: n. 解答,解决办法;溶解,溶液
example: aqueous solution
translation: 水溶液

meaning: v. 解决,解答
example: Fears about the solvency of the banks precipitated the great economic crash.
translation: 对银行偿付能力出现恐慌更加速了经济的崩溃.

meaning: adj. 绝对的，完全的；确实的，肯定的
example: The industry minister described the affair as "an absolute scandal".
translation: 工业部长将此事件形容为“绝对的丑闻”。

meaning: n. 控制台，仪表板；落地柜; v. 安慰，慰问
example: I can console myself with the fact that I'm not alone.
translation: 不是只有我一个人才这样，我可以用这一事实来安慰自己。

meaning: v. 使加固，使加强；(把)联为一体，合并
example: The question is: will the junta consolidate its power by force?
translation: 问题是：军政府会通过武力巩固其政权吗？

meaning: adj. 荒凉的;孤独的; v. 使荒芜
example: Half-ruined, hardly a building untouched, it's a desolate place.
translation: 这里大半遭毁，几乎没有一栋建筑完好无损，变成了一块荒废之地。

meaning: v. (使)溶解,(使)融化;解散,取消
example: Kaifu threatened to dissolve the Parliament and call an election.
translation: 卡夫威胁要解散议会并举行选举。

meaning: n. 小岛(用于诗歌中)
example: Castle-hunters won't be disappointed with the Isle of Man.
translation: 马恩岛不会让城堡探寻者失望的。

meaning: v. 隔离,孤立
example: Political influence is being used to shape public opinion and isolate critics.
translation: 政治影响正被用来左右公众舆论，使批评家们陷于孤立。

meaning: n. 岛，岛屿；(道路上的)交通安全岛
example: They were going to sail around the little island, against the tide.
translation: 他们打算绕着小岛逆潮航行。

meaning: v. 请教，向...咨询，找...商量；查阅，查看
example: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
translation: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

meaning: n. 会诊医师,顾问医生;顾问
example: Shirley's brother is now a consultant heart surgeon in Sweden.
translation: 雪利的兄弟现在在瑞典做心脏外科高级顾问医师。

meaning: v. 隔离,孤立;使绝缘,使绝热
example: He continues to insulate his country from the contagion of foreign ideas.
translation: 他继续使本国远离外来思想的侵袭。

meaning: v. /n.侮辱,凌辱
example: She spat the name out like an insult.
translation: 她像骂人似的说出了那个名字。

meaning: n. 结果,成绩; v. 结果,致使,导致,由…而造成
example: The result reflects a modest rightward shift in opinion.
translation: 结果显示舆论出现一定程度的右倾。

meaning: adj. 作为结果而发生的;合成的
example: the growing economic crisis and resultant unemployment
translation: 不断加剧的经济危机以及由此而产生的失业

meaning: n. 样子, 外表, 面貌, (问题等的)方面
example: Antonio has a contagious enthusiasm for the beautiful aspect of food.
translation: 安东尼奥对食品赏心悦目这一方面的热情非常有感染性。

meaning: v. 预期;期望,指望
example: Don't expect me to come and visit you there.
translation: 别指望我会去那儿看你。

meaning: n. 预期,期望,指望
example: The weight of expectation was getting to them.
translation: 他们逐渐感觉到了期望带来的压力。

meaning: v. 检查,调查,视察
example: They have the right to come in and inspect the meter.
translation: 他们有权进来查表。

meaning: adj. 不顾的,不考虑的,无关的
example: Everyone is treated equally, irrespective of race.
translation: 不分种族，每个人都受到公平对待。

meaning: n. 透视画法,透视图;远景,前途;观点,看法
example: It's the collision of disparate ideas that alters one's perspective.
translation: 是迥然不同的观点之间的碰撞改变了人们的看法。

meaning: n. 景色;前景,前途,展望
example: Unfortunately, there is little prospect of seeing these big questions answered.
translation: 不幸的是，几乎不可能看到这些重大问题得到回复。

meaning: adj. 预期的
example: Prospective buyers should study the small ads in the daily newspaper.
translation: 打算购物的人应该研究研究日报上的小广告。

meaning: n&v. 尊敬,尊重; n. 敬意,问候,关系,方面
example: The treaty binds them to respect their neighbour's independence.
translation: 条约规定他们必须尊重其邻国的独立。

meaning: adj. 各自的,各个的
example: It is important that we dovetail our respective interests.
translation: 让我们各自的利益相吻合很重要。

meaning: v&n. 回顾，回想，追溯[反]foresee
example: The debate seems, in retrospect, to have been fixed from the beginning.
translation: 回想起来，这场辩论好像从一开始就被人操纵了。

meaning: n. (pl.)眼镜;场面,景象;奇观,壮观
example: The big spectacled Joy - Hulga would scowl and redden as if her privacy had been intruded upon.
translation: 戴眼镜的大个儿欢姐--赫尔格会气得横眉怒目,脸色涨红,好象人家触及了她的什么隐私.

meaning: adj. 壮观的,引人注目的; n. 壮观的演出
n. 观众,旁观者
example: spectator sport
translation: 吸引大量观众的体育运动

meaning: n. 谱，光谱，频谱；范围，幅度，系列
v. 猜想；怀疑；察觉; adj. 可疑的; n. 嫌疑犯
example: Its motive and jumping - off place are very suspectable.
translation: 其动机及出发点十分值得怀疑.

meaning: adj. 想不到的, 意外的, 未预料到
example: The desire to be a mother may creep up on you unexpectedly.
translation: 你会不知不觉地产生想当母亲的渴望。

meaning: adv. 特别，尤其，格外；专门地，主要地
example: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
translation: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

meaning: adj. 特殊的,专门的;附加的,额外的
example: Increasing technological application and innovation in manufacturing industries result in more specialisation and distribution of processes on a global scale.
translation: 制造业日益增加科技和创新意念的应用,使工序更趋专门精细和分散于全球.

meaning: n. 专家
n. (specialty)特性，性质；专业/长；特产
example: The production line involves a high degree of specialization of labour.
translation: 生产线要求工人高度专业化.

meaning: v. (specialise)(in)专攻,专门研究,专业化
example: I'm specializing in differential and integral calculus.
translation: 我正专攻微分学和积分学.

meaning: n. (物)种,种类
example: species diversity
translation: 物种多样性；歧异度

meaning: adj. 明确的,具体的;特定的,特有的

meaning: n. 质量，[统计] 品质；特性；才能; adj. 优质的；高品质的；<英俚>棒极了

translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

meaning: n. 批评；考证；苛求
v. 保持；依然；留下；剩余；逗留；残存; n. 遗迹；剩余物，残骸
example: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

meaning: n. 产品；结果；[数] 乘积；作品
example: A series of technical foul-ups delayed the launch of the new product.
translation: 一系列技术问题延误了新产品的上市。

meaning: n. 国家；民族；国民
example: Albania is a small nation state of around 3 million people.
translation: 阿尔巴尼亚是一个大约有300万人口的单一民族独立国家。

meaning: v. 推断；推论
example: People usually infer an unknown fact from a known fact.
translation: 人们通常从已知的事实中推断未知的事实.

meaning: n. 社区；[生态] 群落；共同体；团体
example: There has always been a difference between community radio and commercial radio.
translation: 社区广播电台和商业广播电台一直是有区别的。

meaning: adj. 幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的; n. (Happy)人名；(英、瑞典、喀)哈皮
example: She has now changed into a happy, self-confident woman.
translation: 如今她已经变成一个快乐、自信的女人。

meaning: v. 包括；采访，报导；涉及; n. 封面，封皮；盖子；掩蔽物;幌子，借口
example: Just play it safe, cover your ass, keep your head down.
translation: 要谨慎行事，保护好自己并保持低调。

meaning: n. 出版；出版物；发表
example: The Tundra Times, a weekly newspaper in Alaska, ceased publication this week.
translation: 阿拉斯加的周报《苔原时报》本周停刊了。

meaning: v. 分割; n. 段；部分
example: market segment
translation: 细分市场；市场区隔；分块市场

meaning: v. 寻求；寻找；探索；搜索
example: I am a seeker after truth.
translation: 我追求真理。

meaning: n. 条件；情况；环境；身份; v. 决定；使适应；使健康；以…为条件
example: He was concerned with the enhancement of the human condition.
translation: 他关心人类生存环境的改善。

meaning: n. 因特网
example: Surfing the Internet is fun, but it's also a time waster.
translation: 上网很有意思，但也很浪费时间。

meaning: n. 成功，成就；胜利；大获成功的人或事物
example: I wasn't successful, so they looked down on me.
translation: 我一无所成，所以他们瞧不起我。

meaning: n. 基金；资金；存款; v. 投资；资助
example: He's accused of misusing $17.5 million from a secret government slush fund.
translation: 他被指控滥用秘密的政府行贿基金，金额达1,750万美元。

meaning: n. 结构；构造；建筑物; v. 组织；构成；建造
example: industrial structure
translation: 产业结构

meaning: n. 感觉，功能；观念；道理；理智; v. 感觉到；检测
example: She probably sensed that I wasn'ttelling her the whole story.
translation: 她可能意识到了我并没有对她全盘托出。

meaning: n. 报纸
example: Under the newspaper, atop a sheet of paper, lay an envelope.
translation: 在报纸下面的一张纸上放着一个信封。

meaning: n. 顾客；家伙
example: In some stores we were undermanned and customer service was suffering.
translation: 有些店我们人手不足，对顾客照顾不周。

meaning: adj. 博学的；有学问的；学术上的; n. (Learned)人名；(英)勒尼德
example: She's kicked her drug habit and learned that her life has value.
translation: 她已经戒了毒，并且认识到了生命可贵。

meaning: n. 董事会；木板；甲板；膳食; v. 上（飞机、车、船等）；用板盖上；给提供膳宿
example: You get a big salary incentive and free board and lodging too.
translation: 你们能获得大笔激励性薪水，还可享受免费膳宿。

meaning: n. 总统；董事长；校长；主席
example: The President's speeches are regularly reproduced verbatim in the state-run newspapers.
translation: 总统的讲话通常会被一字不差地刊登在国有报纸上。

meaning: v. 移动，迁移；开除；调动; n. 移动；距离；搬家

translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. 系列，连续；[电] 串联；级数；丛书
example: The harmonious blendofancientcalligraphy and modern sans serif fonts works like a charm.
translation: 古代书法和现代饰线字体的协调融会充斥魔力.

meaning: v. 记录，记载；标明；将录音; n. 档案，履历；唱片；最高纪录; adj. 创纪录的
example: Exports in June rose 1.5% to a record $30.91 billion.
translation: 6月份的出口额上升了1.5%，创下309.1亿美元的历史最高纪录。

meaning: adj. 道德的；精神上的；品性端正的; n. 道德；寓意
example: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: n. 成果；产品；生产；作品
example: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
translation: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

meaning: n. 人口；[生物] 种群，[生物] 群体；全体居民
example: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population.
translation: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

meaning: v. 强调；在…下面划线；预告; n. 下划线；下期节目预告
n. 人类；人道；仁慈；人文学科
example: We admire her dedication to the cause of humanity.
translation: 我们敬佩她对人类事业的献身精神。

meaning: n. 位置，方位；职位，工作；姿态；站位; v. 安置；把……放在适当位置
example: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
translation: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

meaning: adj. 特别的；详细的；独有的；挑剔的; n. 详细说明；个别项目
example: We are taught to construe these terms in a particular way.
translation: 我们被教导要以特定的方式理解这些词语。

meaning: adj. 移民的；迁入的; n. 移民，侨民
example: In recent months many conservative politicians have jumped on the anti-immigrant bandwagon.
translation: 最近几个月，很多保守政客都搭上了“反移民”这班车。

meaning: n. 时机，机会
example: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
translation: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

meaning: v. 使用；存取；接近; n. 进入；使用权；通路
example: The home is situated within easy access of shops and other facilities.
translation: 房子位置便利，距离商店及其他设施都不远。

meaning: v. 庆祝
example: The Royal Greenwich Observatory was founded to observe and catalogue the stars.
translation: 当初创立皇家格林尼治天文台就是为了观察星体并对其进行编目。

meaning: v. 停留；坚持；暂住；停下; n. 逗留；停止；支柱
example: He's not a fast horse but he's certainly a stayer.
translation: 这匹马跑得不快,但很有耐力.

meaning: adj. 商业的；营利的；靠广告收入的; n. 商业广告
example: There has always been a difference between community radio and commercial radio.
translation: 社区广播电台和商业广播电台一直是有区别的。

meaning: v. 显示；透露；揭露；泄露; n. 揭露；暴露；门侧，窗侧
example: Experts reveal only as much as they care to.
translation: 专家们只透露了他们想透露的那些。

meaning: n. 努力；成就
example: McGregor's effort was enough to edge Johnson out of the top spot.
translation: 麦格雷戈奋力一搏，成功地将约翰逊从第一的位置上挤了下来。

meaning: v. 减少；降低；使处于；把…分解
example: The job losses will reduce the total workforce to 7,000.
translation: 职位减少后，在职工人总数将减至7,000人。

meaning: n. 术语；学期；期限；条款；(代数式等的)项; v. 把…叫做
example: in terms
translation: 明确地；毫不含糊地

meaning: n. 行动；活动；功能；战斗；情节

translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

meaning: n. 十年，十年期；十
example: These developments were foreseen in embryo more than a decade ago.
translation: 这些发展早在十多年前的萌芽阶段就已预见到。

meaning: n. 生产力；生产率；生产能力
example: The obverse of rising unemployment is continued gains in productivity.
translation: 失业率上升，相对应的是生产率进一步提高。

meaning: n. [语][计] 句子，命题；宣判，判决; v. 判决，宣判
n. 名人；名声
example: He was more than a footballing superstar, he was a celebrity.
translation: 他不仅仅是足球场上的巨星，也是一位社会名流。

meaning: n. 教师；导师
example: english teacher
translation: 英语教师

meaning: v. 涉及，关系到；使担心; n. 关系；关心；关心的事；忧虑
example: Issues such as these were not really his concern.
translation: 他其实并不关心诸如此类的问题。

meaning: n. 分数；二十；配乐；刻痕; v. 获得；评价；划线，刻划；把…记下
example: The figures flash up on the scoreboard.
translation: 分数在记分牌上亮起。

meaning: n. 多样；种类；杂耍；变化，多样化
example: variety of
translation: 各种各样的

meaning: adj. 独特的，稀罕的；[数] 唯一的，独一无二的; n. 独一无二的人或物
example: Bead-work, applique and embroidery add a uniquely feminine touch.
translation: 珠饰、嵌花和刺绣可增添一种独特的女人味。

meaning: v. 依赖，依靠；取决于；相信，信赖
example: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think.--Dale Carnegie
translation: 请记住，幸福不在于你是谁或者你拥有什么，而仅仅取决于你的心态！

meaning: adj. 原子能的；[细胞] 细胞核的；中心的；原子核的
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: v. 包含；牵涉；使陷于；潜心于
example: The £85m programme will involve an extensive rebranding of the airline.
translation: 这个8,500万英镑的项目将包括全面重塑该航空公司的形象。

meaning: n. 生涯；职业；事业；速度，全速; adj. 作为毕生职业的; v. 全速前进，猛冲
example: Somehow Karin managed to cope with the demands of her career.
translation: 卡琳设法达到了其职业的要求。

meaning: n. 相信，信赖；信仰；教义
example: The Greeks accepted belief in the immortality of the soul.
translation: 希腊人相信灵魂不灭。

meaning: v. 度过，消磨（时光）；花费；浪费；用尽; n. 预算
example: Spendable earnings accrue on the gift annually.
translation: 这个捐献每年生可使用的利息所得.

meaning: adj. 必要的；必需的；必然的; n. 必需品
example: For her, books were as necessary to life as bread.
translation: 对她来说，书就像面包一样，是生活必需品。

meaning: adj. 一般的，普通的；综合的；大体的; n. 一般；将军，上将；常规
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: v. 治疗；治愈；使硫化；加工处理; n. 治疗；治愈；[临床] 疗法
example: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.
translation: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。

meaning: n. 网络；广播网；网状物
example: This film is the first British animation sold to an American network.
translation: 这是第一部出售给美国电视网的英国动画片。

meaning: v. （使）下决心，（使）做出决定
example: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
translation: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

meaning: adj. 可能的；合理的；合适的; n. 可能性；合适的人；可能的事物
example: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
translation: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

meaning: n. 安全；保证；证券；抵押品; adj. 安全的；保安的；保密的
example: social security
translation: 社会保险，社会保障

meaning: n. 组织；机构；体制；团体
example: The term "organization" often connotes a sense of neatness.
translation: organization这个词常常让人想到整洁。

meaning: n. 追赶，追求；职业，工作
example: Moreau took gold in the five-kilometre individual pursuit competition.
translation: 莫罗在个人五公里追逐赛中获得金牌。

meaning: n. 工厂，车间；植物；设备；庄稼; v. 种植；培养；栽培；安置
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: n. 情况；形势；处境；位置
example: current situation
translation: 现状，目前形势；现况

meaning: n. 代理，中介；代理处，经销处
example: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: adj. 自然的；物质的；天生的；不做作的; n. 自然的事情；白痴；本位音
example: The ball is made of rattan — a natural fibre.
translation: 这个球是由一种天然纤维——省藤制成的。

meaning: v. 说话；演讲；表明；陈述
example: It will mean the unspeakable by clearly displaying the speakable.
translation: 它将清楚地指出什么是可以言说的,从而也就指出了什么是不可言说的.

meaning: n. 特色，特征；容貌；特写或专题节目; v. 起重要作用
example: The most arresting feature is the painted wall decoration.
translation: 最醒目的特点是绘有图画的墙面装饰。

meaning: n. 翻译；译文；转化；调任
example: english translation
translation: 英语翻译，英译本

meaning: n. 块，团；群众，民众；大量，众多；质量; adj. 群众的，民众的；大规模的，集中的; v. 聚集起来，聚集
example: On his desk is a mass of books and papers.
translation: 他的书桌上有大堆的书籍和文件。

meaning: v. 取得；获得；实现；成功
example: I asked McKeown if the reunion was meant to achieve closure.
translation: 我问麦基翁重聚是不是为了寻求解脱。

meaning: v. 同意，赞成；承认；约定，商定
example: The dampness of the forest did not agree with him physically.
translation: 他的身体不能适应森林的潮湿。

meaning: adj. 困难的；不随和的；执拗的
example: He had a reputation for being bloody-minded and difficult.
translation: 他为人刻薄、难相处是出了名的。

meaning: adj. 正式的；拘谨的；有条理的; n. 正式的社交活动；夜礼服
example: A formal contract is signed which is renewable annually.
translation: 正式签订了每年可续签的合同。

meaning: n. 律师；法学家
example: "He was a lawyer before that," Mary Ann put in.
translation: “在那之前他是个律师，”玛丽·安补充道。

meaning: n. 趋势，倾向；走向; v. 趋向，伸向
example: She's a very snappy dresser , ie She dresses very smartly and trendily.
translation: 她衣着很入时.

meaning: n. 命令；顺序；规则；[贸易] 定单; v. 命令；整理；定购
example: The waiter returned with their order and Graham signed the bill.
translation: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。

meaning: n. 优势；利益；有利条件; v. 获利
example: I want to take advantage of your lifetime of scholarship.
translation: 我希望能够用到您一生的学识。

meaning: v. 假设；认为；让（虚拟语气）；推想; conj. 假使…结果会怎样
example: The government, the executive and the judi-ciary are supposed to be separate.
translation: 政府、行政部门和司法部门应该彼此分离。

meaning: n. 省；领域；职权
example: Most of those who left the province to work abroad were unskilled.
translation: 那些离开该省出国打工的人大部分都未经专门训练。

meaning: n. 英式足球，足球
example: Sochi was chosen last year to host the 2014 Olympic Winter Games.
translation: 索契于去年赢得2014年冬奥会举办权.

meaning: v. 鼓励，怂恿；激励；支持
example: The idea is to encourage people to get to know their neighbours.
translation: 其目的是促使人们结识邻居。

meaning: n. 许诺，允诺；希望; v. 允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望
example: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.
translation: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

meaning: n. 迹象；符号；记号；手势；指示牌; v. 签署；签名
example: sign up
translation: 签约雇用，签约参加

meaning: n. 分析；分解；验定
example: Throughout, she illustrates her analysis with excerpts from discussions.
translation: 自始至终，她摘引讨论内容来阐明她的分析。

meaning: v. 翻译；转化；解释；转变为；调动
example: translate into
translation: 翻译成

meaning: adj. 熟练的；内行的；老练的; n. 专家；行家；能手; vt. 当专家；在…中当行家
example: You'll also get expert advice on keeping your hair in good condition.
translation: 你还会获得有关如何保持良好发质的专家建议。

meaning: v. 提出；介绍；呈现；赠送; adj. 现在的；出席的; n. 现在；礼物；瞄准
example: The carpet was a wedding present from the Prime Minister.
translation: 这张地毯是首相送的结婚礼物。

meaning: n. 司法，法律制裁；正义；法官，审判员
example: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

meaning: v. 申请；涂，敷；应用
example: Investors can apply for a package of shares at a set price.
translation: 投资者可以申购固定价格的股票组合。

meaning: adj. 有限的; n. 高级快车
example: So far we have had ringing declarations, but only limited action.
translation: 目前，我们已经发表了一些有力的声明，但只采取了有限的行动。

meaning: n. 来源；水源；原始资料
example: It was first mentioned in a 1989 roleplaying game sourcebook.
translation: 1989的一个角色扮演游戏资料设定集首次提到全息网.

meaning: v. 拿，扛；携带；支持；搬运; n. 运载；[计] 进位；射程
example: The indisputable fact is that computers carry out logical operations.
translation: 不容置疑的事实是，电脑执行逻辑操作指令。

meaning: n. 焦点；中心；清晰；焦距; v. 使集中；使聚焦
example: In the background, in soft focus, we see his smiling wife.
translation: 在背景部分，我们可以看到他妻子面带微笑的蒙影像。

meaning: v. 睡，睡觉; n. 睡眠
example: go to sleep
translation: 入睡

meaning: n. 现实；实际；真实
example: The reality of mothering is frequently very different from the romantic ideal.
translation: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

meaning: v. 赶上；抓住；感染；了解; n. 捕捉；捕获物；窗钩
example: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
translation: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

meaning: adj. 基本的；基础的; n. 基础；要素
example: basic principle
translation: 基本原理

meaning: n. 发现；裁决；发现物; v. 找到；感到（find的ing形式）；遇到

meaning: n. 访问；参观；逗留; v. 访问；参观；视察

translation: 进行访问

meaning: n. 模型；典型；模范；模特儿；样式; v. 模拟；塑造；模仿; adj. 模范的；作模型用的

translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: n. 物质；事件; v. 有关系；要紧

translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. [物] 物理的；身体的；物质的；根据自然规律的，符合自然法则的; n. 体格检查

translation: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

meaning: adj. 古典的；经典的；传统的；第一流的; n. 古典音乐

translation: 这些形象属哥特式或者拜占庭式而非古典式。

meaning: n. 增长；发展；生长；种植

translation: 去年，经济增长率下降到4%以下。

meaning: n. 贸易，交易；行业；职业; v. 交易，买卖；以物易物

translation: 福特在20世纪80年代废止了该名称和商标。

meaning: n. 轨道；足迹，踪迹；小道; v. 追踪；通过；循路而行；用纤拉

translation: 田径；田径赛

meaning: adj. 高级的；年长的；地位较高的；年资较深的，资格较老的; n. 上司；较年长者；毕业班学生
example: He has said he will fire editorial employees without regard to seniority.
translation: 他说过不管资历如何，任何编辑人员他都有可能解雇。

meaning: v. 教育；培养；训练

translation: 露丝的父母选择了在家对她进行集中教育。

meaning: v. 站立；位于；停滞; n. 站立；立场；看台；停止

translation: 《伦敦标准晚报》报址几年前迁走了。

meaning: n. 新闻工作者；报人；记日志者

translation: 他当了一辈子新闻记者，如今已出了一本书。

meaning: n. 环境；安装；布置；[天] 沉落; v. 放置；沉没；使…处于某位置（set的ing形式）

translation: 真诚的表演和对波士顿这一背景城市的真实刻画增添了电影的现实主义色彩。

meaning: v. 返回；报答; n. 返回；归还；回球; adj. 报答的；回程的；返回的

translation: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

meaning: n. 关系；关联

translation: 一段美满的恋情需要彼此关心并体恤对方的情感。

meaning: n. 模式；图案；样品; v. 模仿；以图案装饰

translation: 她会教你如何搭配款式和颜色。

meaning: v. 浮现；摆脱；暴露

meaning: v. 驳回诉讼；忽视；不理睬

translation: 电影业故意无视电视业的侵犯性竞争。

meaning: v. 流动，涌流；川流不息；飘扬; n. 流动；流量；涨潮，泛滥

translation: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

meaning: adj. 适当的；相配的
example: There are problems in recruiting suitably qualified scientific officers for NHS laboratories.
translation: 很难为国民医疗保健系统的实验室招募到资历合适的高级科研人员。

meaning: n. 环境，外界

translation: 离开福利机构的照顾，离开这种受保护的环境，他将难以生存下去。

meaning: n. 运动；练习；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼; v. 锻炼；练习；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐

translation: 他的练习本上尽是些红钩钩，都是他应得的。

meaning: n. 力量；武力；军队；魄力; v. 促使，推动；强迫；强加

translation: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。

meaning: v. 介绍；引进；提出；采用
example: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
translation: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

meaning: adj. 个人的；身体的；亲自的; n. 人事消息栏；人称代名词

translation: 我的私人生活不得不让位于事业。

meaning: adj. [数] 负的；消极的；否定的；阴性的; n. 否定；负数；[摄] 底片; v. 否定；拒绝

translation: 到目前为止，参加测试的有57人，测试结果均呈阴性。

meaning: adj. 本国的；土著的；天然的；与生俱来的；天赋的; n. 本地人；土产；当地居民

translation: 我们被禁止使用母语，违者将被关进监狱。

meaning: n. 投资；投入；封锁

translation: 投资可能会中断，而这会引起经济衰退。

meaning: n. 交换；交流；交易所；兑换; v. 交换；交易；兑换

translation: 这可能会加剧爆发核战争的危险。

meaning: n. 范围；幅度；排；山脉; v. （在内）变动；平行，列为一行；延伸；漫游；射程达到

translation: 这家公司生产一系列的新型轻便自行车。

meaning: adj. 专业的；职业的；职业性的; n. 专业人员；职业运动员

translation: 他似乎只是出于职业缘故而喜欢她。

meaning: adj. 坚强的；强壮的；牢固的；擅长的; adv. 强劲地；猛烈地; n. (Strong)人名；(英)斯特朗

translation: 所以, 在这个保险箱里你的秘密是绝对安全的!

meaning: adv. 特别地，非常；另外; n. 临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品; adj. 额外的，另外收费的；特大的

meaning: adj. 成功的；一帆风顺的

translation: 绑匪成功地勒索了7.5万英镑才将她释放。

meaning: v. 导电；带领; n. 进行；行为；实施

meaning: n. 结果；重要性；推论

meaning: adv. 主要地；大部分；大量地

meaning: n. 演变；进化论；进展

translation: 大型油画可以增加小房间的宽敞感。

meaning: n. 情感；情绪

translation: 我先挑出了所有通常留到最后的人。

meaning: n. 经济；节约；理财

translation: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

translation: 该试验能准确地预测一次更大爆炸的威力。

translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

meaning: n. 学科；纪律；训练；惩罚; v. 训练，训导；惩戒

translation: 要革命，就要守纪律、看得远、善表达。

meaning: n. 诗；诗意，诗情；诗歌艺术

translation: 我本人喜欢电影、诗歌、外出吃饭和远途散步。

meaning: adj. 意识到的；故意的；神志清醒的

meaning: n. 结果，结局；成果

translation: 他为人刻薄、难相处是出了名的。

translation: 这一新技术已经被用来鉴别胎儿的性别。

meaning: v. 表达；快递; adj. 明确的；迅速的；专门的; n. 快车，快递，专使；捷运公司

translation: 他在美国运通公司办公大楼外经营一家报摊。

meaning: n. 政策，方针；保险单

meaning: v. 侦察；发现；暗中监视; n. 间谍；密探

translation: 这个小望远镜含有一个透镜.

meaning: n. 教堂；礼拜；教派; adj. 教会的；礼拜的; v. 领…到教堂接受宗教仪式

translation: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

meaning: adv. 错误地；邪恶地，不正当地; n. 坏事；不公正; adj. 错误的；失常的；不适当的; v. 委屈；无理地对待；诽谤

translation: 作恶者经常心中害怕被发觉.

meaning: n. 测量；措施；程度；尺寸; v. 测量；估量；权衡

translation: 殖民地正要求获得更大程度上的自治。

meaning: v. 证明；检验；显示

meaning: n. 竞争；比赛，竞赛

translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: n. 多数；成年

translation: 无党派候选人在地方议会选举中赢得了多数席位。

meaning: n. 商店；储备，贮藏；仓库; v. 贮藏，储存

translation: 几个帮派昨晚聚众闹事，他们打碎商店临街的玻璃窗，并投掷石块和瓶子。

meaning: n. 故事；小说；新闻报道；来历；假话; vt. 用历史故事画装饰; vi. 说谎

translation: n. 爱情故事，恋爱小说

meaning: adj. 现在的；流通的，通用的；最近的；草写的; n. （水，气，电）流；趋势；涌流

meaning: n. 学者；奖学金获得者

meaning: adv. 越来越多地；渐增地

translation: 越来越多的公司客户寻求将设施的管理外包出去。

meaning: v. 期望；指望；认为；预料

translation: 别指望我会去那儿看你。

meaning: v. 获得；取得；学到；捕获

translation: 可能在后来的几年里我们真的让人感到有些古板。

meaning: v. 发生；出现；存在

translation: 如果突然停服这些药，则可能出现一些戒断症状。

meaning: v. 反映；反射，照出；表达；显示;反省

translation: 人生观的这种转变是否反映了日常生活中的真实遭遇？

meaning: n. 进步，发展；前进; v. 前进，进步；进行
example: His remedial teacher sees signs of progress in his reading and writing.
translation: 他的辅导教师发现了他在阅读和写作方面进步的迹象。

meaning: adj. 全球的；总体的；球形的

translation: 全球性生态保护工作很可能会和地方生态系统存在矛盾。

meaning: v. 记得；牢记；纪念；代…问好
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. 消费；消耗；肺痨
example: Most of the wine was unfit for human consumption.
translation: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。

meaning: n. 发展；前进；增长；预付款; v. 提出；预付；使……前进；将……提前; adj. 预先的；先行的

translation: 早早就提前下单是个好主意。

meaning: v. 提倡，主张，拥护; n. 提倡者；支持者；律师
example: He is a keen advocate of park-and-ride schemes.
translation: 他是“停车再换乘”计划的热情拥护者。

meaning: n. 种类；方式；品质; v. 分类；协调；交往
v. 醒来；唤醒；警觉; n. 尾迹；守夜；守丧
example: And I want to thank Wakefield for being such an outstanding host.
translation: 我还要感谢韦克菲尔德高中出色的组织安排.

meaning: n. 怀疑；疑问；疑惑; v. 怀疑；不信；恐怕；拿不准

meaning: n. 数字；人物；图形；价格；（人的）体形；画像; v. 计算；出现；扮演角色

meaning: n. 协会，联盟，社团；联合；联想
example: The support of our members is of great importance to the Association.
translation: 会员的支持对于我们协会来说非常重要。

meaning: n. 关系；叙述；故事；亲属关系
example: Watercolour still seems somehow to be the poor relation of oil painting.
translation: 水彩画似乎仍比油画略逊一筹。

meaning: v. 停止；堵塞；断绝; n. 停止；车站；障碍；逗留
example: If a water - pipe bursts turn off the stopcock immediately.
translation: 水管破裂时要立即关紧旋塞.

meaning: n. 方面；方向；形势；外貌
example: Antonio has a contagious enthusiasm for the beautiful aspect of food.
translation: 安东尼奥对食品赏心悦目这一方面的热情非常有感染性。

meaning: v. 贡献，出力；投稿；捐献
example: Heat, cold, tactile and other sensations contribute to flavour.
translation: 热、冷、触觉和其他感觉构成了食物风味的一部分。

meaning: v. 保存；保护；维持；腌；禁猎; n. 保护区；禁猎地；加工成的食品
example: After the Norman Conquest the forest became a royal hunting preserve.
translation: 诺曼征服之后，这片森林成为了皇家狩猎区。

translation: “这么说，他的记忆一定是完全恢复了？”——“差不多。”

meaning: v. 检查；调查； 检测；考试

translation: 我首先进行概述，然后会分析几个实例。

meaning: n. 部；部门；系；科；局
example: She was the only woman in Shell's legal department.
translation: 她是壳牌公司法律事务部唯一的女性。

meaning: n. 经理；管理人员
example: I want the manager'sjob when he calls it a day.
translation: 等到经理不干了之后，我想接替他的位子。

meaning: adj. 值…的; n. 价值；财产
example: Mr. Buck is a good and worthful man.
translation: 巴克先生是个善良可敬的人.

meaning: v. 设计；计划；构思; n. 设计；图案
example: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
translation: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

meaning: v. 犯罪，做错事；把交托给；指派…作战；使…承担义务
example: He should not commit American troops without the full consent of Congress.
translation: 没有国会的完全同意，他不应该调遣美国军队。

meaning: n. 始祖，祖先；被继承人
example: Her Chinese friends referred to the Empress as their venerable ancestor.
translation: 她的中国朋友们说这位女皇是他们值得敬仰的祖先。

meaning: v. 抢劫；揩油; n. 劫持；威逼；敲诈
example: Every minute during the hijack seemed like a week.
translation: 被劫持过程中，每一分钟都过得如同一周那么漫长。

meaning: v. 使休息，使轻松；把…寄托于; n. 休息，静止；休息时间；剩余部分；支架
example: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

meaning: v. 进入；开始；参加; n. [计] 输入；回车
example: Two men answer-ing the description of the suspects tried to enter Switzerland.
translation: 与描述的疑犯样子相符的两名男子试图进入瑞士。

meaning: n. 创新，革新；新方法
example: The vegetarian burger was an innovation which was rapidly exported to Britain.
translation: 素食汉堡是一种迅速传到了英国的新开发食品。

meaning: v. 维持；支撑，承担；忍受；供养；证实
n. 影像；想象；肖像；偶像; v. 想象；反映；象征；作…的像
example: The European Parliament badly needs a president who can burnish its image.
translation: 欧洲议会急需一位能改善其声望的主席。

meaning: v. 零售；转述; n. 零售; adv. 以零售方式; adj. 零售的
example: There's nothing better than a bit of retail therapy.
translation: 没有什么比花钱买点东西能让自己高兴起来了。

meaning: n. 十几岁的青少年；十三岁到十九岁的少年
example: I have never lost the weight I put on in my teens.
translation: 我十几岁时增加的体重一直没有减下去。

meaning: n. 方式；习惯；种类；规矩；风俗
example: There was much curiosity about what manner of man he was.
translation: 他究竟是什么样的人，大家都十分好奇。

meaning: v. 威胁；恐吓；预示
example: He has accused her of threatening to gouge his eyes out.
translation: 他指控她曾威胁要挖出他的眼睛。

meaning: n. 月，一个月的时间
example: One month before the deadline we see the hollowness of these promises.
translation: 离最后期限只有一个月时，我们认识到了这些许诺都是空头支票。

meaning: n. 国际组织；国际体育比赛；外国居留者；国际股票; adj. 国际的；两国（或以上）国家的；超越国界的；国际关系的；世界的
example: International investors have become jittery about the country's economy.
translation: 国际投资者已对该国的经济状况感到紧张不安。

meaning: v. 重复；复制；背诵; n. 重复；副本
example: Nearly 60% of our bookings come from repeat business and personal recommendation.
translation: 我们近60%的订单来自于回头客和熟人介绍。

meaning: v. 疏忽，忽视；忽略; n. 疏忽，忽视；怠慢
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: n. 模式；方式；风格；时尚
example: The bicycle reigned supreme as Britain's most popular mode of transport.
translation: 当时自行车是英国最流行的交通工具。

meaning: n. 商店；店铺; v. 购物
example: coffee shop
translation: 咖啡店（等于coffee house）

meaning: n. 民族；人们；亲属（复数）; adj. 民间的
example: The folk-song world was another of his abiding interests.
translation: 民歌是他的另一个始终不渝的爱好。

meaning: v. 证明合法；整理版面
example: Domestic conditions did not justify a loosening of monetary policy.
translation: 国内的情况并不足以成为放松货币政策的正当理由。

meaning: v. 提到，谈到；提及，论及；说起; n. 提及，说起
example: His immediate superior has singled him out for a special mention.
translation: 他的顶头上司特别提到了他。

meaning: adj. 抵抗的，反抗的；顽固的; n. 抵抗者
example: The body may be less resistant if it is cold.
translation: 天冷时，身体的抵抗力会下降。

meaning: adj. 日常的；每日的; n. 日报；朝来夜去的女佣; adv. 日常地；每日；天天
example: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
translation: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

meaning: adj. [数] 随机的；任意的；胡乱的; n. 随意; adv. 胡乱地
example: Three people were killed by shots fired at random from a minibus.
translation: 3个人被从一辆面包车中发射的乱弹打死了。

meaning: n. 下降；衰退；斜面; v. 下降；衰落；谢绝
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: adj. 客观的；目标的；宾格的; n. 目的；目标；[光] 物镜；宾格
example: I believe that a journalist should be completely objective.
translation: 我认为新闻记者不应当有丝毫偏见。

meaning: v. 刺，戳；伸出；粘贴; n. 棍；手杖；呆头呆脑的人
example: They watched the stickball game the kids were having.
translation: 他们在看小孩子们玩儿童棒球.

meaning: n. 因素；要素；[物] 因数；代理人; v. 做代理商
example: Stress, both human and mechanical, may also be a contributing factor.
translation: 来自人的和机械方面的压力可能也是一个因素。

meaning: n. 铁轨；扶手；横杆；围栏; v. 抱怨；责骂
example: The government is spending billions of dollars on new urban rail projects.
translation: 政府正把数十亿元花在新城市铁路项目上。

meaning: v. 落下；变成；来临；减弱; n. 下降；秋天；瀑布; adj. 秋天的
example: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
translation: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

meaning: v. 参考；涉及；提到；查阅
example: He could refer the matter to the high court.
translation: 他可以将此事交由高等法院裁决。

meaning: adj. 短的；不足的；矮的，低的; n. 短；缺乏；短路；短裤; adv. 不足；突然；唐突地
n. 论证；论据；争吵；内容提要
example: argument list
translation: 变元表

meaning: v. 分派任务; n. 工作，作业；任务
example: She was a hard taskmaster .
translation: 她是个严厉的工头。

meaning: v. 管理；经营；控制；设法
example: We'll manage somehow, you and me. I know we will.
translation: 我和你，我们总能应付过去的。我知道我们会的。

meaning: adj. 低的，浅的；卑贱的；粗俗的；消沉的; adv. 低声地；谦卑地，低下地; n. 低；低价；低点；牛叫声; v. 牛叫
example: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
translation: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

meaning: n. 存在；出席；参加；风度；仪态
example: We had kept its presence hidden with a strategically placed chair.
translation: 我们用一张摆放得很巧妙的椅子将它隐藏了起来。

meaning: v. 使比赛；使相配；敌得过，比得上；相配；与…竞争; n. 比赛，竞赛；匹配；对手；火柴
example: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
translation: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

meaning: n. 平行线；对比; v. 使…与…平行; adj. 平行的；类似的，相同的
example: Parallel lines will never meet no matter how far extended.
translation: 无论延伸多长，平行线永不相交。

meaning: adj. 军事的；军人的；适于战争的; n. 军队；军人
example: The military regime in power was unpopular and repressive.
translation: 当权的军政府压制人民，不得人心。

meaning: n. 冲突，矛盾；斗争；争执; v. 冲突，抵触；争执；战斗
example: The ethnic populations are so intermingled that there's bound to be conflict.
translation: 各民族人口如此杂居，肯定会发生冲突。

meaning: adv. 可能地；也许；大概
example: Do you think that he could possibly be right?
translation: 你觉得他有可能是对的吗？

meaning: n. 有瘾的人；入迷的人; v. 使沉溺；使上瘾
example: She is a TV addict and watches as much as she can.
translation: 她是个电视迷，看起电视来没完没了。

meaning: n. 欢乐，快乐；乐趣；高兴; v. 欣喜，欢喜
example: It was a joy to see. It really made my day.
translation: 这太有趣了，真的把我高兴坏了。

meaning: v. 使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出; n. 谜；难题；迷惑
example: A rather neat option allows you to design your own fiendish puzzle.
translation: 只要干净利落地做一个选择，你就能自己设计出难以解开的谜题。

meaning: v. 画；拉；吸引; n. 平局；抽签
example: He was waving his arms to draw their attention.
translation: 他正挥手以引起他们的注意。

meaning: v. 开车；猛击；飞跑; n. 驱动器；驾车；[心理] 内驱力，推进力；快车道
example: I don't drive and the buses are quite hopeless.
translation: 我不开车，公共汽车条件又太糟糕。

meaning: v. 对比；形成对照; n. 对比；差别；对照物
example: The boy's room is a complete contrast to the guest room.
translation: 这个男孩的房间和客房截然不同。

meaning: n. 背景；隐蔽的位置; v. 作…的背景; adj. 背景的；发布背景材料的
example: Though his background was modest, it was in no sense deprived.
translation: 尽管他家境一般，但也并不贫穷。

meaning: n. 墙壁，围墙；似墙之物; v. 用墙围住，围以墙; adj. 墙壁的
example: Nelson Irrigation Corporation is headquartered in Walla Walla, Washington, USA.
translation: 描述:美国耐尔森灌溉公司是美国华盛顿在该领域名列前茅的企业.

meaning: n. 艺术家；美术家（尤指画家）；大师
n. 通讯，[通信] 通信；交流；信函
example: The vehicle that permitted both communication and acceptability was social revolution.
translation: 既能实现交流又能被广为接受的手段就是社会革命。

meaning: v. 使化合；使联合，使结合; n. 联合收割机；联合企业
example: I am partial to desserts that combine fresh fruit with fine pastry.
translation: 我偏爱加有新鲜水果的精致油酥甜点。

meaning: n. 字母表，字母系统；入门，初步
example: The alphabet might be more rational if all the vowels came first.
translation: 如果把所有的元音列在前面，字母表可能会更为合理一些。

meaning: v. 打架；与…打仗，与…斗争；反对…提案; n. 打架；战斗，斗志
example: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

meaning: n. 危机；危险期；决定性时刻; adj. 危机的；用于处理危机的
example: The Kremlin is still insisting on a diplomatic solution to the crisis.
translation: 俄罗斯中央政府依然坚持通过外交方式解决危机。

meaning: v. 批准；赞成；为…提供证据
example: The council is considering whether to approve of the use of firearms.
translation: 政务委员会正在考虑是否要批准动用武器。

meaning: n. 协议；同意，一致
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: n. 惊奇，诧异；突然袭击; v. 使惊奇；奇袭; adj. 令人惊讶的
example: He was surprised they had married — they had seemed so different.
translation: 他俩居然结婚了——这让他非常惊讶，因为他们实在是太不一样了。

meaning: v. 想像；猜想；臆断
example: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
translation: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

meaning: adj. 可靠的；可信赖的; n. 可靠的人
example: Broadcast news was accurate and reliable but deadly dull.
translation: 新闻广播准确可靠但却非常枯燥。

meaning: v. 收集；募捐; adv. 由收件人付款地; adj. 由收件人付款的; n. (Collect)人名；(英)科莱克特
example: Methane gas does collect in the mines around here.
translation: 周围的矿井里的确有沼气聚积。

meaning: v. 忘记；忽略; n. (Forget)人名；(法)福尔热
example: If you ever cross him, forget it, you're finished.
translation: 如果你曾经跟他作过对，就别想了，你没戏了。

meaning: adj. 最高的；至高的；最重要的; n. 至高；霸权
example: She gets on with her job and does it supremely well.
translation: 她继续她的工作，并且做得非常出色。

meaning: n. 张力；拉紧；负担；扭伤；血缘; v. 拉紧；尽力
example: The middle button of his uniform jacket was strained over his belly.
translation: 制服上装中间的纽扣在他的肚子上绷得紧紧的。

meaning: adj. 准备好；现成的；迅速的；情愿的；快要…的; n. 现款；预备好的状态; adv. 迅速地；预先; v. 使准备好
example: Fraud squad officers had bugged the phone and were ready to pounce.
translation: 反诈骗小组的警员们已在电话上安装了窃听器，并随时准备突击。

meaning: adj. 保守的; n. 保守派，守旧者
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: v. 消耗，消费；使…著迷；挥霍
example: Classically, overweight people underestimate the volume of food that they consume.
translation: 一般来说，超重的人往往低估自己摄入食物的量。

meaning: v. 否定，否认；拒绝给予；拒绝…的要求
example: They appeared at court yesterday to deny charges of murder.
translation: 他们昨天出庭，否认谋杀的指控。

meaning: v. 追溯；沿路走; n. 痕迹，踪迹；微量；[仪] 迹线；缰绳
example: Ensure the production record and form is integrity , complete and traceability.
translation: 确保生产过程各种记录报表的完整性、符合性,保持产品的可追溯性.

meaning: v. 吸引，占用；使参加；雇佣；使订婚；预定
example: You can engage in croquet on the south lawn.
translation: 你可以参加南边草坪上的槌球游戏。

meaning: v. 消失；失踪；不复存在
example: She stood watching the car's tail-lights disappear down the drive.
translation: 她站在那儿，望着小汽车的尾灯消失在车道尽头。

meaning: n. 损害；损毁；赔偿金; v. 损害；损毁
example: It's a fair guess to say that the damage will be extensive.
translation: 说损失会很严重想必猜得不错。

meaning: n. 痛苦，悲惨；不幸；苦恼；穷困
n. 节约；挽救；存款; adj. 节约的；挽救的；补偿的；保留的; prep. 考虑到；除之外
example: The company intends to squeeze further savings from its suppliers.
translation: 公司试图从供货商那里再省下一笔费用。

meaning: v. 使心烦；颠覆；扰乱; adj. 心烦的；混乱的；弄翻的; n. 混乱；翻倒；颠覆
example: He had blundered into the table, upsetting the flowers.
translation: 他不小心撞到了桌子，把花打翻了。

meaning: n. 首领；酋长；主要部分; adj. 首席的；主要的；主任的; adv. 主要地；首要地
example: The programme of sell-offs has been implemented by the new chief executive.
translation: 新任总裁已经执行了抛售方案。

meaning: adj. 被俘虏的；被迷住的; n. 俘虏；迷恋者
example: He described the difficulties of surviving for four months as a captive.
translation: 他描述了被俘4个月里挣扎求生的艰难岁月。

meaning: n. 意见；主张
example: And what of the effect on U.S domestic opinion?
translation: 对美国国内的舆论有什么影响？

meaning: n. 谅解，理解；理解力；协议; adj. 了解的；聪明的；有理解力的; v. 理解；明白（understand的ing形式）
example: The Arkansan nodded understandingly and said, " Yep. I had a truck like that once.
translation: ”那阿肯色人点了点头,满理解的样子,说, “ 是啊, 我有过一辆卡车也是那么大. ”

meaning: n. 购买；紧握；起重装置; v. 购买；赢得
example: Purchase tax was not payable on goods for export.
translation: 出口商品不需要交购买税。

meaning: adj. 能干的，能胜任的；有才华的
example: I believe I am capable of calculating the political consequences accurately.
translation: 我觉得我能准确预料此事的政治后果。

meaning: n. 间隙；缺口；差距；分歧; v. 裂开
example: Like a good businessman, Stewart identified a gap in the market.
translation: 像精明的商人一样，斯图尔特发现了市场上的一个空白。

meaning: n. 残余；遗骸
example: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
translation: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

meaning: n. 职员；参谋；棒；支撑; adj. 职员的；行政工作的; v. 供给人员；给…配备职员
example: technical staff
translation: 技术人员

meaning: n. 气氛；大气；空气
example: He sets the atmosphere and shapes the scenes pleasingly.
translation: 他把气氛和场面调动得轻松愉快。

meaning: v. 判断；审判; n. 法官；裁判员
example: judge of
translation: 判断；评价

meaning: v. 描绘…的特性；具有…的特征
example: the rolling hills that characterize this part of England
translation: 成为英格兰这一地区特征的绵延起伏的丘陵地

meaning: n. 葡萄；葡萄酒；葡萄树；葡萄色
example: He put a grape into his mouth and swallowed it whole.
translation: 他把一粒葡萄放入嘴里,整个吞了下去.

meaning: v. 使混乱；使困惑
example: I think it's a serious mistake to confuse books with life.
translation: 我认为把书本同生活混为一谈是大错特错。

meaning: n. 意义；含义；意图; adj. 意味深长的; v. 意味；意思是（mean的ing形式）
example: Politicians have debased the meaning of the word "freedom"
translation: 政客们贬低了“自由”一词的意义。

meaning: n. 建筑；建筑物; v. 建筑；建立；增加（build的ing形式）
example: He slewed the car against the side of the building.
translation: 他的车滑到了大楼的一侧，抵住了。

meaning: n. 招聘；新兵；新成员; v. 补充；聘用；征募；使…恢复健康
example: Firms are now keen to hold on to the people they recruit.
translation: 各公司现在都急切地想要留住招聘来的员工。

meaning: n. 失败；故障；失败者；破产
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: v. 责备；归咎于; n. 责备；责任；过失
example: The blame for the Charleston fiasco did not lie with him.
translation: 查尔斯顿惨败错不在他。

meaning: n. 定义；[物] 清晰度；解说
example: It all depends on your definition of punk, doesn'tit?
translation: “这全视乎你对朋克摇滚乐的定义，不是吗？”

meaning: adj. 统一的；一致的；相同的；均衡的；始终如一的; n. 制服; v. 使穿制服；使成一样
example: The uniformitarian principle, like any other scientific " law ", rests on the objective circumstance.
translation: 均变说原理, 象其它任何科学 “ 定律 ” 一样, 是以客观环境作为根据的.

meaning: n. 旅馆，饭店；客栈; vt. 使…在饭店下榻; vi. 进行旅馆式办公
example: The hotel is set plumb in the middle of the high street.
translation: 宾馆正好坐落在商街的中段。

meaning: adj. 智能的；聪明的；理解力强的
example: She was thin and spare, with a sharply intelligent face.
translation: 她又高又瘦，一副精明过人的模样。

meaning: n. 偏见；偏爱；斜纹；乖离率; v. 使存偏见; adj. 偏斜的; adv. 偏斜地
example: Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system.
translation: 各级司法机构普遍存在对女性的偏见。

meaning: n. [计] 选项；选择权；买卖的特权
example: It is not an unattractive option to make programmes for other companies.
translation: 为其他公司制作节目也不失为一个好的选择。

meaning: n. 日期；约会；年代；枣椰子; v. 过时；注明日期；始于（某一历史时期）
example: The Labour government has to date resisted all supplications.
translation: 到目前为止工党政府回绝了所有的请愿求情。

meaning: n. 描述，描写；类型；说明书
example: We were in a disaster situation that defies description.
translation: 我们陷入了难以言表的糟糕处境。

meaning: adj. 特殊的；独特的；奇怪的；罕见的; n. 特权；特有财产
example: Flying at 1,000 ft. he heard a peculiar noise from the rotors.
translation: 在1,000英尺的高度飞行时，他听到旋翼发出一种奇怪的噪音。

meaning: v. 维持；继续；维修；主张；供养
example: In New Zealand, the Maori people maintain a strong cultural tradition.
translation: 在新西兰，毛利人保持着深厚的文化传统。

meaning: v. 消除；排除
example: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it.
translation: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

meaning: n. 真理；事实；诚实；实质
example: Most religions teach you to be truthful and self-disciplined.
translation: 多数宗教教导人们要真诚和律己。

meaning: n. 历史学家
example: The historian Yakut described it picturesquely as a "mother of castles".
translation: 历史学家雅库特把它形象地描述为“城堡之母”。

meaning: n. 企图，试图；攻击; v. 企图，试图；尝试
example: An attempt by anti-abortionists to tighten the rules was defeated.
translation: 反堕胎者所作的加强法规的尝试失败了。

meaning: n. 出生；血统，出身；起源
example: I had obtained the authentic details about the birth of the organization.
translation: 我已经掌握了有关该组织诞生的可靠的详细资料。

meaning: n. 主题（等于theme）；题目；一般规则；总论
example: The magazine's aim is to discuss topical issues within a Christian framework.
translation: 该杂志的宗旨是在基督教框架下讨论时下的热门话题。

meaning: n. 块；件；篇；硬币; v. 修补；接合；凑合
example: How very thoughtless. I'll give him a piece of my mind.
translation: 真是太没头脑了，我要告诉他我很生气。

meaning: adj. 完整的；完全的；彻底的; v. 完成
example: It'll be two years before the process is complete.
translation: 这个过程需要两年才能完成。

meaning: v. 排除；排斥；拒绝接纳；逐出
example: The first task was to fence the wood to exclude sheep.
translation: 第一项任务就是把树林围起来不让羊进去。

meaning: n. [物] 能量；精力；活力；精神
v. 娱乐；招待；怀抱；容纳
n. 增加；利润；收获; v. 获得；增加；赚到
example: This is a cynical manipulation of the situation for short-term political gain.
translation: 这是为了获取短期政治利益而损人利己地对局势进行操纵。

meaning: adj. 吸引人的；有魅力的；引人注目的
example: The deal seems so attractive it would be ridiculous to say no.
translation: 这笔交易看上去太诱人了，要是拒绝它简直是笑话。

meaning: v. 关闭；停业；幽禁; n. 关闭; adj. 关闭的；围绕的
example: The shutdown is the latest in a series of painful budget measures.
translation: 此次关闭是一系列艰难预算措施中最新实施的一项。

meaning: n. 玫瑰；粉红色；蔷薇（花）；粉红色的葡萄酒; adj. 玫瑰花的；玫瑰色的；粉红色的；带有玫瑰香味的; vt. 使成玫瑰色，使（面颊）发红；使有玫瑰香味; vi. 起义( rise的过去式)；升起；（数量）增加；休会
example: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 school-children for an afternoon.
translation: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。

meaning: n. 黄瓜；胡瓜
example: Cucumber is good for soothing tired eyes.
translation: 黄瓜有助于舒缓眼部疲劳。

meaning: n. 程序，手续；步骤
example: British Parliamentary procedure is perplexing at the best of times.
translation: 即使在最好情况下，英国议会的程序也很费解。

meaning: v. 决定；解决；判决
example: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
translation: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

meaning: n. 编者，编辑；社论撰写人；编辑装置
example: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
translation: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

meaning: v. 幸存；生还；幸免于；比活得长
example: Rafferty was the sole survivor from the successful Ireland team of 1988.
translation: 拉弗蒂是1988年红极一时的爱尔兰队硕果仅存的球员。

meaning: v. 证明；展示；论证
example: The best and the brightest pupils competed to demonstrate their intellectual prowess.
translation: 最出色、最聪明的学生们竞相展示他们的才智。

meaning: adj. 学术的；理论的；学院的; n. 大学生，大学教师；学者
example: Henry generally stayed ahead of the others in the academic subjects.
translation: 亨利的文化课成绩通常都优于其他学生。

meaning: n. 经济学；国家的经济状况
example: Ms Senatorova showed an instinctive feel for market economics.
translation: 谢纳托罗娃女士对市场经济学有一种天生的敏感。

meaning: adj. 典型的；特有的；表示特性的; n. 特征；特性；特色
example: With characteristic impetuosity, he announced he was leaving school.
translation: 一贯性急冲动的他又宣布要退学了。

meaning: v. 说服；使确信，使信服
example: I'm not going to believe it myself, never mind convince anyone else.
translation: 我自己都不会相信，更别提说服别人了。

meaning: adj. 重要的；物质的，实质性的；肉体的; n. 材料，原料；物资；布料
example: The material consisted only of already published, unclassified information.
translation: 这份材料里只有一些已公开的、非保密性质的信息。

meaning: n. 树；木料；树状物; v. 把赶上树
example: fault tree
translation: 故障树；失效树

meaning: v. 反对；对抗，抗争
example: It is illogical to oppose the repatriation of economic migrants.
translation: 反对把经济移民遣送归国是不合逻辑的。

meaning: n. [劳经] 报酬；报答；酬谢; v. [劳经] 奖励；奖赏
example: Current employment laws will be changed to reward effort and punish laziness.
translation: 现行雇佣法要变，要奖勤罚懒。

meaning: adj. 理想的；完美的；想象的；不切实际的; n. 理想；典范
example: The reality of mothering is frequently very different from the romantic ideal.
translation: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

meaning: adj. 最初的；字首的; v. 用姓名的首字母签名; n. 词首大写字母
example: They learnt a lot from the initial market testing exercise.
translation: 他们从最初的市场测试中了解了许多信息。

meaning: v. 投合，迎合；满足需要；提供饮食及服务; n. (Cater)人名；(英)凯特
example: The chef is pleased to cater for vegetarian diets.
translation: 厨师非常乐意为客人做素食。

meaning: n. 职业，专业；声明，宣布，表白
example: The attitude of the medical profession is very much more liberal now.
translation: 现在，医务人员的态度开明多了。

meaning: v. 竞争；比赛；对抗
example: They are now trying to compete on an equal footing.
translation: 他们现在想要公平竞争。

meaning: adj. 先进的；高级的；晚期的；年老的; v. 前进；增加；上涨（advance的过去式和过去分词形式）
example: The way Swedes integrate immigrants is, she feels, 100% more advanced.
translation: 她觉得瑞典人帮助移民适应当地生活的方式百分百地更为先进。

meaning: n. 基础；底部；主要成分；基本原则或原理
example: Any action on the basis of such fragmentary evidence would be foolish.
translation: 基于如此不完整的证据采取的任何行动都是愚蠢的。

meaning: v. 误导；带错
example: Ministers must not knowingly mislead Parliament and the public.
translation: 大臣们不应该故意地误导议会与公众。

meaning: v. 面对；遭遇；比较
example: She had decided to confront Kathryn with what she had learnt.
translation: 她决定拿自己了解的事实与凯瑟琳当面对证。

meaning: adj. 全部的，整个的；全体的; n. (Entire)人名；(英)恩泰尔
example: If the Commission has its way, the entire deal will be scuppered.
translation: 如果委员会我行我素的话，整个交易将化为泡影。

meaning: adj. 相反的；对立的; adv. 相反地; n. 相反；反面
example: Several of those present, including Weinberger, had contrary information.
translation: 几个在场的人，包括温博格，所掌握的信息截然不同。

meaning: adj. 实际的；实用性的
example: After half an hour's commis-eration, we turned to more practical matters.
translation: 惺惺相惜了半个小时后，我们转而讨论一些更为实际的问题。

meaning: v. 变化；变异；违反; n. (Vary)人名；(英、法、罗、柬)瓦里
example: The name of the hotel vas " The Grand Eurasian Hotel. "
translation: 旅馆名叫 “ 欧亚大旅社 ”.

meaning: v. 继续；从事；追赶；纠缠
example: There is another avenue to pursue — it involves further negotiations.
translation: 还有一个办法可用，但需要进一步的磋商。

meaning: adj. 暂时的，临时的; n. 临时工，临时雇员
example: temporary storage
translation: 暂时存储器；暂时库容；中间存储器

meaning: adj. 戏剧的；急剧的；引人注目的；激动人心的
example: Recent, more dramatic use of CGI was seen in "Walking With Dinosaurs".
translation: 在纪录片《与恐龙同行》中可以看到最新的、更加生动的电脑特效技术。

meaning: adj. 易受攻击的，易受…的攻击；易受伤害的；有弱点的
v. 代表；表现；描绘；回忆；再赠送
example: The two politicians represent opposite poles of the political spectrum.
translation: 这两位从政者代表了政界的两个极端。

meaning: n. 发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能
example: The new invention ensures the beer keeps a full, frothy head.
translation: 这项新发明能保证啤酒始终保持丰富的泡沫。

meaning: n. 丰富，大量；充足; adj. 足够的，很多的; adv. 足够
example: There were plenty of servants to wait on her.
translation: 有很多仆人服侍她。

meaning: v. 收集；收割；使…聚集；使…皱起; n. 聚集；衣褶；收获量
example: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
translation: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

meaning: adj. 公民的；民间的；文职的；有礼貌的；根据民法的; n. (Civil)人名；(土)吉维尔；(法)西维尔
example: The strike has taken on overtones of a civil rights campaign.
translation: 罢工带上了民权运动的意味。

meaning: n. 罪犯; adj. 刑事的；犯罪的；罪恶的
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: v. 铭刻于，铭记；打烙印于；印…商标于; n. 商标，牌子；烙印
example: But that doesn't mean this brand of politics is dead or dying.
translation: 但那并不意味着这种政治主张已经或正在消亡。

meaning: v. 使兴旺；发隆隆声; n. 繁荣；吊杆；隆隆声
example: The boom of the 1980s led to a taste for petrol-guzzling cars.
translation: 20世纪80年代的经济繁荣使人们喜欢上高油耗的汽车。

meaning: adj. 系统的；体系的；有系统的；[图情] 分类的；一贯的，惯常的
example: The way he works isn't very systematical.
translation: 他的工作方法不是很有条理.

meaning: adj. 大量的；实质的；内容充实的; n. 本质；重要材料
example: substantial evidence
translation: 确实证据

meaning: n. 开始；机会；通路；空缺的职位; adj. 开始的; v. 开放（open的ing形式）；打开；公开
example: He flipped through the post without opening any of it.
translation: 他飞快地翻了一下邮件，但一封也没有打开。

meaning: adj. 有趣的；引起兴趣的，令人关注的
example: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
translation: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

meaning: adj. 组成的，构成的; n. 成分；组件；[电子] 元件
example: The menu is all-important. Every component of every meal should create contrasts.
translation: 饭菜的安排至关重要。每一顿饭的每一道菜都应该有所不同。

meaning: n. 垃圾；废物; v. 拒绝；不愿；抵制
example: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
translation: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

meaning: n. 药；医学；内科；巫术; v. 用药物治疗；给…用药
example: Traditionally young Asians in Britain have gravitated towards medicine, law and engineering.
translation: 英国的亚裔年轻人通常被吸引到医学、法律及工程专业。

meaning: n. 快乐；希望；娱乐；令人高兴的事; vt. 使高兴；使满意; vi. 高兴；寻欢作乐
example: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

meaning: n. 队；组; v. 使合作
example: The tallest teammate held a paper roll made by his teammates.
translation: 参加者每人卷一张报纸,连接在一起,再由队中最高的组员拿著.

meaning: n. 商品；动产；合意的人；真本领
example: Purchase tax was not payable on goods for export.
translation: 出口商品不需要交购买税。

meaning: v. 修改，修饰；更改
example: Established practices are difficult to modify.
translation: 既定的惯例是很难更改的.

meaning: n. 运动；游戏；娱乐；运动会；玩笑; v. 游戏; adj. 运动的
example: in sport
translation: 非认真地；闹着玩

meaning: n. 投票，选举；选票；得票数; v. 提议，使投票；投票决定；公认
example: vote for
translation: 投票赞成

meaning: n. 剂量；一剂，一服; v. 服药
example: The West is getting a heavy dose of snow and rain today.
translation: 西部今天将迎来一场大的雨夹雪。

meaning: n. 衣物；磨损；耐久性; v. 穿着；用旧；耗损；面露
example: Describes briefly the two main aspects of clothing wearability researches, i.
translation: 简要论述服装功能研究的两个方面:服装心理学与服装生理学.

meaning: n. 主题；主旋律；题目; adj. 以奇想主题布置的
example: They were heavily dependent on the scales of Themis, the blindfolded goddess of justice.
translation: 衡量标准主要是忒弥斯 —— 一位双眼被布蒙着的公正女神.

meaning: n. 北，北方; adj. 北方的；朝北的; adv. 在北方，向北方
example: Two trains collided head-on in north-eastern Germany early this morning.
translation: 今天早上德国东北部两列火车迎面相撞。

meaning: n. 领导能力；领导阶层
example: Yet it is feared the Republican leadership could split over the agreement.
translation: 但有人担心，共和党的领导层可能会在该协议上出现意见分歧。

meaning: n. 礼物；天赋；赠品; v. 赋予；向…赠送
example: Her grandmother had the gift of making people happy.
translation: 她奶奶有逗人开心的本事。

meaning: adj. 自由主义的；慷慨的；不拘泥的；宽大的; n. 自由主义者
example: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
translation: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

meaning: n. 保存，保持；保护
example: In time these new excavations will require conservation.
translation: 这些刚发掘出来的物品需要及时保护。

meaning: n. 圆；循环；一回合；圆形物; adj. 圆的；完全的；大概的；肥胖的; adv. 在周围；迂回地；朝反方向；挨个; v. 完成；围捕；绕行；弄圆; prep. 附近；绕过；大约；在…周围
example: It was just then that I chanced to look round.
translation: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。

meaning: v. 坚持，强调
example: They insist on tastier chocolate than the anaemic British stuff.
translation: 他们坚持要比淡而无味的英国货味道更好的巧克力。

meaning: n. 目标；物体；客体；宾语; v. 提出…作为反对的理由
example: He thought of the baby almost as an inanimate object.
translation: 他认为婴儿几乎就是毫无生命的物体。

meaning: n. 表征；代币；记号; adj. 象征的；表意的；作为对某事的保证的; vt. 象征；代表
example: by the same token
translation: 同样地；出于同样原因

meaning: adj. 积极的；活跃的；主动的；有效的；现役的; n. 主动语态；积极分子
example: In April 1944 he was killed on active service.
translation: 1944年4月他在战时服役中阵亡。

meaning: adj. 逐渐的；平缓的; n. 弥撒升阶圣歌集
example: The roads are built to accommodate gradual temperature changes.
translation: 修建这些道路时考虑到了温度的逐渐变化。

meaning: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；变化多的
example: India has always been one of the most religiously diverse countries.
translation: 印度一直都是宗教信仰最多元的国家之一。

meaning: n. 俱乐部，社团；夜总会；棍棒；（扑克牌中的）梅花; v. 用棍棒打；募集; adj. 俱乐部的
example: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd.
translation: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。

meaning: n. 语法；语法书
example: He was known for his poor grammar and punctuation.
translation: 他不通语法和乱用标点是出了名的。

meaning: adj. 狭窄的，有限的；勉强的；精密的；度量小的; n. 海峡；狭窄部分，隘路; v. 使变狭窄
example: Sailing boats lay at anchor in the narrow waterway.
translation: 帆船停泊在狭窄的水道上。

meaning: n. 任命；约定；任命的职位
example: make an appointment
translation: 约会，预约

meaning: adj. 男性的；雄性的；有力的; n. 男人；雄性动物
example: The army is still one of the last male bastions.
translation: 军队仍然是男人占据的最后堡垒之一。

meaning: n. 交易；事务；办理；会报，学报
example: The transactor taking out an option pays a price for it.
translation: 取得此种证券买卖特权的交易者应为此付出代价.

meaning: adj. 创造性的
example: Some thought must be given to the method of validation.
translation: 一些想法必须通过验证法加以证实。

meaning: n. 代表；利益
example: "What do you mean?" I asked, offended on Liddie's behalf.
translation: “你什么意思啊？”我问，替利迪感到愤愤不平。

meaning: n. 才能；天才；天资
example: A few are dim-witted drones, but most are talented, frustrated, wasted people.
translation: 有几个是愚笨的寄生虫，但是大多数是有才能却不得志而自暴自弃的人。

meaning: adj. 微妙的；精细的；敏感的；狡猾的；稀薄的
example: In time you'll appreciate the beauty and subtlety of this language.
translation: 总有一天你会体会到这门语言的优美和微妙之处。

meaning: adj. 优先的；在先的，在前的; adv. 在前，居先; n. (Prior)人名；(法、西、葡、捷)普里奥尔；(英)普赖尔；(意)普廖尔
example: Prior to his Japan trip, he went to New York.
translation: 在去日本之前，他去了纽约。

meaning: n. 责任；[税收] 关税；职务
example: They clocked off duty and left at ten to three.
translation: 他们打卡下班，于2点50分离开。

meaning: n. 应用；申请；应用程序；敷用
example: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

meaning: n. 印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记; v. 印刷；打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样
example: Many of their books have been in print for nearly 40 years.
translation: 他们的很多书都印行将近40年了。

meaning: adj. 向前的；早的；迅速的; adv. 向前地；向将来; v. 促进；转寄；运送; n. 前锋
example: The car passed over the body twice, once backward and then forward.
translation: 那辆车把那人来回轧了两次，先是倒着轧的，再是往前开着轧的。

meaning: n. 通知，布告；注意；公告; v. 通知；注意到；留心
example: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
translation: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

meaning: n. 乐趣；玩笑；有趣的人或事; adj. 供娱乐用的; vi. 开玩笑
example: Surfing the Internet is fun, but it's also a time waster.
translation: 上网很有意思，但也很浪费时间。

meaning: n. 财富；命运；运气; vt. 给予财富; vi. 偶然发生
example: She built up her fortune by cannily playing the stock market.
translation: 她炒股有方，发了大财。

meaning: adj. 富有的；肥沃的；昂贵的; n. (Rich)人名；(丹)里克；(捷)里赫；(英、西)里奇；(葡、法)里什
example: He hoped to strike it rich by investing in ginseng.
translation: 他希望通过投资人参发大财。

meaning: n. 安全；保险；安全设备；保险装置；安打
example: They offer tips on topics such as home safety.
translation: 他们就家居安全等问题提供建议。

meaning: n. 概念；见解；打算
example: The notion that art should be controlled by intellectuals sickened him.
translation: 他讨厌艺术应由知识分子所掌控的观点。

meaning: n. 前途；预期；景色; v. 勘探，找矿
example: Unfortunately, there is little prospect of seeing these big questions answered.
translation: 不幸的是，几乎不可能看到这些重大问题得到回复。

meaning: adj. 青少年的；幼稚的; n. 青少年；少年读物
example: an increase in juvenile delinquency
translation: 青少年犯罪的增加

meaning: v. 履行；实现；满足；使结束（等于fulfil）
example: My father was very keen that I should fulfill my potential.
translation: 我父亲热切地希望我能够发挥出自身的潜力。

meaning: v. 探索；探测；探险
example: I would creep in and with stealthy footsteps explore the second-floor.
translation: 我会偷偷溜进去，轻手轻脚地查看一下二楼。

meaning: v. 使能够，使成为可能；授予权利或方法
example: This committee will enable decisions to be made democratically.
translation: 该委员会将实现民主决议过程。

meaning: n. 解决方案；溶液；溶解；解答
example: aqueous solution
translation: 水溶液

meaning: n. 事情；事务；私事；（尤指关系不长久的）风流韵事
example: He will now face a disciplinary hearing for having an affair.
translation: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。

meaning: adj. 慢的；减速的；迟钝的; v. 变慢；变萧条; adv. 慢慢地；迟缓地; n. (Slow)人名；(英)斯洛
example: There has been a sharp slowdown in economic growth.
translation: 经济增长的速度明显放慢。

meaning: adj. 意识到的；知道的；有…方面知识的；懂世故的; n. (Aware)人名；(阿拉伯、索)阿瓦雷
example: He became more aware of the things that started that tension off.
translation: 他越来越清楚地认识到引起紧张局势的原因。

meaning: n. 票；入场券，标签；（美）候选人名单；证明书；交通罚款单; v. 加标签于；指派；对…开出交通违规罚单
example: air ticket
translation: 机票

meaning: adj. 免疫的；免于……的，免除的; n. 免疫者；免除者
example: This discovery led on to studies of the immune system.
translation: 此发现使人们开始对免疫系统进行研究。

meaning: n. 短语, 习语, 措辞, 乐句; v. 措词, 将(乐曲)分成乐句
example: A phrase from the conference floor set my mind wandering.
translation: 会上发言者的一句话让我思绪飘远。

meaning: adj. 领导的；主要的; n. 领导；铅板；行距; v. 领导（lead的ing形式）
example: The Democratic candidate is still leading in the polls.
translation: 民主党候选人的得票数依然领先。

meaning: v. 扩张；使膨胀；详述
example: The ultimate aim is to expand the network further.
translation: 最终目的是为了进一步拓展该网络。

meaning: v. 给小费；翻倒；倾覆; n. 小费；尖端；小建议，小窍门；轻拍
example: crack tip
translation: 裂纹尖端，裂纹端

meaning: v. 建议；打算，计划；求婚
example: And where do you propose building such a huge thing?
translation: 那么你打算在哪里建这么一个庞然大物呢？

meaning: n. 预算，预算费; v. 安排，预定；把…编入预算; adj. 廉价的
example: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

meaning: v. 死亡；凋零；熄灭; n. 冲模，钢模；骰子
example: He won his first Derby on the aptly named "Never Say Die".
translation: 他驾驭着这匹名副其实的“永不言败”夺得了他的第一个德比马赛冠军。

meaning: v. 改变，使…变形；转换
example: fourier transform
translation: 傅里叶变换

meaning: v. 参加；结合；连接; n. 结合；连接；接合点
example: I know you will join me in wishing them Godspeed.
translation: 我知道你会同我一起祝愿他们诸事顺遂的。

meaning: n. 优先；优先权；[数] 优先次序；优先考虑的事
example: Spain's top priority is the signing of an EMU treaty.
translation: 西班牙的当务之急是签署《欧洲经济和货币联盟条约》。

meaning: v. 控制；支配；占优势；在…中占主要地位
example: Fathers have the power to dominate children and young people.
translation: 父辈们有能力支配孩子们和年轻人的生活。

meaning: v. 减弱，减少；放下，降下；贬低; adj. 下游的；下级的；下等的; n. (Lower)人名；(英、意)洛厄
example: I felt a sharp pain in my lower back.
translation: 我感觉到后腰一阵剧痛。

meaning: n. 种类，分类；[数] 范畴
example: The judges could not decide which category it belonged in.
translation: 评委们无法判定它属于哪一类。

meaning: v. 分支；出现分歧; n. 树枝，分枝；分部；支流
example: When in danger, the anteater lashes its tail round a branch.
translation: 遇有危险，食蚁兽会迅速用尾巴卷住树枝。

meaning: adj. 重大的；有效的；有意义的；值得注意的；意味深长的; n. 象征；有意义的事物
example: She looked up at me significantly, raising an eyebrow.
translation: 她抬起头，眉毛扬起，意味深长地看着我。

meaning: v. 意味；暗示；隐含
example: Cheerfulness doesn't always imply happiness.
translation: 快活并不总是意味着幸福.

meaning: n. 努力；尽力（等于endeavour）; v. 努力；尽力（等于endeavour）
example: Thereupon, we knew, our endeavor was valuable.
translation: 于是, 我们知道, 我们的努力是有价值的!

meaning: n. 性；性别；性行为；色情; v. 引起…的性欲；区别…的性别
example: The sexagenarian population is growing.
translation: 六十岁以上的老年人人数正在增加.

meaning: n. 男演员；行动者；作用物
example: She is said to be stepping out with actor Matt Dillon.
translation: 据说她和演员马特·狄龙一起公开露面了。

meaning: n. 法律顾问；忠告；商议；讨论；决策; v. 建议；劝告
example: The defence counsel warned that the judge should stop the trial.
translation: 被告辩护律师强烈建议法官应该休庭。

meaning: adj. 符合习俗的，传统的；常见的；惯例的
example: He hates the wheeling and dealing associated with conventional political life.
translation: 他对传统政治生活中的权术钻营深恶痛绝。

meaning: v. 发展，进化；进化；使逐步形成；推断出
example: We can evolve the truth from a mass of confused evidence.
translation: 我们可以从庞杂的证据中推断事实真相.

meaning: adj. 最差的，最坏的；最不利的；效能最低的; n. 最坏；最坏的时候; adv. 最坏地；最不利地
example: a grey worsted suit
translation: 一套灰色的精纺毛料西服

meaning: v. 估计，估价; n. 估计，估价；判断，看法
example: Its own estimate of three hundred tallies with that of another survey.
translation: 其估计数目300与另一项调查的结果相吻合。

meaning: v. 评定；估价；对…征税
example: We know some sex offenders dupe the psychologists who assess them.
translation: 我们知道有些性犯罪者会愚弄给他们做测评的心理学家。

meaning: n. 实例；情况；建议; v. 举为例
example: The rally was organised at the instance of two senior cabinet ministers.
translation: 集会是应两位资深内阁大臣的要求组织的。

meaning: v. 批评；评论；非难
example: They would criticize me, or worse yet, pay me no attention.
translation: 他们会指责我，或者更糟糕的是，干脆对我毫不理睬。

meaning: v. 致力；献身；题献
example: He felt that medicine was the most important cause to which he could dedicate himself.
translation: 他觉得医学是他能够为之献身的最重大的事业.

meaning: v. 妥协；危害; n. 妥协，和解；折衷
example: Mr Clarke has shown himself to be resolutely opposed to compromise.
translation: 克拉克先生已表示自己坚决反对妥协。

meaning: adj. 第一的；最初的; n. 总理，首相
example: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.
translation: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。

meaning: vt. 给加薪；给薪水; n. 薪水
example: You get a big salary incentive and free board and lodging too.
translation: 你们能获得大笔激励性薪水，还可享受免费膳宿。

meaning: n. 行星
example: The blue whale is the largest living thing on the planet.
translation: 蓝鲸是地球上体型最大的生物。

meaning: n. 大厅；休息室；会客室；游说议员的团体; v. 对……进行游说
example: The union has attacked the plan and threatened to lobby against it.
translation: 工会不但攻击该计划，而且还扬言要游说议员反对它。

meaning: v. 微笑; n. 微笑；笑容；喜色
example: smile to oneself
translation: 暗笑

meaning: adv. 此外；而且
example: Furthermore, as Gervaise was quick to point out, Mr Scully was not a detective.
translation: 而且，正如热尔韦斯毫不犹豫地指出来的那样，斯库利先生并不是一名侦探。

meaning: n. 打赌，赌注；被打赌的事物; v. 打赌；敢断定，确信
example: Jockeys are forbidden to bet on the outcome of races.
translation: 职业赛马骑师禁止对赛马结果下注。

meaning: adj. 竞争的；比赛的；求胜心切的
example: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive.
translation: 他是一位锐意进取、竞争意识很强的主管，颇受尊敬。

meaning: n. 灌木；矮树丛; v. 以灌木装饰；使…精疲力竭; adj. 如灌木般长得低矮的；粗野的
example: They walked through the dense Mozambican bush for thirty six hours.
translation: 他们花了36个小时穿过茂密的莫桑比克丛林。

meaning: n. 连接；关系；人脉；连接件
example: 13 men have been questioned in connection with the murder.
translation: 有13名男子因谋杀案受到盘问。

meaning: n. 照片，图画；影片；景色；化身; v. 画；想像；描写
example: Police have released an E-fit picture of the suspected gunman.
translation: 警方已公布持枪嫌犯的电子画像。

meaning: adj. 认知的，认识的
example: a child's cognitive development
translation: 儿童的认知开发

meaning: v. 目的在于；引导；把…对准; n. 目的；目标；对准
example: Republican strategists are taking particular aim at Democratic senators.
translation: 共和党的战略家正尖锐地攻击民主党的参议员。

meaning: v. 给予，提供；买得起; n. (Afford)人名；(英)阿福德
example: They could not afford to spoil those maps by careless colouring.
translation: 若是上色的时候不小心弄坏了那些地图，他们可承担不起。

meaning: v. 引用；传讯；想起；表彰
example: His position does not empower him to cite our views without consultation.
translation: 他的地位并没有给予他不经许可就引用我们观点的权力。

meaning: adj. 典型的；特有的；象征性的
example: The models and parameters possess typicality . The methods are reasonable and efficient.
translation: 模型和参数具有典型性, 研究方法合理、有效.

meaning: n. 运动；活动；运转；乐章
example: Monks shave their heads, as do devotees of the Hare Krishna movement.
translation: 和尚要剃度，克利须那派教徒也一样。

meaning: n. 贸易；商业；商务
example: There were notable jousts with the Secretary of Commerce.
translation: 和商业部长之间明显存在竞争。

meaning: adj. 普遍的；通用的；宇宙的；全世界的；全体的; n. 一般概念；普通性
example: universal joint
translation: 万向节；万向接头

meaning: n. 鼻子；嗅觉；突出的部分；探问; v. 嗅；用鼻子触
example: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
translation: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

meaning: v. 恢复；修复；归还
n. 四分之一；地区；季度；一刻钟；两角五分；节; v. 住宿；驻扎; num. 四分之一
example: This little ball of gold weighs a quarter of an ounce.
translation: 这个小金球重0.25盎司。

meaning: n. 意义；重要性；意思
example: economic significance
translation: 经济重要性

meaning: n. 精英；精华；中坚分子
example: They were, by and large, a very wealthy, privileged elite.
translation: 他们基本上是一些非常有钱有势的精英。

meaning: n. 允许，许可
example: Police said permission for the march had not been granted.
translation: 警方说游行并未得到批准。

meaning: n. 管理；规则；校准; adj. 规定的；平常的
example: The results prove that regulation of the salmon farming industry is inadequate.
translation: 结果证明对鲑鱼饲养行业的管理不够完善。

meaning: v. 报价；引述；举证; n. 引用
example: What was that marvellous quote that she came out with?
translation: 她引用的那句妙语是什么来着？

meaning: n. 垄断；垄断者；专卖权
example: "Monopoly" is one of the best-selling games of all time.
translation: “大富翁”是有史以来最畅销的游戏之一。

meaning: n. 焦虑；渴望；挂念；令人焦虑的事
example: He has exhibited symptoms of anxiety and overwhelming worry.
translation: 他表现出焦躁不安和过度忧虑的症状。

meaning: v. 节省；保存；储蓄；解救; prep. 除之外; n. 救援
example: save energy
translation: 节约能源

meaning: n. 部长；大臣；牧师; v. 执行牧师职务；辅助或伺候某人
example: The Prime Minister has been briefed by her parliamentary aides.
translation: 首相已听取了她议会助手的简要汇报。

meaning: n. 性格，品质；特性；角色；[计] 字符; v. 印，刻；使具有特征
example: I didn't know Ron had that much strength of character.
translation: 我当时不知道罗恩有那么坚强的个性。

meaning: adv. 高度地；非常；非常赞许地
example: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
translation: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

meaning: n. 西；西方；西部; adj. 西方的；朝西的; adv. 在西方；向西方；自西方
example: in the west
translation: 在西方，在西方（国家）

meaning: n. 大学生；大学肄业生; adj. 大学生的
example: undergraduate course
translation: 本科课程

meaning: v. 引起；唤醒；鼓励
example: There is nothing like a long walk to arouse the appetite.
translation: 没有什么比走很长的路更能激起食欲的了。

meaning: v. 运用，发挥；施以影响
example: We all know that when we exert ourselves our heart rate increases.
translation: 我们都知道太卖命了会导致心跳加速。

meaning: n. 座位；所在地；职位; v. 使…坐下；可容纳…的；使就职
example: Those electing to smoke will be seated at the rear.
translation: 那些想吸烟的人将坐在后排。

meaning: v. 采取；接受；收养；正式通过
example: Britain is free to adopt policies to bolster its economy.
translation: 英国可以自由制定政策以振兴经济。

meaning: n. 南方，南边；南部; adv. 在南方，向南方; adj. 南的，南方的
example: south korea
translation: 南韩

meaning: v. 挑选；选拔; adj. 精选的；挑选出来的；极好的; n. 被挑选者；精萃
example: She selected a low gear and started down the track carefully.
translation: 她选了低速挡小心翼翼地沿小径下行。

meaning: n. 说明，解释；辩解
example: Their water was turned off weeks ago without explanation.
translation: 他们的水在几周以前就毫无理由地被切断了。

meaning: n. 论文；论点
example: graduation thesis
translation: 毕业论文；毕业设计
