example: Two historical questions — you can answer them how you like.
translation: 两个历史问题——你可以随便回答。

meaning: adj. 随便的；非正式的；临时的；偶然的; n. 便装；临时工人；待命士兵
example: I was wrong about it being a casual meeting.
translation: 我误以为这是个非正式会议。

meaning: adj. 侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的
example: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive.
translation: 他是一位锐意进取、竞争意识很强的主管，颇受尊敬。

meaning: v. 修正；复习；校订; n. 修订；校订
example: The staff should work together to revise the school curriculum.
translation: 全体教职工应当齐心协力修订学校课程。

meaning: n. 管理；行政；实施；行政机构
example: The administration has now endorsed the bill and can't turn back.
translation: 政府部门如今已经签署了那项法案，没有挽回的余地。

meaning: adj. 基本的，根本的; n. 基本原理；基本原则
example: Amnesty says there are fundamental flaws in their military justice system.
translation: 国际特赦组织称他们的军事司法体系存在着根本性的缺陷。

meaning: adj. 相当大的；重要的，值得考虑的
example: He brought to the job not just considerable experience but passionate enthusiasm.
translation: 他不仅给这一工作带来了不少经验，而且倾注了极大的热情。

meaning: n. 风格；时尚；类型；字体; v. 设计；称呼；使合潮流
example: It provides the secrets of writing English news and a stylebook.
translation: 它提供了写好英文新闻的要诀,及写作手册.

meaning: n. 操作；经营；[外科] 手术；[数][计] 运算
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: adj. 灵活的；柔韧的；易弯曲的
example: Times become more flexible off-season, especially in the smaller provincial museums.
translation: 尤其是在规模较小的地方博物馆，开放时间在旅游淡季更加灵活。

meaning: n. 阶段；舞台；戏剧；驿站; v. 举行；上演；筹划
example: She's getting off the stagecoach.
translation: 她正在下马车.

meaning: n. 诱惑；饵；诱惑物; v. 诱惑；引诱
example: The lure of rural life is proving as strong as ever.
translation: 事实证明，乡村生活的魅力丝毫未减。

meaning: v. 交往；结交; n. 同事，伙伴；关联的事物; adj. 副的；联合的
example: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
translation: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

meaning: n. 候选人，候补者；应试者
example: The Democratic candidate is still leading in the polls.
translation: 民主党候选人的得票数依然领先。

meaning: adj. 被动的，消极的；被动语态的; n. 被动语态
example: Even passive acceptance of the regime was a kind of collaboration.
translation: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。

meaning: n. 冲动；[电子] 脉冲；刺激；神经冲动；推动力; vt. 推动
example: All day she had fought off the impulse to telephone Harry.
translation: 她一整天都在克制自己想给哈里打电话的冲动。

meaning: n. 文件；档案；文件夹；锉刀; v. 提出；锉；琢磨；把…归档
example: Substantial numbers of rank and file members ignored their union's advice.
translation: 有相当一部分普通员工不理睬工会的建议。

meaning: n. 轻视，蔑视；耻辱
example: Mr. Kelly was sentenced to six months in prison for contempt.
translation: 凯利先生因藐视法庭被判6个月监禁。

meaning: n. 追求；寻找; v. 追求；寻找
example: I have not faltered in my quest for a new future.
translation: 我对新的未来的追求从未动摇过。

meaning: n. [计] 主机；主人；主持人；许多; v. 主持；当主人招待
example: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.
translation: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。

meaning: v. 察觉，感觉；理解；认知
example: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader.
translation: 投票者认为他是一位坚定果断的国际领导人。

meaning: n. 动机，目的；主题; adj. 发动的；成为动机的; vt. 使产生动机，激起
example: Sheila had an ulterior motive for trying to help Stan.
translation: 希拉想帮助斯坦是另有所图的。

meaning: n. 杯子；奖杯；酒杯; v. 使成杯状；为…拔火罐
example: My wife was tucked up in bed with her cup of cocoa.
translation: 我老婆端着一杯热可可窝在床上。

meaning: adj. 足够的；充分的
v. 回答；作出反应；承担责任; n. 应答；唱和
example: Some cases of arthritis respond to a gluten-free diet.
translation: 无麸质饮食对一些关节炎患者有疗效。

meaning: n. 标题；（足球）头球；信头; v. 用头顶（head的ing形式）
example: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.
translation: 我正要执行一项让我心惊肉跳的秘密任务。

meaning: v. 解决；定居；沉淀；下陷; n. 有背长椅
example: Wool also has a high settleable solid content.
translation: 羊毛还含有沉淀性能极好的固体物质.

meaning: n. 变化；[生物] 变异，变种
example: The variational parameter multiplying each coordinate is called a scale factor.
translation: 每个坐标所乘的变分参数叫定标因子.

meaning: n. 仪表板；嵌板；座谈小组，全体陪审员; v. 嵌镶板
example: All objects are vetted by a distinguished panel of experts.
translation: 所有物品都交由一个著名的专家小组检查鉴定。

meaning: adj. 微小的；很少的; n. (Tiny)人名；(葡、印)蒂尼
example: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
translation: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

meaning: adj. 谨慎的；精明的；节俭的; n. (Prudent)人名；(法)普吕当
example: Tone down your kamikaze tendencies and take more prudent risks.
translation: 别那么玩命，冒险时要谨慎些。

meaning: n. 批准；认可；赞成
example: A reformed party would have to win the approval of the people.
translation: 一个革新的政党需要赢得人民的认可。

meaning: adj. 过多的，极度的；过分的
example: The police vigorously denied that excessive force had been used.
translation: 警方坚决否认曾经滥用武力。

meaning: adj. 谦虚的，谦逊的；适度的；端庄的；羞怯的; n. (Modest)人名；(罗)莫代斯特；(德)莫德斯特；(俄)莫杰斯特
example: Though his background was modest, it was in no sense deprived.
translation: 尽管他家境一般，但也并不贫穷。

meaning: n. 挫折；退步；逆流
v. 邀请，招待；招致; n. 邀请
example: "Let's invite her to dinner." — "Over my dead body!"
translation: “我们请她来吃晚饭吧。”——“除非我死了！”

meaning: v. 领先，在…之前；优于，高于
example: He gestured to Alice to precede them from the room.
translation: 他给艾丽斯做手势，让她在他们前面离开房间。

meaning: adj. 仔细的，小心的
example: You have to be careful what you say on telly.
translation: 在电视上说话时你必须很谨慎。

meaning: adj. 直的；连续的；笔直的；正直的；整齐的；异性恋的; adv. 直接地；不断地；立即；坦率地; n. 直；直线；直男，直女，异性恋者
example: I wrote him a letter and posted it straightaway.
translation: 我给他写了封信，并马上寄了出去。

meaning: n. 原理，原则；主义，道义；本质，本义；根源，源泉
example: Observance of the law is a matter of principle for us.
translation: 守法是我们的一个原则问题。

meaning: v. 解决；解答；溶解
example: Fears about the solvency of the banks precipitated the great economic crash.
translation: 对银行偿付能力出现恐慌更加速了经济的崩溃.

meaning: v. 解散；解雇；开除；让离开；不予理会、不予考虑
example: The Prime Minister has the power to dismiss and appoint senior ministers.
translation: 首相有权任免高级部长。

meaning: n. 瑕疵，缺点；一阵狂风；短暂的风暴；裂缝，裂纹; v. 使生裂缝，使有裂纹；使无效；使有缺陷
example: The only flaw in his character seems to be a short temper.
translation: 他性格中的唯一缺点好像就是脾气急。

meaning: v. 延伸；扩大；推广；伸出；给予；使竭尽全力；对…估价
example: The new territory would extend over one-fifth of Canada's land mass.
translation: 这块新领土将会使加拿大陆地面积扩展1/5以上。

meaning: v. 吸收；吸引；承受；理解；使…全神贯注
example: The material can absorb outward-going radiation from the Earth.
translation: 该物质可以吸收地球向外辐射的能量。

meaning: adj. 奇怪的；陌生的；外行的; adv. 奇怪地；陌生地，冷淡地; n. (Strange)人名；(英)斯特兰奇；(瑞典、塞)斯特朗格
example: In the movie Dr. Strangelove, Sellers portrays a brilliant but psychotic physicist.
translation: 在电影《斯坦洛夫博士》中, 赛勒斯刻画了一个卓越的但精神变态的物理学家.

meaning: n. 损失，代价；消费；开支; vt. 向…收取费用; vi. 被花掉
example: Owen was against it, on the grounds of expense.
translation: 欧文因费用问题对此表示反对。

meaning: adj. 供选择的；选择性的；交替的; n. 二中择一；供替代的选择
example: New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers.
translation: 关节炎的新疗法可能是止痛药之外的另一种选择。

meaning: v. 破坏；消灭；毁坏
example: They can't destroy truth without destroying each and every one of us.
translation: 除非他们将我们赶尽杀绝，否则真理不灭。

meaning: n. 幻觉，错觉；错误的观念或信仰
example: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
translation: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

meaning: n. 移动；变化；手段；轮班; v. 移动；转变；转换
example: phase shift
translation: 相移

meaning: v. 诱惑；引起；冒…的风险；使感兴趣
v. 促进；增加；支援; n. 推动；帮助；宣扬
example: It did give me a boost to win such a big event.
translation: 赢得如此重大的比赛确实使我信心倍增。

meaning: n. 演讲者；扬声器；说话者；说某种语言的人
example: native speaker
translation: 说母语的人，说本族语的人

meaning: adj. 集体的；共同的；集合的；集体主义的; n. 集团；集合体；集合名词
example: They have been galvanised into collective action — militarily, politically and economically.
translation: 他们在形势驱使下已经在政治、经济和军事上采取了联合行动。

meaning: n. 演讲；讲话；[语] 语音；演说
example: speech recognition
translation: 语音辨识

meaning: adj. 显性的；占优势的；支配的，统治的; n. 显性
example: Japan is Asia's dominant supplier of imports and technology.
translation: 日本是亚洲进口货物和技术的最大供应国。

meaning: n. 行，排；划船；街道；吵闹; v. 划船；使……成排
example: We had a humongous row just before she left.
translation: 就在她离开之前，我们大吵了一架。

meaning: n. 哲学；哲理；人生观
example: Apart from criminal investigation techniques, students learn forensic medicine, philosophy and logic.
translation: 除罪案调查技巧外，学生们还要学习法医学、哲学和逻辑学。

meaning: v. 操纵；操作；巧妙地处理；篡改
example: She was unable, for once, to control and manipulate events.
translation: 她仅有一次没能控制和处理好局势。

meaning: v. 源于；得自；获得; n. (Derive)人名；(法)德里夫
example: Most patients derive enjoyment from leafing through old picture albums.
translation: 大多数病人都很喜欢翻看旧相册。

meaning: n. 笑；引人发笑的事或人; v. 笑
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: v. 授予…学位；分等级；标上刻度; n. 研究生；毕业生; adj. 毕业的；研究生的
example: My first job was as a graduate trainee with a bank.
translation: 我的第一份工作是在一家银行做大学毕业实习生。

meaning: n. 柜台；对立面；计数器；（某些棋盘游戏的）筹码; v. 反击，还击；反向移动，对着干；反驳，回答; adj. 相反的; adv. 反方向地；背道而驰地
example: He could just about see the little man behind the counter.
translation: 他勉强能看到柜台后面的小个子男人。

meaning: adj. 民主的；民主政治的；大众的
example: The Democratic candidate is still leading in the polls.
translation: 民主党候选人的得票数依然领先。

meaning: adj. 能生产的；生产的，生产性的；多产的；富有成效的
example: More productive farmers have been able to provide cheaper food.
translation: 农民提高产量就能使食物更加便宜。

meaning: v. 克服；胜过
example: Having identified the problem, the question arises of how to overcome it.
translation: 发现问题后，如何克服它的问题又出现了。

meaning: v. 通知；为…做广告；使突出
example: The players can advertise baked beans, but not rugby boots.
translation: 球员可以给烤菜豆做广告，但不能代言橄榄球靴。

meaning: n. 海；海洋；许多；大量
example: Draining and reinforcing material for reclaiming seabeach and swamp.
translation: 海滩和沼泽地开垦的排水材料和加固材料.

meaning: n. 委员会；会议；理事会；地方议会；顾问班子
example: The council recently drew fire for its intervention in the dispute.
translation: 委员会最近因为介入该起争端而遭到批评。

meaning: v. 使需要，必需；承担；遗传给；蕴含; n. 引起；需要；继承
example: Selective aversion to certain risks may entail acceptance of other greater risks.
translation: 有选择地回避某些风险可能招致更大的风险.

meaning: n. 儿子；孩子（对年轻人的称呼）；男性后裔
example: son of
translation: …之子

meaning: n. 民主，民主主义；民主政治
example: He said parliament and the process of democracy had been debased.
translation: 他说议会和民主程序已遭贬值。

meaning: n. 学院；研究院；学会；专科院校
example: Neil Howorth, director of the academy, tried to calm things down.
translation: 研究院主任尼尔·豪沃思力图平息事态。

meaning: v. 培养；树立；栽种; adv. 向后；在后面; adj. 后方的；后面的；背面的; n. 后面；屁股；后方部队
example: Those electing to smoke will be seated at the rear.
translation: 那些想吸烟的人将坐在后排。

meaning: n. 专家；专门医师; adj. 专家的；专业的
n. 承认；入场费；进入许可；坦白；录用
example: By his own admission, he evaded taxes as a Florida real-estate speculator.
translation: 他亲口承认自己在佛罗里达从事房地产投机生意时逃过税。

meaning: adj. 变量的；可变的；易变的，多变的；变异的，[生物] 畸变的; n. [数] 变量；可变物，可变因素
example: In variably, also, the latest presents from Ramona's admirers were displayed.
translation: 此外,雷蒙娜的情人最近送来的礼物, 也一定会陈列在那儿.

meaning: v. 迫使；强制；赐，施恩惠；责成；义务
example: Mr Oakley always has been ready to oblige journalists with information.
translation: 奥克利先生总是乐于向记者透露消息。

meaning: n. 水果；产物; v. 结果实
example: I tend to stick to fresh fruit for pudding.
translation: 我一直坚持用新鲜水果做甜点。

meaning: adj. 家庭的；日常的；王室的; n. 全家人，一家人；(包括佣工在内的)家庭，户
example: Some barbecues can be plugged into a household electricity supply.
translation: 有一些烧烤炉能直接插到家用电源上。

meaning: adj. 明智的；聪明的；博学的; v. 使知道；教导; n. (Wise)人名；(英)怀斯
example: Jack is a wiseacre who hears the grass grow.
translation: 杰克是个自作聪明的人,对什么事都非常敏感.

meaning: v. 钉；使固定；揭露; n. [解剖] 指甲；钉子
example: He fought tooth and nail to keep his job.
translation: 他竭尽全力保住自己的工作。

meaning: v. 区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出
example: It is common to distinguish between personal and social ethics.
translation: 个人道德准则和社会道德准则常常不一致。

meaning: n. 海湾；狗吠声; v. 向…吠叫
example: He was so happy communing with the dolphin in Dingle Bay.
translation: 他在丁格尔湾与海豚交流的时候特别开心。

meaning: n. 殖民地；移民队；种群；动物栖息地
example: The newly-occupied Italian colony of Libya rose in revolt in 1914.
translation: 意大利新占领的殖民地利比亚于1914年发生叛乱。

meaning: n. 动物，生物；人；创造物
example: Alaskan Eskimos believe that every living creature possesses a spirit.
translation: 阿拉斯加的爱斯基摩人认为每一个活着的生物都有灵魂。

meaning: n. 核心；伤口的嫩肉; adj. 快的；迅速的，敏捷的；灵敏的; adv. 迅速地，快
example: Don't worry. We'll have you out of here double-quick.
translation: 别担心，我们会很快把你从这儿弄出去的。

meaning: v. 使…完整；使…成整体；求…的积分；表示…的总和; adj. 整合的；完全的; n. 一体化；集成体
example: The way Swedes integrate immigrants is, she feels, 100% more advanced.
translation: 她觉得瑞典人帮助移民适应当地生活的方式百分百地更为先进。

meaning: n. 金，黄金；金色；金币; adj. 金的，金制的；金色的
example: They stumble across a ghost town inhabited by a rascally gold prospector.
translation: 他们偶然来到一个居住着一位狡诈的淘金者的废墟之城。

meaning: adv. 不幸地
v. 划分；除；分开；使产生分歧; n. [地理] 分水岭，分水线
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. 轮廓；大纲；概要；略图; v. 概述；略述；描画…轮廓
example: He could see only the hazy outline of the goalposts.
translation: 他只能看见球门柱模糊的轮廓。

meaning: adj. 极端的；极度的；偏激的；尽头的; n. 极端；末端；最大程度；极端的事物
example: The extreme right reared its ugly head in the 1980s.
translation: 极右势力在20世纪80年代有所抬头。

meaning: n. 绘画；油画；着色; v. 绘画（paint的ing形式）；涂色于
example: Visitors see the painting from behind a plate glass window.
translation: 参观者隔着平板玻璃橱窗欣赏那幅画。

meaning: v. 打；打败; n. 拍子；敲击；有规律的一连串敲打; adj. 筋疲力尽的；疲惫不堪的
example: The president beat his breast and called that deal a mistake.
translation: 总裁捶胸顿足，称那是个错误的交易。

meaning: v. 围绕；包围; n. 围绕物; adj. 环绕立体声的
example: Eventually, the water will permeate through the surrounding concrete.
translation: 最终，水会渗透进周围的混凝土中。

meaning: adj. 深思的；体贴的；关切的
example: I strolled up and down thoughtfully before calling a taxi.
translation: 我踱来踱去仔细思量后叫了一辆出租车。

meaning: n. 资源，财力；办法；智谋
example: A country's principal resource is its brainpower.
translation: 一个国家的首要资源是其人才资源。

meaning: n. [计] 局部；当地居民；本地新闻; adj. 当地的；局部的；地方性的；乡土的
example: There has been a busy start to polling in today's local elections.
translation: 今天地方选举的投票一开始就人头攒动。

meaning: n. 所有权；物主身份
example: Brazil says its constitution forbids the private ownership of energy assets.
translation: 巴西称其宪法禁止个人占有能源资产。

meaning: n. 药方；指示；惯例; adj. 凭处方方可购买的
example: The prescription Ackerman gave me isn't doing any good.
translation: 阿克曼给我开的药没有任何疗效。

meaning: n. 癌症；恶性肿瘤
example: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer.
translation: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

meaning: v. 放松，休息；松懈，松弛；变从容；休养
example: Massage is used to relax muscles, relieve stress and improve the circulation.
translation: 按摩可以使肌肉放松，缓解压力和促进血液循环。

meaning: n. 高兴; v. 高兴
example: The British team did not disguise their delight at their success.
translation: 英国队毫不掩饰他们获胜的喜悦。

meaning: n. 愤怒，愤慨；暴行；侮辱; v. 凌辱，强奸；对…施暴行；激起愤怒
example: The decision provoked outrage from women and human rights groups.
translation: 这一决定激起了妇女和人权组织的强烈愤慨。

meaning: v. 折叠；合拢；抱住；笼罩; n. 折痕；信徒；羊栏
example: But as other shops fold, the march of the superstores continues.
translation: 但在其他商店纷纷关门倒闭之时，大型超市的强劲扩张势头却依旧不减。

meaning: n. 数组，阵列；排列，列阵；大批，一系列；衣服; v. 排列，部署；打扮
example: I was confronted with an array of knobs, levers, and switches.
translation: 我面对的是一大堆旋钮、控制杆和开关。

meaning: adj. 多余的；不必要的；奢侈的
n. 房间；空间；余地；机会；房间里所有的人; v. 为…提供住处；租房，合住；投宿，住宿；留…住宿
example: The light went out, and the room was plunged into darkness.
translation: 灯熄了，屋里陷入一片漆黑。

meaning: adj. 平等的；相等的；胜任的; v. 等于；比得上; n. 对手；匹敌；同辈；相等的事物
example: In many respects Asian women see themselves as equal to their men.
translation: 在很多方面，亚洲女性都认为自己和丈夫是平等的。

meaning: n. 获得物，获得；收购
example: How did you go about making this marvellous acquisition then?
translation: 那么你是怎么买到这一绝品的？

meaning: n. 反馈；成果，资料；回复
example: It would monitor traffic flows and provide feedback to motorists.
translation: 它能监控交通状况，然后给司机提供反馈信息。

meaning: v. 钦佩；赞美

translation: 戴维发誓要离开这个项目，我不得不对他表示钦佩。

meaning: v. 承认；准许进入；可容纳
example: You have to admit that you are, in fact, in difficulties.
translation: 你不得不承认，你事实上是陷入了困境。

meaning: adj. 语言的；语言学的
example: When a book goes into translation, all those linguistic subtleties get lost.
translation: 当一部书被翻译成另一种语言后，所有那些语言上的精妙之处就都丢失了。

meaning: n. 工程师；工兵；火车司机; v. 设计；策划；精明地处理
example: The RAF recognized him as an out-standingly able engineer.
translation: 英国皇家空军表彰他是一名非常能干的机械师。

meaning: n. 表面；表层；外观; adj. 表面的，肤浅的; v. 浮出水面
example: on the surface
translation: 在表面上，外表上

meaning: n. 气泡，泡沫，泡状物；透明圆形罩，圆形顶; v. 沸腾，冒泡；发出气泡声
example: As she spoke she felt a bubble of optimism rising inside her.
translation: 当她讲话时，她感到内心的乐观情绪越来越高涨。

meaning: n. 立法；法律
example: They think that any legislation that involved putting down dogs was wrong.
translation: 他们认为任何涉及捕杀狗的立法都是错误的。

meaning: n. 信心；信任；秘密; adj. （美）诈骗的；骗得信任的
example: He has never exhibited the self-confidence, bordering on arrogance, of his predecessor.
translation: 他从未表现出他前任的那种近乎傲慢的自信。

meaning: v. 属于，应归入；居住；适宜；应被放置
example: I'm so glad to see you back where you belong.
translation: 我真高兴看到你又回到了属于你自己的天地。

meaning: n. 餐馆；[经] 饭店
example: He insisted we stop at a small restaurant just outside of Atlanta.
translation: 他坚持让我们在亚特兰大市外不远的一家小餐馆歇歇脚。

meaning: n. 女士，小姐，年轻未婚女子
example: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
translation: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

meaning: adj. 全部的；完全的；整个的; v. 总数达; n. 总数，合计
example: in total
translation: 总计

meaning: n. 味道；品味；审美; v. 尝；体验
example: The decor is tasteful and restrained.
translation: 装饰风格素雅简约。

meaning: n. 雇主，老板
example: An employer can demand written certification that the relative is really ill.
translation: 雇主可以要求出具书面证明，证实员工的亲人确实病了。

meaning: n. 假定；设想；担任；采取
example: We are working on the assumption that it was a gas explosion.
translation: 我们假设这是一场燃气爆炸事故。

meaning: v. 驱使；激怒；煽动；惹起

translation: 如果一家公司倒闭，便有可能引发一连串的破产。

meaning: adj. 正直的，诚实的；垂直的，直立的；笔直的；合乎正道的; n. 垂直；竖立
example: Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge uprightly among men?
translation: 统治者啊,你们果真讲正义 吗 ?你们以公平审判人民 吗 ?

meaning: n. 退休金，抚恤金；津贴；膳宿费; v. 发给养老金或抚恤金
example: He lived on an invalidity pension which came as a weekly giro.
translation: 他靠每周领取的作为病残养老金的直接转账救济支票过日子。

meaning: v. 计算；认为; n. 计数；计算；伯爵
v. 运转；动手术；起作用
example: Hotels operate a collection service for their guests from the airports.
translation: 宾馆为客人提供机场接机服务。

meaning: n. 愤怒；狂暴，肆虐；情绪激动; v. 大怒，发怒；流行，风行
example: I saw her in a towering rage only once.
translation: 我只有一次见过她大发雷霆。

meaning: v. 投诉；发牢骚；诉说

translation: 抱怨

meaning: v. 控制；使掌握；持有；迷住；拥有，具备
example: This figure has long been held to possess miraculous power.
translation: 这个数字长时间以来都被认为拥有神奇的力量。

meaning: v. 嫁；娶；与……结婚; n. (Marry)人名；(阿拉伯)马雷；(法)马里
example: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
translation: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

meaning: v. 通知；告诉；报告
example: Teachers inform me that Tracey's behaviour has improved no end.
translation: 老师们告诉我特雷西的行为大有改善。

meaning: v. 欠；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于; n. (Owe)人名；(瑞典、挪)奥弗
example: I'm broke, Livy, and I owe a couple of million dollars.
translation: 我破产了，莉薇，而且我欠了几百万美元的债。

meaning: n. 属，种；种族，人种；家庭，门第; v. 使参加比赛；和…竞赛；使急走，使全速行进
example: Before the race, he is fine. But afterwards he is worn out.
translation: 赛前他状态很好，赛后就筋疲力尽了。

meaning: adj. 积极的；[数] 正的，[医][化学] 阳性的；确定的，肯定的；实际的，真实的；绝对的; n. 正数；[摄] 正片
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. 好奇，好奇心；珍品，古董，古玩

translation: 她还激发了他的好奇心，使他愿意了解其他文化。

meaning: adj. 完美的；最好的；精通的; v. 使完美；使熟练; n. 完成式

translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

meaning: v. 假定；设想；承担；采取

translation: 不要想当然地认为你的宝宝一闹就是要吃奶。

meaning: adj. 已婚的，有配偶的；婚姻的，夫妇的；密切结合的; n. 已婚者; v. 结婚，与…结婚（marry的过去式）

translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: v. 保证，确保；使安全

translation: 钻头必须缓慢转动，以保证钻孔平整光滑。

meaning: adj. 普遍的，广泛的；分布广的

translation: 我猜想这本书会引起大家最广泛的兴趣。

meaning: v. 躺下；产卵；搁放；放置；铺放；涂，敷; adj. 世俗的；外行的；没有经验的; n. 位置；短诗；花纹方向；叙事诗；性伙伴

translation: 科恩星期天一整天都在家无所事事。

meaning: n. 一千；一千个；许许多多; adj. 成千的；无数的

meaning: adj. 故意的；深思熟虑的；从容的; v. 仔细考虑；商议

translation: 他在第32分钟时因故意手球犯规被罚下场。

meaning: adj. 野生的；野蛮的；狂热的；荒凉的; n. 荒野; adv. 疯狂地；胡乱地
example: A pattern can include regular characters and wildcard characters.
translation: 模式可以包含常规字符和通配符.

meaning: v. 控制；精通；征服; n. 硕士；主人；大师；教师; adj. 主人的；主要的；熟练的

translation: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

meaning: v. 驱使；强迫；束缚
example: The police used horses to constrain the crowd from violence.
translation: 警察骑着马阻止那群人诉诸暴力.

meaning: n. 委员会；佣金；犯；委任；委任状; v. 委任；使服役；委托制作
example: Just a few days ago, I finished a commission.
translation: 就在几天前，我完成了一项委托创作任务。

meaning: n. 持有人；所有人；固定器；（台、架等）支持物
example: Her popular pot holder is also available in do-it-yourself kits.
translation: 她那广受欢迎的防烫布垫也可以自己购买原料套装自己制作。

meaning: v. 抑制；镇压；废止
example: An organic wetting agent or foam suppressant is quite helpful in the formation of filterable hemihydrate.
translation: 某种有机的润湿剂或消泡剂十分有助于形成可过滤的半水物.

meaning: n. 期待；预期；指望
example: The weight of expectation was getting to them.
translation: 他们逐渐感觉到了期望带来的压力。

meaning: n. 音乐家
example: He feels that he was destined to become a musician.
translation: 他觉得自己注定会成为一名音乐家。

meaning: adj. 巨大的；庞大的；无限的; n. (Huge)人名；(英)休奇

translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

meaning: v. 集中；浓缩；全神贯注；聚集; n. 浓缩，精选；浓缩液
example: They will concentrate on teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
translation: 他们将集中教授阅读、写作和算术基础知识。

meaning: n. 失业；失业率；失业人数

translation: 失业率

meaning: n. 对；夫妇；数个; v. 结合；成婚
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: adj. 弥漫的；散开的; v. 扩散；传播；漫射

translation: 一道冰冷的光线透过天窗漫射进来。

meaning: adj. 永久的，永恒的；不变的; n. 烫发（等于permanent wave）
example: The museum will have a permanent exhibition of 60 vintage cars.
translation: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

meaning: v. 监督，管理；指导
example: supervise the manufacture of
translation: 监制

meaning: n. 细胞；电池；蜂房的巢室；单人小室; vi. 住在牢房或小室中

translation: 3个囚犯关在一个3米长2米宽的小牢房里。

meaning: v. 回答；[法] 答辩；回击; n. 回答；[法] 答辩
example: He said in reply that the question was unfair.
translation: 他回答说这个问题不公平。

meaning: adj. 工艺的，科技的；技术上的；专门的
example: The earlier verdict was overturned on a legal technicality.
translation: 由于诉讼程序上的一个技术细则，原先的判决被推翻了。

meaning: n. 交易；便宜货；契约; v. 讨价还价；议价；(谈价钱后)卖
example: They prefer to bargain with individual clients, for cash.
translation: 在现款方面，他们更愿意同散户打交道。

meaning: n. 倾向，趋势；癖好

translation: 发展趋势

meaning: v. 配制；混淆；使混和；使结交; n. 混合；混合物；混乱
example: Stewart has developed a tendency to mix it verbally with the opposition.
translation: 斯图尔特现在变得只要和别人意见不合，就准备大吵一架。

meaning: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；可估价的; n. 贵重物品
example: All all valuableness is not best.
translation: 昂贵的不都是最好的.

meaning: n. 愤慨；愤怒；义愤
example: He bristled with indignation at the suggestion that he was racist.
translation: 有人暗示他是个种族主义者，他对此十分恼火。

meaning: n. 电影院，戏院，剧场；戏剧；手术室

translation: n. 电影院

meaning: n. 救济；减轻，解除；安慰；浮雕
example: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities.
translation: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

meaning: n. 作文，作曲，作品；[材] 构成；合成物；成分
example: The course is designed to help students with colour and composition.
translation: 设置这门课程是为了指导学生如何运用色彩和构图。

meaning: adj. 慷慨的，大方的；宽宏大量的；有雅量的
example: Not everyone thinks that the government is being particularly generous.
translation: 并非所有人都认为政府特别慷慨。

meaning: n. 导体；售票员；领导者；管理人
example: The conductor's eyes darted to Wilfred, then fixed on Michael again.
translation: 乐队指挥飞快地扫了威尔弗雷德一眼，然后视线又落回到迈克尔身上。

meaning: v. 排出；耗尽；使精疲力尽；彻底探讨; n. 排气；废气；排气装置
example: The city's streets are filthy and choked with exhaust fumes.
translation: 那座城市的街道肮脏不堪，弥漫着令人窒息的废气。

meaning: adj. 棕色的，褐色的；太阳晒黑的; v. 变成褐色; n. 褐色，棕色
example: The sand martin is a brown bird with white underneath.
translation: 崖沙燕是一种褐羽白腹的鸟。

meaning: n. 岩石；摇滚乐；暗礁; v. 摇动；使摇晃
example: He once told an interviewer that he didn't even like rock music.
translation: 他曾告诉一位采访者，他甚至都不喜欢摇滚乐。

meaning: n. 公差；宽容；容忍；公差
example: Other changes include more tolerant attitudes to unmarried couples having children.
translation: 其他变化包括对非婚夫妇生育更为宽容的态度。

meaning: adj. 西方的，西部的；有西方特征的; n. 西方人；西部片，西部小说
example: No westerner could fly in without a visa.
translation: 没有签证的西方人不能乘飞机入境。

meaning: n. 援助，帮助；辅助设备
example: Any assistance you could give the police will be greatly appreciated.
translation: 您提供的任何帮助警方都将万分感谢。

meaning: n. 建设；建筑物；解释；造句
example: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: v. 召回；回想起，记起；取消; n. 召回；回忆；撤消
example: I recall many discussions with her on these and kindred topics.
translation: 我回想起多次同她就这些问题及类似话题进行的讨论。

meaning: v. 规划；用公式表示；明确地表达
example: He took care to formulate his reply very clearly.
translation: 他字斟句酌,清楚地做了回答.

meaning: n. 星期一
example: Wendy popped in for a quick bite to eat on Monday night.
translation: 温迪周一晚上过来匆匆吃了点儿饭。

meaning: adj. 真正的，真实的；可信的
example: I had obtained the authentic details about the birth of the organization.
translation: 我已经掌握了有关该组织诞生的可靠的详细资料。

meaning: n. 发生率；影响；[光] 入射；影响范围

translation: 犯罪率高的地区

meaning: v. 忍受；容忍; n. 小溪；小河
example: Ahead, he saw the side railings of First Bridge over Crooked Brook.
translation: 他看见了克鲁克德河上第一大桥的桥栏就在前面。

meaning: n. 商品，货物；日用品
example: Many brokers were charged with cheating customers in commodity trades.
translation: 许多经纪人被指控在商品交易中欺骗顾客。

meaning: n. 喉咙；嗓子，嗓音；窄路; vt. 开沟于；用喉音说

meaning: v. 欺骗；骗取; n. 欺骗，作弊；骗子
example: I know it sounds unbelievable but I never wanted to cheat.
translation: 我知道听上去难以置信，但我从不想撒谎。

meaning: n. 灵魂；心灵；精神；鬼魂; adj. 美国黑人文化的
example: One short song the young lady played in a most soulful and tender mood.
translation: 嘉莉听到从敞着门的楼下客厅里传出了这支歌.

meaning: v. 捕食；掠夺；折磨; n. 捕食；牺牲者；被捕食的动物
example: The spider must wait for prey to be ensnared on its web.
translation: 蜘蛛必须等待猎物被它的蛛网困住。

meaning: adj. 便宜的；小气的；不值钱的; adv. 便宜地

translation: 我们最终将生活在一个视人命为儿戏的社会。

meaning: v. 废除，废止；取消，革除

translation: 议会于翌年表决对谋杀罪废除死刑。

meaning: v. 富于；充满
example: Stories abound about when he was in charge.
translation: 关于他在任时的传闻多不胜数。

meaning: adj. 文学的；书面的；精通文学的
example: Her literary criticism focuses on the way great literature suggests ideas.
translation: 她的文学批评集中关注的是伟大的文学作品表达思想的方式。

meaning: v. 节约，吝惜；饶恕；分出，分让; adj. 多余的；瘦的；少量的; n. 剩余；备用零件
example: Provides the flawless sense of hearing for the net friend to enjoy sparely no effort.
translation: 为网友提供至善至美的听觉享受不遗余力.

meaning: adj. 令人满意的；值得要的; n. 合意的人或事物
example: The crowd moved indoors for what were deemed the most desirable items.
translation: 人群为了被视为最值得拥有的物品涌入屋里。

meaning: v. 吸收；使同化；把…比作；使相似
example: His family tried to assimilate into the white and Hispanic communities.
translation: 他一家人试图融入白人和西班牙裔社区。

meaning: adj. 口头的；言语的；动词的；照字面的; n. 动词的非谓语形式
example: The idea was immediate but the verbalism took hours.
translation: 想法瞬间可得,但表达出来却花费时间.

meaning: v. 集合，聚集；装配；收集
example: Greenpeace managed to assemble enough boats to waylay the ship at sea.
translation: 绿色和平组织设法聚集起足够数量的小船在海上拦截该船。

meaning: adj. 下流的；肮脏的；脾气不好的；险恶的; n. 令人不快的事物

translation: 他们因吃错东西而得了很严重的感染症。

meaning: v. 等候；推迟；延缓; n. 等待；等候
example: The waiter returned with their order and Graham signed the bill.
translation: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。

meaning: n. 工具箱；成套工具; v. 装备
example: I don't like taking my kit off on screen.
translation: 我不喜欢在银幕上表演裸戏。

meaning: v. 进行；发动；从事; n. 工资；代价；报偿
example: A wager is a fool's argument.
translation: 傻瓜一争论就打赌.

meaning: adv. 永远；不断地；常常
example: Although they're expensive, they last forever and never go out of style.
translation: 尽管价格昂贵，但它们经久耐用，永不过时。

meaning: adj. 凶猛的；毁灭性的; v. 砍伐；打倒；击倒; n. [林] 一季所伐的木材；折缝；兽皮
example: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
translation: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

meaning: n. 教训；课; vt. 教训；上课
example: He learned this lesson the hard way from his own personal experience.
translation: 吃一堑长一智，他这个教训来之不易——是从他自己的亲身经历中得来的。

meaning: adj. 适当的；恰当的；合适的; v. 占用，拨出
example: A sense of period was evoked by complementing pictures with appropriate furniture.
translation: 给照片配上一些合适的家具，唤起了一种年代感。

meaning: adj. 相对的；有关系的；成比例的; n. 亲戚；相关物；[语] 关系词；亲缘植物
example: An employer can demand written certification that the relative is really ill.
translation: 雇主可以要求出具书面证明，证实员工的亲人确实病了。

meaning: adj. 等价的，相等的；同意义的; n. 等价物，相等物
example: His party has just suffered the equivalent of a near-fatal heart attack.
translation: 他所在的政党刚刚经历了一次类似心脏病突发般几近致命的打击。

meaning: adj. 漠不关心的；无关紧要的；中性的，中立的
example: Of all the lazy, indifferent, unbusinesslike attitudes to have!
translation: 这是多么懒惰、冷漠、不敬业的态度！

meaning: adj. 革命的；旋转的；大变革的; n. 革命者

example: U.S. forces now occupy a part of the country.
translation: 美国军队现在占领了该国的一部分。

meaning: v. 消失；突然不见；成为零; n. 弱化音
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；煞费苦心的; v. 精心制作；详细阐述；从简单成分合成（复杂有机物）
adj. 严峻的；严厉的；剧烈的；苛刻的

translation: 他被诊断患有严重的阅读困难症，但是却绝顶聪明。

meaning: v. 停止；终了; n. 停止
example: It hurt so badly he wished to cease to be.
translation: 他觉得疼痛难忍，恨不得死了算了。

meaning: adj. 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的; n. 古代人；老人
example: The journey ends in the ancient city of Marrakesh.
translation: 旅行的终点是马拉喀什古城。

meaning: adj. 有毒的；中毒的
example: Drugs may be utilized to alter the pharmacokinetic profile of a toxicant.
translation: 可以利用药物来改变某种毒剂的药动学性质.

meaning: adj. 亲密的；私人的；精通的；有性关系的; n. 知己；至交; v. 暗示；通知；宣布

translation: 布莱克先生直攻要害，问起了性方面的隐私问题。

meaning: n. 插曲；一段情节；插话；有趣的事件

translation: 巴特菲尔德先生否认和此事有关。

meaning: adv. 完全地；全部；统统

meaning: n. 习惯，惯例；风俗；海关，关税；经常光顾；[总称]（经常性的）顾客; adj. （衣服等）定做的，定制的
example: It was his invariable custom to have one whisky before his supper.
translation: 晚饭前来杯威士忌，这是他一直以来的习惯。

meaning: n. 含义；暗示；牵连，卷入；可能的结果，影响

translation: 婚姻不忠会提升领导人可信度的暗示荒谬之极。

meaning: adj. 有争议的；有争论的

meaning: n. 肉，肉类（食用）
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: adj. 船舶的；海生的；海产的；航海的，海运的; n. 海运业；舰队；水兵；（海军）士兵或军官

translation: 海洋微生物腐烂后沉积形成磷酸盐。

meaning: v. 设计；计划；表达；投射; n. 工程；计划；事业
example: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
translation: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

meaning: n. 国会；代表大会；会议；社交

translation: 艾森豪威尔用他的影响力说服国会修改了该项法律。

meaning: n. 资格；成员资格；会员身份
example: The European Builders Confederation has a membership of over 350,000 building companies.
translation: 欧洲建筑商联合会拥有逾35万家建筑公司会员。

meaning: v. 位于；查找…的地点
example: Try to locate exactly where the smells are entering the room.
translation: 找找看气味具体是从什么地方散入房间的。

meaning: n. 航空公司；航线; adj. 航线的
example: The airline had losses of $35m and was bailed out by Qantas.
translation: 这家航空公司亏损达3,500万美元，而澳航出资帮助其摆脱了困境。

meaning: n. 效率；效能；功效
example: The spa is the last word in luxury and efficiency.
translation: 这家矿泉疗养浴场极尽奢华，功效极高。

meaning: n. 臀部；蔷薇果；忧郁; adj. 熟悉内情的；非常时尚的

translation: 我侧一步要躲闪的时候，瓶子打中了我的左髋部。

meaning: n. 智慧，才智；明智；学识；至理名言
example: They might be wise to stop advertising on television.
translation: 他们不妨停止在电视上做广告，这样做可能是明智之举。

meaning: adv. 实际地；几乎；事实上
example: We all knew by then that the affair was practically over.
translation: 到那时，我们都知道事情实际上已经结束了。

meaning: v. 分离；派遣；使超然
example: It helps them detach themselves from their problems and become more objective.
translation: 这有助于他们从所面临的问题中跳出来，变得更客观一些。

meaning: n. [经] 所有者；物主

translation: 以前的房主没有留下任何转递地址。

meaning: n. 道路；小路；轨道
example: Stewart was trying to clear a path for the stretcher.
translation: 斯图尔特在努力给担架开路。

meaning: n. 干；茎；船首；血统; v. 阻止；除去…的茎；给…装柄
example: stem cell
translation: 干细胞，骨髓干细胞

meaning: n. 神；（大写首字母时）上帝; vt. 膜拜，崇拜
example: Thank God they're not on my manor any more.
translation: 谢天谢地，他们再也不在我的辖区里了。

meaning: v. 展览；显示；提出（证据等）; n. 展览品；证据；展示会
example: Two cats or more in one house will also exhibit territorial behaviour.
translation: 一家若有两只或更多的猫，也会表现出争夺地盘的行为。

meaning: n. 比例，占比；部分；面积；均衡; v. 使成比例；使均衡；分摊

translation: 我们对所有的这些都要有轻重缓急之分。

meaning: v. 溅，泼；用使液体飞溅; n. 飞溅的水；污点；卖弄

translation: 浪溅区，飞溅区；干湿交替段

meaning: v. 绕开；忽视；设旁路；迂回; n. 旁路；[公路] 支路

translation: 一条新的绕城环路正在建设当中。

meaning: n. 酒精，乙醇
example: In 1985, he began to show signs of alcohol and drug dependency.
translation: 在1985年，他开始表现出酗酒嗜毒的迹象。

meaning: v. 油漆；绘画；装饰；涂色于；描绘；（用语言，文字等）描写；擦脂粉等; n. 油漆；颜料，涂料；绘画作品；胭脂等化妆品；色彩，装饰

translation: 墙上被人用喷漆涂得乱七八糟。

meaning: n. 呼吸，气息；一口气，（呼吸的）一次；瞬间，瞬息；微风；迹象；无声音，气音

translation: 我屏住呼吸沉入水底。

meaning: n. 碟；金属板；金属牌；感光底片; v. 电镀；给…装甲
example: Garnish the plate with whipped cream rosettes and fresh fruits.
translation: 用玫瑰花形的掼奶油和新鲜的水果作配菜点缀盘子。

meaning: adj. 上级的；优秀的，出众的；高傲的; n. 上级，长官；优胜者，高手；长者
example: The home side rubbed in their superiority with a further goal.
translation: 主队再进一球从而奠定了优势。

meaning: n. 织布机；若隐若现的景象; v. 可怕地出现；朦胧地出现；隐约可见
example: As such tensions increase, they loom larger in Russia's domestic politics.
translation: 这种紧张关系的不断加剧使其在俄罗斯国内政治中愈发凸显。

meaning: n. 暴力；侵犯；激烈；歪曲

translation: 人群变得狂暴起来，并向警察投掷汽油弹。

meaning: n. 经营者；操作员；话务员；行家
example: A blade guard is fitted to protect the operator.
translation: 为保证操作人员的人身安全安装了桨叶保护罩。

meaning: n. 义务；职责；债务
example: Co-operation was more than just an attractive option, it was an obligation.
translation: 合作不仅仅是诱人的选择，它也是一种责任。

meaning: adj. 无生命的；呆板的；废弃了的; adv. 完全地; n. 死者
example: "Let's invite her to dinner." — "Over my dead body!"
translation: “我们请她来吃晚饭吧。”——“除非我死了！”

meaning: n. 假日；节日；休息日; v. 外出度假
example: People are having to think hard about their holiday plans.
translation: 人们现在得仔细地琢磨自己的度假计划。

meaning: n. [数] 极大，最大限度；最大量; adj. 最高的；最多的；最大极限的
example: Twelve hours is the minimum, sixty hours the maximum.
translation: 12小时为下限,60小时为上限.

meaning: n. 赞助者；主办者；保证人; v. 赞助；发起
example: Who won't be search of can sponsorial flesh become'black mouth'new waists - coat?
translation: 谁又能保证人肉搜索不会成为 ‘ 黑嘴 ’ 的新马甲?

meaning: v. 陪伴，伴随；伴奏
example: This volume of essays was designed to accompany an exhibition in Cologne.
translation: 这本文集是为配合在科隆举办的一场展览而出的。

meaning: v. 烦扰，打扰；使……不安；使……恼怒; n. 麻烦；烦恼
example: Mr Brooke is undoubtedly in a spot of bother.
translation: 布鲁克先生肯定遇到了点小麻烦。

meaning: v. 延期；耽搁; n. 延期；耽搁；被耽搁或推迟的时间
example: How much delay should we build into the plan?
translation: 我们应该为这个计划预留多少富余的时间？

meaning: v. 点击；使发咔哒声; n. 单击；滴答声
example: There was a metallic click and the gates swung open.
translation: 随着一声金属碰击的咔嗒声，大门打开了。

meaning: adj. 模糊的；含糊的；不明确的；暧昧的; n. (Vague)人名；(法)瓦格；(英)韦格
example: He looked vaguely around the room as he spoke, his mind elsewhere.
translation: 他边说话边茫然地打量着房间，心不在焉的样子。

meaning: adj. 高尚的；贵族的；惰性的；宏伟的; n. 贵族; vt. 抓住；逮捕
example: He had implicit faith in the noble intentions of the Emperor.
translation: 他对皇帝陛下高尚的动机深信不疑。

meaning: adj. 可适用的；可应用的；合适的
example: The section of the form is not applicable in your case.
translation: 表格这一部分不适合你的情况.

meaning: adj. 聪明的；巧妙的；敏捷的；厉害的；潇洒的；剧烈的；时髦的; n. (Smart)人名；(法)斯马尔；(英、德)斯马特
example: smart card
translation: 智能卡

meaning: adj. 松弛的；疏忽的；不流畅的; v. 松懈；减弱; n. 煤末；峡谷; adv. 马虎地；缓慢地
example: slack off
translation: 偷懒；懈怠

meaning: v. 达到，实现；获得；到达; n. 成就
example: Top-ranking sumo wrestlers attain superstar status.
translation: 顶尖的相扑选手可获得超级明星的地位。

meaning: n. 主动权；首创精神; adj. 主动的；自发的；起始的
example: He proposed a new diplomatic initiative to try to stop the war.
translation: 他提出了一项新的外交计划以尽力阻止这场战争。

meaning: v. 加强，加固；强化；补充; n. 加强；加固物；加固材料
adj. 感人的；令人钦佩的；给人以深刻印象的
example: India while not racking up such an impressive score beat Japan 3-0.
translation: 印度尽管没有大胜，却也以3比0击败了日本。

meaning: n. 产量；农作物；庄稼；平头; v. 种植；收割；修剪；剪短
example: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
translation: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

meaning: v. 使服从；主张；呈递

translation: 提交登记表；提交注册

meaning: n. 印象；效果，影响；压痕，印记；感想；曝光（衡量广告被显示的次数。打开一个带有该广告的网页，则该广告的impression 次数增加一次）
example: My visit to India in 1986 left an indelible impression on me.
translation: 1986年的印度之行给我留下了难忘的印象。

meaning: n. 鼓舞，刺激；马刺；山坡; v. 骑马疾驰；给予刺激

translation: n. [机]正齿轮

meaning: v. 反应；影响；反抗；起反作用
example: There'dbe no telling how John would react to such news as this.
translation: 还不知道约翰听到这样的消息会作何反应。

meaning: v. 例证；例示
example: I'm going to exemplify one or two of these points.
translation: 我打算就论点中的一、两个方面举例说明.

meaning: v. 准备；使适合；装备；起草
example: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

meaning: n. 接触，联系; v. 使接触，联系
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: v. 使依附；贴上；系上；使依恋
example: Magistrates will be able to attach conditions when juveniles are remanded.
translation: 地方法官将可以在少年犯送押时提出附加条件。

meaning: n. 一步；步速；步伐；速度; v. 踱步；缓慢而行
example: Interest rates would come down as the recovery gathered pace.
translation: 随着复苏的加速，利率会降下来。

meaning: adj. 神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: n. 费用；酬金；小费; v. 付费给……
example: He finally corrected his misstatement and offered to reduce the fee.
translation: 他终于纠正了自己的错误说法，提出要减少费用。

meaning: v. 猜测；认为；推测；猜中; n. 猜测；推测
example: Guess what? I'm going to dinner at Mrs. Combley's tonight.
translation: 你猜怎么着？今晚我要去康伯利夫人家里赴宴。

meaning: adj. 不情愿的；勉强的；顽抗的
example: We were reluctant to start the long trudge home.
translation: 我们很不愿意踏上如此漫长艰辛的回家之路。

meaning: n. 叶子；（书籍等的）一张；扇页; v. 生叶；翻书页
example: I was shaking all over, trembling like a leaf.
translation: 我像风中的落叶一样浑身发抖。

meaning: n. 外科；外科手术；手术室；诊疗室
example: His surgical instruments were a knife and a pair of pincers.
translation: 他的外科手术器械是一把刀和一把钳子。

meaning: n. 人事部门；全体人员; adj. 人员的；有关人事的
example: I looked your address up in the personnel file.
translation: 我在人事档案里找到了你的地址。

meaning: v. 煽动；刺激；吹拂; n. 迷；风扇；爱好者
example: As a boy he was a Manchester United fan.
translation: 小时候，他是曼联队的球迷。

meaning: adj. 微妙的；精美的，雅致的；柔和的；易碎的；纤弱的；清淡可口的
example: Although the coral looks hard, it is very delicate.
translation: 珊瑚虽然看上去坚固，实际上非常易碎。

meaning: n. 城堡；象棋中的车; v. 置…于城堡中；筑城堡防御
example: He was riding on his horse looking for the castle.
translation: 他正骑着马寻找那座城堡。

meaning: n. （批评判断的）标准；准则；规范；准据
example: Senior managers stipulated work-life balance as their main criterion when choosing jobs.
translation: 高级经理人把工作与生活的平衡作为择业的主要标准。

meaning: n. 浓度；集中；浓缩；专心；集合
example: We lacked concentration and it cost us the goal and the game.
translation: 我们注意力不够集中，结果丢了球，输了比赛。

meaning: adj. 昏暗的，朦胧的；晦涩的，不清楚的；隐蔽的；不著名的，无名的; v. 使…模糊不清，掩盖；隐藏；使难理解; n. 某种模糊的或不清楚的东西
example: Rumour, myth and hearsay obscure the truth after months of bloodshed.
translation: 杀戮持续了数月后，真相在谣言、谎话和传闻的遮掩下变得模糊不清。

meaning: v. 公然反对；抓…的胡须; n. 胡须；颌毛
example: His beard was just beginning to show signs of grey.
translation: 他的胡子才刚有点泛白。

meaning: n. 感情，情绪；情操；观点；多愁善感
example: Beneath the sentimental psychobabble, there's a likeable movie trying to get out.
translation: 在多愁善感的心理学呓语之下，一部本有可能受到喜爱的电影挣扎欲出。

meaning: adj. 综合的；广泛的；有理解力的; n. 综合学校；专业综合测验
example: There are much brighter prospects for a comprehensive settlement than before.
translation: 综合性的社区具有比以前更加光明的前景。

meaning: n. 娱乐，消遣
example: Learning should no longer be an elitist pastime for the chosen few.
translation: 学习不应再是少数人的高级消遣。

meaning: adj. 怀孕的；富有意义的
example: The number of women who become pregnant after adopting children is legion.
translation: 领养小孩后怀孕的妇女比比皆是。

meaning: v. 表现；（机器等）运转；举止端正；（事物）起某种作用
example: The aim of discipline is to teach children to behave acceptably.
translation: 纪律的目的是教育儿童举止得体。

meaning: adj. 含蓄的；暗示的；盲从的
example: He had implicit faith in the noble intentions of the Emperor.
translation: 他对皇帝陛下高尚的动机深信不疑。

meaning: v. 执行；完成；演奏
example: He can perform an astonishing variety of acts, including mime and juggling.
translation: 他能表演好几种令人惊叹的把戏，包括哑剧和玩杂耍。

meaning: n. 瓷器; adj. 瓷制的
example: China enters a new five-year plan period next year.
translation: 中国明年开始进入新一个五年计划期。

meaning: v. 复兴；复活；苏醒；恢复精神
example: He is seeking advice on how to revive the stagnant economy.
translation: 他正在就如何振兴低迷的经济征求意见。

meaning: adj. 宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的; n. (Precious)人名；(英)普雷舍斯，普雷舍丝(女名)
example: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
translation: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

meaning: n. 朝圣者；漫游者；（美）最初的移民; vi. 去朝圣；漫游
example: This weekend course will be of value to everyone interested in the Pilgrim Route.
translation: 这一周末课程对每一个对朝圣路线感兴趣的人来说都会很有用。

meaning: adv. 同样地；也
example: These requests are ignored. His requests for rent are likewise sometimes ignored.
translation: 这些要求被置之不理。他关于支付租金的要求有时也同样未被理睬。

meaning: n. 奖品；奖赏；战利品; v. 珍视；捕获；估价; adj. 获奖的
example: Each month the total prize kitty is £13.5 million.
translation: 每个月的彩池奖金总额达1,350万英镑。

meaning: adj. 严格的；绝对的；精确的；详细的
example: strict control
translation: 严格控制

meaning: v. 提升；举起；振奋情绪等；提升…的职位
example: Democracy might elevate the common man to a position of political superiority.
translation: 民主也许能提升普通人的政治地位，让他们产生优越感。

meaning: n. 英寸；身高；少许; v. 使缓慢地移动
example: We are prepared to fight for every inch of territory.
translation: 我们时刻准备着为每一寸领土而战。

meaning: v. 超越；胜过，优于；非…所能办到或理解
example: Social research nowadays has a practical urgency surpassing even that of cancer research.
translation: 当今社会研究的现实迫切性甚至超过对癌症的研究.

meaning: v. 演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；与…说话；提出；处理; n. 地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧；称呼
example: Someone cranked up the volume of the public address system.
translation: 有人调大了公共广播系统的音量。

meaning: adj. 失踪的；缺少的; v. 错过（miss的ing形式）；想念；漏掉; n. (Missing)人名；(德)米辛
example: Ah yes, but think of all the family life they're missing.
translation: 是这样，不过别忘了他们错过了多少天伦之乐。

meaning: n. 假设
example: The results confirmed his hypothesis on the use of modal verbs.
translation: 结果证实了他的关于情态动词用法的假设.

meaning: n. 新奇；新奇的事物；新颖小巧而廉价的物品
example: They're treating it like a game, a novelty. That's got to stop.
translation: 他们把这件事当成了一个游戏，觉得很新鲜。不能再那样下去了。

meaning: v. 保护，防卫；警戒
example: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
translation: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

meaning: n. 时钟；计时器; v. 记录；记时
example: It was just gone 7 o'clock this evening when I finished.
translation: 今晚我做完的时候刚过7点。

meaning: v. 启发，启蒙；教导，开导；照耀
example: She didn't enlighten him about her background.
translation: 她未向他讲明自己的出身背景。

meaning: n. （一个地区全部的）生物；生物学
example: An A-level pass in Biology is preferred for all courses.
translation: 不管读什么课程，生物学高级证书考试最好都要及格。

meaning: n. 比较；对照；比喻；比较关系
example: The comparison of her life to a sea voyage simplifies her experience.
translation: 把她的人生比作一次海上航行不足以说明她丰富的经历。

meaning: v. 完成；实现；达到
example: He exhorted his companions, "Try to accomplish your aim with diligence".
translation: 他劝诫同伴说：“要通过勤奋努力实现自己的目标。”

meaning: n. 观众；听众；读者；接见；正式会见；拜会
example: My audience certainly isn't the proverbial man in the street.
translation: 我的观众当然不是街上的平头百姓。

meaning: adj. 有利可图的；赚钱的；有益的
example: Drug manufacturing is the most profitable business in America.
translation: 制药业是美国利润最丰厚的业务。

meaning: n. 自豪；骄傲；自尊心; v. 使得意，以…自豪
example: He wrote the word "pride" in huge letters on the blackboard.
translation: 他在黑板上写了一个大大的单词pride。

meaning: n. 危险；危险物，威胁
example: Subconsciously I had known that I would not be in personal danger.
translation: 我潜意识里已经知道我不会有人身危险。

meaning: n. 阻力；电阻；抵抗；反抗；抵抗力
example: In the end the Kurds surrendered without putting up any resistance.
translation: 最后库尔德人没有作任何抵抗就投降了。

meaning: v. 怨恨；愤恨；厌恶
example: It is only natural that he should resent you.
translation: 他怨恨你是很自然的事。

meaning: adj. 熟悉的；常见的；亲近的; n. 常客；密友
example: Rose heard the familiar voice, but tuned out the words.
translation: 罗斯听到了熟悉的声音，但没注意听说的是什么。

meaning: n. 性；性别；性交; vt. 生（过去式gendered，过去分词gendered，现在分词gendering，第三人称单数genders，形容词genderless）
example: Dara challenges our stereotypical ideas about gender and femininity.
translation: 达拉对我们老一套的性别和女性特质观念提出了异议。

meaning: n. 受害人；牺牲品；牺牲者
example: The probabilities of crime or victimization are higher with some situations than with others.
translation: 在有些情况下，犯罪或受害的几率要相对更高。

meaning: n. 摘要；[管理] 履历，简历; v. 重新开始，继续；恢复，重新占用
example: They thought that he should resume his kingly duties.
translation: 他们认为他应该继续履行君主的职责。

meaning: n. 抓住；理解；控制; v. 抓住；领会
example: He let the ball slip through his grasp and into the net.
translation: 球从他的掌中滑出，钻进了球门。

meaning: adj. 邪恶的；不幸的；有害的；讨厌的; n. 罪恶，邪恶；不幸
adj. 有效的，起作用的；实际的，实在的；给人深刻印象
example: Condoms are an effective method of birth control if used with care.
translation: 如果使用得当，避孕套是很有效的避孕手段。

meaning: v. 徘徊；漫步；迷路；离题; n. (Wander)人名；(英)万德(女子教名)
example: The wanderer has to sleep rough.
translation: 这个流浪汉到处为家.

meaning: v. 提取；取出；摘录；榨取; n. 汁；摘录；榨出物；选粹
example: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
translation: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

meaning: adj. 依靠的；从属的；取决于…的; n. 依赖他人者；受赡养者
example: Matt is weak and dependent, but you love him all the same.
translation: 马特软弱无能且依赖性强，但我们照样爱他。

meaning: adj. 连贯的，一致的；明了的；清晰的；凝聚性的；互相耦合的；粘在一起的
example: He appeared hardly capable of conducting a coherent conversation.
translation: 他好像连话都说不清楚。

meaning: n. 挂钩，吊钩; v. 钩住；引上钩
example: Water and electric hook-ups are available and facilities are good.
translation: 水和电都可以接通，设施也很不错。

meaning: n. 工厂；制造厂；代理店
example: Nora was deflowered by a man who worked in a soda-water factory.
translation: 在汽水厂工作的一个男子夺去了诺拉的童贞。

meaning: v. 更喜欢；宁愿；提出；提升
example: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
translation: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

meaning: n. 指导，引导；领导
example: I went down on my knees and prayed for guidance.
translation: 我跪了下来，祈求得到指引。

meaning: prep. 关于，至于
example: Gail was silent for a moment, regarding Harry with his steady gaze.
translation: 盖尔镇定地注视着哈里，沉默了片刻。

meaning: n. 汽车（等于automobile）；自动; vi. 乘汽车
example: The Auto Compact Disc Cleaner can run off batteries or mains.
translation: 这种光盘自动清洗机可用电池或电源两种方式驱动。

meaning: n. 事故；意外；[法] 意外事件；机遇
example: Captain Cook safely navigated his ship without accident for 100 voyages.
translation: 库克船长驾驶的船安全出航100次无事故。

meaning: adj. 易受影响的；易感动的；容许…的; n. 易得病的人
example: susceptible of
translation: 容许…的，能…的

meaning: adj. 统计的；统计学的
example: statistical analysis
translation: 统计分析

meaning: n. 学生；[解剖] 瞳孔；未成年人
example: After his education, Goldschmidt became a pupil of the composer Franz Schreker.
translation: 学业结束后，戈尔德施米特成了作曲家弗朗兹·施雷克尔的学生。

meaning: adj. 强烈的；紧张的；非常的；热情的
example: I felt so self-conscious under Luke's mother's intense gaze.
translation: 在卢克母亲审视的目光下，我感到极不自在。

meaning: adj. 更好的，更可取的；更合意的
example: Anything was preferable to the tense atmosphere at home.
translation: 什么都比家里的紧张气氛好。

meaning: n. 恐慌，惊慌；大恐慌; adj. 恐慌的；没有理由的; v. 使恐慌
example: You feel an animal panic to run and hide.
translation: 你会感到一种本能的恐惧而想要去逃避。

meaning: n. 设备，装备；器材
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: adj. 凉爽的；冷静的；出色的; v. 使…冷却；使…平静下来; n. 凉爽；凉爽的空气; adv. 冷静地
example: Northbridge is a cool, calculating and clever criminal who could strike again.
translation: 诺思布里奇是个头脑冷静、诡计多端、阴险狡诈的罪犯，他可能还会犯案。

meaning: adj. 充足的；适当的；胜任的
example: adequate for
translation: 胜任……的；对……是足够的；适合……的

meaning: n. 出席；到场；出席人数；考勤
example: Police with riot gear and several fire engines are in attendance.
translation: 防暴警察和数辆消防车都到了。

meaning: n. 船，舰；[组织] 脉管，血管；容器，器皿
example: She was dressed only in a vest and underpants.
translation: 她只穿了一件汗衫和一条短裤.

meaning: v. 激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感
example: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
translation: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

meaning: v. 开发，开拓；剥削；开采; n. 勋绩；功绩
example: I even began to exploit him in subtle ways.
translation: 我甚至开始巧妙地利用他。

meaning: n. 收音机；无线电广播设备; v. 用无线电进行通信
adj. 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的; n. 远程
example: Statistically our chances of being the victims of violent crime are remote.
translation: 从统计数据来看，我们成为暴力犯罪受害者的可能性微乎其微。

meaning: n. 文学；文献；文艺；著作
example: He was well acquainted with the literature of France, Germany and Holland.
translation: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

meaning: n. 格式；版式；开本; v. 使格式化；规定…的格式
example: A new format would alienate its ageing readership without attracting young readers.
translation: 新的版式会疏远上了年纪的读者群，并且也不会吸引年轻读者。

meaning: n. 容器，接受者；容纳者; adj. 容易接受的，感受性强的
example: A suppressed immune system puts a transplant recipient at risk of other infections.
translation: 接受器官移植的病人免疫系统受到抑制后很可能会感染其他疾病。

meaning: v. 说服，劝说；使某人相信；劝某人做（不做）某事; adj. 空闲的，有闲的
example: Somehow, he'd managed to persuade Kay to buy one for him.
translation: 不知用了什么方法，他成功说服凯给他买了一个。

meaning: n. 山峰；最高点；顶点；帽舌; v. 使达到最高点；使竖起; adj. 最高的；最大值的
example: The news programme goes out four times a week at peak time.
translation: 这档新闻节目每周在黄金时段播出4次。

meaning: v. 辩论，争论，讨论; n. 辩论；辩论会
example: There needs to be a properly informed public debate.
translation: 有必要让公众在充分知情的状况下展开辩论。

meaning: n. 表现，表示，表达；表情，脸色，态度，腔调，声调；式，符号；词句，语句，措辞，说法
example: gene expression
translation: [化]基因表达；基因表现

meaning: v. 授予；判定; n. 奖品；判决
example: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
translation: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

meaning: adv. 在国外；到海外; adj. 往国外的; n. 海外；异国
example: He rented out his house while he worked abroad.
translation: 他在国外工作期间把自己的房子租了出去。

meaning: adj. 向前；在前的；领先; adv. 向前地；领先地；在（某人或某事物的）前面；预先；在将来，为未来
example: He looked straight ahead and overtook a lumbering lorry.
translation: 他眼睛直视前方，加速超过了前面一辆慢吞吞行进的大卡车。

meaning: n. 障碍物，屏障；界线; vt. 把…关入栅栏
example: I realized I had to surmount the language barrier.
translation: 我意识到我不得不克服语言障碍。

meaning: v. 竞争；奋斗；斗争；争论
example: They contend that the company failed to disclose material information.
translation: 他们坚持认为该公司并未透露实质性的信息。

meaning: n. 幸存，残存；幸存者，残存物
example: survival rate
translation: 存活率

meaning: n. 入口；进入; v. 使出神，使入迷
example: The entrance hall is littered with toys and wellington boots.
translation: 门厅里到处乱扔着玩具和雨靴。

meaning: n. 选择，挑选；选集；精选品
example: The semantic meaning of a sentence is governed by rules called selectional restrictions.
translation: 句子在语义上是否有意义是受被称为选择限制的规则支配的.

meaning: v. 出席；上（大学等）；照料；招待；陪伴
example: Representatives from across the horse industry will attend the meeting.
translation: 整个赛马业的代表都将参加这次会议。

meaning: n. 挑战；挑动; v. 敢冒；不惧
example: People always think I'm a fool, and I dare say they're right.
translation: 人们总认为我是个傻瓜，想必他们是对的。

meaning: adj. 比较的；相当的; n. 比较级；对手
example: The comparative of "pretty" is "prettier".
translation: pretty的比较级形式是prettier。

meaning: adj. 突然的，意外的；快速的; n. 突然发生的事
example: Family values are suddenly the name of the game.
translation: 家庭价值观突然变得重要起来。

meaning: v. 系；约束；打结；与…成平局; n. 领带；平局；鞋带；领结；不分胜负
example: He held out a small bag tied with string.
translation: 他拿出一个系着细绳的小袋子。

meaning: v. 警告；使警觉，使意识到; adj. 警惕的，警觉的；留心的; n. 警戒，警惕；警报
example: The armed forces were on high alert to guard against any retaliation.
translation: 武装部队保持高度戒备，以防发生任何报复行动。

meaning: n. 储备，储存；自然保护区；预备队；缄默；[金融] 储备金; v. 储备；保留；预约
v. 争辩；质疑; n. 竞赛；争夺；争论
example: The latest opinion polls are predicting a very close contest.
translation: 最近的民意测验预测竞争将会非常激烈。

meaning: v. 引发，引起；触发; n. 扳机；[电子] 触发器；制滑机
example: Pacific push against Darwin Island, where white sale ma and black triggerfish feed beneath breaking waves.
translation: 太平洋汹涌的浪涛撞击达尔文岛所产生的碎波区域正是白色鳊鱼以及黑色鳞鲀觅食的场所.

meaning: n. 先锋；拓荒者; v. 开辟；倡导；提倡

translation: 她参加争取妇女选举权的运动，也是节育倡导者。

meaning: v. 修理；修复; n. 修理，修补；修补部位

meaning: v. 治疗；对待；探讨；视为; n. 请客；款待

translation: 她说必须维护王国政府的主权。

meaning: n. 位置；狭槽；水沟；硬币投币口; v. 跟踪；开槽于

translation: 时间空档；（电视或广播电台的）播放时段

meaning: n. 环境；上下文；来龙去脉

translation: 我会将它放入上下文中进行具体解释。

meaning: n. 通行费；代价；钟声；伤亡人数; v. 征收；敲钟
example: death toll
translation: 死亡人数

meaning: n. 建议；忠告；劝告；通知

translation: 有相当一部分普通员工不理睬工会的建议。

meaning: n. 建筑学；建筑风格；建筑式样；架构

translation: 20世纪80年代初期的经济萧条气氛因各种奇异古怪建筑的出现而有所缓解。

meaning: n. 资格；条件；限制；赋予资格
example: That time with him is my qualification to write this book.
translation: 我和他曾经相处过一段时间，所以才能写出这本书。

meaning: n. 闲暇；空闲；安逸; adj. 空闲的；有闲的；业余的
example: The leisure facilities are there for the use of guests.
translation: 这些休闲设施是供客人使用的。

meaning: v. 组织；使有系统化；给予生机；组织成立工会等
example: In the end, we all decided to organize a concert for Easter.
translation: 最终，我们一致决定组织一场复活节音乐会。

meaning: v. 增补，补充; n. 增补，补充；补充物；增刊，副刊
n. 爱好者；业余爱好者；外行; adj. 业余的；外行的
example: Angela says she longs to join an amateur dramatics class.
translation: 安杰拉说她渴望参加业余戏剧班。

meaning: n. 运动员，体育家；身强力壮的人
example: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.
translation: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

meaning: adj. 庞大的，巨大的；凶暴的，极恶的
example: She was a shy, delicately pretty girl with enormous blue eyes.
translation: 她是一个害羞、娇美的女孩，长着一双大大的蓝眼睛。

meaning: v. 加强；巩固
example: strengthen environmental protection
translation: 加强环境保护

meaning: n. 英雄；男主角，男主人公
example: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
translation: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

meaning: v. 模仿，仿效；仿造，仿制
example: He could imitate in speech or writing most of those he admired.
translation: 他能模仿大多数自己崇拜的偶像的讲话和写作风格。

meaning: n. 紧握；柄；支配；握拍方式；拍柄绷带; v. 紧握；夹紧
example: How much can the President relax his grip over the nation?
translation: 总统可以对国家的控制放松到什么样的程度？

meaning: adj. 特级的；极好的; n. 特级品，特大号；临时雇员
example: We hope that these obstacles may be superable.
translation: 我们希望这些障碍是可以超越的.

meaning: v. 使摆脱；使去掉; n. (Rid)人名；(英)里德
example: The proposals are an attempt to rid the country of political corruption.
translation: 这些提议试图使这个国家摆脱政治腐败。

meaning: n. 连续；继位；继承权；[生态] 演替
example: The successional law and mechanism of aerial seeding community were studied.
translation: 本文主要探讨了飞播后植被的演替规律和演替机制.

meaning: n. 三十年代; num. 三十; adj. 三十个的
n. 详细审查；监视；细看；选票复查
example: Master, they've split up. I humbly suggest we scry on the leader.
translation: 大人, 他们分头行动了. 在下谨建议集中探知那个队长.

meaning: n. 旅行者，观光客; adj. 旅游的; vt. 在旅行参观; vi. 旅游；观光; adv. 坐旅游车厢；坐经济舱
example: tourist resources
translation: 旅游资源

meaning: adj. 难过的；悲哀的，令人悲痛的；凄惨的，阴郁的（形容颜色）
example: This condition is called seasonal affective disorder, or SAD for short.
translation: 这种病情叫做季节性情感失调症，或简称SAD。

meaning: n. 管；烟斗；笛; v. 吹笛；尖叫
example: Just pipe down and I'll tell you what I want.
translation: 别说了，我来告诉你我想要什么。

meaning: n. [环境] 噪音；响声；杂音; v. 谣传
example: Sightseers may be a little overwhelmed by the crowds and noise.
translation: 拥挤的人群和喧闹的噪音可能会让游客有些茫然不知所措。

meaning: n. 贡献；捐献；投稿
example: His contribution is immeasurable.
translation: 他居功至伟。

meaning: v. 称赞；为…喝彩，向…欢呼; n. 欢呼，喝彩；称赞
example: The film met with considerable critical and public acclaim.
translation: 该影片受到了影评人和公众的高度评价。

meaning: v. 怀孕；构思；以为；持有
example: Women, he says, should give up alcohol before they plan to conceive.
translation: 他说女性在计划怀孕之前应该戒酒。

meaning: adj. 不可能的；不可能存在的；难以忍受的；不真实的; n. 不可能；不可能的事
example: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
translation: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

meaning: n. 有权威的书

translation: 理查德叔叔吟诵了《圣经》中的一章，又即兴作了一段祈祷文。

meaning: n. 恶习；缺点；[机] 老虎钳；卖淫; prep. 代替; vt. 钳住; adj. 副的；代替的

translation: 副总统；副主席

meaning: v. 使困惑，使为难；使复杂化
example: We're dismal enough without conjuring up ghosts and visions to perplex us.
translation: 用不着招神现鬼来缠我们,我们已够惨的啦.

meaning: n. 音乐会；一致；和谐; v. 使协调；协同安排; adj. 音乐会用的；在音乐会上演出的
example: He wants to act in concert with other nations.
translation: 他想和其他国家采取一致行动。

meaning: v. 屈服；出产，产生；放弃; n. 产量；收益

translation: 高产；高收益

meaning: n. 拼写；拼字；拼法; v. 拼写；意味着（spell的ing形式）；迷住
example: He gave his name and then helpfully spelt it.
translation: 他说出自己的名字，然后又热心地将它拼了出来。

meaning: n. 范围；余地；视野；眼界；导弹射程; v. 审视
example: All were equipped with 20 - power scopes.
translation: 全都装备有二十倍的望远镜.

meaning: n. 摘要；抽象；抽象的概念; adj. 抽象的；深奥的; v. 摘要；提取；使……抽象化；转移(注意力、兴趣等)；使心不在焉
example: His painting went through both representational and abstract periods.
translation: 他的绘画经历了具象风格和抽象风格两个阶段。

meaning: v. 收获，获得；收割; n. (Reap)人名；(英)里普
example: We are not in this to reap immense financial rewards.
translation: 我们从事这一行不是为了获得巨大的经济回报。

meaning: adj. 更坏的；更差的；更恶劣的（bad的比较级）；（病情）更重的（ill的比较级）; adv. 更糟；更坏；更恶劣地；更坏地; n. 更坏的事；更恶劣的事
example: We were worried that one tiny jolt could worsen her injuries.
translation: 我们担心稍微颠簸一下就可能会使她的伤势恶化。

meaning: n. 没有；缺乏；缺席；不注意
example: There has been much gossip about the possible reasons for his absence.
translation: 关于他缺席的原因有很多传言。

meaning: adj. 幸运的；侥幸的
example: Chantal was lucky to be able to salvage her career.
translation: 尚塔尔能保住她的事业算是走了运。

meaning: v. 维护，坚持；断言；主张；声称
example: assert oneself
translation: 坚持自己的权利或意见

meaning: v. 遭遇，邂逅；遇到; n. 遭遇，偶然碰见
example: You'll have little patience with the hypocrisy and double standards you encounter.
translation: 你将会无法忍受所遭遇的伪善和双重标准。

meaning: n. [天] 地平线；视野；眼界；范围
example: She stared dreamily out of the small window at the blue horizon.
translation: 她出神地看着小窗子外面的蓝色地平线。

meaning: n. 冲进；匆促；急流；灯心草; adj. 急需的; v. 使冲；突袭；匆忙地做；飞跃
example: I hate to rush you but I have another appointment later on.
translation: 我真不想催你，但我稍后还有一个约会。

meaning: adj. 昂贵的；代价高的; n. (Costly)人名；(英)科斯特利
example: Psychometric tests can save organizations from grim and costly mistakes.
translation: 心理测试能够使组织机构避免犯下损失惨重的大错。

meaning: n. 典礼，仪式；礼节，礼仪；客套，虚礼

translation: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

meaning: n. 窗；窗口；窗户

meaning: n. 仪式；惯例；礼制; adj. 仪式的；例行的；礼节性的

translation: 我们在威斯敏斯特教堂看到的是一种经年不变的古旧仪式。

meaning: v. 力劝，催促；驱策，推进; n. 强烈的欲望，迫切要求；推动力
example: The fourth theory era divides tasks according to urgence and importance, into ABCD four grades.
translation: 第四代理论把事情按紧急和重要程序分为ABCD四类.

meaning: v. 使…转化；使…颠倒；使…反转；使…前后倒置; n. 颠倒的事物；倒置物；倒悬者; adj. 转化的
example: Place a plate over the cake tin and invert it.
translation: 在蛋糕烤模上盖一个盘子，然后将其翻倒过来。

meaning: v. 投资；覆盖；耗费；授予；包围
example: They would have to offer cast-iron guarantees to invest in long-term projects.
translation: 他们需提供绝对可靠的担保，才能投资长期项目。

meaning: adj. 明显的；看得见的；现有的；可得到的; n. 可见物；进出口贸易中的有形项目
example: Persons dying from cancer grow thin and visibly waste away.
translation: 因患癌症濒临死亡的人会日渐消瘦，而且身体明显衰弱。

meaning: n. 观点；远景；透视图; adj. 透视的

translation: 是迥然不同的观点之间的碰撞改变了人们的看法。

meaning: adj. 谨慎的；十分小心的
example: Australia, put in to bat, made a cautious start.
translation: 轮到澳大利亚队出场击球，他们开始打得很谨慎。

meaning: v. 突出；强调；使显著；加亮; n. 最精彩的部分；最重要的事情；加亮区
example: Once again, the "Free Press" prefers not to highlight these facts.
translation: “自由新闻”组织再次故意不去突出强调这些事实。

meaning: adj. 不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的
example: Car firms are desperate to achieve economies of scale.
translation: 汽车厂商拼命想要实现规模经济。

meaning: adj. 最终的；决定性的；不可更改的; n. 决赛；期末考试；当日报纸的末版
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: n. 证明；证据；校样；考验；验证；试验; adj. 防…的；不能透入的；证明用的；耐…的; v. 试验；校对；使不被穿透
example: He has had to eat his words about the company being recession-proof.
translation: 他不得不收回他说过的公司能免受经济衰退影响的话。

meaning: adj. 残酷的，残忍的；使人痛苦的，让人受难的；无情的，严酷的
example: He is still the butt of cruel jokes about his humble origins.
translation: 他仍然因出身低微而被人无情嘲笑。

meaning: n. 意识形态；思想意识；观念学
example: To add spice to the debate, they disagreed about method and ideology.
translation: 他们在方法和观念上都持不同意见，这使辩论精彩了很多。

meaning: v. 投标；出价；表示；吩咐; n. 出价；叫牌；努力争取
example: He certainly wasn't going to bid $18 billion for this company.
translation: 他肯定不会出180亿美元来收购这家公司。

meaning: n. 真空；空间；真空吸尘器; adj. 真空的；利用真空的；产生真空的; v. 用真空吸尘器清扫
example: Between bravery layer vacuumize, lens face processing prevents infra - red radiate , the stopper is hot undesirable conductor.
translation: 胆层之间抽真空,镜面处理防红外辐射, 木塞是热的不良导体.

meaning: adj. 自豪的；得意的；自负的; n. (Proud)人名；(英)普劳德
example: Derek is now the proud father of a bouncing baby girl.
translation: 德里克现在为有一个健康活泼的女宝宝而骄傲。

meaning: abbr. 卖点广告（Point of Purchase）
example: The radio had fed him a diet of pop songs.
translation: 他从广播里听到的都是千篇一律的流行歌曲。

meaning: adj. 安静的；安定的；不动的；温顺的; n. 安静；和平; v. 使平息；安慰
example: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information.
translation: 房间很安静，无人主动提供更多的信息。

meaning: adj. 慢性的；长期的；习惯性的; n. (Chronic)人名；(英)克罗尼克
example: Those who suffer from narcissism become self-absorbed or chronic show-offs.
translation: 被自恋症折磨的人会变得只专注于自己的事情，或者不断地自我炫耀。

meaning: n. 体积，容量；大多数，大部分；大块; v. 使扩大，使形成大量；使显得重要
example: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
translation: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

meaning: adj. 忙碌的；热闹的；正被占用的; v. 使忙于; n. (Busy)人名；(匈)布希；(法)比西
example: There has been a busy start to polling in today's local elections.
translation: 今天地方选举的投票一开始就人头攒动。

meaning: n. 带；腰带；地带; v. 用带子系住；用皮带抽打
example: Philippe was in uniform, wearing a pistol holster on his belt.
translation: 菲利普身着制服，腰带上别着手枪皮套。

meaning: v. 燃烧；烧毁，灼伤；激起…的愤怒; n. 灼伤，烧伤；烙印
example: The power stations burn coal from the Ruhr region.
translation: 发电站烧的煤产自鲁尔地区。

meaning: n. 姿势；态度；情形; v. 摆姿势
example: You can make your stomach look flatter instantly by improving your posture.
translation: 通过采取更好的坐姿，你的腹部马上就会看起来平坦一些。

meaning: n. 参考，参照；涉及，提及；参考书目；介绍信；证明书; v. 引用
example: Read these notes carefully and keep them for future reference.
translation: 仔细阅读这些注释并将其保留下来以备将来之用。

meaning: n. 工艺；手艺；太空船; v. 精巧地制作
example: The engine of one landing craft was still running.
translation: 一艘登陆艇的发动机还在运转。

meaning: n. 大门；出入口；门道; v. 给…装大门
example: He reached the garden gate and thrust his way through it.
translation: 他来到花园门口，挤了进去。

meaning: n. 营养，营养学；营养品
example: advice on diet and nutrition
translation: 有关饮食和增加营养的建议

meaning: v. 喘气；喘息；渴望; n. 喘气
example: I heard myself gasp and cry out.
translation: 我听到自己一边喘一边喊。

meaning: v. 联合抵制；拒绝参加; n. 联合抵制
example: Opposition leaders had called for a boycott of the vote.
translation: 反对党领袖已号召人们拒绝投票。

meaning: adj. 难以置信的，惊人的
example: It was an incredible display of motherly love and forgiveness.
translation: 那是慈母般关爱与宽容的了不起的表现。

meaning: n. 引擎，发动机；机车，火车头；工具
example: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
translation: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管抽走。

meaning: n. 情绪，语气；心境；气氛
example: He faced the press, initially, in a somewhat subdued mood.
translation: 他最初面对媒体时情绪有点忧郁。

meaning: v. 保持；雇；记住
example: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
translation: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

meaning: adv. 仅仅，勉强；几乎不；公开地；贫乏地
example: Dave pulled a back muscle and could barely kick the ball.
translation: 戴夫背部拉伤，几乎没法踢球。

meaning: n. 援助；帮助；助手；帮助者; v. 援助；帮助；有助于
example: I thought a phonetic spelling might aid in pronunciation.
translation: 我想语音拼写可能有助于发音。

meaning: adj. 每周的；周刊的；一周一次的; n. 周刊; adv. 每周一次；逐周
example: Howard : So I can never stay up past ten a weeknight now?
translation: 霍华: 所以从现在起,星期一到星期五我再也不能超过十点才睡?

meaning: adj. 正常的；正规的，标准的; n. 正常；标准；常态
example: Life has not yet returned to normal but we are getting there.
translation: 生活还没有恢复正常，不过就快了。

meaning: v. 繁荣，兴旺；茁壮成长
example: Fortune had smiled upon me to that degree , and I had thriven so much.
translation: 幸运这样照耀着我, 我弄了这么多.

meaning: n. 篮球；篮球运动
example: Shaun McCalister also played for the varsity basketball team.
translation: 肖恩·麦卡利斯特也为校篮球队效过力。

meaning: adj. 最终的；极限的；根本的; n. 终极；根本；基本原则
example: What was it ultimately that led you to leave Sarajevo for Zagreb?
translation: 最终是什么让你离开萨拉热窝前往萨格勒布的？

meaning: v. 改正；告诫; adj. 正确的；恰当的；端正的
example: "That is correct, Meg," he answered in his cold, dead voice.
translation: “没错，梅格。”他用冰冷、阴沉的声音答道。

meaning: adj. 熟练的；有技能的；需要技能的
example: Rub up the skillet please.
translation: 请把长柄锅擦亮.

meaning: n. 脾气；（钢等）回火；性情；倾向; v. 使回火；锻炼；调和；使缓和
example: Certain pigment colours were painted on to dry plaster using tempera (where egg yolk is used to fix the pigment).
translation: 使用蛋彩画颜料（内含可以定色的蛋黄）在干石膏上绘出了特定颜色。

meaning: v. 拼，拼写；意味着；招致；拼成；迷住；轮值; n. 符咒；一段时间；魅力
example: spell out
translation: 讲清楚

meaning: v. 挫败；阻挠；使感到灰心; adj. 挫败的；无益的
example: But this didn't frustrate Einstein. He was content to go as far as he could.
translation: 但这并没有使爱因斯坦灰心, 他对能够更深入地研究而感到满意.

meaning: adj. 凶猛的；猛烈的；暴躁的; n. (Fierce)人名；(英)菲尔斯
example: The area has been the scene of fierce fighting for three months.
translation: 这一地区3个月以来不断发生激战。

meaning: v. 倾斜；倾向；易于; n. 倾斜；斜面；斜坡
example: Those who fail incline to blame the world for their failure.
translation: 那些失败者往往将他们的失败归咎于社会。

meaning: n. 线，弦，细绳；一串，一行
example: a string of
translation: 一系列，一串

meaning: n. 薄片；部分；菜刀，火铲; v. 切下；把…分成部分；将…切成薄片
example: a slice of
translation: 一片，一份

meaning: n. 过道，门厅，走廊；会堂；食堂；学生宿舍；大厅，前厅；娱乐中心，会所
example: The entrance hall is littered with toys and wellington boots.
translation: 门厅里到处乱扔着玩具和雨靴。

meaning: adj. 乐观的；乐观主义的
example: Before his first round of discussions, Mr Baker sounded an optimistic note.
translation: 第一轮讨论前，贝克先生听上去还比较乐观。

meaning: n. 赞扬；称赞；荣耀；崇拜; v. 赞美，歌颂；表扬
example: The team also won praise for sportsmanship and fair play.
translation: 该队还因其良好的体育精神及公平竞争精神而受到了表扬。

meaning: n. 借口；理由; v. 原谅；为…申辩；给…免去
example: He'd telephoned with some phoney excuse she didn't believe for a minute.
translation: 他找了某个她根本不会相信的借口给她打电话。

meaning: n. 主管人员；统治者，管理者；[自] 调节器；地方长官
example: Duke was soundly defeated in this month's Louisiana governor's race.
translation: 杜克在本月的路易斯安那州长竞选中大败而归。

meaning: n. 手臂；武器；袖子；装备；部门; v. 武装起来
example: When you are sitting, keep your elbow on the arm rest.
translation: 坐立时，把胳膊肘靠在扶手上。

meaning: n. 金字塔；角锥体; v. 渐增；上涨；成金字塔状
example: There rose before us the great pyramid of Gaza.
translation: 雄伟的加沙金字塔矗立在我们面前。

meaning: n. 脚；英尺；步调；末尾; v. 步行；跳舞；总计
example: I tried to reach the foot brakes but I couldn't.
translation: 我试图去够脚刹，但是没能踩到。

meaning: n. 发射；炮弹；射手；镜头; adj. 用尽的；破旧的；杂色的，闪光的; v. 射击（shoot的过去式和过去分词）
example: shot down
translation: 击落，打垮

meaning: prep. 关于；就…而言; v. 涉及；使关心（concern的ing形式）；忧虑
example: For more information concerning the club contact I. Coldwell.
translation: 咨询俱乐部详情，请与I.科德维尔联系。

meaning: adj. 新鲜的；清新的；淡水的；无经验的; n. 开始；新生；泛滥; adv. 刚刚，才；最新地
example: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.
translation: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很重要，麦麸也是。

meaning: v. （坚定地向某地）前进；行军，进军；游行示威；进展，进行; n. 行进，前进；行军；游行示威；进行曲
example: The unevenly matched armies met at Guilford on 15 March 1781.
translation: 1781年3月15日，力量悬殊的两支队伍在吉尔福德狭路相逢。

meaning: v. 观察；注视；看守；警戒; n. 手表；监视；守护；值班人
example: Theodore Van Runkles'costumes and Faye's wonderful hair made this film fantastically watchable.
translation: 西奥多拉·范朗克尔的服装和费的美丽发型使这部电影有了极佳的观赏性.

meaning: n. 排；等级；军衔；队列; adj. 讨厌的；恶臭的；繁茂的; v. 排列；把…分等
example: Dense smoke swirled and billowed, its rank fumes choking her.
translation: 滚滚浓烟盘旋翻腾，恶臭味呛得她喘不过气来。

meaning: n. [化学] 氧气，[化学] 氧
example: Ozone is a highly reactive form of oxygen gas.
translation: 臭氧是一种非常活跃的氧气形态。

meaning: n. 信仰；信念；信任；忠实
example: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

meaning: n. 雇用，租用；租金，工钱; v. 雇用；出租
example: Child car seats only cost about £10 a week to hire.
translation: 儿童汽车坐椅一周的租金才10英镑。

meaning: n. 膨胀；阐述；扩张物
example: This revolutionary expansion required energetic nation-building policies.
translation: 这种跨越式的扩张需要有活力的国家建设政策。

meaning: n. 迷信
n. 技巧，技术；手法
example: new technique
translation: 新技术

meaning: n. 口，嘴；河口; v. 做作地说，装腔作势地说；喃喃地说出
example: A thorough brushing helps to freshen up your mouth.
translation: 彻底刷牙有助于口气清新。

meaning: v. 植树于，使成为森林; n. 森林
example: The dampness of the forest did not agree with him physically.
translation: 他的身体不能适应森林的潮湿。

meaning: v. 调节，规定；控制；校准；有系统的管理
example: The AA called for laws to regulate clamping firms.
translation: 英国汽车协会呼吁立法，规范夹车公司的行为。

meaning: adj. 有效的；有根据的；合法的；正当的
example: This discovery seems to validate the claims of popular astrology.
translation: 这个发现似乎能印证流行占星术的一些说法。

meaning: v. 忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上; n. 忽视；眺望
example: The owners don't want to overlook any opportunity to make a buck.
translation: 老板们不想错过任何可以赚钱的机会。

meaning: n. 企业家；承包人；主办者
example: The entrepreneur takes business risks in the hope of making a profit.
translation: 企业家为追求利润而冒险.

meaning: v. 借口；为辩护；托称
example: It was no defence to plead that they were only obeying orders.
translation: 辩称他们只是在服从命令站不住脚。

meaning: n. 椅子；讲座；（会议的）主席位；大学教授的职位; v. 担任（会议的）主席；使…入座；使就任要职
example: He sat penitently in his chair by the window.
translation: 他懊悔地坐在靠窗的椅子上。

meaning: n. 链；束缚；枷锁; v. 束缚；囚禁；用铁链锁住
example: The dogs continued to paw and claw frantically at the chain mesh.
translation: 那些狗继续用爪子疯狂地抓铁丝网。

meaning: adj. 痛苦的；疼痛的；令人不快的
example: Economic reform will continue to be painful and ineffective.
translation: 经济改革仍将举步维艰，毫无成效。

meaning: v. 扩大；放大；详述
example: Workmen were hired to remodel and enlarge the farm buildings.
translation: 雇用了工人来改造和扩建农场建筑。

meaning: n. 肩，肩膀；肩部; v. 肩负，承担
example: shoulder to shoulder
translation: adv. 肩并肩地；齐心协力地

meaning: adj. 试验性的，暂定的；踌躇的; n. 假设，试验
example: ASEAN has branched out tentatively into the security business.
translation: 东盟已经尝试将合作范围拓展到安全领域。

meaning: adj. 奇数的；古怪的；剩余的；临时的；零散的; n. 奇数；怪人；奇特的事物
example: He smiled, an odd, dreamy smile that sent chills up my back.
translation: 他笑了，笑容古怪迷离，叫我后背发凉。

meaning: n. 政治家；国务活动家
n. 放任；狂热; v. 遗弃；放弃
example: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
translation: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

meaning: v. 关联; n. 相关物；相关联的人; adj. 关联的
example: The political opinions of spouses correlate more closely than their heights.
translation: 配偶之间政治观点上的相似度要大于他们身高的相似程度。

meaning: v. 使…相异；使…不同; n. (Differ)人名；(法)迪费
example: That is where we differ.
translation: 那就是我俩看法不一的地方。

meaning: adv. 当然；行（用于回答）；必定
example: It is certainly worth checking up on your benefit entitlements.
translation: 查清楚你可以享受哪些福利是绝对有必要的。

meaning: adj. 沉重的；繁重的，巨大的；拥挤的；阴沉的; n. 重物；严肃角色; adv. 大量地；笨重地
example: I don't want any more of that heavy stuff.
translation: 我再也不想碰那种麻烦事了。

meaning: adj. 耐用的，持久的; n. 耐用品
example: The durable high-impact plastic case is water resistant to 100 feet.
translation: 这种结实的高强度塑料盒子在水下100英尺以内是防水的。

meaning: v. 盛行，流行；战胜，获胜
example: We must, each of us, prevail upon our congressman to act.
translation: 我们每一个人都必须说服我们各自的国会议员采取行动。

meaning: n. 野心，雄心；抱负，志向; v. 追求；有…野心
example: He is a man of extraordinary vitality, driving ambition and political nous.
translation: 他是一个精力非凡、志向远大、政治上很有见识的人。

meaning: n. 荣誉；信用；头衔; v. 尊敬（等于honour）；给…以荣誉
example: The Chinese make a point of their personal honor.
translation: 中国人特别重视个人荣誉.

meaning: v. 分离；使分离；劈开；离开；分解; n. 劈开；裂缝; adj. 劈开的
example: split up
translation: 分裂，分离

meaning: n. 指标；指数；索引；指针; v. 做索引
example: The FT 30 share index was up 16.4 points to 1,599.6.
translation: 《金融时报》30股指上涨16.4点，收于1,559.6点。

meaning: adj. 外国的；外交的；异质的；不相关的
example: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
translation: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

meaning: n. 供给，补给；供应品; v. 供给，提供；补充
example: power supply
translation: 电源；电源供应器

meaning: n. 处置；[心理] 性情；[军] 部署；倾向
example: He was a nice lad — bright and with a sunny disposition.
translation: 他是个不错的小伙子——聪明伶俐而且性格开朗。

meaning: n. 雨；下雨；雨天；雨季; v. 下雨；降雨
example: The recent rain had churned up the waterfall into a muddy whirlpool.
translation: 最近的一场雨把瀑布搅成了泥水漩涡。

meaning: v. 同意；赞成；答应; n. 同意；（意见等的）一致；赞成
example: At approxi-mately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search.
translation: 大概晚上11点半的时候，波拉德最终同意进行搜查。

meaning: n. 团结；一致；联合；个体
example: national unity
translation: 国家统一，民族团结

meaning: adj. 冷静的，清醒的；未醉的; v. 使严肃；使醒酒，使清醒; n. (Sober)人名；(英)索伯
example: sober up
translation: 清醒起来；使…清醒；使严肃起来

meaning: n. 房屋；住房供给；[机] 外壳；遮盖物；机器等的防护外壳或外罩
example: The government is taking emergency action to deal with a housing crisis.
translation: 政府正采取紧急措施解决住房危机。

meaning: n. 桌子；表格；平地层; v. 制表；搁置；嵌合; adj. 桌子的
example: They admired the tableau of the Nativity.
translation: 他们欣赏着耶稣降生的场景造型。

meaning: v. 复发；重现；采用；再来；循环；递归
example: Economic crises recur periodically.
translation: 经济危机周期性地发生.

meaning: n. 计划，规划；节目；程序; v. 编程序；制作节目
example: The programme of sell-offs has been implemented by the new chief executive.
translation: 新任总裁已经执行了抛售方案。

meaning: n. 宫殿；宅邸；豪华住宅
example: He recounted how heavily armed soldiers forced him from the presidential palace.
translation: 他讲述了自己是怎样被全副武装的士兵从总统官邸里赶出来的。

meaning: n. 小心，谨慎；警告，警示; v. 警告
example: Television broadcasters were warned to exercise caution over depicting scenes of violence.
translation: 电视台受到警告，要求对暴力场面的描绘采取谨慎态度。

meaning: adj. 稳健的，温和的；适度的，中等的；有节制的; v. 变缓和，变弱
example: Futures prices recovered from sharp early declines to end with moderate losses.
translation: 期货价格在早盘深幅下跌后出现反弹，收盘时未见严重损失。

meaning: adv. 尽管如此，但是
example: The book is too long but, nonetheless, informative and entertaining.
translation: 这本书篇幅太长，但是很有知识性和趣味性。

meaning: v. 引导，开导；形成河道; n. 通道；频道；海峡
example: The series goes out at 10.30pm, Fridays, on Channel 4.
translation: 这部连续剧每周五晚上10点30分在第4频道播出。

meaning: v. 打开；呈现
example: School discipline must be unforced strictly.
translation: 教学纪律必须整顿.

meaning: adv. 部分地；在一定程度上
example: I feel partly responsible for the problems we're in.
translation: 我觉得应为我们遭遇的问题负部分责任。

meaning: n. 重点；强调；加强语气
example: The emphasis is on developing fitness through exercises and training.
translation: 重点在于通过锻炼促进健康。

meaning: adj. 骚乱的，混乱的；狂暴的；吵闹的；激流的，湍流的
example: The relationship of Turco - German epitomize on Baghdad Railways built.
translation: 德国与奥斯曼帝国之间的交往和关系,集中表现在巴格达铁路的修筑上.

meaning: n. 补偿；报酬；赔偿金
example: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay compensation.
translation: 他被有条件地释放了，被责令支付赔偿款。

meaning: n. [经] 客户；顾客；委托人
example: Enviros Consulting has a client base of more than 2,000 organisations worldwide.
translation: EnvirosConsulting公司在全世界拥有逾2,000家组织机构的客户群。

meaning: v. 团结；重整；恢复；（网球等）连续对打; n. 集会；回复；公路赛车会
example: We were very keen when the 1954 Rally came round.
translation: 1954年的集会开始时，我们都非常热切。

meaning: n. 实验室，研究室
example: "He went back to the lab", Iris exclaimed impatiently.
translation: “他回实验室去了，”艾里斯不耐烦地大声说。

meaning: adj. 微弱的，无力的；虚弱的；薄弱的
example: He gave a feeble shrug and tried to squirm free.
translation: 他无力地耸耸肩，扭动身体想要挣脱。

meaning: n. 外貌，外观；出现，露面
example: Marilyn made her last public appearance at Madison Square Garden.
translation: 玛丽莲最后一次公开亮相是在麦迪逊广场花园。

meaning: v. 宣布；述说；预示；播报
example: She was planning to announce her engagement to Peter.
translation: 她正计划宣布她和彼得订婚一事。

meaning: adj. 清洁的，干净的；清白的; v. 使干净; adv. 完全地; n. 打扫
example: They were more concerned about the dogs' welfare than a clean getaway.
translation: 他们更加关心那些狗的安危，而非自己如何干净利落地脱身。

meaning: v. 由…组成；在于；符合
example: The division will consist of two tank companies and one infantry company.
translation: 这个师的组成部队将包括两个坦克连和一个步兵连。

meaning: v. 谴责；判刑，定罪；声讨
example: Bankers are quick to condemn retrospective tax legislation.
translation: 银行家们立即声讨有追溯效力的税收立法。

meaning: v. 渴望；立志；追求
example: For us, it's something that we may aspire to but can never attain.
translation: 对我们来说, 那是可望而不可即的.

meaning: adj. 明显的；明白的
example: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
translation: 通货膨胀的危险在证券价格上已经表现得很明显。

meaning: n. 星期日；礼拜日
example: I wanted to spend Sundays holed up together in our flat.
translation: 我希望可以一起窝在我们的公寓里度过每个周日。

meaning: n. 装配，装置；试穿，试衣; adj. 适合的，适宜的；相称的
example: By his international achievements he leaves a fitting monument to his beliefs.
translation: 他在国际上的成就为其信念作出了最好的注解。

meaning: v. 遵守；顺从，遵从；答应
example: Some beaches had failed to comply with European directives on bathing water.
translation: 有些海滩未能遵守欧洲有关浴场的指令。

meaning: v. 致使；提出；实施；着色；以…回报; n. 打底；交纳；粉刷
example: The Board had been slow to render its verdict.
translation: 董事会迟迟未能作出决定。

meaning: n. 百分比；百分率，百分数
example: The percentage of girls in engineering has increased substantially.
translation: 学工科的女孩的比例已经大大增加了。

meaning: n. 存在，实在；生存，生活；存在物，实在物
example: He had been a rock in the shifting sands of her existence.
translation: 他一直是她曲折坎坷的生活中的主心骨。

meaning: adj. 参与的；有关系的; n. 参与者；关系者
example: A youthful teacher, he finds himself an unwilling participant in school politics.
translation: 作为一名年轻教师，他发现自己并不情愿地参与到了学校的权力争斗中。

meaning: n. 限制；限度；极限；追诉时效；有效期限；缺陷
example: This drug has one important limitation. Its effects only last six hours.
translation: 这种药有一个严重缺陷：它的药力只能持续6个小时。

meaning: v. 诱捕；使…受限制；使…陷入困境; n. 陷阱；圈套；[建] 存水湾
example: on trap
translation: 可得的；随时可用的

meaning: n. 马厩；牛棚; adj. 稳定的；牢固的；坚定的; v. 被关在马厩
example: stable quality
translation: 质量稳定

meaning: n. 目的；用途；意志; v. 决心；企图；打算
example: Most of them are destroyed because they've served their purpose.
translation: 它们中大多数在完成使命后被销毁。

meaning: n. 联营；撞球；水塘；共同资金; v. 联营，合伙经营
example: She was standing by a pool, about to dive in.
translation: 她站在水池旁边，正要往里跳。

meaning: n. 参议员；（古罗马的）元老院议员；评议员，理事
example: He has senatorial experience in defence and foreign policy.
translation: 他在参议院期间有过国防和外交政策方面的经验。

meaning: n. 医院
example: You are welcome to visit the hospital at any time.
translation: 你可以随时来医院。

meaning: n. 休息室；闲逛；躺椅；（英）酒吧间; v. 闲逛；懒洋洋地躺卧；闲混
example: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
translation: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

meaning: adj. 数值的；数字的；用数字表示的（等于numeric）
example: This consolidation meant having to reduce the numerical strength of the Army.
translation: 这次合并意味着不得不削减陆军的兵力。

meaning: v. 评价；估价；求…的值
example: Our research attempts to evaluate the effectiveness of the different drugs.
translation: 我们的研究试图对不同药物的疗效进行评估。

meaning: n. 时尚；时装；样式；时髦人物; v. 使用；改变；做成…的形状
example: Many of the clothes come from the world's top fashion houses.
translation: 这些服装中有很多出自世界顶级时装设计公司。

meaning: v. 认识到，明白
example: Various textile techniques will be explored to realise design possibilities.
translation: 将尝试和探索纺织技巧来把这些设计变为现实。

meaning: n. 结婚；婚姻生活；密切结合，合并
example: After a three-weekend courtship, Pamela accepted Randolph's proposal of marriage.
translation: 经过3个周末的追求之后，帕梅拉接受了伦道夫的求婚。

meaning: n. 信用，信誉；[金融] 贷款；学分；信任；声望; v. 相信，信任；把…归给，归功于；赞颂
example: Make a note of credit card numbers and check expiry dates.
translation: 记下信用卡卡号，核对有效期限。

meaning: n. 过渡；转变；[分子生物] 转换；变调
example: We are still in the transitional stage between the old and new methods.
translation: 我们仍然处于新旧方法的过渡阶段。

meaning: n. 灾难，灾祸；不幸
example: An airliner came close to disaster while approaching Heathrow Airport.
translation: 一架大型客机在飞近希思罗机场时差点儿发生空难。

meaning: n. 背面；相反；倒退；失败; v. 颠倒；倒转; adj. 反面的；颠倒的；反身的
example: Amis tells the story in reverse, from the moment the man dies.
translation: 埃米斯以倒叙的方式讲述了这个故事，从这个男人死去的时候开始讲起。

meaning: v. 开始（调查）；制定；创立；提起（诉讼）; n. 学会，协会；学院
example: The Institute of Export now fears that 100,000 jobs will go.
translation: 现在出口协会担心将失去10万个工作机会。

meaning: v. 确认；确定；证实；批准；使巩固
example: His new role could confirm him as one of our leading actors.
translation: 他的新角色会确保他跻身我们的一流演员之列。

meaning: n. 界限，边界;约束；限制; v. 限制；禁闭
example: Doctors confine themselves to prescribing rather than dispensing.
translation: 医生仅仅是开药而不配药。

meaning: n. 框架；结构；[电影] 画面; v. 设计；建造；陷害；使…适合; adj. 有木架的；有构架的
example: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
translation: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

meaning: n. 分；一分的硬币；森特（等于半音程的百分之一）
example: By 1973 the government deficit equalled thirty per cent of GNP.
translation: 到1973年，政府财政赤字相当于国民生产总值的30%。

meaning: n. 肌肉；力量; v. 加强；使劲搬动；使劲挤出
example: Eisenhower used his muscle to persuade Congress to change the law.
translation: 艾森豪威尔用他的影响力说服国会修改了该项法律。

meaning: adj. 成熟的；充分考虑的；到期的；成年人的; v. 成熟；到期
example: These plants are then pollinated and allowed to mature and produce seed.
translation: 然后，这些植物就被授粉，从而成熟结籽。

meaning: n. [医] 医师；内科医师
example: I'm a practicing physician trying to help people here and now.
translation: 我是一名此时此刻只想治病救人的执业医师。

meaning: n. 身份；同一性，一致；特性；恒等式
example: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
translation: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

meaning: v. 使吃惊
example: Neil's ability to utter banalities never ceased to amaze me.
translation: 每次我都很惊讶，尼尔怎么能讲出这么索然无味的东西。

meaning: n. 减少；下降；缩小；还原反应
example: The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction.
translation: 公司在降低成本方面付出了艰苦卓绝的努力。

meaning: n. 鲨鱼；骗子; v. 诈骗
example: shark fin
translation: 鱼翅，鲨鱼鳍

meaning: adj. 大量的；巨大的，厚重的；魁伟的
example: Combined with other compounds, they created a massive dynamite-type bomb.
translation: 将其与其他化合物结合，就制造出杀伤力极强的硝酸甘油炸弹。

meaning: adj. 稳定的；不变的；沉着的; v. 稳固; adv. 稳定地；稳固地; n. 关系固定的情侣；固定支架
example: The steak was tough and the peas were like bullets.
translation: 牛排老得嚼不动，豌豆像子弹一样硬。

meaning: n. 读写能力；精通文学
example: Of course, literacy isn't the same thing as intelligence.
translation: 当然，识字和智力是两码事。

meaning: n. 无知，愚昧；不知，不懂
example: Ignorance of people brings fear, fear of the unknown.
translation: 人们的无知会带来恐惧，对未知事物的恐惧。

meaning: adj. 无形的，看不见的；无形的；不显眼的，暗藏的
example: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel.
translation: 一名办事员会感到如此受人忽视，令人觉得不可思议。

meaning: n. 顾问；咨询者；会诊医生
example: Shirley's brother is now a consultant heart surgeon in Sweden.
translation: 雪利的兄弟现在在瑞典做心脏外科高级顾问医师。

meaning: v. 延缓，推迟；使暂停；使悬浮
example: The reason and mechanism of the suspender damage are generalized.
translation: 总结了吊杆破损的表现、原因和机理.

meaning: n. 婴儿；幼儿；未成年人; adj. 婴儿的；幼稚的；初期的；未成年的
example: The United States ranks 20th in its infant mortality rate.
translation: 美国在婴儿死亡率方面排名第20。

meaning: n. 颌；下巴；狭窄入口；唠叨; v. 教训；唠叨
example: His jaw was broken after he was hit on the head.
translation: 他的头部受重击之后下颌骨折了。

meaning: n. 纵队，列；专栏；圆柱，柱形物
example: She also writes a regular column for the Times Educational Supplement.
translation: 她也定期为《泰晤士报高等教育增刊》写专栏文章。

meaning: v. 推论，推断；演绎出
example: Can we deduce from your silence that you do not approve?
translation: 你保持沉默，我们是否可以据此而推断出你不赞成？

meaning: v. 得到燃料; n. 燃料；刺激因素
example: His comments are bound to add fuel to the debate.
translation: 他的话必将为争论推波助澜。

meaning: adj. 可疑的；怀疑的；多疑的
example: The tan-coloured dog looks suspiciously like an American pit bull terrier.
translation: 这只棕黄色的狗看上去非常像美国比特犬.

meaning: v. 体现，使具体化；具体表达; n. (Embody)人名；(英)恩博迪
example: Any incomes policy must embody the attributes of fairness and flexibility.
translation: 任何收入政策都应该具有公平与灵活性之特征.

meaning: n. 汉堡包，火腿汉堡；牛肉饼，肉饼；碎牛肉
example: Avoid unhealthy foods such as hamburger and chips.
translation: 不要吃不健康食品，如汉堡和薯条。

meaning: v. 从事，着手；上船或飞机
example: The fears have prompted several countries to embark on massive armament plans.
translation: 几个国家开始实施大规模的军备计划，以防患于未然。

meaning: n. 公路，马路；道路；手段; vt. （狗）沿臭迹追逐（猎物）; adj. （美）巡回的
