example: on the road
translation: 在旅途中；到处奔走

meaning: v. 慢跑；轻推；蹒跚行进；使颠簸; n. 慢跑；轻推，轻撞
example: They set off at a jog up one street and down another.
translation: 他们开始沿着一条又一条的街道慢跑。

meaning: n. 缺点；短处
example: Fame can be a shortcut to love and money.
translation: 有了名气就容易收获爱情和金钱。

meaning: v. 分析；分解；细察
example: Data mining is used to analyse individuals' buying habits.
translation: 数据采掘被用来分析个体的购买习惯。

meaning: n. （美）电话；电话机；电话耳机; v. 打电话
example: Accessibility also applies to things like WAP, handheld devices, and telephonic devices.
translation: 其实可操作性也可以应用在WAP 、 手持设备以及电话设备中.

meaning: n. 卡路里（热量单位）
example: Nutritionists say only 33% of our calorie intake should be from fat.
translation: 营养学家说我们所摄入的卡路里中只应有33％来自脂肪。

meaning: adj. 有毒的；恶毒的；讨厌的
example: Poisonous smoke had got into the water supply.
translation: 毒烟已经进入供水系统。

meaning: adj. 徒劳的；自负的；无结果的；无用的
example: She is a vainglorious woman.
translation: 她是个爱虚荣的女性.

meaning: n. 干扰，冲突；干涉
example: The parliament described the decree as interference in the republic's internal affairs.
translation: 议会形容此法令为对共和国内政的干涉。

meaning: adj. 暴力的；猛烈的
example: violent crime
translation: 暴力犯罪，暴力罪行

meaning: n. 仪器；工具；乐器；手段；器械
example: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
translation: 一种叫做套管针的工具在腹壁上刺了一个孔。

meaning: n. 临床；诊所
example: Charles was at the clinic recovering from an operation on his arm.
translation: 查尔斯的胳膊动了手术，正在这家诊所进行康复治疗。

meaning: n. 庇护；避难所；遮盖物; v. 保护；使掩蔽
example: The shelterbelt kept the sand in check.
translation: 防护林带挡住了风沙.

meaning: v. 特许；包租；发给特许执照; n. 宪章；执照；特许状
example: They described the Home Office scheme as a "charter for cheats"
translation: 他们称内政部的方案是“对诈骗的纵容”。

meaning: adj. 共和国的；共和政体的；共和主义的；拥护共和政体的; n. 共和主义者
example: Amy's own Republican sympathies strengthened as the days passed.
translation: 埃米个人对共和党的支持与日俱增。

meaning: n. 最小值；最低限度；最小化；最小量; adj. 最小的；最低的
example: Many of Britain's beaches fail to meet minimum standards of cleanliness.
translation: 英国许多海滩连最起码的卫生标准都达不倒。

meaning: adj. 绝对的；完全的；专制的; n. 绝对；绝对事物
example: The industry minister described the affair as "an absolute scandal".
translation: 工业部长将此事件形容为“绝对的丑闻”。

meaning: adj. 微不足道的，可以忽略的
example: The company says the cost of relocation will be negligible.
translation: 公司称搬迁的费用可以忽略不计。

meaning: n. 紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻; adj. 紧急的；备用的
example: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

meaning: adj. 好奇的，有求知欲的；古怪的；爱挑剔的
example: The interior was shielded from the curious gaze of passersby.
translation: 屋子内部被挡住了，以防路人好奇地张望。

meaning: n. （纳税品等的）申报；宣布；公告；申诉书
example: On the customs declaration, the sender labeled the freight as agricultural machinery.
translation: 在报关单上，寄货人将货物列为农用机械。

meaning: n. 火花；朝气；闪光; v. 发动；鼓舞；求婚
example: spark plug
translation: n. 火花塞；带头人；中坚分子

meaning: v. 投，抛；计算；浇铸；投射（光、影、视线等）; n. 投掷，抛；铸件，[古生] 铸型；演员阵容；脱落物
example: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
translation: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

meaning: n. 现款，现金; v. 将…兑现；支付现款
example: All the bills had the same serial number. The cash was counterfeit.
translation: 所有钞票的序列号都是一样的。这些钱是伪钞。

meaning: v. 翻阅；以拇指拨弄；作搭车手势；笨拙地摆弄; n. 拇指
example: rule of thumb
translation: 经验法则

meaning: n. 衣服，服装；外表，外观; v. 给…穿衣服
example: She stood up and began to disrobe, folding each garment neatly.
translation: 她站起来开始脱衣服，并把每件衣服叠整齐。

meaning: adv. 确实地，毋庸置疑的
n. 力量；力气；兵力；长处
example: His visit is intended to strengthen ties between the two countries.
translation: 他此次访问旨在增进两国间的关系。

meaning: n. 混淆，混乱；困惑
example: His mind was a haze of fear and confusion.
translation: 由于害怕和困惑，他当时处于一种混沌状态。

meaning: v. 浸透，使湿透；使饱和，使充满; adj. 浸透的，饱和的；深颜色的
example: As the domestic market becomes saturated, firms begin to export the product.
translation: 由于国内市场饱和，各公司开始外销。

meaning: adj. 视觉的，视力的；栩栩如生的
example: The most specific visualisation method is the localization of particular enzymes within an acrylamide gel.
translation: 最特异的显色方法是对丙烯酰胺凝胶中特殊的酶进行定位.

meaning: n. 溪流；流动；潮流；光线; v. 流；涌进；飘扬
example: main stream
translation: 干流；主干流

meaning: adj. 向后的；反向的；发展迟缓的; adv. 向后地；相反地
example: The car passed over the body twice, once backward and then forward.
translation: 那辆车把那人来回轧了两次，先是倒着轧的，再是往前开着轧的。

meaning: n. 装配；集会，集合
example: Several proposals are under consideration by the state assembly.
translation: 有几个提案州议会正在讨论中。

meaning: v. 决定；溶解；使…分解；决心要做…; n. 坚决；决定要做的事
example: This merely strengthens our resolve to win the league.
translation: 这只会更加坚定我们赢得联赛的决心。

meaning: n. 坐标；同等的人或物; adj. 并列的；同等的; v. 调整；整合
example: They appointed a new manager to coordinate the work of the team.
translation: 为协调这个队的工作，他们任用了一位新经理。

meaning: v. 提醒；使想起
example: remind of
translation: 提醒；使记起；使回想起

meaning: n. (女士)手提袋；(国家、家庭、团体等的) 财力; v. （嘴巴）皱起，使缩拢；撅嘴
example: She looked at me and then reached in her purse for cigarettes.
translation: 她看看我，接着伸手去包里拿香烟。

meaning: n. 蛋糕；块状物；利益总额; v. 使结块
example: Serve the cake warm or at room temperature, cut in squares.
translation: 等蛋糕温热或凉至室温时切成四方块端上桌。

meaning: n. 听力；审讯，听讯; v. 听见（hear的ing形式）
example: He will now face a disciplinary hearing for having an affair.
translation: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。

meaning: v. 使溶解；使分解；使液化; n. 叠化画面；画面的溶暗
example: Kaifu threatened to dissolve the Parliament and call an election.
translation: 卡夫威胁要解散议会并举行选举。

meaning: adj. 静的，平静的；沉着的; v. 使平静；使镇定; n. 风平浪静
example: Officials hoped admitting fewer foreigners would calm the situation.
translation: 官员们希望通过减少外国人入境的数量来使局势平定下来。

meaning: n. 平等；相等；[数] 等式
example: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
translation: 迄今为止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

meaning: n. 刺眼；耀眼的光；受公众注目; v. 瞪眼表示
example: Norma is said to dislike the glare of publicity.
translation: 据说诺尔玛不喜欢被人过多关注。

meaning: v. 使丧失，剥夺
example: This law will deprive us of our most basic rights.
translation: 这条法律将剥夺我们最基本的权利.

meaning: v. 冒烟；发怒; n. 烟；愤怒，烦恼
example: The pump exhaust should lead to the open air or a fume hood.
translation: 抽气泵的排气管应该导向室外空旷处或导向一座通风橱.

meaning: n. 前言；引语; v. 为…加序言；以…开始
example: He has written a fine preface to the play.
translation: 他为这个剧本写了一篇精彩的序言.

meaning: n. 大会；[法] 惯例；[计] 约定；[法] 协定；习俗
example: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

meaning: v. 高飞；高耸；往上飞舞; n. 高飞；高涨
n. 小船；轮船; v. 划船
example: Driving a boat is not the same as driving a car.
translation: 驾船和开车不是一回事。

meaning: n. 运河；[地理] 水道；[建] 管道；灌溉水渠; v. 在…开凿运河
example: The rough rock walls were like the sides of a deep canal.
translation: 凸凹不平的石墙就像一条很深的运河的河岸。

meaning: adj. 有义务的；必定的；受约束的；装有封面的; v. 束缚；使跳跃; n. 范围；跳跃
example: They are bound to take time to readjust after a holiday.
translation: 他们肯定需要时间重新适应假期结束后的生活。

meaning: n. 版本
v. 飞驰，飞快地移动；迅速增加; n. 火箭
example: A Delta II rocket was launched from Cape Canaveral early this morning.
translation: 今天一早，一枚“德尔塔”Ⅱ型火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。

meaning: adj. 快速的，敏捷的; n. 舰队；港湾；小河; v. 飞逝；疾驰；掠过
example: A fleet of ambulances took the injured to hospital.
translation: 一队救护车把伤者送往医院。

meaning: adj. 口头的，口述的; n. 口试
example: The story of King Arthur became part of oral tradition.
translation: 亚瑟王的故事成为口头传说的一部分。

meaning: n. 模仿，仿造；仿制品; adj. 人造的，仿制的
example: He gave his imitation of Queen Elizabeth's royal wave.
translation: 他模仿伊丽莎白女王挥手致意。

meaning: n. 步行，走；散步; v. 散步；走过
example: They settled in a walkable area a pleasantly busy town center.
translation: 他们令人愉悦的繁忙的镇中心一个易于步行的区域安了家.

meaning: n. 便利；厕所；便利的事物
example: Like working women anywhere, Asian women are buying convenience foods.
translation: 像其他地方的职业女性一样，亚洲女性也购买方便食品。

meaning: n. [数] 精确度，准确性
example: She took the gun and blazed away with calm and deadly accuracy.
translation: 她拿起枪，冷静地连续射击，弹无虚发。

meaning: v. 指导；通知；命令；教授
example: We should instruct the passengers what customs regulations are.
translation: 我们应该向乘客说明海关规则是什么.

meaning: n. 童年时期；幼年时代
example: His parents' obsession with keeping up appearances haunted his childhood.
translation: 父母过于爱面子的做法在他儿时一直困扰着他。

meaning: v. 使文明；教化；使开化
example: We must civilize away the boy's bad habit.
translation: 我们必须教育这孩子使其改掉恶习.

meaning: v. 尊敬；认为；考虑；估价; n. 尊重；尊敬
example: It was so humiliating, a terrible blow to my self-esteem.
translation: 这件事如此丢脸，深深地挫伤了我的自尊心。

meaning: adj. 勤勉的；用功的，费尽心血的; n. (Diligent)人名；(法)迪利让
example: He was careful and diligent. I was all over the place.
translation: 他细心且勤奋，我则稀里糊涂。

meaning: n. 接待；接收；招待会；感受；反应
example: Mr Mandela was given a tumultuous reception in Washington.
translation: 曼德拉先生在华盛顿受到热情的款待。

meaning: v. 组成，构成；建立；任命
example: Volunteers constitute more than 95% of The Center's work force.
translation: 该中心95%以上的工作人员是志愿者.

meaning: n. 邀请；引诱；请帖；邀请函
example: "I can't pass this up." She waved the invitation.
translation: “我不能错过这个机会，”她挥舞着请帖说。

meaning: v. 钻孔; n. 孔；令人讨厌的人
example: Our tour prices bore little resemblance to those in the holiday brochures.
translation: 我们的旅游报价和那些度假手册里的价格相去甚远。

meaning: adj. 本质的，固有的
example: intrinsic value
translation: 内在规定

meaning: n. 剩余；[贸易] 顺差；盈余；过剩; adj. 剩余的；过剩的
example: Say what you have to say with no surplusage.
translation: 讲你必须讲的话,别多嗦.

meaning: n. 混合；混合物；混合剂
example: Liquidize the mixture and then pass it through a sieve.
translation: 将混合物打成泥状，然后用滤网滤一下。

meaning: v. 授予；给予; n. (Confer)人名；(英)康弗
example: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.
translation: 他想与他的同事先商议一下再作出决定。

meaning: adj. 值得的；有价值的；配得上的，相称的；可尊敬的；应…的; n. 杰出人物；知名人士
example: worthy of
translation: 值得，配得上

meaning: n. 开业者，从业者，执业医生
example: She was a medical practitioner before she entered politics.
translation: 从政前她是个开业医生.

meaning: adj. 经验主义的，完全根据经验的；实证的
example: The empirical evidence considered here is subject to many qualifications.
translation: 此处提及的实验证据有诸多限制条件。

meaning: n. 工程，工程学; v. 设计；管理（engineer的ing形式）；建造
example: Traditionally young Asians in Britain have gravitated towards medicine, law and engineering.
translation: 英国的亚裔年轻人通常被吸引到医学、法律及工程专业。

meaning: adj. 文盲的；不识字的；没受教育的; n. 文盲
example: A small but significant number of 11-year-olds are illiterate.
translation: 数量不多但仍有相当一部分11岁孩子是文盲。

meaning: adj. 丰富的；充裕的；盛产
example: Birds are abundant in the tall vegetation.
translation: 高大的植被中有着大量的鸟类。

meaning: v. 扭曲；使失真；曲解
example: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
translation: 画家可能会对线条和形状进行夸大或扭曲。

meaning: n. 私语；谣传；飒飒的声音; v. 耳语；密谈；飒飒地响
example: in a whisper
translation: 低声地，悄声地

meaning: n. 打字机
example: Shorthand and typewriting have been described as the twin arts.
translation: 速记和打字被说成是一对孪生技巧.

meaning: n. 纪念碑，纪念馆；纪念仪式；纪念物; adj. 记忆的；纪念的，追悼的
example: The Memorial seems almost ugly, dominating the landscape for miles around.
translation: 那座纪念碑耸立在方圆数英里景致之中显得近乎难看。

meaning: n. 病房；保卫；监视; v. 避开；保卫；守护
example: A new warden took over the prison.
translation: 一位新的监狱长接管了这所监狱。

meaning: n. 肉；肉体; v. 喂肉给…；使发胖
example: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.
translation: 我正要执行一项让我心惊肉跳的秘密任务。

meaning: v. 剽窃；偷偷地做；偷窃; n. 偷窃；便宜货；偷垒；断球
example: James did not push her into stealing the money.
translation: 詹姆斯没有怂恿她去偷钱。

meaning: v. 使震惊；打昏；给以深刻的印象; n. 昏迷；打昏；惊倒；令人惊叹的事物
v. 仔细考虑；衡量; n. (Ponder)人名；(英)庞德
example: The visitor can ponder over the boomerangs used by aborigines at the time of Cook.
translation: 来访者可以琢磨琢磨土著人在库克时期用的回飞镖.

meaning: v. 控告，指控；谴责；归咎于
example: I hate it when people accuse us of that.
translation: 我讨厌别人就那件事指责我们。

meaning: n. 运动员；运动家；冒险家
v. 引导；踢；解雇；使穿靴; n. 靴子；踢；汽车行李箱
example: As we drew near, I saw that the boot lid was up.
translation: 我们靠近时,我看见汽车行李箱的盖子翘了起来.

meaning: adj. 陡峭的；不合理的；夸大的；急剧升降的; v. 泡；浸；使…充满; n. 峭壁；浸渍
example: Then the effect is to steepen the flanks of the pulse spectrum.
translation: 因此在效果上是加大了脉冲谱翼部的陡度.

meaning: adj. 手工的；体力的; n. 手册，指南
example: Too often he only absorbs half the information in the manual.
translation: 他对于说明书上所说的经常是一知半解。

meaning: v. 控制，引导；驾驶; n. 阉牛
example: The ship went with easy steerage.
translation: 这条船容易操舵.

meaning: n. 铅笔；笔状物; v. 用铅笔写；用眉笔涂
example: He picked up a pencil and toyed with it idly.
translation: 他捡起一支铅笔，无所事事地摆弄着。

meaning: n. [数][计] 序列；顺序；续发事件; v. 按顺序排好
example: They are only available when playing a MIDI file by external sequencer!
translation: 他们只用时由外部音序演奏MIDI文件!

meaning: v. 播送，播放；（无线电或电视）广播；播撒（种子）; n. 广播；播音；广播节目; adj. 广播的
example: More cash will be saved by shutting studios and selling outside-broadcast vehicles.
translation: 通过关闭演播室和出售实况转播车将节省更多资金。

meaning: adv. 在飞机上；[船] 在船上；在火车上; prep. 在…上
example: Joseph watched a shady-looking bunch playing cards aboard a Mississippi steamer.
translation: 约瑟夫看到一群可疑的人在密西西比河的一艘轮船上打牌。

meaning: n. 完善；完美
example: Like the old trouper he is, he timed his entry to perfection.
translation: 作为一名老戏骨，他上场的时间把握得恰到好处。

meaning: n. 飞行员；领航员; adj. 试点的; v. 驾驶；领航；试用
example: The minutes towards departure ticked by, until finally the pilot arrived.
translation: 离出发的时间越来越近，最后飞行员终于到了。

meaning: n. 包，包裹；套装软件，[计] 程序包; adj. 一揽子的; v. 打包；将…包装
example: Investors can apply for a package of shares at a set price.
translation: 投资者可以申购固定价格的股票组合。

meaning: n. 画廊；走廊；旁听席；地道; vt. 在…修建走廊；在…挖地道; vi. 挖地道
example: Laura landed a plum job with a smart art gallery.
translation: 劳拉在一家时尚画廊找到了份美差。

meaning: n. 财政，财政学；金融; v. 负担经费，供给…经费
example: The finance minister will continue to mastermind Poland's economic reform.
translation: 财政部长将继续策划波兰的经济改革。

meaning: adj. 致命的；重大的；毁灭性的；命中注定的; n. (Fatal)人名；(葡、芬)法塔尔
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: adv. 顺便；偶然地；附带地
example: "I didn'task you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
translation: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么过来？”

meaning: n. 晚餐，晚宴；宴会；正餐
example: Guess what? I'm going to dinner at Mrs. Combley's tonight.
translation: 你猜怎么着？今晚我要去康伯利夫人家里赴宴。

meaning: n. 东方；东风；东方国家; adj. 东方的；向东的；从东方来的; adv. 向东方，在东方
example: Big credits were given to East Germany by successive West German governments.
translation: 历届西德政府给予东德大量的贷款。

meaning: v. 使充实；使肥沃；使富足; n. (Enrich)人名；(西)恩里奇
example: People with disabilities are now doing many things to enrich their lives.
translation: 残疾人士如今做很多事情来丰富他们的生活。

meaning: adj. 精密的；美好的；细微的；和蔼的; n. (Nice)人名；(英)尼斯
example: "Ah, Captain Fox," Martin McGuinness said affably. "Nice to see you again."
translation: “啊，福克斯上尉，”马丁·麦吉尼斯亲切地说，“很高兴再次见到您。”

meaning: v. 打瞌睡；假寐; n. 瞌睡
example: In one room, young mothers weave while babies doze in their laps.
translation: 在一间屋子里，年轻的母亲们在织布，而她们的孩子就在她们膝上打盹。

meaning: n. 血，血液；血统; v. 从…抽血；使先取得经验
example: He wiped away the blood with a paper napkin.
translation: 他用纸巾将血迹擦去。

meaning: adj. 流行的；时髦的；上流社会的
example: It's fashionable but wearable, and it's easy to look after.
translation: 它既时尚又耐穿，而且容易打理。

meaning: n. 盗窃；偷；赃物
example: This underground vault is theftproof.
translation: 这所地下保管库是防盗的.

meaning: adj. 灭绝的，绝种的；熄灭的; vt. 使熄灭
example: Herbalism had become an all but extinct skill in the Western world.
translation: 草药医术在西方已经成了一门几乎绝迹的技艺。

meaning: v. 延长；拖延
example: A long drawn out war would likely deepen and prolong the recession.
translation: 一场旷日持久的战争很可能会使衰退程度加剧，时间延长。

meaning: n. 形成；构造；编队
example: They saw a squadron of fifteen motorcycle policemen driving in V-formation.
translation: 他们看见15名警察骑着摩托车排成V字形前行。

meaning: v. 分散；使散开；传播; adj. 分散的
example: Police fired shots and used teargas to disperse the demonstrators.
translation: 警方鸣枪并使用催泪弹来驱散示威者。

meaning: v. 开始，创始；发起；使初步了解; n. 开始；新加入者，接受初步知识者; adj. 新加入的；接受初步知识的
example: Chen was an initiate of a Chinese spiritual discipline.
translation: 陈是某个中国神学领域的新入门者。

meaning: n. 阴影；影子；幽灵；庇护；隐蔽处; v. 遮蔽；使朦胧；尾随；预示; adj. 影子内阁的
example: in the shadow of
translation: 在…附近

meaning: n. 膝上型轻便电脑，笔记本电脑
example: She used to work at her laptop until four in the morning.
translation: 她从前经常用手提电脑一直工作到凌晨4点。

meaning: n. 块；街区；大厦；障碍物; v. 阻止；阻塞；限制；封盖; adj. 成批的，大块的；交通堵塞的
example: A block up the street I found a parking lot.
translation: 沿着街道往北过了一个街区，我找到了一个停车场。

meaning: v. 删除
example: We will be pleased to delete the charge from the original invoice.
translation: 我们决定将这笔费用从原始发票上删去。

meaning: n. 秘密，谜；神秘，神秘的事物；推理小说，推理剧；常作 mysteries 秘技，秘诀
example: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
translation: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

meaning: v. 掩饰；假装；隐瞒; n. 伪装；假装；用作伪装的东西
example: The British team did not disguise their delight at their success.
translation: 英国队毫不掩饰他们获胜的喜悦。

meaning: n. 七月
example: In July 1957, we were married in New York.
translation: 我们于1957年7月在纽约举行了婚礼。

meaning: n. 摇摆；摆动；秋千；音律；涨落; v. 摇摆；转向；悬挂；大摇大摆地行走; adj. 旋转的；悬挂的；强节奏爵士音乐的
example: in full swing
translation: 活跃；正在全力进行中

meaning: n. 企业；事业；进取心；事业心
example: He favoured a middle course between free enterprise and state intervention.
translation: 他更倾向于在自由经营与国家干预之间走一条中庸之道。

meaning: v. 剥夺；剥去；脱去衣服; n. 带；条状；脱衣舞
example: strip of
translation: 剥夺

meaning: n. 六月；琼（女名）
example: June always rhymes with moon in old love songs.
translation: 在老情歌中June总是和moon成韵。

meaning: adj. 难懂的，复杂的
example: Though off-puttingly complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
translation: 虽然地税在细节上复杂得要命，但在本质上却很简单。

meaning: adj. 有秩序的；整齐的；值班的; n. 勤务兵；传令兵；护理员; adv. 顺序地；依次地
example: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
translation: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

meaning: n. 接纳；赞同；容忍
example: Acceptance of women preachers varies greatly from denomination to denomination.
translation: 在接受女性传教士的问题上，不同教派的态度大相径庭。

meaning: n. 祖母；女祖先; vt. 当…的祖母; vi. 当祖母
example: She looks disconcertingly like a familiar aunt or grandmother.
translation: 令人疑惑的是，她看上去就像一位面熟的邻家阿姨或是祖母。

meaning: n. 塔；高楼；堡垒; v. 高耸；超越
example: I saw her in a towering rage only once.
translation: 我只有一次见过她大发雷霆。

meaning: n. [生物] 器官；机构；风琴；管风琴；嗓音
example: The patient'simmune system would reject the transplanted organ as a foreign object.
translation: 病人的免疫系统会对移植器官产生异质排斥反应。

meaning: n. 河，江
example: The river widens considerably as it begins to turn east.
translation: 河流转向东流时河道大幅度变宽。

meaning: adj. 自大的，傲慢的
example: He is spoiled, arrogant and has a tendency towards snobbery.
translation: 他被宠坏了，傲慢无礼，而且经常自命不凡。

meaning: v. 认为，视作；相信; n. (Deem)人名；(英)迪姆
example: I deem it advisable to purchase the shares in the railway now.
translation: 我认为现在购买铁路股票是明智的.

meaning: n. 深处；深渊; adj. 深的；低沉的；深奥的; adv. 深入地；深深地；迟
example: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
translation: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

meaning: adj. 有利的；良好的；赞成的，赞许的；讨人喜欢的
v. 治理；套；驾驭；披上甲胄；利用; n. 马具；甲胄；挽具状带子；降落伞背带；日常工作
example: He was almost strangled by his parachute harness straps.
translation: 他差点被自己的降落伞吊带勒死。

meaning: n. 乳房，胸部；胸怀；心情; v. 以胸对着；与…搏斗
example: The president beat his breast and called that deal a mistake.
translation: 总裁捶胸顿足，称那是个错误的交易。

meaning: adj. 卓越的；极好的；杰出的
example: The regions are interconnected by an excellent highway system.
translation: 那些地区通过完善的公路系统相互连接。

meaning: adj. （男子）英俊的；可观的；大方的，慷慨的；健美而端庄的
example: The opposition won a handsome victory in the election.
translation: 反对党在竞选中以高票获胜。

meaning: n. 钱包，皮夹
n. 码头；船坞；被告席；尾巴的骨肉部分; v. 使靠码头；剪短
example: The truck left the loading dock with hoses still attached.
translation: 卡车驶离装货月台时塑料水龙带还连在上面。

meaning: n. 尊严；高贵
example: It's an affront to human dignity to keep someone alive like this.
translation: 如此维持一个人的生命是对人类尊严的冒犯。

meaning: n. 建议；示意；微量，细微的迹象
example: Emily turned and threw her a suggestive grin.
translation: 埃米莉转过头，冲她意味深长地一笑。

meaning: n. 治疗，疗法
example: Xishuangbanna, the Lahu Theravada Buddhist faith.
translation: 西双版纳的拉祜族信仰小乘佛教.

meaning: v. 实施，执行；强迫，强制
example: Game wardens were appointed to enforce hunting laws in New Hampshire.
translation: 狩猎监督官被派到新罕布什尔州去执行狩猎法令。

meaning: v. 压抑；使沮丧；使萧条
example: The rainy days always depress me.
translation: 雨天总是使我沮丧.

meaning: n. 抑制，克制；约束
example: The old sense of deference and restraint in royal reporting has vanished.
translation: 在对皇室进行的新闻报道中，那种由来已久的尊重和收敛意识已经消失了。

meaning: v. 取样；尝试；抽样检查; n. 样品；样本；例子; adj. 试样的，样品的；作为例子的
example: These figures were often spuriously computed by selecting particularly favorable sample groups.
translation: 这些数字往往是用错误的方法计算出来的，所用的都是特别挑选出来的对自己有利的样本组。

meaning: n. 螃蟹；蟹肉；脾气乖戾的人；起重机; v. 抱怨；破坏；使偏航
example: Although it is tasty, crab is very filling.
translation: 螃蟹虽然好吃，却容易让人感到饱足。

meaning: n. 特权；优待; v. 给与…特权；特免
example: Pironi was the son of privilege and wealth, and it showed.
translation: 皮罗尼出身于有钱有势的豪门，这看得出来。

meaning: n. 厄运；死亡；判决；世界末日; v. 注定；判决；使失败
example: Why are people so full of gloom and doom?
translation: 为什么人们如此沮丧悲观？

meaning: n. 学费；讲授
example: tuition fee
translation: 学费

meaning: n. 悬崖；绝壁
example: A pall of oily black smoke drifted over the cliff-top.
translation: 一团油腻的黑色烟雾飘到悬崖顶上。

meaning: v. 忍受，容忍；停留；遵守
example: She couldn't abide his success.
translation: 她见不得他成功。

meaning: n. 杰作；绝无仅有的人
example: The whole thing was a masterpiece of crowd management.
translation: 整件事情就是人群管理的典范。

meaning: v. 按某路线发送; n. 路线；航线；通道
example: The route that the boatmen choose varies according to the water level.
translation: 船夫选择的路线会随水位的变化而有所不同。

meaning: n. 识别；承认，认出；重视；赞誉；公认
example: But by the year 2020 business computing will have changed beyond recognition.
translation: 但是到了2020年，商业计算会变得面目全非。

meaning: adj. 杰出的；有名的；明显的
example: eminent domain
translation: [律]土地征用权；国家最高支配权

meaning: n. 一瞥；一滑；闪光; v. 扫视，匆匆一看；反光；瞥闪，瞥见
example: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
translation: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

meaning: v. 忍耐；容忍
example: Then something seemed to snap in me. I couldn't endure any more.
translation: 这时候，我的心里像有个东西突然绷断了——我再也忍受不了啦。

meaning: n. 洞察力；洞悉
example: He got his first insight into how inhumane employers can be.
translation: 他对雇主的冷酷无情第一次有了深刻认识。

meaning: n. 大陆，洲，陆地; adj. 自制的，克制的
example: Its shops are among the most stylish on the Continent.
translation: 其店铺跻身欧陆最时尚的店铺之列。

meaning: v. 藐视；公然反抗；挑衅；使落空; n. 挑战；对抗
example: Her criteria defy analysis.
translation: 她的标准让人搞不明白。

meaning: n. 地点；斑点; v. 认出；弄脏；用灯光照射; adj. 现场的；现货买卖的; adv. 准确地；恰好
example: Each morning cleaners make sure everything is spotless.
translation: 每天早晨，清洁工们会把一切都打扫得干干净净。

meaning: n. 膝盖，膝; v. 用膝盖碰
example: A stiff knee following surgery forced her to walk with a limp.
translation: 手术后她的膝盖活动不便，走路时被迫跛行。

meaning: v. 坚持，墨守；紧贴；附着
example: The birds cling to the wall and nibble at the brickwork.
translation: 鸟儿们紧贴在墙上，啄着砖缝。

meaning: v. 单足跳跃〔跳行〕; n. 蹦跳,跳跃；跳舞；一次飞行的距离
example: The group's debut album was immediately acclaimed a hip hop classic.
translation: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

meaning: v. 爬；攀登；上升; n. 爬；攀登
example: In an embarrassing climb-down, the Home Secretary lifted the deportation threat.
translation: 内务大臣尴尬地作出让步，解除了将其驱逐出境的威胁。

meaning: v. 表示，指示
example: We often denote danger by red letters.
translation: 我们常常用红字表示危险.

meaning: n. 论述；谈话；演讲; v. 演说；谈论；讲述
example: Gates responds with a lengthy discourse on deployment strategy.
translation: 盖茨以一篇有关部署策略的鸿篇大论予以回应。

meaning: v. 促进；帮助；使容易
example: The new trade agreement should facilitate more rapid economic growth.
translation: 新贸易协定应当会加快经济发展。

meaning: adj. 合理的，公道的；通情达理的
example: They will need a reasonable amount of desk area and good light.
translation: 他们将需要一个面积较大的摆放办公桌的地方和充足的照明。

meaning: abbr. 电视（television）
example: Methods: The preoperative and postoperative nursing materials of 180 cases undertaken TVP were analyzed retrospectively.
translation: 方法对180例TVP患者手术前后的护理资料进行回顾性分析.

meaning: n. 报信者，送信者；先驱
example: The messenger bent and scratched at his knee where the strapping chafed.
translation: 送信人弯下腰来，挠着膝部被绑腿磨红的地方。

meaning: v. 表示；意味；预示
example: Iago . I am very glad to see you, signior Welcome to Cyprus.
translation: 伊阿古 我很高兴看见您, 大人;欢迎您到塞浦路斯来!

meaning: n. 手掌；棕榈树；掌状物; v. 将…藏于掌中
example: He cupped her chin in the palm of his hand.
translation: 他用手心托着她的下巴。

meaning: n. 生日，诞辰；诞生的日子
example: I might buy one for a friend's birthday as a giggle.
translation: 我可能会买一件送给朋友当生日礼物，逗他开心。

meaning: n. 自由；许可；冒失
example: He firmly believes liberty is inseparable from social justice.
translation: 他坚信自由与社会正义是不可分的。

meaning: v. 喘息；渴望；气喘吁吁地说出某事; n. 气喘；喘息；喷气声
example: You pant ( for breath ) after running hard for a time.
translation: 拼命跑一阵后便会觉得气短.

meaning: adj. 永久的；不断的；四季开花的；无期限的
example: Little by little she lost the taut, strained air of perpetual anxiety.
translation: 长期焦虑带来的紧张而疲惫的神色从她脸上慢慢消失了。

meaning: n. 熟人；相识；了解；知道
example: Hammer's business pedigree almost gua-ranteed him the acquaintance of U.S. presidents.
translation: 哈默的商业背景几乎保证了他能够结识美国总统。

meaning: adj. 精力充沛的；积极的；有力的
example: We look for applicants who are numerate, computer-literate and energetic self-starters.
translation: 我们对求职者的要求是具备运算能力，熟练使用电脑，精力充沛而且工作积极主动。

meaning: v. 澄清；阐明
example: The aim of this initial meeting is to clarify the issues.
translation: 本次初步会议的目标是澄清这些问题。

meaning: n. 散文；试图；随笔; v. 尝试；对…做试验
example: essay test
translation: n. 申论方式测验

meaning: v. 熄灭；压制；偿清
example: Firefighters tried to extinguish the flames.
translation: 消防队员奋力救火。

meaning: n. 观点，看法；视角
example: A fast and accurate picking algorithm based on viewport space is presented.
translation: 提出一种基于视口空间的快速精确的拾取算法.

meaning: n. 一对，一双，一副; v. 把…组成一对
example: On the mantelpiece are a pair of bronze Ming vases.
translation: 壁炉台上是一对明代的青铜花瓶。

meaning: adj. 活着的；活泼的；有生气的
example: It's an affront to human dignity to keep someone alive like this.
translation: 如此维持一个人的生命是对人类尊严的冒犯。

meaning: n. 拒绝；优先取舍权；推却；取舍权
example: They cited Alex's refusal to return to the marital home.
translation: 他们引证了亚历克斯拒绝回到婚后的家中一事。

meaning: n. 考虑；原因；关心；报酬
example: Several proposals are under consideration by the state assembly.
translation: 有几个提案州议会正在讨论中。

meaning: v. 推动，增加；对…施加压力，逼迫；按；说服; n. 推，决心；大规模攻势；矢志的追求
example: I saw her push the boulder down on you.
translation: 我看见她将巨石推下砸向你。

meaning: n. 全部节目；计算机指令系统；（美）某人或机器的全部技能
example: Meredith D'Ambrosio has thousands of songs in her repertoire.
translation: 梅雷迪思·丹布罗西奥会唱几千首歌曲。

meaning: adj. 紧急的；急迫的
example: Candidates are urgently sought for the post of Conservative party chairman.
translation: 保守党主席的职位急寻候选人。

meaning: n. 动机；刺激; adj. 激励的；刺激的
example: You get a big salary incentive and free board and lodging too.
translation: 你们能获得大笔激励性薪水，还可享受免费膳宿。

meaning: n. 宴会，盛宴；宴请，款待; v. 宴请，设宴款待
example: Last night he attended a state banquet at Buckingham Palace.
translation: 昨晚他出席了在白金汉宫举行的国宴。

meaning: adj. 生动的；鲜明的；鲜艳的
example: I can vividly remember the feeling of panic.
translation: 我能清楚地记起那种恐慌感。

meaning: adj. 悲观的，厌世的；悲观主义的
example: Hardy has often been criticised for an excessively pessimistic view of life.
translation: 哈代由于对生活持过度悲观的态度而常常受到批评。

meaning: n. 运气；幸运；带来好运的东西; v. 靠运气，走运；凑巧碰上
example: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
translation: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

meaning: v. 借；借用；从其他语言中引入; n. (Borrow)人名；(英)博罗
example: Most people here cannot borrow from banks because they lack collateral.
translation: 由于拿不出东西作为抵押，这里大部分人无法从银行贷款。

meaning: v. 使着迷，使神魂颠倒
example: I believed devoutly in her power to fascinate him, in her dazzling loveliness.
translation: 我由衷地相信她有使他神魂颠倒的力量, 相信她有令人眼花缭乱的姿色.

meaning: n. 外科医生
example: plastic surgeon
translation: 整形外科医生

meaning: n. 里面；内部；内情；内脏; adj. 里面的；内部的；秘密的; adv. 在里面; prep. 少于；在…之内
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: n. 记者
example: She was a TV reporter and worked long hours.
translation: 她是个电视台记者，总是工作到很晚。

meaning: adj. 机械的；力学的；呆板的；无意识的；手工操作的
example: The company undertakes mechanical work on all types of cars.
translation: 该公司承接各类汽车的修理工作。

meaning: adj. 强大的；可怕的；令人敬畏的；艰难的
example: They possess a formidable arsenal of rifles, machine guns, landmines and teargas.
translation: 他们持有的步枪、机枪、地雷和催泪弹数量惊人。

meaning: n. 线索；（故事等的）情节; v. 为…提供线索；为…提供情况
example: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
translation: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

meaning: n. 撤退；休息寓所；撤退; v. 撤退；退避；向后倾
example: In June 1942, the British 8th Army was in full retreat.
translation: 1942年6月,英国第八军全面撤退.

meaning: n. 冲压机；打洞器；钻孔机; v. 开洞；以拳重击
example: W. Somerset Maugham's novel still packs an emotional punch.
translation: 威廉·萨默塞特·毛姆的小说仍具有强烈的情感冲击力。

meaning: v. 命令；口述；使听写; n. 命令；指示
example: He cannot be allowed to dictate what can and cannot be inspected.
translation: 什么能检查什么不能检查不能由他说了算。

meaning: v. 给…穿衣; n. 连衣裙；女装
example: Does this dress make my legs look too stumpy?
translation: 这条裙子会使我的腿看上去又短又粗吗？

meaning: n. （美）分；便士
example: The directors of this company feel he's worth every penny.
translation: 这家公司的主管们觉得他值得栽培。

meaning: adj. 单调的，无抑扬顿挫的；无变化的
example: Closures and job losses are again being announced with monotonous regularity.
translation: 倒闭和失业的消息又在一次次地反复宣布着。

meaning: adj. 相关的；切题的；中肯的；有重大关系的；有意义的，目的明确的
example: We are trying to make politics more relevant to younger people.
translation: 我们试图使政治活动更加贴近年轻人。

meaning: adj. 寂寞的；偏僻的; n. 孤独者
example: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
translation: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

meaning: n. 奢侈，奢华；奢侈品；享受; adj. 奢侈的
example: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
translation: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

meaning: adj. 焦虑的；担忧的；渴望的；急切的
example: I believe he is most painfully anxious about Diana.
translation: 我相信他肯定非常担心黛安娜。

meaning: n. 夏娃； 前夕；傍晚；重大事件关头
example: Richard had turned up on Christmas Eve with Tony.
translation: 理查德和托尼在圣诞夜一道露面了。

meaning: n. 组织；纸巾；薄纱；一套; v. 饰以薄纱；用化妆纸揩去
example: Refractive index is the essential parameter of tissular optical characteristics.
translation: 光在生物组织中的传输行为与组织的光学特性有关.

meaning: n. 可能性，可能
example: He faces growing unease among the Democrats about the likelihood of war.
translation: 他面临民主党内对可能出现的战事不断滋长的不满情绪。

meaning: v. 预见；预知
example: We do not foresee any problems.
translation: 我们预料不会出任何问题。

meaning: v. 使迷惑，使不知所措
example: Again and again passages in his essays exasperate or bewilder.
translation: 他的文章里使人忿然或困惑的章节屡见不鲜.

meaning: v. 粘合；似胶般固着于; n. 胶；各种胶合物
example: Stick them on using a small amount of glue.
translation: 用少许胶水把它们贴上。

meaning: adv. 反复地；再三地；屡次地
example: A list of items is repeatedly flashed up on the screen.
translation: 一个选项列表反复出现在屏幕上。

meaning: n. 斗蓬；宽大外衣；托词; v. 遮掩；隐匿
example: She was released from prison in a cloak and dagger operation yesterday.
translation: 在昨天的一次秘密行动中她从监狱获释。

meaning: n. 时代；年代；纪元
example: As the era wore on, she switched her attention to films.
translation: 随着这个时代慢慢过去，她把目光投向了电影业。

meaning: adj. 感谢的；令人愉快的，宜人的
example: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
translation: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

meaning: adj. 多重的；多样的；许多的; n. 倍数；[电] 并联
example: He gave the cause of death as multiple injuries.
translation: 他说多处受伤导致了死亡。

meaning: v. 乘；使增加；使繁殖；使相乘; adv. 多样地；复合地; adj. 多层的；多样的
example: Take the time in seconds, square it, and multiply by 5.12.
translation: 记下用了多少秒时间，将其平方，再乘以5.12。

meaning: adj. 典型的，有代表性的；代议制的; n. 代表；典型；众议员
example: Professor Baker is unacquainted with the idea of representative democracy.
translation: 贝克教授并不熟悉“代议制民主”这一思想。

meaning: n. 渡船；摆渡；渡口; v. （乘渡船）渡过；用渡船运送；空运
example: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years.
translation: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。

meaning: n. 旅馆；门房；集会处；山林小屋; v. 提出；寄存；借住；嵌入
example: Authorities requisitioned hotel rooms to lodge more than 3,000 stranded Christmas vacationers.
translation: 当局征用旅馆房间安顿了3,000多名无处落脚的圣诞度假者。

meaning: adj. 固体的；可靠的；立体的；结实的；一致的; n. 固体；立方体
example: The paper studies the alkaline cooking properties of Solidago analysis.
translation: 对加拿大一枝黄花碱法蒸煮性能进行了研究.

meaning: n. 满意，满足；赔偿；乐事；赎罪
example: Their motives have never been satisfactorily explained.
translation: 他们的动机一直未得到令人满意的解释。

meaning: adv. 容易地；乐意地；无困难地
example: The document is expressed in terms that are readily understood and agreed.
translation: 文件用语浅显易懂，让人易于接受。

meaning: n. 观察；监视；观察报告
example: The diaries are a mixture of confession, work in progress and observation.
translation: 这些日记里既有自白，也有当下工作记录，还有见闻评论。

meaning: n. 面具；口罩；掩饰; v. 掩饰；戴面具；化装
example: But as with other charitable bodies, these figures mask the true picture.
translation: 但和其他慈善机构一样，这些数字掩盖了实情。

meaning: v. 跳跃；跳绳；遗漏；跳读; n. 跳跃；跳读
example: The details of both LEAF and SKIPJACK are classified , and publicly available.
translation: LEAF和SKIPJACK的细节是保密的, 公众能使用.

meaning: adv. （美）目前；不久
example: "Just take it easy," David said. "You'll feel better presently."
translation: “放松点，”戴维说，“你很快就会觉得更舒服些。”

meaning: n. 属性；特质; v. 归属；把…归于
example: People were beginning to attribute superhuman qualities to him.
translation: 人们开始觉得他超人一等。

meaning: adj. 青春期的；未成熟的; n. 青少年
example: Adolescent suicide is rarely an impulsive reaction to immediate distress.
translation: 青少年自杀很少是由于突然发生不幸而作出的冲动反应。

meaning: n. 视力；美景；眼力；幻象；想象力；幻视（漫威漫画旗下超级英雄）; vt. 想象；显现；梦见
example: Forget your visional goals. You should realize your current situation.
translation: 放弃你不切实际的目标吧. 你应该认识到你现在的情况.

meaning: adj. 紧张的；拉紧的; v. 变得紧张；使拉紧; n. 时态
example: The word tensegrity is a contraction of tensile and integrity , firstly conceived by Fuller.
translation: Tensegrity一词是tensile和integrity两词的缩写, 首先由美国人Fuller提出.

meaning: v. 娱乐；消遣；使发笑；使愉快
example: Their antics never fail to amuse.
translation: 他们滑稽的举止总是让人发笑。

meaning: n. 蛋白质；朊; adj. 蛋白质的
example: Too much protein in the diet may advance the ageing process.
translation: 饮食中摄入过量蛋白质可能会加速衰老。

meaning: adj. 普通的；平凡的；平常的; n. 普通；平常的人（或事）
example: It was just an ordinary voice, but he sang in tune.
translation: 他声音很一般，但唱得都在调子上。

meaning: n. 桩，棍子；赌注；火刑；奖金; v. 资助，支持；系…于桩上；把…押下打赌
example: New stakeholder pensions will aim to give all workers a retirement pension they can live on.
translation: 新存托养老金计划的目标是为所有工作者提供可以赖以为生的退休养老金。

meaning: n. [数] 除法；部门；分配；分割；师（军队）；赛区
example: Villa had just been relegated from the First Division.
translation: 维拉队刚刚从甲级联赛中降级。

meaning: v. 容纳；使适应；供应；调解
example: He has never put an arm around his wife to accommodate photographers.
translation: 他从未为了迎合摄影师而搂住妻子。

meaning: n. 沼泽；湿地; v. 使陷于沼泽；使沉没；使陷入困境
example: But a good chunk of it is swampland.
translation: 但州内大部分地区却是沼泽地.

meaning: v. 沾污；败坏；给…着色; n. 污点；瑕疵；着色剂
example: stain resistance
translation: 抗着色污染；防沾污性

meaning: adj. 富有的；充分的；丰裕的; n. 富人
example: It can be extremely difficult to wean children off junk food.
translation: 让儿童改掉吃零食的习惯有时十分困难.

meaning: adj. 重大的；严肃的；黯淡的; n. 墓穴，坟墓；死亡; v. 雕刻；铭记
example: Universities are facing grave problems because of diminishing resources.
translation: 由于资源的减少，大学正面临严峻的问题。

meaning: n. 反射；沉思；映象
example: On reflection, he says, he very much regrets the comments.
translation: 经过反省，他说自己对所作的评论感到非常后悔。

meaning: n. 智慧；才智；智力; v. <古>知道；即
example: They say she died after a witch cast a spell on her.
translation: 他们说她是被一个女巫施了魔法后死的。

meaning: n. 碎片；片断或不完整部分; v. 使成碎片
example: This was only a fragment of a long conversation with John.
translation: 这仅仅是与约翰长谈的一个片断.

meaning: n. 使命，任务；代表团；布道; vt. 派遣；向……传教
example: Their mission is simply to scout out places where helicopters can land.
translation: 他们的任务只是找到能够让直升机着陆的地方。

meaning: v. 利用；欺骗；施加影响
example: I didn't want to impose myself on my married friends.
translation: 我不想打扰自己已婚的朋友。

meaning: n. 屏，幕；屏风; v. 筛；拍摄；放映；掩蔽
example: TV firms were later banned from screening any pictures of the demo.
translation: 后来各电视台被禁止播放任何有关这次游行的画面。

meaning: adj. 主要的；最好的；基本的; adv. 极好地; n. 初期；青年；精华；全盛时期; v. 使准备好；填装
example: The Prime Minister has been briefed by her parliamentary aides.
translation: 首相已听取了她议会助手的简要汇报。

meaning: v. 低估；看轻; n. 低估
n. 住宅，住处；居住
example: They had entered the country and had applied for permanent residence.
translation: 他们已经入境该国，并申请了永久居留权。

meaning: v. 制造；伪造；装配
example: They plan to fabricate a cinema next year.
translation: 他们计划明年建造一座电影院.

meaning: n. 位置（形容词locational）；地点；外景拍摄场地
example: The first duty of a director is to recce his location.
translation: 主管的第一项任务是熟悉所在地区的情况。

meaning: v. 旋转；循环出现；反复考虑; n. 旋转；循环；旋转舞台
example: Mars takes longer to revolve on its axis than the earth.
translation: 火星自转一周的时间比地球长。

meaning: n. 制造；产品；制造业; v. 制造；加工；捏造
example: They manufacture the class of plastics known as thermoplastic materials.
translation: 他们生产这类被称为热塑材料的塑料制品。

meaning: n. 灰尘；尘埃；尘土; v. 撒；拂去灰尘
example: Lights reflected off dust-covered walls creating a ghostly luminescence.
translation: 灯光照在满是灰尘的墙上，反射回苍白的冷光。

meaning: n. 陆军，军队
example: Mobutu ascended through the ranks, eventually becoming commander of the army.
translation: 蒙博托出身行伍，通过一级级晋升，最终成为了陆军司令。

meaning: v. 剪裁；使合适; n. 裁缝
n. 回顾，追溯; v. 回顾，追溯；回想
example: The debate seems, in retrospect, to have been fixed from the beginning.
translation: 回想起来，这场辩论好像从一开始就被人操纵了。

meaning: n. 本能，直觉；天性; adj. 充满着的
example: His instinct would be to seek a new accommodation with the nationalists.
translation: 他本能的反应会是寻求与民族主义者取得新的和解。

meaning: n. 附近；街坊；接近；街区
example: It is a neighborhood beset by all the usual inner-city problems.
translation: 这是个为各种内城常见问题所困扰的社区。

meaning: n. 版权，著作权; adj. 版权的；受版权保护的; v. 保护版权；为…取得版权
example: She threatened legal action against the Sun for breach of copyright.
translation: 她威胁说要对《太阳报》侵犯其著作权的行为采取法律措施。

meaning: v. 抛弃；放弃；丢弃; n. 抛弃；被丢弃的东西或人
example: Einstein had the chutzpah to discard common sense and long-established theory.
translation: 爱因斯坦敢于抛弃常识和长期公认的理论。

meaning: n. 皮，皮子；毛皮；软毛; v. 用毛皮覆盖；使穿毛皮服装
example: We were amused to see how assiduously the animal groomed its fur.
translation: 看着这只动物如此认真地梳理自己的毛，我们被逗乐了。

meaning: n. 头发；毛发；些微; vt. 除去…的毛发; vi. 生长毛发；形成毛状纤维; adj. 毛发的；护理毛发的；用毛发制成的
example: She walked forward and embraced him and stroked his tousled white hair.
translation: 她走上前拥抱他并轻抚他凌乱的白发。

meaning: n. 爆炸；爆发；激增
example: A violent explosion seemed to jolt the whole ground.
translation: 剧烈的爆炸好像要把整个地面都掀起来。

meaning: n. 怒，愤怒；忿怒; v. 使发怒，激怒；恼火
example: in anger
translation: 生气地，愤怒地

meaning: adj. 哑的，无说话能力的；不说话的，无声音的
example: The questions were set up to make her look dumb.
translation: 问题这么设计，就是为了让她出丑。

meaning: n. 地理；地形
example: Why are Geography, Drama, Art and English in the ascendant?
translation: 为什么地理、戏剧、艺术和英语逐渐受宠？

meaning: n. （塑料或金属的）夹子；回纹针；修剪；剪报; v. 剪；剪掉；缩短；给…剪毛（或发）用别针别在某物上，用夹子夹在某物上
example: They moved out from the airport at a brisk clip.
translation: 他们迅速撤离机场。

meaning: adj. 不可缺少的；绝对必要的；责无旁贷的; n. 不可缺少之物；必不可少的人
example: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.
translation: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

meaning: n. 巢，窝；安乐窝；温床; v. 筑巢；嵌套
example: As soon as the two chicks hatch, they leave the nest burrow.
translation: 两只小鸟一出壳就离开了巢穴。

meaning: n. 粮食；颗粒；[作物] 谷物；纹理; v. 成谷粒
example: The firemen unwrapped their hoses and began dousing the scorched grain silos.
translation: 消防员展开水龙带，开始冲着烧焦的谷仓喷水。

meaning: adj. 有罪的；内疚的
example: Striker Alan Smith was guilty of two glaring misses.
translation: 前锋艾伦·史密斯两次严重失误，将球射偏。

meaning: v. 编译；编制；编辑；[图情] 汇编
example: The book took 10 years to compile.
translation: 编这本书花了10年时间。

meaning: n. 访问者，参观者；视察者；候鸟
example: frequent visitor
translation: 常客；熟客

meaning: n. 雾；烟雾，尘雾；迷惑; v. 使模糊；使困惑；以雾笼罩
example: His mind was in a fog when he finally got up.
translation: 他终于起床了，头脑一片混沌。

meaning: n. 云；阴云；云状物；一大群；黑斑; v. 使混乱；以云遮敝；使忧郁；玷污
example: The powdery dust rose in a cloud around him.
translation: 一团粉尘在他周围扬起。

meaning: n. 块，块状；肿块；瘤；很多；笨人; v. 混在一起；使成块状；忍耐；笨重地移动; adj. 成团的；总共的; adv. 很；非常
example: They used to buy ten kilos of beef in one lump.
translation: 他们过去常买10公斤重的整块牛肉。

meaning: n. 方言，土话；同源语；行话；个人用语特征; adj. 方言的
example: In the fifties, many Italians spoke only local dialect.
translation: 在20世纪50年代，许多意大利人只会说当地方言。

meaning: v. 限制；约束；限定
example: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills.
translation: 村民们说这个围栏将限制公众进入山区。

meaning: n. 胡椒；辣椒；胡椒粉; v. 加胡椒粉于；使布满
example: Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of cayenne.
translation: 调以盐、胡椒和少许辣椒粉。

meaning: n. 电影；薄膜；胶卷；轻烟; v. 在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影
example: The criticisms will not stop people flocking to see the film.
translation: 批评的声音不会阻止人们涌到影院观看这部电影。

meaning: n. 樱桃；樱桃树；如樱桃的鲜红色；处女膜，处女
example: The cherry blossom came out early in Washington this year.
translation: 今年华盛顿的樱花开得很早。

meaning: adj. 外面的，外部的；远离中心的; n. 环外命中
example: There is room for infill between the new outer suburbs.
translation: 在新建的远郊住宅区之间还有空地可以盖房。

meaning: n. 裤子
example: He put on a pair of short pants and an undershirt.
translation: 他穿上了一条短裤和一件汗衫。

meaning: v. 使漂浮；实行; n. 彩车，花车；漂流物；浮舟；浮萍
example: A fresh egg will sink and an old egg will float.
translation: 新鲜鸡蛋会沉下去而不新鲜的会浮在上面。

meaning: n. 游行；阅兵；炫耀；行进；阅兵场; v. 游行；炫耀；列队行进
example: Morning parade was in progress on the parade ground.
translation: 阅兵场正在进行早间检阅。

meaning: n. 口袋；钱；容器; v. 隐藏；忍受；将…放入衣袋; adj. 小型的，袖珍的；金钱上的
example: He spends most of his pocket money on PlayStation games.
translation: 他大部分零花钱都用来买PS游戏了。

meaning: n. [地理][水文] 冰碛；放钱的抽屉；备用现金; prep. 直到; conj. 直到为止; v. 耕种；犁
adj. 高雅的，优雅的；讲究的；简炼的；简洁的
example: She produces elegant wedding gowns in a variety of sumptuous fabrics.
translation: 她用各种华贵的布料制作高雅的婚纱。

meaning: adj. 胜任的；有能力的；能干的；足够的
example: I had always considered myself a strong, competent woman.
translation: 一直以来，我始终认为自己是个女强人。

meaning: v. 控制；筑坝; n. [水利] 水坝；障碍
example: Breaking the dam could submerge downstream cities such as Wuhan.
translation: 摧毁大坝可能会淹没下游城市，比如武汉。

meaning: v. 恶化，变坏
example: The position of the have-nots in our society could deteriorate even further.
translation: 穷人的社会地位可能会进一步恶化。

meaning: v. 上煤；加煤; n. 煤；煤块；木炭
example: The fossil fuels (coal and oil) are finite resources.
translation: 化石燃料（如煤和石油）属于有限资源。

meaning: n. 抱怨；诉苦；疾病；委屈
example: Eczema is a common skin complaint which often runs in families.
translation: 湿疹是一种常见的皮肤病，通常具遗传性。

meaning: n. 照片
example: The popular papers all have photo features on their inside pages.
translation: 通俗报纸的内页都有照片专栏.

meaning: v. 使适应；确定方向；使朝东; n. 东方；东方诸国; adj. 东方的
example: The climbers stopped to orient themselves before descending the mountain.
translation: 登山者先停下来确定所在的位置,然后再下山.

meaning: v. 结合；装订；有约束力；过紧; n. 捆绑；困境；讨厌的事情；植物的藤蔓
example: It is expensive to buy and a bind to carry home.
translation: 买这个费用很贵，搬回家也费劲。

meaning: v. 使麻木；毁坏
example: Buddhism had to adapt to the new world or perish.
translation: 佛教必须适应新时代，否则将会消亡。

meaning: v. 更新；使……恢复；使……清新；消除……的疲劳
example: They had stopped by a spring to refresh themselves.
translation: 他们曾在一处泉边停歇休息。

meaning: n. 保证，誓言；抵押；抵押品，典当物; v. 保证，许诺；用……抵押；举杯祝……健康
example: His tax-cutting pledge brought a delirious crowd to their feet.
translation: 他减税的承诺让亢奋的人群欢呼雀跃起来。

meaning: n. 可能性；机率；[数] 或然率
example: Formal talks are still said to be a possibility, not a probability.
translation: 据称正式会谈仍有可能，但可能性不大。

meaning: adj. 原始的，远古的；简单的，粗糙的; n. 原始人
example: Duffy's primitive guitar playing is well below par.
translation: 达菲粗糙的吉他演奏技巧远不够水平。

meaning: n. 洞，孔；洞穴，穴；突破口; v. 凿洞，穿孔；（高尔夫球等）进洞
example: He admitted that the government was in "a dreadful hole".
translation: 他承认政府目前“处境极为尴尬”。

meaning: adj. 和平的，爱好和平的；平静的
example: Altogether, it was a delightful town garden, peaceful and secluded.
translation: 总体上说，这是个令人愉快的城市花园，宁静而偏僻。

meaning: n. 十二个，一打; adj. 一打的
example: Ernest Brown lives about a dozen blocks from where the riots began.
translation: 欧内斯特·布朗住在离骚乱发生处几个街区远的地方。

meaning: n. 机器人；遥控设备，自动机械；机械般工作的人
example: They have docked a robot module alongside the orbiting space station.
translation: 他们已经将一个自动操作舱与沿轨道运行的空间站并行对接上了。

meaning: adj. 频繁的；时常发生的；惯常的; v. 常到，常去；时常出入于
example: Bordeaux is on the main Paris-Madrid line so there are frequent trains.
translation: 波尔多位于巴黎到马德里的铁路主干线上，来往列车频繁。

meaning: adj. 非凡的；特别的；离奇的；临时的；特派的
example: They testify to the extraordinary potency of his personality.
translation: 这些事情证明了他非凡的人格魅力。

meaning: adv. 相反地
example: You can add the fluid to the powder, or, conversely, the powder to the fluid.
translation: 可把液体加入粉末，或者相反，把粉末加入液体。

meaning: v. 实施统计调查; n. 人口普查，人口调查
example: Of these, 40% told census-takers they were Muslims.
translation: 这些人当中，有40%的人告诉人口普查员说自己是穆斯林。

meaning: n. 帮助；助攻; v. 参加；出席
example: We are here to protect and assist the weak and infirm.
translation: 我们来这里保护、帮助年迈体弱者。

meaning: v. 疲劳；厌倦; n. 轮胎；头饰
example: You must have noticed how tired he sometimes looks.
translation: 你一定注意到他有时候显得特别疲惫。

meaning: n. 冬季；年岁；萧条期; v. 过冬; adj. 冬天的；越冬的
example: in winter
translation: 在冬天；在冬季

meaning: v. 描述；描画
example: The media depict him as a left-wing bogeyman.
translation: 媒体把他描述成一个左翼大反派。

meaning: n. 牙科医生
example: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
translation: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

meaning: v. 复制；复印；抄袭; n. 副本；一册；摹仿
example: I autographed a copy of one of my books.
translation: 我在自己的一本书上签了名。

meaning: v. 烹调，煮; n. 厨师，厨子
example: Captain Cook safely navigated his ship without accident for 100 voyages.
translation: 库克船长驾驶的船安全出航100次无事故。

meaning: v. 妨碍；束缚；使困累; n. 食盒，食篮；阻碍物
example: Before entering the bathroom, he emptied his dirty laundry into the hamper.
translation: 进浴室前，他把脏衣服全都放进洗衣筐里。

meaning: n. 数据包，信息包；小包，小捆; vt. 包装，打包
example: You could save yourself a packet.
translation: 你能为自己省一大笔钱。

meaning: v. 使吓一跳；使惊奇; n. 惊愕；惊恐
example: The second paragraph startled me even more than the first.
translation: 第二段比第一段更让我吃惊。

meaning: int. 天哪; n. 善良，优秀 ；精华，养分
example: She had an unshakeable faith in human goodness and natural honesty.
translation: 她坚信人的本性是善良诚实的。

meaning: n. 一生；寿命；终生；使用期; adj. 一生的；终身的
example: I want to take advantage of your lifetime of scholarship.
translation: 我希望能够用到您一生的学识。

meaning: v. 辩护；防护
example: Those people who took up weapons to defend themselves are political prisoners.
translation: 那些拿起武器自卫的人是些政治犯。

meaning: n. 周期，期间；时期；月经；课时；（语法学）句点，句号; adj. 某一时代的
example: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer.
translation: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

meaning: v. 总结；概述
example: What follows is a brief summary of the process.
translation: 接下来是对此流程的一个简短概括。

meaning: n. 核心；要点；果心；[计] 磁心; v. 挖的核
example: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
translation: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

meaning: v. 分配；指派；[计][数] 赋值
example: It had been a monumental blunder to give him the assign-ment.
translation: 当时把这项任务给他是大错特错了。

meaning: n. 忠诚；忠心；忠实；忠于…感情
example: Loyalty and support became the bywords of the day.
translation: 忠诚和支持成了那个时代人们时常挂在嘴边的词儿。

meaning: n. 恶梦；梦魇般的经历; adj. 可怕的；噩梦似的
example: Taking my son Peter to a restaurant was a nightmare.
translation: 带我儿子彼得外出吃饭简直糟糕透了。

meaning: v. 不喜欢，厌恶; n. 嫌恶，反感，不喜爱
example: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
translation: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

meaning: v. 养育；鼓励；培植; n. 养育；教养；营养物
example: The human organism learns partly by nature, partly by nurture.
translation: 人的学习能力部分是天生的，部分是后天培养的。

meaning: v. 移植；迁移；使移居; n. 移植；移植器官；被移植物；移居者
example: The demand for transplantable organs is rising about 15 percent annually.
translation: 每年需要移植器官的人又以约百分之十五的速度递增.

meaning: n. 电话；耳机，听筒; v. 打电话
example: I took the phone, and she went discreetly into the living room.
translation: 我拿起了电话，她知趣地进了客厅。

meaning: n. 星期六
example: On Tuesdays and Saturdays the market comes to town.
translation: 每逢周二与周六，镇上就会有集市。

meaning: n. 天才，天赋；精神
example: I was hoping some of his genius might rub off.
translation: 我希望他的才华也可以影响他人。

meaning: n. （一套）家具；套房；组曲；（一批）随员，随从
example: Barnaby may be 15, but he's nippy and suited to badminton.
translation: 巴纳比可能15岁了，但他动作敏捷，适合打羽毛球。

meaning: v. 抗议；断言; n. 抗议; adj. 表示抗议的；抗议性的
example: Teachers staged a sit-down protest in front of the president's office.
translation: 老师们在校长办公室门前举行了一场静坐抗议。

meaning: v. 使转变；转换…；使…改变信仰; n. 皈依者；改变宗教信仰者
example: We would like to convert the loft into another bedroom.
translation: 我们想把阁楼改造成又一间卧室。

meaning: adv. 以后，后来
example: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: adj. 主要的；资本的; n. 首长；校长；资本；当事人
example: The two principal combustion products are water vapor and carbon dioxide.
translation: 两种主要的燃烧产物是水蒸气和二氧化碳。

meaning: n. 宇宙；世界；领域
example: His beautifully illustrated book well attested his love of the university.
translation: 他那本带有精美插图的书见证了他对大学的热爱。

meaning: v. 抵挡；禁得起；反抗
n. 工作室；[广播][电视] 演播室；画室；电影制片厂
example: a studious young man
translation: 勤奋的小伙子

meaning: adj. 舒适的，舒服的; n. 盖被
example: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
translation: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

meaning: adj. 极好的；华丽的；宏伟的; n. (Superb)人名；(罗)苏佩尔布
example: Harley - Davidson enters Superbike racing with the introduction of the VR 1000 , a dual overhead cam, liquid - cooled motorcycle.
translation: 哈雷戴维森 在超级摩托车比赛推出了配备双顶置凸轮水冷发动机的VR1000摩托车.

meaning: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴
example: We felt we might finish third. Any better would be a bonus.
translation: 我们感觉我们可能会获得第三名，要是能比这个名次更好那就是意外的惊喜了。

meaning: v. 使适应；改编
example: The scriptwriter helped him to adapt his novel for the screen.
translation: 编剧帮助他将其所著小说改编成电影。

meaning: v. 刺激；鼓舞，激励
example: By stimulating the economy, we're going to put people to work.
translation: 我们将通过刺激经济让人们实现就业。

meaning: n. 会议；会见；集会；汇合点; v. 会面；会合（meet的ing形式）
example: We'll go to a meeting in Birmingham and come straight back.
translation: 我们将去伯明翰参加会议，然后马上回来。

meaning: adj. 同情的；交感神经的；共鸣的；赞同的；和谐的；合意的; n. 交感神经；容易感受的人
example: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

meaning: n. 律师；代理人；检查官
example: Luckily, Nancy's father and her attorney were one and the same person.
translation: 幸运的是，南希的父亲就是她的律师。

meaning: v. 撤退；收回；撤消；拉开
example: If these drugs are stopped abruptly then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
translation: 如果突然停服这些药，则可能出现一些戒断症状。

meaning: v. 调查；研究
example: We were asked to investigate the alleged inconsistencies in his evidence.
translation: 我们被要求对他证词中的前后矛盾之处进行调查。

meaning: n. 地板，地面；楼层；基底；议员席; v. 铺地板；打倒，击倒；（被困难）难倒
example: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
translation: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

meaning: n. 证人；目击者；证据; v. 目击；证明；为…作证
example: Mr. De Witt was the first to recover the power of speech.
translation: 最先恢复说话本能的是德韦特先生.

meaning: n. 基础设施；公共建设；下部构造
example: The infrastructure, from hotels to transport, is old and decrepit.
translation: 从宾馆到交通，所有的基础设施都已陈旧失修。

meaning: v. 以…为中心; n. 中心; adj. 中央的
example: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: adj. 黑暗的，深色的；模糊的；无知的；忧郁的; n. 黑暗；夜；黄昏；模糊
example: In the dark my sense of hearing becomes so acute.
translation: 黑暗中我的听觉变得异常灵敏。

meaning: v. 倒塌；瓦解；暴跌; n. 倒塌；失败；衰竭
example: A few days after his collapse he was sitting up in bed.
translation: 他病倒后没过几天就又能在床上坐起来了。

meaning: n. 逻辑；逻辑学；逻辑性; adj. 逻辑的
example: By now all logic had gone out of the window.
translation: 到这时根本就不讲什么逻辑了。

meaning: n. 吨；很多，大量
example: There is little tonal variety in his voice.
translation: 他说话几乎没有声调变化。

meaning: n. 指令，命令；指示；教导；用法说明
example: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
translation: 这一方法给教学带来了活力，也使知识的吸收变得容易了。

meaning: v. 营救；援救; n. 营救；援救；解救
example: Lights clipped onto life jackets improve the chances of rescue.
translation: 别在救生衣上的灯提高了获救可能性。

meaning: n. 昆虫；卑鄙的人
example: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.
translation: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。

meaning: adj. 尴尬的；笨拙的；棘手的；不合适的
example: Unfortunately, Grandma always seems to awaken at awkward moments.
translation: 不幸的是，奶奶好像总是醒来的不是时候。

meaning: n. 手册，小册子
example: Every member will receive their own "Welcome to Labour" brochure.
translation: 每个党员都将收到一本名为《欢迎加入工党》的小册子。

meaning: v. 谴责；罚…下地狱; n. 一点；诅咒; adj. 可恶的; adv. 非常; int. 讨厌
example: "Wait a damn minute," Mindy spat. "Nobody said anything about staying overnight."
translation: “该死的，等一下”，明迪愤愤地说道，“谁也没说过要过夜。”

meaning: adj. 混凝土的；实在的，具体的；有形的; v. 凝结; n. 具体物；凝结物
example: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
translation: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

meaning: n. 货摊；公用电话亭
example: Booth was a revivalist intent on his Christian vocation.
translation: 布思是一个坚定不移地奉行其基督徒天职的宗教复兴运动者。

meaning: n. 出口，通道；退场; v. 退出；离去
example: Go north on I-15 to the exit just past Barstow.
translation: 沿着15号州际公路一直向北，一过巴斯托就从出口驶出。

meaning: adj. 疲倦的；厌倦的，厌烦的; v. 疲倦；对…腻烦（tire的过去分词形式）
example: tired of
translation: 厌烦

meaning: v. 损害；削弱；减少
example: Tiredness can seriously impair your ability to drive.
translation: 疲劳会大大影响你的驾驶能力.

meaning: n. 住处；寓所; v. 居住（dwell的现在分词）
adv. 大概；推测起来；可假定
example: He had gone to the reception desk, presumably to check out.
translation: 他已经去前台了，可能是要办理退房手续。

meaning: n. 圣诞节；圣诞节期间
example: "Prices are down 40 per cent since Christmas," he lamented.
translation: “圣诞节以来物价降了4成，”他悲叹道。

meaning: v. 滑动；滑倒；犯错；失足；减退; n. 滑，滑倒；片，纸片；错误；下跌；事故; adj. 滑动的；有活结的；活络的; abbr. 串行线路接口协议，是旧式的协议（Serial Line Interface Protocol）
example: What are the advantages to using a slipcase with my album?
translation: 我得相册使用一个书套有什么好处?

meaning: v. 觉醒，意识到；醒来；被唤起; adj. 醒着的
example: The hypnotic state actually lies somewhere between being awake and being asleep.
translation: 催眠状态实际上介乎清醒和睡眠之间。

meaning: adj. 共同的；相互的，彼此的
example: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
translation: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

meaning: adj. 暗淡的，昏暗的；模糊的，看不清的；悲观的，怀疑的; v. 使暗淡，使失去光泽；使变模糊; n. 笨蛋，傻子
example: A few are dim-witted drones, but most are talented, frustrated, wasted people.
translation: 有几个是愚笨的寄生虫，但是大多数是有才能却不得志而自暴自弃的人。

meaning: n. 群众,一伙;一堆,许多,大众; v. 拥挤,挤满,挤进
example: The crowd in Robinson's Coffee-House was thinning, but only by degrees.
translation: 鲁宾逊咖啡屋里的人正在变少，但也只是渐少而已。

meaning: n. 结局；结尾
example: I nearly died when I learned where I was ending up.
translation: 得知自己到了哪里时，我简直要晕过去了。

meaning: v. 增加；增大; n. 增加；增大
example: The government'sfirst concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
translation: 政府关心的首要问题是扩充军队及辅助队伍。

meaning: n. 代理人，代表; adj. 副的；代理的
example: She was so disloyal to her deputy she made his position untenable.
translation: 她对她的副手很不守信义，使得他的职位岌岌可危。

meaning: n. 木材；木料
example: timber tree
translation: 成材木

meaning: n. 语气；色调；音调；音色; v. 增强；用某种调子说
example: "What shall we do?" Milton said again in a toneless voice.
translation: “我们该怎么办？”米尔顿又用平板而单调的声音问道。

meaning: adj. [法] 非法的；违法的；违反规则的; n. 非法移民，非法劳工
example: By-laws are to make it illegal to smoke in public.
translation: 地方法规将规定在公共场合抽烟为非法。

meaning: n. 红色，红颜料；赤字; adj. 红色的；红肿的，充血的
example: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
translation: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

meaning: n. 幻想；想象力；爱好; adj. 想象的；奇特的；昂贵的；精选的; v. 想象；喜爱；设想；自负
example: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
translation: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

meaning: n. 例外；异议
example: Almost without exception those convicted were our friends and colleagues.
translation: 那些被判有罪的人几乎无一例外都是我们的朋友和同事。

meaning: adj. 无效的；有病的；残废的; n. 病人；残废者; v. 使伤残；使退役
example: Margaret resides with her invalid mother in a London suburb.
translation: 玛格丽特同她病弱的母亲住在伦敦郊区。

meaning: n. 动作；移动；手势；请求；意向；议案; v. 运动；打手势
example: She made a fanning motion, pretending to cool herself off.
translation: 她做了个扇风的动作，假装想让自己凉快一点。

meaning: n. 车站；驻地；地位；身份; v. 配置；安置；驻扎
example: Stationary cars in traffic jams cause a great deal of pollution.
translation: 交通堵塞中静止不动的汽车产生了大量污染。

meaning: v. 残杀；彻底击败; n. 大屠杀；惨败
example: The massacre laid bare the moral bankruptcy of the regime.
translation: 大屠杀使该政权的道德沦丧暴露无遗。

meaning: v. 发抖；战栗；焦虑；摇晃; n. 颤抖；战栗；摇晃
example: The seismograph showed a sharp spike in response to the trembler.
translation: 地震仪显示,震动器的反应突然大增.

meaning: v. 成为阻碍; adj. 后面的; n. (Hinder)人名；(芬)欣德
example: Does the fact that your players are part-timers help or hinder you?
translation: 队员们都是兼职的，这对你有利还是不利？

meaning: n. 村庄；村民；（动物的）群落
example: A villager had noted the number of the truck.
translation: 一个村民记下了车牌号.

meaning: adj. 选出的；当选的；卓越的; n. 被选的人；特殊阶层；上帝的选民; v. 选举；选择；推选
example: Councils should be answerable to the people who elect them.
translation: 市政会成员应对推选他们的人负责。

meaning: n. 腐烂；腐败；腐坏; v. 腐烂；腐败；堕落; int. （表示厌恶、蔑视、烦恼等）胡说；糟了
example: It took internal whistle-blowing and investigative journalism to uncover the rot.
translation: 是内部检举和调查性报道揭露了这一腐败事实。

meaning: n. 预备；准备
example: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it.
translation: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

meaning: n. 让步；特许（权）；承认；退位
example: We can not make heavy concession to the matter.
translation: 我们在这个问题上不能过于让步.

meaning: adj. 不重要的，琐碎的；琐细的
example: All the way, darkness engulfs the daytime, wave sinks the boat , trivialism conquers the ardour.
translation: 一直都是, 黑暗吞噬了白昼, 恶浪击沉了轻舟, 琐碎征服了激情.

meaning: v. 培养；养育，抚育；抱（希望等）; adj. 收养的，养育的; n. (Foster)人名；(英、捷、意、葡、法、德、俄、西)福斯特
example: The children were waiting for placement in a foster care home.
translation: 这些孩子在抚育院等待安置。

meaning: n. 污垢，泥土；灰尘，尘土；下流话
example: He claims Pasolini overtook and tackled him, pushing him into the dirt.
translation: 他声称帕索利尼追上去打他，把他推倒在烂泥里。

meaning: v. 支撑；鼓励；赞成；举起
example: The young couple plan to upholster their bedroom with velvet.
translation: 小俩口打算用天鹅绒装饰他们的卧室.

meaning: n. 有机体；生物体；微生物
example: The human organism learns partly by nature, partly by nurture.
translation: 人的学习能力部分是天生的，部分是后天培养的。

meaning: v. 呻吟；抱怨；发吱嘎声; n. 呻吟；叹息；吱嘎声
example: She heard him let out a pitiful, muffled groan.
translation: 她听到他发出一声令人悲悯的低沉的呻吟声。

meaning: n. 兽群，畜群；放牧人; v. 成群，聚在一起
example: Stefano used a motor cycle to herd the sheep.
translation: 斯特凡诺骑一辆摩托车放羊。

meaning: n. 磨光，擦亮；擦亮剂；优雅，精良; v. 擦亮，变光滑; adj. 波兰的
example: Those killed have been described as the flower of Polish manhood.
translation: 那些牺牲者被称为波兰男子中的精英。

meaning: adj. 记录的；文件的；记实的; n. 纪录片
example: The documentary left me in a state of shock.
translation: 那部纪录片使我大为震惊。

meaning: n. 截止期限，最后期限
example: One month before the deadline we see the hollowness of these promises.
translation: 离最后期限只有一个月时，我们认识到了这些许诺都是空头支票。

meaning: v. 建议；劝告，忠告；通知；警告
example: Dietary experts can advise on the ins and outs of dieting.
translation: 饮食专家可以对日常饮食的方方面面提出建议。

meaning: n. 几率；胜算；不平等；差别
example: He sweeps up and does a few odds and ends.
translation: 他扫完地，又干了几样杂活儿。

meaning: n. 信赖；信心；受信赖的人或物
example: Reliance on sponsorship can have a malign effect on theatre groups.
translation: 对赞助的依赖会给剧团带来不良的影响。

meaning: v. 宣告，公布；声明；表明；赞扬
example: His classic boyish looks seemed to proclaim his good humour and openness.
translation: 他的长相非常孩子气,显得性情很好且诚实坦率.

meaning: v. 合作；勾结，通敌
example: The two men met and agreed to collaborate.
translation: 这两个人见了面，并同意进行合作。

meaning: n. 闹钟；警报，警告器；惊慌; v. 警告；使惊恐
example: Any escape, once it's detected, sets off the alarm.
translation: 一旦发现有泄漏，警报就会响起来。

meaning: n. 粉红色；化身，典范；石竹花；头面人物; v. 扎，刺，戳；使…变粉红色；使…面红耳赤; adj. 粉红的；比较激进的；石竹科的；脸色发红的
example: He was holding a cloth that dripped pink drops upon the floor.
translation: 他正拿着一块布，布上粉红色的水滴落在地板上。

meaning: n. 投掷；摇荡；投掷的距离；掷币赌胜负; v. 投掷；使…不安；突然抬起；使…上下摇动；与…掷币打赌
example: toss in
translation: [新西兰俚语]放弃；结束

meaning: n. 角落，拐角处；地区，偏僻处；困境，窘境; v. 囤积；相交成角
example: Claire stared after him until he disappeared around a corner.
translation: 克莱尔一直注视着他，直到他消失在拐角。

meaning: n. 肢，臂；分支；枝干; vt. 切断…的手足；从…上截下树枝
example: Try to rest the injured limb as much as possible.
translation: 尽量不要活动受伤的手臂。

meaning: n. 注意；言辞; v. 评论；觉察
example: I didn't mean any offence. It was a flippant, off-the-cuff remark.
translation: 我本无意冒犯，那不过是句脱口而出的冒失话。

meaning: n. 锚；抛锚停泊；靠山；新闻节目主播; v. 抛锚；使固定；主持节目; adj. 末棒的；最后一棒的
example: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
translation: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

meaning: n. 高原; adj. 高原印第安人的
example: The US heroin market now appears to have reached a plateau.
translation: 美国的海洛因市场现在似乎已到了停滞期。

meaning: v. 举起；提升；鼓舞；空运；抄袭; n. 电梯；举起；起重机；搭车
example: I gave her a lift back out to her house.
translation: 我让她搭我的便车回家。

meaning: n. 砍；排骨；商标；削球; v. 剁碎；砍
example: He won't say which programmes are for the chop.
translation: 他不愿说哪些项目将被毙掉。

meaning: adj. 威严的；令人敬畏的; n. 八月（简写为Aug）
example: The Great War started in August of that year.
translation: 第一次世界大战于那年8月爆发。

meaning: adj. 愤愤不平的；义愤的
example: MPs were indignant that the government had not consulted them.
translation: 政府没有事先征求他们的意见，下院议员们感到很愤怒。

meaning: n. 牛仔裤；工装裤
example: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger.
translation: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。

meaning: n. [数] 公式，准则；配方；婴儿食品
example: There is no magic formula for producing winning products.
translation: 获奖电影的制作没有捷径可取。

meaning: adj. 天真的,幼稚的
example: The drama takes an idealistic, even a naive view of the subject.
translation: 这部戏在对待这一主题上有些理想化，甚至是天真。

meaning: n. 键盘; v. 键入；用键盘式排字机排字
example: To close your document, press CTRL+W on your keyboard.
translation: 关闭文件时要同时按键盘上的CTRL键和W键。

meaning: adj. 害羞的；畏缩的，胆怯的; v. 投；畏缩；惊退；厌恶; n. 投掷；惊跳
example: Shylock is a usurer, yet not a usurer in general.
translation: 夏洛克是一个放高利贷者, 但又不是一个一般化的放高利贷者.

meaning: n. 先生；（用于姓名前）爵士；阁下；（中小学生对男教师的称呼）先生；老师
example: dear sir or madam
translation: 尊敬的先生或女士（信笺的开头语）

meaning: n. 罪恶；罪孽；过失; v. 犯罪；犯过失
example: SINA gene was firstly identified in Drosophila.
translation: SINA基因最初是在果蝇中克隆到.

meaning: adj. 上了年纪的；过了中年的；稍老的
example: We usually think of a victim of mugging as being someone elderly.
translation: 我们通常以为被拦路抢劫的受害者是老年人。

meaning: adj. 显著的，突出的，惊人的；打击的；罢工的; v. 打（strike的ing形式）
example: In one respect, however, the men really were strikingly similar.
translation: 然而，一方面，那些男人真的非常相似。

meaning: n. 翻覆；[贸易] 营业额；流通量；半圆卷饼；失误; adj. 翻过来的；可翻转的
example: A lot of motels lie beside the turnpike.
translation: 很多汽车旅馆都位于付费公路旁边.

meaning: adj. 可选择的，随意的; n. 选修科目
example: We also recommend a full day optional excursion to the Upper Douro.
translation: 我们还推荐去杜罗河上游的短途自选一日游。

meaning: pron. 自己；亲自
example: The doll-like figures in these stories are unlike anybody, let alone oneself.
translation: 这些故事中的玩偶形象跟谁都不像，更不用说像自己了。

meaning: v. 巩固，使固定；联合
example: The question is: will the junta consolidate its power by force?
translation: 问题是：军政府会通过武力巩固其政权吗？

meaning: n. 方面;[数] 维；尺寸；次元；容积 vt标出尺寸; adj. 规格的
example: There was undeniably a strong theoretical dimension to his thinking.
translation: 不可否认，他的思想很有理论深度。

meaning: v. 使减少；使变小
example: Federalism is intended to diminish the power of the central state.
translation: 联邦制旨在削弱中央政府的权力。

meaning: v. 存留，坚持；持续，固执
example: If the symptoms persist, it is important to go to your doctor.
translation: 如果这些症状持续存在，一定要去看医生。

meaning: adj. 奇异的（指态度，容貌，款式等）
example: The allegations ranged from the banal to the bizarre.
translation: 从平淡无奇到离奇百怪的各种说法都有。

meaning: v. 拥抱；信奉，皈依；包含; n. 拥抱
example: I couldn't find it in me to embrace him.
translation: 我打心眼里不想拥抱他。

meaning: v. 播种；散布；使密布; n. 母猪
example: sow seeds
translation: 播种

meaning: v. 提高；增高；加强；使更显著
example: Use eye shadow to heighten your eyes.
translation: 使用眼影可以增大你的眼睛.

meaning: n. 雕塑；雕刻；刻蚀; v. 雕塑；雕刻；刻蚀
example: I was attracted by the sculpturesque beauty of David's face.
translation: 我被大卫脸上精雕细凿的美所吸引.

meaning: v. 合并；使合并；吞没; n. (Merge)人名；(意)梅尔杰
example: Like a chameleon, he could merge unobtrusively into the background.
translation: 他就像一条变色龙，可以神不知鬼不觉地隐藏在背景中间。

meaning: n. 偏见；侵害; v. 损害；使有偏见
example: Rowe does a very clever riff on the nature of prejudice.
translation: 罗就偏见的本质讲了一番很精辟的话。

meaning: n. 接见，采访；面试，面谈; v. 采访；接见；对…进行面谈；对某人进行面试
example: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
translation: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

meaning: n. 更换；复位；代替者；补充兵员
example: Hormone replacement therapy is very important and should be instituted early.
translation: 激素替代治疗非常重要，应该及早开始。

meaning: n. 耻辱；丢脸的人或事；失宠; v. 使……失宠；给……丢脸；使……蒙受耻辱；贬黜
example: Republican leaders called him a disgrace to the party.
translation: 共和党领导人称他是全党的耻辱。

meaning: v. 许可；允许; n. 许可证，执照
example: He can let the court's decision stand and permit the execution.
translation: 他有权维持法庭判决，批准死刑生效。

meaning: adj. 潜在的；根本的；在下面的；优先的; v. 放在…的下面；为…的基础；优先于（underlie的ing形式）
example: In some stores we were undermanned and customer service was suffering.
translation: 有些店我们人手不足，对顾客照顾不周。

meaning: n. 重叠；重复; v. 部分重叠；部分的同时发生
example: The upper layer of felt should overlap the lower.
translation: 毛毡的上层应与下层重叠。

meaning: n. 飞机（等于airplane）
example: I didn't get a wink of sleep on the aeroplane.
translation: 我在飞机上没合一下眼。

meaning: v. 释放；发射；让与；允许发表; n. 释放；发布；让与
example: Acupressure is used to release tension spots in the shoulders and neck.
translation: 指压按摩用于缓解肩部和颈部的紧张。

meaning: n. 贫困；困难；缺少；低劣
example: Mr Dunn's pleas of poverty are only partly justified.
translation: 邓恩先生贫穷的托词只是部分成立。

meaning: n. 优点，价值；功绩；功过; v. 值得
example: Surely such weighty matters merit a higher level of debate?
translation: 这样重大的事件谅必应进行更高级别的讨论吧？

meaning: n. 家伙；朋友；同事；会员; adj. 同伴的，同事的；同道的; vt. 使…与另一个对等；使…与另一个匹敌
example: By all accounts, Rodger would appear to be a fine fellow.
translation: 据说，罗杰是个好小伙。

meaning: adj. 攻击的；冒犯的；无礼的；讨厌的; n. 攻势；攻击
example: The army now appears to have launched a counter-offensive.
translation: 军队现在似乎已经发起了反攻。

meaning: n. 女儿；[遗][农学] 子代; adj. 女儿的；子代的
example: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
translation: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

meaning: n. 文件，公文；[计] 文档；证件; v. 用文件证明
example: To close your document, press CTRL+W on your keyboard.
translation: 关闭文件时要同时按键盘上的CTRL键和W键。

meaning: adj. 生硬的；突然的；唐突的；陡峭的
example: Cross was a little taken aback by her abrupt manner.
translation: 她鲁莽的态度让克罗斯感到有点吃惊。

meaning: v. 控告；请求; n. (Sue)人名；(日)末(名)；(法)休；(英)休(女子教名Susan、Susanna的昵称)
example: He pulled on his heavy suede shoes and tied the laces.
translation: 他穿上厚厚的软皮鞋，系上鞋带。

meaning: adj. 谦逊的；简陋的；（级别或地位）低下的；不大的; v. 使谦恭；轻松打败（尤指强大的对手）；低声下气
example: Now experts are extolling the virtues of the humble potato.
translation: 现在专家们都在赞美其貌不扬的马铃薯的种种好处。

meaning: n. 少数民族；少数派；未成年; adj. 少数的；属于少数派的
example: A minority of officers were prepared to bend the rules.
translation: 少数官员准备篡改规则。

meaning: n. 同伴；朋友；指南；手册; v. 陪伴
example: He has been her constant companion for the last four months.
translation: 4个月来，他一直陪伴在她身边。

meaning: n. 农夫，农民
example: Mr Farmer and Mrs Jones both admitted conspiring to murder her husband.
translation: 法默先生和琼斯太太都承认密谋杀死了琼斯先生。

meaning: n. 殖民地居民; adj. 殖民地的，殖民的
example: Many Filipinos see the bases as an extension of American colonial rule.
translation: 很多菲律宾人视这些基地为美国殖民统治的延续。

meaning: adj. 错误的；虚伪的；伪造的; adv. 欺诈地
example: I was wearing false eyelashes and a sweater two sizes too small.
translation: 我戴着假睫毛，穿着小了两号的毛衣。

meaning: n. 军人；[昆] 兵蚁；懒汉；一片烤面包; v. 当兵；磨洋工；坚持干；假称害病
example: soldier on
translation: 继续服役；坚持着干；迎着困难干

meaning: v. 向…课税；使负重担; n. 税金；重负
example: income tax
translation: 所得税

meaning: v. 轻敲；轻打；装上嘴子; n. 水龙头；轻打
example: Tapa cloth is an unwoven fabric made by pounding bark into a thin sheet.
translation: 南洋树皮纸是种非织造织物,是通过把树皮挤压成薄皮而制成的.

meaning: n. 范围；球体; vt. 包围；放入球内；使…成球形; adj. 球体的
example: In spheric linkages, the axes of all revolute pairs must intersect at point.
translation: 在球面连杆机构中, 所有的转动副的轴必在一点上相交.

meaning: n. 探针；调查; v. 调查；探测
example: A doctor used a probe to remove metal fragments from a wound.
translation: 医生用探针将伤口中的金属碎片取出.

meaning: n. 租金; v. 出租；租用；租借
example: They actually moved down from upstairs because the rent's that expensive.
translation: 他们确实从楼上搬到了楼下，因为房租太贵了。

meaning: n. [计] 目录；工商名录；姓名地址录; adj. 指导的；咨询的
example: Yahoo is the oldest and best-known Web directory service.
translation: 雅虎是最早且最知名的因特网目录服务网站。

meaning: adj. 自发的；自然的；无意识的
example: Usually a woman's breasts produce milk spontaneously after the birth.
translation: 女性的乳房通常在产后会自然泌乳。

meaning: n. 饮食；食物；规定饮食; v. 节食
example: It makes sense to eat a reasonably balanced diet when slimming.
translation: 在减肥过程中保持饮食的营养相对均衡是明智的。

meaning: v. 召唤；召集；鼓起；振作
example: Two Will O'the Wisp are summoned to help their summoner in battle.
translation: 在战斗中,两个鬼火将被召唤来帮助它们的召唤者.

meaning: v. 滑行；沿岸航行; n. 海岸；滑坡
example: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula.
translation: 这艘船停泊在离该半岛北部海岸不远的地方。

meaning: v. 踌躇，蹒跚；失足；犯错; n. 绊倒；蹒跚而行
example: stumble upon
translation: 偶然发现

meaning: v. 互相影响；互相作用; n. 幕间剧；幕间休息
example: After initiation, the youths started to interact with the older members.
translation: 入会仪式后，这些小伙子与老成员开始互动。

meaning: n. 管家；乘务员；膳务员；工会管事; vi. 当服务员；当管事; vt. 管理
example: Please show your ticket to the stewardess when you board the plane.
translation: 登机时请向空中小姐出示机票.

meaning: n. 信封，封皮；包膜；[天] 包层；包迹
example: Return the enclosed Donation Form today in the prepaid envelope provided.
translation: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。

meaning: v. 使破裂；打开；变声; n. 裂缝；声变；噼啪声; adj. 最好的；高明的
example: She's calm and strong, and she is just not going to crack.
translation: 她镇定而且坚强，绝不会垮掉。

meaning: adv. 完全地；总共；总而言之; n. 整个；裸体
example: His objective was to kill the space station project altogether.
translation: 他的目的是使空间站项目全面停止。

meaning: n. 熔炉，锻铁炉；铁工厂; v. 伪造；做锻工；前进
example: He again pledged to forge ahead with his plans for reform.
translation: 他再次承诺会稳步推进自己的改革计划。

meaning: n. 耐性，耐心；忍耐，容忍
example: Non-violence and patience are the central tenets of their faith.
translation: 非暴力和忍耐是他们的信仰的核心原则。

meaning: adv. 立刻；简短地；唐突地
example: Any exercise that causes undue shortness of breath should be stopped.
translation: 任何导致呼吸出现困难的锻炼都应停止。

meaning: v. 禁止，取缔; n. 禁令，禁忌
example: The Partial Test-Ban Treaty bans nuclear testing in the atmosphere.
translation: 《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止在大气层中进行核试验。

meaning: adv. 迄今；至今
example: a hitherto unknown species of moth
translation: 迄今仍属未知种类的蛾

meaning: adj. 俯卧的；有…倾向的，易于…的; n. (Prone)人名；(意、法)普罗内
example: Bob slid from his chair and lay prone on the floor.
translation: 鲍勃从椅子上滑下来，趴在了地板上。

meaning: n. 条，棒；酒吧；障碍；法庭; v. 禁止；阻拦; prep. 除……外
example: They drink bitter on draught in the local bar.
translation: 他们在当地的酒吧里喝桶装的苦啤酒。

meaning: n. 恳求，请求；辩解，辩护；借口，托辞
example: Her plea of guilty to manslaughter through provocation was rejected.
translation: 她因受到挑衅而过失杀人的有罪答辩被驳回。

meaning: n. 小道传闻；随笔；爱说长道短的人; v. 闲聊；传播流言蜚语
example: It provided some juicy gossip for a few days.
translation: 这制造了一些非常八卦的流言蜚语，足够说上几天的。

meaning: n. 热心，热忱，热情
example: She radiates an infectious enthusiasm for everything she does.
translation: 她做任何事情都充满一种极富感染力的热情。

meaning: adj. 美丽的
example: It's been a beautiful evening and you have made it all possible.
translation: 那是个美好的夜晚，你让一切成为可能。

meaning: n. 彩票；碰运气的事，难算计的事；抽彩给奖法
example: Imagine winning the local lottery first prize of £5,000.
translation: 想象一下中个5,000英镑的当地彩票头奖吧。

meaning: adj. 奇异的；空想的；异想天开的；古怪的；极好的，极出色的；不可思议的；不切实际的; n. 古怪的人
example: I got a fantastic new job and my salary tripled.
translation: 我得到了一份非常好的新工作，薪水涨到了原来的3倍。

meaning: n. 钢笔；作家；围栏; v. 写；关入栏中
example: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
translation: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

meaning: n. 宠物；生气；受宠爱的人; v. 宠爱; adj. 宠爱的
example: They would sell the meat off as pet food.
translation: 他们将把肉当作宠物食品卖掉。

meaning: adj. 无辜的；无罪的；无知的; n. 天真的人；笨蛋
example: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
translation: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

meaning: n. 邻居; adj. 邻近的; v. 友好；毗邻而居
example: And he said unto him, "Who is my neighbor?"
translation: 他于是对他说道：“谁是我邻居？”

meaning: n. 散文；单调; adj. 散文的；平凡的；乏味的; vi. 写散文；乏味地讲话; vt. 把…写成散文
example: His prose is vigorous and dense, occasionally to the point of obscurity.
translation: 他的散文文笔有力、内容庞杂，有时几近晦涩。

meaning: n. 礼物；[税收] 贡物；颂词；（尤指对死者的）致敬，悼念，吊唁礼物
example: Tributyl citrate is a new material of non - toxic plasticizer.
translation: 摘要柠檬酸三丁酯是一种新型无毒增塑剂.

meaning: n. 绝望；令人绝望的人或事; v. 绝望，丧失信心
example: Don't let yourself despair; this will only make matters worse.
translation: 不要想不开，这样只能使情况变得更糟。

meaning: adj. 始终如一的，一致的；坚持的
example: consistent with
translation: 符合；与…一致

meaning: adj. 可行的；可能的；可实行的
example: It's just not feasible to manage the business on a part-time basis.
translation: 兼职管理业务是搞不好的。

meaning: n. 电灯泡；鳞茎；球状物; vi. 生球茎；膨胀成球状
example: A 40 watt bulb would be quite sufficient and would not obtrude.
translation: 40瓦的灯泡完全够亮了，并且不会晃眼。

meaning: n. [药][毒物] 海洛因，吗啡
example: The US heroin market now appears to have reached a plateau.
translation: 美国的海洛因市场现在似乎已到了停滞期。

meaning: n. 装饰；[建][服装] 装饰物；教堂用品; v. 装饰，修饰
example: The clock is simply for ornament; it doesn't work any more.
translation: 这架时钟纯属摆设，它再也不走了。

meaning: v. 传输；传播；发射；传达；遗传
example: Airborne transmittal has also been confirmed. Brucellosis occurs worldwide and is, generally speaking, under - reported.
translation: 布氏杆菌病在世界范围内有发生, 但一般而言, 报告的疫情少于实际情况.

meaning: v. 运送；装货；使充满; n. 货运；运费；船货
example: On the customs declaration, the sender labeled the freight as agricultural machinery.
translation: 在报关单上，寄货人将货物列为农用机械。

meaning: n. 条款；[计] 子句
example: The sentence consists of a main clause and a subordinate clause.
translation: 这句中有一个主句和一个从句.

meaning: n. 曲线；弯曲；曲线球；曲线图表; v. 弯；使弯曲; adj. 弯曲的；曲线形的
example: Was it just a temporary blip on an otherwise healthy growth curve?
translation: 这是否是原本良好的增长曲线中暂时的偏离？

meaning: n. 机制；原理，途径；进程；机械装置；技巧
example: Some objects had got entangled with the underneath mechanism of the engine.
translation: 一些东西缠在了发动机下面的机件上。

meaning: n. 原料；要素；组成部分; adj. 构成组成部分的
example: The active ingredient in some of the mouthwashes was simply detergent.
translation: 某些漱口剂中的有效成分只不过是洗涤剂而已。

meaning: v. 公开；揭露
example: They contend that the company failed to disclose material information.
translation: 他们坚持认为该公司并未透露实质性的信息。

meaning: adj. 妒忌的；猜疑的；唯恐失去的；戒备的
example: I worked myself into frenzy plotting ways to make him jealous.
translation: 我绞尽脑汁，处心积虑，就是为了让他嫉妒。

meaning: v. 犁；耕; n. 犁；耕地（等于plow）
example: It would pay farmers to plough up the scrub and plant wheat.
translation: 它会出钱雇农民开垦这块低矮丛林来种植麦子。

meaning: n. 歌剧；歌剧院；歌剧团
example: The following year she joined the Royal Opera House.
translation: 次年她加入了皇家歌剧院。

meaning: n. 优越，优势；优越性
example: Mr. Weber superiorly puffed away the absurd misgivings of women.
translation: 韦伯先生高傲地对女人们不合理的忧虑付之一笑.

meaning: v. 证明，证实；作证
example: He reacted testily to reports that he'd opposed military involvement.
translation: 有报道称他反对军队参与，对此他很是恼火。

meaning: n. 出口，排放孔；[电] 电源插座；销路；发泄的方法；批发商店
example: Her father had found an outlet for his ambition in his work.
translation: 她父亲在工作中找到了施展抱负的机会。

meaning: v. 伸展,张开；（大量地）使用，消耗（金钱，时间）；使竭尽所能；使全力以赴；; n. 伸展，延伸
example: Stewart was trying to clear a path for the stretcher.
translation: 斯图尔特在努力给担架开路。

meaning: n. 暴露；曝光；揭露；陈列
example: Their sporting reputation has suffered enormously from Johnson's exposure.
translation: 由于约翰逊东窗事发，他们的体育声誉受到了严重损害。

meaning: n. 凭借，手段；度假胜地；常去之地; v. 求助，诉诸；常去；采取某手段或方法
example: For a beach resort with a difference, try Key West.
translation: 如果想去一个与众不同的海滨度假胜地，那就去基韦斯特吧。

meaning: adj. 最重要的；最先的; adv. 首先；居于首位地
example: She is, first and foremost, her husband's alter ego.
translation: 她首先是丈夫的知己。

meaning: adj. 巨大的，广大的；无边无际的；非常好的
example: I'd seen it before in people who held immense power.
translation: 我以前曾在掌握大权的人身上看到过这种情况。

meaning: adj. 独有的；排外的；专一的; n. 独家新闻；独家经营的项目；排外者
example: People will always pay top dollar for something exclusive.
translation: 人们总是会为绝无仅有的东西付出高价。

meaning: v. 宣称，断言；提出…作为理由
example: Prosecutors in the trial allege the defendants plotted to overthrow the government.
translation: 检方在审判中指称被告密谋推翻政府。

meaning: n. 横梁；光线；电波；船宽；[计量] 秤杆; v. 发送；以梁支撑；用…照射；流露
example: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
translation: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

meaning: v. 居住；存在于；细想某事
example: I shut out the memory which was too painful to dwell on.
translation: 我不再去回忆那些痛苦不堪的往事了。

meaning: n. 月相
example: The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.
translation: 实际上写作过程中最重要的阶段是修改。

meaning: n. 社会学；群体生态学
example: sociology of law
translation: 法律社会学

meaning: v. 超速，加速；加速，迅速前行；兴隆; n. 速度，速率；迅速，快速；昌盛，繁荣
example: high speed
translation: 高速全速

meaning: v. 刺激；使活动；使活泼；使产生放射性
n. 政权，政体；社会制度；管理体制
example: The military regime in power was unpopular and repressive.
translation: 当权的军政府压制人民，不得人心。

meaning: n. 委员会
example: This committee will enable decisions to be made democratically.
translation: 该委员会将实现民主决议过程。

meaning: n. 人质；抵押品
example: The class was held hostage by a hooded gunman.
translation: 全班同学被一个蒙面的持枪歹徒劫为人质。

meaning: n. 地区；范围；部位
example: The power stations burn coal from the Ruhr region.
translation: 发电站烧的煤产自鲁尔地区。

meaning: n. 激动；震颤；紧张; v. 使…颤动；使…紧张；使…感到兴奋或激动
example: Set in contemporary Dublin, this pacy thriller features kidnapping, mayhem and murder.
translation: 这部节奏紧张刺激的惊悚片以当代都柏林为背景，包含了绑架、暴力致人伤残和谋杀情节。

meaning: v. 称做…；定名为…；给…称号；使…有权利
example: They lose their entitle-ment to benefit when they start work.
translation: 他们一开始工作就失去了获得救济金的资格。

meaning: adj. 附加的，额外的
example: Shares and bonds can bring one quite a considerable additional income.
translation: 股票和债券能给人带来不菲的额外收入。

meaning: adj. 伴随的；侍候的; n. 服务员，侍者；随员，陪从
example: Tony Williams was working as a car-park attendant in Los Angeles.
translation: 托尼·威廉斯在洛杉矶的一个停车场当服务生。

meaning: v. 尖叫；呼啸；发出尖锐刺耳的声音；令人触目惊心; n. 尖叫声；尖锐刺耳的声音；极其滑稽可笑的人
example: She is not SCREAMER or MOANER - She is VOCALLY APPRECIATIVE.
translation: 她并不乱叫或发牢骚,只是用声音表示喜怒.

meaning: adj. 悲惨的；痛苦的；卑鄙的
example: Miserable, and unexpectedly lonely, she went in search of Jean-Paul.
translation: 内心痛苦、突感寂寞的她去寻找琼－保罗。

meaning: n. 老兵；老手；富有经验的人；老运动员; adj. 经验丰富的；老兵的
example: He is a veterinarian, he is very kind to animals.
translation: 他是位兽医, 他对动物们可好了.

meaning: n. 配偶; vt. 和…结婚
example: He replaced the boiler when the last one began to spout flames.
translation: 原来的锅炉开始往外喷火苗后他便换了个新的。

meaning: n. 旅行；行程; v. 旅行
example: The average commuter journey there is five hours long.
translation: 那里的通勤一族平均上下班要花5个小时。

meaning: n. 条纹，斑纹；种类; v. 加条纹于…
example: He was faultlessly attired in black coat and striped trousers.
translation: 他穿着黑色上衣和条纹裤子，简直无可挑剔。

meaning: n. 伤害；损害; v. 伤害；危害；损害
example: Nudism, the council decided, was doing the resort more harm than good.
translation: 委员会认定在休闲胜地的裸体行为弊大于利。

meaning: v. 诱导；引起；引诱；感应
example: He might decide that it is best to induce labour.
translation: 他也许决定最好引产。

meaning: v. 使惊吓；吓唬…
example: Fairground rides are intended to frighten the life out of you.
translation: 露天游乐场的飞车就是想把人吓丢了魂儿。

meaning: n. 参议院，上院；（古罗马的）元老院
example: He was in Georgia stumping for Senator Wyche Fowler, a Democrat.
translation: 他正在佐治亚州为民主党参议员威奇·福勒作巡回演说。

meaning: n. 节俭；节约；[植] 海石竹
example: We should run all undertakings industrially and thriftily.
translation: 我们要勤俭办一切事业.

meaning: n. 论坛，讨论会；法庭；公开讨论的广场
example: The forum is now open to all budding entrepreneurs.
translation: 这个论坛目前向所有企业家新秀敞开大门。

meaning: v. 说明；口译
example: They could interpret it that way if they'd a mind to.
translation: 如果他们愿意的话，可以那样理解。

meaning: v. 悬挂，垂下；装饰；绞死；使悬而未决; n. 悬挂；暂停，中止
example: The King has merely given the politicians enough rope to hang themselves.
translation: 国王只不过是给了这些政客自缚的绳子。

meaning: n. 感恩
example: KJV For this is thankworthy , if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
translation: [新译]因为人若在神面前为良心的缘故,忍受冤屈的苦楚, 是有福的.

meaning: n. 类比；类推；类似
example: The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
translation: 老师打了个比喻，把人的心脏比作水泵。

meaning: n. 壳，贝壳；炮弹；外形; v. 剥落；设定命令行解释器的位置
example: The coating was a mixture of shellac and alcohol.
translation: 这种涂料是虫胶与酒精的混合物.

meaning: n. 架子；搁板；搁板状物；暗礁
example: He bought a shelfful of books.
translation: 他买了一书架的书.

meaning: n. 叉；餐叉；耙; v. 叉起；使成叉状
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: v. 兜售，沿街叫卖；捕捉；咳出; n. 鹰；鹰派成员；掠夺他人的人
example: The hawk swooped and soared away carrying something.
translation: 那只鹰向下猛冲，抓住东西后又展翅高飞了。

meaning: v. 变硬，变坚固；变坚强；变冷酷; n. (Harden)人名；(英、德、罗、瑞典)哈登；(法)阿尔当
example: Give the cardboard two or three coats of varnish to harden it.
translation: 在纸板上涂两三层清漆使其变硬。

meaning: n. 英国模拟考试（mocks）; v. 愚弄，嘲弄; adj. 仿制的，模拟的，虚假的，不诚实的
example: He screwed his face into an expression of mock pain.
translation: 他面部扭曲，假装疼痛。

meaning: n. 投票；投票用纸；投票总数; v. 投票；抽签决定
example: The ballot was re-run on Mr Todd's insistence after accusations of malpractice.
translation: 因被控舞弊，在托德先生的坚持下重新进行了投票。

meaning: v. 努力；奋斗；抗争
example: In all things else, I have striven to be true!
translation: 不管我有什么不好, 我可一直想努力作一个诚实的人!

meaning: v. 憎恨；厌恶；遗憾; n. 憎恨；反感
example: I hate it when people accuse us of that.
translation: 我讨厌别人就那件事指责我们。

meaning: v. 反对；与…战斗; n. 战斗；争论; adj. 战斗的；为…斗争的
example: They demanded a more expansionary economy to combat rising unemployment.
translation: 他们要求发展扩张性的经济以应对升高的失业率。

meaning: v. 抱怨，悲叹；呻吟; n. 呻吟声；悲叹
example: You can go see him and have a good old moan.
translation: 你可以去看看他，好好地诉诉苦。

meaning: adj. 同一的；完全相同的; n. 完全相同的事物
example: The identical treatment of such dissimilar items is totally illogical.
translation: 对如此不同的东西用一模一样的处理方法是完全不合逻辑的。

meaning: v. 计算；以为；作打算
example: Take a hundred and twenty values and calculate the mean.
translation: 取120个值计算平均数。

meaning: v. 卷；滚动，转动；辗; n. 卷，卷形物；名单；摇晃
example: The brothers usually roll into their studio around midday.
translation: 兄弟几个总是要到正午前后才姗姗来到工作室。

meaning: adj. 局部的；偏爱的；不公平的
example: The Partial Test-Ban Treaty bans nuclear testing in the atmosphere.
translation: 《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止在大气层中进行核试验。

meaning: n. 悖论，反论；似非而是的论点；自相矛盾的人或事
example: He was a paradox—a loner who loved to chat to strangers.
translation: 他真是个矛盾人物，生性孤僻却又喜欢和陌生人闲聊。
