meaning: n. 意见；判断力；[法] 审判；评价
example: A tide of emotion rose and clouded his judgement.
translation: 心头涌起一阵强烈的感情，模糊了他的判断力。

meaning: n. 绰号；昵称; v. 给……取绰号；叫错名字
example: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
translation: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

meaning: v. 战胜，征服；攻克，攻取
example: They feared that totalitarians might yet conquer the entire world.
translation: 他们担心极权主义者会征服整个世界。

meaning: n. 钟摆；摇锤；摇摆不定的事态
example: In education, the pendulum has swung back to traditional teaching methods.
translation: 教育界又恢复了传统教学法。

meaning: adj. 男性的；阳性的；男子气概的; n. 男性；阳性，阳性词
example: In most languages adjectives have slightly different spellings for masculine and feminine.
translation: 在多数语言中，形容词的阳性和阴性的拼法略为不同。

meaning: n. 侄子；外甥
example: "Cut her out of your will," urged his nephew.
translation: “把她从你的遗嘱中删去，”他的侄子催促道。

meaning: n. 箱子，容器；二进制; v. 把…放入箱中
example: His dismembered body was found in a rubbish bin.
translation: 在垃圾桶里发现了他被肢解的尸体。

meaning: n. 丑闻；流言蜚语；诽谤；公愤
example: sex scandal
translation: 性丑闻；桃色新闻

meaning: v. 节制，克制；避免；制止; n. 叠句，副歌；重复
example: Rosa's constant refrain is that she doesn't have a life.
translation: 罗莎总是重复的一句话就是她没有像样的生活。

meaning: int. 再见（等于goodbye）; n. (Goodby)人名；(英)古德拜
example: Well, goodby, everyone. Lets get together again soon.
translation: 嗯, 各位再见, 我们很快再见个面吧!

meaning: n. 航空；飞行术；飞机制造业
example: The civil aviation minister ordered all the planes to be grounded.
translation: 民航部长下令所有飞机不得起飞。

meaning: v. 磨碎；磨快; n. 磨；苦工作
example: The daily grind of government is done by Her Majesty's Civil Service.
translation: 枯燥的日常政务都由女王陛下的政府行政部门来处理。

meaning: n. 搅拌；轰动; v. 搅拌；激起；惹起
example: I crammed my mouth with stirabout for fear I might give utterance to my anger.
translation: 我生怕自己会吐出气愤的声音,拼命往嘴里喂麦片粥.

meaning: v. 剃，用剃刀刮; n. 剃刀
example: The camp is surrounded by razor-wire fences and guarded by military police.
translation: 营地周围架着尖利的铁丝网，且有宪兵看守。

meaning: v. 淹没；把…淹死; n. (Drown)人名；(英)德朗
example: He tried to recollect things and drown himself in them.
translation: 他极力回想过去的事情而沉浸于回忆之中.

meaning: adj. 精确的；明确的；严格的
example: Elgar supplied his works with precise indications of tempo.
translation: 埃尔加给自己的作品标上了精确的节奏标记。

meaning: n. 火腿；业余无线电爱好者；蹩脚演员; v. 表演过火; adj. 过火的；做作的
example: Vacuum-packed ham slices should be unwrapped 30 minutes before serving.
translation: 真空包装的火腿片应在食用前30分钟把包装除去。

meaning: adj. 谨慎的；小心的
example: She had meant to make a discreet entrance, but conversation stopped dead.
translation: 她本打算悄悄进去，但谈话却突然中断了。

meaning: n. 祝贺；贺辞
example: This is not a matter for self-congratulation.
translation: 你不应该为此事沾沾自喜。

meaning: n. 邮递员；邮差
example: I remembered a particular story about a postman who was a murderer.
translation: 我记得有个故事，讲的是一个邮递员杀人的事情。

meaning: v. 巡航，巡游；漫游; n. 巡航，巡游；乘船游览
example: Don's story unfolded as the cruise got under way.
translation: 随着航行的开始，唐的故事也随之展开。

meaning: v. 反驳，驳斥；驳倒
example: Isabelle is quick to refute any suggestion of intellectual snobbery.
translation: 伊莎贝尔对于任何关于她恃才傲物的暗示都迅速予以否认。

meaning: n. 推翻；倾覆；瓦解; v. 推翻；打倒；倾覆
example: These feelings are likely to make people attempt to overthrow the system.
translation: 这些情绪有可能促使人们想要推翻现行的体制。

meaning: n. 星期五；忠仆
example: I shall be 26 years old on Friday next.
translation: 下周五我就26岁了.

meaning: n. 壁炉
example: He had a bed and a fireplace and everything.
translation: 他家里有一张床、一个壁炉及其他物品。

meaning: n. 气候；风气；思潮；风土
example: If climate changes continue, we will suffer the consequences.
translation: 如果气候变化继续下去，我们将自食其果。

meaning: n. 监视器；监听器；监控器；显示屏；班长; v. 监控
example: Officials had not been allowed to monitor the voting.
translation: 以前不允许官员监督投票。

meaning: n. 光谱；频谱；范围；余象
v. 发出，表达；发射; adj. 完全的；彻底的；无条件的; n. (Utter)人名；(德、芬)乌特
example: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
translation: 他说的每句话都会被仔细审查。

meaning: v. 识别；领悟，认识
example: Below the bridge we could just discern a narrow, weedy ditch.
translation: 我们仅能依稀辨出桥下一条杂草丛生的窄沟。

meaning: n. 缺陷，缺点；缺乏；不足的数额
example: Symptoms of anaemia include weakness, fatigue and iron deficiency.
translation: 贫血的症状包括虚弱、疲劳和缺铁。

meaning: v. 冒犯；使…不愉快
example: There can be little doubt that he will offend again.
translation: 毋庸置疑他还会再犯的。

meaning: adj. 爱国的
example: The Patriotic Front took power after a three-month civil war.
translation: 经过3个月内战，爱国阵线夺取了政权。

meaning: n. 干草; v. 把晒干
example: make hay
translation: 利用机会去赚钱

meaning: v. 溢出；泛滥；充溢; n. 充满，洋溢；泛滥；超值；溢值
example: Tents have been set up next to hospitals to handle the overflow.
translation: 医院旁搭起了帐篷以安置容纳不下的人员。

meaning: adj. 粗糙的；天然的，未加工的；粗鲁的; n. 原油；天然的物质
example: Oil majors need not fear being unable to sell their crude.
translation: 大型石油公司无需担心原油销售不出去。

meaning: v. 振动；颤动；摇摆；踌躇
example: The acting force and motion of vibratile tumbling machine are analysed theoretically.
translation: 对振动光饰机的受力和运动进行理论分析.

meaning: v. 叹息，叹气; n. 叹息，叹气
example: They observed the comet for 70 days before it faded from sight.
translation: 他们观察了这颗彗星70天，直至其慢慢从视线中消失。

meaning: adj. 义务的；必修的；被强制的; n. （花样滑冰、竞技体操等的）规定动作
example: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
translation: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

meaning: v. 类似，像
example: Did it resemble the earth when this was destitute of an atmosphere?
translation: 它同地球上还没有大气的时候一样 吗 ?

meaning: adj. 合法的；正当的；合理的；正统的; v. 使合法；认为正当（等于legitimize）
example: Most doctors appear to recognize homeopathy as a legitimate form of medicine.
translation: 大多数医生似乎都接受顺势疗法是一种合理的医疗手段。

meaning: n. [电子] 脉冲；脉搏; v. 使跳动
example: There was no breathing or pulse and he was lifeless.
translation: 没有呼吸，也没有脉搏，他已经死了。

meaning: n. 章，回；（俱乐部、协会等的）分会；人生或历史上的重要时期; vt. 把…分成章节
example: Uncle Richard intoned a chapter from the Bible and improvised a prayer.
translation: 理查德叔叔吟诵了《圣经》中的一章，又即兴作了一段祈祷文。

meaning: n. [化学] 臭氧；新鲜的空气
example: Ozone is a highly reactive form of oxygen gas.
translation: 臭氧是一种非常活跃的氧气形态。

meaning: adj. 恰好的；熟练的；合适的; adv. 恰好；熟记地; n. 轻拍；小块；轻拍声; v. 轻拍
example: Pat was a tower of strength to our whole family.
translation: 帕特是我们全家人的主心骨。

meaning: v. 发明；创造；虚构
example: His father had helped invent a whole new way of doing business.
translation: 他父亲帮助创造了一套全新的生意经。

meaning: v. 溺爱；糟蹋；破坏；掠夺; n. 次品；奖品
example: He was determined to track down the cause of food spoilage.
translation: 他决心查出食品腐烂的原因.

meaning: adj. 顽固的；顽强的；难处理的
example: Some interest rates have remained stubbornly high.
translation: 部分利率一直居高不下。

meaning: adv. 在今晚; n. 今晚
example: The Cu - ben - tonite can adsorp xanthated ion directly, giving catalysis to its oxidization reaction.
translation: 铜基土能直接吸附黄原酸根离子, 同时对其氧化反应产生催化作用.

meaning: n. 洋葱；洋葱头
example: Fry for about 4 minutes, until the onion has softened.
translation: 煎4分钟左右，直到洋葱变软。

meaning: n. 观光；游览; adj. 观光的；游览的; v. 观光（sightsee的ing形式）；游览
example: The sightseer gggpno speaks highly of the highway with sigh.
translation: 观光者叹息着盛赞这条公路.

meaning: v. 吵架；争论；挑剔; n. 吵架；反目；怨言；争吵的原因；方头凿
example: They could quarrel quite legitimately with some of my choices.
translation: 他们大有理由不同意我的一些选择。

meaning: n. 衬垫；护具；便笺簿；填补; v. 步行；放轻脚步走
example: Keep a pad handy to jot down queries as they occur.
translation: 手边放一本便笺簿，以便有问题时随时记下。

meaning: adj. 理论的；理论上的；假设的；推理的
example: Theoretically, the price is supposed to be marked on the shelf.
translation: 照理说，价格应该标在货架上。

meaning: adj. 缺乏的，不足的；稀有的; adv. 仅仅；几乎不；几乎没有
example: scarce resources
translation: 稀有资源

meaning: n. 平底锅；盘状的器皿；淘盘子，金盘，秤盘; v. 淘金；在浅锅中烹调（食物）；[非正式用语]严厉的批评
example: Put a pan of salted water on to boil.
translation: 将一锅盐水放上去煮。

meaning: v. 放大，扩大；增强；详述
n. 弓；鞠躬；船首; v. 鞠躬；弯腰; adj. 弯曲的
example: We should not have to bow down to anyone.
translation: 我们不必向任何人示弱。

meaning: v. 溜；鬼鬼祟祟做事；向老师打小报告; n. 鬼鬼祟祟的人；偷偷摸摸的行为；告密者; adj. 暗中进行的
example: I have a sneaker factory in Canada?
translation: 我还有个在加拿大的帆布运动鞋厂?

meaning: adj. 永恒的；不朽的
example: The series chronicles the everyday adventures of two eternal bachelors.
translation: 这个系列剧按照时间顺序记述了两个老光棍每天的奇遇。

meaning: v. 庇护；怀有; n. 海港；避难所
example: He had jumped overboard in New York harbor and swum to shore.
translation: 他在纽约港跳下船，游上了岸。

meaning: n. 番茄，西红柿
example: the tomb of the Unknown Soldier
translation: 无名战士墓

meaning: adv. 顺时针方向地; adj. 顺时针方向的
example: He told the children to start moving clockwise around the room.
translation: 他让孩子们开始按顺时针方向绕着房间走。

meaning: v. 核实；查证
example: Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
translation: 我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要卖我了。

meaning: n. 动物园
example: beijing zoo
translation: 北京动物园

meaning: v. 混合; n. 混合；掺合物
example: Blend the butter with the sugar and beat until light and creamy.
translation: 把糖掺入黄油然后搅拌至滑软细腻。

meaning: n. 攻击；袭击; v. 攻击；袭击
example: At the police station, I was charged with assault.
translation: 在警察局，我被指控殴打他人。

meaning: adj. 自愿的；志愿的；自发的；故意的; n. 志愿者；自愿行动
example: voluntary contributions
translation: 自愿捐款

meaning: n. 母鸡；女人；雌禽
example: The pheasant is a close relative of the Guinea hen.
translation: 雉与珍珠鸡有很近的亲缘关系。

meaning: v. 使隔离；使孤立；使绝缘; n. [生物] 隔离种群; adj. 隔离的；孤立的
example: Political influence is being used to shape public opinion and isolate critics.
translation: 政治影响正被用来左右公众舆论，使批评家们陷于孤立。

meaning: n. 方向；定向；适应；情况介绍；向东方
example: They give their new employees a day or two of perfunctory orientation.
translation: 他们对新员工进行了一两天例行公事的培训。

meaning: n. 转让；转移；传递；过户; v. 转让；转学；换车
example: One pre - condition for transferability is the pricing for such non - transferable shares.
translation: 解决全流通问题的前提是如何给 非 流通股定价.

meaning: n. 袋；猎获物；（俚）一瓶啤酒; v. 猎获；把…装入袋中；占据，私吞；使膨大
example: "I'll get the Republican nomination," he assured me. "It's in the bag."
translation: “我会得到共和党提名的，”他向我保证，“这是十拿九稳的事。”

meaning: adj. 明智的; 通情达理的; 合乎情理的; 意识到的，能感觉到的;; n. 可感觉到的东西; 敏感的人;
example: He sensibly decided to lie low for a while.
translation: 他明智地决定暂时保持低调。

meaning: n. 围攻；包围；围城；不断袭击；长期努力; vt. 围攻；包围
example: Siegfried cringed and shrank against the wall.
translation: 西格弗里德畏缩了，退避到墙根。

meaning: adj. 水平的；地平线的；同一阶层的; n. 水平线，水平面；水平位置
example: The frames are secured by horizontal rails to the back wall.
translation: 框架用横杆牢牢固定在后墙上。

meaning: n. 剪刀；剪式跳法; v. 剪开；删除（scissor的第三人称单数）
n. 香水；香味; v. 洒香水于…；使…带香味
example: As she went past there was a gust of strong perfume.
translation: 她走过时有一股浓烈的香水味。

meaning: n. 蔬菜；植物；植物人; adj. 蔬菜的；植物的
example: vegetable oil
translation: 植物油

meaning: n. 泡沫；水沫；灭火泡沫; v. 起泡沫；吐白沫；起着泡沫流动
example: We had given him a large foam mattress to sleep on.
translation: 我们给了他一张大海绵床垫用来睡觉。

meaning: v. 把挤在一起；使缩成一团；草率了事; n. 拥挤；混乱；杂乱一团
example: Between plays the coach was talking to the offense in the huddle.
translation: 中场时，这位教练对围拢一圈的进攻队员进行战术指导。

meaning: n. 超级市场；自助售货商店
adj. 热带的；热情的；酷热的
example: tropical fruit
translation: 热带水果

meaning: adj. 女性的；妇女（似）的；阴性的；娇柔的
example: In most languages adjectives have slightly different spellings for masculine and feminine.
translation: 在多数语言中，形容词的阳性和阴性的拼法略为不同。

meaning: n. 层级；等级制度
example: The principle of hierarchy does not equate to totalitarian terror.
translation: 等级制度在原则上并不等同于极权主义恐怖。

meaning: v. 润滑；涂油；起润滑剂作用
example: Franklin's task was to lubricate the discussions with the French.
translation: 富兰克林的任务是促使与法国方面的会谈顺畅进行。

meaning: v. 无意中听到；偷听
example: They were shut away in a little room where nobody could overhear.
translation: 他们被关在一个小屋里，没人能听到他们的动静。

meaning: adj. 编辑的；社论的; n. 社论
example: A Wall Street Journal editorial encapsulated the views of many conservatives.
translation: 《华尔街日报》的一篇社论概述了很多保守派人士的观点。

meaning: n. 现代化
example: The modernization of the industry was phased over at 20 - year period.
translation: 工业现代化分20年逐步实现.

meaning: n. 豌豆
example: green pea
translation: 嫩豌豆；青豌豆

meaning: v. 超过；胜过
example: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day.
translation: 每天的饮酒量不应超过两个计量单位。

meaning: adj. 空的；无效的；无人的; n. 空虚；空间；空隙; v. 使无效；排放
example: How to provide void marriage and voidable marriage in marriage law?
translation: 如何在婚姻法中设置无效婚姻和得撤销的婚姻?

meaning: n. 校长
example: He was headmaster of a public school in the West of England.
translation: 他是英格兰西部一所公学的校长。

meaning: v. 捻；拧；扭伤；编织；使苦恼; n. 扭曲；拧；扭伤
example: The twister hit the roofs of homes and buildings.
translation: 龙卷风把房屋以及农机建筑物连根拔起.

meaning: v. 用硫磺处理; n. 硫磺；硫磺色
example: sulfur dioxide
translation: 二氧化硫

meaning: v. 刺；刺伤；戳；刺穿；直入; n. 刺；戳；尝试；突发的一阵
example: The man was stabbed to death in a frenzied attack.
translation: 这名男子在一次疯狂的袭击中被刺死。

meaning: n. 化学家；化学工作者；药剂师；炼金术士
example: She worked as a research chemist.
translation: 她曾经是化学研究员。

meaning: adj. 婚姻的；夫妇间的
example: The implication that marital infidelity enhances a leader's credibility is preposterous.
translation: 婚姻不忠会提升领导人可信度的暗示荒谬之极。

meaning: n. 内部；本质; adj. 内部的；国内的；本质的
example: Interior decoration by careful coordination seems to have had its day.
translation: 精心搭配的室内装饰似乎已不再受欢迎了。

meaning: n. 匙，勺子；一杓的量; v. 用匙舀；使成匙状
example: greasy spoon
translation: 低级小饭馆；经济小吃店

meaning: n. 植被；植物，草木；呆板单调的生活
example: The harshness of the climate makes vegetative growth extremely slow.
translation: 恶劣的气候使植物生长特别缓慢。

meaning: n. 钢盔，头盔
example: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorbike.
translation: 一位戴头盔的男子正跨上摩托车。

meaning: n. [数] 余数，残余；剩余物；其余的人; adj. 剩余的；吃剩的; v. 廉价出售；削价出售
example: I spent the remainder of the day feeling terrible.
translation: 我那天余下的时间里心情都很糟糕。

meaning: adj. 富裕的；丰富的；流畅的; n. 支流；富人
example: The Strand is one of London's busiest and most affluent streets.
translation: 斯特兰德街是伦敦最繁华、最富足的街道之一。

meaning: adj. 准确的，精密的；精确的; v. 要求；强求；急需
example: The exact locations are being kept secret for reasons of security.
translation: 确切地点因为安全原因要保密。

meaning: v. 铺设；安排；作铺设之用; n. (Pave)人名；(西、塞)帕韦
example: pave the way for
translation: 为…做好准备；为…铺平道路

meaning: n. 循环；周期；自行车；整套；一段时间; v. 使循环；使轮转
example: Eddie parked his cycle against a lamp post and padlocked it.
translation: 埃迪把他的自行车靠在路灯柱上，用挂锁锁好。

meaning: n. 车间；研讨会；工场；讲习班
example: Even grandfather has come to the worksite.
translation: 连爷爷也到工地来了.

meaning: v. 乞讨；恳求；回避正题; n. (Beg)人名；(德、塞、巴基)贝格
example: We beg the Government on bended knees not to cut this budget.
translation: 我们恳求政府不要削减这项预算。

meaning: n. 蜜蜂，蜂；勤劳的人
example: bee pollen
translation: 蜂花粉

meaning: n. 电报; vt. 用电报发送; vi. 发电报
example: The Telegraph puts the union in a historical perspective.
translation: 《电讯报》从历史的角度对该工会进行了报道。

meaning: adj. 声名狼藉的，臭名昭著的
example: The accident happened on a notorious black spot on the A43.
translation: 事故发生在A43号公路上一个出了名的事故多发地段。

meaning: v. 祝福；保佑；赞美; n. (Bless)人名；(英、意、德、匈)布莱斯
example: During his visit, the Pope will also bless the new hospital.
translation: 在访问期间，教皇还将为新医院祈福。

meaning: n. 半岛
example: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula.
translation: 这艘船停泊在离该半岛北部海岸不远的地方。

meaning: n. 基督徒，信徒; adj. 基督教的；信基督教的
example: Ethiopia'sart springs from her early Christian as well as her Muslim heritage.
translation: 埃塞俄比亚的艺术起源于其早期的基督教和伊斯兰教文化遗产。

meaning: v. 涂脂于；贿赂; n. 油脂；贿赂
example: Grease 6 ramekin dishes of 150 ml (5-6 fl oz) capacity.
translation: 将6个容量为150毫升（5至6液盎司）的烤盘涂上油。

meaning: v. 任命；指定；约定
example: "Why didn't you appoint Ron twelve months ago?"—"Good question."
translation: “你为什么12个月前不任命罗恩呢？”——“问得好。”

meaning: v. 减轻，缓和；使安心; n. 轻松，舒适；安逸，悠闲
example: They agreed to work co-operatively to ease tensions wherever possible.
translation: 他们同意互相配合尽一切努力缓解紧张局势。

meaning: v. 消化；吸收；融会贯通; n. 文摘；摘要
example: The organization publishes a regular digest of environmental statistics.
translation: 该组织定期出版一份环境统计数据摘要。

meaning: adj. 公正的，明断的；法庭的；审判上的
example: The process of judicial selection was held up to ridicule.
translation: 司法选举的过程成为了笑柄。

meaning: v. 逮捕；阻止；吸引; n. 逮捕；监禁
example: Some magistrates have abused their powers of arrest to extort confessions.
translation: 有些地方执法官滥用逮捕权进行逼供。

meaning: v. 计算；估算；用计算机计算; n. 计算；估计；推断
example: I compute my losses at 500 dollars.
translation: 我估计我的损失有五百元.

meaning: adj. 定量的；量的，数量的
example: That's the whole difference between quantitative and qualitative research.
translation: 那就是定量研究和定性研究之间的重大差别。

meaning: n. 下属，下级；部属，属下; adj. 从属的；次要的; v. 使……居下位；使……服从
example: When & quot ; in & quot ; I will come when I can & quot; is a subordinating conjunction.
translation: 在“ IwillcomewhenIcan ”中,“when”是从属连词.

meaning: n. 否认；拒绝；节制；背弃
example: The denial was limited to rejecting the construction put on his remarks.
translation: 这种否认仅限于不接受对他所说话语的阐释。

meaning: v. 赞同；称赞；向…喝彩
example: Every person stood to applaud his unforgettable act of courage.
translation: 所有人起立为他不可磨灭的英勇之举鼓掌。

meaning: v. 注入；注射
example: The result might inject more sense into future bargaining.
translation: 其结果可能为未来的谈判注入更多的理性。

meaning: n. 花；青春；旺盛; v. 使开花；使茂盛
example: The skin loses its youthful bloom.
translation: 皮肤失去了年轻时的光泽。

meaning: n. 网络空间；赛博空间
example: She travels in cyberspace by sending messages to friends around the world.
translation: 她利用电子空间给世界各地的朋友们发送信件.

meaning: n. 馅饼；饼图；爱说话的人; vt. 使杂乱
example: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
translation: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

meaning: n. 猪；猪肉; v. 生小猪；像猪一样过活
example: I'm afraid I made a pig of myself at dinner.
translation: 恐怕我晚餐时吃得太多了。

meaning: v. 阐明，说明；照亮；使灿烂；用灯装饰
example: Our interesting teacher could illuminate almost any subject we studied.
translation: 我们这位有趣的老师几乎能解释清楚我们所学的所有科目.

meaning: n. 足球，橄榄球; vi. 踢足球；打橄榄球
example: There are other forms of civil disorder — most notably, football hooliganism.
translation: 还有其他形式的民众骚乱，最出名的是足球流氓行为。

meaning: n. 海军
example: The Navy is to carry out an examination of the wreck tomorrow.
translation: 海军明天将对失事船只进行细查。

meaning: n. 矿井；深坑；陷阱；（物体或人体表面上的）凹陷；（英国剧场的）正厅后排；正厅后排的观众; v. 使竞争；窖藏；使凹下；去…之核；使留疤痕
example: A gold mine is not a bottomless pit, the gold runs out.
translation: 金矿并非无底的宝藏，金子终究会被采光。

meaning: n. 困苦；苦难；艰难险阻
example: Many people are suffering economic hardship.
translation: 很多人正处于经济困难之中。

meaning: adj. 外部的；表面的；外在的; n. 外部；表面；外型；外貌
example: His gruff exterior concealed one of the kindest hearts.
translation: 他粗暴的外表下藏着一颗非常善良的心。

meaning: adj. 光荣的；辉煌的；极好的
example: We opened the windows and let in the glorious evening air.
translation: 我们打开窗户，让傍晚那沁人心脾的空气流进室内。

meaning: n. 壶；盆；罐; v. 把…装罐；射击；节略
example: You will need a pot of broth for poaching.
translation: 你需要一锅汤来煮。

meaning: n. 承租人；房客；佃户；居住者; v. 租借（常用于被动语态）
n. 杂技演员，特技演员；随机应变者；翻云覆雨者，善变者
example: The acrobat balanced a long pole on his left shoulder.
translation: 杂技演员让一根长杆在他的左肩上保持平衡.

meaning: n. 量，数量；大量；总量
example: quantity of
translation: 数量；流量

meaning: n. 潜水艇；海底生物; adj. 海底的；水下的; v. 用潜水艇攻击
example: The submariner will stop under for two hours.
translation: 潜水员要在水下呆两个小时.

meaning: n. 红衣主教；枢机主教；鲜红色；【鸟类】(北美)主红雀; adj. 主要的，基本的；深红色的
example: Bishop Daly said he was devastated by news of the Cardinal's death.
translation: 戴利主教说他听到红衣主教去世的消息后感到极为震惊和难过。

meaning: adj. 荒谬的；可笑的; n. 荒诞；荒诞作品
example: It is absurd to be discussing compulsory redundancy policies for teachers.
translation: 讨论针对教师的强制裁员政策真是滑稽可笑。

meaning: v. 起媒介作用; adj. 中间的，中级的; n. [化学] 中间物；媒介
example: You should consider breaking the journey with intermediate stopovers at airport hotels.
translation: 你应该考虑将旅程分为几段，中途在机场旅馆稍作停留。

meaning: n. 庙宇；寺院；神殿；太阳穴
example: temple of heaven
translation: 天坛

meaning: n. 陆军上校
example: The colonel was rewarded with a resounding cheer from the men.
translation: 士兵对上校报以震天的欢呼声。

meaning: v. 服从，听从；按照……行动; n. (Obey)人名；(英、法)奥贝
example: Clifford's only stipulation is that his clients obey his advice.
translation: 克利福德唯一的要求就是客户必须听从他的建议。

meaning: n. 吊车，起重机；鹤; v. 伸着脖子看；迟疑，踌躇
example: Crane is a kind of bird with very long legs and neck.
translation: 鹤是一种腿和脖子都很长的鸟.

meaning: n. 评价；估价（尤指估价财产，以便征税）；估计
example: Self-appraisal is never easy.
translation: 进行自我评价向来很难。

meaning: n. 博士学位；博士头衔
example: He obtained his doctorate in Social Psychology.
translation: 他获得了社会心理学博士学位。

meaning: n. 指导方针
example: A written IQ test is merely a guideline.
translation: 书面智商测试仅供参考。

meaning: n. 肿块，隆起物；撞击; v. 碰撞，撞击；颠簸而行; adv. 突然地，猛烈地
example: The child took five steps, and then sat down with a bump.
translation: 小孩走了5步，接着扑通一声坐到了地上。

meaning: n. 电子
example: The structure of molecules can be seen under an electron microscope.
translation: 分子的结构可在电子显微镜下观察到.

meaning: n. 皇室；版税；王权；专利税
example: She bowed her head in a gesture somehow reminiscent of royalty.
translation: 她低头的姿势让人想起皇室风范。

meaning: v. 除草；铲除; n. 杂草，野草；菸草
example: weed control
translation: 除草；杂草防除；野草控制

meaning: n. 刺；[植] 荆棘
v. 楔入；挤进；楔住; n. 楔子；楔形物；导致分裂的东西
example: wedge in
translation: 挤入；插入

meaning: v. 分配；拨出；使坐落于
example: Our plan is to allocate one member of staff to handle appoint-ments.
translation: 我们的计划是分派一位职员处理预约事宜。

meaning: n. 公牛；看好股市者；粗壮如牛的人；胡说八道；印玺; adj. 大型的；公牛似的；雄性的; v. 企图抬高证券价格；吓唬；强力实现
example: I also met with Pollack again to kind of shoot the bull.
translation: 我也再次和波拉克会面，两人闲聊了会儿。

meaning: v. 绑架；诱拐；拐骗
example: He was charged with the kidnap of a 25 year-old woman.
translation: 他被指控绑架一名25岁的女子。

meaning: n. 皱纹; v. 起皱
example: He was a smallish, greying man, with a wrinkly face.
translation: 他是一个满脸皱纹、头发灰白的小个子男人。

meaning: v. 哭泣；流泪；哀悼；滴落；渗出液体; n. 哭泣；眼泪；滴下
example: weep for
translation: 为…而哭泣

meaning: adj. 鲁莽的，不顾后果的；粗心大意的; n. (Reckless)人名；(英)雷克利斯
example: Many people believe reckless drivers are treated too leniently.
translation: 很多人认为对鲁莽驾驶的司机处罚过轻。

meaning: v. 伐木；喧闹地向前走；笨重地行动，缓慢地移动; n. 木材；废物，无用的杂物；隆隆声
example: It was made of soft lumber, spruce by the look of it.
translation: 其制作材料是软木，看起来像是云杉。

meaning: n. [天] 十月
example: By October 1990, when arrested, he was hopelessly in debt.
translation: 到1990年10月被捕时，他已经负债累累。

meaning: adj. [数] 任意的；武断的；专制的
example: The choice of players for the team seemed completely arbitrary.
translation: 看来这个队的队员完全是随意选定的。

meaning: v. 卸；摆脱…之负担；倾销
example: She planned to unlock the store at 8.00 sharp this morning.
translation: 她打算今天早上8点整准时开门营业。

meaning: v. 用带捆绑；用皮条抽打；约束; n. 带；皮带；磨刀皮带；鞭打
example: You cannot straphang in an airliner as you can on a Taipei bus.
translation: 你可以在台北的公共汽车上拉着吊带站着,但在飞机上你做不到.

meaning: adj. 熟练的；巧妙的
example: The author skillfully fuses these fragments into a cohesive whole.
translation: 作者将这些片断巧妙地结合成一个连贯的整体.

meaning: n. 稻草；吸管；一文不值的东西; adj. 稻草的；无价值的
example: He sent his driver to fetch him a strawberry shake.
translation: 他让司机去给他买一杯草莓奶昔。

meaning: v. 使弯曲；使屈服；使致力；使朝向; n. 弯曲
example: I rounded a bend where the trees and brush grew thickly.
translation: 我绕过一个林木茂盛的弯。

meaning: adj. 缺席的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的; v. 使缺席
example: Carol was absent-minded and a little slow on the uptake.
translation: 卡萝尔心不在焉，反应有点迟钝。

meaning: n. 悲痛；忧伤；不幸
example: "He's been arrested for theft and burglary." — "Good grief!"
translation: “他因为偷窃和入室盗窃而被逮捕了。”——“我的天哪！”

meaning: n. 人类；男性
example: Mankind's knowledge of the universe has increased beyond measure.
translation: 人类对于宇宙的了解已经大为增加。

meaning: n. 金属；合金; v. 以金属覆盖; adj. 金属制的
example: Light fittings with metal parts should always be earthed.
translation: 有金属部件的照明装置都应该走地线。

meaning: v. 反叛；反抗；造反; n. 反叛者；叛徒; adj. 反抗的；造反的
example: The spokesman confirmed that the area was now in rebel hands.
translation: 这位发言人证实该地区现已落入叛乱分子手中。

meaning: n. 皮革；皮革制品; v. 用皮革包盖；抽打; adj. 皮的；皮革制的
example: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger.
translation: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。

meaning: n. 撞碎；坠毁；破产；轰隆声；睡觉; v. 摔碎；坠落；发出隆隆声；(金融企业等)破产
example: A light aircraft crash-landed on a putting green yesterday.
translation: 一架轻型飞机昨天在一个高尔夫球场的球洞区紧急降落了。

meaning: v. 引起，唤起；博得
example: These images are likely to evoke a strong response in the viewer.
translation: 这些图像可能会在观众中产生强烈反响.

meaning: n. 红利；股息；[数] 被除数；奖金
example: dividend payments of 50 cents a share
translation: 每股50分的股息支付

meaning: adj. 电的；电动的；发电的；导电的；令人震惊的; n. 电；电气车辆；带电体
example: All Dreamland's electric blankets are guaranteed for three years.
translation: 所有的梦乡牌电热毯质保3年。

meaning: v. 埋葬；隐藏; n. (Bury)人名；(法)比里；(英、西)伯里；(德、意、罗、波、捷、匈)布里；(俄)布雷
example: When we feel anger, we bury the emotion and feel guilty instead.
translation: 当我们感到愤怒时，压抑这种情绪反而会觉得内疚。

meaning: v. 摔倒；倒塌；滚动；打滚；仓惶地行动; n. 跌倒；翻筋斗；跌跤
example: take a tumble
translation: 恍然大悟

meaning: adj. 外交的；外交上的；老练的
example: The Kremlin is still insisting on a diplomatic solution to the crisis.
translation: 俄罗斯中央政府依然坚持通过外交方式解决危机。

meaning: n. 难民，避难者；流亡者，逃亡者
example: Many of the refugee villages are in isolated areas.
translation: 很多难民村落都在偏远地区。

meaning: n. 酒馆；客栈
example: It was five long miles to the nearest pub.
translation: 离最近的酒吧有长长的5英里的路程。

meaning: n. 鸽子；鸽派人士; v. 潜水（dive的过去式）
example: A dove cooed softly.
translation: 一只鸽子轻柔地咕咕叫。

meaning: n. 致敬，欢迎；敬礼; v. 行礼致敬，欢迎
example: As a second lieutenant, he had to salute damned near everybody.
translation: 身为少尉，他几乎是逢人便得敬礼。

meaning: n. 铃，钟；钟声，铃声；钟状物; v. 装钟于，系铃于
example: They skip rope and play catch, waiting for the bell.
translation: 他们又是跳绳，又是玩接球，等着上课铃声响起。

meaning: adj. 英雄的；英勇的；记叙英雄及其事迹的；夸张的; n. 史诗；英勇行为
example: The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction.
translation: 公司在降低成本方面付出了艰苦卓绝的努力。

meaning: n. 地壳；外壳；面包皮；坚硬外皮; v. 结硬皮；结成外壳
example: Sergeant Parrott normally spoke with an upper-crust accent.
translation: 帕罗特军士说话通常带着上流社会的腔调。

meaning: n. 仁慈；好意；友好的行为
example: Build her up with kindness and a sympathetic ear.
translation: 用友善和富有同情心的倾听来重拾她的信心。

meaning: n. 伏特（电压单位）；环骑；闪避
example: His compatriot Volta showed that this was not so.
translation: 他的本国同胞伏打指出,情况并非如此.

meaning: v. 压碎；弄皱，变形；使…挤入; n. 粉碎；迷恋；压榨；拥挤的人群
example: Put both vegetables into a bowl and crush with a potato masher.
translation: 把这两样蔬菜都放进一个碗里，然后用捣土豆器把它们捣碎。

meaning: n. 独木舟；轻舟; v. 乘独木舟
example: We beached the canoe, running it right up the bank.
translation: 我们把独木舟径直划到岸边，并拖上岸。

meaning: n. 驾驶室；出租汽车；出租马车; v. 乘出租马车（或汽车）
example: The cab pulled up and the driver jumped out.
translation: 出租车减速停下，司机跳了出来。

meaning: n. 宿舍（等于dormitory）
example: Could you tell the girls in your dorm about the party?
translation: 你能不能告诉你宿舍的女孩子有关聚会的事?

meaning: n. 请愿；请愿书；祈求；[法] 诉状; v. 请愿；请求
example: His lawyers filed a petition for all charges to be dropped.
translation: 他的律师提请撤销所有指控。

meaning: v. 围绕；装入；放入封套
example: Please enclose your remittance, making cheques payable to Thames Valley Technology.
translation: 请附上汇款，支票收款人为泰晤士河谷科技公司。

meaning: v. 发出，放射；发行；发表
example: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.
translation: 金属容器开始发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。

meaning: n. 果园；果树林
example: Each bamboo house was surrounded by a thriving orchard.
translation: 每座竹楼周围都是茂密的果园.

meaning: v. 中断；打断；插嘴；妨碍; n. 中断
example: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. "Sorry to interrupt, Colonel."
translation: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下，上校。”

meaning: n. 并发症；复杂；复杂化；混乱
example: An added complication is the growing concern for the environment.
translation: 还有个问题就是对环境的日益关注。

meaning: n. 碑；药片；写字板；小块；平板电脑; vt. 用碑牌纪念；将(备忘录等)写在板上；将…制成小片或小块
example: He rapped the tabletop with his knuckles until they were sore.
translation: 他用指关节轻敲着桌面直到感到疼痛为止.

meaning: n. 睡椅，长沙发；床；卧榻; v. 蹲伏，埋伏；躺着
example: Roy swung his legs carefully off the couch and sat up.
translation: 罗伊小心地把腿挪下沙发，坐了起来。

meaning: v. 凝视；注视; n. 凝视；注视
example: Gail was silent for a moment, regarding Harry with his steady gaze.
translation: 盖尔镇定地注视着哈里，沉默了片刻。

meaning: adj. 经济的；节约的；合算的
example: Mexican cookery is economical, she says. Nothing goes to waste.
translation: “墨西哥的烹调注重俭省，”她说，“任何东西都不会浪费。”

meaning: n. 被子；棉被; v. 东拼西凑地编；加软衬料后缝制
example: The quilt has pretty, scalloped edges and intricate quilting.
translation: 这条被子有漂亮的荷叶饰边，而且绗缝活做得也很精致。

meaning: adj. 帝国的；皇帝的；至高无上的；威严的; n. 纸张尺寸；特等品
example: In 1959, Akihito broke with imperial tradition by marrying a commoner.
translation: 明仁天皇在1959年打破皇室传统，娶了一位平民女子为妻。

meaning: adj. 传染的；传染性的；易传染的
example: Infectious diseases are spreading among many of the flood victims.
translation: 传染病正在遭受洪灾的很多灾民中蔓延。

meaning: v. 用糖煮；使结晶为砂糖；美化; n. 糖果（等于sweets）；冰糖（等于sugar candy，rock candy）；毒品; adj. 新潮的（服饰）；甜言蜜语的
example: Joe's other peculiarity was that he was constantly munching hard candy.
translation: 乔还有一个怪癖，就是喜欢不停地嚼硬糖。

meaning: n. 口香糖；树胶；橡皮; v. 用胶粘，涂以树胶；使…有粘性
example: When not removed, plaque causes tooth decay and gum disease.
translation: 牙斑如果不清除就会导致牙齿蛀蚀和牙龈疾病。

meaning: adj. 不透明的；不传热的；迟钝的; n. 不透明物; vt. 使不透明；使不反光
example: The jargon in his talk was opaque to me.
translation: 他谈话中使用的行话对我是一团迷雾。

meaning: n. 家务事
example: I discovered an addiction to housework which I had never felt before.
translation: 我发现自己迷上了做家务，之前我从没有这种感觉。

meaning: n. 五十；五十个；编号为50的东西; adj. 五十的；五十个的；众多的
example: The village is a settlement of just fifty houses.
translation: 这个村子里只住了50户人。

meaning: n. [化]汞，水银
example: That night the mercury fell to thirty degrees below zero.
translation: 那天晚上温度计显示气温降到了零下30度。

meaning: n. 通道，走道；侧廊
example: He was in no hurry to walk down the aisle.
translation: 他并不急于结婚。

meaning: n. 嗜好；业余爱好
example: It is only a hobby, not a life or death struggle.
translation: 这只是一项爱好，不需要拼死拼活地努力。

meaning: n. 流放，充军；放逐，被放逐者；流犯; v. 放逐，流放；使背井离乡
example: Rovers lost 4-1 and began their long exile from the First Division.
translation: 流浪者队以1比4落败，从此开始长期无缘甲级联赛。

meaning: n. [临床] 综合症状；并发症状；校验子；并发位
example: severe acute respiratory syndrome
translation: 严重急性呼吸系统综合症

meaning: n. 半径，半径范围；[解剖] 桡骨；辐射光线；有效航程
v. 检查；视察；检阅
example: They have the right to come in and inspect the meter.
translation: 他们有权进来查表。

meaning: n. 遗赠，遗产
example: She offered to settle a legacy on Katharine.
translation: 她提出要把一笔遗产留给凯瑟琳。

meaning: adj. 柠檬色的; n. 柠檬
example: Lemon and lime juice were both temporarily out of stock.
translation: 柠檬汁和酸橙汁暂时都缺货。

meaning: v. 渗透，透过；弥漫
example: Eventually, the water will permeate through the surrounding concrete.
translation: 最终，水会渗透进周围的混凝土中。

meaning: v. 波动；涨落；动摇
example: Prices fluctuate from year to year.
translation: 物价年年波动.

meaning: n. 宝石；珠宝; v. 镶以宝石；饰以珠宝
example: Alan, you're a jewel.
translation: 艾伦，你真是出类拔萃呀。

meaning: n. 运输；运输机；狂喜；流放犯; v. 运输；流放；使狂喜
example: Determine test contents of transportability and build up an evaluation parameter system.
translation: 确定了运输性试验内容并建立了评价指标体系.

meaning: n. 告别，辞别；再见；再会; int. 别了！（常含有永别或不容易再见面的意思）；再会！; adj. 告别的
example: She bade farewell to her son.
translation: 她和儿子道了别。

meaning: n. 木匠，木工; v. 当木匠，做木匠工作
example: They are sleeping in the carpenter's shop directly above.
translation: 他们正在正上方的木匠铺子里睡觉。

meaning: n. 说服；说服力；信念；派别
example: It didn't take much persuasion to get her to tell us where he was.
translation: 我们没费什么口舌就让她说出了他的下落。

meaning: v. 监禁; n. 监狱
example: He could wind up in gaol.
translation: 他可能最后会进监狱。

meaning: v. 轻视，鄙视
n. [法] 陪审团；评判委员会; adj. 应急的
example: The jury found that the NFL had violated antitrust laws.
translation: 陪审团裁决全国橄榄球联盟触犯了反垄断法。

meaning: n. 动脉；干道；主流
example: A muscular spasm in the coronary artery can cause a heart attack.
translation: 冠状动脉的肌肉痉挛可能导致心脏病。

meaning: n. 丝绸；蚕丝；丝织物; adj. 丝的；丝绸的；丝制的; vi. （玉米）处于长须的阶段中
example: silk road
translation: 丝绸之路

meaning: n. 男人，家伙; v. 嘲弄，取笑
example: This guy, Jack Smith, does he go by the name of Jackal?
translation: 这个叫杰克·史密斯的家伙是不是还有个名字叫杰凯尔？

meaning: adj. 浪漫的；多情的；空想的; n. 浪漫的人; vt. 使…浪漫化
example: The reality of mothering is frequently very different from the romantic ideal.
translation: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

meaning: n. 内脏；肠子；剧情；胆量；海峡；勇气；直觉；肠; v. 取出内脏；摧毁（建筑物等）的内部; adj. 简单的；本质的，根本的；本能的，直觉的
example: "Is it right she belted old George in the gut?" she asked.
translation: “她真的把老乔治痛打了一顿？”她问。

meaning: adj. 沉闷的；冗长乏味的
example: The story is tediously spun out.
translation: 这故事拖得很讨厌.

meaning: adj. 友好的；亲切的；支持的；融洽的，和睦的; adv. 友善地；温和地; n. (Friendly)人名；(英)弗兰德利
example: The spokesman said the tone of the letter was very friendly.
translation: 发言人说信函的语气非常友好。

meaning: n. 痛苦；苦恼; v. 使极度痛苦
example: Every line etched on her face told a story of personal anguish.
translation: 她脸上的每条皱纹都讲述了一次痛苦的经历。

meaning: n. 枪支；枪状物；持枪歹徒; v. 用枪射击；加大油门快速前进
example: Planes dropped bombs and raked the beach with machine gun fire.
translation: 飞机投下炸弹，并用机关枪扫射海滩。

meaning: n. 技工，机修工; adj. 手工的
example: An elevator mechanic can work the machinery directly by turning this lever.
translation: 电梯修理工可以转动这根杠杆直接操作机器。

meaning: n. 征服，战胜；战利品
example: After the Norman Conquest the forest became a royal hunting preserve.
translation: 诺曼征服之后，这片森林成为了皇家狩猎区。

meaning: adj. 生理学的，生理的
example: Thinking angry thoughts can provoke strong physiological arousal.
translation: 想着生气的事情能激起强烈的生理反应。

meaning: n. 臭虫，小虫；故障；窃听器; v. 烦扰，打扰；装窃听器
example: He heard that they were planning to bug his office.
translation: 他得知他们打算在他办公室安装窃听器。

meaning: n. 诅咒；咒骂; v. 诅咒；咒骂
example: Apathy is the long-standing curse of British local democracy.
translation: 冷漠是英国地方民主制度长期以来难以推广的祸根。

meaning: n. 徽章；证章；标记; v. 授给…徽章
example: She glanced briefly at his lapel badge.
translation: 她扫了一眼他翻领上的徽章.

meaning: n. 群；一伙；一组; v. 使成群结队；结伙伤害或恐吓某人
example: Come on over, we've got lots of the old gang here.
translation: 过来吧，好多老朋友都在这儿。

meaning: n. 芽，萌芽；蓓蕾; v. 发芽，萌芽
example: The flowers are bronzy in bud and bright yellow when open.
translation: 这些花的花蕾是青铜色，开放后呈明黄色。

meaning: n. 核，核心；原子核
example: The repulsive force within the nucleus is enormous.
translation: 核子内部的斥力是巨大的。

meaning: n. 褐雨燕; adj. 快的；迅速的；敏捷的；立刻的; adv. 迅速地
example: taylor swift
translation: 泰勒·斯威夫特（乡村女歌手）

meaning: adj. 奢侈的；浪费的；过度的；放纵的
example: I can have a brainstorm and be very extravagant.
translation: 我有时会头脑发热，挥霍无度。

meaning: adj. 潜在的；潜伏的；隐藏的
example: It may also appeal to the latent chauvinism of many ordinary people.
translation: 它可能也迎合了许多普通人心中的沙文主义情结。

meaning: n. 牛肉；肌肉；食用牛；牢骚; v. 抱怨，告发；发牢骚
example: They used to buy ten kilos of beef in one lump.
translation: 他们过去常买10公斤重的整块牛肉。

meaning: adj. 名义上的；有名无实的；[会计] 票面上的; n. [语] 名词性词
example: All the ferries carry bicycles free or for a nominal charge.
translation: 所有的渡船都免费或以极低的收费运载自行车。

meaning: v. 复制；再生；生殖；使…在脑海中重现
example: He is not attempting necessarily to reproduce the cadence of speech.
translation: 他不想刻意重复那种讲话的语调。

meaning: n. 地质学；地质情况
example: We went on a geology field trip.
translation: 我们去进行地质野外考察。

meaning: n. 啤酒; vi. 喝啤酒
example: He cracked jokes and talked about beer and girls.
translation: 他爱说笑话，喜欢谈论啤酒和姑娘。

meaning: n. 匆忙，急忙; v. 仓促（做某事）；催促；（朝某方向）迅速移动；迅速处理
example: Dave was in a hurry to get back to work.
translation: 戴夫急于回到工作岗位。

meaning: n. 调查；测量；审视；纵览; v. 调查；勘测；俯瞰
example: questionnaire survey
translation: 问卷调查

meaning: n. 长袍，长外衣；礼服；睡袍；法衣; v. 使穿睡衣
example: She crept from the bed and fumbled for her dressing gown.
translation: 她从床上蹑手蹑脚地爬起来，摸索着自己的晨衣。

meaning: adj. 神圣的；非凡的；天赐的；极好的; v. 占卜；预言；用占卜勘探; n. 牧师；神学家
example: A degree does not give you a divine right to wealth.
translation: 拥有学位并不能保证你就能获得财富。

meaning: n. 舌头；语言; v. 舔；斥责；用舌吹
example: Julia was a very tough, sharp-tongued woman.
translation: 朱莉娅是一个非常粗野、说话刻薄的女子。

meaning: v. 下沉；消沉；渗透; n. 水槽；洗涤槽；污水坑
example: heat sink
translation: 散热器；吸热部件；冷源

meaning: v. 唱歌；歌颂；鸣叫；呼号; n. 演唱；鸣声；呼啸声
example: The cargo was due to be offloaded in Singapore three days later.
translation: 货物定于3天后在新加坡卸载。

meaning: v. 高兴；庆祝
example: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
translation: 战争结束，人们终于可以欢欣鼓舞了。

meaning: v. 倾斜；投掷；搭帐篷；坠落; n. 沥青；音高；程度；树脂；倾斜；投掷；球场
example: Footballers in whopping great studded boots walk over the pitch.
translation: 脚蹬帅气钉靴的足球运动员走进了球场。

meaning: n. 自助餐厅
example: People are sprawled on makeshift beds in the cafeteria.
translation: 人们懒散地躺在食堂里搭起的临时床铺上。

meaning: n. 手推车；（美）有轨电车（等于trolley car）；（英）无轨电车（等于trolleybus）；空中吊运车; vi. 乘电车; vt. 用手推车运
example: You'll have to change to the trolleybus next stop.
translation: 你下一站得改乘无轨电车.

meaning: v. 抹去；擦除
example: She tried to erase the memory of that evening.
translation: 她试图忘却那天晚上的事。

meaning: v. 喷射；驱逐，逐出
example: This safety invention will eject the pilot from a burning plane.
translation: 这个安全装置会把飞行员从燃烧着的飞机中弹出.

meaning: adj. 惭愧的，感到难为情的；耻于……的
example: I felt incredibly ashamed of myself for getting so angry.
translation: 我对自己发那么大的火而深感惭愧。

meaning: n. 垃圾，废物；舢板
example: The truth is that junk bonds were misnamed, and therefore misunderstood.
translation: 事实上人们对垃圾债券的称谓有误，所以产生了误解。

meaning: n. 补语；余角；补足物; v. 补足，补助
example: Nutmeg, parsley and cider all complement the flavour of these beans well.
translation: 肉豆蔻、西芹和苹果酒都能很好地突出这些豆子的味道。

meaning: adj. 上面的，上部的；较高的; n. (Upper)人名；(英)厄珀
example: Dictionary order, case - insensitive, uppercase preference, for use with 1252 Character Set.
translation: 字典顺序, 不区分大小写, 大写字母优先, 用于1252字符集.

meaning: adj. 有希望的；有前途的; n. 有希望成功的人
example: They are hopeful of bringing the siege to a peaceful conclusion.
translation: 他们希望能和平结束这次围困。

meaning: n. 关税表；收费表; v. 定税率；征收关税
example: import tariff
translation: 进口关税

meaning: v. 理解；包含；由…组成
example: They can neither read nor write, nor can they comprehend such concepts.
translation: 他们不会读，不会写，也理解不了这样的概念。

meaning: n. [微] 细菌；杆菌属
example: They found a bacterium visible to the human eye.
translation: 他们发现了一种肉眼可见的细菌。

meaning: v. 跌跌撞撞地走；犯大错; n. 大错
example: It had been a monumental blunder to give him the assign-ment.
translation: 当时把这项任务给他是大错特错了。

meaning: n. 电冰箱
example: The fridge door was open and food was scattered across the floor.
translation: 冰箱门开着，食物散落在地板上。

meaning: n. 毛巾，手巾；[纸] 纸巾; v. 用毛巾擦
example: James came out of his bedroom, toweling his wet hair.
translation: 詹姆斯从卧室出来，用毛巾擦着他湿漉漉的头发。

meaning: n. 步枪；来复枪; v. 用步枪射击；抢夺；偷走
example: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle.
translation: 他们用自动步枪近距离开枪射杀了他。

meaning: n. [解剖] 肾脏；腰子；个性
example: Liver and kidney are particularly rich in vitamin A.
translation: 肝脏和肾脏的维生素A含量尤其丰富。

meaning: n. 存储；仓库；贮藏所
example: Jim Coulters will mind the store while I'm away.
translation: 我不在的时候吉姆·库尔特斯会照看店铺的。

meaning: v. 拍卖；竞卖; n. 拍卖
example: The sale is a big coup for the auction house.
translation: 这笔交易是该拍卖行的一大成功之举。

meaning: adj. 庄严的，严肃的；隆重的，郑重的
example: solemn promise
translation: 庄严承诺；誓言

meaning: n. 强度；强烈；[电子] 亮度；紧张
example: The most visible sign of the intensity of the crisis is unemployment.
translation: 预示危机严重程度的一个最显著的迹象就是失业情况。

meaning: n. 假装；骗子；赝品; v. 假装；冒充; adj. 假的；虚假的；假装的
example: A black suitcase containing a number of untraceable blood diamonds will change hands at the Shamal.
translation: 一个装有不定数额血腥钻石的手提箱将在夏马风酒店转手.

meaning: n. 珠宝；珠宝类
example: I spend a lot on expensive jewelry and clothing.
translation: 我花很多钱购买昂贵的首饰和衣服。

meaning: n. 鬼，幽灵; v. 作祟于；替…捉刀；为人代笔
example: They stumble across a ghost town inhabited by a rascally gold prospector.
translation: 他们偶然来到一个居住着一位狡诈的淘金者的废墟之城。

meaning: n. 暴风雨；大动荡; v. 起风暴；横冲直撞；狂怒咆哮
example: tropical storm
translation: 热带风暴

meaning: n. 主；上帝; int. 主，天啊; v. 使成贵族
example: "Good lord, that's what he is: he's a policeman."
translation: “我的天哪，他原来是警察呀。”

meaning: n. 香肠；腊肠；装香肠的碎肉
example: beef sausage
translation: 牛肉香肠

meaning: adj. 处女的；纯洁的；未经利用的，处于原始状态的; n. 处女
example: Somehow she'd always been a child in his mind, pure and virginal.
translation: 不知何故，她在他心里一直是个天真无邪的孩子。

meaning: v. 航行；启航，开船; n. 帆，篷；航行
example: They were going to sail around the little island, against the tide.
translation: 他们打算绕着小岛逆潮航行。

meaning: adj. 立即的；紧急的；紧迫的; n. 瞬间；立即；片刻
example: In the same instant he flung open the car door.
translation: 与此同时，他猛地推开了车门。

meaning: n. 鹿
example: red deer
translation: n. [动]马鹿；欧亚洲的赤鹿

meaning: v. 量化；为…定量；确定数量
example: The risks to health are impossible to quantify.
translation: 健康的风险是无法用数量表示的。

meaning: n. 喜爱，感情；影响；感染
example: Normally, such an outward display of affection is reserved for his mother.
translation: 通常，只有在母亲面前他的情感才会如此外露。

meaning: v. 原谅；免除（债务、义务等）
example: I can never, ever forgive him. I despise him.
translation: 我永远不会原谅他。我鄙视他。

meaning: n. 明信片
example: For more details about these products, send a postcard marked HB/FF.
translation: 要了解这些产品的详细信息，请寄来标明HB/FF字样的明信片。

meaning: n. 传动装置，[机] 变速器；传递；传送；播送
example: Stereo business card printing and membership card making into a reflective and transmissive.
translation: 立体制卡和会员卡制作一般分为透过式与反射式两种.

meaning: v. 背叛；出卖；泄露（秘密）；露出…迹象
example: betray oneself
translation: 原形毕露

meaning: v. 承认；坦白；忏悔；供认
example: You just go to the church and confess your sins.
translation: 你干脆去教堂忏悔自己的罪过吧。

meaning: n. 巫术；魔法；戏法; adj. 不可思议的；有魔力的；魔术的
example: It infected them with some of the magic of a lost age.
translation: 逝去的岁月让他们平添了几分魅力。

meaning: n. 航行；航程；旅行记; v. 航行；航海
example: maiden voyage
translation: n. 初航，首航，处女航

meaning: adj. 明确的；清楚的；直率的；详述的
example: Criticism is hinted at, but never made explicit.
translation: 批评总是含沙射影，但从未明说。

meaning: v. 涂黄油于；讨好; n. 黄油；奶油；奉承话
example: Butter, margarine, and oily fish are all good sources of vitamin D.
translation: 黄油、人造黄油和多脂鱼都含有丰富的维生素D。

meaning: v. 张贴，裱糊；用浆糊粘; n. 面团，膏；糊状物，[胶粘] 浆糊
example: Make deep slashes in the meat and push in the spice paste.
translation: 在肉上切出深深的口子，再把辣酱塞进切口中。

meaning: n. 预约，预订；保留
example: After three days, the strikers' demands were met almost without reservation.
translation: 3天以后，罢工人员的要求几乎全部得到了满足。

meaning: adj. 坚决的；果断的
example: He described the situation as very dangerous and called for resolute action.
translation: 他将形势描述得非常危险，并号召采取果断行动。

meaning: n. 石英
example: The prospectors have discovered such minerals as calcite, quartz and asbestos here.
translation: 探矿人员在这里发现了方解石 、 石英、石棉等矿藏.

meaning: adj. 人造的；仿造的；虚伪的；非原产地的；武断的
example: Organic food is unadulterated food produced without artificial chemicals or pesticides.
translation: 有机食品是未使用人工化学制剂和杀虫剂的纯净食品。

meaning: v. 镀锌于…；涂锌于…；用锌处理; n. 锌
example: Improvement in alkaline etching and smut removing before zincate treatment was summed up.
translation: 对浸锌前处理的碱蚀和出光的改进方法进行了总结.

meaning: v. 耸肩，耸肩表示; n. 耸肩
example: Everybody accepts that the threat has now shrunk to vanishing point.
translation: 现在每个人都认为，威胁已几近消失了。

meaning: n. [电] 电池，蓄电池
example: The battery in my car gave up the ghost.
translation: 我的汽车电池报废了。

meaning: n. 领域；域名；产业；地产
example: The state of their marriage has been put into the public domain.
translation: 他们的婚姻状况已公开。

meaning: v. 打环；翻筋斗; n. 环；圈；弯曲部分；翻筋斗
example: I think that the vice president was in the loop.
translation: 我认为副总统是局内人。

meaning: n. 羊，绵羊；胆小鬼
example: black sheep
translation: 败家子；害群之马

meaning: adj. 绝对的；透明的；峻峭的；纯粹的; adv. 完全；陡峭地; v. 偏航; n. 偏航；透明薄织物
example: sheer nonsense
translation: 一派胡言

meaning: n. 甲板；行李仓；露天平台; v. 装饰；装甲板；打扮
example: All deck fittings, windows, hatches and doors had been fastened.
translation: 甲板上所有的装置、窗户、舱口盖和门都已经关牢了。

meaning: v. 使固定；集中于；扎牢；强加于; n. (Fasten)人名；(英)法森
example: Builders must fasten down roofs of newly-built homes more securely.
translation: 建造工人必须把新建房屋的屋顶固定得更牢靠些。

meaning: v. 安装；任命；安顿
example: Another change that Sue made was to install central heating.
translation: 休所作的另一个改变是安装中央供暖系统。

meaning: adj. 加强的；集中的；透彻的；加强语气的; n. 加强器
example: She spent the night in intensive care after the operation.
translation: 手术后的那个夜晚她在重症监护病房度过。

meaning: adj. 线的，线型的；直线的，线状的；长度的
example: In his art he broke the laws of scientific linear perspective.
translation: 他在自己的绘画艺术中打破了科学的直线透视法规律。

meaning: n. 破坏；失事；残骸；失去健康的人; v. 破坏；使失事；拆毁
example: Mark was dragged from the burning wreckage of his car.
translation: 马克被人从他着火的汽车残骸中拉了出来。

meaning: n. 凳子；粪便；厕所; v. 长新枝；分檗
example: bar stool
translation: 酒吧的高脚凳

meaning: v. 弯腰；屈服；堕落; n. 弯腰，屈背；屈服
example: The criticisms will not stop people flocking to see the film.
translation: 批评的声音不会阻止人们涌到影院观看这部电影。

meaning: adj. 异常的，例外的; n. 超常的学生
example: Capital punishment is allowable only under exceptional circumstances.
translation: 只有特殊情况才允许执行死刑。

meaning: n. 元音；母音; adj. 元音的
example: To mark ( a vowelless Hebrew text , for example ) with vowel points.
translation: 加元音符号于 ( 如没有元音的希伯莱文 )

meaning: n. 巧克力，巧克力糖；巧克力色; adj. 巧克力色的；巧克力口味的
example: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water.
translation: 同时，把碗置于微沸的水上，将白巧克力放入碗中使其熔化。

meaning: n. 主要产品；订书钉；主题；主食; adj. 主要的，大宗生产的；常用的；纺织纤维的; v. 把…分级；钉住
example: The stapler belongs to her.
translation: 这订书机是她的.

meaning: n. 庭院，院子；天井
example: Dena took them into the courtyard to sit in the sun.
translation: 德娜带他们到院子里晒太阳。

meaning: n. 餐巾；餐巾纸；尿布
example: He wiped away the blood with a paper napkin.
translation: 他用纸巾将血迹擦去。

meaning: n. 颤抖；箭袋；震动; v. 颤抖；振动
example: Mack made his voice quiver with fear on these last two words.
translation: 麦克说出最后这两个字时，吓得声音颤抖。

meaning: prep. 对；与相对；对抗
example: Vert or green - Hope, joy and sometimes loyalty in love.
translation: 绿色 - 希望 、 欢乐,有时也表示对爱情的忠贞.

meaning: n. 石头；结石；[宝] 宝石; adj. 石的，石制的; v. 向扔石块；用石头铺
example: leave no stone unturned
translation: 千方百计

meaning: n. 悲剧；灾难；惨案
adj. 亲爱的；尊敬的；昂贵的; adv. 高价地；疼爱地; int. 哎呀; n. 亲爱的人
example: Outside, Bruce glanced at his watch: "Dear me, nearly oneo'clock."
translation: 出了门，布鲁斯瞥了一眼自己的手表，“天哪，快一点了。”

meaning: n. 忍耐力；忍耐；持久；耐久
example: He showed remarkable endurance throughout his illness.
translation: 他在整个生病期间表现出非凡的忍耐力。

meaning: n. 安装；分期付款；部分；就职
example: His car was repossessed because of default of monthly installment.
translation: 因为拖欠按月应付的分期付款,他的汽车被收回了.

meaning: n. 秋天；成熟期；渐衰期，凋落期; adj. 秋天的，秋季的
example: This could be the feel-good movie of the autumn.
translation: 这可以称得上是今秋令人赏心悦目的影片了。

meaning: n. 院长；系主任；教务长；主持牧师
example: Stan Dean, easily identifiable by his oddly-shaped hat, sat in a doorway.
translation: 斯坦·迪安坐在门口，他那顶奇形怪状的帽子一下子就让人认出他来。

meaning: adj. 聋的
example: I hope that our appeals will not fall on deaf ears.
translation: 我希望我们的呼吁不会没人理睬。

meaning: adj. 辐射的；容光焕发的；光芒四射的; n. 光点；发光的物体
example: For 40 years she has captivated the world with her radiant looks.
translation: 40年来，她那令人惊艳的美貌让全世界为之痴迷。

meaning: n. 牧师；神父；教士; vt. 使成为神职人员；任命…为祭司
example: The priest made the sign of the cross over him.
translation: 神父在他上方画了个十字。

meaning: n. 确立，制定；公司；设施
example: The fusty old establishment refused to recognise the demand for popular music.
translation: 这一古板的老旧机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

meaning: adj. 神秘的；不可思议的；难解的
example: Soon they were dead, victims of a mysterious poisoner.
translation: 不久他们就死了，是一个神秘的投毒者下的手。

meaning: n. 情味，风味；香料；滋味; v. 加味于
example: Vegetables such as peppers can overpower the flavor of the stock.
translation: 像甜椒这样的蔬菜会抢了原汤的味道。

meaning: n. 制裁，处罚；认可；支持; v. 制裁，处罚；批准；鼓励
example: The Security Council will consider taking future actions against sanction-busters.
translation: 安理会将考虑未来采取措施打击破坏制裁的人。

meaning: v. 排水；流干; n. 排水；下水道，排水管；消耗
example: I drain the pasta, then I share it out between two plates.
translation: 我将意大利面滤干，然后平分到两个盘子里。

meaning: adj. 临时的，暂时的；中间的；间歇的; n. 过渡时期，中间时期；暂定
example: She was sworn in as head of an interim government in March.
translation: 她3月份宣誓就任过渡政府首脑。

meaning: adj. 持续不断的；频繁的
example: The school has been in continual use since 1883.
translation: 自1883年以来，该校从未停办过。

meaning: n. 同时代的人；同时期的东西; adj. 当代的；同时代的；属于同一时期的
n. 垃圾；废物; v. 丢弃；修剪树枝
example: trash can
translation: 垃圾桶

meaning: adj. 意味深长的；雄辩的，有口才的；有说服力的；动人的
v. 贷；增添，提供；把……借给; n. (Lend)人名；(德)伦德
example: Will you lend me your jacket for a little while?
translation: 你能把上衣借给我穿一会儿吗？

meaning: n. 银河；[天] 星系；银河系；一群显赫的人
example: From this you can calculate the total mass in the Galaxy.
translation: 由此你可以算出银河系的总质量。

meaning: n. 蘑菇，伞菌；蘑菇形物体；暴发户; adj. 蘑菇的；蘑菇形的；迅速生长的; v. 迅速增加；采蘑菇；迅速生长
example: cream of mushroom soup
translation: 奶油蘑菇汤

meaning: v. 模仿；假装；冒充; adj. 模仿的；假装的
example: Training includes realistic simulation of casualty procedures.
translation: 培训包括对急救过程的真实模拟。

meaning: v. 夸口说，自吹自擂说；以有…而自豪; n. 自夸；值得夸耀的事物，引以为荣的事物
example: We remember our mother's stern instructions not to boast.
translation: 我们谨记母亲不许我们在人前炫耀的严厉教诲。

meaning: n. 感觉；轰动；感动
example: Experts agreed that this was a truly sensational performance.
translation: 专家们一致认为这的确是一场精彩绝伦的演出。

meaning: n. 车库；汽车修理厂；飞机库; v. 把……送入车库；把（汽车）开进车库
example: Ben drove past them, nosing his car into the garage.
translation: 本小心翼翼地把车开进车库时从他们身边经过。

meaning: n. 破坏，毁灭；摧毁
example: There is worldwide concern about the destruction of the rainforests.
translation: 全世界都在关注热带雨林遭到破坏的问题。

meaning: n. 腰，腰部
example: Don had a hefty roll of flab overhanging his waistband.
translation: 唐的腰间沉甸甸地坠着一圈赘肉。

meaning: n. 频率；频繁
example: Their instruments detected very faint radiowaves at a frequency of 3 kilohertz.
translation: 他们的仪器检测到一个3千赫的微弱无线电波。

meaning: v. 节约地使用（或管理）; n. 丈夫
example: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
translation: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

meaning: n. 麻布袋；洗劫; v. 解雇；把……装入袋；劫掠
example: Other industries have had to sack managers to reduce administrative costs.
translation: 其他行业只得精简管理人员以减少行政开支。

meaning: adj. 分析的；解析的；善于分析的
example: The analytic method is dialectical.
translation: 分析的方法就是辩证的方法.

meaning: v. 抹掉；用海绵擦拭；讨得; n. 海绵；海绵状物
example: sponge cake
translation: 松糕

meaning: n. 防御；防卫；答辩；防卫设备
example: The defence counsel warned that the judge should stop the trial.
translation: 被告辩护律师强烈建议法官应该休庭。

meaning: n. 条约，协议；谈判
example: More than 7 million shares changed hands, treble the normal daily average.
translation: 有700多万股换手，是通常日平均成交量的3倍。

meaning: v. 使失去能力；使残废；使无资格
example: One bomb can disable a ship.
translation: 一颗炸弹就能炸毁一艘船.

meaning: adj. 便利的；手边的，就近的；容易取得的；敏捷的; n. (Handy)人名；(英)汉迪
example: Keep a pad handy to jot down queries as they occur.
translation: 手边放一本便笺簿，以便有问题时随时记下。

meaning: n. 输出，出口；出口商品; v. 输出物资
example: There is nothing sinister or conspiratorial about the export licensing system.
translation: 这种出口许可制度没有任何阴险或者见不得人的东西。

meaning: n. 热带；回归线; adj. 热带的
example: The company is the world's largest destroyer of tropical forests.
translation: 该公司对热带雨林的破坏位居世界之首。

meaning: adj. 城市的；住在都市的; n. (Urban)人名；(西)乌尔万；(斯洛伐)乌尔班；(德、俄、罗、匈、塞、波、捷、瑞典、意)乌尔班；(英)厄本；(法)于尔邦
example: She describes him as urbane and charming.
translation: 她说他文雅而迷人。

meaning: n. 米；公尺；韵律
example: Prices start at £13.95 a metre for printed cotton.
translation: 印花棉布以每米13.95英镑的价格起售。

meaning: v. 测算，估计；认为；计算
example: I reckon I'm due one of my travels.
translation: 我想我就要开始我的一次旅行了.

meaning: adj. 合作的；合作社的; n. 合作社
example: Cooperative activity is essential to effective community work.
translation: 要把社区工作做好，协作活动是必不可少的。

meaning: v. 修改；改善，改进; n. (Amend)人名；(德、英)阿门德
example: The president agreed to amend the constitution and allow multi-party elections.
translation: 总统同意修订宪法，允许多党选举。

meaning: n. 成语，习语；土话
example: It was an old building in the local idiom.
translation: 这是一座具有当地特色的古建筑.

meaning: n. 门；家，户；门口；通道
example: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
translation: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

meaning: n. 行李；皮箱
example: He waited until all the luggage was cleared, but Paula's never appeared.
translation: 他一直等到所有的行李都拿走了，但始终没看见葆拉的。

meaning: adj. 包括的，包含的
example: inclusive of
translation: 把…包括在内

meaning: v. 唤醒；激起，使振奋；惊起; n. 觉醒；奋起
example: She seemed to be unable to rouse herself to do anything.
translation: 她似乎打不起精神去做任何事情。

meaning: n. 按钮；纽扣; v. 扣住；扣紧；在…上装纽扣
example: I know how to darn, and how to sew a button on.
translation: 我会打补丁，缝纽扣。

meaning: n. 领域，范围；王国
example: This is a target which is surely within the realm of possibility.
translation: 这是一个完全有可能实现的目标。

meaning: v. 享受；款待，宴请; n. 筵席，宴会；节日
example: The feast was served by his mother and sisters.
translation: 这顿美餐是他母亲和他的姐妹们准备的。

meaning: v. 繁荣，昌盛；成功; n. (Prosper)人名；(英、德、罗、法)普罗斯珀
example: The high street banks continue to prosper.
translation: 商业街上的银行仍旧一派繁荣景象。

meaning: n. 笨蛋，傻瓜；白痴
example: He snubbed her in public and made her feel an idiot.
translation: 他当众冷落她，让她觉得自己像一个白痴似的。

meaning: v. 流浪；践踏，踩；脚步沉重地行走; n. 流浪者；沉重的脚步声；徒步旅行
example: Please don't trample on the azaleas.
translation: 请勿踩踏杜鹃花。

meaning: n. 把手；瘤；球形突出物; vi. 鼓起; vt. 使有球形突出物
example: Top the steaming hot potatoes with a knob of butter.
translation: 在冒热气的马铃薯上放一小块黄油。

meaning: adj. 极好的，精彩的，绝妙的；奇妙的；美妙；胜；神妙
example: Wonderfully melodic and tuneful, his songs have made me weep.
translation: 他的歌旋律优美、悦耳动听，让我潸然泪下。

meaning: adj. 防水的，不透水的; v. 使防水; n. 防水材料
example: waterproof paint
translation: 防水涂料；防水漆

meaning: n. 牛；公牛
example: Seize a horse by the mane, and lead an ox by the nose.
translation: 马儿抓鬃牛牵鼻.

meaning: v. 推荐；称赞；把…委托
example: I commend Ms. Orth on writing such an informative article.
translation: 我对奥思太太写出内容如此翔实的文章表示赞许。

meaning: n. [力] 惯性；惰性，迟钝；不活动
example: I can't seem to throw off this feeling of inertia.
translation: 我好像无法摆脱这种无力的感觉。

meaning: n. 瓜；甜瓜；大肚子；圆鼓鼓像瓜似的东西
example: Next, she disembowelled a melon with a quiet fury.
translation: 接着，她闷着头愤愤地掏空瓜瓤。

meaning: n. 克
example: The pro-gramme's researchers are guilty of bias and misrepresentation.
translation: 该项目的研究者们对心存偏见和误解感到非常内疚。

meaning: n. 消防队员；救火队员；锅炉工
example: The fireman evacuated the guests from the burning hotel.
translation: 消防队员把客人们从燃烧着的旅馆中撤出来.

meaning: v. 使工业化

meaning: v. 远足；徒步旅行；上升; n. 远足；徒步旅行；涨价
example: They went on a ten-mile hike through the forest.
translation: 他们做了一次穿越森林的十英里徒步旅行。

meaning: n. 眼罩；斑点；碎片；小块土地; v. 修补；解决；掩饰
example: The company I work for went through a rough patch.
translation: 我所在的公司经历了一段困难时期。

meaning: n. 当中，中间; prep. 在…中间（等于amidst）
example: She stood preening in their midst, delighted with the attention.
translation: 她得意洋洋地站在他们中间，为受人瞩目而高兴。

meaning: n. 物理学家；唯物论者
example: I think he's a physicist or something of that nature.
translation: 我想他大概是物理学家或那一类的人.

meaning: adj. 东方的；东方人的; n. 东方人
example: It sells everything from hair ribbons to oriental rugs.
translation: 这里出售各种商品，从发带到东方小地毯应有尽有。

meaning: n. 嫉妒，妒忌；羡慕; v. 嫉妒，妒忌；羡慕
example: Unconscious envy manifests itself very often as this kind of arrogance.
translation: 潜意识里的嫉妒常表现为这种傲慢自大。

meaning: n. 胶囊；[植] 蒴果；太空舱；小容器; adj. 压缩的；概要的; v. 压缩；简述
example: The police say he swallowed a cyanide capsule to avoid arrest.
translation: 警察说他为了逃避逮捕就吞了一颗氰化物胶囊。

meaning: adj. 综合的；合成的，人造的; n. 合成物
example: Studying the value of science is a new and synthetical study.
translation: 科学价值的向度研究是一个崭新的综合性跨学科领域研究.

meaning: n. 寓言；无稽之谈; vi. 编寓言；虚构; vt. 煞有介事地讲述；虚构
example: The old fable continues to echo down the centuries.
translation: 这则古老的寓言流传了数个世纪。

meaning: n. 通讯记者；客户；通信者；代理商行
example: Frank Deford is a special correspondent for Newsweek magazine.
translation: 弗兰克·德福特是《新闻周刊》杂志的特派记者。

meaning: n. 借口；托辞; vt. 以…为借口
example: They wanted a pretext for subduing the region by force.
translation: 他们想找借口用武力征服这个地区。

meaning: adj. 温和的；文雅的; v. 使温和，使驯服; n. 蛆，饵
example: The blustery winds of spring had dropped to a gentle breeze.
translation: 呼啸的春风已经减弱，成了习习的微风。

meaning: v. 使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面
example: I had to postpone ideas of a career and stay at home.
translation: 我不得不暂缓就业打算，呆在家里。

meaning: n. 一月
example: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd.
translation: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。

meaning: v. 开始；继续进行；发生；行进; n. 收入，获利
example: This can be done if you proceed as follows.
translation: 按照如下操作即可完成。

meaning: n. 羊肉
example: He likes to eat mutton which was seasoned with garlic.
translation: 他喜欢吃用大蒜调味的羊肉.

meaning: n. 职业；占有；消遣；占有期
example: Intellectual life in France was smothered by the occupation.
translation: 在被占领期间法国思想界受到了压制。

meaning: n. 势头；[物] 动量；动力；冲力
example: Demands for his dismissal have gathered momentum in recent weeks.
translation: 最近几周，要求将他解职的呼声越来越高。

meaning: n. [计] 控制台；[电] 操纵台; v. 安慰；慰藉
example: I can console myself with the fact that I'm not alone.
translation: 不是只有我一个人才这样，我可以用这一事实来安慰自己。

meaning: n. 苹果，苹果树，苹果似的东西；[美俚]炸弹，手榴弹，（棒球的）球；[美俚]人，家伙。
example: What will be the effect of the alliance between IBM and Apple?
translation: 若IBM公司和苹果公司联合将会有什么效果呢？

meaning: n. 大教堂
example: As Wren's epitaph famously declares, the cathedral itself is his monument.
translation: 众所周知，雷恩的墓志铭中写道，大教堂本身就是他的纪念碑。

meaning: adv. 轻轻地；温柔地，温和地
example: If your child's temperature rises, sponge her down gently with tepid water.
translation: 如果你孩子的体温上升，就用海绵蘸上温水轻轻地擦拭她的身体。

meaning: adj. 激烈的；猛烈的; n. 烈性泻药
example: Now there is a dawning realisation that drastic action is necessary.
translation: 现在人们开始意识到必须采取断然的行动。

meaning: n. 彩虹；五彩缤纷的排列；幻想; adj. 五彩缤纷的；彩虹状的; vt. 使呈彩虹状；如彩虹般装饰; vi. 呈彩虹状
example: The moon was casting a rainbow through the spray from the waterfall.
translation: 月亮在瀑布溅起的水雾上照出了一道彩虹。

meaning: n. 中午；正午；全盛期
example: There is a ceaseless struggle from noon to night.
translation: 从中午到夜晚，争斗没有停歇。

meaning: n. 循环，周期；圆；圈子；圆形物; v. 盘旋，旋转；环行
example: The process is not a circle but rather a spiral.
translation: 这个过程不是一个圆周运动而是螺旋上升型的。

meaning: adj. 东北的；向东北的；来自东北的; n. 东北; adv. 向东北；来自东北
example: Snow in October is nothing strange in northeast China.
translation: 10月下雪在东北不是什么希罕的事.

meaning: n. [化学] 硅；硅元素
example: a silicone breast implant
translation: 硅酮隆胸植入物

meaning: adv. 非常；极其；极度地；极端
example: Physical perfection in a human being is exceedingly rare.
translation: 体貌完美的人极为罕见。

meaning: n. 威严；最高权威，王权；雄伟；权威
example: The daily grind of government is done by Her Majesty's Civil Service.
translation: 枯燥的日常政务都由女王陛下的政府行政部门来处理。

meaning: n. 发言人；代言人
example: Spokespeople for both campaigns did not respond to questions.
translation: 两家竞选团队的发言人均没有就此问题做出回应.

meaning: n. 暗示；线索; v. 暗示；示意
example: "I think I hear the telephone ringing."—"Okay, I can take a hint."
translation: “我想我听到电话铃在响。”——“好的，我明白你的意思了。”

meaning: n. 瓶子；一瓶的容量; v. 控制；把…装入瓶中
example: As I sidestepped, the bottle hit me on the left hip.
translation: 我侧一步要躲闪的时候，瓶子打中了我的左髋部。

meaning: n. 界面；<计>接口；交界面; v. （使通过界面或接口）接合，连接；[计算机]使联系
example: The different components all have to interface smoothly.
translation: 不同的部件都必须能顺利接合。

meaning: n. 谷类，谷物；谷类食品；谷类植物; adj. 谷类的；谷类制成的
example: Fibre is found in cereal foods, beans, fruit and vegetables.
translation: 谷类食品、豆类、水果和蔬菜中含有纤维素。

meaning: n. 娱乐；消遣；款待
example: Crudeness is on the rise in all fields of entertainment.
translation: 所有娱乐领域都日益粗俗化。

meaning: v. 安排，计划；编制目录；将……列入计划表; n. 时间表；计划表；一览表
example: The volume of scheduled flights is straining the air traffic control system.
translation: 定期航班的数量正让空中交通指挥系统不堪重负。

meaning: n. 大陆；本土; adj. 大陆的；本土的
example: The island may be reached by boat from the mainland.
translation: 这个岛屿可以从大陆乘小船到达。

meaning: adj. 轻率的；鲁莽的；不顾后果的; n. [皮肤] 皮疹；突然大量出现的事物
example: He may break out in a rash when he eats these nuts.
translation: 他吃了这些坚果可能会长皮疹。

meaning: n. 鉴定，识别；认同；身份证明
example: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
translation: 稍稍停顿了一下，他问道，“你有任何身份证明吗？”

meaning: adj. 温柔的；柔软的；脆弱的；幼稚的；难对付的; n. 偿付，清偿；看管人；小船; v. 提供，偿还；使…变嫩；使…变柔软
example: The Tenderee will issue the Bidding Document after receiving the confirmation letter and bid security.
translation: 招标人在收到投标人的确认函和投标保证金后,发出招标文件.

meaning: v. 给…穿衣；覆盖；赋予
example: They clothe their children in the latest fashions.
translation: 他们给他们的孩子穿最时髦的服装。

meaning: n. 天鹅绒，丝绒；天鹅绒似的东西; adj. 天鹅绒的
example: My teeth feel like they're covered with velveteen.
translation: 我的牙齿就好像覆盖了一层东西一样.

meaning: n. [劳经] 加班时间；延长时间；加时赛; adj. 超时的；加班的; vt. 使超过时间; adv. 加班地
example: He would work overtime, without pay, to finish a job.
translation: 他会为了完成工作无偿加班。

meaning: v. 伤害；给留下伤痕; n. 创伤；伤痕
example: The scarab image was used for recording historical events.
translation: 圣甲虫像用于记录历史性事件.

meaning: adj. 钝的，不锋利的；生硬的；直率的; v. 使迟钝; n. (Blunt)人名；(英)布伦特
example: The blunt comment made Richard laugh in spite of himself.
translation: 这番率直的话让理查德不由自主地大笑起来。

meaning: n. 温度；体温；气温；发烧
example: My father, who had always been very self-controlled, became bad-tempered.
translation: 平素一直非常自制的父亲变得暴躁了。

meaning: n. 蜡烛；烛光；烛形物; v. 对着光检查
example: The tramp produced a stump of candle from his deep pockets.
translation: 流浪汉从深口袋里掏出了一截蜡烛。

meaning: n. 束；捆; v. 捆
example: Splitting the price six ways had still cost them each a bundle.
translation: 即使把价钱平摊成6份，每人也还是要花一大笔钱。

meaning: v. 赶上；压倒；突然来袭
example: Pulling out to overtake, the car collided head-on with a van.
translation: 越线超车时，轿车和一辆厢式货车迎面相撞。

meaning: n. 混沌，混乱
example: Whatever troubles arise, we'll have peace of mind amidst seeming chaos.
translation: 无论出现什么样的麻烦，我们都会在貌似混乱的情形中保持平和的心态。

meaning: adj. 歇斯底里的；异常兴奋的
example: Paul Mazursky was Master of Ceremonies, and he was pretty hysterical.
translation: 保罗·马祖尔斯基担任司仪，他简直把人笑坏了。

meaning: n. 冥想；沉思，深思
example: The title track is a pointed meditation on a continent gone wrong.
translation: 主打歌是对一个误入歧途的大陆的深刻沉思。

meaning: n. 一致；和谐
example: Cancellation charges will apply in accordance with paragraph 4 above.
translation: 按照上面第四节条款内容应该支付注销费.

meaning: n. 走廊
example: The young man led Mark Ryle along a corridor.
translation: 那个年轻人领着马克·赖尔沿走廊而去。

meaning: v. 追逐；追捕；试图赢得；雕镂; n. 追逐；追赶；追击
example: Ellery's return will help to chase away some of the gloom.
translation: 埃勒里的归来可以驱散一些抑郁的情绪。

meaning: v. 抑制，控制；约束；制止
example: Unable to restrain herself, she rose and went to the phone.
translation: 她没能克制住自己，起身走向电话。

meaning: n. 物质；实质；资产；主旨
example: The cold has made already substandard living conditions even worse.
translation: 寒冷使得已经较差的生活环境变得更糟糕。

meaning: n. 冒险；冒险精神；投机活动; v. 冒险；大胆说出
example: They'rewritten as adventure stories. They're not intended to be deep.
translation: 它们是作为历险故事来写的，并没打算追求深刻。

meaning: n. 副词; adj. 副词的
example: Adverb is to describe a verb or an action .
translation: 副词是来形容一个动词或一个动作。

meaning: n. 火炉，熔炉
example: The flame in the furnace can be looked at through coloured glasses.
translation: 可以通过有色眼镜观看高炉内的火焰.

meaning: adj. 可疑的；暧昧的；无把握的；半信半疑的
example: They would now find some dubious pretext to restart the war.
translation: 他们现在会找个蹩脚的借口重新发动战争。

meaning: v. 骚扰；惹恼；打搅; n. 烦恼（等于annoyance）
example: As the years went by his nastiness began to annoy his readers.
translation: 年深日久，他恶毒的文字开始让读者生厌。

meaning: adj. 有责任的，有义务的；应受罚的；有…倾向的；易…的
example: Offenders will be liable to a seven-year prison term.
translation: 违犯者可判处7年监禁。

meaning: adj. 粘的；粘性的
example: sticky rice
translation: n. 糯米

meaning: adj. 口渴的，口干的；渴望的，热望的
example: Cairo has only thirteen square centimetres of green space for each inhabitant.
translation: 开罗居民的人均绿地面积仅13平方厘米。

meaning: n. 篮子；（篮球比赛的）得分；一篮之量；篮筐; vt. 装入篮
example: He'd put his dirty laundry in the clothes basket.
translation: 他会把自己的脏衣服扔进洗衣篮里。

meaning: n. 图表；海图；图纸；排行榜; v. 绘制…的图表；在海图上标出；详细计划；记录；记述；跟踪（进展或发展
example: The chart can then display the links connecting these groups.
translation: 这张图就会显示出这些群体之间的关联。

meaning: n. 螺母，螺帽；坚果；难对付的人，难解的问题; v. 采坚果
example: The Daily Express describes Dr Carey as a pretty tough nut.
translation: 《每日快报》把凯里医生说成是特别难对付的家伙。

meaning: adv. 在楼上，向楼上；上楼；往楼上; adj. 楼上的; n. 楼上
example: go upstairs
translation: 上楼；爬楼梯

meaning: n. 花园；菜园; v. 栽培花木
example: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
translation: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

meaning: n. 助手，大副；配偶；同事；配对物; v. 使配对；使一致；结伴
example: "How are you, mate?" — "Not bad, mate, how's yourself?"
translation: “最近怎么样，老兄？”——“还不错，你呢？”

meaning: adj. 垂直的，直立的；[解剖] 头顶的，顶点的; n. 垂直线，垂直面
example: On the Structure of " Nationality Corridor " and " Two Verticality & Three Horizontality "
translation: 论 “ 民族走廊 ” 及 “ 二纵三横 ” 的格局.

meaning: n. 墓地；公墓
example: We got arrested once, for singing bawdy songs in a cemetery.
translation: 我们曾经因为在公墓唱下流歌曲而被拘留过一次。

meaning: n. 仙女，小精灵；漂亮姑娘; adj. 虚构的；仙女的
example: The story ascends from a gothic tragedy to a miraculous fairy-tale.
translation: 故事从一个哥特式悲剧升华为神奇的童话。

meaning: n. 灯笼；提灯；灯笼式天窗
example: I've been thinking I'd better have asked for a lantern.
translation: 我一直认为我还不如要一个灯笼呢.

meaning: adj. 无知的；愚昧的
example: Authors are famously ignorant about the realities of publishing.
translation: 作者们不了解出版界的实际情况，这是人所共知的。

meaning: v. 闪光；闪烁; n. 闪光；灿烂
example: Gary Glitter, 48, revealed the secret of his youthful looks.
translation: 48岁的加里·格利特透露了他青春永驻的秘密。

meaning: n. 背心；汗衫; v. 授予；使穿衣
example: It is a gardener's improvement on the vestal of the forest, the wild cherry.
translation: 它是一个园艺家培养出的森林修女-野樱桃的一个变种.

meaning: adj. 橙色的；橘色的; n. 橙；橙色；桔子
example: Hybridising the two species will reduce the red to orange.
translation: 将这两个物种杂交后颜色会由红色淡化成橙色。

meaning: v. 迫害；困扰；同…捣乱
example: They persecute those who do not conform to their ideas.
translation: 他们迫害那些不信奉他们思想的人.

meaning: n. 否决权; v. 否决；禁止
example: veto power
translation: 否决权

meaning: n. 农业；农耕；农业生产；农艺，农学
example: Kaspar had spoken know-ledgeably about the state of agriculture in Europe.
translation: 卡斯帕对欧洲农业状况发表了一番颇有见地的见解。

meaning: n. 家庭主妇
example: She seemed less like a poetess than a distracted housewife.
translation: 她似乎不像个女诗人，更像一个心烦意乱的家庭主妇。

meaning: n. 准备；预赛；初步措施; adj. 初步的；开始的；预备的
example: The winner of each preliminary goes through to the final.
translation: 每场初赛的获胜者进入决赛。

meaning: v. 用粉笔写；用白垩粉擦；记录；规划; n. 粉笔；白垩；用粉笔划的记号; adj. 用粉笔写的
example: The two places, he insists, are as different as chalk and cheese.
translation: 他坚持说那两个地方有天壤之别。

meaning: n. 天花板；上限
example: Flavell had accidentally discharged a pistol, firing it into the ceiling.
translation: 弗拉维尔不小心扳动了一把手枪的扳机，子弹射入了天花板。

meaning: n. 航行；航海
example: The expedition was wrecked by bad planning and poor navigation.
translation: 这次探险因计划不周和导航不利而失败。

meaning: n. 共产主义
example: He was a politically conscious fighter for communism.
translation: 在政治上,他是个自觉的共产主义战士.

meaning: n. 围巾；嵌接，嵌接处；头巾领巾; v. 披嵌接；用围巾围
example: His scarfpin was a large diamond, oddly set.
translation: 他的领带别针是一颗很大的钻石, 不过镶嵌得奇特古怪.

meaning: v. 惊吓；把…吓跑; n. 恐慌；惊吓；惊恐; adj. （美）骇人的
example: Then he took a poke at my hair, telling me I looked like a scarecrow!
translation: 然后他开始嘲笑我的头发, 说我看起来像个稻草人!

meaning: n. 婚约；约会；交战；诺言
example: The constitution prohibits them from military engagement on foreign soil.
translation: 宪法禁止他们在外国采取军事行动。

meaning: n. 骚动；喧嚣
n. 鼠标；老鼠；胆小羞怯的人; v. 探出
example: Use your mouse to drag the pictures to their new size.
translation: 用鼠标拖动图片，将其调整为新的尺寸。

meaning: n. 传奇；浪漫史；风流韵事；冒险故事; v. 虚构；渲染；写传奇
example: Producers decided to end her on-screen romance with Pierce Lawton.
translation: 制片人决定结束她在影片中与皮尔斯·劳顿的恋情。

meaning: n. 动词；动词词性；动词性短语或从句; adj. 动词的；有动词性质的；起动词作用的
example: They were jostled and subjected to a torrent of verbal abuse.
translation: 他们被推来搡去，受到大肆的谩骂攻击。

meaning: v. 辅导；约束; n. 导师；家庭教师；助教
example: private tutor
translation: 私人教师，家庭教师

meaning: adj. 社交的；好交际的；友善的; n. 联谊会
example: Hall very sociably pulled up.
translation: 霍尔和气地勒住僵绳.

meaning: adj. 健全的；理智的；[临床] 神志正常的; n. (Sane)人名；(日)实(姓)；(日)实(名)；(芬、塞、冈、几比、塞内)萨内
example: Did he come across as a sane rational person?
translation: 他看起来是一个正常而理智的人吗？

meaning: n. 沙；沙地；沙洲；沙滩；沙子; v. 撒沙于；以沙掩盖；用砂纸等擦平或磨光某物；使撒沙似地布满；给…掺沙子
example: The sand on the floor scrunched under our feet.
translation: 地板上的沙子在我们脚下嘎吱作响。

meaning: n. 楼梯，阶梯；梯级
example: America'sFirst Lady stood on the sweeping staircase of the White House.
translation: 美国第一夫人站在白宫的弧形楼梯上。

meaning: n. 蒸气（等于vapor）；水蒸气
example: His readings of her seemed now to be vapoury and indistinct.
translation: 他现在对她的认识似乎是既虚幻而又朦胧.

meaning: v. 统一；使相同，使一致
n. 内地；内陆; adj. 内陆的；内地的；国内的; adv. 在内地；向内地；向内陆；在内陆
example: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
translation: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

meaning: n. [化学] 氢
example: Hydrogen is used extensively in industry for the production of ammonia.
translation: 氢气在工业上广泛用于制氨。

meaning: adj. 聪明的；机灵的；熟练的
example: Northbridge is a cool, calculating and clever criminal who could strike again.
translation: 诺思布里奇是个头脑冷静、诡计多端、阴险狡诈的罪犯，他可能还会犯案。

meaning: v. 繁殖；饲养；产生; n. [生物] 品种；种类，类型
example: If they are unemployed it's bound to breed resentment.
translation: 如果他们失去工作，一定会产生怨恨。

meaning: adv. 总是；不变地；一定地
example: The Inspector remembered her as a small, mousy woman, invariably worried.
translation: 检察官记得，她是一个矮小、羞怯、总是闷闷不乐的人。

meaning: n. 演讲；讲稿；教训; v. 演讲；训诫
example: Chuck would lecture me, telling me to get a haircut.
translation: 查克就会数落我，让我去理一下发。

meaning: n. 货摊；畜栏；托辞; v. 停止，停转；拖延
example: market stall
translation: 街市档位

meaning: n. 暴风雪；雪暴
example: If you design your kid's Halloween costume to fit over a snowsuit, you live in Ontario.
translation: 如果你给孩子设计的鬼节服装要适合穿在风雪衣外面, 那你是住在安大略省.

meaning: n. 边界；范围；分界线
example: Just before the town boundary fork left onto a minor road.
translation: 快到城镇边界时要走岔路的左边一条小路。

meaning: n. 黑人; adj. 黑人的
example: The Negro minstrel is touring the country.
translation: 那个黑人歌舞团正在全国各地巡回演出.

meaning: n. 暂停；间歇; v. 暂停，停顿，中止；踌躇
example: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
translation: 稍稍停顿了一下，他问道，“你有任何身份证明吗？”

meaning: n. 投票；民意测验；投票数；投票所; v. 投票；剪短；对…进行民意测验；获得选票; adj. 无角的；剪过毛的；修过枝的
example: He will have been heartened by the telephone opinion poll published yesterday.
translation: 他会为昨天公布的电话民意调查结果感到鼓舞。

meaning: n. 杆；极点；电极; v. 用竿支撑
example: She is a pole dancer at London's famous Spearmint Rhino club.
translation: 她是伦敦著名的“薄荷犀牛”夜总会的钢管舞舞者。

meaning: adj. 麻烦的；讨厌的；使人苦恼的
example: He has touched troublesomely in his work.
translation: 他已在他的工作中碰上了麻烦.

meaning: adj. 椭圆的；卵形的; n. 椭圆形；卵形
example: Congress is waiting to see how the Oval Office will react.
translation: 国会正观望总统方面的反应。

meaning: n. 刺痛；讽刺，刺激；刺毛; v. 刺；驱使；使…苦恼；使…疼痛
n. 障碍；不利条件，不利的因素; v. 妨碍，阻碍；使不利
example: I see your handicap is down from 16 to 12.
translation: 我发现你的差点已从16杆降到了12杆。

meaning: n. 道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物
example: Nancy wasn't sure what to make of Mick's apology.
translation: 南希不知应该如何理解米克的道歉。

meaning: n. 肖像；描写；半身雕塑像
example: Today his picture goes on show at the National Portrait Gallery.
translation: 今天他的画作在国家肖像美术馆展出。

meaning: v. 受压缩小
example: He never understood how to organize or compress large masses of material.
translation: 他从来就不懂如何对大篇的材料进行整理或精简。

meaning: n. 咳嗽，咳嗽声；咳嗽病; v. 咳出
example: Will this be enough to persuade Congress to cough up?
translation: 这能说服国会掏钱吗？

meaning: v. 后退；减弱
example: If untreated, the gums recede, become swollen and bleed.
translation: 如果不进行治疗，牙龈会开始萎缩、红肿和出血。

meaning: adj. 灵巧的；整洁的；优雅的；齐整的；未搀水的；平滑的
example: Neat solutions are not easily found to these issues.
translation: 很难找到解决这些问题的巧妙办法。

meaning: n. （植物的）茎，秆；（支持叶子、果实和花的）梗，柄；追踪；高视阔步; v. 追踪，潜近；高视阔步
example: Did you know that John Lennon was murdered by a stalker?
translation: 你知道约翰列侬就是被追星族杀掉的 吗 ?

meaning: adj. 陈腐的；不新鲜的; v. 变陈旧；撒尿；变得不新鲜; n. 尿
example: Efforts to break the stalemate in the peace talks continue.
translation: 打破和平谈判僵局的努力仍在继续.

meaning: n. 盐；风趣，刺激性; adj. 咸水的；含盐的，咸味的；盐腌的；猥亵的; v. 用盐腌；给…加盐；将盐撒在道路上使冰或雪融化
example: Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of cayenne.
translation: 调以盐、胡椒和少许辣椒粉。

meaning: n. 英镑；重击，重击声；兽栏；拘留所; v. 捣烂；敲打；监禁，拘留
example: The one thousand pound bomb was triggered by a wire.
translation: 那颗重达1,000磅的炸弹是由一根导线引爆的。

meaning: n. 脖子；衣领；海峡; v. 搂著脖子亲吻；变狭窄
example: He shouted at his brother, his neck veins bulging.
translation: 他朝他的兄弟吼叫，脖子上青筋暴突。

meaning: v. 投；抛；掷; n. 投掷；冒险
example: Now they are producing throwaway razors.
translation: 他们正在生产一次性剃须刀。

meaning: vt. 筑成池塘; vi. 筑成池塘; n. 池塘
example: Tourist numbers from across the pond have dropped dramatically.
translation: 来自大西洋彼岸的游客数量已急剧减少。

meaning: n. 邮票；印记；标志；跺脚; v. 铭记；标出；盖章于…；贴邮票于…；用脚踩踏
example: A wall collapsed and 39 people, were killed in the panic-stricken stampede.
translation: 一堵墙倒了，慌乱中有39人死于踩踏事故。

meaning: n. 分数；部分；小部分；稍微
example: If a stranger stops you, just wind the window down a fraction.
translation: 如果有陌生人拦你的车，把车窗摇下一点点就行。

meaning: n. 异议，反对；缺陷，缺点；妨碍；拒绝的理由
example: I no longer have any objection to your going to see her.
translation: 我不会再因为你去见她而不高兴。

meaning: adj. 荒凉的；无人烟的; v. 使荒凉；使孤寂
example: Half-ruined, hardly a building untouched, it's a desolate place.
translation: 这里大半遭毁，几乎没有一栋建筑完好无损，变成了一块荒废之地。

meaning: v. 烤，焙；烘，烘烤；暴露于某种热力下以得温暖; adj. 烘烤的；烤过的; n. 烤肉；烘烤
example: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
translation: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

meaning: n. 总部；指挥部；司令部
example: Its headquarters will soon be relocated from Westminster to the Greenwich site.
translation: 其总部很快将从威斯敏斯特迁往格林尼治。

meaning: n. 到来；到达；到达者
example: On arrival, a six-course meal was top of the agenda.
translation: 他们到达之后要做的第一件事是吃一顿六道菜的大餐。

meaning: n. 手帕；头巾，围巾
example: She balled the handkerchief up and threw it at his feet.
translation: 她把手绢揉成一团，丢在了他的脚边。

meaning: n. 胃；腹部；胃口; v. 忍受；吃下
example: Henry got a stomachache and asked to be excused.
translation: 亨利肚子疼请求离开一下.

meaning: adj. [核] 放射性的；有辐射的
example: The waste is safely locked away until it is no longer radioactive.
translation: 废料被安全储存起来，直到其不再有辐射性。

meaning: n. 悲伤；懊悔；伤心事; v. 懊悔；遗憾；感到悲伤
example: Roy told his sorrowful tale with simple words anybody could understand.
translation: 罗伊用简单的、人人都能理解的语言讲述了他那个伤感的故事。

meaning: n. 油轮；运油飞机；油槽车；坦克手
example: oil tanker
translation: 油轮；油罐车

meaning: v. 旋转；循环; adj. [植] 辐状的
example: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
translation: 伴随着隆隆的低沉噪声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

meaning: v. 使…卷曲；使卷起来; n. 卷曲；卷发；螺旋状物
example: A curl of black hair fell loosely across his forehead.
translation: 他的额头上垂着一绺散开的黑色卷发。

meaning: n. 收到；收据；收入; v. 收到
example: I'm going to make out a receipt for you.
translation: 我开一张收据给你。

meaning: adj. 积分的；完整的，整体的；构成整体所必须的; n. 积分；部分；完整
example: Rituals and festivals form an integral part of every human society.
translation: 仪式与节日构成了任何人类社会不可缺少的一部分。

meaning: n. 面包；生计; v. 在…上洒面包屑
example: For her, books were as necessary to life as bread.
translation: 对她来说，书就像面包一样，是生活必需品。

meaning: n. 进口，进口货；输入；意思，含义；重要性; v. 输入，进口；含…的意思
example: We import an incredible amount of cheese from the Continent.
translation: 我们从欧洲大陆进口数量惊人的奶酪。

meaning: n. 综合，[化学] 合成；综合体
example: There are many amino acids that the body cannot synthesise itself.
translation: 有许多种氨基酸人体自身不能合成.

meaning: n. 盒式磁带；暗盒；珠宝箱；片匣
example: I dis-covered a mutilated cassette stuffed in a waste-basket.
translation: 我发现一盘被弄坏的盒式磁带丢在废纸篓里。

meaning: n. 刀；匕首; v. 用刀切；（口）伤害
example: She produced the knife during arguments with her friends.
translation: 在和朋友争吵的时候，她掏出了刀。

meaning: n. 蝴蝶；蝶泳；举止轻浮的人；追求享乐的人
example: She wore butterfly glasses and had a beehive hairdo.
translation: 她戴着一副蝶形眼镜，顶着一头蜂窝式发型。

meaning: v. 按铃；敲钟；回响；成环形; n. 戒指；铃声，钟声；拳击场；环形物
example: If you'd like more information, ring the Hotline on 414 3929.
translation: 如果想了解更多信息，请拨打热线电话4143929。

meaning: n. 福利；幸福；福利事业；安宁; adj. 福利的；接受社会救济的
example: In truth, this is not socialism, but an extension of long standing corporate welfarism.
translation: 实际上, 这不是社会主义, 而是长期的公司福利主义的延伸.

meaning: n. 目的地，终点
example: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home.
translation: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。

meaning: n. 折扣；贴现率; v. 贴现；打折扣出售商品
example: I'll sell at a discount in return for a speedy sale.
translation: 为了尽快售出，我会打折销售。

meaning: n. 气体；[矿业] 瓦斯；汽油；毒气; v. 加油；毒（死）
example: natural gas
translation: 天然气

meaning: adj. 快乐的；放荡的；艳丽的; n. 同性恋者
example: Curiously, the word "gay" does not occur in the index.
translation: 奇怪的是，gay这个词没有出现在索引当中。

meaning: n. 海报，广告；招贴
example: The current national poster child is a tiny, freckle-faced redhead.
translation: 现在的那个全国广告代言人个头不高，红头发，脸上有雀斑。

meaning: n. 充裕，丰富
example: The shallow sea bed yields up an abundance of food.
translation: 浅海床提供了丰富的食物。

meaning: n. 蚊子
example: I threw aside my mosquito net and jumped out of bed.
translation: 我把蚊帐甩到一边，跳下床来。

meaning: n. 暴乱；放纵；蔓延; v. 骚乱；放荡
example: Twelve inmates have been killed during a riot at the prison.
translation: 12名犯人在一场监狱暴乱中被杀害。

meaning: n. 壁橱；议事室，密室；小房间; adj. 秘密的，私下的；空谈的; v. 把…关在私室中
example: I suspect he's a closet fascist.
translation: 我怀疑他是秘密的法西斯分子。

meaning: v. 恢复；弥补；重新获得; n. 还原至预备姿势
example: Legal action is being taken to try to recover the money.
translation: 正在进行诉讼以收回那笔钱。

meaning: adj. 晕眩的；使人头晕的；昏乱的；心不在焉的；愚蠢的; v. 使头晕眼花；使混乱；使茫然; n. (Dizzy)人名；(英)迪齐
example: The person may become dizzy for no apparent reason.
translation: 这类人可能会莫名其妙地感到头晕。

meaning: n. 橡树；橡木色；橡木家具; adj. 栎树的；栎木制的
example: The wind was bouncing the branches of the big oak trees.
translation: 一棵棵高大橡树的枝条随风摇摆。

meaning: adj. 连贯的；连续不断的
example: Between 1940 and 1943 he had a string of 62 consecutive victories.
translation: 他在1940年至1943年间连续62次获胜。

meaning: adj. 旋转的，转动的；轮流的; n. 旋转式机器；[动力] 转缸式发动机
example: A rotary telephone has a wheel with holes for each number.
translation: 转盘式电话有个带眼的轮子.

meaning: n. 桨；橹；桨手; vt. 划（船）; vi. 划行
example: An oar often acts as rudder.
translation: 桨常可起舵的作用.

meaning: n. 飞行；班机；逃走; v. 射击；使惊飞
example: She made her first and only space flight last September.
translation: 她第一次也是唯一一次宇宙飞行是在去年9月。

meaning: n. 壶；[化工] 釜；罐；鼓
example: I filled the kettle while she was talking and plugged it in.
translation: 她说话间，我把水壶灌满并插上了电源。

meaning: n. 提议，建议；求婚
example: After a three-weekend courtship, Pamela accepted Randolph's proposal of marriage.
translation: 经过3个周末的追求之后，帕梅拉接受了伦道夫的求婚。

meaning: adj. 熟的，成熟的；时机成熟的; vt. 搜查；调查; vi. 进行搜查; n. (Ripe)人名；(意、瑞典)里佩
example: The conditions are ripe for the spread of disease.
translation: 这种疾病传播的条件已经成熟。

meaning: n. 相似；相似之处；相似物；肖像
example: Our tour prices bore little resemblance to those in the holiday brochures.
translation: 我们的旅游报价和那些度假手册里的价格相去甚远。

meaning: v. 发现；揭开；揭露
example: His long, uncovered hair flew back in the wind.
translation: 他那露在外面的长发随风向后飞舞。

meaning: n. 说明；插图；例证；图解
example: The illustration shows a cluster of five roses coloured apricot orange.
translation: 插图上是一簇杏橙色的玫瑰，一共5朵。

meaning: n. 苗圃；托儿所；温床
example: We have started a campaign for better nursery and school services.
translation: 我们已发起一场要求改善幼儿园和中小学教育服务的运动。

meaning: n. 外甥女，侄女
example: He looked affectionately at his niece.
translation: 他慈爱地看着他的侄女。

meaning: n. 避难；避难所；庇护; vt. 给予…庇护；接纳…避难; vi. 避难；逃避
example: We climbed up a winding track towards a mountain refuge.
translation: 我们沿着一条蜿蜒的小道爬向山上的一处避难所。

meaning: n. 自助餐；小卖部；打击；猛烈冲击; v. 与…搏斗；连续猛击; adj. 自助的；自助餐的
example: At lunchtime, there's a choice between the buffet or the set menu.
translation: 午餐可以吃自助餐，也可以选套餐。

meaning: v. 挤；紧握；勒索; n. 压榨；紧握；拥挤；佣金
example: squeeze casting
translation: 模压铸造，压挤铸造

meaning: v. 正视，面对；想像
example: What level of profit do you envisage?
translation: 你预计会有什么样的利润水平？

meaning: v. 折磨；拷问；歪曲; n. 折磨；拷问；歪曲
example: This is a torturous, agonizing way to kill someone.
translation: 这是一种让人受尽折磨、痛苦难忍的杀人方法。

meaning: n. 冠军；拥护者；战士; v. 支持；拥护; adj. 优胜的；第一流的
example: The heavyweight champion will be given a shot at Holyfield's world title.
translation: 这名重量级拳击冠军将尝试挑战霍利菲尔德的世界冠军头衔。

meaning: n. 共和国；共和政体
example: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
translation: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

meaning: v. 掷，抛；嘲笑；使陷入；轻蔑地投射；猛动; n. 掷，抛；嘲弄；急冲
example: She claims she had a brief fling with him 30 years ago.
translation: 她声称在30年前曾和他有过一段短暂的风流韵事。

meaning: adj. 音乐的；悦耳的; n. 音乐片
example: London's musical life might become as exciting as Berlin's.
translation: 伦敦的音乐生活可能会变得像柏林的一样令人兴奋。

meaning: n. 黄昏，薄暮；幽暗，昏暗; adj. 微暗的; v. 使变微暗
example: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
translation: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

meaning: n. 公告，公报; v. 公布，公告
example: The Internet is the largest computer bulletin board in the world.
translation: 因特网是世界上最大的计算机公告系统。
