example: Comet also sired the champion foal out of Spinway Harvest.
translation: “彗星”还跟“斯平威·哈维斯特”生下了这匹出类拔萃的小马驹。

meaning: n. 鱼苗；油炸食物; v. 油炸；油煎
example: Fry remaining peppers, adding a little more dressing if necessary.
translation: 用油炸一下剩下的辣椒，如果需要再加点调味汁。

meaning: n. 张力，拉力；紧张，不安；电压; vt. 使紧张；使拉紧
example: This is the result of tensional or compressional forces originating from tectonic movement.
translation: 当岩石受到因地壳板块移动而产生的张力或横压力时,断层便会出现.

meaning: adj. 季度的，按季度的；一年四次的; adv. 按季度，[农] 一季一次地；纵横四分地; n. 季刊
example: In 1987 Congressional Quarterly published a series of guidebooks to American politics.
translation: 1987年《国会季刊》出版了一系列美国政治指南读物。

meaning: v. 使闪光；反射; n. 闪光，闪现；一瞬间; adj. 闪光的，火速的
example: She had heard the news-flash on a TV channel's news update.
translation: 她在一家电视台的新闻快讯中听到了这则简明新闻。

meaning: n. 大理石；大理石制品；弹珠; adj. 大理石的；冷酷无情的
example: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.
translation: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。

meaning: adj. 生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的
example: They get angry if they think they are being treated disrespectfully.
translation: 他们要是觉得受到了怠慢，就会大动肝火。

meaning: adj. 明显的；独特的；清楚的；有区别的
example: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
translation: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

meaning: adj. 不舒服的；心神不安的；不稳定的
example: uneasy about
translation: 担忧

meaning: v. 选择
example: To keep the cost down, opt for a basic model.
translation: 要想花钱少些，就选择基本的型号。

meaning: n. 讽刺；讽刺文学，讽刺作品
example: Looking at her satiric parent she only gave a little laugh.
translation: 她望着她那挖苦人的父亲,只讪讪地笑了一下.

meaning: adj. 高兴的；乐意的；令人高兴的；灿烂美丽的; vt. 使高兴; n. (Glad)人名；(塞、瑞典)格拉德；(英)格莱德；(法、挪)格拉
example: I'm so glad to see you back where you belong.
translation: 我真高兴看到你又回到了属于你自己的天地。

meaning: n. 草；草地，草坪; v. 放牧；使……长满草；使……吃草
example: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
translation: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

meaning: n. 柜，箱；上锁的人；有锁的橱柜；锁扣装置；有锁的存物柜
example: At the swimming pool I put my clothes in a locker.
translation: 在游泳池我把衣服锁在小柜里.

meaning: adj. 偶然的；临时的；特殊场合的
example: She saw the occasional glimmer of a moth's wings.
translation: 她看见蛾子的翅膀偶尔会泛光。

meaning: adj. 健全的；有益健康的；合乎卫生的；审慎的
example: The papers we found shed some valuable light on this question, wholesomely contradicting all lies.
translation: 我们找到的这些论文资料对认识这个问题很有帮助, 有利于反驳所有的谎言.

meaning: n. 饿，饥饿；渴望; v. 渴望；挨饿
example: The meat they'd managed to procure assuaged their hunger.
translation: 他们把搞到手的肉拿来充饥。

meaning: v. 违反；侵犯，妨碍；亵渎
example: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

meaning: v. 使再循环；使…重新利用; n. 再生；再循环；重复利用
example: The objective would be to recycle 98 per cent of domestic waste.
translation: 目标是对98%的生活垃圾进行回收利用。

meaning: n. 集装箱；容器
example: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
translation: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

meaning: n. 立方；立方体；骰子; v. 使成立方形；使自乘二次；量…的体积
example: She sucked an ice cube into her mouth, and crunched it loudly.
translation: 她吸了块冰块到嘴里，嘎嘣嘎嘣地大声嚼着。

meaning: v. 使闪耀；使张开；用发光信号发出；使外倾; n. 加剧，恶化；底部展开；（鼻孔）张开的意思；闪光，闪耀；耀斑；爆发；照明弹
example: Don'tspill too much fat on the barbecue as it could flare up.
translation: 不要在烤肉上浇太多的油，会烧起来的。

meaning: n. 矿；矿石
example: We dowse oil and ore in South America for big companies.
translation: 我们在南美洲为一些大公司探测石油和矿石。

meaning: n. 货物，船货
example: Fire may have breached the cargo tanks and set the oil ablaze.
translation: 大火当时有可能把货船上的油罐烧漏了，从而引燃原油。

meaning: n. 颗粒；[物] 质点；极小量；小品词
example: A proton is an elementary particle of matter.
translation: 质子是物质的基本粒子。

meaning: n. 布；织物；桌布; adj. 布制的
example: He was holding a cloth that dripped pink drops upon the floor.
translation: 他正拿着一块布，布上粉红色的水滴落在地板上。

meaning: adj. 封建制度的；领地的；世仇的
example: Diplomacy was in his blood: his ancestors had been feudal lords.
translation: 他天生擅长交际：他的祖先曾是封建领主。

meaning: n. 【物】速度
example: Cyclists pedal their bikes furiously when riding in the velodrome on a track with banked turns.
translation: 选手在带有倾斜弯道轨道的室内赛车场地上拼命地蹬他们的自行车.

meaning: v. 简化；使单纯；使简易
example: Division of mankind into workingman and capitalists suffers from the fallacy of simplism.
translation: 硬把人类分成工人阶级和资本阶级就犯了过分简单化的错误.

meaning: adj. 巨大的，庞大的
example: The gigantic natural harbour of Poole is a haven for boats.
translation: 巨型天然港普尔港是船只的避风港。

meaning: v. 遗弃；放弃；逃跑; n. 沙漠；荒原；应得的赏罚; adj. 沙漠的；荒凉的；不毛的
example: The vehicles have been modified to suit conditions in the desert.
translation: 车辆已改装过以适应沙漠的环境。

meaning: n. 奇迹，奇迹般的人或物；惊人的事例
example: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
translation: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

meaning: adj. 进步的；先进的; n. 改革论者；进步分子
example: One prominent symptom of the disease is progressive loss of memory.
translation: 这种疾病的一个显著症状就是记忆逐渐丧失。

meaning: n. 结晶，晶体；水晶；水晶饰品; adj. 水晶的；透明的，清澈的
example: If you're a Billy Crystal fan, you'lllove this movie.
translation: 如果你是比利·克里斯托的影迷，你会喜爱这部影片。

meaning: n. 圣人；圣徒；道德崇高的人; adj. 神圣的; v. 成为圣徒
example: I've had enough—there are limits even for the patience of a saint!
translation: 我已经受够了——即使是圣人忍耐也是有限的！

meaning: n. 秘书；书记；部长；大臣
example: He resigned secretaryship on the ostensible ground of health.
translation: 他借口身体不好,辞去书记的职务.

meaning: n. 蛇；阴险的人; v. 迂回前进
example: snake venom
translation: 蛇毒

meaning: v. 转移；分心
example: There was nothing at all in this miserable place to distract him.
translation: 这个鬼地方根本没有什么东西可以让他分心。

meaning: n. 外行；门外汉；俗人；一般信徒
example: These technical terms are difficult for the layman to understand.
translation: 这些专门术语是外行人难以理解的.

meaning: v. 排除；妨碍；阻止
example: We try to preclude any possibility of misunderstanding.
translation: 我们努力排除任何误解的可能性.

meaning: n. [机] 齿条；架子；拷问台; v. 变形；随风飘；小步跑
example: My rucksack was too big for the luggage rack.
translation: 我的背包太大了，行李架上放不下。

meaning: v. 闪烁；发亮; n. 闪烁
example: A galaxy of twinkling stars matched the thousands of sparkling city lights.
translation: 闪烁的繁星与城内闪耀的万家灯火交相辉映.

meaning: adj. 愚蠢的；不明事理的；没头脑的; n. 傻瓜
example: Silo usually have individual capacities of 1000 to 2000 tons.
translation: 竖仓单个的容量通常是1000到2000吨.

meaning: n. 不幸；灾祸，灾难
example: He has known great misfortune in his life.
translation: 他一生中经历过巨大的不幸。

meaning: adj. 宏伟的；豪华的；极重要的; n. 大钢琴；一千美元
example: Do you always have a bet on the Grand National?
translation: 你总是对全国赛马大会下点注吗？

meaning: n. 鸭子；鸭肉；（英）宝贝儿；零分; v. 闪避；没入水中
example: Drizzle the remaining dressing over the duck and salad.
translation: 将剩下的调料淋在鸭肉和色拉上。

meaning: n. 流感
example: swine flu
translation: 猪流感

meaning: n. 牛；牲畜（骂人的话）；家畜；无价值的人
example: The old stone cattle trough still sits by the main entrance.
translation: 陈旧的石制牛食槽仍然放在大门口。

meaning: n. 曲调；和谐；心情; v. 调整；使一致；为…调音

translation: 走调；不协调；（对某事）没有兴趣

meaning: n. 厘米；公分
example: The snails are no larger than one centimetre across.
translation: 这些蜗牛体宽不超过1厘米。

meaning: n. 职员，办事员；店员；书记；记账员；<古>牧师，教士; v. 当销售员，当店员；当职员
example: A stupid medical clerk had slipped the wrong tab on his X-ray.
translation: 一个蠢笨的医护人员一不留神在他的X光片上贴错了标签。

meaning: n. 针脚，线迹；一针; v. 缝，缝合
example: Here's a book that will have you in stitches.
translation: 这是一本会让你笑破肚皮的书。

meaning: n. [脊椎] 斑马; adj. 有斑纹的

translation: n. 斑马线

meaning: n. （大学）校园；大学，大学生活；校园内的草地
example: From what I hear, half the campus is lusting after her.
translation: 从我听到的来看，半个学校的人都想和她上床。

meaning: n. [土壤] 粘土；泥土；肉体；似黏土的东西; vt. 用黏土处理
example: As the wheel turned, the potter shaped the clay.
translation: 轮子一边转动，制陶工人一边拉坯。

meaning: v. 骑马；乘车；依靠；漂浮; n. 骑；乘坐；交通工具；可供骑行的路；（乘坐汽车等的）旅行；乘骑；（乘车或骑车的）短途旅程；供乘骑的游乐设施
example: If you want a cheap ride, take a minicab.
translation: 要想出行便宜，就坐小型出租车吧。

meaning: n. 意图；目的；意向；愈合
example: The president said he had no intention of deploying ground troops.
translation: 总统称并不打算部署地面部队。

meaning: v. 使成合金；使减低成色; n. 合金
example: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
translation: 黄铜是铜锌合金。

meaning: v. 使麻痹；使瘫痪
example: The snake uses its venom to stun or paralyze its victims.
translation: 蛇用其毒液使受害者失去知觉或瘫痪.

meaning: v. 使固定；修理；安装；准备; n. 困境；方位；贿赂
example: I wrote back to Meudon at once to fix up a meeting.
translation: 我马上给缪顿回信安排会面。

meaning: v. 通告，通知；公布
example: I don't suppose it occurred to you to notify the police.
translation: 我看你没想过要去通知警察。

meaning: adj. 好的；优良的；细小的，精美的；健康的；晴朗的; n. 罚款; v. 罚款；澄清; adv. 很好地；精巧地
example: "I want to send a telegram." — "Fine, to whom?"
translation: “我想发份电报。”——“好的，发给谁？”

meaning: n. 激情；热情；酷爱；盛怒
example: It was Allen who fired this rivalry with real passion.
translation: 是艾伦为这场较量注入了激情。

meaning: n. 小麦；小麦色
example: wheat flour
translation: 小麦粉

meaning: n. 稻；米饭; v. 把…捣成米糊状
example: Under these laws, he said, Mr. Rice's assets could have been frozen.
translation: 他说根据这些法规，赖斯先生的资产可能已经被冻结了。

meaning: adj. 野蛮的；残酷的；狂怒的；荒凉的; n. 未开化的人；粗鲁的人；残暴成性的人; v. 乱咬；粗暴的对待
example: "What do you want!" she whispered savagely. "Get out."
translation: “你想干什么！”她粗野地低语道，“滚开。”

meaning: n. 电影；电影院；电影业，电影制作术
example: Working with Ford closely, I fell in love with the cinema.
translation: 与福特的密切合作开始令我爱上了电影。

meaning: n. [计量] 毫米
example: In the back of the truck was a 12.7 millimeter rapid-fire machine gun.
translation: 在卡车后面有一只12.7毫米口径的速射机关枪。

meaning: v. 鼓掌，拍手；啪地关上; n. 鼓掌；拍手声
example: Let's give the children a big clap.
translation: 让我们为孩子们热烈鼓掌.

meaning: n. 爪；螯，钳；爪形器具; v. 用爪抓（或挖）
example: The dogs continued to paw and claw frantically at the chain mesh.
translation: 那些狗继续用爪子疯狂地抓铁丝网。

meaning: v. 描绘；扮演
example: He has worked hard in recent months to portray New York in a better light.
translation: 最近几个月里他努力从更积极的角度来描绘纽约。

meaning: n. 图书馆员；图书管理员
example: The old librarian illuminated some old books and manuscripts.
translation: 这个老图书馆员把一些古书和旧抄稿加上各种装饰.

meaning: n. 喇叭，号角；角; v. 装角于
example: The storms had abated by the time they rounded Cape Horn.
translation: 他们绕过合恩角时，暴风雨已经减弱。

meaning: v. 包含，吸收；体现；把……合并; adj. 合并的；一体化的；组成公司的
example: Queensway Quay will incorporate shops, restaurants and other amenities.
translation: 女王道码头将会融商店、餐馆以及其他生活便利设施为一体。

meaning: n. 软管；长筒袜；男性穿的紧身裤; v. 用软管浇水；痛打
example: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
translation: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管抽走。

meaning: n. 谷仓；畜棚；车库；靶（核反应截面单位）; vt. 把…贮存入仓
example: The barn was filled with the sour-sweet smell of fresh dung.
translation: 谷仓里弥漫着新粪酸甜的气味。

meaning: n. 助动词；辅助者，辅助物；附属机构; adj. 辅助的；副的；附加的
example: The government'sfirst concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
translation: 政府关心的首要问题是扩充军队及辅助队伍。

meaning: n. [航] 宇宙飞船，航天器
example: manned spacecraft
translation: 载人飞船；人操纵的宇宙飞船

meaning: adj. 空的；赤裸的，无遮蔽的; v. 露出，使赤裸; n. (Bare)人名；(英)贝尔
example: They would have liked bare wooden floors throughout the house.
translation: 他们本想在整个房间的木地板上都不铺地毯的。

meaning: v. 浓缩；凝结
example: We have learnt how to condense serious messages into short, self-contained sentences.
translation: 我们已经学会了如何把重要的信息压缩成简短独立的句子。

meaning: n. 雷；轰隆声；恐吓; v. 打雷；怒喝
example: thunder and lightning
translation: 雷电；指责

meaning: n. 扩音器，麦克风
example: He wore a hidden microphone to secretly tape-record conversations.
translation: 他身上藏了一个传声器，打算偷偷录下谈话内容。

meaning: v. 复制；使加倍; n. 副本；复制品; adj. 复制的；二重的
example: Charles scored again, with an exact duplicate of his first goal.
translation: 查尔斯梅开二度,与第一次破门如出一辙.

meaning: n. 数学（等于mathematics）
example: The papers in maths and English are very testing.
translation: 数学试卷和英语试卷很难。

meaning: adj. 中立的，中性的；中立国的；非彩色的; n. 中立国；中立者；非彩色；齿轮的空档
example: "I know you," he said flatly, matter-of-fact, neutral in tone.
translation: “我认识你。”他平淡地说道，就事论事，不带任何感情。

meaning: n. 崇拜；礼拜；尊敬; v. 崇拜；尊敬；爱慕
example: The worshiper thinks that the worst is the insufficient horsepower.
translation: 崇拜者认为最坏的事是马力不足.

meaning: n. 文具；信纸
example: The stationmaster pounced and wrestled the gun from him.
translation: 站长猛扑过去，奋力夺下他手中的枪。

meaning: v. 转移；使…欢娱；使…转向; n. (Divert)人名；(法)迪韦尔
example: The President needed to divert attention away from his own economic record.
translation: 总统需要将人们的视线从他以往在经济上的表现上转移开。

meaning: n. 班轮，班机；衬垫；画线者
example: It became impractical to make a business trip by ocean liner.
translation: 乘坐远洋班轮进行商务旅行变得不合时宜了。

meaning: n. 亚麻布，亚麻线；亚麻制品; adj. 亚麻的；亚麻布制的
example: We're a bit low on bed linen. You'll have to make do.
translation: 我们的床单有些次，您将就着用吧。

meaning: adj. 奇怪的；同性恋的；不舒服的；心智不平衡的; v. 搞糟；使陷于不利地位; n. 同性恋者；怪人；伪造的货币
example: I could not help but think this is a very queer life.
translation: 我忍不住会认为这是一种非常怪异的生活。

meaning: v. 练习，实践；实施，实行；从事
example: To improve hand-eye co-ordination, practise throwing and catching balls.
translation: 要想提高手眼协调能力，就练习投球和接球。

meaning: v. 屠杀; n. 屠夫
example: Klaus Barbie was known in France as the Butcher of Lyon.
translation: 在法国，克劳斯·巴比是臭名昭著的“里昂屠夫”。

meaning: v. 当心，小心
example: Holidaymakers should beware of using plastic cards in foreign cash dispensers.
translation: 外出度假时，在外币取款机上使用银行卡一定要小心。

meaning: n. 行话，术语；黄锆石
example: APEC seems be drowning in an ocean of jargon.
translation: 亚太经合组织似乎为一大堆空洞的胡言乱语所淹没。

meaning: n. 沐浴；浴室；浴盆; v. 洗澡
example: Try a hot bath with some relaxing bath oil.
translation: 用舒缓沐浴油洗个热水澡吧。

meaning: n. 裤子，长裤
example: I was not at all embarrassed : " For my trousseau. "

meaning: adj. 诚实的，实在的；可靠的；坦率的
example: To be honest the house is not quite our style.
translation: 说实话，这所房子不太适合我们。

meaning: n. 邮资，邮费
example: Send a cheque for £18.99 plus £2 for postage and packing.
translation: 请寄上18.99英镑的支票，外加2英镑的邮资和包装费。

meaning: v. 反抗；反叛；反感，厌恶; n. 反抗；叛乱；反感
example: Soon the entire armed forces were in open revolt.
translation: 很快，整个武装部队开始公然抗命。

meaning: n. 介词；前置词
example: The word is compounded of a preposition and a verb.
translation: 这个词是由一个介词和一个动词复合而成的.

meaning: v. 淹没；充满；溢出; n. 洪水；泛滥；一大批
example: Infectious diseases are spreading among many of the flood victims.
translation: 传染病正在遭受洪灾的很多灾民中蔓延。

meaning: n. 飞机，航空器
example: The onslaught of orders should keep aircraft manufacturers busy for some time.
translation: 纷至沓来的订单应该会让飞机制造商忙碌一段时间。

meaning: n. 肝脏；生活者，居民
example: Liver and kidney are particularly rich in vitamin A.
translation: 肝脏和肾脏的维生素A含量尤其丰富。

meaning: v. 侵略；侵袭；侵扰；涌入
example: The press invade people's privacy unfairly and unjustifiably every day.
translation: 新闻媒体每天都在不公正地且没有正当理由地侵犯人们的隐私。

meaning: n. 项链
example: She was wearing the obligatory sweater and pearl necklace.
translation: 她穿着那件经常穿的毛衣，戴着那串惯常戴的珍珠项链。

meaning: n. 兔子，野兔; v. 让…见鬼去吧
example: Rabbit stew is one of chef Giancarlo Moeri's signature dishes.
translation: 炖野兔是厨师詹卡洛·莫里的招牌菜之一。

meaning: n. 联邦；共和国；国民整体
example: The Commonwealth Development Corporation has agreed to reschedule Tanzania's debt.
translation: 英联邦开发公司已经同意推迟坦桑尼亚的债务偿还时间。

meaning: v. 击败，战胜；挫败；使…失败; n. 失败的事实；击败的行为
example: After the pain of defeat passes, England have some thinking to do.
translation: 失败的痛苦过去以后，英国人应该认真反思一下。

meaning: v. 傻笑；咯咯地笑; n. 吃吃的笑
example: I might buy one for a friend's birthday as a giggle.
translation: 我可能会买一件送给朋友当生日礼物，逗他开心。

meaning: n. 剩余; adj. 剩余的
example: Obedience by women towards men is a remnant of religious teaching.
translation: 女人对男人的顺从是宗教教义的残迹。

meaning: n. 闪耀；火花；活力; v. 使闪耀；使发光
n. [物] 分辨率；决议；解决；决心
example: "I think I'll try a hypnotist," I said with sudden resolution.
translation: “我会找催眠师试试，”我突然坚决地说。

meaning: v. 挤；强使；撞；猛推; n. 推；挤
example: He took a shovel, dug a hole, and buried his once-prized possessions.
translation: 他拿起一把铁锨，挖了个坑，将自己曾经珍爱的物品埋了起来。

meaning: v. 使…安心，使消除疑虑
example: Banks are built to look solid to reassure their customers.
translation: 银行往往建得看上去很坚固，好让顾客放心。

meaning: n. 密封；印章；海豹；封条；标志; v. 密封；盖章
example: seal of
translation: 证明；保证

meaning: n. 缝；接缝; v. 缝合；接合；使留下伤痕
example: The Seaman was a bar for pool players and hard drinkers.
translation: “水手”是供台球玩家和酒徒消遣的酒吧。

meaning: n. 小叶；传单
example: Judy reached into her handbag and handed me a small printed leaflet.
translation: 朱蒂把手伸进提包，拿出一张小的印刷传单给我。

meaning: n. 词汇；词表；词汇量
example: She loved singing as a child and started vocal training at 12.
translation: 她从小就喜欢唱歌，12岁开始了声乐训练。

meaning: n. 规定；条款；准备；[经] 供应品; v. 供给…食物及必需品
example: There is no provision for funding performance-related pay rises.
translation: 没有为与业绩挂钩的加薪预作资金准备。

meaning: adv. 尽管，仍然; prep. 尽管，虽然; conj. 虽然
example: He despised William Pitt, notwithstanding the similar views they both held.
translation: 尽管他和威廉·皮特看法相似，却瞧不起他。

meaning: n. 汽车旅馆
example: He took off at once and headed back to the motel.
translation: 他立刻离开，回到汽车旅馆。

meaning: adj. 方便的；[废语]适当的；[口语]近便的；实用的
example: There wasn't even a convenient place for students to assemble between classes.
translation: 在课间，学生们连一个方便凑在一起的地方都没有。

meaning: n. 妻子，已婚妇女；夫人
example: husband and wife
translation: 夫妻

meaning: n. 所在；位置；地点
example: people living in the locality of the power station
translation: 居住在发电站周围地区的人

meaning: v. 考虑；计划；企图
example: That's when I try to meditate or do some deep-breathing exercises.
translation: 这时我就会试着沉思或者做些深呼吸练习。

meaning: v. 计划；制成蓝图; n. 蓝图，设计图；计划
example: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
translation: 子女身上遗传了父母双方的基因型板。

meaning: v. 呼喊；喊叫；大声说; n. 呼喊；呼叫
example: His team-mates opened hotel windows, shouting "Jump!" and somewhat less printable banter.
translation: 他的队友打开了酒店的窗户，大叫着“跳！”，还开了一些上不了台面的玩笑。

meaning: n. 王朝，朝代
example: The Seljuk dynasty of Syria was founded in 1094.
translation: 叙利亚的塞尔柱王朝始建于1094年。

meaning: n. 马力（功率单位）
example: a powerful car with a 170 horsepower engine
translation: 发动机为170马力的大功率汽车

meaning: adj. 黄色的；黄皮肤的; n. 黄色；黄种人；黄色颜料; v. 使变黄或发黄
example: yellow river
translation: 黄河

meaning: n. 垃圾；废物
example: A bomb planted in a garbage can exploded early today.
translation: 今天早些时候，安放在垃圾箱里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

meaning: n. 阳光；愉快；晴天；快活
num. 十四；十四个；第十四; n. 十四的记号；十四岁；十四点钟；十五世纪

translation: “14分钟,”克里斯瞥了一眼他的手表说道.

meaning: n. 局，处；衣柜；办公桌

translation: 联邦调查局

meaning: v. 证明；保证
example: This swimming certificate is to certify that I swim one hundred metres.
translation: 这张游泳证证明我可以游100米.

meaning: adj. 静态的；静电的；静力的; n. 静电；静电干扰

translation: 物理学家知道, 静力学只是动力学的一种抽象.

meaning: n. 熊猫；猫熊
example: It is well known that bamboo shoots are a panda's staple diet.
translation: 竹笋是熊猫的主要食物，这是人所共知的。

meaning: v. 伐木; n. 记录；航行日志；原木
example: In the evening a log fire would provide cosiness.
translation: 晚上点起篝火会让人感到温暖舒适。

meaning: n. 纠纷；混乱状态; v. 使纠缠；处于混乱状态

translation: 与…吵架，争吵；与…争论；与…有纠葛

meaning: adj. 高尚的；壮丽的；华丽的；宏伟的

translation: 她54岁了，精力和气色都非常好。

meaning: adj. 了不起的；非凡的；令人惊异的；不平常的

translation: “这是不是太不可思议了？”她低声说。

meaning: v. 发誓；咒骂; n. 宣誓；诅咒

translation: 对…发誓；[口]极其信赖

meaning: n. 叶片；刀片，刀锋；剑
example: A blade guard is fitted to protect the operator.
translation: 为保证操作人员的人身安全安装了桨叶保护罩。

meaning: adj. 地磁的；有磁性的；有吸引力的

translation: 二次电流在管子内部会产生磁场。

meaning: v. 嗅；嗤之以鼻; n. 吸，闻；嗤之以鼻；气味；以鼻吸气；吸气声

translation: 发现；寻找

meaning: v. 使出汗；流出；使干苦活；剥削；藉出汗减轻；焦急地期待; n. 汗；水珠；焦急；苦差使
example: no sweat
translation: 不费力地

meaning: adj. 丑陋的；邪恶的；令人厌恶的
example: ugly duckling
translation: 丑小鸭；小时难看长大后变得才貌出众的人

meaning: adj. 形象的；图表的；绘画似的
example: She asked her son, a graphic designer, to create letterheads and stationery.
translation: 她请做平面设计师的儿子设计了信头和信笺。

meaning: n. 领土，领域；范围；地域；版图

translation: 休尖叫起来，声音不大，吃惊多于恐惧。

meaning: v. 喝酒（drink的过去分词）; adj. 喝醉了的

translation: “又累又激动”是形容人喝醉酒的一种委婉说法。

meaning: n. 队长，首领；船长；上尉；海军上校; v. 指挥；率领
example: "Ah, Captain Fox," Martin McGuinness said affably. "Nice to see you again."
translation: “啊，福克斯上尉，”马丁·麦吉尼斯亲切地说，“很高兴再次见到您。”

meaning: n. 邻近，附近；近处
example: A vicious price war between manufacturers has cut margins to the bone.
translation: 制造商之间的恶性价格战已将利润削减到了最低。

meaning: n. 木偶；傀儡；受他人操纵的人
example: When the invasion occurred he ruled as a puppet of the occupiers.
translation: 外敌入侵时，他作为占领者的傀儡行使统治。

meaning: n. 后代，子孙；产物
example: Of course, not all alcoholics and drug abusers produce deviant offspring.
translation: 当然，并不是所有的酗酒者和吸毒者都会生育出不正常的后代。

meaning: n. 房东，老板；地主
example: The landlord refused to serve him because he considered him too drunk.
translation: 酒吧老板觉得他已经喝多了，拒绝再给他添酒。

meaning: v. 蹒跚；使交错；使犹豫; n. 蹒跚；交错安排; adj. 交错的；错开的
num. 十九
example: He set off for a nineteen-day moose hunt in Nova Scotia.
translation: 他动身前往新斯科舍参加为时19天的驼鹿捕猎活动。

meaning: n. 种子；根据；精液；萌芽；子孙；原由; v. 播种；结实；成熟；去…籽
example: in seed
translation: ◎撒过种的，播过种的

meaning: adj. 宇宙的（等于cosmical）
example: NASA plans to launch a satellite to study cosmic rays.
translation: 美国国家航空航天局计划发射一颗卫星上天，对宇宙射线进行研究。

meaning: adj. 丰富的；许多的；丰饶的；众多的
example: There is a plentiful supply of arms on the black market.
translation: 黑市上有大量武器出售。

meaning: n. 梳子；蜂巢；鸡冠; v. 梳头发；梳毛
example: We went over that area with a fine-tooth comb.
translation: 我们对那个地区进行了彻底的搜查。

meaning: adj. 单数的；单一的；非凡的；异常的; n. 单数
example: singular value
translation: n. 奇异值；奇值

meaning: n. 少数；一把；棘手事
example: Only a handful had returned to work in the immediate vicinity.
translation: 仅有几个人回到临近地区工作。

meaning: n. [化学] 氧化物
example: an oxide of tin
translation: 氧化锡

meaning: n. 幼儿园；幼稚园
example: Children graduate to the kindergarten, then pre-school, and then school.
translation: 孩子们先上幼儿园，然后上学前班，再接着上小学。

meaning: n. 女演员
example: Jane is determined to stake her claim as an actress.
translation: 简决心主张自己作为一名女演员的权利。

meaning: n. 渔夫；渔人
example: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean.
translation: 斯皮罗斯·拉齐斯的第一份职业是爱琴海上一名地位卑贱的渔夫。

meaning: v. 崇拜；爱慕；喜爱；极喜欢; n. (Adore)人名；(法)阿多尔
example: I adore good books and the theatre.
translation: 我爱读好书，也喜欢看戏。

meaning: n. [动力] 涡轮；[动力] 涡轮机
example: steam turbine
translation: 汽轮机；蒸汽轮机；蒸汽透平

meaning: v. 抓住; n. 巡警，警官
example: Malone, a cop, felt as much an outsider as any of them.
translation: 马隆是个警察，他跟他们一样都觉得自己像个外人。

meaning: n. 奶牛，母牛；母兽; v. 威胁，恐吓
example: Switzerland isn't all cow bells and yodelling, you know.
translation: 你知道，瑞士不仅仅只有牛铃声和约德尔调歌声。

meaning: n. 其时，其间; adv. 同时；其间
example: In the meantime the war of nerves seems likely to continue.
translation: 与此同时，心理战似乎还可能继续。

meaning: n. 前沿；边界；国境; adj. 边界的；开拓的
example: A "frontier-free" Europe implies a greatly increased market for all economic operators.
translation: “无国界的”欧洲对所有经营者来说都意味着一个大大扩展了的市场。

meaning: n. 圆筒；汽缸；[数] 柱面；圆柱状物
v. 扫除；猛拉；掸去; n. 打扫，扫除；范围；全胜
example: They give a better performance, with less sweepback, at high and low speeds.
translation: 空客的设计展示出了一个在高速和低速飞行时减少后掠的更好的机身外貌.

meaning: n. 十二月
example: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
translation: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

meaning: adj. 舒适的；惬意的; n. 保温罩
example: In the cosy consulting room the children are surrounded by familiar objects.
translation: 在温馨的诊疗室里，孩子们周围摆满了亲切熟悉的东西。

meaning: v. 追猎；烦扰；激励; n. 猎犬；卑劣的人
example: The police have promised to hound down those responsible for the explosion.
translation: 警方已保证要追查此次爆炸事件有责任的人员.

meaning: n. 飓风，暴风
example: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: n. （美）玉米；（英）谷物；[皮肤] 鸡眼; v. 腌；使成颗粒
example: They are offering farmers $2.15 a bushel for corn.
translation: 他们向农民出价每蒲式耳2.15美元收购玉米。

meaning: n. 叛徒；卖国贼；背信弃义的人
n. 联合；联邦；联盟；联邦政府
example: The Russian Federation declared itself to be a sovereign republic.
translation: 俄罗斯联邦宣布自己为主权独立的共和国。

meaning: n. 海盗；盗版；侵犯专利权者; v. 掠夺；翻印；剽窃
example: Pirate copies of the video are already said to be in Britain.
translation: 该录像带的盗版版本据说已在英国出现。

meaning: n. 侧面；轮廓；外形；剖面；简况; v. 描…的轮廓；扼要描述
example: The police deliberately kept a low profile in most places.
translation: 警方在大多数地方有意保持低调。

meaning: n. [力] 推力；刺; v. 插；插入；推挤
example: An ion thruster test for NASA's Deep Space 1.
translation: 对于美国宇航局的离子推进器测试深空1号.

meaning: n. 照相机；摄影机
example: Sylvia, camera in hand, asked, "Where do we go first?"
translation: 西尔维娅手里拿着相机问道：“我们先去哪里？”

meaning: adj. 流畅的，流利的；液态的；畅流的
example: He is a fluent speaker of Hebrew.
translation: 他说一口流利的希伯来语。

meaning: n. 内阁；橱柜；展览艺术品的小陈列室; adj. 内阁的；私下的，秘密的
example: This issue, more than any other, has divided her cabinet.
translation: 主要是这一问题使她的内阁产生了分歧。

meaning: n. 骚扰；烦恼
example: They have a policy of zero tolerance for sexual harassment.
translation: 他们对性骚扰采取绝不容忍的政策。

meaning: adj. 神的；神圣的；宗教的；庄严的
example: sacred flame
translation: 圣火

meaning: n. 入口；门槛；开始；极限；临界值
example: The crowds became violent and threw petrol bombs at the police.
translation: 人群变得狂暴起来，并向警察投掷汽油弹。

meaning: adj. 未付的；欠着的; v. 欠；把…归功于（owe的ing形式）
example: He could take what was owing for the rent.
translation: 他可以把自己欠的钱抵作对方的租金。

meaning: n. 单位，单元；装置；[军] 部队；部件
example: Russia demanded that Unita send a delegation to the peace talks.
translation: 俄罗斯要求安盟派代表团参加和谈。

meaning: n. 国籍，国家；民族；部落
example: Discrimination by employers on the grounds of race and nationality was illegal.
translation: 雇主以种族或国籍为由歧视员工是非法的。

meaning: n. 使用；用法；惯例
example: In the 1980 s USAID was still providing assistance in varying amounts to 56 nations.
translation: 直到80年代,美国国际开发署还在为56个国家提供数额不等的援助.

meaning: n. [作物] 土豆，[作物] 马铃薯
example: The potato cakes should be crisp outside and meltingly soft inside.
translation: 土豆饼应该外面酥脆,里面嫩软.

meaning: n. 绳索；束缚; v. 用绳子捆绑
example: Tack the cord around the cushion.
translation: 用粗线沿着垫子边绷一圈。

meaning: n. 赤字；不足额
example: These will be very constrained budgets designed to get the deficit down.
translation: 这些预算旨在减少赤字，将会大大受限。

meaning: n. 破裂，断裂；[外科] 骨折; v. 破裂；折断
example: He suffered a hairline fracture of the right index finger.
translation: 他右手食指骨裂。

meaning: n. 绷带; v. 用绷带包扎
example: Use a crepe bandage to support the affected area.
translation: 用强力绷带托住伤处。

meaning: adj. 向下的，下降的; adv. 向下
example: His adult life mirrored the downward course of his father's life.
translation: 他成年后的生活反映出了他父亲的生活在走下坡路。

meaning: n. 平台；月台，站台；坛；讲台
example: PLATFORM is an alliance of more than 80 rail-user groups.
translation: PLATFORM公司是80多个铁路用户组的联盟。

meaning: adj. 整齐的；相当大的; v. 整理；收拾；弄整齐; n. 椅子的背罩

translation: 收拾，整理

meaning: n. 山羊；替罪羊（美俚）；色鬼（美俚）
example: Sheep's milk is produced in much the same way as goat's milk.
translation: 绵羊奶和山羊奶的生产过程差不多。

meaning: adj. 贪婪的；贪吃的；渴望的
example: Edith was seen as a conniving, greedy woman.
translation: 人们认为伊迪丝是一个诡计多端的贪婪女人。

meaning: adj. 细长的；苗条的；微薄的
example: slender body
translation: 细长体；瘦长体

meaning: v. 移动；随季节而移居；移往
example: People migrate to cities like Jakarta in search of work.
translation: 人们为找工作而迁移到雅加达这类城市里。

meaning: n. 垫子；起缓解作用之物；（猪等的）臀肉；银行储蓄; v. 给…安上垫子；把…安置在垫子上；缓和…的冲击
example: Lie face upwards with a cushion under your head.
translation: 头枕垫子仰卧。

meaning: n. 碎片；残余物；打架；少量; v. 废弃；使解体；拆毁; adj. 废弃的；零碎的
example: scrap metal
translation: 废金属

meaning: adj. 操作的；运作的
example: Exports have not been halted completely because another line is operational.
translation: 出口并没有完全停止，因为另一条生产线还能运转。

meaning: n. 幕；窗帘; v. 遮蔽；装上门帘
example: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend'swife.
translation: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

meaning: adj. 可怜的；卑鄙的；令人苦恼或难受的
example: The country's 37 million people are wretchedly poor.
translation: 该国3,700万人一贫如洗。

meaning: n. 葬礼；麻烦事; adj. 丧葬的，出殡的
example: Most of those attending the funeral stood silently showing little emotion.
translation: 出席葬礼的人大多都面无表情地静静站着。

meaning: adj. 愉快的；欢乐的；宜人的; adv. 很；非常; v. （口）用好话劝某人做…；（口）用好话使高兴; n. (Jolly)人名；(法)若利；(英、印)乔利；(德)约利
example: It was jolly hard luck on him, wasn't it?
translation: 他可真倒霉，不是吗？

meaning: n. 手套; vt. 给…戴手套
example: The UN inspectors work hand in glove with the Western intelligence agencies.
translation: 联合国观察员和西方情报机构之间密切合作。

meaning: v. 利用
example: My limited diplomatic skills were tested to the utmost.
translation: 我有限的外交手腕儿受到了极其严峻的考验。

meaning: v. 使满足；足够…用；合格
example: There's a sufficiency of drama in these lives to sustain your interest.
translation: 这些人的生活充满了戏剧性，总能让你兴趣盎然。

meaning: n. 港口，口岸；（计算机的）端口；左舷；舱门; v. 转向左舷
example: He asked for a glass of port after dinner.
translation: 晚饭后，他要了一杯波尔图葡萄酒。

meaning: v. 烤，烘焙; n. 烤；烘烤食品
example: Bake some big red peppers and hollow them out.
translation: 将几个大红甜椒烤一烤，再把它们掏空。

meaning: n. 公寓；房间
example: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
translation: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

meaning: n. 镜子；真实的写照；榜样; v. 反射；反映
example: Light colours provide an effective backdrop for pictures or a mirror.
translation: 浅色是挂放图画或镜子很有效果的衬托。

meaning: n. 环境；周围的事物
example: surrounding ground
translation: 周围土地

meaning: adj. 卓越的；非凡的；值得注意的
example: He made a remarkable recovery from a shin injury.
translation: 他的胫骨伤恢复得相当不错。

meaning: n. 趋势，潮流；潮汐; v. 随潮漂流
example: spring tide
translation: 大潮；涨潮

meaning: adj. 月亮的，月球的；阴历的；银的；微亮的; n. (Lunar)人名；(西)卢纳尔
example: The astronauts piloted their craft down to the lunar surface.
translation: 宇航员驾驶太空飞船在月球表面降落.

meaning: adj. 迂回的，绕道的；圆滚滚的; n. 迂回路线；环状交叉路口
example: The turn is about two kilometres before the roundabout.
translation: 拐弯就在环岛前面约2公里处。

meaning: adj. 未来的；预期的; n. 预期；展望
example: Prospective buyers should study the small ads in the daily newspaper.
translation: 打算购物的人应该研究研究日报上的小广告。

meaning: adv. 大声地；出声地
example: Prue entered the passage in her notebook, then read it aloud again.
translation: 普吕把那一段写在她的笔记本上，然后又大声念了一遍。

meaning: n. [计] 模块；组件；模数
example: They have docked a robot module alongside the orbiting space station.
translation: 他们已经将一个自动操作舱与沿轨道运行的空间站并行对接上了。

meaning: n. 羽毛球
example: Barnaby may be 15, but he's nippy and suited to badminton.
translation: 巴纳比可能15岁了，但他动作敏捷，适合打羽毛球。

meaning: adj. 秃顶的；光秃的；单调的；无装饰的; v. 变秃; n. (Bald)人名；(英)鲍尔德；(德、法、波)巴尔德
example: He was short and bald and had a moustache.
translation: 他个头不高，秃顶，留着八字胡。

meaning: n. 框架，骨架；结构，构架
example: The magazine's aim is to discuss topical issues within a Christian framework.
translation: 该杂志的宗旨是在基督教框架下讨论时下的热门话题。

meaning: v. 标记号于；滴答地记录; n. 滴答声；扁虱；记号；赊欠
example: tick off
translation: 列举；用记号标出

meaning: n. 腿；支柱
example: He had to have one leg amputated above the knee.
translation: 他的一条腿不得不从膝部以上截断。

meaning: n. [建] 楼层；叠架的一层
example: the rock star's storied career
translation: 那位摇滚歌星尽人皆知的演唱生涯

meaning: n. 镍；镍币；五分镍币; v. 镀镍于
example: Nickel can be used for making coins.
translation: 镍可做成钱币.

meaning: v. 取消；解开；破坏；扰乱
example: Memory is very full. The previous operation is no longer undoable.
translation: 内存已用完. 上次操作已无法撤消.

meaning: n. [雷达] 雷达，无线电探测器
n. 抽屉；开票人；出票人；起草者；酒馆侍
example: He folded the papers and stuck them in his desk drawer.
translation: 他将文件叠起来，塞进自己的书桌抽屉里。

meaning: v. 爆炸，爆发；激增
example: Catherine was ready to explode. "I think you're contemptible!"
translation: 凯瑟琳气得快要炸了。“我觉得你真是可鄙！”

meaning: n. 头盖骨，脑壳
example: My hair is plastered into a skullcap.
translation: 一顶便帽紧紧地箍住我的头发.

meaning: v. 膨胀；肿胀；隆起; n. 肿胀；隆起; adj. 漂亮的；一流的
example: She was taken up by swelldom.
translation: 她被上流社会接受了.

meaning: v. 看护，护理；照顾；培养；给…喂奶; n. 护士；奶妈，保姆
example: "Can you walk all right?" the nurse asked him.
translation: “你走路有困难吗？”护士问他。

meaning: v. 点燃；使燃烧；使激动
example: The recent fighting in the area could ignite regional passions far beyond the borders.
translation: 最近该地区的战斗可能激发边境以外整个地区的激动情绪。

meaning: n. 老生常谈；司空见惯的事；普通的东西; adj. 平凡的；陈腐的
example: It's commonplace to see people collapsing from hunger in the streets.
translation: 在街上看见有人饿晕是很平常的事。

meaning: v. 欺骗；行骗
example: The boys, if my eyes did not deceive me, were praying.
translation: 如果我没有看错的话，那些男孩子正在祈祷。

meaning: n. 运输；运费；四轮马车；举止；客车厢
example: He sat in the corner of a second-class carriage.
translation: 他坐在一节二等车厢的角落里。

meaning: n. 问候，招呼；祝贺; v. 致敬，欢迎（greet的现在分词）
example: He took her hand in greeting and asked solicitously how everything was.
translation: 他握着她的手表示问候，关切地问她一切是否都好。

meaning: n. 电车轨道；煤车; v. 用煤车运载
v. 咆哮；怒吼；狂吠; n. 嗥叫；怒号；嚎哭
example: Traditionalists may howl, but in today's world, cultural relativism rules.
translation: 传统卫道士们也许会叫嚣反对，但在当今世界，文化相对论确实是占据着统治地位。

meaning: n. 投入；跳进; v. 突然地下降；投入；陷入；跳进
example: Take the opportunity to plunge yourself into your career.
translation: 抓住机会投身到事业中去。

meaning: n. 传记；档案；个人简介
example: He has written a speculative biography of Christopher Marlowe.
translation: 他写了一篇关于克里斯托弗·马洛的推测性传记。

meaning: n. 雕像，塑像; vt. 以雕像装饰
example: ConclusionSerum IGF 1 and urinary GH levels have important significance in the diagnosis of short statued children.
translation: 结论尿GH水平测定无创、简便,配合IGF1等指标的检测,对于矮小儿童的诊断和鉴别诊断具有重要意义.

meaning: adj. 贫瘠的；不生育的；无益的；沉闷无趣的；空洞的; n. 荒地
example: He prayed that his barren wife would one day have a child.
translation: 他祈祷自己不孕的妻子有朝一日能怀上宝宝。

meaning: n. 焦炭；可卡因；可口可乐（Coca-Cola）; v. 焦化
example: "Steve, what do you want?" — "Coke, Pepsi, it doesn't matter."
translation: “史蒂夫，你要喝点什么？”——“可口可乐，百事，随便啦。”

meaning: n. 托盘；文件盒；隔底匣；（无线电的）发射箱
example: cable tray
translation: 电缆槽

meaning: n. 猪肉; vt. 与女子性交
example: Legs of pork were cured and smoked over the fire.
translation: 在火上熏制猪腿。

meaning: v. 把……装入桶内; n. 桶；枪管，炮管
example: To keep warm they burnt wood in a rusty oil barrel.
translation: 他们在一只生锈的油桶里烧木柴来保暖。

meaning: adj. 摩西的；拼成的；嵌花式的; n. 马赛克；镶嵌；镶嵌细工
example: a design in mosaic
translation: 马赛克图案

meaning: n. 爆炸；冲击波；一阵; v. 猛攻
example: The space shuttle had been scheduled to blast off at 04:38.
translation: 航天飞机已经预定于凌晨4点38分发射升空。

meaning: n. 海边；海滨; adj. 海边的；海滨的
example: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
translation: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

meaning: n. 烟雾
example: photochemical smog
translation: n. 光化雾

meaning: n. 嘴唇；边缘; vt. 以嘴唇碰; adj. 口头上的; vi. 用嘴唇
example: She had quite severe bruising and a cut lip.
translation: 她身上有严重的淤伤，嘴唇也破了。

meaning: n. 商人，批发商；店主; adj. 商业的，商人的
example: The ride was smooth until they got into the merchant ship's wake.
translation: 航行一直很顺利，直到他们碰上了商船的尾流。

meaning: n. 摘录，引用; v. 引用，摘录
example: The following excerpt is illustrative of her interaction with students.
translation: 接下来的节选部分可以说明她与学生的互动情况。

meaning: v. 铸造（货币）；杜撰，创造; n. 硬币，钱币
example: I pulled a coin from my pocket and flipped it.
translation: 我从口袋里掏出一个硬币，把它弹向空中。

meaning: adj. 空中的，航空的；空气的；空想的; n. [电讯] 天线
example: Adjust the aerial's position and direction for the best reception.
translation: 调整天线的位置和方向以达到最佳接收效果。

meaning: n. 暗喻，隐喻；比喻说法
example: Despite the mixed metaphor, there is some truth in this judgement.
translation: 尽管有混用的比喻，这个判断还是有些道理的。

meaning: n. 盖子；眼睑；限制; vt. 给…盖盖子
example: As we drew near, I saw that the boot lid was up.
translation: 我们靠近时,我看见汽车行李箱的盖子翘了起来.

meaning: adj. 市政的，市的；地方自治的
example: The decor was reminiscent of a municipal arts-and-leisure centre.
translation: 这种布置让人想起都市里的艺术休闲中心。

meaning: v. 盘绕，把…卷成圈; n. 线圈；卷
example: The heated gas is piped through a coil surrounded by water.
translation: 受热气体通过水中的盘管输送。

meaning: n. 教皇，罗马教皇；权威，大师
example: pope benedict xvi
translation: 教皇本笃十六世（现任天主教教宗）

meaning: n. 衰退；退潮；衰落; v. 衰退；减少；衰落；潮退
example: We decided to leave on the ebb at six o'clock next morning.
translation: 我们决定第二天早晨6点钟趁退潮时离开。

meaning: n. 草地；草坪
example: The windows overlooked a lawn of tall waving grass.
translation: 窗户外边是一块草地，高高的草随风摇摆。

meaning: n. 商品；货物; v. 买卖；推销
example: The merchandise is reasonably priced and offers exceptionally good value.
translation: 这些商品定价合理，很是划算。

meaning: n. 启示；揭露；出乎意料的事；被揭露的真相
example: I was shocked, brought down to earth by this revelation.
translation: 真相的披露让我深感震惊，我被带回了现实。

meaning: v. 沉思；注视；思忖；预期
example: The possibility of war is too horrifying to contemplate.
translation: 战争的可能性太可怕了,真不堪细想.

meaning: n. 讨论会，座谈会；专题论文集；酒宴，宴会
example: One prominent symptom of the disease is progressive loss of memory.
translation: 这种疾病的一个显著症状就是记忆逐渐丧失。

meaning: adj. 好战的; n. 富有战斗性的人；好斗者；激进分子
example: The fiery right-wing leader toned down his militant statements after the meeting.
translation: 言辞激烈的右翼领袖在会后收敛了他的好战言论。

meaning: n. 线；螺纹；思路；衣服；线状物；玻璃纤维；路线; v. 穿过；穿线于；使交织
example: The furniture was threadbare; he'd obviously picked it up for nothing.
translation: 这件家具很破旧，显然他是白捡来的了。

meaning: n. 蜘蛛；设圈套者；三脚架
example: Central American orchid having spiderlike flowers with prominent green warts.
translation: 中美洲的一种兰花,具有蜘蛛状花朵,花上长有突出的绿色的瘤.

meaning: n. 火把，火炬；手电筒；启发之物; v. 像火炬一样燃烧
example: Ancient Greek had never organized torch relay or torchbearer race.
translation: 古代的泛希腊奥运会从来没有组织过火炬接力或手持火炬赛跑.

meaning: v. 呛；使窒息；阻塞；抑制；扑灭; n. 窒息；噎；[动力] 阻气门
example: It's enough to make them choke with apoplectic rage.
translation: 足以气得让他们说不出话来。

meaning: n. 点心；起提神作用的东西；精力恢复
example: Would you care to partake of some refreshment?
translation: 你想吃些东西吗？

meaning: v. 淹没；压倒；受打击；覆盖；压垮
example: After my lecture, the students began to overwhelm me with questions.
translation: 讲课之后, 学生们开始问一系列问题,使我不知所措.

meaning: prep. 在其中，在其间; n. (Amid)人名；(法、阿拉伯)阿米德
example: They announced, amid much ballyhoo, that they had made a breakthrough.
translation: 在一通大吹大擂中，他们宣布自己取得了突破。

meaning: n. 耳朵；穗；听觉；倾听; vi. （美俚）听见；抽穗
example: Her ear, shoulder and hip are in a straight line.
translation: 她的耳朵、肩膀和髋部呈一条直线。

meaning: n. 比率，比例
example: In 1978 there were 884 students at a lecturer/student ratio of 1:15.
translation: 1978年有884名学生，师生比为1比15。

meaning: v. 打喷嚏; n. 喷嚏
v. 同情，怜悯；支持
example: Sometimes a sympathizer is one step away from a lover.
translation: 有时侯,同情者与情人仅一步之遥.

meaning: n. 手腕；腕关节; vt. 用腕力移动
example: He has to wear a security wristband and be under constant supervision.
translation: 他必须戴着监控手环并且实时监控.

meaning: n. 石油
example: Petroleum engineers plan and manage the extraction of oil.
translation: 石油工程师规划并管理石油的提炼。

meaning: n. [心理] 想象力；空想；幻想物
example: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world.
translation: 儿童可能无法将自己的幻想与真实世界区分开来。

meaning: adj. 琐碎的；小气的；小规模的; n. (Petty)人名；(英、法)佩蒂
example: Petty crime is having a deleteri-ous effect on community life.
translation: 轻微罪行正对社区生活产生有害影响。

meaning: v. 赋予；捐赠；天生具有
example: Herbs have been used for centuries to endow a whole range of foods with subtle flavours.
translation: 数个世纪以来，香草一直被用于给各种食物增添淡淡的香味。

meaning: adj. 多云的；阴天的；愁容满面的
example: a grey, cloudy day
translation: 灰暗多云的天空

meaning: adj. 灾难性的；损失惨重的；悲伤的
example: The first four years of government were completely disastrous.
translation: 政府前4年的执政彻底失败。

meaning: n. 晚上；傍晚；（联欢性的）晚会；后期; adj. 在晚上的；为晚上的；晚上用的; int. 晚上好（等于good evening）
example: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
translation: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

meaning: n. 垫；垫子；衬边; v. 缠结；铺席于……上; adj. 无光泽的
example: She touched the thick mat of sandy hair on his chest.
translation: 她摸着他那浓密的淡棕色胸毛。

meaning: v. 庆祝，纪念；成为…的纪念
example: A series of movies will be shown to commemorate the 30th anniversary of his death.
translation: 为纪念他逝世30周年，有一系列的电影要上映。

meaning: adj. 全体一致的；意见一致的；无异议的
example: Today its executive committee voted unanimously to reject the proposals.
translation: 今天执行委员会投票一致否决了这些提案。

meaning: n. [计量] 公里；[计量] 千米
example: Moreau took gold in the five-kilometre individual pursuit competition.
translation: 莫罗在个人五公里追逐赛中获得金牌。

meaning: n. 赤道
example: GPS operates best near the equator.
translation: 全球定位系统在赤道附近性能最好。

meaning: n. 化学；化学过程
example: The Oxford Chemistry Primers aim to cover important topics in organic chemistry.
translation: 《牛津化学初级读本》丛书旨在论述有机化学中的重要问题。

meaning: n. 文明；文化
example: I think we can date the decline of Western Civilization quite precisely.
translation: 我认为我们可以相当准确地确定西方文明开始衰落的年代。

meaning: n. 量；体积；卷；音量；大量；册; adj. 大量的; vi. 成团卷起; vt. 把…收集成卷
example: sales volume
translation: 销售量

meaning: n. [园艺] 梨树；梨子
example: In gardens, cankers are most prominent on apples and pear trees.
translation: 花园里，苹果树和梨树患枯枝病最明显。

meaning: n. 继承者；后续的事物
example: legal successor
translation: 法定继承人；合法继承人

meaning: n. 草地；牧场；牧草; v. 放牧；吃草
example: Every summer the shepherds drive the sheep up to pasture.
translation: 每年夏天牧羊人都将羊群赶到牧场去。

meaning: n. 女主人，女老板；女服务员；舞女；女房东
example: An air hostess was arrested and charged with drug smuggling.
translation: 一名空姐被捕，并被控以走私毒品的罪名。

meaning: v. 碰撞；抵触，冲突
example: What happens when the two interests collide will make a fascinating spectacle.
translation: 两种利益发生冲突时将会上演一场好戏。

meaning: v. 巩固，加强；用水泥涂；接合; n. 水泥；接合剂
example: The gym teachers lined us up against the cement walls.
translation: 体育老师让我们靠着水泥墙排好。

meaning: v. （为猎奇或救济等）去贫民窟; n. 贫民窟；陋巷；脏乱的地方
example: She fell into a deep and peaceful slumber.
translation: 她睡着了，睡得又沉又香。

meaning: n. 展望；观点；景色; vt. 比……好看；用目光压倒; vi. 朝外看
example: He remained for some years avowedly radical in his political outlook.
translation: 他多年来保持公然激进的政治观。

meaning: n. 星期四
example: She wondered why Thurston had not warned her of this risky snag.
translation: 她奇怪为什么泽尔斯顿没有警告她提防这个危险的暗礁.

meaning: n. 茶托，浅碟；浅碟形物；眼睛
example: flying saucer
translation: 飞碟

meaning: n. 雨伞；保护伞；庇护；伞形结构
example: beach umbrella
translation: n. （美）遮阳伞（海滨或花园用的）

meaning: v. 爆发，突发；爆炸; n. 爆发，突发；爆炸
example: A brilliant shaft of sunlight burst through the doorway.
translation: 一束耀眼的阳光从门口照射进来。

meaning: n. 故障；崩溃；分解；分类；衰弱；跺脚曳步舞
example: She is not herself. She came near to a breakdown.
translation: 她身体不舒服，简直要崩溃了。

meaning: adj. 曲折的；锯齿形的；之字形的; v. 使成之字形；使曲折行进; n. 之字形；Z字形; adv. 曲折地；之字形地；Z字形地
example: zigzag course
translation: 曲折航线

meaning: n. 会计师；会计人员
example: He's not a bad chap—quite human for an accountant.
translation: 这个家伙人不坏——就会计来说已经很有人情味了。

meaning: v. 饿死；挨饿；渴望
example: In Green's invective there is the starveling author's jealousy of the prosperous actor.
translation: 格林的痛骂声里包含潦倒作家对发迹演员的嫉妒.

meaning: n. 租约；租期；租赁物；租赁权; v. 出租；租得
example: The operation has given me a new lease of life.
translation: 手术使我重获新生。

meaning: n. 楼梯
example: Woodshadows floated silently by through the morning peace from the stairhead seaward where he gazed.
translation: 树林的阴影穿过清晨的寂静,从楼梯口悄然无声地飘向他正在眺望着的大海.

meaning: n. 恐惧；可怕的人（或物）; v. 惧怕；担心; adj. 可怕的
example: I dread to think what our telephone bill is going to be.
translation: 我不敢想象我们的电话费会有多少。

meaning: adj. 可移动的；机动的；易变的；非固定的; n. 运动物体
example: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
translation: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。

meaning: n. 年轻人；少年
n. （总称）[服装] 服装；帆装; v. 覆盖（clothe的ing形式）；给…穿衣
example: In warm weather, you should wear clothing that is cool and comfortable.
translation: 在热天里，应该穿凉快舒适的衣服。

meaning: n. 岛；岛屿；安全岛；岛状物; adj. 岛的; vt. 孤立；使成岛状
example: They were going to sail around the little island, against the tide.
translation: 他们打算绕着小岛逆潮航行。

meaning: n. [化学] 氮
example: The atmosphere consist of more than 70 % of nitrogen.
translation: 大气中含有70%以上的氮气.

meaning: n. 姐妹；（称志同道合者）姐妹；修女；护士; adj. 姐妹般的；同类型的
example: There was a degree of solidarity and sisterhood among the women.
translation: 这些女人之间存在着一定程度的团结精神和姐妹情谊。

meaning: n. 资本主义
example: His article is, predictably, a scathing attack on capitalism.
translation: 可想而知，他的文章是对资本主义的严厉抨击。

meaning: n. 发音；读法
example: I thought a phonetic spelling might aid in pronunciation.
translation: 我想语音拼写可能有助于发音。

meaning: v. 游泳；漂浮；浸；眩晕; n. 游泳；漂浮；眩晕; adj. 游泳时穿戴的
example: in the swim
translation: 合时髦；合潮流；熟悉内情；积极参加活动

meaning: adj. 高的；崇高的；高级的；高傲的; n. (Lofty)人名；(英)洛夫蒂
example: Victorian houses can seem cold with their lofty ceilings and rambling rooms.
translation: 维多利亚式房屋屋顶高耸，房间布局凌乱，因此可能会显得较为阴冷。

meaning: v. 绊倒；远足；犯错误；轻快地走; n. 旅行；绊倒；差错
example: on a trip
translation: 在旅途中

meaning: v. 修剪；整理；装点; n. 修剪；整齐；情形; adj. 整齐的
example: Due to the special configuration of trimaran, the flow field around its body is very complex.
translation: 由于三体船具有独特的结构, 使得其周围流场非常复杂.

meaning: n. 素描；略图；梗概; v. 画素描或速写
example: I take my sketchbook with me whenever I go away.
translation: 我每次出去都带来素描簿.

meaning: n. 直径
example: This hole was a scant .23 inches in diameter.
translation: 这个洞眼的直径只有0.23英寸。

meaning: n. 光荣，荣誉；赞颂; v. 自豪，骄傲；狂喜
example: The glory of the idea blossomed in his mind.
translation: 在他的脑海中这一想法变得越来越宏大。

meaning: n. 盎司；少量；雪豹
example: This little ball of gold weighs a quarter of an ounce.
translation: 这个小金球重0.25盎司。

meaning: n. 腹部；下腹；腹腔
example: The patient is complaining of pain in the abdomen, doctor.
translation: 大夫, 病人在叫肚子疼.

meaning: v. 歧视；区别；辨别
n. 肘部；弯头；扶手; v. 推挤；用手肘推开
example: When you are sitting, keep your elbow on the arm rest.
translation: 坐立时，把胳膊肘靠在扶手上。

meaning: n. 染料；染色; v. 染；把…染上颜色
example: Applying the dye can be messy, particularly on long hair.
translation: 涂抹染发剂可能会搞得一团糟，特别是长发。

meaning: n. 社会主义
example: Jamaica's socialist government is adopting US-inspired free market practices.
translation: 牙买加的社会主义政府正在仿效美国实行自由市场。

meaning: n. 圣歌（尤指美国南部黑人的）; adj. 精神的，心灵的
example: spiritual civilization
translation: 精神文明

meaning: v. 偿还；报答；报复
example: His main task is to raise enough finance to repay secured loans.
translation: 他的主要任务是筹集足够的资金以偿还抵押贷款。

meaning: n. 激光
example: He made contact with someone with an idea for reconditioning laser copiers.
translation: 他联系了一个会修理激光复印机的人。

meaning: adj. 令人愉快的，舒适的；讨人喜欢的，和蔼可亲的; n. (Pleasant)人名；(英)普莱曾特
example: Lloyd George was most anxious to be agreeable and pleasant.
translation: 劳埃德·乔治极力想表现得平易近人、和蔼亲切。

meaning: v. 抽打；煽动；搅打（蛋，奶油）；彻底击败; n. 鞭子；抽打；车夫；[机] 搅拌器
example: His gauntlets contain a flamethrower, and a whipcord lanyard launcher.
translation: 他的护手里安装了火焰喷射器和绳索发射器.

meaning: v. 登记；使加入；把记入名册；使入伍
example: I should like to enroll all my children in the swimming class.
translation: 我愿意让我的孩子们都参加游泳班.

meaning: adj. 每月的，每月一次的；有效期为一个月的; n. 月刊; adv. 每月，每月一次
example: She presents a monthly magazine programme on the BBC.
translation: 她在英国广播公司主持一个月刊节目。

meaning: n. 复合材料；合成物；菊科; adj. 复合的；合成的；菊科的; vt. 使合成；使混合
example: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people.
translation: 西班牙是多种传统和多个民族的合成体。

meaning: n. 几何学
example: His idea was to apply geometry to dynamics.
translation: 他的想法就是将几何学应用在力学上。

meaning: n. 动力；促进；冲力
example: This is the primary impetus behind the economic recovery.
translation: 这是促使经济复苏的主要动力.

meaning: v. 逃走；消失，消散
example: A trickle of refugees began to flee the country.
translation: 难民开始三五成群地陆续逃离该国。

meaning: n. 郡，县
example: For a local bus timetable, contact Dyfed County Council.
translation: 若要当地公共汽车时刻表，请与达费德郡政务委员会联系。

meaning: n. 瓷；瓷器; adj. 瓷制的；精美的
example: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
translation: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

meaning: n. 学期；半年
example: fall semester
translation: 秋季班，秋季学期

meaning: n. 微风；轻而易举的事；煤屑；焦炭渣；小风波; v. 吹微风；逃走
example: The blustery winds of spring had dropped to a gentle breeze.
translation: 呼啸的春风已经减弱，成了习习的微风。

meaning: n. 计算机硬件；五金器具
example: Hardware stores have sold out of water pumps and tarpaulins.
translation: 五金店内水泵和防水油布已经卖光了。

meaning: n. 间隔；间距；幕间休息
example: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years.
translation: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。

meaning: v. 使麻木；使发愣；使失去感觉; adj. 麻木的；发愣的
example: He could feel his fingers growing numb at their tips.
translation: 他能感到指尖正在变得麻木。

meaning: n. 创伤，伤口; v. 使受伤
example: wound healing
translation: 创伤修复，愈合；伤口愈合

meaning: n. 鸡肉；小鸡；胆小鬼，懦夫; adj. 鸡肉的；胆怯的；幼小的
example: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
translation: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

meaning: v. 把…做成流线型；使现代化；组织；使合理化；使简单化; n. 流线；流线型; adj. 流线型的
example: The cars all have a new streamlined design.
translation: 这些汽车都是流线型新款。

meaning: n. 协调；和睦；融洽；调和
example: As they smiled at each other, harmony was restored again.
translation: 他们彼此微笑的时候，又恢复了往日的和睦。

meaning: adv. 今后；自此以后
example: We were finally released with a formal warning that we were henceforth barred from the base.
translation: 我们被正式警告从此不得进入基地后终于获得了释放。

meaning: n. 横幅图片的广告模式
example: Lucy had strung a banner across the wall saying "Welcome Home Daddy".
translation: 露西在墙上挂了一条横幅，上面写着“欢迎爸爸回家”。

meaning: n. 狮子；名人；勇猛的人；社交场合的名流
example: A man-eating lion is on the loose somewhere in England.
translation: 英格兰有一头吃人的狮子跑出来了。

meaning: n. 香槟酒；香槟酒色
example: We had a nice meal with a bottle of champagne.
translation: 我们美餐了一顿，还喝了一瓶香槟。

meaning: n. 分类；类别，等级
example: These things belong in a different classification.
translation: 这些东西属于不同的类别.

meaning: v. 插入；嵌入; n. 插入物；管芯；镶块；[机械]刀片
example: Insert coins into the slot and press for a ticket.
translation: 把硬币放进投币口，按钮取票。

meaning: adj. 侦探的; n. 侦探
example: "Once a detective, always a detective," he said lightly.
translation: “一日为侦探，终生为侦探，”他满不在意地说。

meaning: n. 原子
example: He patented the idea that the atom could be split.
translation: 他获得了“原子可以再分”这一概念的专利权。

meaning: n. 恐怖；恐怖行动；恐怖时期；可怕的人
example: Anything to terrorise the civilian population.
translation: 任何让平民恐惧的事情都会发生.

meaning: v. 在…上铺地毯，把地毯铺在…上；斥责; n. 地毯；地毯状覆盖物
example: The carpet was a wedding present from the Prime Minister.
translation: 这张地毯是首相送的结婚礼物。

meaning: v. 派遣；发送；匆匆吃下; n. 派遣；发送（等于dispatch）
example: He feels we should act with despatch.
translation: 他觉得我们应该迅速行动。

meaning: n. 欺骗；骗子；诡计
example: Fraud squad officers had bugged the phone and were ready to pounce.
translation: 反诈骗小组的警员们已在电话上安装了窃听器，并随时准备突击。

meaning: n. 发烧，发热；狂热; vt. 使发烧；使狂热；使患热病; vi. 发烧；狂热；患热病
example: During fever a large quantity of fluid is lost in perspiration.
translation: 发烧时，大量水分会通过排汗而丧失。

meaning: n. 海湾；深渊；分歧；漩涡; vt. 吞没
example: These issues were brought into sharp focus by the Gulf crisis.
translation: 海湾危机让这些问题备受关注。

meaning: v. 鞭打；冲击；摆动；扎捆；煽动；讽刺; n. 鞭打；睫毛；鞭子；责骂；讽刺
example: Never before had he felt the full lash of John's temper.
translation: 他以前从未见识过约翰如此暴烈的脾气.

meaning: n. 人行道
example: Crews stray outside to film the view from the pavement.
translation: 工作人员移到人行道上拍摄这一景色。

meaning: n. [植] 胚芽，萌芽；细菌; vi. 萌芽
example: The germ of an idea took root in Rosemary's mind.
translation: 罗斯玛丽心里萌生了一个念头。

meaning: adj. 平的；单调的；不景气的；干脆的；平坦的；扁平的；浅的; adv. （尤指贴着另一表面）平直地；断然地；水平地；直接地，完全地; n. 平地；公寓；平面; vt. 使变平；[音乐]使（音调）下降，尤指降半音; vi. 逐渐变平；[音乐]以降调唱（或奏）
example: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
translation: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

meaning: v. 使溢出，使流出；使摔下; n. 溢出，溅出；溢出量；摔下；小塞子
example: Put the bottle in a plastic bag in case of spillage.
translation: 把瓶子装在塑料袋里，以免洒得到处都是。

meaning: n. 拍打，拍打声；神经紧张；[航] 襟翼; v. 拍动；神经紧张；鼓翼而飞；（帽边等）垂下
example: They would flap bath towels from their balconies as they chatted.
translation: 他们聊天时会在阳台上抖搂浴巾。

meaning: v. 激增；膨胀如气球; n. 气球; adj. 像气球般鼓起的
example: They floated the trial balloon of actually cutting Social Security.
translation: 他们推出了真正削减社会保障的试行方案。

meaning: v. 标记；衰退；枯萎; n. 标志；旗子
example: On top of the gantry the American flag flew.
translation: 台架顶上飞舞着美国国旗。

meaning: adj. 液体的；清澈的；明亮的；易变的; n. 液体，流体；流音
example: We found a cyst and I suctioned off the liquid within.
translation: 我们发现了一个囊肿，我把其中的液体吸了出来。

meaning: n. 浴盆；桶; vt. 把…装入桶；为…洗盆浴; vi. 洗盆浴；（衣服等）被放在桶里洗
example: in the tub
translation: 破产

meaning: adj. 东方的；朝东的；东洋的; n. 东方人；（美国）东部地区的人
example: Physical and ideological barriers had come down in Eastern Europe.
translation: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

meaning: n. 美德；优点；贞操；功效
example: Even if she were a virtueless woman , or a shameless whore, she would be Queen nevertheless.
translation: 但纵然没有任何德性,纵然不过是个娼妓,那时候, 她也仍旧是王后.

meaning: n. 拖船；拖曳；苦干; v. 用力拉；竞争；努力做
example: The Tugboat Saloon and Eatery is a must-visit.
translation: 拖轮沙龙和小餐馆是必去之处。

meaning: n. 公路，大路；捷径
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: n. 铜；铜币；警察; adj. 铜制的; v. 镀铜
example: The combination of sex and treachery proved a copper-bottomed circulation booster.
translation: 事实证明，性和背叛的话题结合起来无疑大大增加了发行量。

meaning: n. 志愿者；志愿兵; adj. 志愿的; v. 自愿
example: Long is the way the leads of the voluptuary to the severities of life.
translation: 将骄奢淫逸的人引到艰苦的生活中来,这条路是漫长的.

meaning: n. 象；大号图画纸
example: The pavilion has become a £4 million steel and glass white elephant.
translation: 这个耗资400万英镑、用钢与玻璃所构筑起的亭子已经成了一个华而不实的摆设。

meaning: n. 美；美丽；美人；美好的东西
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: adj. 古怪的，反常的; n. 古怪的人
example: Great chess players have a reputation for being both eccentric and argumentative.
translation: 国际象棋大师们以性格怪异和好与人争辩而闻名。

meaning: n. 矿物；（英）矿泉水；无机物；苏打水（常用复数表示）; adj. 矿物的；矿质的
example: The mineral is weakly magnetic.
translation: 这种矿物带有轻微的磁性。

meaning: n. 病；疾病
example: Attitudes to mental illness have shifted in recent years.
translation: 最近几年对精神病的态度已有所改变。

meaning: adj. 习惯的；通常的; n. 习惯法汇编
example: They interrupted the customary one minute's silence with jeers and shouts.
translation: 他们讥讽着，喊叫着，打破了惯常的那一分钟沉默。

meaning: v. 剥，剥落；削; n. 皮
example: Blend in the lemon extract, lemon peel and walnuts.
translation: 调入柠檬汁、柠檬皮和核桃。

meaning: n. 惊吓；惊骇; v. 使惊恐
example: Howard wanted to be a popular singer, but stage fright crippled him.

meaning: n. 暖和， 温暖 A；热心， 热情

translation: 这个系列剧按照时间顺序记述了两个老光棍每天的奇遇。

translation: 我的医生要我去做个检查，看是否患有糖尿病。

translation: 我们常常用红字表示危险.

meaning: n. 雄伟， 壮丽， 庄严

translation: 枯燥的日常政务都由女王陛下的政府行政部门来处理。

translation: 一个需求可以由多个界面元素来满足,这种情况比较普遍.

translation: 新的版式会疏远上了年纪的读者群，并且也不会吸引年轻读者。

meaning: v. 招待， 款待; vt. 使娱乐； 使欢乐

translation: 他是一个精力非凡、志向远大、政治上很有见识的人。

meaning: vt. 超过， 胜过
example: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day.
translation: 每天的饮酒量不应超过两个计量单位。

meaning: v. 扩大， 放大， 增大
example: Workmen were hired to remodel and enlarge the farm buildings.
translation: 雇用了工人来改造和扩建农场建筑。

meaning: vt. 防止， 避免 A；转移
example: He managed to avert suspicion.
translation: 他设法避嫌.

meaning: n. 基督， 救世主
example: He looked at her watch. "Christ! We only have three minutes!"
translation: 他看了看她的表：“天哪！我们仅剩3分钟了！”

meaning: vt. 轻拍， 轻打； 抚摸; n. 轻拍， 轻打； 抚摸
example: Pat was a tower of strength to our whole family.
translation: 帕特是我们全家人的主心骨。

meaning: n. 装船， 装运；装载的货物； 装货量
example: By sheer fluke, one of the shipowner's employees was in the city.
translation: 非常凑巧的是，船主的一个雇员正在城里。

meaning: n. 马力
example: a powerful car with a 170 horsepower engine
translation: 发动机为170马力的大功率汽车

meaning: adj. 邪恶的， 恶毒的， 凶残的
example: "He deserved to die," said Penelope viciously.
translation: “他该去死，”佩内洛普恶毒地说道。

meaning: v. 系带， 扎带; n. 蕾丝， 花边；带子， 鞋带
example: I am wearing a plaid nightgown trimmed with white lace.
translation: 我穿着一件带有白色蕾丝花边的格子呢睡衣。

meaning: n. 邀请， 招待；请柬
example: "I can't pass this up." She waved the invitation.
translation: “我不能错过这个机会，”她挥舞着请帖说。

meaning: n. 爪
example: cat's paw
translation: 傀儡；受人利用者

meaning: n. 潮湿， 湿气， 湿度
example: A thin, glistening thread of moisture ran along the rough concrete sill.
translation: 在粗糙不平的水泥窗台上有一条细细的发光水印。

meaning: adj. 巨大的， 庞大的
example: She was a shy, delicately pretty girl with enormous blue eyes.
translation: 她是一个害羞、娇美的女孩，长着一双大大的蓝眼睛。

meaning: v. 烘， 烤；祝酒; n. 烤面包， 吐司；祝酒
example: propose a toast
translation: 敬酒；举杯

meaning: adj. 外部的， 外面的
example: External broadcasting soaks up more resources in Britain than elsewhere.
translation: 英国花费在对外广播上的财力高于其他国家。

meaning: n. 情况，情形
example: You might say that we've been victims of circumstance.
translation: 你可以说我们一直不走运吧。

meaning: n. 元音； 元音字母
example: To mark ( a vowelless Hebrew text , for example ) with vowel points.
translation: 加元音符号于 ( 如没有元音的希伯莱文 )

meaning: vt. 修订， 校订 <；修正， 修改
example: The staff should work together to revise the school curriculum.
translation: 全体教职工应当齐心协力修订学校课程。

meaning: n. 权力； 威信； 权威；学术权威， 专家； 权威的典籍 A
example: Fifteen-year-old Danny is on the run from a local authority home.
translation: 15岁的丹尼从地方当局的收容所逃跑了。

meaning: n. 人， 动物；产物
example: Alaskan Eskimos believe that every living creature possesses a spirit.
translation: 阿拉斯加的爱斯基摩人认为每一个活着的生物都有灵魂。

meaning: adj. 友善的， 友好的；好交际的， 合群的
example: Hall very sociably pulled up.
translation: 霍尔和气地勒住僵绳.

meaning: n. 半导体
example: semiconductor laser
translation: [光]半导体激光（等于diode laser）

meaning: adj. 已废弃的， 过时的
example: With technological changes many traditional skills have become obsolete.
translation: 随着技术的革新，许多传统技艺已被淘汰。

meaning: n. 工具， 仪器， 器械 A；乐器
example: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
translation: 一种叫做套管针的工具在腹壁上刺了一个孔。

meaning: n. 汽油
example: Unleaded gasoline rose more than a penny a gallon.
translation: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了1分多。

meaning: adj. 中等的， 适中的; n. 中间； 适中；媒介物， 媒体； 传导体
example: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

meaning: n. 界面； 分界面；接口
example: The different components all have to interface smoothly.
translation: 不同的部件都必须能顺利接合。

meaning: n. 激素， 荷尔蒙
example: Hormone replacement therapy is very important and should be instituted early.
translation: 激素替代治疗非常重要，应该及早开始。

meaning: n. 智慧， 明智；名言， 格言
example: They might be wise to stop advertising on television.
translation: 他们不妨停止在电视上做广告，这样做可能是明智之举。

meaning: adj. 致命的； 毁灭性的
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: n. 心理学；心理
example: Abraham Maslow described psychology as "the science of being."
translation: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛形容心理学是“存在的科学”。

meaning: n. 岭， 山脉；屋脊 A；鼻梁
example: Every man who could fight was now committed to defend the ridge.
translation: 每个能够参加战斗的男子现在都决心要保卫这条山脊。

meaning: n. 航线；航空公司
example: The airline had losses of $35m and was bailed out by Qantas.
translation: 这家航空公司亏损达3,500万美元，而澳航出资帮助其摆脱了困境。

meaning: adj. 可动的， 活动的， 运动的
example: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
translation: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。

meaning: v. 履行， 执行； 做；表演， 演出
example: He can perform an astonishing variety of acts, including mime and juggling.
translation: 他能表演好几种令人惊叹的把戏，包括哑剧和玩杂耍。

meaning: n. 进化， 渐进， 演化
example: the evolution of the human species
translation: 人类的进化

meaning: adj. 高峰的； 最高的; n. 顶点， 最高点；峰， 山峰
example: The news programme goes out four times a week at peak time.
translation: 这档新闻节目每周在黄金时段播出4次。

meaning: n. 肖像， 画像
example: Today his picture goes on show at the National Portrait Gallery.
translation: 今天他的画作在国家肖像美术馆展出。

meaning: n. 抱怨， 诉苦；申诉；疾病
example: Eczema is a common skin complaint which often runs in families.
translation: 湿疹是一种常见的皮肤病，通常具遗传性。

meaning: vt. 注射， 注入
example: The result might inject more sense into future bargaining.
translation: 其结果可能为未来的谈判注入更多的理性。

meaning: v. 引导； 集中; n. 海峡， 水道；信道， 频道；途径， 渠道
example: The series goes out at 10.30pm, Fridays, on Channel 4.
translation: 这部连续剧每周五晚上10点30分在第4频道播出。

meaning: vi. 聚集， 集中 A; n. 焦点， 中心
example: In the background, in soft focus, we see his smiling wife.
translation: 在背景部分，我们可以看到他妻子面带微笑的蒙影像。

meaning: adj. 看不见的； 无形的
example: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel.
translation: 一名办事员会感到如此受人忽视，令人觉得不可思议。

meaning: vt. 妨碍， 阻碍； 牵制， 束缚
example: Before entering the bathroom, he emptied his dirty laundry into the hamper.
translation: 进浴室前，他把脏衣服全都放进洗衣筐里。

meaning: adj. 赞许的； 有利的， 顺利的
adj. 完全的， 全部的， 完整的
example: If the Commission has its way, the entire deal will be scuppered.
translation: 如果委员会我行我素的话，整个交易将化为泡影。

meaning: n. 汽车旅馆
example: He took off at once and headed back to the motel.
translation: 他立刻离开，回到汽车旅馆。

meaning: n. 腕， 腕关节
example: He has to wear a security wristband and be under constant supervision.
translation: 他必须戴着监控手环并且实时监控.

meaning: v. 靠近， 接近， 邻近; n. 方法， 途径；探讨； 试探
example: We have a very communicative approach to teaching languages.
translation: 我们在语言教学中非常强调交际教学法。

meaning: n. 豌豆
example: green pea
translation: 嫩豌豆；青豌豆

meaning: n. 百科全书
example: He was a walking encyclopaedia.
translation: 他是一部活的百科全书。

meaning: n. 店主
example: Shopkeeping naturally bulks large among London occupations.
translation: 开店铺在伦敦各职业间,自然显得重要.

meaning: adj. 决定性的
example: They were outplayed by the Colombians' slick passing and decisive finishing.
translation: 哥伦比亚队凭借流畅的传球和终场前的制胜进球击败了他们。

meaning: adj. 简明的， 简洁的
example: Burton's text is concise and informative.
translation: 伯顿的文章语言简洁，信息丰富。

meaning: n. 论文；论题； 论点
example: graduation thesis
translation: 毕业论文；毕业设计

meaning: v. 碰， 撞；颠簸着前进; n. 碰， 撞；隆起物
example: The child took five steps, and then sat down with a bump.
translation: 小孩走了5步，接着扑通一声坐到了地上。

meaning: v. 恢复； 复苏 <
example: He is seeking advice on how to revive the stagnant economy.
translation: 他正在就如何振兴低迷的经济征求意见。

meaning: prep. 每；经， 由
example: He pronounced it Per-sha, the way the English do.
translation: 他像英格兰人那样将它读成Per-sha。

meaning: n. 工资， 报酬; vt. 进行， 开展
example: A wager is a fool's argument.
translation: 傻瓜一争论就打赌.

meaning: n. 纤维， 纤维质
example: The muscle fiber of this animal is diseased.
translation: 这个动物的肌肉纤维产生了病变.

meaning: vi. 进行， 继续下去； 发生
example: This can be done if you proceed as follows.
translation: 按照如下操作即可完成。

meaning: n. 公司， 企业； 团体 <
example: The Commonwealth Development Corporation has agreed to reschedule Tanzania's debt.
translation: 英联邦开发公司已经同意推迟坦桑尼亚的债务偿还时间。

meaning: n. 忠诚， 忠心
example: Loyalty and support became the bywords of the day.
translation: 忠诚和支持成了那个时代人们时常挂在嘴边的词儿。

meaning: n. 灯泡； 球状物
example: A 40 watt bulb would be quite sufficient and would not obtrude.
translation: 40瓦的灯泡完全够亮了，并且不会晃眼。

meaning: vt. 免职， 解雇， 开除； 解散
example: The Prime Minister has the power to dismiss and appoint senior ministers.
translation: 首相有权任免高级部长。

meaning: adj. 含蓄的； 潜在的； 根本的； 在下面的
example: In some stores we were undermanned and customer service was suffering.
translation: 有些店我们人手不足，对顾客照顾不周。

meaning: n. 智力， 才智； 灵性， 悟性；情报， 消息； 报道
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: vt. 分析； 分解
example: They will take that problem apart and analyze it in great detail.
translation: 他们会认真分析那个问题，指出其症结所在。

meaning: n. 指出， 指示；迹象， 暗示
example: If she had noticed her father's entrance, she gave no indication.
translation: 就算她已经注意到了父亲的到来，她也会不动声色。

meaning: n. 体积， 容积；大批， 大量， 大块
example: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
translation: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

meaning: vi. 对…绝望; n. 绝望
example: Don't let yourself despair; this will only make matters worse.
translation: 不要想不开，这样只能使情况变得更糟。

meaning: n. 公牛
example: I also met with Pollack again to kind of shoot the bull.
translation: 我也再次和波拉克会面，两人闲聊了会儿。

meaning: n. 冠军， 得胜者；拥护者； 勇士
example: The heavyweight champion will be given a shot at Holyfield's world title.
translation: 这名重量级拳击冠军将尝试挑战霍利菲尔德的世界冠军头衔。

meaning: n. 树胶；口香糖
example: When not removed, plaque causes tooth decay and gum disease.
translation: 牙斑如果不清除就会导致牙齿蛀蚀和牙龈疾病。

meaning: adj. 奇怪的， 异常的；不舒服的； 眩晕的
example: I could not help but think this is a very queer life.
translation: 我忍不住会认为这是一种非常怪异的生活。

meaning: n. 周线； 巡回； 环行；电路， 线路
example: He was just starting to become known on the cabaret circuit.
translation: 他在卡巴莱歌舞表演圈中刚刚开始有点名气。

meaning: adj. 本能的， 直觉的; n. 肠； 肠线; vt. 毁坏的内部；取出…的内脏
example: "Is it right she belted old George in the gut?" she asked.
translation: “她真的把老乔治痛打了一顿？”她问。

meaning: adj. 壮丽的， 宏伟的
example: At 54 years old her energy and looks are magnificent.
translation: 她54岁了，精力和气色都非常好。

meaning: n. 家伙， 伙计
example: This guy, Jack Smith, does he go by the name of Jackal?
translation: 这个叫杰克·史密斯的家伙是不是还有个名字叫杰凯尔？

meaning: vt. 限制， 约束 <
example: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills.
translation: 村民们说这个围栏将限制公众进入山区。

meaning: adj. 立即的， 直接的；紧迫的；速溶的； 方便的; n. 瞬间， 时刻
example: In the same instant he flung open the car door.
translation: 与此同时，他猛地推开了车门。

meaning: vi. 偷看， 窥视
example: "Fourteen minutes," Chris said, taking a peep at his watch.
translation: “14分钟,”克里斯瞥了一眼他的手表说道.

meaning: vi. 仔细看， 费力地看; n. 同龄人； 同等地位的人；贵族
example: Lord Swan was made a life peer in 1981.
translation: 斯旺勋爵于1981年受封终身贵族。

meaning: vt. 迫害 <
example: They persecute those who do not conform to their ideas.
translation: 他们迫害那些不信奉他们思想的人.

meaning: adj. 昂贵的； 价值高的； 豪华的
example: Psychometric tests can save organizations from grim and costly mistakes.
translation: 心理测试能够使组织机构避免犯下损失惨重的大错。

meaning: adj. 必要的； 紧急的， 极重要的；命令的; n. 必要的事， 必须完成的事；祈使语气 “
example: It was imperative that he act as naturally as possible.
translation: 最重要的是他要做到尽可能自然。

meaning: adv. 到目前为止， 迄今 <
example: a hitherto unknown species of moth
translation: 迄今仍属未知种类的蛾

meaning: adj. 文献的; n. 纪录片
example: The documentary left me in a state of shock.
translation: 那部纪录片使我大为震惊。

meaning: n. 暴力， 暴行；激烈， 猛烈
example: The crowds became violent and threw petrol bombs at the police.
translation: 人群变得狂暴起来，并向警察投掷汽油弹。

meaning: adv. 因此， 从而；相应地， 照着
example: We have to discover his plans and act accordingly.
translation: 我们得找出他的计划，照着办。

meaning: n. 结果， 后果， 影响；重要性
example: as a consequence
translation: 因此，结果

meaning: adj. 健壮的， 强壮的， 健康的
example: The Neanderthals were very robust and quite different from us.
translation: 尼安德特时期的人非常强壮，和我们迥然不同。

meaning: adj. 线的， 直线的 A；长度的；【数】线性的
example: In his art he broke the laws of scientific linear perspective.
translation: 他在自己的绘画艺术中打破了科学的直线透视法规律。

meaning: adj. 支配的， 统治的；占优势的
example: Japan is Asia's dominant supplier of imports and technology.
translation: 日本是亚洲进口货物和技术的最大供应国。

meaning: vt. 削皮， 剥皮; n. 果皮
example: Blend in the lemon extract, lemon peel and walnuts.
translation: 调入柠檬汁、柠檬皮和核桃。

meaning: vt. 公开指责， 抨击；告发某人
v. 接近， 濒临; n. 边， 边缘
example: on the verge of
translation: 濒临于；接近于

meaning: n. 构架， 框架， 结构
example: The magazine's aim is to discuss topical issues within a Christian framework.
translation: 该杂志的宗旨是在基督教框架下讨论时下的热门话题。

meaning: adj. 不顾的， 不考虑的 <
example: Everyone is treated equally, irrespective of race.
translation: 不分种族，每个人都受到公平对待。

meaning: n. 实体； 事物的存在
example: The state is not a unified and internally coherent entity.
translation: 该国不是一个统一的、内部团结的实体。

meaning: n. 潮， 潮汐；潮流， 趋势
example: spring tide
translation: 大潮；涨潮

meaning: vt. 禁止， 阻止， 不准 <；使不可能
example: In most of the residence halls we visited, rules prohibit disorderly conduct.
translation: 在我们走访的学生宿舍里，大多明令禁止胡作非为。

meaning: n. 特许权；选举权；经销权; vt. 特许
example: The diving school has acquired a franchise for scuba equipment.
translation: 潜水学校获得潜水用水肺的特许经营权.

meaning: n. 乘务员
example: Please show your ticket to the stewardess when you board the plane.
translation: 登机时请向空中小姐出示机票.

meaning: n. 箭； 箭头， 箭状物
example: An arrow pointed to the toilets.
translation: 箭头指向卫生间。

meaning: vi. 统治， 支配；盛行； 占优势; n. 统治， 支配； 统治时期； 朝代
example: The commanders accused him of carrying out a reign of terror.
translation: 指挥官们谴责他实行恐怖统治。

meaning: n. 节奏， 速度； 行进速度
example: Although spiritual leader of millions of people, the Pope has no temporal power.
translation: 教皇虽然是亿万人的精神领袖，但没有丝毫的世俗权力。

meaning: n. 子孙， 后代
example: His design was a descendant of a 1956 device.
translation: 他的设计是从一个1956年的装置衍生而来的。

meaning: n. 方式， 方法；举止；风俗
example: There was much curiosity about what manner of man he was.
translation: 他究竟是什么样的人，大家都十分好奇。

meaning: vt. 预见， 预知 <
example: We do not foresee any problems.
translation: 我们预料不会出任何问题。

meaning: vi. 交往， 结合; adj. 副的; vt. 使联系， 使联合; n. 合作人， 伙伴， 同事， 同行
example: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
translation: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

meaning: n. 肾， 肾脏
example: Liver and kidney are particularly rich in vitamin A.
translation: 肝脏和肾脏的维生素A含量尤其丰富。

meaning: n. 审判， 判决；判断力， 识别力； 看法， 意见
example: I depended on his companionship and on his judgment.
translation: 我信赖他的友情，也相信他的判断。

meaning: n. 慈善， 仁慈， 施舍 <
example: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
translation: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

meaning: n. 文具
example: The stationmaster pounced and wrestled the gun from him.
translation: 站长猛扑过去，奋力夺下他手中的枪。

meaning: adv. 后来， 以后
example: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: n. 名声， 声望
example: He had a reputation for being bloody-minded and difficult.
translation: 他为人刻薄、难相处是出了名的。

meaning: v. 耸肩; n. 耸肩
example: Everybody accepts that the threat has now shrunk to vanishing point.
translation: 现在每个人都认为，威胁已几近消失了。

meaning: n. 独立， 自主
example: The pull-out of the army paves the way for independence.
translation: 军队的撤出为独立铺平了道路。

meaning: vt. 抑制， 制止
example: Unable to restrain herself, she rose and went to the phone.
translation: 她没能克制住自己，起身走向电话。

meaning: adj. 笨拙的， 不灵活的；棘手的； 尴尬的；使用不便的

translation: 不幸的是，奶奶好像总是醒来的不是时候。

meaning: v. 毁灭， 毁坏； 破产； 堕落; n. 毁灭， 崩溃

translation: 她不会让她的计划破产的。

meaning: n. 羊肉

translation: 他喜欢吃用大蒜调味的羊肉.

meaning: adj. 不耐烦的， 急躁的

translation: 一个小时、两个小时过去了，他不耐烦了。

meaning: v. 溢出， 溅出; n. 摔下， 跌下

translation: 把瓶子装在塑料袋里，以免洒得到处都是。

meaning: n. 摇篮 A；发源地
example: Mali is the cradle of some of Africa's richest civilizations.
translation: 马里是非洲一些最悠久的文明的发祥地。

meaning: n. 收藏， 收集

meaning: n. 发现， 发现物

meaning: n. 实验室， 研究室

translation: 在实验室用老鼠进行的实验证明了这一点。

meaning: adj. 拉丁的； 拉丁文的; n. 拉丁语

translation: 卡萝尔身材高大，黑发棕肤，是个有着拉丁风情的女子。

meaning: vt. 检查， 调查， 视察

meaning: n. 战役；活动； 竞选运动

meaning: adj. 生死攸关的， 重大的；生命的， 生机的

translation: 要害部位

meaning: vi. 抵触， 冲突 A; n. 战斗， 斗争；矛盾， 冲突
example: The ethnic populations are so intermingled that there's bound to be conflict.
translation: 各民族人口如此杂居，肯定会发生冲突。

meaning: vt. 更新； 使现代化

translation: 大多数制造商都满足于对现有款型进行更新。

meaning: vt. 察觉， 发觉；侦察， 探测

translation: 他猜测说有些人也许能够察觉重大灾难。

meaning: adj. 业余的; n. 业余活动者
example: Angela says she longs to join an amateur dramatics class.
translation: 安杰拉说她渴望参加业余戏剧班。

meaning: vt. 谴责， 指责 A；判刑， 宣告有罪

translation: 银行家们立即声讨有追溯效力的税收立法。

meaning: n. 商业， 贸易

translation: 和商业部长之间明显存在竞争。

meaning: n. 帮助， 援助
example: Any assistance you could give the police will be greatly appreciated.
translation: 您提供的任何帮助警方都将万分感谢。

meaning: n. 海湾
example: These issues were brought into sharp focus by the Gulf crisis.
translation: 海湾危机让这些问题备受关注。

meaning: n. 定义， 解释
example: It all depends on your definition of punk, doesn'tit?
translation: “这全视乎你对朋克摇滚乐的定义，不是吗？”

translation: 剃掉，刮掉

meaning: adj. 概括的， 简略的; n. 摘要， 概要

meaning: n. 镍 <；镍币； 五美分

meaning: vt. 使习惯于<
example: It took him a while to accustom himself to the idea.
translation: 他过了一段时间才习惯这个想法.

meaning: vt. 牵涉； 使成为必要；限定继承人
example: Selective aversion to certain risks may entail acceptance of other greater risks.
translation: 有选择地回避某些风险可能招致更大的风险.

meaning: n. 宣传
example: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
translation: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

meaning: adj. 下等的， 下级的； 差的， 次的  <; n. 下级； 晚辈

translation: 他喜欢与那些智力水平不如他的人共处。

meaning: n. 硫

translation: 硫含量

meaning: n. 避难处， 藏身处

translation: 我们沿着一条蜿蜒的小道爬向山上的一处避难所。

meaning: adj. 戏剧的； 戏剧性的；巨大的； 突然的

translation: 在纪录片《与恐龙同行》中可以看到最新的、更加生动的电脑特效技术。

meaning: n. 必然， 肯定；必然的事

translation: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和把握就毫无价值。

meaning: n. 脊骨， 脊柱， 脊椎；刺， 刺毛 A；书脊

translation: 我对奥思太太写出内容如此翔实的文章表示赞许。

meaning: v. 腐蚀， 侵蚀

meaning: n. 吉他， 六弦琴

translation: 安开始弹吉他时，莫莉感到有些难堪。

meaning: n. 蚊子

translation: 我把蚊帐甩到一边，跳下床来。

meaning: adj. 人工的， 人造的；矫揉造作的

translation: 有机食品是未使用人工化学制剂和杀虫剂的纯净食品。

meaning: n. 寄生虫

translation: 寄生虫传播的一种方式是通过排泄物。

meaning: n. 缺乏， 不足；缺陷， 缺点
example: Symptoms of anaemia include weakness, fatigue and iron deficiency.
translation: 贫血的症状包括虚弱、疲劳和缺铁。

meaning: adj. 想象的， 虚构的
example: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
translation: 精神分裂症的最常见的一个症状就是幻听。

translation: 那只是一笔带过的评论，他没有继续论述。

translation: 人生最大的幸福是实现对 自我 的超越.

translation: 他捕捉到五条鲟鱼.

meaning: n. 寓言 A <

translation: 这则古老的寓言流传了数个世纪。

meaning: adj. 称心的； 值得要的

translation: 人群为了被视为最值得拥有的物品涌入屋里。

meaning: n. 阳台；楼厅， 楼座

translation: 克里斯拉开百叶窗，走到了阳台上。

meaning: v. 在于， 存在于；由…组成， 由…构成

translation: 这个师的组成部队将包括两个坦克连和一个步兵连。

meaning: n. 准备， 预备；制剂， 制备品

translation: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

meaning: vt. 刺伤， 刺痛；刺孔; n. 刺伤， 刺痛

translation: 将马铃薯戳一些洞，并用盐揉搓外皮。

meaning: adj. 能和睦相处的， 合得来的；兼容的

translation: 他认为自由企业制并不违背俄罗斯的价值观和传统。

meaning: n. 语法； 语法书

translation: 他不通语法和乱用标点是出了名的。

meaning: n. 批评家， 评论家；批评， 评论

translation: 他是个苛刻的批评家，但却是个非常善良的人。

meaning: vt. 使能够， 使成为可能

translation: 该委员会将实现民主决议过程。

meaning: n. 台风

translation: 马特软弱无能且依赖性强，但我们照样爱他。

meaning: n. 职业， 自由职业；公开表示

meaning: vt. 悲悼， 哀叹；谴责

meaning: n. 拉链; vt. 用拉链拉上或扣上

translation: n. 邮政编码

meaning: vt. 压缩， 浓缩

translation: 他从来就不懂如何对大篇的材料进行整理或精简。

meaning: vi. 出现， 发生；由…引起， 由…产生 A

translation: 无论出现什么样的麻烦，我们都会在貌似混乱的情形中保持平和的心态。

meaning: vt. 珍爱 <；怀有

translation: 总统将铭记这次俄亥俄之行。

meaning: n. 想象， 空想； 想象力
example: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world.
translation: 儿童可能无法将自己的幻想与真实世界区分开来。

meaning: n. 抵抗， 反抗； 抵抗力， 阻力；电阻

translation: 最后库尔德人没有作任何抵抗就投降了。

meaning: adj. 杰出的， 显赫的

translation: [律]土地征用权；国家最高支配权

meaning: adv. 在下面， 在底下; prep. 在…下面

translation: 我们已发起一场要求改善幼儿园和中小学教育服务的运动。

meaning: n. 【物】谱； 光谱； 【电信】频谱；范围， 幅度

meaning: vt. 拉长， 延长

meaning: n. 阀；电子管， 真空管

translation: n. [化]控制阀

meaning: adj. 特别喜欢的， 中意的; n. 最喜欢的人或物
example: We had lunch the other day at our favorite restaurant.
translation: 前两天我们在最喜欢的餐馆吃了午饭。

meaning: vt. 退还， 偿还； 退款; n. 退款； 偿还额

translation: 退税；退税单

meaning: n. 苦恼；危难； 不幸; vt. 使苦恼

meaning: n. 残余物； 零头布料；遗迹

meaning: adj. 经典的； 古典的

meaning: n. 特权， 优惠， 特许; vt. 给予优惠， 给予特权
example: Pironi was the son of privilege and wealth, and it showed.
translation: 皮罗尼出身于有钱有势的豪门，这看得出来。

meaning: n. 代用品， 代替品; vt. 代替， 替换
example: In my experience a straight substitution of carob for chocolate doesn'twork.
translation: 根据我的经验，用角豆制品直接代替巧克力行不通。

meaning: vi. 燃烧， 冒火焰；照耀， 发光; n. 火焰； 火光；闪光， 光辉
example: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
translation: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

meaning: adv. 再者， 加之， 而且
example: Moreover, Ramsay was no mean thinker himself.
translation: 而且拉姆齐自己也是一位出色的思想家。

meaning: adj. 神秘的， 可疑的； 难理解的

translation: 不久他们就死了，是一个神秘的投毒者下的手。

meaning: v. 散开， 驱散；散布， 散播

translation: 玛丽阿姨糊里糊涂的,她总是忘东忘西.

meaning: vt. 违反， 违背

meaning: adj. 集体的， 共同的; n. 集体， 团体
example: They have been galvanised into collective action — militarily, politically and economically.
translation: 他们在形势驱使下已经在政治、经济和军事上采取了联合行动。

meaning: v. 驾驶， 掌舵；指导
example: The ship went with easy steerage.
translation: 这条船容易操舵.

meaning: vt. 遭受； 经历； 承受
example: The feeding of dairy cows has undergone a revolution.
translation: 乳牛的喂养方法发生了巨大的改变。

meaning: vi. 同情， 体谅； 共鸣， 同感
example: Sometimes a sympathizer is one step away from a lover.
translation: 有时侯,同情者与情人仅一步之遥.

meaning: vt. 擦掉；删去
example: She tried to erase the memory of that evening.
translation: 她试图忘却那天晚上的事。

meaning: n. 铁路; vt. 由铁道运输
example: The railroad finally reached Santa Barbara in 1877.
translation: 铁路终于在1877年修到了圣巴巴拉。

meaning: n. 代理， 代办处； 机构

translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: n. 包围， 围攻

translation: 西格弗里德畏缩了，退避到墙根。

meaning: adj. 抽象的; n. 摘要， 提要; vt. 提取

translation: 他的绘画经历了具象风格和抽象风格两个阶段。

meaning: vi. 擅长， 胜过其他; vt. 优于， 超过

translation: 他开始在学术上超越他人。

meaning: n. 出现， 出场， 露面；外表， 外貌， 外观

translation: 玛丽莲最后一次公开亮相是在麦迪逊广场花园。

meaning: adj. 液体的， 液态的 A; n. 液体

meaning: adj. 匿名的， 无名的；无特色的

translation: 那些匿名电话的恶毒语气很令他吃惊。

meaning: adj. 假的; n. 假货；骗子; vt. 伪装， 伪造 A

translation: 在搜集了有关情况后，他们说照片是伪造的。

translation: 他的字从小就写得流畅优美。

meaning: adj. 更可取的， 较适合的， 更好的

meaning: n. 共谋， 阴谋

translation: 起初，他幸好不知道那些针对他的阴谋。
