translation: 我回想起多次同她就这些问题及类似话题进行的讨论。

meaning: v. 拍打， 拍动; n. 垂下物； 帽檐； 袋盖；慌乱， 紧张
example: They would flap bath towels from their balconies as they chatted.
translation: 他们聊天时会在阳台上抖搂浴巾。

meaning: vi. 跳， 跳跃 <; n. 跳跃， 飞跃
example: Warwicks leap to third in the table, 31 points behind leaders Essex.
translation: 沃里克队在排名中蹿升至第3名，落后领先的埃塞克斯队31分。

meaning: n. 反对， 异议
example: I no longer have any objection to your going to see her.
translation: 我不会再因为你去见她而不高兴。

meaning: vi. 争论， 争执; n. 争论， 辩论
n. 女衬衫
example: She was wearing a white ruffled blouse and a blue velvet skirt.
translation: 她穿着一件有花边的白色上衣和一条蓝色天鹅绒裙子。

meaning: n. 观察； 观测； 监视；观察资料或报告； 言论
example: The diaries are a mixture of confession, work in progress and observation.
translation: 这些日记里既有自白，也有当下工作记录，还有见闻评论。

meaning: vi. 发抖， 颤抖；摇动， 晃动
example: The seismograph showed a sharp spike in response to the trembler.
translation: 地震仪显示,震动器的反应突然大增.

meaning: n. 居民， 住户
example: Cairo has only thirteen square centimetres of green space for each inhabitant.
translation: 开罗居民的人均绿地面积仅13平方厘米。

meaning: n. 碎片； 小部分， 一点儿；分数
example: If a stranger stops you, just wind the window down a fraction.
translation: 如果有陌生人拦你的车，把车窗摇下一点点就行。

meaning: adj. 象征性的; n. 表示， 象征； 标志， 记号；礼券， 代金券；信物； 纪念品；筹码
example: by the same token
translation: 同样地；出于同样原因

meaning: vi. 滤过， 渗透; n. 滤器； 滤纸； 滤嘴
example: Children should have glasses which filter out UV rays.
translation: 儿童应该戴上滤除紫外线的眼镜。

meaning: n. 宇宙飞船
example: manned spaceship
translation: 载人宇宙飞船

example: It hurt so badly he wished to cease to be.
translation: 他觉得疼痛难忍，恨不得死了算了。

meaning: n. 情绪； 情感
vt. 估价， 评价
example: We know some sex offenders dupe the psychologists who assess them.
translation: 我们知道有些性犯罪者会愚弄给他们做测评的心理学家。

meaning: n. 长袍， 上衣
example: He brought forth a small gold amulet from beneath his robe.
translation: 他从袍子下面拿出一个不大的金护身符。

meaning: n. 药方， 处方
example: The prescription Ackerman gave me isn't doing any good.
translation: 阿克曼给我开的药没有任何疗效。

meaning: n. 观众； 旁观者
example: spectator sport
translation: 吸引大量观众的体育运动

meaning: n. 行为， 举止；特性； 运转情况 A
example: Many parents find it hard to discourage bad behaviour.
translation: 很多父母觉得要孩子循规蹈矩是件很难的事情。

meaning: adj. 缺乏的， 不足的；稀少的， 罕见的
example: scarce resources
translation: 稀有资源

meaning: vi. 排队; n. 行列， 长队
example: queue up
translation: v. 排队等候

meaning: n. 争论， 辩论；论据， 论点
example: argument list
translation: 变元表

meaning: adj. 彻底的， 完全的; vt. 说， 发出
example: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
translation: 他说的每句话都会被仔细审查。

meaning: adj. 足够的， 充分的； 恰当的
example: adequate for
translation: 胜任……的；对……是足够的；适合……的

meaning: adj. 有希望的， 给以人希望的；抱有希望的； 充满希望的
example: They are hopeful of bringing the siege to a peaceful conclusion.
translation: 他们希望能和平结束这次围困。

meaning: n. 香肠， 腊肠
example: beef sausage
translation: 牛肉香肠

meaning: adj. 巨大的， 极大的
example: I found the scene in which Percy proposed to Olive tremendously poignant.
translation: 我觉得珀西向奥利芙求婚的一幕太让人心酸了。

meaning: v. 逐步增长或发展， 更紧张；逐步上升， 逐步加强， 扩大
example: Costs can escalate terrifyingly.
translation: 成本的上涨速度会很惊人。

meaning: v. 压缩， 凝结；精简， 压缩
example: We have learnt how to condense serious messages into short, self-contained sentences.
translation: 我们已经学会了如何把重要的信息压缩成简短独立的句子。

meaning: vt. 使转向， 使改道；转移， 转移…的注意力 <；使娱乐， 使消遣
example: The President needed to divert attention away from his own economic record.
translation: 总统需要将人们的视线从他以往在经济上的表现上转移开。

meaning: n. 卫生
example: Infection with head lice is no reflection on personal hygiene.
translation: 头上生虱子并不说明不讲个人卫生。

meaning: n. 正义； 公平；审判， 司法， 法律制裁
example: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

meaning: adj. 显眼的； 明显的
example: You may feel tearful in situations where you feel conspicuous.
translation: 觉得自己身处众目睽睽之下时，你可能会有想哭的感觉。

meaning: n. 标签， 货签; vt. 贴标签于
example: price tag
translation: 价格标签；标价

meaning: n. 韵文， 诗；诗节， 诗句
example: Page is well versed in many styles of jazz.
translation: 佩奇精通多种风格的爵士乐。

meaning: adj. 狂怒的； 狂暴的， 猛烈的
example: I am absolutely furious that he divorced me to marry her.
translation: 他为了娶她而和我离婚，我愤怒至极。

meaning: n. 肥大， 肥胖
example: The study also demonstrated a direct link between obesity and mortality.
translation: 该研究还表明了肥胖症和死亡率之间存在直接的联系。

meaning: vi. 晒黑; adj. 棕褐色的; n. 黝黑
example: Elephants were often to be found in swamp in eastern Kenya around the Tana River.
translation: 在肯尼亚东部的塔纳河一带经常发现陷入沼泽的大象。

meaning: n. 柏油， 焦油
example: Paul asked Tara out to dinner but she gave him the brush-off .
translation: 保罗邀请塔拉外出吃饭，但遭到拒绝。

meaning: adj. 个人的； 单独的； 独特的 <; n. 个人， 个体
example: Tourism is up, jobs are up, individual income is up.
translation: 旅游火了，工作机会多了，个人收入涨了。

meaning: n. 公文包， 公事包
example: I should not leave my briefcase and camera bag unguarded.
translation: 我不该把我的公文包和相机包留在那儿无人看管。

meaning: n. 暴风雪 A
example: If you design your kid's Halloween costume to fit over a snowsuit, you live in Ontario.
translation: 如果你给孩子设计的鬼节服装要适合穿在风雪衣外面, 那你是住在安大略省.

meaning: n. 税；负担; vt. 对…征税；使负重担； 使受压力
example: income tax
translation: 所得税

meaning: vt. 束缚， 限制；强迫， 强制
example: The police used horses to constrain the crowd from violence.
translation: 警察骑着马阻止那群人诉诸暴力.

meaning: n. 刺激； 激动， 兴奋
example: It had been a time of almost uncontrollable excitement.
translation: 那是一个几乎难以抑制亢奋的时期。

meaning: n. 蓝图； 方案
example: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
translation: 子女身上遗传了父母双方的基因型板。

meaning: adj. 暂时的， 临时的; n. 间歇； 过渡期间
example: She was sworn in as head of an interim government in March.
translation: 她3月份宣誓就任过渡政府首脑。

meaning: n. 证据； 证词；表明， 说明
example: Testiness crept into my voice.
translation: 我的话音渐渐带上了怒气.

meaning: vt. 实施， 执行 <；强制 <
example: Game wardens were appointed to enforce hunting laws in New Hampshire.
translation: 狩猎监督官被派到新罕布什尔州去执行狩猎法令。

meaning: vi. 闪耀; n. 光辉， 灿烂
example: Gary Glitter, 48, revealed the secret of his youthful looks.
translation: 48岁的加里·格利特透露了他青春永驻的秘密。

meaning: n. 离开， 起程
example: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
translation: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

meaning: adj. 易碎的， 易损的；脆弱的， 易受伤害的
example: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
translation: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

meaning: n. 映像， 倒影；反省， 沉思
example: The dark areas of the reflexion map aren't really black.
translation: 反射贴图的黑色部分其实并不全黑。

meaning: n. 出租汽车； 轻便马车；司机室， 驾驶室 A
example: The cab pulled up and the driver jumped out.
translation: 出租车减速停下，司机跳了出来。

meaning: n. 社会学
example: sociology of law
translation: 法律社会学

meaning: adj. 巨大的， 庞大的
example: The gigantic natural harbour of Poole is a haven for boats.
translation: 巨型天然港普尔港是船只的避风港。

meaning: vi. 逃走； 逃避；消失
example: A trickle of refugees began to flee the country.
translation: 难民开始三五成群地陆续逃离该国。

meaning: adj. 清楚的， 明显的；截然不同的
example: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
translation: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

meaning: n. 地质
example: We went on a geology field trip.
translation: 我们去进行地质野外考察。

meaning: n. 篱笆， 树篱； 障碍物; vt. 保护…以免； 预防
example: Hawker Siddeley tried to hedge its bets by diversifying into other fields.
translation: 霍克·西德利试图通过在其他领域进行多样化发展来规避风险。

meaning: v. 哭泣； 流泪; n. 悲叹， 哀悼， 为…伤心
example: weep for
translation: 为…而哭泣

meaning: v. 调音； 调频；调整； 调节; n. 调子， 曲调
example: out of tune
translation: 走调；不协调；（对某事）没有兴趣

meaning: vt. 举起， 升起， 吊起
example: Materials are elevated to the top floor by the new hoist.
translation: 材料由那台新起重机吊到楼顶.

meaning: adj. 知道的， 意识到的
example: He became more aware of the things that started that tension off.
translation: 他越来越清楚地认识到引起紧张局势的原因。

meaning: adj. 数字的， 用数字表示的
example: This consolidation meant having to reduce the numerical strength of the Army.
translation: 这次合并意味着不得不削减陆军的兵力。

meaning: n. 戏剧； 剧本；戏剧性事件或场面
example: "Kathleen" was, as its 1892 subtitle asserted, "An Irish Drama".
translation: 正如1892年剧本的副标题所强调的，《凯瑟琳》是一部“爱尔兰戏剧”。

meaning: n. 奖; vt. 授予， 奖给
example: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
translation: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

meaning: adj. 有条件被选中的， 有资格当选的； 合格的
example: Millions of householders are eligible to claim the new council tax benefit.
translation: 数百万房主都有资格申请新的市政税优惠。

meaning: n. 炉子， 火炉
example: gas stove
translation: n. 煤气炉

meaning: n. 警报；惊恐， 惊慌; vt. 使惊恐， 惊动， 惊吓 A；向…报警； 警告
example: Any escape, once it's detected, sets off the alarm.
translation: 一旦发现有泄漏，警报就会响起来。

meaning: n. 估计， 估量；评价
example: Self-appraisal is never easy.
translation: 进行自我评价向来很难。

meaning: v. 锄草; n. 杂草， 野草
example: weed control
translation: 除草；杂草防除；野草控制

meaning: n. 冰河， 冰川
example: The best bit was walking along the glacier.
translation: 最好的部分就是沿着冰川走。

meaning: n. 气球
example: They floated the trial balloon of actually cutting Social Security.
translation: 他们推出了真正削减社会保障的试行方案。

meaning: n. 方向， 方位， 定位；熟悉， 适应； 〈主美〉 情况介绍
example: They give their new employees a day or two of perfunctory orientation.
translation: 他们对新员工进行了一两天例行公事的培训。

meaning: n. 运动， 动；提议， 动议; vt. 向…示意 A
example: She made a fanning motion, pretending to cool herself off.
translation: 她做了个扇风的动作，假装想让自己凉快一点。

meaning: adj. 空闲的， 闲置的；无用的， 无效的；懒散的; vt. 浪费， 虚度
example: Brian kept up the idle chatter for another five minutes.
translation: 布赖恩又絮絮地唠叨了5分钟。

meaning: adj. 有限的， 被限制的
example: So far we have had ringing declarations, but only limited action.
translation: 目前，我们已经发表了一些有力的声明，但只采取了有限的行动。

meaning: n. 困境， 苦境
example: The country's economic plight is strangling its scientific institutions.
translation: 该国的经济困境阻碍了其科研机构的工作进展。

meaning: vi. 下雹; vt. 向…欢呼， 欢迎 A; n. 冰雹
example: The victim was hit by a hail of bullets.
translation: 受害者被一阵弹雨击中。

meaning: adj. 可怕的
example: "It sounds the most fearful hard work," Sybil said later.
translation: “这听起来是极为令人生畏的艰苦工作。”西比尔后来说。

meaning: n. 腔调； 口音 A；重音
example: There is often a strong accent on material success.
translation: 经常大力强调物质成就。

meaning: adj. 被动的， 消极的 <
example: Even passive acceptance of the regime was a kind of collaboration.
translation: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。

meaning: n. 卡车， 运货汽车
example: He looked straight ahead and overtook a lumbering lorry.
translation: 他眼睛直视前方，加速超过了前面一辆慢吞吞行进的大卡车。

meaning: n. 碎片； 小部分， 片断 <
example: This was only a fragment of a long conversation with John.
translation: 这仅仅是与约翰长谈的一个片断.

meaning: n. 运送者， 载体； 携带者
example: He had returned to England in an aircraft carrier no less.
translation: 他竟然坐航空母舰回的英格兰。

meaning: n. 回答， 回音；反应， 响应
example: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: n. 种类
example: The judges could not decide which category it belonged in.
translation: 评委们无法判定它属于哪一类。

meaning: adj. 竞争的， 对手的; n. 竞争者， 对手; vt. 竞争， 对抗
example: Leaders of some rival factions signed a peace agreement last week.
translation: 上周，一些敌对派系领导人签订了和平协议。

meaning: adv. 回原处; n. 背,后面; adj. 后面的; v. 后退
example: If you love life, life will love you back.
translation: 热爱生活，生活也会厚爱你。(Arthur Rubinstein)

meaning: adj. 重要的,意义重大的
example: She looked up at me significantly, raising an eyebrow.
translation: 她抬起头，眉毛扬起，意味深长地看着我。

meaning: n. 技能,技巧
example: Computers and electronics are growth industries and need skilled technicians.
translation: 计算机与电子行业属于蓬勃发展的产业，需要娴熟的技术人员。

meaning: adj. 公共的,公开的; n. 公众
example: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

meaning: v. 去,离开,进行
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 鱼; v. 钓鱼
example: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
translation: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

meaning: n. (一)套; v. 放置,设定
example: Old Tone Bao's daughter - in - law examined their fine seta of eggs.
translation: 四大娘看自家的五张“布子”.

meaning: adv. 一次,曾经; conj. 一旦…(就…)
example: It had once been the home of a wealthy nobleman.
translation: 这里曾是一个有钱贵族的宅邸。

meaning: n. 桌子,表格
example: They admired the tableau of the Nativity.
translation: 他们欣赏着耶稣降生的场景造型。

meaning: n&v. 要求,需要
example: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: n. 天,一昼夜,时期
example: On Sunday Cohen lay around the house all day.
translation: 科恩星期天一整天都在家无所事事。

meaning: n. 南部; adj. 南方的; adv. 在南方
example: south korea
translation: 南韩

meaning: adv. 几乎,差不多
example: The representatives almost came to blows at a meeting.
translation: 代表们在一次会议上差点动起手来。

meaning: adj. 当地的,局部的; n. 当地人
example: There has been a busy start to polling in today's local elections.
translation: 今天地方选举的投票一开始就人头攒动。

meaning: adj. 开的,开放的; v. 开
example: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

meaning: v. (掩)盖,包括,报道; n. 盖子,封面
example: Just play it safe, cover your ass, keep your head down.
translation: 要谨慎行事，保护好自己并保持低调。

meaning: n. 目的,意图
example: Most of them are destroyed because they've served their purpose.
translation: 它们中大多数在完成使命后被销毁。

meaning: v. 到达,伸出,达成; n. 范围
adj. 不同的,多样的,多方面的
example: He has been variously described as a hero, a genius and a bully.
translation: 他被描述为英雄、天才、恶霸，不一而足。

meaning: adj. 晚的,最近的; adv. 迟,晚
example: He defected from the party in the late 1970s.
translation: 他在20世纪70年代后期叛出了该党。

meaning: adv. 将来(或过去)某个时候; adj. 以前的
example: He told some lies and sometimes just embroidered the truth.
translation: 他说了些谎，有时只是对事实添油加醋了一番。

meaning: n. 功能,职务; v. 运行,起作用
example: His function is vital to the accomplishment of the agency's mission.
translation: 要完成该机构的使命，他的作用至关重要。

meaning: adj. 能够…的,得以…的
example: Chantal was lucky to be able to salvage her career.
translation: 尚塔尔能保住她的事业算是走了运。

meaning: v. 允许(…进入),同意给,承认
example: They will not allow your more way-out ideas to pass unchallenged.
translation: 他们不会放过你这些古怪的念头的。

meaning: n. 中部,中间; adj. 中部的,中间的
example: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday.
translation: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。

meaning: n. 家(乡)
example: It had once been the home of a wealthy nobleman.
translation: 这里曾是一个有钱贵族的宅邸。

meaning: adj. 欧洲的; n. 欧洲人
example: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: n. 原因v分析,推理
example: I really don't see any reason for changing it.
translation: 我真的不明白为什么要改变它。

meaning: n&v. 上升,升起

translation: 警方已公布持枪嫌犯的电子画像。

meaning: n. 东(方，部)a东方(部)的; adv. 向东方
example: Big credits were given to East Germany by successive West German governments.
translation: 历届西德政府给予东德大量的贷款。

meaning: n. 农业,农学
example: Kaspar had spoken know-ledgeably about the state of agriculture in Europe.
translation: 卡斯帕对欧洲农业状况发表了一番颇有见地的见解。

meaning: n. 微粒,极小量
example: A proton is an elementary particle of matter.
translation: 质子是物质的基本粒子。

meaning: n. 方面,外观
example: Antonio has a contagious enthusiasm for the beautiful aspect of food.
translation: 安东尼奥对食品赏心悦目这一方面的热情非常有感染性。

meaning: adj. 工业的,产业的
example: The seven major industrial countries will have their yearly meeting in London.
translation: 7个主要工业国家将在伦敦举行一年一度的会议。

meaning: n. 田地,领域
example: He was the fastest thing I ever saw on a baseball field.
translation: 他是我在棒球场上见过的跑得最快的家伙。

meaning: n. 试验; v. 尝试,做实验
example: He is always eager for new experiences and ever-willing to experiment.
translation: 他总是渴望拥有新的经历，而且永远愿意尝试。

meaning: pron. 它自己
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: v. 叙述,使有联系,有关联
example: Other recommendations relate to the details of how such data is stored.
translation: 其他建议涉及此类信息储存方面的一些细节。

meaning: adv. 还,已经; conj. 然而
example: and yet
translation: 可是，然而

meaning: n. 仪器,工具
example: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
translation: 一种叫做套管针的工具在腹壁上刺了一个孔。

meaning: n. 速度; v. 加速,急行
example: high speed
translation: 高速全速

meaning: n. 一千(个),许许多多,成千上万
example: A small investment brings a ten thousandfold profit.
translation: 一本万利。

meaning: v. 印刷,冲洗(照片)
example: Many of their books have been in print for nearly 40 years.
translation: 他们的很多书都印行将近40年了。

meaning: adv. 因此,所以
example: The committee will examine the agreement and any problems arising therefrom.
translation: 委员会将审查这项协议和由此引起的问题。

meaning: n. 传统,惯例
example: cultural tradition
translation: 文化传统

meaning: n. 货物,商品
example: Purchase tax was not payable on goods for export.
translation: 出口商品不需要交购买税。

meaning: v. 代表,表现,描绘
example: The two politicians represent opposite poles of the political spectrum.
translation: 这两位从政者代表了政界的两个极端。

meaning: n. 冰山,冷若冰霜的人
example: The above complaints are, I suspect, just the tip of the iceberg.
translation: 我想，以上的抱怨只是冰山一角。

meaning: pron. 我们的
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: n. 男人,人(类)
example: She ran away with a man called McTavish last year.
translation: 去年，她和一个叫麦克塔维什的男人私奔了。

meaning: v. 储存,贮藏; n. 商店
example: Gangs rioted last night, breaking storefront windows and hurling rocks and bottles.
translation: 几个帮派昨晚聚众闹事，他们打碎商店临街的玻璃窗，并投掷石块和瓶子。

meaning: v. 依靠,取决于
example: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think.--Dale Carnegie
translation: 请记住，幸福不在于你是谁或者你拥有什么，而仅仅取决于你的心态！

meaning: a&ad. 重的,大量的
example: I don't want any more of that heavy stuff.
translation: 我再也不想碰那种麻烦事了。

meaning: adj. 普遍的,概括的
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: n. 故事,小说
example: love story
translation: n. 爱情故事，恋爱小说

meaning: n. 工艺,技术
example: science and technology
translation: 科学与技术

meaning: n. 雨; v. 下雨
example: The recent rain had churned up the waterfall into a muddy whirlpool.
translation: 最近的一场雨把瀑布搅成了泥水漩涡。

meaning: v&n. 对比,对照
example: The boy's room is a complete contrast to the guest room.
translation: 这个男孩的房间和客房截然不同。

meaning: n. 掠夺者,食肉动物
example: the relationship between predator and prey
translation: 捕食性动物与猎物之间的关系

meaning: prep. 反对,逆,防御
example: He spent 25 years campaigning against racist and unjust immigration laws.
translation: 他用了25年的时间与带有种族歧视色彩和没有公正可言的移民法作斗争。

meaning: v. 活着,幸存
example: Rafferty was the sole survivor from the successful Ireland team of 1988.
translation: 拉弗蒂是1988年红极一时的爱尔兰队硕果仅存的球员。

meaning: adj. 生物(学)的
example: The living organisms somehow concentrated the minerals by biological processes.
translation: 生命体通过某种生物过程聚集矿物质。

meaning: n. 自然(界),本性
example: The nature of the polymer is currently a trade secret.
translation: 这一聚合物的性质目前是个商业机密。

meaning: n. 措辞,表达
example: gene expression
translation: [化]基因表达；基因表现

meaning: adj. 太阳(能)的
example: solar energy
translation: 太阳能

meaning: n. 教师
example: english teacher
translation: 英语教师

meaning: adv. 掉(下),离开,停止
example: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
translation: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

meaning: n. 城市,城镇
example: in town
translation: 在城里；在镇上

meaning: n. 建筑,建筑学
example: The economic gloom of the early 1980s was relieved by fanciful architecture.
translation: 20世纪80年代初期的经济萧条气氛因各种奇异古怪建筑的出现而有所缓解。

meaning: v. 训练,培训
example: All class specific spell books that previously dropped in dungeons are now trainable at level 60.
translation: 所有以前副本掉落的技能书现在在60级时即可学习到.

meaning: v. 捐助,贡献
example: Heat, cold, tactile and other sensations contribute to flavour.
translation: 热、冷、触觉和其他感觉构成了食物风味的一部分。

meaning: ad&a. 最小的,最少的
example: Try to eat at least four slices of bread a day.
translation: 每天尽量至少吃4片面包。

meaning: v. 通过,经过
example: They will not allow your more way-out ideas to pass unchallenged.
translation: 他们不会放过你这些古怪的念头的。

meaning: adv. 总是,一直,始终,
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 正常的,正规的
example: Life has not yet returned to normal but we are getting there.
translation: 生活还没有恢复正常，不过就快了。

meaning: n. 矿物,矿石
example: The mineral is weakly magnetic.
translation: 这种矿物带有轻微的磁性。

meaning: adv. 主要地,起初地
example: Investment remains tiny primarily because of the exorbitant cost of land.
translation: 投资仍然微乎其微，主要原因在于土地成本过高。

meaning: n. 知识,学问
example: Father had no more than a superficial knowledge of music.
translation: 父亲对音乐只懂一点皮毛。

meaning: v. 询问,请求,邀请
example: That was Nicholas's cue to ask for another chocolate chip cookie.
translation: 那表示尼古拉斯还想要一块巧克力曲奇。

meaning: v. 注意到,观察,监视
example: The Royal Greenwich Observatory was founded to observe and catalogue the stars.
translation: 当初创立皇家格林尼治天文台就是为了观察星体并对其进行编目。

meaning: adj. 简单的,朴素的
example: The LORD protects the simplehearted; when I was in great need, he saved me.
translation: 耶和华保护愚人.落到卑微的地步 、 救了我.

meaning: adj. 慢的; v. 放慢,减速
example: There has been a sharp slowdown in economic growth.
translation: 经济增长的速度明显放慢。

meaning: n. 运河,沟渠
example: The rough rock walls were like the sides of a deep canal.
translation: 凸凹不平的石墙就像一条很深的运河的河岸。

meaning: n. 工艺,手艺
example: The engine of one landing craft was still running.
translation: 一艘登陆艇的发动机还在运转。

meaning: n. 名字; v. 命名
example: She has had many credits and name-checks in American Vogue.
translation: 美国版《时尚》多次对她进行赞扬或是提到她的名字。

meaning: v. 反映,反射
example: Does such an attitudinal change reflect real experiences in daily life?
translation: 人生观的这种转变是否反映了日常生活中的真实遭遇？

meaning: n. 加,增加,附加物
example: In addition to my weekly wage, I got a lot of tips.
translation: 除了每周的薪水外，我还能得到不少小费。

meaning: v. 说服,争论,辩论
example: Few would argue that this team has experience and proven ability.
translation: 这个队伍的丰富经验和表现出来的实力是众所公认的。

meaning: v. 画,拖,移动
example: He was waving his arms to draw their attention.
translation: 他正挥手以引起他们的注意。

meaning: n. 戏院,剧场
example: movie theater
translation: n. 电影院

meaning: prep. 在…上方,多(大,高)于; adv. 在上面
example: That big high-rise above us is where Brian lives.
translation: 我们上面的那座摩天大楼就是布赖恩住的地方。

meaning: adv. 特别,尤其
example: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
translation: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

meaning: adj. 中心的,主要的,重要的
example: The central heating's been turned off. I've turned it on again.
translation: 中央供暖系统已经关上。我又将它打开了。

meaning: v. 申请,应用
example: Investors can apply for a package of shares at a set price.
translation: 投资者可以申购固定价格的股票组合。

meaning: adv. 快速地
example: He skimmed the pages quickly, then read them again more carefully.
translation: 他先快速地浏览页面，然后再细细阅读。

meaning: adj. 每个,一切的,每隔
example: Someone comes in every day to check all is in order.
translation: 每天都有人来检查是否一切都井然有序。

meaning: adj. 成功的,圆满的
example: Her kidnapper successfully extorted a £75,000 ransom for her release.
translation: 绑匪成功地勒索了7.5万英镑才将她释放。

meaning: adj. 频繁的,经常的
example: Bordeaux is on the main Paris-Madrid line so there are frequent trains.
translation: 波尔多位于巴黎到马德里的铁路主干线上，来往列车频繁。

meaning: v. 包围,环绕
example: Eventually, the water will permeate through the surrounding concrete.
translation: 最终，水会渗透进周围的混凝土中。

meaning: n&v. 练习
example: His hands were rough and calloused, from years of karate practice.
translation: 由于多年练习空手道，他的双手粗糙不平，布满老茧。

meaning: v. 介绍,引进
example: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
translation: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

meaning: adj. 侵略的,进攻性的
example: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive.
translation: 他是一位锐意进取、竞争意识很强的主管，颇受尊敬。

meaning: v. 行动,表演; n. 行为
example: He wants to act in concert with other nations.
translation: 他想和其他国家采取一致行动。

meaning: n. 加拿大
example: Until 1987, Canada's industry had been the star performer.
translation: 直到1987年，加拿大的工业一直成就斐然。

meaning: adj. 极度的,极端的; n. 极端,过分
example: The extreme right reared its ugly head in the 1980s.
translation: 极右势力在20世纪80年代有所抬头。

meaning: n&vt. 试验,测试
adj. 冰川(期)的,非常冷的
example: The Duchess's glare was glacial.
translation: 公爵夫人冷漠地看着。

meaning: v. 感觉,意识到
example: She probably sensed that I wasn'ttelling her the whole story.
translation: 她可能意识到了我并没有对她全盘托出。

meaning: v. 吃
example: It makes sense to eat a reasonably balanced diet when slimming.
translation: 在减肥过程中保持饮食的营养相对均衡是明智的。

meaning: adj. 单一的,单个的,独身的
example: Singlechip are necessary for the development of basic skills.
translation: 是开发单片机必备的基本技巧.

meaning: n. 质量,品质,性质
example: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

meaning: v. 讲授,教授
example: teach oneself
translation: 自学

meaning: n. 大陆,洲
example: Its shops are among the most stylish on the Continent.
translation: 其店铺跻身欧陆最时尚的店铺之列。

meaning: n. 循环,周期; v. 骑自行(摩托)车,循环
example: Eddie parked his cycle against a lamp post and padlocked it.
translation: 埃迪把他的自行车靠在路灯柱上，用挂锁锁好。

meaning: adj. 以前的,先于,在之前
example: Douglas was a 29-year-old journeyman fighter, erratic in his previous fights.
translation: 道格拉斯29岁，是个技术不错的拳击手，在以前的比赛中发挥不太稳定。

meaning: adj. 北方的,北部的
example: The film takes no position on the politics of Northern Ireland.
translation: 这部电影未在北爱尔兰政治问题上选择站边。

meaning: v. 分开,隔开
example: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
translation: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

meaning: n. 价格,成本; v. 花费,使付出
example: Companies are moving jobs to towns with a lower cost of living.
translation: 各公司正在把工作岗位转移至生活费用较低的城镇。

meaning: n. 优势,有利条件; v. 有利于
example: I want to take advantage of your lifetime of scholarship.
translation: 我希望能够用到您一生的学识。

meaning: n. 运输(工具、系统)
example: transportation system
translation: 运输系统；交通物流系统

meaning: n. 发现,发现物
example: The discovery is being hailed as The Holy Grail of astronomy.
translation: 这一发现圆了天文学界的一个梦想。

meaning: n. 小河,溪流; v. 涌流(出)
example: main stream
translation: 干流；主干流

meaning: v. 获得,得到
example: Only with mass direct action will we obtain such change.
translation: 只有采取大规模直接行动，我们才会取得这样的改变。

meaning: v. 认出,确认,意识到
n. 父母亲
example: Many children are now born into or raised in one-parent families.
translation: 现在很多孩子在单亲家庭中出生或成长。

meaning: n. 假设
example: The results confirmed his hypothesis on the use of modal verbs.
translation: 结果证实了他的关于情态动词用法的假设.

meaning: n. 英格兰
example: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
translation: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

meaning: adj. 农村的
example: The lure of rural life is proving as strong as ever.
translation: 事实证明，乡村生活的魅力丝毫未减。

meaning: v. 有关于,使担心,
example: Issues such as these were not really his concern.
translation: 他其实并不关心诸如此类的问题。

meaning: v. 获得,得到
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 物质,实质,主旨
example: The cold has made already substandard living conditions even worse.
translation: 寒冷使得已经较差的生活环境变得更糟糕。

meaning: adj. 原始的,最初的
example: The new town would have been unrecognisable to the original inhabitants.
translation: 原来的居民可能会认不出这个崭新的城镇了。

meaning: adv. 容易地
example: Stan Dean, easily identifiable by his oddly-shaped hat, sat in a doorway.
translation: 斯坦·迪安坐在门口，他那顶奇形怪状的帽子一下子就让人认出他来。

meaning: n. [常pl]通道,渠道
example: The series goes out at 10.30pm, Fridays, on Channel 4.
translation: 这部连续剧每周五晚上10点30分在第4频道播出。

meaning: v. 属于
example: I'm so glad to see you back where you belong.
translation: 我真高兴看到你又回到了属于你自己的天地。

meaning: n. 建造,结构
example: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: n&v. 游泳
example: in the swim
translation: 合时髦；合潮流；熟悉内情；积极参加活动

meaning: adj. 南的,南方的
example: Bob Wilson is a Southerner, from Texas.
translation: 鲍勃·威尔逊是南方人，来自得克萨斯州。

meaning: prep. 相当于…价值的,值得…的; n. 价值
example: Mr. Buck is a good and worthful man.
translation: 巴克先生是个善良可敬的人.

meaning: v. 跑,运转,经营
example: The ballot was re-run on Mr Todd's insistence after accusations of malpractice.
translation: 因被控舞弊，在托德先生的坚持下重新进行了投票。

meaning: v. 暗示, 意味
example: Cheerfulness doesn't always imply happiness.
translation: 快活并不总是意味着幸福.

meaning: adj. 基本的,基础的
example: basic principle
translation: 基本原理

meaning: adj. 内在的,国内的
example: It took internal whistle-blowing and investigative journalism to uncover the rot.
translation: 是内部检举和调查性报道揭露了这一腐败事实。

meaning: n. 水晶
example: If you're a Billy Crystal fan, you'lllove this movie.
translation: 如果你是比利·克里斯托的影迷，你会喜爱这部影片。

meaning: n. 解释,说明
example: Their water was turned off weeks ago without explanation.
translation: 他们的水在几周以前就毫无理由地被切断了。

meaning: v. 演变,进化,发展
example: We can evolve the truth from a mass of confused evidence.
translation: 我们可以从庞杂的证据中推断事实真相.

meaning: n. 百,[pl]数以百计
example: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
translation: 3亿美元远远不够。

meaning: v. 开始,出发
example: The United States is certain to reject the proposal as a non-starter.
translation: 美国肯定会以无成功希望为由拒绝这项提案。

meaning: v. 请求,乞求
example: We beg the Government on bended knees not to cut this budget.
translation: 我们恳求政府不要削减这项预算。

meaning: adj. 快的,迅速的
example: The company made a rapid-fire series of settlements with 25 States.
translation: 公司同25个州进行了一连串迅速的结算。

meaning: n. 量,数量
example: quantity of
translation: 数量；流量

meaning: v. 说明,阐明
example: He quoted some old Chinese sayings to illustrate his points.
translation: 他援用了一些中国话来解释他的论点.

meaning: v. 定位,把…设置在
example: Try to locate exactly where the smells are entering the room.
translation: 找找看气味具体是从什么地方散入房间的。

meaning: v. 移开,去除
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: prep. 穿过,在对面
example: They stumble across a ghost town inhabited by a rascally gold prospector.
translation: 他们偶然来到一个居住着一位狡诈的淘金者的废墟之城。

meaning: pron. 谁的,那(些)人的
adj. 典型的,有代表性的
example: The models and parameters possess typicality . The methods are reasonable and efficient.
translation: 模型和参数具有典型性, 研究方法合理、有效.

meaning: n. 事情,情况; v. 要紧
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 资源
example: A country's principal resource is its brainpower.
translation: 一个国家的首要资源是其人才资源。

meaning: adj. 东方的,东部的
example: Physical and ideological barriers had come down in Eastern Europe.
translation: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

meaning: n&a. 一半,半个的

example: I felt so self-conscious under Luke's mother's intense gaze.
translation: 在卢克母亲审视的目光下，我感到极不自在。

meaning: v. 支配,占优势

meaning: adj. 野生的; n. 荒野

translation: 模式可以包含常规字符和通配符.

meaning: n. 吨,大量

translation: 他说话几乎没有声调变化。

meaning: n. 船; v. 航运,载运

translation: 在麦克法茨一家和海外传教士戴维森一家之间, 产生了一种同舟共济的情谊.

meaning: n. 意义,重要性

meaning: n. 墨西哥(拉丁美洲国家)

meaning: adj. 平常的,普通的
example: It was just an ordinary voice, but he sang in tune.
translation: 他声音很一般，但唱得都在调子上。

meaning: n. 事例,情形
example: He actually became convinced that the nurses had an unanswerable case.
translation: 他实际上已经相信了护士们的情况确实如此。

meaning: v. 组成,写作
example: They must each compose a poem in strict alliterative metre.
translation: 他们必须每人作一首严格押头韵的诗。

meaning: n. 罗马
example: He had been sent to Rome by his employer.
translation: 他已被老板派往罗马。

meaning: n. 通行证,执照; v. 许可,允许
example: He can let the court's decision stand and permit the execution.
translation: 他有权维持法庭判决，批准死刑生效。

meaning: adj. 有能力的,能干的

translation: 我觉得我能准确预料此事的政治后果。

meaning: adv. 充分地,完全地
example: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
translation: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

meaning: adj. 事实的,实际的

meaning: adj. 很少的,微小的

translation: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

meaning: n. 口,嘴
example: A thorough brushing helps to freshen up your mouth.
translation: 彻底刷牙有助于口气清新。

meaning: n. 连接,关系
example: 13 men have been questioned in connection with the murder.
translation: 有13名男子因谋杀案受到盘问。

meaning: n. 费城(美国宾西法尼亚州东南部港市)
example: Bank is a 38-year-old singleton who grew up in Philadelphia.
translation: 班克是一名38岁的单身汉，在费城长大。

meaning: n. 力,力量
example: His visit is intended to strengthen ties between the two countries.
translation: 他此次访问旨在增进两国间的关系。

meaning: adj. 专业的,职业的
example: He seemed fond of her in a strictly professional way.
translation: 他似乎只是出于职业缘故而喜欢她。

meaning: adv. 事实上,实质上
n. 通常所吃的食物,会议
example: It makes sense to eat a reasonably balanced diet when slimming.
translation: 在减肥过程中保持饮食的营养相对均衡是明智的。

meaning: n. 现象
example: This phenomenon is not as outrageous as it seems.
translation: 这种现象并不像它看上去那样骇人。

meaning: adj. 永久的,持久的

translation: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

meaning: n. 圆柱,专栏
example: She also writes a regular column for the Times Educational Supplement.
translation: 她也定期为《泰晤士报高等教育增刊》写专栏文章。

meaning: n. 使热的人,温热装置
example: We're having warmish days and coolish nights.
translation: 白天暖洋洋的,夜间凉爽爽的.

meaning: n&v. 休息

translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

meaning: n. 腿; v. 走,跑
example: He had to have one leg amputated above the knee.
translation: 他的一条腿不得不从膝部以上截断。

meaning: n. 接触,联系
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: adj. 旧石器时代的
example: They are all our Chinese ancestors dwelling in the Paleolithic age.
translation: 他们都是中华民族旧石器时代的祖先.

meaning: v. 听到,听说
example: "I'm afraid he's ill." — "I'm sorry to hear that."
translation: “恐怕他生病了。”——“真是遗憾。”

meaning: n. 乌鸦; v. 啼叫
example: She gave a little crow of triumph.
translation: 她轻轻地发出了胜利的欢呼声。

meaning: v. 花费,度过
example: Spendable earnings accrue on the gift annually.
translation: 这个捐献每年生可使用的利息所得.

meaning: v. 回答,响应,作出反应
example: Some cases of arthritis respond to a gluten-free diet.
translation: 无麸质饮食对一些关节炎患者有疗效。

example: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
translation: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

meaning: n. 华盛顿
example: george washington
translation: 乔治·华盛顿（美国第一位总统）

meaning: n. 机械,机器
example: On the customs declaration, the sender labeled the freight as agricultural machinery.
translation: 在报关单上，寄货人将货物列为农用机械。

meaning: n. 个体,(计量)单位
example: Russia demanded that Unita send a delegation to the peace talks.
translation: 俄罗斯要求安盟派代表团参加和谈。

meaning: n. 改进,进步
example: CBS's ratings again showed huge improvement over the previous year.
translation: 与前一年相比，哥伦比亚广播公司的收视率再次大幅提高。

meaning: n. 交易; v. 处理,分配
n. 混合物
example: Police fired on them as they fled into the embassy compound.
translation: 当他们逃进使馆大院时，警察向他们开了枪。

meaning: n. 恐怖,害怕; v. 害怕,畏惧
example: His mind was a haze of fear and confusion.
translation: 由于害怕和困惑，他当时处于一种混沌状态。

meaning: n. 羽毛,轻的东西
example: The feather must be removed with a straight, firm pull.
translation: 拔羽毛必须干净利落。

meaning: v. 专攻
example: I'm specializing in differential and integral calculus.
translation: 我正专攻微分学和积分学.

meaning: n. 床,基础; v. 安置
example: Her bed was crisply made, her clothes put away.
translation: 她的床收拾得很整洁，衣服也收起来了。

meaning: adj. 最初的,初始的
example: They learnt a lot from the initial market testing exercise.
translation: 他们从最初的市场测试中了解了许多信息。

meaning: n. 英寸
example: We are prepared to fight for every inch of territory.
translation: 我们时刻准备着为每一寸领土而战。

meaning: v. (使)蒸发,消失
example: Blasting cold air over it makes the water evaporate.
translation: 向它喷射冷空气可以使水蒸发。

meaning: adj. 电的
example: All Dreamland's electric blankets are guaranteed for three years.
translation: 所有的梦乡牌电热毯质保3年。

meaning: n. 核子
example: The repulsive force within the nucleus is enormous.
translation: 核子内部的斥力是巨大的。

meaning: n. 生态学者
example: Saturation of a biotope is of special interest to the ecologist.
translation: 生境小区的饱和对生态学家是特别有意义的.

meaning: n&v. 运动,练习
example: His exercise books were full of well deserved red ticks.
translation: 他的练习本上尽是些红钩钩，都是他应得的。

meaning: prep. 尽管,不论
example: despite of
translation: 不管；不顾

meaning: n. 印度(人)
example: Sri Lankans share a common ancestry with their Indian brethren.
translation: 斯里兰卡人和他们的印度兄弟有共同的祖先。

meaning: n. 中立派,无党派者
example: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
translation: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

meaning: n. 邻居,邻国
example: And he said unto him, "Who is my neighbor?"
translation: 他于是对他说道：“谁是我邻居？”

meaning: v. 迁移,转移
example: People migrate to cities like Jakarta in search of work.
translation: 人们为找工作而迁移到雅加达这类城市里。

meaning: n. 贡献
example: His contribution is immeasurable.
translation: 他居功至伟。

meaning: v. 分,划分
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: v. 捕食,掠夺
example: The spider must wait for prey to be ensnared on its web.
translation: 蜘蛛必须等待猎物被它的蛛网困住。

meaning: v. 期待,预期
example: Don't expect me to come and visit you there.
translation: 别指望我会去那儿看你。

meaning: n. 创造物
example: Alaskan Eskimos believe that every living creature possesses a spirit.
translation: 阿拉斯加的爱斯基摩人认为每一个活着的生物都有灵魂。

meaning: n&a. 十亿(的)
example: Exports in June rose 1.5% to a record $30.91 billion.
translation: 6月份的出口额上升了1.5%，创下309.1亿美元的历史最高纪录。

meaning: v. 死亡
example: He won his first Derby on the aptly named "Never Say Die".
translation: 他驾驭着这匹名副其实的“永不言败”夺得了他的第一个德比马赛冠军。

meaning: n. 改革,创新
example: The vegetarian burger was an innovation which was rapidly exported to Britain.
translation: 素食汉堡是一种迅速传到了英国的新开发食品。

meaning: n. 沮丧,消沉
example: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.
translation: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。

meaning: n. 边(缘); v. 侧着移动,徐徐移动
example: McGregor's effort was enough to edge Johnson out of the top spot.
translation: 麦格雷戈奋力一搏，成功地将约翰逊从第一的位置上挤了下来。

meaning: adv. 曾经,永远
example: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
translation: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

meaning: n. 工作,职业

translation: 他是由海军上将精心挑选出来担任这项工作的。

meaning: n. 保护
example: For added protection choose a lipstick with a sun screen.
translation: 选择防晒护唇膏来增强保护。

meaning: n. 树带界线
example: We specialize in metal connecting piece and dental plate for timberwork.
translation: 专业加工木结构产品的金属连接件,齿板.

meaning: v. 获得,学到
example: Perhaps we did acquire a somewhat fuddy-duddy image in the later years.
translation: 可能在后来的几年里我们真的让人感到有些古板。

meaning: n. 协会,联合,结交

translation: 会员的支持对于我们协会来说非常重要。

meaning: adj. 丰富的,充裕的
example: Birds are abundant in the tall vegetation.
translation: 高大的植被中有着大量的鸟类。

meaning: n. 尊敬; v. 看待,当作
example: with regard to
translation: adv. 关于；至于

meaning: pron. 没有什么; n. 没有; adv. 毫不
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: v. 生产,获利,屈服
example: high yield
translation: 高产；高收益

meaning: n. 适应, 改编, 改写本
example: social adaptation
translation: 社会适应，适应能力

meaning: v&n. 攻击,进攻
example: Bob died of a heart attack, brought on by his lifestyle.
translation: 鲍勃死于由他的生活方式引起的心脏病突发。

meaning: n. 同时代的人; adj. 当代的
adj. 富有的
example: It can be extremely difficult to wean children off junk food.
translation: 让儿童改掉吃零食的习惯有时十分困难.

meaning: v. 建造,构造,创立
example: Any attempt to construct an ideal society is foredoomed to failure.
translation: 任何构建理想社会的努力都注定要失败。

meaning: v. 采用,收养

translation: 英国可以自由制定政策以振兴经济。

meaning: n. 石油
example: Petroleum engineers plan and manage the extraction of oil.
translation: 石油工程师规划并管理石油的提炼。

meaning: n. 夏季
example: He walked towards the summerhouse, at first furtively, then with more confidence.
translation: 他朝凉亭走去，开始还偷偷摸摸地，后来就壮大了胆子。

meaning: n. 竞争,竞赛
example: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

translation: 驾船和开车不是一回事。

meaning: v. 示范,证明,论证
example: The best and the brightest pupils competed to demonstrate their intellectual prowess.
translation: 最出色、最聪明的学生们竞相展示他们的才智。

meaning: n. 裂缝,噼啪声; v. (使)破裂

translation: 她镇定而且坚强，绝不会垮掉。

translation: 卡夫威胁要解散议会并举行选举。

meaning: n. 潮湿,湿气

translation: 在粗糙不平的水泥窗台上有一条细细的发光水印。

meaning: n. 水蒸气
example: water vapor
translation: 水汽；水蒸气

meaning: n. 装备,设备
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: v. 恐吓,威胁
example: He has accused her of threatening to gouge his eyes out.
translation: 他指控她曾威胁要挖出他的眼睛。

meaning: n. 连续,继承
example: The successional law and mechanism of aerial seeding community were studied.
translation: 本文主要探讨了飞播后植被的演替规律和演替机制.

meaning: adj. 年度的
n. 牛,家养牲畜
example: The old stone cattle trough still sits by the main entrance.
translation: 陈旧的石制牛食槽仍然放在大门口。

meaning: num. 六,六个
example: six months
translation: 六个月；半年

meaning: adj. 地下的,地面下的
example: underground water
translation: 地下水；潜水

meaning: n. 彗星
example: They observed the comet for 70 days before it faded from sight.
translation: 他们观察了这颗彗星70天，直至其慢慢从视线中消失。

meaning: n. 创造,创作物

meaning: v. 感觉,触摸; v. 有知觉

translation: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

meaning: n. 爵士乐
example: Page is well versed in many styles of jazz.
translation: 佩奇精通多种风格的爵士乐。

meaning: n. 玛雅人,玛雅语
example: The doctor is bewitched by Maya's beauty.
translation: 医生被马娅的美貌深深吸引。

example: You have to take capital appreciation of the property into account.
translation: 你必须将该处房产的资本增值考虑在内。

meaning: adj. 贫穷的,可怜的
example: Conditions for the poor in Los Angeles have not improved.
translation: 洛杉矶穷人的境况仍未得到改善。

meaning: v. 描述,描写
example: The media depict him as a left-wing bogeyman.
translation: 媒体把他描述成一个左翼大反派。

meaning: adj. 优先的,在前的
example: Prior to his Japan trip, he went to New York.
translation: 在去日本之前，他去了纽约。

meaning: n. 幻想
example: The film starts off realistically and then develops into a ridiculous fantasy.
translation: 电影以写实开头，然后却发展成为荒诞的幻想。

meaning: adj. 生态学的
example: Global ecological efforts can easily be at odds with local ecologies.
translation: 全球性生态保护工作很可能会和地方生态系统存在矛盾。

meaning: n. 橡树果,橡子
example: The oak is implicit in the acorn.
translation: 橡树孕育于橡子之中.

meaning: v. 雇用
example: The organisers have to employ performers to pull a crowd.
translation: 组织者不得不雇些演员来聚拢人气。

meaning: a&ad. 公平的
example: I have a fair idea of how difficult things can be.
translation: 我大致了解情况会有多困难。

meaning: n. 移民,侨民
example: In recent months many conservative politicians have jumped on the anti-immigrant bandwagon.
translation: 最近几个月，很多保守政客都搭上了“反移民”这班车。

meaning: n. 泵,抽水机
example: They find it difficult to pump themselves up for the games.
translation: 他们感到要为自己加油打气，自信满满地去打比赛并不容易。

meaning: adj. 新鲜的,无经验的
example: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.
translation: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很重要，麦麸也是。

meaning: n. 工业化,产业化
example: Industrialization inevitably led to the expansion of the urban working class.
translation: 工业化不可避免地导致了城市工人阶级人数的增多.

meaning: adj. 适当的,相配的
example: There are problems in recruiting suitably qualified scientific officers for NHS laboratories.
translation: 很难为国民医疗保健系统的实验室招募到资历合适的高级科研人员。

meaning: v. 培养,耕作
example: Estonia has done much to cultivate the friendship of western European countries.
translation: 爱沙尼亚努力发展与西欧国家的友谊。

meaning: v. 扎,捆绑

translation: 他拿出一个系着细绳的小袋子。

meaning: v. 获取,得自,起源
example: Most patients derive enjoyment from leafing through old picture albums.
translation: 大多数病人都很喜欢翻看旧相册。

meaning: v. 保持,保留
example: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
translation: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

meaning: n. 机会
example: They had met by chance at university and finished up getting married.
translation: 他们在大学偶遇，最后结了婚。

meaning: adj. 公民的,文明的
example: The strike has taken on overtones of a civil rights campaign.
translation: 罢工带上了民权运动的意味。

meaning: adj. 史前的
example: The display of prehistoric monsters is comically naive.
translation: 史前怪物的展览幼稚可笑。

meaning: n&v. 展览,陈列,展示
example: Two cats or more in one house will also exhibit territorial behaviour.
translation: 一家若有两只或更多的猫，也会表现出争夺地盘的行为。

meaning: adj. 众多的,许多的

translation: 医生们列举了大量病人被逐出医院的实例。

meaning: n. 猎人

translation: 亨特先生及他率领的管理小组加入了州长们的队伍。

meaning: n. 佛罗里达(美国州名)
example: All the nice areas in Florida are becoming more and more urbanized.
translation: 佛罗里达所有的那些好去处都在变得越来越都市化。

meaning: n. 规则,条例; v. 支配,统治
example: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
translation: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

meaning: n. 比赛
example: Game wardens were appointed to enforce hunting laws in New Hampshire.
translation: 狩猎监督官被派到新罕布什尔州去执行狩猎法令。

meaning: n. [矿]黑曜石
example: Sepulchrals are sacred undead and wield magical obsidian glaives.
translation: 丧葬者是神圣的亡灵生物,挥舞带有魔力的黑耀石砍刀.

meaning: adj. 迁移的,流浪的

translation: 这架单翼飞机在他的摆弄下时速达到了每小时330英里，他感到很高兴。

meaning: n. 烟道, 暖气管
example: The fire won't burn because the flue is blocked up.
translation: 因烟道堵塞火烧不起来.

meaning: n. 枢轴; v. 在枢轴上转动

translation: 西非是可可豆贸易的中心。

meaning: n. 协调
example: Interior decoration by careful coordination seems to have had its day.
translation: 精心搭配的室内装饰似乎已不再受欢迎了。

meaning: v.  取消， 废除； 删去， 删除； 抵消
example: He wonders if the different influences might not cancel each other out.
translation: 他在想，各种影响能不能相互抵消。

meaning: v.  向后倚靠， 斜倚

translation: Recline&Sprawl是伦敦一家店名有趣的家具店。

meaning: v.  准备， 预备

translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

translation: 贝内特发起了一场捍卫“道德价值”、反对腐朽堕落的“自由相对论”的战争。

meaning: vt.  取代， 代替
example: Although it's not strenuous exercise, you feel toned-up, supple and relaxed.
translation: 虽然这不是剧烈运动，但会让人感到强健、柔韧与放松。

meaning: n.  外科医师

meaning: adj.  突然的， 意外的； 唐突的， 鲁莽的

meaning: vt.  使泄气， 使灰心； 阻止， 劝阻

meaning: v.  事先影响某人； 易受感染

translation: 他们千方百计雇用那些性格上天生适合服务顾客的人。

meaning: adj.  自发的， 自然产生的； 自然的， 无雕饰的

translation: 女性的乳房通常在产后会自然泌乳。

meaning: n.  对流； 传送

translation: 这些火焰造成了对流漏斗，把许多微粒抛向上层大气。

meaning: vt. 使失事；破坏; n.  沉船； 失事

translation: 马克被人从他着火的汽车残骸中拉了出来。

meaning: adj.  闪光的; n. 瞬间，一眨眼

translation: 5家波兰银行将和5家西欧银行结为姐妹银行。

meaning: adj.  忧郁的， 令人沮丧的； 昏暗的， 阴暗的， 阴沉的

translation: 生意不景气也未必全是坏事。

meaning: v&n.  指责， 斥责， 批评
example: You've no reason to reproach yourself, no reason to feel shame.
translation: 你没有理由自责，也没有理由感到惭愧。

meaning: n.  关税， 进口税； 海关

translation: 海关放行；结关

meaning: n. 授权，批准；许可证；委任状，执行令; vt.  保证， 担保； 使正当
example: So, if all of his units are going into foreclosure are bought by individuals, then the building would be warrantable.
translation: 所以，如果他的单位是丧失抵押品赎回权都是由个人购买，然后大楼将可保证。

meaning: n.  缘故， 理由； 好处

translation: “拜托！”多特反驳道，“它们又便宜又管用。”

meaning: vt.  隐蔽； 隐瞒； 覆盖

translation: 弗朗西斯决定把机器藏在带铰链的嵌板的后面。

meaning: adj. 固体的；实心的；结实的，稳固的；可靠的；连续的; n.  固体

translation: 对加拿大一枝黄花碱法蒸煮性能进行了研究.

meaning: adj.  叙述性的; n. 叙述；记叙体，叙述技巧

translation: 他们自己的生活似乎已经拥有叙事艺术的对称性。

meaning: vi.  同时发生； 一致， 相符； 重合

meaning: adj.  圆形的， 环形的； 循环的； 绕行的

meaning: vt. 刮擦，划；抓，搔; n.  划痕； 挠痒

meaning: vt.  需要； 要求， 命令

meaning: adj. 合作的，协作的；配合的; n.  合作企业

translation: 要把社区工作做好，协作活动是必不可少的。

meaning: n.  柳， 柳树； 柳木制品

meaning: adj.  肉体的， 身体的； 物质的； 实体的

meaning: adj.  急躁的， 易怒的； 易受刺激的； 过敏的

translation: 他们或许会感到疲惫，虽然外表看似没事，但可能很容易发火。

meaning: v. 增至三倍; adj.  三部分的； 三方的； 三倍的

meaning: n. 脾气，性情; vt.  缓和， 调节

translation: 使用蛋彩画颜料（内含可以定色的蛋黄）在干石膏上绘出了特定颜色。

meaning: adj.  清楚的； 易读的

translation: 任何无法辨认的词都将视为错字。

meaning: adj.  易接近的； 可得到的； 可进入的

translation: 法律援助制度应该面向更多人。

meaning: n.  年龄歧视
n.  悬崖， 峭壁

translation: 一团油腻的黑色烟雾飘到悬崖顶上。

meaning: v. 滚动，转动；卷，绕；摇摆，摇晃; n.  卷； 卷形物； 名单， 花名册

translation: 兄弟几个总是要到正午前后才姗姗来到工作室。

meaning: adj. 值得注意的，明显的；显著的；著名的；重要的; n.  名人， 要人

translation: 她在三四十年代成了一位名导演。

meaning: v.  承认； 让步； 允许

translation: 他不允许任何事情来干扰他的工作.

translation: 我必须要问一个你可能觉得颇具冒犯性的问题。

meaning: n.  亮度， 发光度； 光明

translation: 它的亮度有几年一度达到了现在太阳亮度的一万倍左右。

meaning: n. 授权，委任；委员会；佣金，回扣; vt.  委托， 授权

meaning: n.  政策， 方针； 原则； 保险单

translation: 遣返真正的难民回国并非政府的政策。

meaning: v.  重新开始， 继续

translation: 他们认为他应该继续履行君主的职责。

translation: 一些青少年可能相比同龄人在性方面更成熟、更具挑逗性。

meaning: v.  作讲话； 写姓名地址; n. 地址；讲话

translation: 有人调大了公共广播系统的音量。

meaning: vi. 盘旋；盘旋上升；急剧增长; adj. 螺旋形的; n.  螺旋形； 螺旋式的上升

translation: 弧齿锥齿轮；螺旋伞齿轮

meaning: adj.  艺术的； 富有艺术性的， 精美的； 有艺术天赋的

translation: 不过，缺乏的是一种内在的艺术凝聚力。

meaning: vi. 漫游；漫谈，闲聊; n.  漫步

meaning: n.  职业； 使命感； 圣召

meaning: v.  停住， 停下; n. 停止，阻止；暂停

meaning: v. 投，掷，抛；丢，扔；使陷入，使处于；使困惑，使吃惊; n.  投， 掷， 抛； 投掷的距离
example: Now they are producing throwaway razors.
translation: 他们正在生产一次性剃须刀。

meaning: n.  日落， 傍晚

meaning: n.  身材， 身高； 地位， 声望， 名望
example: They have no wish for any change in the status quo.
translation: 他们不想改变现状。

meaning: adj.  顽强的， 坚持不懈的； 顽固的， 固执的
example: He has been dogged by allegations of questionable business practices.
translation: 他一直被那些指控他有不正当商业行为的说法所困扰。

meaning: n.  血浆； 等离子体

translation: 留一些血浆给重病号.

meaning: adj.  过高的， 不合理的
example: Investment remains tiny primarily because of the exorbitant cost of land.
translation: 投资仍然微乎其微，主要原因在于土地成本过高。

meaning: n.  外科手术； 外科学； 手术室， 诊疗室
example: His surgical instruments were a knife and a pair of pincers.
translation: 他的外科手术器械是一把刀和一把钳子。

meaning: adj.  暴力的； 感情强烈的， 激情的； 强烈的， 激烈的

translation: 暴力犯罪，暴力罪行

meaning: adj.  难达到的， 不可及的； 不能得到的

translation: 我们得到了通常难以获取的大量数据。

meaning: v. 解决；决定，决心；分解；显现; n.  决心， 决议
example: This merely strengthens our resolve to win the league.
translation: 这只会更加坚定我们赢得联赛的决心。

meaning: v.  设计舞蹈动作， 编舞
example: This was a show they had helped to choreograph, sometimes in minute detail.
translation: 这是一场他们设计的表演, 甚至有时具体指导其中的微小细节.

meaning: vt.  使面临， 使遭遇； 对抗
example: She had decided to confront Kathryn with what she had learnt.
translation: 她决定拿自己了解的事实与凯瑟琳当面对证。

meaning: adj.  非语言的
example: These five channels of nonverbal communication exist in every culture.
translation: 非言语交流的这五个方面在每个文化里都存在着。

meaning: vt.  部署， 调度； 利用

translation: 步兵黎明时开始进入战斗位置.

meaning: v.  繁殖， 生育； 复制； 再现
example: He is not attempting necessarily to reproduce the cadence of speech.
translation: 他不想刻意重复那种讲话的语调。

meaning: n.  梗概， 提纲； 骨架， 骨骼； 框架

translation: 钢骨架

meaning: vi.  聚集在一起， 挤作一团； 蜷缩， 缩成一团， 蜷缩; n. 挤在一起的人

meaning: adj.  句法的； 按照句法的

translation: 一种基于字符串的语法关系的编译程序.

meaning: n.  表演， 演唱； 提供， 给予； 翻译

translation: 这些音乐家激情演绎了《帕迪·凯西的里尔舞曲》。

meaning: n.  交点； 十字路口， 道路交叉口

translation: 警察在交叉路口指挥交通.

meaning: n.  奖学金； 学问， 学识

translation: 我们用标准化考试来衡量学生的学业成绩.

meaning: adj.  无数的； 大量的; n. 无数；大量

translation: 各种色彩的款式应有尽有。

meaning: adv.  而且， 还有; prep. 除…之外
example: I think she has many good qualities besides being very beautiful.
translation: 我觉得她不但长得非常漂亮，而且还有很多优秀品质。

meaning: vt.  使生效， 执行， 实施
example: Leadership is about the ability to implement change.
translation: 领导才能就是要有实施变革的能力。

meaning: v.  分散， 散开； 疏散； 散布
example: Police fired shots and used teargas to disperse the demonstrators.
translation: 警方鸣枪并使用催泪弹来驱散示威者。

meaning: adj.  古怪的， 反复无常的； 不规则的； 不稳定的

translation: 道格拉斯29岁，是个技术不错的拳击手，在以前的比赛中发挥不太稳定。

meaning: vt.  焚化， 焚毁

translation: 这种难以置信的突然爆发无疑会把地球表面的一切生命烧成灰烬.

meaning: n.  想象， 幻想
example: The film starts off realistically and then develops into a ridiculous fantasy.
translation: 电影以写实开头，然后却发展成为荒诞的幻想。

meaning: adj.  毛状的； 毛细血管的; n. 毛细血管
example: Rapid capillary proliferation is a prominent feature of all early wound healing.
translation: 迅速的毛细血管增生是所有早期伤口愈合的一个突出表现.

meaning: v.  变形
example: Shoes that are too tight deform the feet.
translation: (穿)太紧的鞋子会使脚变形.

meaning: v.  侵蚀， 腐蚀

translation: 美国人心中上帝赋予了他们独一无二的品质的信念开始逐渐丧失。

meaning: adj.  提供消息的， 给予知识的； 见闻广博的

translation: 有些建筑的立面图能比平面图提供更多的信息。

meaning: n. 支票；账单；

translation: 定期检查汽油，并对车辆进行定期维护。

meaning: vt.  使感到灰心， 挫败； 阻止

translation: 但这并没有使爱因斯坦灰心, 他对能够更深入地研究而感到满意.

meaning: adj.  稀疏的， 稀少的； 贫乏的

translation: 在他那所少有陈设的房子里，我们坐在灯下喝着茶。

meaning: adj.  漂亮的； 令人愉快的； 华丽的， 灿烂的

meaning: adj.  务实的， 注重实效的， 实用的

translation: 对管理问题采取的务实做法

meaning: n.  腐蚀， 侵蚀； 削弱， 减少

meaning: n.  甲烷， 沼气

meaning: adj.  地壳构造的

meaning: adj.  迷信的， 受迷信思想支配的
example: Superstitiously he refused to travel on Friday the 13 th.
translation: 他很迷信,拒绝在一个是星期五的13号旅行.

meaning: v.  上升， 升高； 攀登

translation: 一段石阶从鹅卵石路上一直向上直通城墙。

meaning: n.  弹力； 弹性
example: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
translation: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

meaning: adj.  积极主动的； 先发制人的

translation: 积极的财政政策

meaning: adj. 原始的；土著的，土生土长的; n.  土著

meaning: adj.  必不可少的

translation: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

meaning: n.  透镜； 镜头； 镜片

translation: 为什么不给所有的镜头都配上遮光罩呢？

meaning: vt.  表达， 体现； 含有

translation: 任何收入政策都应该具有公平与灵活性之特征.

meaning: adj.  可证实的， 可核实的

translation: 在她的事情核实之前，所有针对她的指控都已撤回。

meaning: adj.  可理解的， 能懂的， 能充分理解的

translation: 他突然开口了，说的却是几乎听不懂的阿拉伯语。

meaning: adj.  发动的； 导致运动的; n. 动机，目的
example: Sheila had an ulterior motive for trying to help Stan.
translation: 希拉想帮助斯坦是另有所图的。

meaning: n. 鹰，隼；主战分子; vt.  叫卖， 兜售
example: The hawk swooped and soared away carrying something.
translation: 那只鹰向下猛冲，抓住东西后又展翅高飞了。

meaning: v. 弄上斑点；点缀; n.  斑点； 色斑
example: The sky was speckled with stars.
translation: 天空中繁星点点。

meaning: v.  散发； 表现， 显示
example: Waves emanate from the same atom source.
translation: 波是由同一原子辐射的.

meaning: adj. 外部的，外表的; n.  外部， 外表
example: His gruff exterior concealed one of the kindest hearts.
translation: 他粗暴的外表下藏着一颗非常善良的心。

meaning: n.  囚禁， 拘留
example: He also talked briefly about the isolation he endured while in captivity.
translation: 他还简单谈及了他被俘期间忍受的孤独。

meaning: vt. 征收; n.  征收额； 税款； 征兵
example: It turns out Levy is talking in metaphorical terms.
translation: 利维原来说的是一种比喻。

meaning: adj.  有效的， 生效的； 显著的； 实际的， 事实上的
example: Condoms are an effective method of birth control if used with care.
translation: 如果使用得当，避孕套是很有效的避孕手段。

meaning: n.  肌肉； 体力， 力量， 实力； 影响力
example: Eisenhower used his muscle to persuade Congress to change the law.
translation: 艾森豪威尔用他的影响力说服国会修改了该项法律。

meaning: adj.  慷慨的， 大方的； 大量的， 丰富的； 宽厚的， 宽宏大量的
example: Not everyone thinks that the government is being particularly generous.
translation: 并非所有人都认为政府特别慷慨。

meaning: n.  变迁， 不断的变动
example: Both quantum mechanics and chaos theory suggest a world constantly in flux.
translation: 量子力学和混沌理论都表明世界永远处于不断变化中。

meaning: n.  果冻， 胶状物
example: You can buy a formulation containing royal jelly, pollen and vitamin C.
translation: 可以买一种含蜂王浆、花粉和维生素C的配方产品。

meaning: v. 探查，探测；盘问，追问; n.  探针； 探测器； 探索， 调查
example: A doctor used a probe to remove metal fragments from a wound.
translation: 医生用探针将伤口中的金属碎片取出.

meaning: adj. 新月形的；逐渐增强的; n.  新月； 新月形， 月牙形
example: They decided a housing co-operative was the way to regenerate Ormiston Crescent.
translation: 他们最终决定通过住房合作社来重建奥米斯顿月牙街。

meaning: v.  充气， 膨胀； 鼓吹， 吹捧； 涨价
example: The promotion of a big release can inflate a film'sfinal cost.
translation: 大规模发行所需的广告宣传会增加一部电影的最终成本。

meaning: adj. 稳定的，安定的；牢固的；沉稳的; n.  马厩
example: stable quality
translation: 质量稳定

meaning: adj.  数量的， 定量的
example: That's the whole difference between quantitative and qualitative research.
translation: 那就是定量研究和定性研究之间的重大差别。

meaning: n.  吵闹， 喧哗
example: The clamor of traffic has receded to a distant murmur.
translation: 车辆的喧闹声已渐渐远去，变得模糊起来。

meaning: vt. 利用…产生动力；给上挽具; n.  马具
example: He was almost strangled by his parachute harness straps.
translation: 他差点被自己的降落伞吊带勒死。

meaning: vt.  煽动， 挑起， 激起
example: The rebels know the truth and seek to foment revolution.
translation: 那些叛乱者知道真相,并且想办法来挑起革命.

meaning: vi.  回答， 答复； 作出反应； 响应
example: Some cases of arthritis respond to a gluten-free diet.
translation: 无麸质饮食对一些关节炎患者有疗效。

meaning: n.  事情， 事件； 摩擦， 冲突
example: A member of the security forces was killed in a sniping incident.
translation: 有一名安全部队成员在一场狙击战中被打死。

meaning: vi.  成群， 成串； 丛生； 群集; n. 簇，团，串，丛；群
example: Chinese waiters stood in a cluster, sharing a private joke.
translation: 华人服务生们站在一起，讲着只有他们自己才懂的笑话。

meaning: vi. 捕食，捕获; n.  猎物； 受害者， 牺牲品
example: The spider must wait for prey to be ensnared on its web.
translation: 蜘蛛必须等待猎物被它的蛛网困住。

meaning: n. 穿着，服饰; vt.  给…穿衣， 打扮
example: In those crowded streets her attire did not rate a second glance.
translation: 在那些拥挤的街道她的穿着并未引起注意。

meaning: v. 拖，
example: The Tugboat Saloon and Eatery is a must-visit.
translation: 拖轮沙龙和小餐馆是必去之处。

meaning: n.  神经元， 神经细胞
example: Information is transferred along each neuron by means of an electrical impulse.
translation: 信息在电脉冲作用下经神经元传递。

meaning: adj.  有脊椎的; n. 脊椎动物
n.  远征； 探险
example: The expedition was wrecked by bad planning and poor navigation.
translation: 这次探险因计划不周和导航不利而失败。

meaning: n.  音乐会， 演奏会； 一致
example: He wants to act in concert with other nations.
translation: 他想和其他国家采取一致行动。

meaning: vt.  吸收； 理解， 掌握； 吸引…的注意， 使全神贯注； 使并入， 同化
example: The material can absorb outward-going radiation from the Earth.
translation: 该物质可以吸收地球向外辐射的能量。

meaning: n. 供应；储备；补给; vt.  供给， 供应； 满足， 弥补
example: power supply
translation: 电源；电源供应器

meaning: vt. 涉及，关系到；使关心，使担忧; n.  关心， 挂念； 关系； 有关的事， 负责的事； 公司， 企业
example: Issues such as these were not really his concern.
translation: 他其实并不关心诸如此类的问题。

meaning: v.  循环； 流通； 传播， 流传
example: Merchandise can now circulate freely among the EU countries.
translation: 商品现在可以在欧盟各国自由流通。

meaning: v.  孵化； 培育； 潜伏
example: The birds returned to their nests and continued to incubate the eggs.
translation: 鸟儿回到巢里继续孵卵。

meaning: vt.  矫正， 纠正； 整顿
example: Only an act of Congress could rectify the situation.
translation: 只有国会法案才能矫正这种形势。

meaning: n.  反义词
example: "Long" is the antonym of "short".
translation: “长”是“短”的反义词。

meaning: n.  正直； 完整
example: He inspires affection and respect as a man of unquestionable integrity.
translation: 他无可争议的忠诚正直赢得了人们的爱戴和尊敬。

meaning: v.  抑制； 戒除; n. 反复句，副歌
example: Rosa's constant refrain is that she doesn't have a life.
translation: 罗莎总是重复的一句话就是她没有像样的生活。

meaning: n.  协议， 条约， 公约
example: A non-aggression pact will be signed between the two countries.
translation: 两国将签署互不侵犯条约。

meaning: n.  符号， 记号
example: Using binary notation is in fact just manipulating ones and noughts.
translation: 使用二进制标号法实际上只运用1和0两个数.

meaning: adj.  有责任的， 有义务的； 易于…的
example: Offenders will be liable to a seven-year prison term.
translation: 违犯者可判处7年监禁。

meaning: adj.  有返回原地本能的
example: All the royal cars are fitted with electronic homing devices.
translation: 所有的皇家轿车都装有电子自导引装置。

meaning: v.  陈述， 说明， 声明； 规定; n. 情况，状况；国家；州
example: Centuries of statecraft had refined the concept of sovereignty.
translation: 几个世纪的治国方法锤炼了民族主义哲学.

meaning: n.  货物
example: Fire may have breached the cargo tanks and set the oil ablaze.
translation: 大火当时有可能把货船上的油罐烧漏了，从而引燃原油。

meaning: v.  压， 按， 挤； 压榨， 压迫； 催促， 逼迫; n. 报刊；新闻界，新闻工作者；报道，评论；出版社；印刷厂；压，按，挤
example: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
translation: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

meaning: vt. 混杂，掺杂; n.  杂乱的一堆， 混乱的一团
example: Your old clothes will be gratefully accepted by jumble sale organisers.
translation: 旧货义卖的组织者会感激地领受您捐赠的旧衣物。

meaning: n. 元素，要素，组成部分；
example: In order to make it safe, the element is electrically insulated.
translation: 为安全起见，该元件作了电绝缘处理。

meaning: adj.  有关环境的， 自然环境的， 生态环境的； 环境的
example: This commission would keep environmental scorecards on UN member nations.
translation: 该委员会将对联合国的成员国采用环境记录卡制。

meaning: adj.  挑剔的， 难以取悦的
example: Everyone knows children are picky eaters.
translation: 众所周知，小孩子吃东西挑食。

meaning: adj.  甲壳类的; n. 甲壳类动物
example: The illustrious Cuvier did not perceive that a barnacle was a crustacean.
translation: 大名鼎鼎的居维叶也未看出藤壶是一种甲壳动物.

meaning: v.  惊叫， 呼喊
example: The Munroe girls rushed up to exclaim over her dress.
translation: 孟家的女孩子都跑过来为她的衣服喝彩.

meaning: adj. 对面的；对立的；相反的; prep.  在…对面; n. 对立面；对立物
example: The argument contained herein takes exactly the opposite point of view.
translation: 本文所持的论点恰恰是站在相反的立场。

meaning: v. 收拾，打包；捆扎；塞满; n.  包， 包裹
example: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
translation: 我尽量言简意赅。

meaning: n.  抑制， 克制； 限制； 约束力； 管制措施
example: The old sense of deference and restraint in royal reporting has vanished.
translation: 在对皇室进行的新闻报道中，那种由来已久的尊重和收敛意识已经消失了。

meaning: n.  后果， 余波
example: A lot of rebuilding took place in the aftermath of the war.
translation: 战后进行了大量的重建工作。

meaning: n.  污染物质， 有害物质
example: Since 1979 China has collected 24.7 billion yuan in pollutant discharge fees.
translation: 1979年以来,全国共征收排污费247亿元.

meaning: adj.  未开发的， 未使用的
n.  暗示， 提示
example: That was Nicholas's cue to ask for another chocolate chip cookie.
translation: 那表示尼古拉斯还想要一块巧克力曲奇。

meaning: n.  流出物， 废水， 污水
example: Industrial effluent often causes a problem to people's health.
translation: 工业废水常常危害人们的健康.

meaning: adj.  未驯服的， 难驾驭的
example: He was found desperately trying to untangle several reels of film.
translation: 他被撞见拼命想要解开几盘缠在一起的胶卷。

meaning: n. 陈规；固定形式，老套；刻板印象; vt.  对…形成固定看法
example: You are likely to find many people who have stereotyped ideas about women.
translation: 你很可能会发现很多人对女性都抱有老一套的看法。

meaning: v.  登记， 注册； 招收
example: I should like to enroll all my children in the swimming class.
translation: 我愿意让我的孩子们都参加游泳班.

meaning: adj. 彻底的，广泛的；〈贬〉笼统的，一概而论的; n.  清扫， 扫除； 垃圾
example: He sweepingly condemned the entire population of the country for the war crimes.
translation: 他笼统地谴责了这个国家所有人的战争罪行.

meaning: adj.  热心的， 热情洋溢的
adj.  黏着的； 使凝结的， 使内聚的
example: "Daring Adventures" from '86 is a far more cohesive and successful album.
translation: 1986年发行的《勇于冒险》是一张风格更为统一也更为成功的专辑。

meaning: n.  电池； 排炮； 一系列， 一批
example: The battery in my car gave up the ghost.
translation: 我的汽车电池报废了。

meaning: n.  泥土， 黏土
example: As the wheel turned, the potter shaped the clay.
translation: 轮子一边转动，制陶工人一边拉坯。

meaning: adj.  不敬的
example: Taylor combined great knowledge with an irreverent attitude to history.
translation: 泰勒知识渊博，而且并不把历史太当回事。

meaning: vt.  促进； 提升； 宣传， 推销
example: They have begun dialogues to promote better understanding between both communities.
translation: 双方已经开始了对话，以增进两个社群间的彼此了解。

meaning: n.  正面； 表面
v.  与…离婚； 使分离， 使脱离; n. 离婚；分离，脱离
example: I wanted a divorce. I wanted to get away.
translation: 我想离婚，以求解脱。

meaning: vt.  分配， 分发； 散布
example: We didn't understand how difficult it was to distribute a national paper.
translation: 我们不了解分销一份全国发行的报纸有多难。

meaning: vt.  连接； 依附于； 系， 贴， 连接； 使依恋， 使喜爱 ； 认为有
example: Magistrates will be able to attach conditions when juveniles are remanded.
translation: 地方法官将可以在少年犯送押时提出附加条件。

meaning: n.  墙角石， 奠基石； 基础
example: This study is the cornerstone of the whole research programme.
translation: 此项研究是整个研究计划的基础。

meaning: n. 小测验；智力竞赛; vt.  测验； 盘问， 查问， 询问
example: Below are printed the answers to the Brain of Soccer 1993 quiz.
translation: 以下所印的是1993年“脑力足球”小测验的答案。

meaning: n.  爱好， 意愿； 趋向， 趋势； 倾斜度
example: Their inclination to wait and demand more resources desolated President Lincoln.
translation: 他们总是等待并要求得到更多资财的倾向让林肯总统甚感不快。

meaning: vi.  参与， 参加
example: This in effect denied them their right to participate meaningfully in elections.
translation: 这实际上是剥夺了他们正式参与选举的权利。

meaning: n.  成分， 要素； 原料
example: The active ingredient in some of the mouthwashes was simply detergent.
translation: 某些漱口剂中的有效成分只不过是洗涤剂而已。

meaning: v.  巩固； 合并
example: The question is: will the junta consolidate its power by force?
translation: 问题是：军政府会通过武力巩固其政权吗？

meaning: adj.  生物化学的， 生化的
example: Carbohydrates are one of the four major classes of biochemical molecules.
translation: 碳水化合物是四大类生物化学分子中的一类.

meaning: n.  图书馆馆长； 图书管理员
example: The old librarian illuminated some old books and manuscripts.
translation: 这个老图书馆员把一些古书和旧抄稿加上各种装饰.

meaning: n.  等高线； 轮廓
adj. 抒情的; n. 抒情诗；
example: The Lyric Theatre is presenting a new production of "Over the Bridge".
translation: 利里克剧院正在上演新排的《桥对面》。

meaning: vt.  收买， 买通， 唆使
n.  家族， 宗族， 氏族； 帮派
example: The men mustered before their clan chiefs.
translation: 男人们聚集在族长们面前。

meaning: adj. 紫色的; n.  紫色
example: "Get the guy in the purple shirt." — "All right, my man."
translation: “把那个穿紫衬衫的家伙叫过来。”——“好的，老兄。”

meaning: v.  停止； 放弃； 离开； 辞
example: Well, parenthetically, I was trying to quit smoking at the time.
translation: 嗯，插一句，我那时正在努力戒烟。

meaning: n.  蛤， 蛤肉； 〈口〉守口如瓶的人， 寡言的人
adj.  经济的， 实惠的； 节俭的， 节约的； 精打细算的
example: Mexican cookery is economical, she says. Nothing goes to waste.
translation: “墨西哥的烹调注重俭省，”她说，“任何东西都不会浪费。”

meaning: v.  磨光， 擦亮； 修改， 润色; n.  上光剂
example: Those killed have been described as the flower of Polish manhood.
translation: 那些牺牲者被称为波兰男子中的精英。

meaning: n.  内阁； 储藏柜， 陈列柜
example: This issue, more than any other, has divided her cabinet.
translation: 主要是这一问题使她的内阁产生了分歧。

meaning: adj. 序数的；顺序的; n.  序数词
example: Individual data items or records can be identified by a key or ordinal.
translation: 单个数据项或记录可用关键字和顺序号识别出来.

meaning: n.  保险； 保险费； 保险业
example: Police investigating a £10 million car insurance fiddle arrested 16 people yesterday.
translation: 调查涉及1,000万英镑的汽车保险诈骗案的警察昨天逮捕了16人。

meaning: n.  原则； 原理； 道德准则， 行为规范； 信念
example: Observance of the law is a matter of principle for us.
translation: 守法是我们的一个原则问题。

meaning: adj.  单调乏味的， 令人厌烦的
example: The story is tediously spun out.
translation: 这故事拖得很讨厌.

meaning: n.  源， 源泉； 来源， 出处； 信息来源
example: It was first mentioned in a 1989 roleplaying game sourcebook.
translation: 1989的一个角色扮演游戏资料设定集首次提到全息网.

meaning: n.  电信
example: For instance, if you are a security guard, you probably cannot telecommute.
translation: 比方说, 如果你是个保安, 那你可能就没法远程办公了.

meaning: n.  参与者； 参赛者
example: A youthful teacher, he finds himself an unwilling participant in school politics.
translation: 作为一名年轻教师，他发现自己并不情愿地参与到了学校的权力争斗中。

meaning: vt.  发起， 开始， 创始； 接纳， 让…加入; n.  新加入组织的人
example: Chen was an initiate of a Chinese spiritual discipline.
translation: 陈是某个中国神学领域的新入门者。

meaning: adj.  国内的； 家庭的； 驯养的
example: And what of the effect on U.S domestic opinion?
translation: 对美国国内的舆论有什么影响？

meaning: adj.  净化的， 清洁的; n. 清洁剂
example: The active ingredient in some of the mouthwashes was simply detergent.
translation: 某些漱口剂中的有效成分只不过是洗涤剂而已。

meaning: v.  怒目而视； 发出刺眼的光; n. 耀眼的光；怒视，瞪眼
example: Norma is said to dislike the glare of publicity.
translation: 据说诺尔玛不喜欢被人过多关注。

meaning: adj.  陆地的， 陆生的， 陆栖的； 地球的
example: terrestrial ecosystem
translation: 陆地生态系统

meaning: n.  骗局； 诡计； 欺骗， 欺诈
example: Human beings have an infinite capacity for self-deception.
translation: 人类自欺的本事是无穷的。

meaning: vt.  汇编； 编辑， 编纂
example: The book took 10 years to compile.
translation: 编这本书花了10年时间。

meaning: n. 偏见，偏心; vt.  使有偏见， 使偏心
example: Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system.
translation: 各级司法机构普遍存在对女性的偏见。

meaning: vi.  冒烟； 大为恼火
example: The pump exhaust should lead to the open air or a fume hood.
translation: 抽气泵的排气管应该导向室外空旷处或导向一座通风橱.

meaning: v. 做预算; adj.  价格低廉的; n. 预算
example: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

meaning: v.  辐射， 发射； 流露， 显示； 自中心向各方伸展
example: Callahan posits that chemical elements radiate electromagnetic signals.
translation: 卡拉汉假定化学元素放射电磁信号。

meaning: n.  紧张； 拉紧； 张力
example: This is the result of tensional or compressional forces originating from tectonic movement.
translation: 当岩石受到因地壳板块移动而产生的张力或横压力时,断层便会出现.

meaning: adj.  纤细的； 稀薄的； 脆弱的
n.  反映； 映像； 深思， 考虑； 回忆； 记录， 描述
example: On reflection, he says, he very much regrets the comments.
translation: 经过反省，他说自己对所作的评论感到非常后悔。

meaning: n.  校园
example: From what I hear, half the campus is lusting after her.
translation: 从我听到的来看，半个学校的人都想和她上床。

meaning: adj. 最后的，最终的；根本的; n.  最好的事物； 最大的或最先进的事物
example: What was it ultimately that led you to leave Sarajevo for Zagreb?
translation: 最终是什么让你离开萨拉热窝前往萨格勒布的？

meaning: v.  起诉， 控告， 检举； 担任控方律师； 继续从事
example: Will you be able to prosecute your responsibilities effectively?
translation: 你能有效地履行职责 吗 ?

meaning: adj.  口头的； 言辞的； 动词的
example: The idea was immediate but the verbalism took hours.
translation: 想法瞬间可得,但表达出来却花费时间.

meaning: n.  地区， 区域； 管区， 行政区
example: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
translation: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

meaning: adj.  树栖的； 树木的
example: Man was evolved from an ancestor that was probably arboreal.
translation: 人大概是从住在树上的祖先进化而来的.

meaning: adv.  总共; adj. 全面的，综合的; n.  工作服， 工装裤
example: The college has few ways to assess the quality of education overall.
translation: 总体看来,这所大学评估教育质量的方法寥寥无几.

meaning: vt.  假定； 承担
example: Don't assume your baby automatically needs feeding if she's fretful.
translation: 不要想当然地认为你的宝宝一闹就是要吃奶。

meaning: n. 胡椒；辣椒; vt.  撒胡椒粉； 大量给予
example: Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of cayenne.
translation: 调以盐、胡椒和少许辣椒粉。

meaning: adj. 醇香的；柔和的；成熟的; v.  醇香； 柔和； 成熟
example: He'd had a few glasses of champagne himself and was fairly mellow.
translation: 他自己也已几杯香槟下肚，很是飘飘然。

meaning: n.  概念， 观念； 设想
example: The snowcoach concept in Yellowstone provides low-impact, low-pollution access.
translation: 在黄石公园里使用雪车这一想法，为人们提供了一种对环境低影响、低污染的游览方式。

meaning: adj.  没有人情味的， 冷淡的； 客观的
example: The rest of the room was neat and impersonal.
translation: 房间的其余部分整洁干净，不带任何的个人色彩。

meaning: n. 一千年，千年期
example: the second millennium AD
translation: 公元第二个千年

meaning: adj.  抵抗的， 有抵抗力的； 抵制的； 抗…的， 耐…的
example: The body may be less resistant if it is cold.
translation: 天冷时，身体的抵抗力会下降。

meaning: n.  火蜥蜴； 火蛇
example: European salamander having dark skin with usually yellow spots.
translation: 黑色皮肤上通常有黄色斑点的欧洲蝾螈.

meaning: n.  灾难； 彻底的失败
example: An airliner came close to disaster while approaching Heathrow Airport.
translation: 一架大型客机在飞近希思罗机场时差点儿发生空难。

meaning: adv.  十足; adj. 赤裸的；严酷的，严峻的；明显的，鲜明的；十足的，极端的
example: I often have dreams a moonless and starless dark night.
translation: 我常常做梦.无月无星的黑夜里我的梦最多.

meaning: v. 搭便车；提起，拉起；拴住; n.  故障， 障碍
example: The shooting of The Maltese Falcon proceeded without a hitch.
translation: 《马耳他之鹰》的拍摄进展顺利。

meaning: adj.  感知的， 知觉的
example: Some children have more finely trained perceptual skills than others.
translation: 一些孩子比其他孩子具备更为训练有素的感知技能。

meaning: adj.  毛皮似的； 盖着毛皮的； 生苔的
example: The moss was soft and furry to the touch.
translation: 苔藓柔软，摸起来像绒毛。

meaning: vt.  提高； 增强
example: Large paintings can enhance the feeling of space in small rooms.
translation: 大型油画可以增加小房间的宽敞感。

meaning: n.  会议； 习俗， 惯例； 公约
example: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

meaning: n.  头盖骨的， 颅骨的
example: Methods: Cranial computer tomography ( CT ) and transcranial Doppler ( TCD ) were performed in 38 patients.
translation: 方法: 采用头颅 CT 影像技术及经颅多普勒 ( TCD ) 技术对38例患者分别进行两项检测.

meaning: n. 购买；购买的物品; vt.  购买
example: Purchase tax was not payable on goods for export.
translation: 出口商品不需要交购买税。

meaning: n. 滨，岸; vt.  支撑， 支持
example: shore up
translation: 支持，支撑；加固

meaning: vi.  充满， 到处都是
example: For most of the year, the area is teeming with tourists.
translation: 一年中大部分时间里，这个地区游人如织。

meaning: n.  社会道德沦丧， 失范； 混乱
n.  氯
example: Since 1908, chlorine has been added to drinking water.
translation: 自1908年以来氯就被添加进饮用水当中。

meaning: v.  勉力完成； 应付； 操纵， 控制； 管理
example: We'll manage somehow, you and me. I know we will.
translation: 我和你，我们总能应付过去的。我知道我们会的。

meaning: adj. 相同的; vt. 等于；相当于; n.  同等的人； 相等的事物
example: In many respects Asian women see themselves as equal to their men.
translation: 在很多方面，亚洲女性都认为自己和丈夫是平等的。

meaning: adj.  漂亮的， 时髦的； 高雅的， 有格调的
example: He is the finest stylist in the English language of today.
translation: 他是当今英语世界中文采最好的。

meaning: v. 对…感到惊异，大为赞叹; n.  令人惊异的人， 奇迹； 不凡的成果
example: It was a marvel that the floor never gave way.
translation: 惊奇的是地板居然从未塌陷。

meaning: n.  硅
example: a silicone breast implant
translation: 硅酮隆胸植入物

meaning: n.  硅酸盐
example: The host rock conformably overlies a band of siliceous chertybrecia.
translation: 含矿主岩整合地上覆于硅质燧石角砾石带之上.

meaning: n. 基金，专款；储备，蕴藏；; vt.  为…提供资金
example: He's accused of misusing $17.5 million from a secret government slush fund.
translation: 他被指控滥用秘密的政府行贿基金，金额达1,750万美元。

meaning: n.  重力； 严重性； 严肃， 庄严
example: Anything with strong gravity attracts other things to it.
translation: 任何有较强重力的物体都会对其他物体产生引力。

meaning: n.  接受者， 收受者
example: A suppressed immune system puts a transplant recipient at risk of other infections.
translation: 接受器官移植的病人免疫系统受到抑制后很可能会感染其他疾病。

meaning: vt.  施催眠术； 使入迷， 迷住
example: He could mesmerize an audience by the sheer force of his presence.
translation: 他只要一出场,观众就为之倾倒.

meaning: vt. 给…提供资金; n. 财政，金融；
example: The finance minister will continue to mastermind Poland's economic reform.
translation: 财政部长将继续策划波兰的经济改革。

meaning: vt. 隐藏，藏匿; n.  贮藏物
example: Rock'n'roll had entered a period of stasis.
translation: 摇滚乐已经进入了一个停滞期。

meaning: n.  机动车停放； 停车场
example: A block up the street I found a parking lot.
translation: 沿着街道往北过了一个街区，我找到了一个停车场。

meaning: n.  工作室， 画室； 摄影室， 演播室， 录音室； 练习室； 电影公司
example: a studious young man
translation: 勤奋的小伙子

meaning: vt.  招致， 招惹， 遭受
example: Any expenses you may incur will be chargeable to the company.
translation: 你的所有开销均由本公司支付。

meaning: adv. 向下，往下; adj.  向下的
example: His adult life mirrored the downward course of his father's life.
translation: 他成年后的生活反映出了他父亲的生活在走下坡路。

meaning: adj.  微胖的； 丰满的
example: Alexandra looked plump and awkward in her cast-off clothing.
translation: 亚历山德拉穿着那身过时的衣裳，显得臃肿笨拙。

meaning: adv.  并列地， 并排地
example: As they reached the start-finish line Prost jinked right and drew abreast.
translation: 当他们接近起止线时，普罗斯特猛向右转，两辆车并排驶过了终点。

meaning: vi. 弹回；后退，退缩；产生后坐力; n.  后退， 退缩； 反冲， 后坐力
example: People used to recoil from the idea of getting into debt.
translation: 过去人们不能接受欠债这种事情。

meaning: v.  管理， 控制； 调整， 调节； 校准
example: The AA called for laws to regulate clamping firms.
translation: 英国汽车协会呼吁立法，规范夹车公司的行为。

meaning: adj.  交互式的； 合作的， 互相配合的
example: The school believes in interactive teaching methods.
translation: 这所学校相信互动教学法。

meaning: adj.  倦怠的， 没精打采的
example: He was listless and pale and wouldn't eat much.
translation: 他无精打采，脸色苍白，食欲不振。

meaning: n.  腺
example: Her mother has an underactive adrenal gland.
translation: 她的母亲肾上腺机能不全.

meaning: adj.  补充的； 互补的
example: Two complementary exhibitions are on show at the Africa Centre.
translation: 两场互为补充的展览正在非洲中心展出。

meaning: n.  浓度， 密度； 一致性， 协调； 连接， 结合
example: internal consistency
translation: 內部一致性；内部相容性

meaning: n.  折磨； 严峻考验
example: Mona remains unshaken by her ordeal and is matter-of-fact about her courage.
translation: 莫娜不为她经历的这场磨难所动，对自己表现出的勇气也态度淡然。

meaning: n.  灵长类， 灵长目动物； 大主教
example: The woolly spider monkey is the largest primate in the Americas.
translation: 绒毛蛛猴是美洲最大的灵长类动物。

meaning: adj.  成束的； 纤细的
example: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
translation: 有一朵云彩来遮盖他们.也有声音从云彩里出来说, 这是我的爱子,你们要听他.

meaning: n.  房屋和地基， 经营场址； 前提， 假设
example: Well, now just a second, I don't altogether agree with the premise.
translation: 嗯，且慢，我并不完全同意这个前提。

meaning: vt.  聚居于， 大批生长于； 开拓殖民地， 移居于
example: The first British attempt to colonize Ireland was in the twelfth century.
translation: 英国最早尝试在爱尔兰开拓殖民地是在12世纪。

meaning: n.  季节； 时节； 时期
example: I'll wait for a seasonable moment to speak to her.
translation: 我要等个适当时机跟她说话.

meaning: adj.  引起争论的， 有争议的
example: The committee backtracked by scrapping the controversial bonus system.
translation: 委员会改变主意，放弃了有争议的奖金制度。

meaning: vt.  达到； 获得
example: Top-ranking sumo wrestlers attain superstar status.
translation: 顶尖的相扑选手可获得超级明星的地位。

meaning: n. 房客，承租人; vt.  居住
n.  画廊， 美术馆
example: Laura landed a plum job with a smart art gallery.
translation: 劳拉在一家时尚画廊找到了份美差。

meaning: n.  恢复； 整修， 修复； 复位， 复原； 归还
example: The restoration took almost 4,000 man-hours over four years.
translation: 修复工作历时4年，耗费近4,000工时。

meaning: vi.  变得苍白， 变得暗淡; adj. 苍白的；淡色的；暗淡的，微弱的
example: In the background, dressed in pale green, stood Eunice.
translation: 尤妮斯穿着浅绿色的衣服站在后面不起眼的地方。

meaning: n.  五金制品， 金属制品； 硬件
example: Hardware stores have sold out of water pumps and tarpaulins.
translation: 五金店内水泵和防水油布已经卖光了。

meaning: v. 连续猛击; n.  击球手； 面糊
example: Stir the batter every now and then to keep it from separating.
translation: 不时搅动面糊，防止其成分散开。

meaning: n.  不幸的人； 恶棍， 无赖
example: Wretched woman, he thought, why the hell can't she wait?
translation: 他想，可恶的女人，她怎么就不能等一等呢？

meaning: n.  优先权， 优先； 优先考虑的事， 最重要的事
example: Spain's top priority is the signing of an EMU treaty.
translation: 西班牙的当务之急是签署《欧洲经济和货币联盟条约》。

meaning: adj.  金属般的； 金属制的； 含金属的
example: There was a metallic click and the gates swung open.
translation: 随着一声金属碰击的咔嗒声，大门打开了。

meaning: adj.  有创造力的， 创造性的
example: Some thought must be given to the method of validation.
translation: 一些想法必须通过验证法加以证实。

meaning: n.  神话； 神话学； 虚幻的想法
example: In Norse mythology the moon is personified as male.
translation: 在斯堪的纳维亚神话里，月亮被赋予了男性身份。

meaning: v. 穿梭往返；短程往返运送; n.  航天飞机； 梭子； 航班
example: She sent the shuttlecock flying over the net with a practised flick of the wrist.
translation: 她熟练地轻抖手腕,把羽毛球击过了网.

meaning: vt.  分配， 分派， 把…拨给
example: Our plan is to allocate one member of staff to handle appoint-ments.
translation: 我们的计划是分派一位职员处理预约事宜。

meaning: n.  硬面包圈
example: You can't even get a decent bagel in Washington , D . C .
translation: 在华盛顾 特区, 甚至都吃不到好的百吉饼.

meaning: adj.  最初的； 首要的； 基本的
example: It is nearly always women who are the primary care givers.
translation: 从事初级保健护理工作的几乎都是女性。

meaning: n. 原木，木材；日志，航海日志，飞行日志; vt.  记录； 伐木
example: In the evening a log fire would provide cosiness.
translation: 晚上点起篝火会让人感到温暖舒适。

meaning: n.  企业， 公司； 事业
example: He favoured a middle course between free enterprise and state intervention.
translation: 他更倾向于在自由经营与国家干预之间走一条中庸之道。

meaning: n.  猎鹰， 隼
example: The shooting of The Maltese Falcon proceeded without a hitch.
translation: 《马耳他之鹰》的拍摄进展顺利。

meaning: n.  通风设备； 空气流通
example: It is the combination of rigidity and ventilative degree very much.
translation: 的纸浆可得到较好的抗张力,耐折力,以及较好的挺硬度与透气度的组合性.

meaning: adj.  太阳的， 日光的； 太阳能的
example: solar energy
translation: 太阳能

meaning: vt.  消耗， 损耗； 消费； 吃， 喝； 使充满； 烧毁， 毁灭
example: Classically, overweight people underestimate the volume of food that they consume.
translation: 一般来说，超重的人往往低估自己摄入食物的量。

meaning: n.  形成， 构成； 形成物； 编队
example: They saw a squadron of fifteen motorcycle policemen driving in V-formation.
translation: 他们看见15名警察骑着摩托车排成V字形前行。

meaning: n.  心理分析， 精神分析
example: We esteem Sigmund Freud as the father of psychoanalysis.
translation: 我们把西格蒙德·弗罗伊德看做精神分析学之父.

meaning: n.  双语现象
n.  能力， 胜任； 权限； 技能
example: The selection process is based on rigorous tests of competence and experience.
translation: 选拔过程是基于对能力和经验的严格测试。

meaning: v. 融合；熔接；熔化；因保险丝烧断而断电；合并; n.  保险丝； 引信； 导火线
example: The fuse blew as he pressed the button to start the motor.
translation: 他按下按钮启动马达的时候保险丝烧断了。

meaning: adj.  琐碎的， 无关紧要的； 愚蠢的， 可笑的； 无聊的， 不严肃的， 轻佻的
example: This is a frivolous way of attacking the problem.
translation: 这是一种轻率敷衍的处理问题的方式.

meaning: n.  借口， 托词
example: They wanted a pretext for subduing the region by force.
translation: 他们想找借口用武力征服这个地区。

meaning: adj.  突现的； 新兴的； 紧急的
example: Emergent democracies created markets that were ripe for exploitation.
translation: 新兴的民主国家创造了可供开拓的成熟市场.

meaning: vt.  确保； 使确信
example: This may sound trivial, but I assure you it is quite important!
translation: 这听上去也许微不足道，但是，相信我，它十分重要！

meaning: v.  请教； 商议； 参考， 翻阅
example: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
translation: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

meaning: n.  基金， 资金； 提供资金
example: initial funding
translation: 启动基金

meaning: v.  幸免， 幸存； 继续存在， 存货； 艰难度过； 比…长命
example: Rafferty was the sole survivor from the successful Ireland team of 1988.
translation: 拉弗蒂是1988年红极一时的爱尔兰队硕果仅存的球员。

meaning: adj. 开始的，最初的; n.  词首大写字母
example: They learnt a lot from the initial market testing exercise.
translation: 他们从最初的市场测试中了解了许多信息。

meaning: adj.  未充分发展的， 原始的； 基本的， 基础的
example: They were given only rudimentary training in the job.
translation: 他们仅仅受到过基本的职业训练。

meaning: n.  对手， 敌手
example: Elliott crossed the finish line just half a second behind his adversary.
translation: 埃利奥特跨过终点线时仅比对手落后半秒钟。

meaning: vt.  假定， 假设
example: Offe also challenges the postulate of an "organized capitalism".
translation: 奥费也质疑“有组织的资本主义”的假设。

meaning: vt.  大批滋生， 大批出没于
example: Several animals in sea water can infest wood.
translation: 海水中有好多动物能侵害木材.

meaning: adj.  讽刺的， 嘲讽的
example: It presented in satirical terms points made in earnest by Catholic writers.
translation: 它用讽刺的语言呈现了天主教作家郑重其事表明的观点。

meaning: adj.  永恒的， 不朽的
example: The series chronicles the everyday adventures of two eternal bachelors.
translation: 这个系列剧按照时间顺序记述了两个老光棍每天的奇遇。

meaning: v.  变皱， 起皱； 破裂； 崩溃， 垮台
example: The front and rear of the car will crumple during a collision.
translation: 碰撞时，汽车的前部和后部会被撞瘪。

meaning: n.  讽刺文学， 讽刺作品； 讽刺
example: Looking at her satiric parent she only gave a little laugh.
translation: 她望着她那挖苦人的父亲,只讪讪地笑了一下.

meaning: adj.  流行的， 普遍的
example: This condition is more prevalent in women than in men.
translation: 这种病症在女性当中比在男性当中更为普遍。

meaning: vi.  附着， 黏住； 紧紧抓住； 挨近
example: The birds cling to the wall and nibble at the brickwork.
translation: 鸟儿们紧贴在墙上，啄着砖缝。

meaning: v. 夹住，扣住；修剪；剪下; n.  夹子， 回形针， 别针； 弹夹， 弹仓； 电影片段， 剪报
example: They moved out from the airport at a brisk clip.
translation: 他们迅速撤离机场。

meaning: n.  绿洲； 避风港

translation: 我们常常用红字表示危险.

translation: 开发区

meaning: adj.  听得见的

translation: 在客人们鱼贯进入餐厅之前，她核实了一遍座位安排。

meaning: vt.  需要， 使成为必要
example: It is common that a single requirement will necessitate multiple interface elements.
translation: 一个需求可以由多个界面元素来满足,这种情况比较普遍.

meaning: adj.  传统的； 正统的

meaning: n.  劫掠， 掠夺， 破坏

translation: 大多数南方城镇都遭受过这帮武装匪徒的鲁蛮掠夺.

meaning: n.  结合， 混合； 化合； 组合
example: You can cobble it together from any old combination of garments.
translation: 把以前的衣服随便搭配一下就能拼凑出一套。

meaning: n&vt.  埋伏， 伏击
n.  〈总称〉首饰； 珠宝

translation: 我花很多钱购买昂贵的首饰和衣服。

meaning: v.  获得； 通用， 流行
