example: Selective aversion to certain risks may entail acceptance of other greater risks.
translation: 有选择地回避某些风险可能招致更大的风险.

meaning: adj. 劣等的，较差的；次要的；级别低的; n.  下级， 下属， 晚辈
example: He preferred the company of those who were intellectually inferior to himself.
translation: 他喜欢与那些智力水平不如他的人共处。

meaning: adj.  戏剧的； 引人注目的； 突然的， 巨大的； 戏剧性的
example: Recent, more dramatic use of CGI was seen in "Walking With Dinosaurs".
translation: 在纪录片《与恐龙同行》中可以看到最新的、更加生动的电脑特效技术。

meaning: n.  小型立式钢琴
n.  蚊子
example: I threw aside my mosquito net and jumped out of bed.
translation: 我把蚊帐甩到一边，跳下床来。

meaning: n.  寄生物； 食客
example: One of the ways the parasite spreads is through fecal matter.
translation: 寄生虫传播的一种方式是通过排泄物。

meaning: adj.  人工的， 人造的， 假的； 矫揉造作的， 假装
example: Organic food is unadulterated food produced without artificial chemicals or pesticides.
translation: 有机食品是未使用人工化学制剂和杀虫剂的纯净食品。

meaning: n.  不足， 缺乏
example: Symptoms of anaemia include weakness, fatigue and iron deficiency.
translation: 贫血的症状包括虚弱、疲劳和缺铁。

meaning: adj.  想象中的， 虚构的， 假想的
example: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
translation: 精神分裂症的最常见的一个症状就是幻听。

meaning: n.  除去； 移动， 搬迁
v&n.  评论； 注释
example: It was just a passing comment, he didn't go on about it.
translation: 那只是一笔带过的评论，他没有继续论述。

meaning: v.  蒸发， 汽化
example: Customer installations generally include a tank, vaporizer, and pressure control manifold.
translation: 用户使用的设备一般包括储存罐 、 汽化器和压力控制管.

meaning: vt.  超越
example: The biggest happiness in life is realizing self - transcendence.
translation: 人生最大的幸福是实现对 自我 的超越.

meaning: adj.  长满刺的， 多刺的， 带刺的； 棘手的
adj.  按年代顺序排列的， 年代学的
example: The chronological sequence gives the book an element of structure.
translation: 时间顺序让这本书有了一定的结构。

meaning: adj. 人道主义的，慈善的; n.  人道主义者， 博爱者， 慈善家
example: Even as a humanitarian mission it has been only a qualified success.
translation: 即便是作为一次人道主义行动，它也不过是取得了有限的成功。

meaning: vt. 用，使用；雇用; n.  受雇， 雇用
example: The organisers have to employ performers to pull a crowd.
translation: 组织者不得不雇些演员来聚拢人气。

meaning: n. 额外费用，增收费，附加费; vt.  收取额外费用
example: Training surcingle made of poly web with PVC lining across the back and inside the girth.
translation: 培训肚带作出聚网络与PVC内衬整个背部和内围.

meaning: adj.  健壮的， 结实的； 稳固的； 顽强的
example: He catches five sturgeon fish.
translation: 他捕捉到五条鲟鱼.

meaning: n.  寓言； 谎言
example: The old fable continues to echo down the centuries.
translation: 这则古老的寓言流传了数个世纪。

meaning: n.  阳台； 楼厅， 楼座
example: Chris unhooked the shutters and went out on the balcony.
translation: 克里斯拉开百叶窗，走到了阳台上。

meaning: vt.  慢慢灌输； 逐渐培养
example: I consider it important to instill a pride in the players.
translation: 我认为使运动员逐步感到自豪是很重要的.

meaning: vi.  在于， 存在于； 由…组成， 由…构成
example: The division will consist of two tank companies and one infantry company.
translation: 这个师的组成部队将包括两个坦克连和一个步兵连。

meaning: adj.  美味的， 可口的； 合意的， 认可的
example: Some of the dialogue has been changed to make it more palatable to an American audience.
translation: 有些对白有所修改以适应美国观众的口味。

meaning: adj.  协调的， 一致的； 兼容的； 能和睦相处的
example: Free enterprise, he argued, was compatible with Russian values and traditions.
translation: 他认为自由企业制并不违背俄罗斯的价值观和传统。

meaning: n.  评论家， 批评家； 吹毛求疵者
example: He was a stern critic but an extremely kindly man.
translation: 他是个苛刻的批评家，但却是个非常善良的人。

meaning: n.  廉租公寓
n.  光合作用
example: Our current research topic is photosynthesis.
translation: 我们现在研究的课题是光合作用。

meaning: n.  补充报道
example: I got a bottle of my best malt out of the sideboard.
translation: 我从餐具柜里取出一瓶自己收藏的最好的麦芽威士忌。

meaning: v.  达到顶点; n. 顶峰，顶点；浪尖；羽冠
example: On the wall is the family crest.
translation: 墙上挂着那个家族的饰章。

meaning: n.  职业； 同行； 专业； 宣称
example: The attitude of the medical profession is very much more liberal now.
translation: 现在，医务人员的态度开明多了。

meaning: vt.  悲叹， 哀叹， 公开谴责
example: We deplore this lamentably ill-advised decision.
translation: 我们强烈反对这个拙劣的、欠考虑的决定。

meaning: v.  压缩； 缩短； 浓缩
example: He never understood how to organize or compress large masses of material.
translation: 他从来就不懂如何对大篇的材料进行整理或精简。

meaning: adv.  冷酷地； 严肃地； 坚定地
example: "It's too late now to stop him," Harris said grimly.
translation: “现在阻止他已经太晚了，”哈里斯严肃地说道。

meaning: vt.  爱护， 珍爱； 怀有， 抱有
example: The president will cherish the memory of this visit to Ohio.
translation: 总统将铭记这次俄亥俄之行。

meaning: vt.  比…长命， 比…耐久
example: I'm sure Rose will outlive many of us.
translation: 我肯定罗丝会比我们中的很多人长命。

meaning: v.  以高人一等的态度对待； 光顾； 赞助， 资助
example: Don't you patronize me!
translation: 别在我面前摆出一副屈尊俯就的样子！

meaning: adj.  显著的， 杰出的
example: eminent domain
translation: [律]土地征用权；国家最高支配权

meaning: adv.  在下面; prep. 在…下面
n.  谱， 光谱， 频谱； 范围， 幅度
vt.  拉长， 延长
example: A long drawn out war would likely deepen and prolong the recession.
translation: 一场旷日持久的战争很可能会使衰退程度加剧，时间延长。

meaning: n.  偿还额； 退款; vt.  退还， 偿付
example: tax refund
translation: 退税；退税单

meaning: n. 痛苦，忧伤；贫困，窘迫；遇难; vt.  使痛苦， 使悲伤， 使忧虑
example: He keeps coming to the aid of this damsel in distress.
translation: 他不断出手相助这位落难女子。

meaning: n.  残余物； 布头； 遗迹
example: Obedience by women towards men is a remnant of religious teaching.
translation: 女人对男人的顺从是宗教教义的残迹。

meaning: v. 广播，播放; n.  广播， 广播节目
example: More cash will be saved by shutting studios and selling outside-broadcast vehicles.
translation: 通过关闭演播室和出售实况转播车将节省更多资金。

meaning: adj.  可压缩的
example: We frequently regard gases as compressible, liquids as incompressible.
translation: 我们通常认为气体是可压缩的, 液体是不可压缩的.

meaning: adj. 陡的，陡峭的；急剧的；过高的; v.  浸泡； 沉浸
example: Then the effect is to steepen the flanks of the pulse spectrum.
translation: 因此在效果上是加大了脉冲谱翼部的陡度.

meaning: adj.  经典的， 古典的
example: The images were Gothic or Byzantine rather than classical.
translation: 这些形象属哥特式或者拜占庭式而非古典式。

meaning: n.  免疫力； 保护； 免除， 豁免
example: The embassy official claimed diplomatic immunity and was later released.
translation: 那名使馆官员申请外交豁免，随后被释放。

meaning: vt. 给予特权，特别优待; n.  特权， 特殊待遇； 特殊利益， 优惠； 荣耀， 荣幸
example: Pironi was the son of privilege and wealth, and it showed.
translation: 皮罗尼出身于有钱有势的豪门，这看得出来。

meaning: vt. 隐藏，遮蔽; n.  裹尸布， 寿衣； 遮蔽物
example: Pancake Day ( Shrove Tuesday, when pancakes are traditionally eaten )
translation: 薄饼日 ( 忏悔节前一日, 按传统吃薄饼 ).

meaning: v.  代替; n. 代替者，代替品
example: In my experience a straight substitution of carob for chocolate doesn'twork.
translation: 根据我的经验，用角豆制品直接代替巧克力行不通。

meaning: v. 构成十字形图案；交叉往来; adj.  纵横交错的
adj.  统一的； 均匀的; n. 制服
example: The uniformitarian principle, like any other scientific " law ", rests on the objective circumstance.
translation: 均变说原理, 象其它任何科学 “ 定律 ” 一样, 是以客观环境作为根据的.

meaning: adj.  波浪起伏的， 不平静的； 不连贯的， 支离破碎的
example: A gale was blowing and the sea was choppy.
translation: 狂风大作，海面上波浪起伏。

meaning: vi.  燃烧， 着火； 发光， 放光彩； 怒视; n. 火焰；光辉，强烈的光；迸发
example: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
translation: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

meaning: adj.  慷慨的； 大量的， 充足的
example: State aid is less bountiful than it was before.
translation: 国家提供的援助比以往减少了。

meaning: adj.  不足的， 贫乏的； 消瘦的
example: His meager allotment of gas had to be saved for emergencies.
translation: 他分到的那一点点煤气必须留着急用。

meaning: v.  使分散， 驱散， 散开； 撒播
example: Aunt Mary is such a scatterbrain that she always forgets something.
translation: 玛丽阿姨糊里糊涂的,她总是忘东忘西.

meaning: vt.  违反， 违背； 亵渎； 侵犯， 干扰
example: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

meaning: n.  甲醇
example: The wet filter cake was recrystallized from 650 ml methanol.
translation: 将湿的滤饼用650毫升甲醇进行重结晶.

meaning: v. 驾驶，为…操舵；引导; n.  食用公牛
example: The ship went with easy steerage.
translation: 这条船容易操舵.

meaning: n.  信息素
adj. 集体的，共同的; n.  集体， 共同体
example: They have been galvanised into collective action — militarily, politically and economically.
translation: 他们在形势驱使下已经在政治、经济和军事上采取了联合行动。

meaning: n.  密友； 搭档， 伙伴
example: Hey, no way, buddy.
translation: 嘿，没门儿，老兄。

meaning: vt.  经历； 遭受
example: The feeding of dairy cows has undergone a revolution.
translation: 乳牛的喂养方法发生了巨大的改变。

meaning: adj.  边远的， 偏僻的； 无关的， 题外的
example: Tourists can visit outlying areas like the Napa Valley Wine Country.
translation: 游客可以前往像纳帕谷酒乡这样远离城市喧嚣的地方游览。

meaning: vt.  描绘， 描述； 解释
example: Biography must to some extent delineate characters.
translation: 传记必须在一定程度上描绘人物。

meaning: n.  代理处， 经销机构； 专门机构
example: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: n.  礼券， 优惠券； 配给券， 票证
example: To enter, simply complete the coupon on page 150.
translation: 要想参加，只需填写第150页的参赛表格。

meaning: n.  大量， 众多； 群众， 民众； 人群
example: There are a multitude of small quiet roads to cycle along.
translation: 有很多可以骑车的宁静小路。

meaning: vt.  居住于， 栖居于
example: some of the rare species that inhabit the area
translation: 生活在这个地区的一些罕见物种

meaning: adj.  天生的， 固有的； 内在的， 直觉的
example: Home ownership has been an overarching and innate desire of the British.
translation: 拥有私宅是所有英国人心中压倒一切和根深蒂固的强烈愿望。

meaning: n.  包围， 围困； 封锁
example: Siegfried cringed and shrank against the wall.
translation: 西格弗里德畏缩了，退避到墙根。

meaning: vt.  使满意， 使高兴； 满足
example: He did that to gratify his girlfriend's vanity.
translation: 他做那事是要满足他女友的虚荣心.

meaning: adj.  迷人的， 醉人的
example: The list of drinks, a dozen pages long, makes fascinating reading.
translation: 酒水单一共有十几页长，读起来很有趣。

meaning: adj. 抽象的；抽象派的; n.  摘要， 梗概; vt.  做…的摘要； 提取
example: His painting went through both representational and abstract periods.
translation: 他的绘画经历了具象风格和抽象风格两个阶段。

meaning: n.  议程， 议程表
example: Never before has a summit had such a crowded agenda.
translation: 以前从来没有一次峰会的日程排得这么满。

meaning: adj. 液体的，液态的，流体的；清澈的；流畅的; n.  液体； 液态
example: We found a cyst and I suctioned off the liquid within.
translation: 我们发现了一个囊肿，我把其中的液体吸了出来。

meaning: n.  类星体
example: Within a few million years, quasar and galaxy will have merged.
translation: 在几百万年的时间里, 类星体和伴星系将会合并在一起.

meaning: adj.  匿名的， 不具名的； 无特色的， 无个性特征的
example: He was surprised by the venomous tone of the anonymous calls.
translation: 那些匿名电话的恶毒语气很令他吃惊。

meaning: v.  伪造； 伪装
example: They said, after digging around, the photo was a fake.
translation: 在搜集了有关情况后，他们说照片是伪造的。

meaning: n. 跨度；持续时间; vt.  跨越； 持续， 贯穿； 包括
example: life span
translation: 寿命；使用期限

meaning: v.  废除种族隔离
example: The courts ordered busing to desegregate the schools.
translation: 法律规定要用校车运送学生来打破学校的种族隔离。

meaning: n.  主梁， 大梁
example: Compatibility will require that the girder deflection at B be zero.
translation: 根据协调性的要求,梁在B点的挠度应为零.

meaning: adj.  奇形怪状的， 古怪可笑的， 怪诞的
example: The allegations ranged from the banal to the bizarre.
translation: 从平淡无奇到离奇百怪的各种说法都有。

meaning: adj.  完美的， 理想的； 完全的， 十足的; vt.  使完美， 使熟练
example: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

meaning: v.  更喜欢， 宁愿
example: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
translation: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

meaning: adj.  天文学的； 极大的， 庞大的
example: Houses in the village are selling for astronomical prices.
translation: 乡村的房价正在飙升。

meaning: vt.  把…归于； 归咎于
example: To ascribe opinions retrospectively is of course very dangerous.
translation: 事后再翻出当初谁说了什么当然是很危险的。

meaning: n.  地极； 磁极， 电极； 柱， 杆， 杖； 极端
example: She is a pole dancer at London's famous Spearmint Rhino club.
translation: 她是伦敦著名的“薄荷犀牛”夜总会的钢管舞舞者。

meaning: n.  少数； 少数民族
example: A minority of officers were prepared to bend the rules.
translation: 少数官员准备篡改规则。

meaning: n&v.  诱惑， 吸引
example: It's a game that has really lost its allure.
translation: 这是一项的确已失去了魅力的游戏。

meaning: n.  提到， 论及， 涉及； 引文， 参考； 介绍
example: Read these notes carefully and keep them for future reference.
translation: 仔细阅读这些注释并将其保留下来以备将来之用。

meaning: n.  密谋； 阴谋
example: At first, he was blissfully unaware of the conspiracy against him.
translation: 起初，他幸好不知道那些针对他的阴谋。

meaning: n.  会议厅； 议院； 洞穴； 腔， 室； 房间
example: More than 80 parties are contesting seats in the two-chamber parliament.
translation: 有80多个党派在竞争两院的议席。

meaning: v.  布置； 安排， 筹备
example: It is not for me to arrange such matters.
translation: 我无权安排这些事情。

meaning: adj.  贵族的， 有贵族气派的
example: He laughed it off with aristocratic indifference.
translation: 他带着贵族式的漠然对其一笑置之。

meaning: vt.  使显得琐碎； 轻视
example: Every normal operator is trivially subnormal.
translation: 每一个正规算子显而易见地是次正规的.

meaning: vi.  离开； 背离
example: My connecting plane didn't depart for another six hours.
translation: 我搭乘的联运航班又过了6个小时才起飞。

meaning: n.  解释者； 倡导者， 拥护者； 指数， 幂
example: She was a leading exponent of free trade during her political career.
translation: 她从政期间是自由贸易的主要倡导者。

meaning: n.  手风琴
example: The background music was provided by an accordion player.
translation: 背景音乐是由一位手风琴乐手演奏的。

meaning: n.  不一致， 不和谐
example: She smiled at the incongruity of the question.
translation: 面对这样突兀的问题，她笑了。

meaning: v.  恳请； 乞求； 征求； 勾引； 招揽
v. 押韵；和…同韵; n.  押韵； 同韵词， 押韵词
example: All of the poems are written in traditional metres and rhyme schemes.
translation: 所有的诗都按传统的韵律和韵脚而作。

meaning: adj. 化石的；陈腐的; n.  化石； 老顽固
example: The fossil fuels (coal and oil) are finite resources.
translation: 化石燃料（如煤和石油）属于有限资源。

meaning: n.  门徒， 弟子， 追随者
example: a disciple of the economist John Maynard Keynes
translation: 经济学家约翰∙梅纳德∙凯恩斯的信徒

meaning: n.  碰撞； 冲突， 抵触
example: He heard tires squeal as the car braked to avoid a collision.
translation: 为避免相撞而刹车时，他听到了轮胎与地面刺耳的摩擦声。

meaning: vt. 大量制造，成批生产；捏造; n. 大量制造；
example: They manufacture the class of plastics known as thermoplastic materials.
translation: 他们生产这类被称为热塑材料的塑料制品。

meaning: n.  关节炎
example: New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers.
translation: 关节炎的新疗法可能是止痛药之外的另一种选择。

meaning: adj.  焦点的； 很重要的
example: In rural areas, the school is often the focal point for the local community.
translation: 在农村，学校常常是当地社区的活动中心。

meaning: adj. 旋转的; n.  纺纱
example: spinning machine
translation: n. [纺]纺纱机

meaning: n.  鱿鱼， 枪乌贼
example: giant squid
translation: [生]巨型乌贼；大王乌贼

meaning: n.  标语， 口号； 广告语
n.  胸部， 乳房； 胸怀， 内心
example: The dress exaggerates her wasp waist and enlarges her bosom.

meaning: adj.  可忍受的， 可容忍的； 尚好的， 过得去的
adj.  两院制的， 有两个议院的
example: The US Congress is a bicameral legislature.
translation: 美国国会是一个两院制的立法机构。

meaning: vi.  相一致， 符合； 相当于； 通信
example: Her expression is concerned but her body-language does not correspond.
translation: 她满脸关切之情，但她的肢体语言并非如此。

meaning: n. 刺激；激励；马刺; vt.  激励， 鼓舞； 刺激， 促进
example: spur gear
translation: n. [机]正齿轮

meaning: n.  方式， 形式； 风格； 时尚
example: The bicycle reigned supreme as Britain's most popular mode of transport.
translation: 当时自行车是英国最流行的交通工具。

meaning: adj.  后部的， 后面的; vt. 养育，抚养，培养；饲养; n. 后部，后方；臀部
example: Those electing to smoke will be seated at the rear.
translation: 那些想吸烟的人将坐在后排。

meaning: vi.  消逝， 流逝
example: A hundred long years must still elapse before Englishman could hear the name of Oliver Cromwell.
translation: 离英国人听到奥利弗·克伦姆威尔的名字还有一百年之久呢.

meaning: n.  对称； 相似， 相仿
example: axial symmetry
translation: 轴对称性

meaning: n.  昆虫， 虫
example: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.
translation: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。

meaning: vt.  补充， 补足， 使完善； 与…相配; n.  补充物， 补足物； 足数， 足额； 补足语
example: Nutmeg, parsley and cider all complement the flavour of these beans well.
translation: 肉豆蔻、西芹和苹果酒都能很好地突出这些豆子的味道。

meaning: v.  具有资格， 合格； 有权； 限定， 修饰
vi.  预示
example: It's an ominous development that may bode ill for the Russian parliament.
translation: 进展很不顺利，对俄罗斯议会来说这可能是个坏兆头。

meaning: adv.  已， 已经
example: He was already asleep in the bed, which smelled faintly of mildew.
translation: 他已经在略带霉味的床上睡着了。

meaning: n.  普韦布洛印第安人村落； 普韦布洛人
example: He delivered one of his longest and most important speeches at Pueblo, Colorado, on September 25.
translation: 9月25日,他在科罗拉多的普韦布洛发表他最长而且最重要的演说之一.

meaning: adj.  可应用的， 可实施的； 适当的， 合适的
example: The section of the form is not applicable in your case.
translation: 表格这一部分不适合你的情况.

meaning: n.  准许进入； 入场费； 承认
example: By his own admission, he evaded taxes as a Florida real-estate speculator.
translation: 他亲口承认自己在佛罗里达从事房地产投机生意时逃过税。

meaning: vi.  黏附， 附着； 坚持； 遵守
example: All members of the association adhere to a strict code of practice.
translation: 协会的所有成员都遵守一套严格的行为规范。

meaning: n.  沉淀物， 沉积物
example: Acid phosphatase was initially contained within a continuous membrane in a sedimentable particle.
translation: 酸性磷酸酶最初包含在可沉淀颗粒的连续膜内.

meaning: adj.  发抖的， 颤抖的； 害怕的
example: "He was so good to me," she said tremulously.
translation: “他对我非常好，”她战栗地说。

meaning: adj. 杂交产生的；混合的，合成的; n.  杂交植物； 混合物， 合成物
example: A mule is a hybrid of a male donkey and a female horse.
translation: 骡子是公驴和母马交配而生的杂种动物。

meaning: n.  全景， 全貌； 概观， 综述
example: There is a superb panorama of the mountains from the hotel.
translation: 从旅馆可饱览峰峦叠嶂的雄伟景观。

meaning: adj.  能适应的； 可改编的
example: Older workers can be as adaptable and quick to learn as anyone else.
translation: 较年长的工人的适应能力和学习速度有时并不亚于其他任何人。

meaning: adj. 当代的；
v. 嘲笑，嘲弄；模仿；蔑视，; n.  模拟考试
example: He screwed his face into an expression of mock pain.
translation: 他面部扭曲，假装疼痛。

meaning: n.  可信性， 真实性； 信任； 信念
example: Historical evidence lends credence to his theory.
translation: 史学根据使他的理论更为可信。

meaning: n. 齿轮，传动装置；挡；设备; vt.  调节， 使适应
example: There wasn't enough room in the baggage compartment for all the gear.
translation: 行李舱没有足够的空间放下所有的工具。

meaning: vt.  推动， 促进
example: The new trade agreement should facilitate more rapid economic growth.
translation: 新贸易协定应当会加快经济发展。

meaning: vt.  抢夺， 抢掠； 剥夺， 使失去
example: They rob us, they infringe our rights, they kill us.
translation: 他们劫掠我们，侵犯我们的权利，对我们实施杀戮。

meaning: n.  杆， 棒
example: The rod bent double, the reel shrieked and ratcheted.
translation: 操作杆进一步弯曲，线轴发出刺耳的吱吱声。

meaning: n.  鱼卵
example: He joined Sanders Roe, moving on later to become General Manager.
translation: 他加入了桑德斯·罗公司，后来一路晋升至总经理。

meaning: vi.  颤动， 抖动; n. 颤抖；箭筒
example: Mack made his voice quiver with fear on these last two words.
translation: 麦克说出最后这两个字时，吓得声音颤抖。

meaning: vt.  包住
example: The original plan was to encase a small amount of a radioactive substance in a protective steel container.
translation: 原先计划是要将少量的放射性物质封存在一个钢质防护罩中。

meaning: v.  打电报， 发电报; n. 电报；电报机
example: daily telegraph
translation: 每日电讯报

meaning: v.  失望， 扫兴
example: Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
translation: 她决定取消这场音乐会，肯定会使她的歌迷失望。

meaning: adj.  反叛的， 叛逆的； 叛乱的
example: From childhood, he was evidently at once rebellious and precocious.
translation: 从儿时起，他就明显地既叛逆又早熟。

meaning: v.  有光泽; n. 光泽，色泽；亮光漆；注解
example: Some foreign governments appear happy to gloss over continued human rights abuses.
translation: 一些外国政府似乎很乐于掩盖不断出现的侵犯人权现象。

meaning: n. 配给量，定量；给养，口粮; vt.  配给， 定量供应
example: We all had to queue up for our ration books.
translation: 我们都得排队领取定量配给票证薄。

meaning: n.  构造， 结构； 建筑物
example: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: v.  预言， 预测
example: The test can accurately predict what a bigger explosion would do.
translation: 该试验能准确地预测一次更大爆炸的威力。

meaning: vt. 丢弃，倾倒；抛弃；推卸；倾销; n.  垃圾场
example: I thought he was going to dump me for another girl.
translation: 我以为他要为了另一个女孩而和我分手。

meaning: adj.  普遍的， 全体的； 通用的， 万能的； 宇宙的， 全世界的
example: universal joint
translation: 万向节；万向接头

meaning: adj.  主观的， 个人的
example: Our preliminary results suggest that people do subjectively find the speech clearer.
translation: 我们的初步结果显示，人们的确在主观上感觉演讲表达得更清晰明了了。

meaning: vi.  开花； 长成; n. 花
example: The cherry blossom came out early in Washington this year.
translation: 今年华盛顿的樱花开得很早。

meaning: adj. 根本的；激进的，极端的；全新的，不同凡响的; n.  激进分子； 游离基， 自由基
example: There will be a radical swing to the right or the left.
translation: 将出现极左或极右的情况。

meaning: adj. 钝的；不敏感的；直率的; vt.  使迟钝； 使减弱
example: The blunt comment made Richard laugh in spite of himself.
translation: 这番率直的话让理查德不由自主地大笑起来。

meaning: adj.  无法抗拒的， 诱人的； 不能自已的
example: I came upon an irresistible item at a yard sale.
translation: 在一次庭院拍卖会上，我偶然发现了一个忍不住想买的东西。

meaning: vi.  乱涂， 胡画
example: I often doodle when I'm on the phone.
translation: 我打电话时常常信手乱画。

meaning: adj.  直觉的
example: A positive pregnancy test soon confirmed her intuitive feelings.
translation: 阳性孕检结果很快证实了她的直觉。

meaning: adj.  细微的， 极小的； 细致入微的， 详细的; n.  分， 分钟； 一会儿， 片刻； 时刻
example: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
translation: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

meaning: n.  类比， 类推
example: The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
translation: 老师打了个比喻，把人的心脏比作水泵。

meaning: adj.  卓越的， 出众的
example: Few men have had such transcendental capacity to stir the heart of people.
translation: 很少人有如此超群出众的打动人心的才能.

meaning: v.  打旋， 旋转; n. 漩涡；螺旋形
example: We could hear the swish and gurgle of water against the hull.
translation: 我们能听到水拍打船体时的哗哗声。

meaning: n.  请求， 申请； 应用， 运用； 敷用
example: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

meaning: adj.  生产的； 能产的， 多产的； 富有成效的
example: More productive farmers have been able to provide cheaper food.
translation: 农民提高产量就能使食物更加便宜。

meaning: n.  蜂鸟
example: The hummingbird perches on a twig of the hawthorn.
translation: 小蜂鸟栖在山楂树枝上.

meaning: n.  学期
example: fall semester
translation: 秋季班，秋季学期

meaning: n.  假设， 假说； 前提
example: The results confirmed his hypothesis on the use of modal verbs.
translation: 结果证实了他的关于情态动词用法的假设.

meaning: v&n.  崩溃， 倒塌； 虚脱
example: A few days after his collapse he was sitting up in bed.
translation: 他病倒后没过几天就又能在床上坐起来了。

meaning: adj.  乏味的， 单调的； 迟钝的； 无光泽的； 萧条的； 阴沉的， 昏暗的
example: The evidence was read out to the court in a dull monotone.
translation: 证据被当庭呆板地宣读了一遍。

meaning: v.  发酵； 骚动; n.  发酵； 动乱， 骚动
example: Foods that ferment quickly in the stomach are excellent natural laxatives.
translation: 能在肠胃里迅速发酵的食物是绝佳的天然通便剂。

meaning: v.  理解， 领会； 包括， 由…组成
example: They can neither read nor write, nor can they comprehend such concepts.
translation: 他们不会读，不会写，也理解不了这样的概念。

meaning: n.  影响力， 支配力； 效力
example: They testify to the extraordinary potency of his personality.
translation: 这些事情证明了他非凡的人格魅力。

meaning: adj.  正确无误的， 精确的
example: Schools were told their exam information had to be spot-on and accurate.
translation: 各学校接到通知，要求考试信息必须准确无误。

meaning: n.  章鱼
example: He experienced nausea after eating octopus.
translation: 吃了章鱼后他感到恶心.

meaning: n.  卖淫； 出卖灵魂， 堕落； 滥用
example: Brothels, she insists, are the acceptable face of prostitution.
translation: 她坚持认为，妓院是卖淫可为人接受的一种形式。

meaning: n.  传奇故事， 传说； 传奇文学
example: His pitching was a legend among major league hitters.
translation: 他的投球在大联盟的击球员中是个传奇。

meaning: v.  解释； 改写; n. 释义
example: Parents, to paraphrase Philip Larkin, can seriously damage your health.
translation: 菲利普·拉金的意思是：父母可能会严重损害你的健康。

meaning: adj. 直立的; vt.  建立； 竖立
example: Her legs were long and fine, her hips slender, her carriage erect.
translation: 她长腿细臀，身姿笔直。

meaning: adj.  崇高的， 高贵的， 显赫的
example: She was the only woman to rise to such an exalted position.
translation: 她是唯一高升到如此显赫地位的女人。

meaning: n.  身份证明； 辨认， 鉴定
example: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
translation: 稍稍停顿了一下，他问道，“你有任何身份证明吗？”

meaning: n.  蛋白质
example: Too much protein in the diet may advance the ageing process.
translation: 饮食中摄入过量蛋白质可能会加速衰老。

meaning: adj. 每年的，一年一度的; n.  年报， 年刊， 年鉴； 一年生植物
adj. 独占的；除外的，排他的；奢华的; n.  独家新闻
example: People will always pay top dollar for something exclusive.
translation: 人们总是会为绝无仅有的东西付出高价。

meaning: v. 震动；冲突，抵触；感到不快; n.  坛子； 广口瓶
example: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
translation: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

meaning: n.  贫穷， 贫困
example: Mr Dunn's pleas of poverty are only partly justified.
translation: 邓恩先生贫穷的托词只是部分成立。

meaning: n.  常备剧目， 保留剧目； 可表演节目； 全部才能
example: Meredith D'Ambrosio has thousands of songs in her repertoire.
translation: 梅雷迪思·丹布罗西奥会唱几千首歌曲。

meaning: vi. 求助; n.  度假胜地； 手段
example: For a beach resort with a difference, try Key West.
translation: 如果想去一个与众不同的海滨度假胜地，那就去基韦斯特吧。

meaning: v.  减少； 缩小
example: Yet, as earth's other natural resources dwindle, nations eye the Antarctic as a final repository.
translation: 然而, 由于地球上其他自然资源的减少, 一些国家视南极洲为最后的宝库.

meaning: adj.  闪电般的， 快速的; n. 闪电
example: It was unbelievably dramatic as lightning crackled all round the van.
translation: 闪电在货车周围炸开时，情景异常壮观。

meaning: n. 颌，颚；
example: His jaw was broken after he was hit on the head.
translation: 他的头部受重击之后下颌骨折了。

meaning: n.  礁， 暗礁
example: coral reef
translation: 珊瑚礁

meaning: n.  边缘； 页边空白； 差数， 差额； 余地， 余裕
example: The group had a net profit margin of 30% last year.
translation: 去年，这个集团的纯利润率为30%。

meaning: n. 指甲，爪；钉; vt.  将…钉牢， 钉住
example: He fought tooth and nail to keep his job.
translation: 他竭尽全力保住自己的工作。

meaning: v. 失去光泽；玷污，败坏; n.  污点； 瑕疵
adj.  阳光照射的
vt.  精炼， 精制； 使完善； 净化， 提纯
example: We shall have to refine on our methods of advertising.
translation: 我们得进一步改进做广告的方法.

meaning: v. 增加；登上，攀登；骑上，乘上；发起，组织，开展; n.  山， 山峰； 支架， 底座
example: America has enough firepower in the area to mount sustained air strikes.
translation: 美国在该地区拥有足够的火力发动持续的空中打击。

meaning: vi.  共存
example: Pockets of affluence coexist with poverty.
translation: 少数富裕地区与贫困地区并存。

meaning: vi.  默许， 默认
example: Steve seemed to acquiesce in the decision.
translation: 史蒂夫好像默认了这个决定。

meaning: adj.  可怜的， 引起怜悯的， 令人怜惜的
example: We encountered the pathetic sight of a family packing up its home.
translation: 我们目睹了一家人正在收拾家当准备离开的凄惨景象。

meaning: n.  火鸡； 失败
example: roast turkey
translation: 烤火鸡；烧火鸡

meaning: adj.  原子的； 原子能的
example: atomic absorption
translation: 原子吸收；原子吸收作用

meaning: adv. 加班; adj.  超时的， 加班的
example: He would work overtime, without pay, to finish a job.
translation: 他会为了完成工作无偿加班。

meaning: v. 烧焦；枯萎，枯黄; n.  焦痕
example: a scorcher of a free kick
translation: 一记精准的任意球

meaning: n.  望远镜
example: Any decent shot with telescopic sights could pick us off at random.
translation: 任何借助望远镜瞄准器的像样射手都可以随意把我们逐个干掉。

meaning: n.  土墩， 土丘； 堆， 垛
example: The table was a mound of paper and books.
translation: 桌上堆满了文件和书。

meaning: n.  有教养， 文雅
example: He took her hand with discreet gentility.
translation: 他温文尔雅地牵着她的手。

meaning: vt.  谴责； 指责， 归咎； 指控， 控告
example: I hate it when people accuse us of that.
translation: 我讨厌别人就那件事指责我们。

meaning: n.  代数
example: She is fascinated by algebra while he considers it meaningless nonsense.
translation: 她对代数非常着迷，而他却认为代数毫无意义。

meaning: vt.  支持， 拥护， 赞成
example: Some teachers enthusiastically espouse the benefits to be gained from educational software.
translation: 有些教师热烈赞同可以从教学软件中得到好处的观点.

meaning: n.  前辈； 前任； 原有事物
example: He has never exhibited the self-confidence, bordering on arrogance, of his predecessor.
translation: 他从未表现出他前任的那种近乎傲慢的自信。

meaning: vt.  获得， 取得
example: Perhaps we did acquire a somewhat fuddy-duddy image in the later years.
translation: 可能在后来的几年里我们真的让人感到有些古板。

meaning: n. 手段，策略；
example: They have removed all tactical nuclear missiles that could strike Europe.
translation: 他们已经拆除所有能够袭击欧洲的战术核导弹。

meaning: adj. 值…的，价值…的，值得…的; n.  价值； 财产
example: Mr. Buck is a good and worthful man.
translation: 巴克先生是个善良可敬的人.

meaning: n.  汽车， 机动车
example: He is repairing the brake lever of an automobile.
translation: 他正在修理汽车的刹车杆.

meaning: adj.  肥沃的， 富饶的； 能结果的， 能繁殖的； 想象力丰富的
example: They used force to banish the natives from the more fertile land.
translation: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。

meaning: n.  多样性
n.  概念， 观念； 想法
example: The notion that art should be controlled by intellectuals sickened him.
translation: 他讨厌艺术应由知识分子所掌控的观点。

meaning: adj. 被监禁的，被困住的；受控制的; n.  俘虏， 战俘
example: He described the difficulties of surviving for four months as a captive.
translation: 他描述了被俘4个月里挣扎求生的艰难岁月。

meaning: n.  红利， 股息； 回报， 效益； 被除数
example: dividend payments of 50 cents a share
translation: 每股50分的股息支付

meaning: adj.  通俗的； 受欢迎的； 流行的
example: The military government has been unable to win popular support.
translation: 军政府一直未能赢得广泛的支持。

meaning: n.  恶行， 恶习； 副， 代理
example: vice president
translation: 副总统；副主席

meaning: n&vt.  尊重， 敬重
example: It was so humiliating, a terrible blow to my self-esteem.
translation: 这件事如此丢脸，深深地挫伤了我的自尊心。

meaning: vt.  超过
example: The advantages of this deal largely outweigh the disadvantages.
translation: 这笔交易的利远远大于弊。

meaning: v.  剪； 切断， 剪切
example: shear stress
translation: [物]剪应力；剪切应力

meaning: adj.  楔形的

meaning: adj.  供役使的; n. 草图，草稿；汇票；气流; vt. 起草；征募，选派

translation: 现在已经委派官员着手起草解决方案。

meaning: adj.  不情愿的， 勉强的
example: I felt loath to sully the gleaming brass knocker by handling it.
translation: 我不愿意伸手去抓那闪亮的黄铜门环，怕把它弄脏。

meaning: adj.  合成的， 综合的； 复杂的， 错综的， 难以理解的; n.  建筑群； 综合体， 集合体； 情结
example: I had a persecution complex and thought people were conspiring against me.
translation: 我有过被害情结，认为大家都在密谋暗算我。

meaning: n.  湿度； 潮湿
example: As an asthmatic, he cannot cope with the heat and humidity.
translation: 他患有哮喘病，经不起高温和潮湿。

meaning: adj.  液体的； 流动的; n. 液体，流体
example: During fever a large quantity of fluid is lost in perspiration.
translation: 发烧时，大量水分会通过排汗而丧失。

meaning: n.  小册子
example: Over a thousand copies of the pamphlet have now been given out.
translation: 现在已分发了一千多本小册子.

meaning: adj.  有益健康的
example: The Orientals use no butter. They prefer the very healthful peanut oil.
translation: 东方人不吃黄油，他们更喜欢对健康非常有益处的花生油。

meaning: vt.  安排； 假定
example: Most religions posit the existence of life after death.
translation: 大多数宗教都假定人死后生命仍存在。

meaning: adj.  华丽的， 豪华的
example: a mirror in an ornate gold frame
translation: 镶着豪华金框的镜子

meaning: n.  首府； 大都市
example: He was dazzled by the gaiety and splendour of the metropolis.
translation: 大都市的花花世界使他感到眼花缭乱.

meaning: n.  文件； 归档， 文献记录
example: I couldn't enter the country because I didn't have all the necessary documentation.
translation: 我不能入境是因为我证明文件不齐备。

meaning: vi.  激增， 迅速繁殖
example: Rabbits proliferate when they have plenty of food.
translation: 兔子有充足的食物就会繁衍得很快.

meaning: adj.  个人的， 私人的； 亲自的
example: My personal life has had to take second place to my career.
translation: 我的私人生活不得不让位于事业。

meaning: adj.  塑料的； 可塑的； 做作的， 虚伪的; n. 塑料
example: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
translation: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

meaning: v. 耽搁，延迟; n.  耽搁， 延迟
example: How much delay should we build into the plan?
translation: 我们应该为这个计划预留多少富余的时间？

meaning: n.  冲击； 攻击， 猛攻
example: The onslaught of orders should keep aircraft manufacturers busy for some time.
translation: 纷至沓来的订单应该会让飞机制造商忙碌一段时间。

meaning: adj.  短暂的， 转瞬即逝的； 临时的
example: transient stability
translation: [电]暂态稳定度

meaning: n.  坏名声， 不光彩
example: The players' behaviour on the field is likely to bring the game into disrepute .
translation: 球员在赛场上的表现很可能使这场比赛臭名远扬。

meaning: n.  木板； 政策要点， 政纲的核心
example: Frank put the first plank down and nailed it in place.
translation: 弗兰克放下第一块厚木板，把它钉在合适的位置上。

meaning: n.  全盛期
example: In its heyday , the company ran trains every fifteen minutes.
translation: 公司在最兴隆时期每隔十五分钟就开出一列火车。

meaning: v.  用海绵擦， 揩; n. 海绵；寄生虫
example: sponge cake
translation: 松糕

meaning: v.  处理， 对付； 给予； 做买卖， 经营; n. 交易，买卖；协议
n.  意大利式细面条
vt.  使隔离， 使隔绝
example: He continues to insulate his country from the contagion of foreign ideas.
translation: 他继续使本国远离外来思想的侵袭。

meaning: v.  密谋， 秘密策划， 图谋; n. 计划，方案；阴谋；体系，体制
example: He's a schemer, and now his plot struck back.
translation: 他是个阴谋家, 而现在他搞的阴谋却反过来害了他自己.

meaning: vt.  影响； 感染
example: Poor housing and family stress can affect both physical and mental health.
translation: 住房条件差、家庭压力大会影响身心两方面的健康。

meaning: v. 流走，流出；使耗尽; n.  下水道， 排水沟； 排放； 消耗
example: I drain the pasta, then I share it out between two plates.
translation: 我将意大利面滤干，然后平分到两个盘子里。

meaning: adv.  顺利地； 平稳地； 平静地
example: Sayer was delighted with the smoothness of the engine.
translation: 塞耶对发动机平稳流畅的运转很是满意。

meaning: vt.  使隔离， 使孤立
example: Political influence is being used to shape public opinion and isolate critics.
translation: 政治影响正被用来左右公众舆论，使批评家们陷于孤立。

meaning: adj.  市民的， 公民的， 平民的； 民事的； 国家的， 政府的； 文明的， 有教养的
example: The strike has taken on overtones of a civil rights campaign.
translation: 罢工带上了民权运动的意味。

meaning: adj.  随后的； 并发的
example: subsequent events
translation: 财务报表编制后发生的事项

meaning: v.  表明， 显示； 指出， 指示； 象征， 预示； 暗示， 间接提及
example: Ballpark estimates indicate a price tag of $90 million a month.
translation: 大致的估计费用为每月9,000万美元。

meaning: adj.  新陈代谢的
example: Regular exercise can increase your basal metabolic rate.
translation: 定期运动能够提高你的基础代谢率。

meaning: n.  完成， 实现； 结束
example: The repairs to the Hafner machine were near to completion.
translation: 对哈夫纳机器的修理即将结束。

meaning: vt.  包含， 容纳； 控制； 防止…蔓延
example: Our range of herbal teas contain no preservatives, colourings or artificial flavourings.
translation: 我们这一系列的药草茶不含防腐剂、色素以及人工调味品。

meaning: v.  乱扔； 使凌乱; n. 废弃物，垃圾；一窝幼崽
example: On Wednesday we cleared a beach and woodland of litter.
translation: 星期三我们清理了一块海滨林地的垃圾。

meaning: v.  缝， 做针线活； 缝补， 缝上
example: Sewage nutrients do increase algal growth in the harbour.
translation: 污水中的营养物确实会加快港口的海藻生长。

meaning: adj. 卵形的，椭圆形的; n.  卵形， 椭圆形
example: Congress is waiting to see how the Oval Office will react.
translation: 国会正观望总统方面的反应。

meaning: n.  专栏； 圆柱， 支柱； 纵队
example: She also writes a regular column for the Times Educational Supplement.
translation: 她也定期为《泰晤士报高等教育增刊》写专栏文章。

meaning: adj.  贫困的， 贫穷的
example: The town government is responsible for assistance to indigent people.
translation: 镇政府负责给穷人提供帮助.

meaning: n.  传记
example: He has written a speculative biography of Christopher Marlowe.
translation: 他写了一篇关于克里斯托弗·马洛的推测性传记。

meaning: n.  程序， 手续， 步骤
example: British Parliamentary procedure is perplexing at the best of times.
translation: 即使在最好情况下，英国议会的程序也很费解。

meaning: n. 样品，标本; vt.  抽样调查； 品尝， 体验
example: These figures were often spuriously computed by selecting particularly favorable sample groups.
translation: 这些数字往往是用错误的方法计算出来的，所用的都是特别挑选出来的对自己有利的样本组。

meaning: v.  合并， 成为一体
example: The way Swedes integrate immigrants is, she feels, 100% more advanced.
translation: 她觉得瑞典人帮助移民适应当地生活的方式百分百地更为先进。

meaning: adj. 运转中的；生效的；操作性的; n.  起作用的人
example: There are two corollaries of operant conditioning Aversion therapy and desensitization.
translation: 使事情发生动作的条件有2种推论,厌恶疗法及减敏.

meaning: n.  大提琴演奏家
example: Who can deny his stature as the world's greatest cellist?
translation: 谁能否认他是世界上最伟大的大提琴演奏家呢？

meaning: n.  申请者
example: Not every applicant had a degree.
translation: 不是所有的求职者都有学位。

meaning: adj.  使人敬畏的； 使人恐惧的
example: Graf looked in awesome form as she cruised to an easy victory.
translation: 格拉芙轻松取胜，看上去状态极佳。

meaning: n.  钦佩， 赞赏， 羡慕
example: She is full of admiration for the head and teachers.
translation: 她对校长和教师们满心钦佩。

meaning: n.  木星
example: The planet Jupiter may have no solid surface at all.
translation: 木星表面可能根本就不是固体的。

meaning: vt. 激怒；激起，引起; n.  恼怒， 生气； 怨恨
example: When he realized nobody was listening to him, he left in a fit of pique .
translation: 他发觉无人理睬他的话，就愤然离去。

meaning: adj.  行星的
example: Within our own galaxy there are probably tens of thousands of planetary systems.
translation: 在我们自己的星系里可能有数以万计的行星系。

meaning: adj.  紫外的
example: ultraviolet radiation
translation: 紫外线；紫外线照射

meaning: v.  诊断； 判断
example: He could diagnose an engine problem simply by listening.
translation: 他仅靠听就能判断发动机出了什么问题。

meaning: v.  请愿， 正式请求; n. 请愿；请愿书；诉状
example: His lawyers filed a petition for all charges to be dropped.
translation: 他的律师提请撤销所有指控。

meaning: adv.  稍微， 有点
example: I wanted to get her away to somewhere safe.
translation: 我想带她逃到一个安全的地方。

meaning: n.  邻近， 附近
example: A vicious price war between manufacturers has cut margins to the bone.
translation: 制造商之间的恶性价格战已将利润削减到了最低。

meaning: adj. 认真的；真诚的; n.  诚挚； 认真
example: It presented in satirical terms points made in earnest by Catholic writers.
translation: 它用讽刺的语言呈现了天主教作家郑重其事表明的观点。

meaning: n.  合法性； 符合逻辑
example: There are many ways of doing science validly appropriate in different situations.
translation: 在不同场合有很多种方式正当地搞科学.

meaning: n.  缺口， 裂缝
example: He edged the tool into the crevice.
translation: 他把刀具插进裂缝里.

meaning: v.  在…之前， 先于
example: He gestured to Alice to precede them from the room.
translation: 他给艾丽斯做手势，让她在他们前面离开房间。

meaning: adj.  幽默的， 滑稽的， 诙谐的
example: John Lennon found time to publish two books of his humorous prose.
translation: 约翰·列侬抽时间出版了两本幽默散文。

meaning: v.  打赌； 敢说， 确信; n. 打赌；赌注
example: Jockeys are forbidden to bet on the outcome of races.
translation: 职业赛马骑师禁止对赛马结果下注。

meaning: v.  不同， 区别
example: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world.
translation: 儿童可能无法将自己的幻想与真实世界区分开来。

meaning: v.  释放； 放； 解雇； 清偿； 履行; n.  流出物； 放电
example: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay compensation.
translation: 他被有条件地释放了，被责令支付赔偿款。

meaning: n.  缺点， 障碍， 不利之处
example: Depression is the third thing that works to my patients' disadvantage.
translation: 抑郁是威胁我的病人健康的第三大杀手。

meaning: v.  在…上抹灰泥， 厚厚地涂; n. 灰浆，灰泥，石膏
example: One of the kids was peeling plaster off the wall.
translation: 其中一个孩子在剥墙上的灰泥。

meaning: adj.  大都市的； 本土的
example: He is currently being held in a metropolitan correctional center.
translation: 他现在被关在一个大城市的改造中心。

meaning: n.  折中主义
example: The eclecticism of the designs means it is difficult to define one overall look.
translation: 这些设计中的兼收并蓄意味着难以界定一个总体的风格。

meaning: n.  垃圾， 废物； 废话， 无聊的东西； 垃圾箱
example: A bomb planted in a garbage can exploded early today.
translation: 今天早些时候，安放在垃圾箱里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

meaning: adj.  可疑的， 令人怀疑的； 不信任的， 猜疑的， 多疑的
example: The tan-coloured dog looks suspiciously like an American pit bull terrier.
translation: 这只棕黄色的狗看上去非常像美国比特犬.

meaning: v.  诉苦， 抱怨； 投诉； 控告
example: complain about
translation: 抱怨

meaning: n.  一夫多妻制， 一妻多夫制， 多配偶制
example: The Mormons, organizing themselves in response to a religious vision, practiced polygamy in all their settlements.
translation: 摩门教徒按照宗教幻想而组织起来,他们在自己的所有村落里实行一夫多妻制.

meaning: vt.  修复； 更新， 翻新
v.  调整， 调节； 适合， 适应； 校正， 校准
example: Adjust the aerial's position and direction for the best reception.
translation: 调整天线的位置和方向以达到最佳接收效果。

meaning: n.  债务； 负债情况； 罪过
example: The plan is designed to reduce some of the company's mountainous debt.
translation: 该计划旨在减少公司堆积如山的债务。

meaning: adj. 成直角的，垂直的; n.  垂直线
example: The left wing dipped until it was perpendicular to the ground.
translation: 左翼下垂至与地面成90度角。

meaning: n.  纵坐标
example: She'll show you how to co-ordinate pattern and colours.
translation: 她会教你如何搭配款式和颜色。

meaning: vt.  认为， 相信
example: I deem it advisable to purchase the shares in the railway now.
translation: 我认为现在购买铁路股票是明智的.

meaning: v.  变僵硬； 变坚定， 变强硬
example: This indicated that the fracture had initiated at the unfused butt weld in the longitudinal stiffener.
translation: 研究表明裂纹是从纵向加劲助未熔透的对接焊缝中起始的.

meaning: vt.  驱使， 强迫
example: The law can compel fathers to make regular payments for their children.
translation: 这项法律可强制父亲定期支付子女费用。

meaning: vt.  降低， 削弱； 使沮丧； 使萧条
example: The rainy days always depress me.
translation: 雨天总是使我沮丧.

meaning: n.  垂饰， 下垂物
example: My necklace has a heart pendant, but I don't wear it everyday.
translation: 我的项链有一个心形的垂饰, 但我并非每天都戴他.

meaning: vt.  克制， 抑制； 镇压， 压制
example: By pushing aside unpleasant thoughts they merely repress these thoughts.
translation: 他们对不愉快的想法不予理会，其结果仅仅是压制了这些想法。

meaning: n. 谜；谜语；难解之谜；粗筛; vt.  使布满窟窿
example: He was on a caravanning holiday.
translation: 他驾房车外出游玩去了。

meaning: vt.  通知， 告诉
example: He came to apprise us that the work had been successfully completed.
translation: 他来通知我们工作已胜利完成.

meaning: adj.  坦白的， 直率的， 直言不讳的
example: Nat is candid about the problems she is having with Steve.
translation: 娜特对她眼下和史蒂夫之间的问题毫不隐瞒。

meaning: n.  委托人， 当事人； 顾客
example: Enviros Consulting has a client base of more than 2,000 organisations worldwide.
translation: EnvirosConsulting公司在全世界拥有逾2,000家组织机构的客户群。

meaning: n.  浮游生物
example: The first organisms that reproduced sexually were free-floating plankton.
translation: 最早开始有性繁殖的生物是四处漂浮的浮游生物。

meaning: n.  转变， 变换； 改变信仰， 皈依
example: Currency-conversion costs remain one of the biggest obstacles to cross-border trade.
translation: 货币兑换成本仍是跨境贸易的最大障碍之一。

meaning: adj.  给人印象深刻的； 闪耀的； 杰出的， 卓越的
example: A brilliant shaft of sunlight burst through the doorway.
translation: 一束耀眼的阳光从门口照射进来。

meaning: adj.  实用的； 实际的； 现实的
example: After half an hour's commis-eration, we turned to more practical matters.
translation: 惺惺相惜了半个小时后，我们转而讨论一些更为实际的问题。

meaning: adj.  演绎的， 推论的
example: She didn't seem at all impressed by his deductive powers.
translation: 她似乎根本不为他的推论能力所动。

meaning: n.  呼吸
example: She could hear his ragged breathing, as if he had been running.
translation: 她能听到他不均匀的呼吸声，似乎他是跑着过来的。

meaning: adj. 被束缚的，有义务的; v.  跳跃； 弹回； 形成…的界线， 给…划界
example: They are bound to take time to readjust after a holiday.
translation: 他们肯定需要时间重新适应假期结束后的生活。

meaning: v.  衰退， 衰落； 发抖， 结巴地说； 蹒跚
example: Investment could dry up and that could cause the economy to falter.
translation: 投资可能会中断，而这会引起经济衰退。

meaning: v. 〔动物〕交配繁殖; n. 〔宠物或牲畜的〕品种
example: If they are unemployed it's bound to breed resentment.
translation: 如果他们失去工作，一定会产生怨恨。

meaning: adj.  难以理解的， 难懂的； 难捕捉的； 逃避的
example: Happiness, which had been so elusive in Henry's life, still evaded him.
translation: 亨利生活中过去一直难以捕捉的幸福仍旧与他无缘。

meaning: vt.  估价； 估量； 评价， 评定
example: An expert came to appraise the value of my antiques.
translation: 一位专家来对我的古玩作了估价.

meaning: n.  金字塔； 锥体； 金字塔形物； 金字塔式的组织
example: There rose before us the great pyramid of Gaza.
translation: 雄伟的加沙金字塔矗立在我们面前。

meaning: n.  王国， 国度； 界， 范围， 领域
example: This is a target which is surely within the realm of possibility.
translation: 这是一个完全有可能实现的目标。

meaning: vt.  避免， 规避
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: adj.  全面的； 综合的
example: There are much brighter prospects for a comprehensive settlement than before.
translation: 综合性的社区具有比以前更加光明的前景。

meaning: n.  〈总称〉随从， 随行人员
example: He was accompanied by an entourage of a dozen police officers.
translation: 他有12名警官随行。

meaning: adj. 敏捷的；及时的，迅速的; vt. 促进，推动；提示；鼓励; n.  提词， 提示
example: There are many emergencies which need prompt first aid treatment.
translation: 有很多紧急情况需要进行迅速的急救处理。

meaning: v.  开凿隧道； 挖地道; n. 隧道；地道
example: wind tunnel
translation: 风洞

meaning: adj.  精心制作的， 复杂精美的; v.  详述； 详细制订， 精心制作
vt.  履行； 实现； 符合， 具备
example: My father was very keen that I should fulfill my potential.
translation: 我父亲热切地希望我能够发挥出自身的潜力。

meaning: adj.  先进的； 高级的， 高等的； 晚期的， 后期的
example: The way Swedes integrate immigrants is, she feels, 100% more advanced.
translation: 她觉得瑞典人帮助移民适应当地生活的方式百分百地更为先进。

meaning: n.  产量； 输出； 产生
example: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.
translation: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

meaning: n.  劳累； 疲劳
example: She continued to have severe stomach cramps, aches, fatigue, and depression.
translation: 她仍然患有严重的胃痉挛，感觉疼痛、疲乏、抑郁。

meaning: adj.  不活动的； 怠惰的
example: The satellite had been inactive since its launch two years ago.
translation: 该卫星自从两年前发射以来一直没起作用。

meaning: n.  调制解调器

meaning: v.  加冕； 使圆满， 使完美; n. 王冠；花冠

meaning: v.  打听， 询问

meaning: adj.  和谐的， 协调的； 和睦的， 融洽的

meaning: v.  运转， 开动； 动手术； 经营， 管理； 起作用

meaning: n.  裁定； 判断； 意见

meaning: n.  教条， 教义； 学说
example: The doctrine of karma is inseparably linked with reincarnation.
translation: 业的教义与轮回转世说紧密相关。

meaning: n.  模板， 样板
example: No one carrying arms is allowed within the precincts of a temple.
translation: 携带武器者不得进入神殿的界域。

meaning: n.  比例； 部分； 均衡， 相称

meaning: n. 水晶；晶体，

translation: 如果你是比利·克里斯托的影迷，你会喜爱这部影片。

meaning: n.  先知； 预言者； 拥护者， 鼓吹者

translation: 他深信自己是当代先知。

meaning: n. 追求；

translation: 莫罗在个人五公里追逐赛中获得金牌。

meaning: n.  牛仔， 牧牛工
example: Do you know the legend of the Cowhand and Weaver Maid ?
translation: 你知道牛郎和织女的传说吗？

meaning: n. 盘子；板条，板材；号码牌; vt.  镀， 电镀； 覆盖
example: Garnish the plate with whipped cream rosettes and fresh fruits.
translation: 用玫瑰花形的掼奶油和新鲜的水果作配菜点缀盘子。

meaning: n.  比赛； 锦标赛
adj.  无情的， 残酷的， 冷酷的； 坚决的， 彻底的
example: Successfully merging two banks requires a fast and ruthless attack on costs.
translation: 成功合并两家银行需要坚决快速地着手解决费用问题。

meaning: vt. 吸引，诱惑; n.  诱惑力； 诱饵
example: The lure of rural life is proving as strong as ever.
translation: 事实证明，乡村生活的魅力丝毫未减。

meaning: n.  明喻
example: the similitude between humans and gorillas
translation: 人类和大猩猩的相像

meaning: n.  炎症， 发炎
example: Aloe may have an analgesic effect on inflammation and minor skin irritations.
translation: 芦荟可能对发炎以及轻微的皮肤炎症具有镇痛作用。

meaning: v.  溶解； 清除； 解散， 结束

translation: 卡夫威胁要解散议会并举行选举。

meaning: n. 偏见，成见; vt.  使产生偏见； 使…受到损害， 有损于
example: Rowe does a very clever riff on the nature of prejudice.
translation: 罗就偏见的本质讲了一番很精辟的话。

meaning: v.  把…放置成一角度； 使带上倾向性; n. 角；角度，立场，观点
example: The helicopter turned at an awful angle before righting itself.
translation: 直升机在恢复平稳之前倾斜得很厉害。

meaning: adj. 移来的，移民的; n.  移民； 侨民
example: In recent months many conservative politicians have jumped on the anti-immigrant bandwagon.
translation: 最近几个月，很多保守政客都搭上了“反移民”这班车。

meaning: adj.  急迫的， 紧迫的
example: Candidates are urgently sought for the post of Conservative party chairman.
translation: 保守党主席的职位急寻候选人。

meaning: adj. 眼的；视觉的；光学上的; n.  光学仪器

translation: 这其中的原因在于视神经是大脑的一部分。

meaning: n. 捆，束；包袱; vt.  收集， 归拢； 把…塞入

translation: 即使把价钱平摊成6份，每人也还是要花一大笔钱。

meaning: n.  大豆
example: Yeast and lactobacillus were as starters for production of sour soymilk liquor.
translation: 对酵母菌与乳酸菌混合发酵制备酸豆浆酒的工艺进行了研究.

meaning: n.  咨询； 辅导

translation: 我建议我们开始缩短咨询服务的时间。

translation: 恐怕他们会破译盟军的密码。

meaning: n.  作曲家， 作曲者
example: After his education, Goldschmidt became a pupil of the composer Franz Schreker.
translation: 学业结束后，戈尔德施米特成了作曲家弗朗兹·施雷克尔的学生。

meaning: vi.  统治， 支配， 占优势

translation: 他想创造一个以伊斯兰教戒律为主导的社会。

meaning: adj.  有孔的， 多孔的； 能渗透的
example: Swimming is helpful for bones that are porous and weak.
translation: 游泳有助于改善骨质疏松和骨骼脆弱。

meaning: adj.  系统的， 体系的
example: The way he works isn't very systematical.
translation: 他的工作方法不是很有条理.

meaning: adj.  流行的， 时髦的; n. 时尚，风气，流行
example: Although Catherine wears designer clothes, she still looks nothing like a voguey person.
translation: 尽管凯瑟琳穿着名家设计的衣服, 她还是不像个时髦的人.

meaning: adj.  可燃的， 易燃的
example: Don't smoke near combustible materials.
translation: 别在易燃的材料附近吸烟.

meaning: v.  再申请； 再利用
example: And they must reply reapply for their words the awards each semester.
translation: 并且他们每个学期必须重新应用奖金.

meaning: adv.  同样； 也
example: These requests are ignored. His requests for rent are likewise sometimes ignored.
translation: 这些要求被置之不理。他关于支付租金的要求有时也同样未被理睬。

meaning: n.  咸肉， 熏肉
example: Who brings up the baby and who brings home the bacon?
translation: 是谁抚养孩子的，是谁赚钱养家的？

meaning: v. 躲藏；掩藏；掩盖; n.  兽皮
example: You feel an animal panic to run and hide.
translation: 你会感到一种本能的恐惧而想要去逃避。

meaning: n.  多角形， 多边形
example: A polygon with ten sides is a decagon.
translation: 十条边的形状叫十边形。

meaning: adj.  法人的， 公司的； 共同的， 全体的
example: Increasingly, corporate clients are seeking to outsource the management of their facilities.
translation: 越来越多的公司客户寻求将设施的管理外包出去。

meaning: adj.  说明用法的; n. 教导；
example: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
translation: 这一方法给教学带来了活力，也使知识的吸收变得容易了。

meaning: v&n.  拖着脚走； 洗； 蒙混； 搅乱

translation: 推卸；摆脱

meaning: vt.  使迷恋； 使糊涂

translation: 这是些使孩子们愚蠢的玩具.

meaning: adj. 坚定的；稳定的；不变的，持续的; n.  常数， 恒量
example: There was constant jeering and interruption from the floor.
translation: 议员席上不断有人在嘲讽和打岔.

meaning: adj.  有争议的
example: It is debatable whether or not antibiotics would make any difference.
translation: 抗生素能否起到什么作用还无法定论。

meaning: n. 挽歌，悼词; vt.  抱怨； 痛惜

translation: 孩子们哀悼母亲的去世.

meaning: n. 暴行；
example: The decision provoked outrage from women and human rights groups.
translation: 这一决定激起了妇女和人权组织的强烈愤慨。

meaning: v.  散播， 传播； 漫射， 扩散; adj.  扩散的， 漫射的； 冗长的

translation: 一道冰冷的光线透过天窗漫射进来。

meaning: adj.  公共的， 共享的； 社区的

translation: 在该国不同的地区发生了群体暴力事件。

meaning: v. 分开，分裂；撕裂；分担，分享；断绝关系，分手; n.  裂口； 分化， 分裂

meaning: adj.  传染性的； 有感染力的

translation: 安东尼奥对食品赏心悦目这一方面的热情非常有感染性。

meaning: vt.  使浸没于； 使沉浸于， 使陷入

translation: 把布浸在染料里20分钟.

meaning: n.  出版， 发行； 出版物； 公布， 发表

translation: 阿拉斯加的周报《苔原时报》本周停刊了。

meaning: v.  对…有强烈的欲望; n. 性欲；强烈的欲望

meaning: adj.  嘲笑的， 讥讽的

translation: 它能帮我把我一直保持的水份全都挤出来.

meaning: v.  播种， 种； 灌输； 煽动

meaning: n.  石油

translation: 石油工程师规划并管理石油的提炼。

meaning: n.  生手， 新手； 新信徒
example: I'm a novice at these things, Lieutenant. You're the professional.
translation: 中尉，做这些事情我是新手，你是行家。

meaning: n.  画像技法； 肖像， 画像

translation: 我请人给自己画张肖像.

meaning: adj.  不重要的； 外围的
example: Science is peripheral to that debate.
translation: 科学并非那场辩论的重点。

meaning: adj. 引入的；新任的；正来临的，刚收到的; n. 进来，到来；

translation: 他们声称击落了一枚来犯的导弹。

meaning: adj.  无生命的； 无生气的
example: He thought of the baby almost as an inanimate object.
translation: 他认为婴儿几乎就是毫无生命的物体。

meaning: adj. 平坦的；等高的; n. 水平；高度；级别; vt.  夷平， 使平坦

translation: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

meaning: vt.  保护， 维护； 保存， 保养

translation: 诺曼征服之后，这片森林成为了皇家狩猎区。

meaning: adj.  茂盛的

translation: 不是园艺大师也可以把自己的家里装点得绿意盎然。

meaning: vt.  建立， 设立； 安置， 使定居； 确定， 证实

translation: 我们正努力在这些团体和金融机构之间建立联系。

meaning: adj. 巨大的; n.  猛犸， 毛象

translation: 这项艰巨的任务在18个月内完成了。

meaning: adj.  相关的， 有关的； 中肯的， 贴切的； 有价值的， 有意义的

translation: 我们试图使政治活动更加贴近年轻人。

meaning: v.  威慑， 阻止

translation: 所有的门都用砖堵了起来，防止破坏分子闯入。

meaning: adj. 合成的，综合的；人造的

translation: 科学价值的向度研究是一个崭新的综合性跨学科领域研究.

meaning: v.  宣布， 声明； 显示

translation: 他的长相非常孩子气,显得性情很好且诚实坦率.

meaning: v.  捆成一束； 聚集; n. 簇，束，捆；帮，伙
example: Joseph watched a shady-looking bunch playing cards aboard a Mississippi steamer.
translation: 约瑟夫看到一群可疑的人在密西西比河的一艘轮船上打牌。

meaning: v. 震动，颠簸；震惊; n.  震动， 颠簸； 震惊； 一阵强烈的感情等
example: A violent explosion seemed to jolt the whole ground.
translation: 剧烈的爆炸好像要把整个地面都掀起来。

meaning: vt.  破坏， 危及
example: The dispute could jeopardize the negotiations.
translation: 那一争论可能会使谈判处于险境。

meaning: n.  地方主义， 乡土性
example: He wanted to escape from the provincialism of the small university where he taught.
translation: 他所执教是一所规模很小的大学,他想摆脱存在于其中的地方主义桎梏.

meaning: adj.  占优势的， 主导的， 支配的； 显著的， 盛行的
example: Yellow is the predominant colour this spring in the fashion world.
translation: 黄色是今春时装界的流行颜色。

meaning: vt.  驯养， 驯化； 使精于家务， 使喜爱家居

translation: 有些男人很难做好家务活。

meaning: n.  食谱； 方法， 秘诀， 诀窍
example: Each recipe specifies the size of egg to be used.
translation: 每种菜谱都具体规定了所用鸡蛋的大小。

meaning: vi. 栖息; n.  栖息处， 鸟巢
vt.  分配； 分派
example: Talk things through in stages. Do not accuse or apportion blame.
translation: 把事情按部就班地讲清楚。不要责难或归罪于人。

meaning: adj.  精神的； 智力的； 精神健康的
example: The woman will be confined to a mental institution.
translation: 这个女人将被关进精神病院。

meaning: adj.  体面的； 适当的， 得体的； 令人满意的； 正派的
example: I went to Brooks Brothers and bought myself a decent shirt.
translation: 我去布鲁克斯兄弟专卖店给自己买了一件体面的衬衫。

meaning: adv.  漂浮地; adj. 漂浮的；有偿债能力的，能维持下去的
example: They talked modestly of their valiant efforts to keep the tanker afloat.
translation: 他们说起自己设法使油轮漂浮的英勇之举时非常谦虚。

meaning: v.  转变， 改变； 交换， 掉换; n. 开关，电闸；转换，改变；枝条，鞭子

translation: 政府关心的首要问题是扩充军队及辅助队伍。

example: "What do you want!" she whispered savagely. "Get out."
translation: “你想干什么！”她粗野地低语道，“滚开。”

meaning: adj.  可行的， 可实施的； 可生长发育的
example: With their aid a vital viaduct on the main Athens railway line was destroyed.
translation: 在他们的帮助下,破坏了雅典铁路干线上的一座主要高架桥梁.

meaning: adj.  面部的； 面部用的
example: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
translation: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

meaning: n.  副产品； 副作用， 意外结果

example: I can console myself with the fact that I'm not alone.
translation: 不是只有我一个人才这样，我可以用这一事实来安慰自己。

meaning: adj.  吉兆的， 吉利的； 幸运的

translation: 新学年的开门红

meaning: v.  碰巧， 偶然发生； 冒…的险; n. 机会；可能性，偶然性；偶然的事

translation: 他们在大学偶遇，最后结了婚。

meaning: n.  药物治疗； 药物

translation: 他患有癫痫，但是拒绝服药治疗。

meaning: adj.  苛求的， 难满足的； 需要高的， 费力的

translation: 这车坐上去很舒服，但需要高超的驾驶技术。

meaning: v. 钻，打眼；训练; n.  钻； 训练
example: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.
translation: 钻孔已塞上了塞子。

meaning: n.  必然的结果； 推断

translation: 政府决心打击暴力犯罪，直接导致了囚犯数量的增多。

meaning: v.  变魔术， 变戏法； 召唤

translation: 到1920年，福克斯和环球已经声名显赫。

meaning: v.  承认， 确认； 对…表示感谢

translation: 你得承认我们生活在一个有种族偏见的社会中。

meaning: n.  感受器； 受体
example: These may bind to receptor molecules on the surfaces of cells.
translation: 这些可能会在细胞表面和受体分子结合在一起。

meaning: adj.  静止的； 休眠的； 隐匿的
example: The virus remains dormant in nerve tissue until activated.
translation: 病毒潜伏于神经组织里直到被激活。

meaning: v.  游说; n. 休息室，大厅；游说团

translation: 工会不但攻击该计划，而且还扬言要游说议员反对它。

meaning: n.  脉搏， 脉率； 脉冲
example: There was no breathing or pulse and he was lifeless.
translation: 没有呼吸，也没有脉搏，他已经死了。

meaning: adj.  描述性的， 叙述的

translation: 小说中的描写性段落

meaning: n.  复兴； 改造， 再建
example: Work began on the reconstruction of the road.
translation: 道路的重建工作开始了。

translation: 旅游火了，工作机会多了，个人收入涨了。

meaning: n.  鲑鱼， 大马哈鱼
example: Poachers have been netting salmon to supply the black market.
translation: 盗猎者一直在捕捞大麻哈鱼到黑市上去卖。

meaning: n.  花束； 香味， 芬芳
example: The 1985 vintage has a stronger bouquet and slight caramelly flavour.
translation: 这种1985年酿制的陈年佳酿味道更醇厚，带有一种淡淡的焦糖甜味。

meaning: adj.  本能的
example: The relationship between a parent and a child is instinctual and stems from basic human nature.
translation: 父母与孩子的关系是天生的，源于基本的人性。

meaning: vt.  束缚， 限制
example: The police used horses to constrain the crowd from violence.
translation: 警察骑着马阻止那群人诉诸暴力.

meaning: n.  女皇， 皇后
example: Her Chinese friends referred to the Empress as their venerable ancestor.
translation: 她的中国朋友们说这位女皇是他们值得敬仰的祖先。

meaning: n.  提供消息或情报的人， 线人； 提供资料的人； 合作者
example: The journalist did not want to reveal the identity of his informant.
translation: 那个新闻工作者不想透露消息提供人的身分.

meaning: n.  腱
example: achilles tendon
translation: 跟腱

meaning: adj.  暂时的， 过渡的; n. 间歇，过渡期间
example: She was sworn in as head of an interim government in March.
translation: 她3月份宣誓就任过渡政府首脑。

meaning: n.  证词； 证据， 证明
example: Testiness crept into my voice.
translation: 我的话音渐渐带上了怒气.

meaning: vt.  实施， 生效， 执行； 强迫， 迫使
example: Game wardens were appointed to enforce hunting laws in New Hampshire.
translation: 狩猎监督官被派到新罕布什尔州去执行狩猎法令。

meaning: vi. 闪烁，闪耀; n.  灿烂的光辉； 诱惑力， 魅力
example: Gary Glitter, 48, revealed the secret of his youthful looks.
translation: 48岁的加里·格利特透露了他青春永驻的秘密。

meaning: adj.  注定的； 以…为目的地的
example: destined for
translation: 驶往；去往

meaning: adj.  易碎的； 脆弱的； 纤巧的； 虚弱的
example: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
translation: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

meaning: adj.  煞费苦心的， 勤勉的
example: Forensic experts carried out a painstaking search of the debris.
translation: 法医专家对残骸进行了极其仔细的搜索。

meaning: n.  社会学
example: sociology of law
translation: 法律社会学

meaning: adj.  结实的， 强壮的； 肥胖的； 顽强的
adj.  巨大的， 庞大的
example: The gigantic natural harbour of Poole is a haven for boats.
translation: 巨型天然港普尔港是船只的避风港。

meaning: adj.  明显的， 清楚的； 确实的； 截然不同的
example: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
translation: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

meaning: vi. 觅食；搜寻; n.  草料， 饲料
example: They were forced to forage for clothing and fuel.
translation: 他们不得不去寻找衣服和燃料。

meaning: adj.  游牧的； 流浪的
example: Nomadic tribes wander these deserts.
translation: 游牧部落在这些荒漠上游牧.

meaning: n.  地质学； 地质概况
example: We went on a geology field trip.
translation: 我们去进行地质野外考察。

meaning: v.  用篱笆围； 避免直接回答; n. 树篱；防止损失的措施；防备
example: Hawker Siddeley tried to hedge its bets by diversifying into other fields.
translation: 霍克·西德利试图通过在其他领域进行多样化发展来规避风险。

meaning: n.  蜻蜓
example: Inbry caught me a dragonfly.
translation: 英布里给我抓了一只蜻蜓.

meaning: adj.  知道的； 意识到的
example: He became more aware of the things that started that tension off.
translation: 他越来越清楚地认识到引起紧张局势的原因。

meaning: adj.  符合条件的， 合格的； 适合的
example: Millions of householders are eligible to claim the new council tax benefit.
translation: 数百万房主都有资格申请新的市政税优惠。

meaning: n. 闹钟；警报; vt.  使惊恐； 使担心
example: Any escape, once it's detected, sets off the alarm.
translation: 一旦发现有泄漏，警报就会响起来。

meaning: n.  杂草； 水草
example: weed control
translation: 除草；杂草防除；野草控制

meaning: adj. 巴比伦的；奢华的; n.  巴比伦人
example: The Babylonian captivity civilized them and consolidated them.
translation: 巴比伦的囚虏使他们走向文明,并且统一起来.

meaning: n.  冰川， 冰河
example: The best bit was walking along the glacier.
translation: 最好的部分就是沿着冰川走。

meaning: n.  最后通牒
example: The other is Ultimo , intent on trying to stop Vice from wreaking more havoc.
translation: 另一个叫做上月,正试图阻止邪恶发泄自己的愤怒的破坏行为.

meaning: n.  一大群人； 游牧部落
example: Why should she feed this horde of hungry men?
translation: 她干吗要养活这群饿痨鬼 呢 ?

meaning: n.  降雨； 降雨量
example: Victoria Falls has had above average levels of rainfall this year.
translation: 维多利亚瀑布今年的降雨量超过了平均水平。

meaning: n.  种族主义， 种族歧视
n.  方向， 方位； 定位； 培训； 情况介绍
example: They give their new employees a day or two of perfunctory orientation.
translation: 他们对新员工进行了一两天例行公事的培训。

meaning: adj.  奢侈的， 奢华的
example: Here is your opportunity to acquire a luxurious one bedroom home.
translation: 现在正是购买一套豪华一居室住房的机会。

meaning: v.  做动作， 示意; n. 运动，移动；动作；提议，动议
example: She made a fanning motion, pretending to cool herself off.
translation: 她做了个扇风的动作，假装想让自己凉快一点。

meaning: adj. 懒散的；没有工作的，闲散的；空闲的；漫无目的的；无用的，无效的; v.  无所事事， 虚度
example: Brian kept up the idle chatter for another five minutes.
translation: 布赖恩又絮絮地唠叨了5分钟。

meaning: n.  困境， 苦境
example: The country's economic plight is strangling its scientific institutions.
translation: 该国的经济困境阻碍了其科研机构的工作进展。

meaning: v.  匹配; n. 比赛；对手
example: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
translation: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

meaning: n.  过错， 过失； 缺点， 弱点； 断层
example: The aircraft made an unscheduled landing after developing an electrical fault.
translation: 飞机由于发生电力故障而作了临时降落。

meaning: n&vi.  相互作用， 相互影响
example: the interplay between politics and the environment
translation: 政治与环境的相互影响

meaning: v.  招呼； 高呼； 赞扬， 称颂； 下冰雹; n. 冰雹；一阵
example: The victim was hit by a hail of bullets.
translation: 受害者被一阵弹雨击中。

meaning: n.  重音； 口音； 重音符号; vt.  重读
example: There is often a strong accent on material success.
translation: 经常大力强调物质成就。

meaning: adj.  被动的， 消极的； 被动语态的
example: Even passive acceptance of the regime was a kind of collaboration.
translation: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。

meaning: adj.  恶心的； 令人作呕的， 令人厌恶的
example: If the patient is poorly nourished, the drugs make them feel nauseous.
translation: 如果患者进食欠佳，药物会让他们感觉作呕。

meaning: v.  分裂， 成碎片; n.  碎片， 断片
example: This was only a fragment of a long conversation with John.
translation: 这仅仅是与约翰长谈的一个片断.

meaning: n.  花岗岩， 花岗石
example: Here the Nile broadens out between the huge granite boulders.
translation: 尼罗河在此处变宽，从两块花岗岩巨石间穿过。

meaning: n.  回答； 反应， 响应
example: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: adj.  使人耳目一新的； 提神的， 使人精神振作的
example: What is refreshing is the author's easy, conversational style.
translation: 让人耳目一新的是作者轻松自如的会话式写作风格。

meaning: adj.  遗忘的； 未注意的， 不知不觉的
example: Llewelyn appeared oblivious of his surroundings.
translation: 卢埃林看起来没有注意到他周围的情况。

meaning: n.  种类； 范畴
example: The judges could not decide which category it belonged in.
translation: 评委们无法判定它属于哪一类。

meaning: adj.  竞争的， 对抗的; vt. 与…相匹敌，比得上; n. 竞争对手
example: Leaders of some rival factions signed a peace agreement last week.
translation: 上周，一些敌对派系领导人签订了和平协议。

meaning: n. 药房；配药学，药剂学；制药业；一批备用药品
example: Modern pharmacy has solved the problem of sleeplessness.
translation: 现代制药学已经解决了失眠问题.

meaning: adj. 辛苦的；劳苦的；费力的
v. 抹去，抹掉；使自己不受人注意
adj. 塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的; n. 塑料制品；整形；可塑体
example: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
translation: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

meaning: n. 主张；拥护；辩护
example: I support your advocacy of free trade.
translation: 我支持你自由贸易的主张。

meaning: n. 杂乱，混乱; v. 使凌乱；胡乱地填满
example: Caroline prefers her worktops to be clear of clutter.
translation: 卡罗琳喜欢把厨房台面收拾得整整齐齐。

meaning: n. 职业，专业；声明，宣布，表白
example: The attitude of the medical profession is very much more liberal now.
translation: 现在，医务人员的态度开明多了。

meaning: adj. 吝啬的；过于节俭的；质量差的
example: Many scrollbars are quite parsimonious in doling out information to users.
translation: 很多滚动条都很吝啬,给用户传递的信息太少.

meaning: n. 磷
example: Annuals, as a general rule , are very responsive to phosphorus fertilization.
translation: 通常说来,对一年生植物施用磷肥是相当有效的.

meaning: n. 喝彩；亡命徒; v. 喝彩; int. 好极了
example: Alpha-Bravo-Zulu 643 to Saltezar, do you read me? Over.
translation: 阿尔法－布拉沃－祖鲁643呼叫萨德扎，能听到我的声音吗？完毕。

meaning: n. 碱；可溶性无机盐; adj. 碱性的
example: The valence atom of an alkali - metal atom has two states.
translation: 碱金属原子的价原子具有两种能态.

meaning: v. 增加；增大; n. 增加；增大
example: The government'sfirst concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
translation: 政府关心的首要问题是扩充军队及辅助队伍。

meaning: adj. 喜欢吵架的；好争论的
example: Benedict had been a wild boy and a quarrelsome young man.
translation: 贝内迪克特小时候野性难驯，年轻时又爱与人争吵。

meaning: v. 鼓起；举起；使隆起
example: They have profaned the long upheld traditions of the Church.
translation: 他们亵渎了教会长期以来的传统。

meaning: adj. 无责任的；莫名其妙的；不可理解的
example: And then, unaccountably, she giggled.
translation: 接着，她莫名其妙地咯咯笑了起来。

meaning: v. 猜测；推测; n. 推测；猜度
example: I realized I had to surmount the language barrier.
translation: 我意识到我不得不克服语言障碍。

meaning: n. 名人；名声
example: He was more than a footballing superstar, he was a celebrity.
translation: 他不仅仅是足球场上的巨星，也是一位社会名流。

meaning: adj. 勤劳的；艰苦的；费劲的
example: They had the laborious task of cutting down the huge tree.
translation: 他们接受了伐大树的艰苦工作.

meaning: adj. 暴躁的；任性的；难以取悦的
example: His critics say he's just being silly and petulant.
translation: 批评家说他就是愚蠢和任性。

meaning: adj. 迅速的；会飞的；飞行的; n. (Volant)人名；(法)沃朗
v. 使退化；恶化; adj. 退化的；堕落的; n. 堕落的人
example: Will too much freedom make them degenerate?
translation: 太多的自由会令他们堕落 吗 ?

meaning: adj. 空想的，妄想的；荒唐的
example: His Utopia is not a chimerical commonwealth but a practical improvement on what already exists.
translation: 他的乌托邦不是空想的联邦,而是对那些已经存在的联邦事实上的改进.

meaning: n. 斜坡；倾斜；斜率；扛枪姿势; v. 倾斜；逃走
example: slope stability
translation: 坡面稳定性

meaning: vt. 损伤；损害; n. 损伤；危害；损害
n. 一代；产生；一代人；生殖
example: A new generation of scientists became fascinated by dinosaurs.
translation: 新一代科学家对恐龙研究着了迷。

meaning: n. 旅；大部队；队列; v. 把…编成旅；把…编成队
example: We gave the gate money to the St John Ambulance brigade.
translation: 我们将门票收入都捐给了圣约翰急救队。

meaning: v. 交替；轮流; adj. 交替的；轮流的; n. 替换物
example: The three acts will alternate as headliners throughout the tour.
translation: 这3个节目将在整个巡回演出中轮流打头牌。

meaning: adj. 每三年的；连续三年的; n. 三年生植物
example: The games occur triennially.
translation: 运动会每叁年举行一次.

meaning: v. 指责，非难；抨击；反驳；对…表示怀疑
example: Rose and I differ somewhat in our definition of art. Not to impugn your work, sir.
translation: 我们在艺术上的见解颇有分歧,我不是在批评你的作品.

meaning: n. 测高仪，高度计
example: Fixed cistern barometers are used as a standard for checking altimeter.
translation: 固定槽式气压计可以作为标准件去检验测高计.

meaning: n. 正统；正教；正统说法
example: As pope he won wide support for his strict orthodoxy.
translation: 作为教皇他严守正统教义，赢得了广泛的支持。

meaning: n. 汽油
example: Unleaded gasoline rose more than a penny a gallon.
translation: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了1分多。

meaning: n. 障碍；妨碍；妨害；阻碍物
example: To be honest, she was more of a hindrance than a help.
translation: 说实在的，她没帮上忙，反而成了累赘。

meaning: v. 炫耀；飘扬; n. 炫耀；飘扬；招展
example: One secret he learned very early on was not to flaunt his success.
translation: 他很早就学到的一个秘诀就是不要夸耀自己的成功。

meaning: n. 演变；进化论；进展
example: the evolution of the human species
translation: 人类的进化

meaning: n. 通行费；代价；钟声；伤亡人数; v. 征收；敲钟
example: death toll
translation: 死亡人数

meaning: adj. 肯定的；独断的；坚定而自信的
example: Be assertive and spell out exactly how you feel.
translation: 要自信点儿，把自己的感受讲清楚。

meaning: n. n中值，中位数；三角形中线；梯形中位线; adj. 中值的；中央的
example: Where the speed distribution is skew, it's better to quote the median speed.
translation: 在速度分布是扭曲的情况下, 最好用中值速度.

meaning: adj. 显著的；突出的；跳跃的; n. 凸角；突出部分
example: Chronic fatigue is also one of the salient features of depression.
translation: 慢性疲劳也是抑郁症的显著特点之一。

meaning: adj. 建设性的；推定的；构造上的；有助益的
example: The Prime Minister has promised that Israel will play a constructive role.
translation: 首相承诺以色列将发挥积极的作用。

meaning: n. 诅咒；革出教门；被诅咒者；令人厌恶的人
example: Her views are ( an ) anathema to me.
translation: 她的观点真叫我讨厌.

meaning: adj. 倒退的；退化的；次序颠倒的; v. 逆行；倒退；退步; adv. 倒退地；向后地
example: The closure of the factory is a retrograde step .
translation: 工厂的关闭是一大退步。

meaning: adv. 无论什么地方；究竟在哪里; conj. 无论在哪里；无论什么情况下
example: He has not wherewith to pay his debts.
translation: 他无钱还债.

meaning: adj. 柔弱的；女人气的; n. 女子气的男人; vt. 使柔弱；使无男子汉气概; vi. 变得无男子汉气概；变得柔弱
example: His voice was curiously high-pitched, reedy, almost effeminate.
translation: 他的嗓音出奇地高，尖声尖气，有些娘娘腔。

meaning: adj. 晒热的；热情的
example: torrid zone
translation: n. 热带

meaning: adj. 动态的；动力的；动力学的；有活力的; n. 动态；动力
example: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

meaning: n. 辞职；放弃；辞职书；顺从
example: His resignation was a body blow to the team.
translation: 他的辞职是对该队的沉重打击。

meaning: n. 读写能力；精通文学
example: Of course, literacy isn't the same thing as intelligence.
translation: 当然，识字和智力是两码事。

meaning: v. 浪费；使…消散
example: Don't dissipate your efforts.
translation: 不要浪费你的精力.

meaning: adj. 虚构的，假想的；想像的；虚数的
example: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
translation: 精神分裂症的最常见的一个症状就是幻听。

meaning: adj. 有症状的；症候的
example: symptomatic treatment
translation: 症状疗法

meaning: adj. 有目的的；有决心的
example: Purposeful work is an important part of the regime for young offenders.
translation: 使从事有意义的劳动是管理少年犯的重要方法。

meaning: v. 遍及；弥漫
example: Science and technology have come to pervade every aspect of our lives.
translation: 科学和技术已经渗透到我们生活的每一个方面.

meaning: adj. 美的；美学的；审美的，具有审美趣味的
example: He responded very strongly to the aesthetic of this particular work.
translation: 他强烈地感受到这件作品的美学价值。

meaning: adj. [化学] 腐蚀性的；[化学] 苛性的；刻薄的；焦散的; n. [助剂] 腐蚀剂；苛性钠；焦散曲线
example: He was often caustic and mocking, or flew into rages.
translation: 他常常讽刺或挖苦人，有时又会大发雷霆。

meaning: n. [电子] 定时器；计时器；计时员，记时员；跑表；延时调节器
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: n. 螺旋，螺旋状物；[解剖] 耳轮
example: Coil the fibre into a helix.
translation: 将纤维卷绕成螺旋形。

meaning: adj. 有利的；有益的
example: A free trade agreement would be advantageous to both countries.
translation: 自由贸易协定对两国都会有利。

meaning: adj. 有利可图的，赚钱的；合算的
example: It was quite a lucrative sideline.
translation: 这份兼职很赚钱。

meaning: adj. 依教规的；权威的；牧师的; n. 牧师礼服
example: The quantal features can be obtained by the canonical procedure of quantization.
translation: 量子特征可用正则量子化方式得到.

meaning: n. 伪装；装束；外观; vt. 使化装; vi. 伪装

meaning: n. [机] 密封剂
example: silicone sealant
translation: 硅酮密封剂，硅酮嵌缝膏；硅密封胶

meaning: v. 平息；减弱；沉淀；坐下
example: A surveyor said that the problems were caused by subsidence and the house needed to be underpinned.
translation: 一名勘测员说是地面下陷导致了这些问题出现，房子需要加固地基。

meaning: n. 匆忙；急忙；轻率; vi. 匆忙；赶紧; vt. 赶快
example: The pilot wisely decided to return to Farnborough post haste.
translation: 飞行员明智地决定尽快返回法恩伯勒。

meaning: n. 计算；数字的读法；[数] 命数法；编号
example: The radix complement in the pure binary numeration system.
translation: 纯二进制记数系统中的基数补码.

meaning: adj. 堕落的；腐化的；卑鄙的; v. 使腐化（deprave的过去式和过去分词）
example: In 1766 he excommunicated the village for its "depraved diversion."
translation: 1766年，他以“堕落地享乐”为由将那个村庄逐出教会。

meaning: n. 热情；热心；热诚
example: zeal for
translation: 热心

meaning: n. 序文；电报报头；先兆; v. 作序文
example: The aims of the treaty are stated in its preamble.
translation: 条约的宗旨已在序言中说明。

meaning: n. 证明书；推荐书; adj. 证明的；褒奖的；表扬的
example: His testimony, however, was only one in a salvo of new attacks.
translation: 然而他的证词只是新一轮唇枪舌剑中的一股火力。

meaning: n. 情况好转; vt. 使……转朝上；翻转; vi. 向上
example: Down below them was the sea of upturned faces.
translation: 他们下面是无数张仰望的脸。

meaning: v. 下来；飞落; adj. 烧着的；点亮着的
example: Her eyes were alight with a girlish enjoyment of life.
translation: 她的眼睛闪闪发亮，闪烁着少女般的幸福和满足。

meaning: adj. 任意的；无差别的；不分皂白的
example: The indiscriminate use of fertilisers is damaging to the environment.
translation: 乱用化肥会破坏环境。

meaning: n. 合理性；合理的行动
example: We live in an era of rationality.
translation: 我们生活在理性的时代。

meaning: adj. 纯正的；英币的；纯银制的; n. 英国货币；标准纯银
example: He was a stern critic but an extremely kindly man.
translation: 他是个苛刻的批评家，但却是个非常善良的人。

meaning: n. 元素；要素；原理；成分；自然环境
example: In order to make it safe, the element is electrically insulated.
translation: 为安全起见，该元件作了电绝缘处理。

meaning: adj. 顽固的；倔强的；难以控制的
example: Formal, exact and obstinate, he was also cold, suspicious, touchy and tactless.
translation: 严肃、严谨、倔强的他同时又冷漠、多疑、敏感、不会变通。

meaning: v. 翻滚；蠕动; n. 翻滚；扭动；苦恼
v. 体现，使具体化；具体表达; n. (Embody)人名；(英)恩博迪
example: Any incomes policy must embody the attributes of fairness and flexibility.
translation: 任何收入政策都应该具有公平与灵活性之特征.

meaning: adj. 苦行的；禁欲主义的; n. 苦行者；禁欲者
example: The monks lived a very ascetic life.
translation: 僧侣过着很清苦的生活。

meaning: n. 均衡；平静；保持平衡的能力
example: He had recovered his equilibrium and even his good humour, somehow.
translation: 不知怎的，他已经恢复了平静，连心情也变好了。

meaning: adj. 显性的；占优势的；支配的，统治的; n. 显性
example: Japan is Asia's dominant supplier of imports and technology.
translation: 日本是亚洲进口货物和技术的最大供应国。

meaning: v. 抢劫；使…丧失；非法剥夺
example: They rob us, they infringe our rights, they kill us.
translation: 他们劫掠我们，侵犯我们的权利，对我们实施杀戮。

meaning: v. 宣布放弃；公开认错
example: White House officials ordered Williams to recant.
translation: 白宫官员命令威廉斯公开宣布放弃自己的观点。

meaning: n. 解释者；口译者；注释器
example: He was an official interpreter to the government of Nepal.
translation: 他曾是尼泊尔政府的官方译员。

meaning: n. 确认，查证；核实
example: They now take extra steps to verify the creditworthiness of customers.
translation: 他们现在又采取额外措施来核实客户的信用度。

meaning: adj. 唐突的；直率的；无礼的; n. (Brusque)人名；(法)布吕斯克
example: His manner was self-assured and brusque.
translation: 他态度傲慢无礼。

meaning: v. 切细；仔细分析
example: People want to dissect his work and question his motives.
translation: 人们想仔细分析他的作品，并对他的动机提出质疑。

meaning: v. 分支；出现分歧; n. 树枝，分枝；分部；支流
example: When in danger, the anteater lashes its tail round a branch.
translation: 遇有危险，食蚁兽会迅速用尾巴卷住树枝。

meaning: n. 阴极（电解）
example: Cathode rays are attracted by a positive charge.
translation: 阴极射线被正电荷所吸引.

meaning: n. 混乱，骚动
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: n. 授权；命令，指令；委托管理；受命进行的工作; v. 授权；托管
example: The proposed initiative would mandate a reduction of carbon dioxide of 40%.
translation: 倡议将强制规定把二氧化碳排放量降低40%。

meaning: adj. 不重要的，琐碎的；琐细的
example: All the way, darkness engulfs the daytime, wave sinks the boat , trivialism conquers the ardour.
translation: 一直都是, 黑暗吞噬了白昼, 恶浪击沉了轻舟, 琐碎征服了激情.

meaning: adj. 悲哀的，悲惨的
example: He plays some passages so slowly that they become lugubrious.
translation: 有些段落他演奏得异常徐缓，听上去有些忧伤。

meaning: n. 空间；太空；距离; v. 留间隔
example: We must make good use of the available space.
translation: 我们必须充分利用现有空间。

meaning: n. 理性主义；唯理主义
example: Coleridge was to spend the next thirty years attacking rationalism.
translation: 柯尔律治在之后的30年里一直抨击理性主义。

meaning: n. 碑文，墓志铭
example: As Wren's epitaph famously declares, the cathedral itself is his monument.
translation: 众所周知，雷恩的墓志铭中写道，大教堂本身就是他的纪念碑。

meaning: n. 恢复力；弹力；顺应力
example: Do your muscles have the strength and resilience that they should have?
translation: 你的肌肉有足够的力量和弹性吗？

meaning: adj. [地质] 同源的；同类的; n. 同族；同根词
example: Physics and astronomy are cognate sciences.
translation: 物理学与天文学是互有关联的科学.

meaning: adj. 迷人的；可爱的；引人注目的
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: n. 称呼；名称；名目
example: He earned the appellation "rebel priest."
translation: 他赢得了“反叛牧师”的称号。

meaning: n. 激动；搅动；煽动；烦乱
example: Danny returned to Father's house in a state of intense agitation.
translation: 丹尼回到神父的房子时显得极为焦虑不安。

meaning: n. 同意，全体一致
example: Reviewers have been almost unanimous in their disparagement of this book.
translation: 评论家们几乎一致贬抑这本书。

meaning: n. 骚动；暴乱
example: Sounds of voices and commotion could be heard downstairs now.
translation: 现在能听见楼下人声鼎沸。

meaning: adj. 机敏的；狡猾的，诡计多端的
example: It was a pretty astute deduction.
translation: 那是一个颇为敏锐的推论。

meaning: n. 胃蛋白酶
example: Gastric juice contains hydrochloric acid to provide an acidic solution for pepsin.
translation: 胃液内含有盐酸给胃蛋白酶提供酸溶液.

meaning: n. 反驳，顶嘴；曲颈瓶; v. 反驳，反击
example: His sharp retort clearly made an impact.
translation: 他尖刻的反驳显然起了作用。

meaning: adj. 潜意识的；下意识的; n. 潜在意识；下意识心理活动
adj. 庞大的，巨大的；凶暴的，极恶的
example: She was a shy, delicately pretty girl with enormous blue eyes.
translation: 她是一个害羞、娇美的女孩，长着一双大大的蓝眼睛。

meaning: v. 培养；养育，抚育；抱（希望等）; adj. 收养的，养育的; n. (Foster)人名；(英、捷、意、葡、法、德、俄、西)福斯特
example: The children were waiting for placement in a foster care home.
translation: 这些孩子在抚育院等待安置。

meaning: adj. 优雅的；轻飘的；缥缈的；超凡的
example: The music has an ethereal quality.
translation: 这段乐曲给人一种飘渺的感觉.

meaning: adj. 优柔寡断的；踌躇不定的；无决断的
example: I stood irresolute beside my car.
translation: 我犹豫不决地站在我的车旁。

meaning: v. 召集；召集…开会
example: The king convoke parliament to cope with the impending danger.
translation: 国王召开国会以应付迫近眉睫的危险.

meaning: n. 遗嘱的附录
example: She add a codicil to her will just before she die.
translation: 她临终前在遗嘱上加了附录.

meaning: adj. 保留的，预订的；缄默的，冷淡的，高冷的；包租的
example: Normally, such an outward display of affection is reserved for his mother.
translation: 通常，只有在母亲面前他的情感才会如此外露。

meaning: adj. 郁闷的；孤僻的
example: He is a morose, work-shy layabout.
translation: 他是个整天垂头丧气、游手好闲的人。

meaning: adj. 昏昏欲睡的；沉寂的；催眠的
example: He had been feeling drowsy, the effect of an unusually heavy meal.
translation: 他一直感到昏昏沉沉的，这是吃了一顿超级大餐的结果。

meaning: n. 乱语；快速而不清楚的言语
example: You were talking gibberish in your sleep.
translation: 你在睡梦里讲着呓语。

meaning: n. 教条主义者；独断家；独断论者
example: In his manner was something of the dogmatist.
translation: 在他身上有一种独断专行的派头.

meaning: adj. 外国的；相异的，性质不同的；不相容的; n. 外国人，外侨；外星人; v. 让渡，转让
example: Leningrad was the third alien city to offer him a surrogate home.
translation: 列宁格勒是他在异地安家的第三个外国城市。

meaning: n. 制图师；地图制作者
example: Find a good cartographer. Though his maps may cost more, they are extremely accurate.
translation: 找一个好制图师. 价钱可能有点贵, 但是一分钱一分货嘛.

meaning: v. 使怨恨；使难受；使受苦
example: The loss of all his money embitter the old man.
translation: 失去全部的钱,使这位老人甚为痛苦.

meaning: adj. 突出的；强迫人的；冒失的
example: "You are rude and obtrusive, Mr Galbraith," said Tommy.
translation: “您粗暴无礼而且冒失莽撞，加尔布雷思先生，”汤米说道。

meaning: v. 仿真；模仿；尽力赶上；同…竞争; n. 仿真；仿效
example: Sons are traditionally expected to emulate their fathers.
translation: 历来认为儿子会仿效父亲。

meaning: v. 取悦；盛情款待; n. 款待
example: New media is in the pace in this regale is more fast.
translation: 新媒体在这场盛宴中的步伐更为快速.

meaning: adj. 无数的，数不清的
example: Innumerable books have been written on the subject.
translation: 已经有无数书籍写过这个主题。

meaning: n. 卡路里（热量单位）
example: Nutritionists say only 33% of our calorie intake should be from fat.
translation: 营养学家说我们所摄入的卡路里中只应有33％来自脂肪。

meaning: n. 报应；给与惩罚的人；天罚
example: He believes AIDS is our collective nemesis.
translation: 他认为艾滋病是对我们所有人的惩罚。

meaning: n. 难题；谜语
example: Scientists had focused on two explanations to solve this conundrum.
translation: 科学家已锁定两种解释来解开这个难题。

meaning: v. 发牢骚；哭诉；嘎嘎响；发呜呜声; n. 抱怨；牢骚；哀鸣
example: whine about
translation: 发牢骚

meaning: v. 控告；暗示有罪
example: He had been forced to incriminate himself in cross - examinations .
translation: 他在 盘问 中被迫受到牵连.

meaning: n. 灭绝；消失；消灭；废止
example: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
translation: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

meaning: n. 罚款，罚金；处罚
example: It was a crime of espionage and carried the death penalty.
translation: 这是间谍罪，应判死刑。

meaning: n. 警戒，警觉；警醒症
example: He warned the public to be vigilant and report anything suspicious.
translation: 他警告公众要提高警惕，遇到任何可疑情况都要报告。

meaning: n. 分析者；精神分析医师；分解者
example: Constance's husband is a financial analyst.
translation: 康斯坦斯的丈夫是一名财政分析家.

meaning: n. 关节；接缝；接合处，接合点；（牛，羊等的腿）大块肉; adj. 共同的；连接的；联合的，合办的; v. 连接，贴合；接合；使有接头
example: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
translation: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

meaning: adj. 鬼鬼祟祟的，秘密的
example: She was furtive and vicious by temperament.
translation: 她本来做事就偷偷摸摸，心肠狠毒。

meaning: adj. 真正的，真实的；可信的
example: I had obtained the authentic details about the birth of the organization.
translation: 我已经掌握了有关该组织诞生的可靠的详细资料。

meaning: v. 收缩；感染；订约; n. 合同；婚约
example: A formal contract is signed which is renewable annually.
translation: 正式签订了每年可续签的合同。

meaning: n. 哲学；哲理；人生观
example: Apart from criminal investigation techniques, students learn forensic medicine, philosophy and logic.
translation: 除罪案调查技巧外，学生们还要学习法医学、哲学和逻辑学。

meaning: adj. 挑衅的；目中无人的，蔑视的；挑战的
example: The players are in defiant mood as they prepare for tomorrow'sgame.
translation: 球员在备战明天的比赛时带着蔑视对手的情绪。

meaning: v. 支撑；鼓励；赞成；举起
example: The young couple plan to upholster their bedroom with velvet.
translation: 小俩口打算用天鹅绒装饰他们的卧室.

meaning: v. 侵犯；违反；破坏
example: They rob us, they infringe our rights, they kill us.
translation: 他们劫掠我们，侵犯我们的权利，对我们实施杀戮。

meaning: n. 基因组；染色体组
example: They were comparing notes on each other's progress towards solving that most taxing of all puzzles: the riddle of the human genome.
translation: 他们就解决人类所面临的最大难题，即人类基因组之谜的进展情况交换了意见。

meaning: adj. 马的；骑马的；骑术的; n. 骑手；骑马者
example: equestrian events at the Olympic Games
translation: 奥林匹克运动会的马术比赛项目

meaning: adj. 固定的；静止的；定居的；常备军的; n. 不动的人；驻军
example: Is there a stationer's near here?
translation: 这附近有没有文具店？

meaning: v. 模仿，仿效；仿造，仿制
example: He could imitate in speech or writing most of those he admired.
translation: 他能模仿大多数自己崇拜的偶像的讲话和写作风格。

meaning: adj. 切线的，相切的；接触的；离题的; n. [数] 切线，[数] 正切
example: Too much time was spent discussing tangential issues.
translation: 太多的时间花在了讨论那些无关紧要的问题上。

meaning: adj. 徒劳的；自负的；无结果的；无用的
example: She is a vainglorious woman.
translation: 她是个爱虚荣的女性.

meaning: n. 干扰，冲突；干涉
example: The parliament described the decree as interference in the republic's internal affairs.
translation: 议会形容此法令为对共和国内政的干涉。

meaning: adj. 暴力的；猛烈的
example: violent crime
translation: 暴力犯罪，暴力罪行

meaning: n. [贸易] 报价单；引用语；引证
example: The book began with a quotation from Goethe.
translation: 这本书一开头引用了歌德的隽语。

meaning: n. 杂质；不纯；不洁
example: The oxygen reacts vigorously with the impurity in the iron.
translation: 氧气与铁中的杂质发生剧烈的化学反应.

meaning: adj. 提高的；高尚的；严肃的；欢欣的; v. 提高；抬起；振奋；提拔（elevate的过去分词）; n. 高架铁路
example: An elevated platform on the stage collapsed during rehearsals.
translation: 在排练过程中舞台上垫高的一个平台塌了。

meaning: n. 磨光，擦亮；擦亮剂；优雅，精良; v. 擦亮，变光滑; adj. 波兰的
example: Those killed have been described as the flower of Polish manhood.
translation: 那些牺牲者被称为波兰男子中的精英。

meaning: v. 衰退，[核] 衰减；腐烂，腐朽; n. 衰退，[核] 衰减；腐烂，腐朽
example: tooth decay
translation: 蛀牙；龋齿；齵齿

meaning: n. 门徒，信徒；弟子
example: a disciple of the economist John Maynard Keynes
translation: 经济学家约翰∙梅纳德∙凯恩斯的信徒

meaning: n. 紧握；柄；支配；握拍方式；拍柄绷带; v. 紧握；夹紧
example: How much can the President relax his grip over the nation?
translation: 总统可以对国家的控制放松到什么样的程度？

meaning: adj. 给人好感的；有魅力的；引人注意的; v. 预先影响；使先具有（prepossess的现在分词）
example: He was not a prepossessing sight.
translation: 他长相不怎么样。

meaning: v. 弄脏，涂抹；玷污
example: The daughter asks bemusedly :'so, why do you besmear alter changes even? "
translation: 女儿困惑地问: “ 那么, 你为什么还要涂涂改改 呢 ? ”

meaning: n. 求援，求助；[经] 追索权；依赖；救生索
example: It enabled its members to settle their differences without recourse to war.
translation: 这样，其成员就可以不必诉诸战争来解决分歧。

meaning: v. 拒绝；否定；批判；与…断绝关系；拒付
n. 一百年；百年纪念; adj. 一百年的
example: The club will celebrate its centenary next year.
translation: 俱乐部明年要庆祝成立一百周年。

meaning: n. 攻击者; adj. 袭击的；攻击的
example: Other party-goers rescued the injured man from his assailant.
translation: 其他参加聚会的人把这名伤者从行凶者手中救了出来。

meaning: n. 强盗；土匪；盗贼
example: We passed the desiccated corpse of a brigand hanging on a gibbet.
translation: 我们路过一具悬在绞刑架上的土匪干尸.

meaning: v. 危害；使陷危地；使受危困
example: The dispute could jeopardize the negotiations.
translation: 那一争论可能会使谈判处于险境。

meaning: adj. 假装虔诚的；假装圣洁的；假装诚实的
example: He writes smug, sanctimonious waffle.
translation: 他写的满篇都是自鸣得意、道貌岸然的废话。

meaning: adj. 不定的；周游的；错误的；偏离正路的
