meaning: n. 特点；品质证明; v. 给…盖上品质证明印记；使具有…标志
example: One hallmark of a good politician is his ability to influence people.
translation: 衡量一个优秀政治家的标志之一就是他影响大众的能力.

meaning: n. 精华；典范；第五元素（被视为地、水、火、风以外之构成宇宙的元素）
example: He was the quintessence of all that Eva most deeply loathed.
translation: 他是伊娃最深恶痛绝的那种人中的典型。

meaning: n. 懊恼；委屈；气愤; v. 使…懊恼
example: Much to his chagrin, he did not win the race.
translation: 使他大为懊恼的是他赛跑没获胜.

meaning: n. 风味；热心；强烈的兴趣; v. 给…调味
example: Macaroni Parmesan Cheese Topping , and Sage Gravy will appeal to their zesty personalities.
translation: 意大利的通心面 、 士和美味肉汁一定很合他们的口味.

meaning: v. 安排；排列；整理
example: It is not for me to arrange such matters.
translation: 我无权安排这些事情。

meaning: v. 集合，聚集；装配；收集
example: Greenpeace managed to assemble enough boats to waylay the ship at sea.
translation: 绿色和平组织设法聚集起足够数量的小船在海上拦截该船。

meaning: n. [解剖] 角膜
example: The operation involves making several cuts in the cornea.
translation: 该手术要在角膜上做几个切口。

meaning: n. 洪水；一阵；大雨；突然迸发
v. 摇动；骚动；使…激动
example: The women who worked in these mills had begun to agitate for better conditions.
translation: 在这些工厂里做工的妇女们开始抗议要求改善工作条件。

meaning: n. 旅游，旅行；巡回演出; v. 旅行，在……旅游；在……作巡回演出
example: tour guide
translation: 导游人员

meaning: adj. 愉快的
example: She has a blithesome nature.
translation: 她有个乐天本性.

meaning: v. 兜售；招徕；刺探赛马情报; n. 侦查者；兜售者
n. 轶事；奇闻；秘史
example: He departed from the text to tell an anecdote.
translation: 他偏离课文讲起了一则轶事.

meaning: n. [解剖] 小脑
example: This part of the vertebrate brain has two divisions, the medulla and the cerebellum.
translation: 脊椎动物脑子的这一部分可分为两部分:脑髓和小脑.

meaning: adj. 好捣乱的；好搞派系的；源于派别的
example: Fabvier was factious ; Bavoux was revolutionary.
translation: 法布维埃是暴动分子, 巴武是革命党人.

meaning: n. 艺术性；工艺；艺术技巧；艺术效果；艺术工作
example: There is artistry in what he does.
translation: 他做的一切都具有艺术性。

meaning: adj. 顽固的，执拗的；冷酷无情的
example: Parts of the administration may be changing but others have been obdurate defenders of the status quo.
translation: 政府的一些部门可能正在作出改变，但是其他部门却执意维护现状。

meaning: v. 克服；胜过
example: Having identified the problem, the question arises of how to overcome it.
translation: 发现问题后，如何克服它的问题又出现了。

meaning: n. 偶像破坏者；提倡打破旧习的人
example: Cage was an iconoclast. He refused to be bound by western musical traditions of harmony and structure.
translation: 凯奇是个反传统的人。他拒绝接受西方有关和声和结构的音乐传统的束缚。

meaning: n. 加速，促进；[物] 加速度
example: Acceleration is accompanied by a resonating growl from the gearbox.
translation: 变速箱随着加速传来一阵轰鸣。

meaning: adj. 尖锐的；辛酸的；深刻的；切中要害的; n. (Poignant)人名；(法)普瓦尼昂
example: I found the scene in which Percy proposed to Olive tremendously poignant.
translation: 我觉得珀西向奥利芙求婚的一幕太让人心酸了。

meaning: adj. 辛辣的；刺激性的；刺鼻的；苦痛的；尖刻的
example: He enjoyed the play's shrewd and pungent social analysis.
translation: 他喜欢剧中尖锐机敏、一针见血的社会分析。

meaning: n. 高温；压力；热度；热烈; v. 使激动；把…加热
example: heat transfer
translation: 热传递，传热

meaning: n. 恢复；赔偿；归还
example: coefficient of restitution
translation: 恢复系数；回弹系数

meaning: adj. 错误的；扭曲的; adv. 歪曲地；歪斜地；错误地
example: His dark hair was all awry.
translation: 他的黑头发全乱了。

meaning: n. 涟音；波音
adj. 沮丧的，灰心的
example: Everyone has days when they feel dejected or down.
translation: 每个人都有沮丧失意或情绪低落的时候。

meaning: n. 结果，结局；要点
example: Salter held the bag by the corners and shook it upside down.
translation: 索尔特捏住包的外角，把它倒过来晃了晃。

meaning: v. 把降低到；归入；提交
example: Some scientists relegate parapsychology to the sphere of quackery.
translation: 一些科学家把灵学归类到骗术范围.

meaning: adj. 自恋的；自我陶醉的
example: She exhibited none of the narcissistic and nihilistic tendencies of her peers.
translation: 她一点儿都没表现出同龄人那种自恋和虚无主义的性格倾向。

meaning: adj. 智力的；聪明的；理智的; n. 知识分子；凭理智做事者
example: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
translation: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

meaning: n. 怠惰，懒惰；[脊椎] 树懒
example: He was not slothful: he had been busy all night.
translation: 他可不懒，昨晚他忙了整整一夜。

meaning: adj. 不注意的；不留心的
example: She stood glued to the radio, heedless of the ordered bustle about her.
translation: 她站在那里一动不动地听收音机, 毫不注意周围有秩序的忙碌.

meaning: n. 树木的培植/栽培
v. 爆炸；电闪；怒喝; n. 雷酸盐；烈性炸药
example: The newspapers fulminate against the crime.
translation: 报纸严厉谴责这个罪行.

meaning: v. 变矮小; n. 侏儒，矮子; adj. 矮小的
example: The dwarf's long arms were not proportional to his height.
translation: 那侏儒的长臂与他的身高不成比例.

meaning: n. [力] 共振；共鸣；反响
example: His voice had lost its resonance; it was tense and strained.
translation: 他的声音不再洪亮，而是显得紧张，不太自然。

meaning: v. 追溯；折回；重描
example: She turned around and began to retrace her steps towards the house.
translation: 她转身沿原路向那栋房子走去。

meaning: adj. 顽强的；顽固的; vt. 跟踪；尾随（dog的过去式）
example: He has been dogged by allegations of questionable business practices.
translation: 他一直被那些指控他有不正当商业行为的说法所困扰。

meaning: adj. 小的，小型的，微小的; n. 爱称；指小词；身材极小的人
example: She noticed a diminutive figure standing at the entrance.
translation: 她注意到入口处站着一个小小的身影。

meaning: n. 对称（性）；整齐，匀称
example: axial symmetry
translation: 轴对称性

meaning: adj. （言语或理论）轻率的，未经深思熟虑的
example: The subject of racism is admittedly too complex for facile summarization.
translation: 无可否认，种族主义这个话题太过复杂，不可能一言蔽之。

meaning: v. 使溶解；使分解；使液化; n. 叠化画面；画面的溶暗
example: Kaifu threatened to dissolve the Parliament and call an election.
translation: 卡夫威胁要解散议会并举行选举。

meaning: n. 重复；背诵；副本
example: Her prose style is not always felicitous; she tends to repetition.
translation: 她的行文风格并非总是恰到好处，往往爱重复。

meaning: n. 斯多葛学派哲学家；禁欲主义者；恬淡寡欲的人，不以苦乐为意的人; adj. 坚忍的，苦修的；斯多葛派的；禁欲主义的
example: Her great-grandfather had clearly been a dedicated and stoical traveller.
translation: 她的曾祖父显然是一位非常投入而且坚忍不拔的旅行爱好者。

meaning: adj. 总共的；粗野的；恶劣的；显而易见的; v. 总共收入; n. 总额，总数
example: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.
translation: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

meaning: n. 寓言
example: The play is being widely read as an allegory of imperialist conquest.
translation: 这部剧被广泛解读为对帝国主义征服的讽喻。

meaning: adj. 天真的；朴实的；无虚饰的
example: She was curiously artless.
translation: 她单纯得令人难以置信。

meaning: v. 报答；互换；互给
example: Although she did not reciprocate his feelings, she did not discourage him.
translation: 尽管她没有回应他的感情, 她也没有使他丧失信心.

meaning: n. [病毒] 病毒；恶毒；毒害
example: influenza virus
translation: 流感病毒

meaning: v. 检疫；隔离；使隔离; n. 检疫；隔离；检疫期；封锁
example: No mammals other than people may enter the country without lengthy quarantine.
translation: 除人之外，所有的哺乳动物进入这个国家都必须经过长期隔离。

meaning: adj. 暂时的，临时的; n. 临时工，临时雇员
example: temporary storage
translation: 暂时存储器；暂时库容；中间存储器

meaning: n. 监督人；负责人；主管；指挥者
adj. 怠慢的；迟缓的；不小心的
v. 使黯然失色；形成蚀; n. 日蚀，月蚀；黯然失色
example: Of course, nothing is going to eclipse winning the Olympic title.
translation: 当然，没有什么能比得过赢得奥运会冠军。

meaning: n. 平等；相等；[数] 等式
example: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
translation: 迄今为止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

meaning: n. 古董；艺术品爱好
example: Argentina came to a virtual standstill while the game was being played.
translation: 在比赛进行的时候，阿根廷全国几乎陷入了停顿状态。

meaning: adj. 戏剧的；急剧的；引人注目的；激动人心的
example: Recent, more dramatic use of CGI was seen in "Walking With Dinosaurs".
translation: 在纪录片《与恐龙同行》中可以看到最新的、更加生动的电脑特效技术。

meaning: n. 谴责；训斥；申诉; v. 谴责；训斥；责难
example: Her attempts to reprimand him were quickly shouted down.
translation: 她本想斥责他，但很快就被大声喝止了。

meaning: adj. 威严的；令人敬畏的; n. 八月（简写为Aug）
example: The Great War started in August of that year.
translation: 第一次世界大战于那年8月爆发。

meaning: v. 沉浸；使陷入
example: Immerse the cloth in the dye for twenty minutes.
translation: 把布浸在染料里20分钟.

meaning: n. 选举权；投票；参政权；代祷；赞成票
example: She was a suffragette and a birth control pioneer.
translation: 她参加争取妇女选举权的运动，也是节育倡导者。

meaning: adj. 好斗的；野蛮的；言词刻毒的
example: We were reluctant to start the long trudge home.
translation: 我们很不愿意踏上如此漫长艰辛的回家之路。

meaning: n. 法警；执行官；区镇的地方长官
example: Only a few go through the final humiliation of meeting the bailiff at the door.
translation: 很少有人经受执达官上门的奇耻大辱。

meaning: adj. 愤愤不平的；义愤的
example: MPs were indignant that the government had not consulted them.
translation: 政府没有事先征求他们的意见，下院议员们感到很愤怒。

meaning: adj. 最重要的，主要的；至高无上的; n. 最高统治者
example: She wrote to Paramount Studios and asked if they would audition her.
translation: 她写信给派拉蒙电影公司，询问他们是否同意让她去试镜。

meaning: n. 不满，不平；委屈；冤情
example: He will not easily forget his grievance.
translation: 他不会轻易忘掉他的委屈.

meaning: n. 做作；矫揉造作；假装
example: Lawson writes so well: in plain English, without fuss or affectation.
translation: 劳森写得很好：英文通俗易懂，朴实无华又不矫揉造作。

meaning: n. [解剖] 神经元，神经单位
example: Information is transferred along each neuron by means of an electrical impulse.
translation: 信息在电脉冲作用下经神经元传递。

meaning: v. 尽情享受；使有风味；加调味品于；品尝，欣赏; n. 滋味；气味；食欲
n. 沼泽，沼泽地；无法脱身的困境
example: His people had fallen further and further into a quagmire of confusion.
translation: 他的人民在混乱不安的泥潭里越陷越深。

meaning: adj. 不合理的；昧着良心的；肆无忌惮的；过度的
example: Beneath the conscious mind there are many levels of the unconscious.
translation: 在意识心理之下存在很多层次的无意识。

meaning: n. 一队；民防团；地方武装团队
example: a little posse of helpers
translation: 一小伙帮忙的人

meaning: n. 营养物；促进生长的东西
example: The matter of the body is continually changing by process of nutriment and wastage.
translation: 肉体的物质通过营养与消耗的过程不断变化着.

meaning: n. 夸大的言辞; adj. 夸大的
example: There was no bombast or conceit in his speech.
translation: 他的演讲并没有夸大其词和自吹自擂。

meaning: n. （法国封建时代的）城堡；（尤指法国的）别墅
example: The house was modelled on a French chateau.
translation: 这房子是模仿一座法国大别墅建造的.

meaning: n. [数] 公式，准则；配方；婴儿食品
example: There is no magic formula for producing winning products.
translation: 获奖电影的制作没有捷径可取。

meaning: v. 使困扰；使烦恼；反复袭击
example: The harass-ment had become too much to tolerate and he decided to move out.
translation: 骚扰越来越过分，他难以忍受，决定搬走。

meaning: adj. 易燃的；易激动的；燃烧性的; n. 可燃物；易燃物
example: Don't smoke near combustible materials.
translation: 别在易燃的材料附近吸烟.

meaning: n. [化学] 纯度；纯洁；纯净；纯粹
example: Human life weighed more with him than purity of policy.
translation: 人类生命对他而言比政策的纯洁性更重要。

meaning: n. 灾难；不幸事件
example: He described drugs as the greatest calamity of the age.
translation: 他称毒品是这个时代最大的祸害。

meaning: adj. 残忍的；野蛮的；无人性的
example: The barbaric slaughter of whales is unnecessary and inhuman.
translation: 对鲸的野蛮屠杀既不必要也不人道。

meaning: v. 否认，否定；抵赖；拒绝对…的责任
example: I disavow all responsibility for you.
translation: 我不承认对你有任何责任.

meaning: v. 使多样化，使变化；增加产品种类以扩大
example: Farmers are being encouraged to diversify into new crops.
translation: 目前正鼓励农民兼种新的农作物。

meaning: n. 友好；亲善关系；友好关系
example: He wished to live in amity with his neighbour.
translation: 他希望与邻居和睦相处。

meaning: n. 接缝；连接；接合
example: The battle had reached a crucial juncture.
translation: 战斗已到了关键时刻。

meaning: adj. 歪斜的; adv. 歪斜地，斜地; n. (Askew)人名；(英)艾斯丘
example: His glasses had been knocked askew by the blow.
translation: 他的眼镜一下子被打歪了。

meaning: n. 前言；引语; v. 为…加序言；以…开始
example: He has written a fine preface to the play.
translation: 他为这个剧本写了一篇精彩的序言.

meaning: n. 算术，算法
example: They will concentrate on teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
translation: 他们将集中教授阅读、写作和算术基础知识。

meaning: n. 装饰乐段
example: First movement, with cadenza any , from contestant's choice from L . V. Beethoven until nowadays.
translation: 从贝多芬时期到现在的一首协奏曲作品的第一乐章和装饰奏.

meaning: v. 记住，背熟；记忆
example: I don't try to memorize speeches word for word.
translation: 我不会试图一字不落地记住讲话要说的内容。

meaning: adj. 有独创性的；机灵的，精制的；心灵手巧的
example: ingenious ways of saving energy
translation: 节约能源的巧妙方法

meaning: n. 流浪者；流浪儿；飘流物；无主物；信号旗
example: Waikiki and spectacular magic and lighting with and dances.
translation: 大格局的魔术,十全十美的灯光与音响,令人叹为观止.

meaning: n. 碰撞；冲突；（意见，看法）的抵触；（政党等的）倾轧
example: He heard tires squeal as the car braked to avoid a collision.
translation: 为避免相撞而刹车时，他听到了轮胎与地面刺耳的摩擦声。

meaning: v. 止血；使不漏；平息; adj. 坚固的；忠实的；防水的
example: My parent are the stanchion of our family.
translation: 父母是我们家的支柱.

meaning: adj. 适于抓握的；善于领会的
example: the monkey's prehensile tail
translation: 猴子能缠住东西的尾巴

meaning: n. 大杂烩；混煮；一团糟; vt. 使混乱
example: The region became a hodgepodge of languages and dialects, some from the east, some from the south and some from other countries entirely.
translation: 这个地区成为语言和方言的大杂烩，有些来自东部，有些来自南部，而有些完全是来自别的国家。

meaning: adj. 下流的；言谈粗俗的; n. 言谈粗俗的人；说下流话的人
example: He loves entertaining his friends with ribald stories.
translation: 他喜欢用下流故事来逗他的朋友们开心.

meaning: adj. 过度的，过分的；不适当的；未到期的
example: undue influence
translation: n. 不正当影响；[律]不正当压力

meaning: adj. 生物所能分解的，能进行生物降解的
example: The company had falsely claimed that its products were biodegradable.
translation: 公司谎称他们的产品是可生物降解的.

meaning: adj. 盐的；含盐分的; n. 盐湖；碱盐泻药
example: Wash the lenses in saline solution.
translation: 用盐溶液清洗镜片。

meaning: n. 复合，再结合；[遗] 重组
example: Genetic recombination can occur without the formation of a chiasmata.
translation: 遗传重组在没有形成交叉的情况下,也可以发生.

meaning: adj. 优先的；选择的；特惠的；先取的
example: Despite her status, the Duchess will not be given preferential treatment.
translation: 虽然地位显赫，但是公爵夫人并不会得到优待。

meaning: adj. 易受攻击的，易受…的攻击；易受伤害的；有弱点的
n. 数字；手指或足趾；一指宽
example: Australia had 15 years of double-digit inflation.
translation: 澳大利亚有15年通货膨胀率维持在两位数。

meaning: n. 反感；厌恶；憎恶；不相容
example: She'd often spoken of her antipathy towards London.
translation: 她常提及她对伦敦的反感。

meaning: adj. 肉体的；肉欲的；淫荡的；性欲的; n. (Carnal)人名；(西)卡纳尔
example: Their ruling passion is that of carnal love.
translation: 他们现在情欲正盛。

meaning: n. 秘密；秘密行动；鬼祟
example: Slowly and stealthily, someone was creeping up the stairs.
translation: 有人正蹑手蹑脚地上楼。

meaning: n. 烧杯；大口杯
example: a beaker of coffee
translation: 一杯咖啡

meaning: n. 干涉者；爱管闲事的人
example: " I know you, you scoundrel! I have heard of you before. You are Holmes, the meddler. "
translation: “ 我知道你, 这个恶棍. 我以前听过你. 你是福尔摩斯, 爱管闲事的人. ”

meaning: n. 刚毅；不屈不挠；勇气

meaning: n. [免疫] 抗体

meaning: v. 叙述；给…作旁白

meaning: n. 诡辩

translation: 每当临近漆树的生长旺季,其树叶在经历了风吹雨打之后色彩显得更为明亮.

meaning: adj. 不屈的；坚强的；[材] 不易弯曲的

meaning: n. 模范；完美之物；优秀之人; adj. 完美的

meaning: n. 滋养品；食物; v. 向…提供营养物

meaning: n. 血统；家谱; adj. 纯种的

meaning: adj. 种族的；人种的

meaning: n. 滋味；风味；食欲；开胃小菜；含义；调味品; v. 盼望;期待;享受; 品味；喜爱；给…加佐料

meaning: adj. 腐败的，贪污的；堕落的; v. 使腐烂；使堕落，使恶化

meaning: v. 仔细考虑；衡量; n. (Ponder)人名；(英)庞德
example: The visitor can ponder over the boomerangs used by aborigines at the time of Cook.
translation: 来访者可以琢磨琢磨土著人在库克时期用的回飞镖.

meaning: v. 存在；维持生活
example: The standard of living today is on the edge of subsistence.
translation: 现在的生活水平几乎快要无法维持生计。

meaning: v. 克服，越过；战胜
example: She guessed Bertha's present difficulty, and It'seemed easily surmountable.
translation: 她猜出了伯莎目前的为难之处; 而这看来很容易克服.

meaning: adj. 完美的；洁净的；无瑕疵的
example: The goalkeeper'sperformance was immaculate.
translation: 守门员的表现堪称完美。

meaning: n. [林] 树干；红玄武土
example: A climber goes up the bole, attaches the rope near the top.
translation: 攀登者达到树干, 把绳子拴到在靠近顶端处.

meaning: n. 奖学金；固定薪金；定期津贴；养老金
example: Magistrate who is not usually a qualified lawyer ( as opposed to a stipendiary magistrate ).
translation: 通常不是一个合格律师的治安法官,它与领薪裁判官相对.

meaning: adj. 奴隶的；奴性的；卑屈的；卑屈的
example: She's a curious mixture of stubbornness and servility.
translation: 她既固执又恭顺，令人捉摸不透。

meaning: v. 妥协；危害; n. 妥协，和解；折衷
example: Mr Clarke has shown himself to be resolutely opposed to compromise.
translation: 克拉克先生已表示自己坚决反对妥协。

meaning: adj. 不协调的；不一致的；不和谐的
example: She was small and fragile and looked incongruous in an army uniform.
translation: 她又小又弱，穿一身军装看起来很不协调。

meaning: n. [电] 变压器；促使变化的人
example: The AC stabilized voltage supply with transformerless output an intelligent device control led by a microcomputer.
translation: 无工频输出变压器交流稳压电源系采用微机控制的智能化电源.

meaning: n. 抄写；抄本；誊写
example: transcription factor
translation: [化]转录因子

meaning: v. 安置；安顿下来；使…隐藏
example: It makes use of peculiar UV coating way to ensconce the color inside the lens.
translation: 它是利用UV特殊涂料方式将镜片的颜色藏在镜片里面的方式生产的.

meaning: v. 使复杂化；使恶化；使卷入
example: To complicate matters further, everybody's vitamin requirements vary.
translation: 更麻烦的是，每个人对维生素的需求量是不同的。

meaning: n. 合理化
example: The main lines of the plan were a reduction in expenditure and the rationalization of government controls.
translation: 该计划的主要内容是支出的缩减和政府控制的合理化改革。

meaning: v. 控告，指控；谴责；归咎于
example: I hate it when people accuse us of that.
translation: 我讨厌别人就那件事指责我们。

meaning: n. [天] 精密记时表；高度精确的钟表；航海经线仪
example: Murchison followed with his eye the hand of his chronometer.
translation: 莫奇生的眼睛追随着他的时计的秒针.

meaning: n. 含义；暗示；牵连，卷入；可能的结果，影响
example: The implication that marital infidelity enhances a leader's credibility is preposterous.
translation: 婚姻不忠会提升领导人可信度的暗示荒谬之极。

meaning: adj. 专横的；迫切的；傲慢的
example: From across the desk she gave him a witheringly imperious look.
translation: 她从桌子对面扫了他一眼，目光咄咄逼人，凌利而专横。

meaning: adj. 预知的；有先见之明的
example: It was a remarkably prescient vision.
translation: 这的确很有远见.

meaning: adj. 先天的；固有的；与生俱来的
example: Home ownership has been an overarching and innate desire of the British.
translation: 拥有私宅是所有英国人心中压倒一切和根深蒂固的强烈愿望。

meaning: v. 不同意；不信奉国教; n. 异议；（大写）不信奉国教
example: Political dissent would no longer be tolerated.
translation: 政见不和将不再被容忍。

meaning: adj. 失礼的，无礼貌的；粗鲁的
n. 手法，技巧；熟练，灵巧；诡计
example: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
translation: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

meaning: adj. 表面的；假装的
example: The ostensible reason for his absence was illness.
translation: 他假托生病缺勤。

meaning: adj. 有争议的；有争论的
example: The committee backtracked by scrapping the controversial bonus system.
translation: 委员会改变主意，放弃了有争议的奖金制度。

meaning: adj. 负债的；感激的；受惠的; v. 使负债；使受恩惠（indebt的过去分词）
example: America's treasury secretary identified the most heavily indebted countries.
translation: 美国财政部长指出了负债最多的那些国家。

meaning: v. 逼使；强迫；冲出
example: A 40 watt bulb would be quite sufficient and would not obtrude.
translation: 40瓦的灯泡完全够亮了，并且不会晃眼。

meaning: n. 大使；代表；使节
example: The decision will be relayed to Iraq's ambassador at the UN.
translation: 这个决定将会被传达给伊拉克驻联合国大使。

meaning: adj. 金属线制的；金属丝般的；坚硬的；瘦长结实的；（噪音）尖细的
v. 波动；起伏；挥手示意；摇动；呈波形; n. 波动；波浪；高潮；挥手示意；卷曲
example: Conversely, a waveform can not be specified without these three quantities.
translation: 反之, 不知道这3个量就不可能确定一个波形.

meaning: v. 召唤；召集；鼓起；振作
example: Two Will O'the Wisp are summoned to help their summoner in battle.
translation: 在战斗中,两个鬼火将被召唤来帮助它们的召唤者.

meaning: adj. 吝啬的；缺乏的；贫困的
example: One penurious year, my parents used Swiss cheese plant.
translation: 经济拮据的一年, 我父母曾用绳状藤来代替圣诞树.

meaning: v. 揉合，揉捏；按摩；捏制
example: She felt him knead the aching muscles.
translation: 她感到他在按摩她酸痛的肌肉。

meaning: adj. 可辩解的，有道理的；可证明为正当的
example: The cutbacks are justifiable on the grounds of cost.
translation: 削减符合成本方面的考虑.

meaning: adj. 和谐的；协调的；一致的；和声的
example: The ultrabasic bodies are generally concordant intrusions, with related feeder dikes.
translation: 超基性岩一般为具有补给岩墙的整合侵入体.

meaning: v. 拆除；取消；解散；除掉…的覆盖物
n. 管弦乐队；乐队演奏处
example: The orchestra gave its first performance on Whit Monday.
translation: 乐团在周一的圣灵降临节举行了首场演出。

meaning: n. 凹室；壁龛
example: The bookcase fits neatly into the alcove.
translation: 书架正好放得进壁凹。

meaning: v. 比…重（在重量上）；比…重要；比…有价值
example: The advantages of this deal largely outweigh the disadvantages.
translation: 这笔交易的利远远大于弊。

meaning: n. 债券；结合；约定；粘合剂；纽带; v. 结合，团结在一起
example: In graphite sheets, carbon atoms bond together in rings.
translation: 石墨层中的碳原子相互连接形成碳环。

meaning: adj. 奉献的（副词votively）；献纳的；诚心祈求的
adj. 乐观的；满怀希望的；面色红润的; vt. 血染；以血沾污; n. 血红色
example: They have begun to take a more sanguine view.
translation: 他们的看法已经开始变得乐观起来。

meaning: n. 逼真，貌似真实；逼真的事物
adj. 谨慎的；机警的；惟恐的；考虑周到的
example: wary of
translation: adj. 小心翼翼的；警觉的；谨防的

meaning: n. 矢量；带菌者；航线; vt. 用无线电导航
example: Objective To study the effects of short - term simulated weightlessness on human vectorcardiogram ( VCG ).
translation: 目的探讨短期-6°头低位卧床模拟失重对人心电向量图 ( vectorcardiogram,VCG ) 的影响.

meaning: adj. 三倍的；三方的; n. 三倍数；三个一组; v. 增至三倍
example: triple jump
translation: 三级跳远

meaning: adj. 平均的；卑鄙的；低劣的；吝啬的; v. 意味；想要；意欲; n. 平均值
example: "What do you mean?" I asked, offended on Liddie's behalf.
translation: “你什么意思啊？”我问，替利迪感到愤愤不平。

meaning: v. 过滤；渗出；浸透; n. 滤过液；渗出液
example: New fashions took a long time to percolate down.
translation: 新时尚要很长时间才能在大众中流行起来。

meaning: v. 扰乱；使…混乱；使…心绪不宁
example: Her sudden appearance did not seem to perturb him in the least.
translation: 她的突然出现似乎一点也没有令他不安。

meaning: n. 长寿，长命；寿命
example: The main characteristic of the strike has been its longevity.
translation: 这次罢工的主要特点是持续时间长。

meaning: n. 联合；结合，合并
example: The Liberal leader has announced his party's withdrawal from the ruling coalition.
translation: 自由党领袖已宣布该党退出执政联盟。

meaning: adj. 短暂的；朝生暮死的; n. 只生存一天的事物
example: Most newspapers are of ephemeral interest.
translation: 多数报纸只能引起读者短暂的注意.

meaning: adj. 不道德的；邪恶的；淫荡的
example: I rejected the teaching that premarital sex was immoral.
translation: 我反对宣扬婚前性行为不道德的说教。

meaning: adj. 充满激情的；感激的; v. 使充满激情（impassion的过去式和过去分词）
example: The jury listened to his impassioned explication of article 306.
translation: 陪审团听取了他对第306条充满激情的阐述。

meaning: v. 奉献；使神圣；供神用；献身于; adj. 神圣的；被献给神的
example: What experience does is merely to confirm and consecrate our confident dream.
translation: 经验之作用无非在于把我们充满自信心的梦境肯定下来,奉为神圣不可侵犯而已.

meaning: v. 承认；公开宣称；坦率承认
example: The senator was forced to avow openly that he had received some money from that company.
translation: 那个参议员被迫承认曾经收过那家公司的一些钱.

meaning: n. 熟悉，精通；亲密；随便
example: Tony was unnerved by the uncanny familiarity of her face.
translation: 怪异的是，她看起来竟有些面熟，这让托尼心慌意乱。

meaning: n. 物质；事件; v. 有关系；要紧
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 疯狂的；精神错乱的；愚蠢的; n. 疯子；疯人
example: This murderous lunatic could kill them both without a second thought.
translation: 这个杀人狂会不假思索地把他们两个都杀掉。

meaning: n. 姿态；手势; v. 作手势；用动作示意
example: Their handshake appeared to be a gesture of reconciliation.
translation: 他们的握手似乎是和解的表示。

meaning: n. [化学] 沉淀物; v. 使沉淀；促成；猛抛；使陷入; adj. 突如其来的；猛地落下的；急促的
example: Adding sulphate to the solution will give a precipitate.
translation: 将硫酸盐加入该溶液会产生沉淀.

meaning: adj. 抽筋的；急动的；不平稳的; n. 牛肉干
example: Some people moved in silky, liquid movements, others were jerky, probably drunk.
translation: 一些人动作平稳流畅，其他人则跌跌撞撞，大概是喝醉了。

meaning: n. 奇迹，奇事；奇才；奇观；预兆
example: She was a child prodigy, giving concerts before she was a teenager.
translation: 她是个神童，十来岁不到就举办音乐会了。

meaning: n. 意外事故；伤亡人员；急诊室
adj. 国内的；家庭的；驯养的；一心只管家务的; n. 国货；佣人
example: And what of the effect on U.S domestic opinion?
translation: 对美国国内的舆论有什么影响？

meaning: v. 同意；赞成; n. 同意；赞成
example: Without their assent a political settlement cannot be reached.
translation: 没有他们的同意，不可能达成政治上的和解。

meaning: v. 围攻；围
n. 刺客，暗杀者
example: He decided no assassin would chance a shot from amongst that crowd.
translation: 他认定，没有刺客会冒险混在人群里开枪。

meaning: n. 远景，狭长的街景；展望；回顾
v. 装备；供以军用品，供以服装
adj. 第一的；最初的; n. 总理，首相
example: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.
translation: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。

meaning: n. 骗子；欺骗；谎话; v. 欺骗；哄骗
example: There was all the usual humbug and obligatory compliments from ministers.
translation: 全都是些部长们常说的骗人鬼话和少不了的奉承恭维。

meaning: v. 沸腾；冒泡；激动; n. 沸腾；感情等的迸发
example: He is seething at all the bad press he is getting.
translation: 他正为所有那些关于自己的负面报道窝着一肚子火。

meaning: adj. 有实质的；大量的；真实的；独立存在的; n. 名词性实词；独立存在的实体
example: WTO - consistency had to be secured substantively as well.
translation: 与WTO的一致性还必须获得实质性的保证.

meaning: n. 恩惠；福利；利益; adj. 愉快的；慷慨的
example: This battery booster is a boon for photographers.
translation: 这种电池充电器是摄影工作者的好帮手。

meaning: v. 使年轻；使更新；使恢复精神；使复原
example: Shelley was advised that the Italian climate would rejuvenate him.
translation: 有人建议雪莱去意大利，那里的天气会使他恢复活力。

meaning: n. 懒散，懒惰；无痛
example: He was noted for his indolence.
translation: 他的懒惰是出了名的。

meaning: adj. 文字的；逐字的；无夸张的
example: A literal translation of the name Tapies is "walls."
translation: Tapies这个名字直译过来是“墙”。

meaning: adj. 休眠的；静止的；睡眠状态的；隐匿的; n. (Dormant)人名；(法)多尔芒
example: The virus remains dormant in nerve tissue until activated.
translation: 病毒潜伏于神经组织里直到被激活。

meaning: n. 人类学家；人类学者
example: The lecturer is an anthropologist.
translation: 这位讲师是人类学家。

meaning: n. 联盟，联合；联姻
example: What will be the effect of the alliance between IBM and Apple?
translation: 若IBM公司和苹果公司联合将会有什么效果呢？

meaning: adj. 可锻的；可塑的；有延展性的；易适应的
example: The malleable mayor of New York was under his control.
translation: 这位听话的纽约市市长听命于他。

meaning: v. 伪造；篡改；歪曲；证明虚假
example: They falsify or deny whatever doesn't suit their books.
translation: 他们篡改或者否定任何不符合他们意见的东西.

meaning: n. 能见度，可见性；能见距离；明显性
example: He was making a visible effort to control himself.
translation: 他明显是在努力控制自己的情绪。

meaning: adj. 过度的；无节制的；紊乱的
example: They spend an inordinate amount of time talking.
translation: 他们花在说上的时间太多了。

meaning: adj. 缩短了的；被删节的；切去顶端的; v. 缩短（truncate的过去分词）；截去…的顶端
example: Such truncation is evidence of an erosional hiatus.
translation: 这种削蚀现象是侵蚀沉积间断的证据.

meaning: n. [鸟] 金丝雀；淡黄色
example: His body was found at sea in waters off the Canary Islands.
translation: 他的尸体在离加那利群岛不远的海上被发现。

meaning: adj. 世界性的；世界主义的，四海一家的; n. 四海为家者；世界主义者；世界各地都有的东西
example: The family are rich, and extremely sophisticated and cosmopolitan.
translation: 这家人很富有，老于世故，而且见多识广。

meaning: n. 微波，小浪
example: In quantum mechanics all particles, not only photons, exhibit wavelike properties.
translation: 在量子力学中不仅光子, 而且所有粒子都显示波性.

meaning: adj. 讽刺的；反话的
example: It's ironic that she became a teacher—she used to hate school.
translation: 令人啼笑皆非的是她成了教师—她过去一向厌恶上学。

meaning: n. 结论；裁定
n. 恋情；偷情，奸情
example: I'm sorry for your sake that I had no hopeless amour.
translation: 为了你的缘故,我感到遗憾的是,我不曾有过那种毫无希望的不正当男女关系.

meaning: n. 失重；无重状态
example: Surely such weighty matters merit a higher level of debate?
translation: 这样重大的事件谅必应进行更高级别的讨论吧？

meaning: adj. 系统的；体系的；有系统的；[图情] 分类的；一贯的，惯常的
example: The way he works isn't very systematical.
translation: 他的工作方法不是很有条理.

meaning: v. 使习惯于，使熟悉于
example: One can habituate oneself to living alone, though rarely with any pleasure.
translation: 虽然独自一人生活很少会有乐趣,但还是可以习惯的.

meaning: adj. 大量的；实质的；内容充实的; n. 本质；重要材料
example: substantial evidence
translation: 确实证据

meaning: adj. 和谐的，和睦的；协调的；悦耳的
example: It is a harmonious community where pupils are happy and industrious.
translation: 这是一个和睦的集体，学生们开心玩耍，用功读书。

meaning: n. 智力；情报工作；情报机关；理解力；才智，智慧；天分
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: n. 快乐主义；快乐论
example: The age of hedonism is being ushered out by a new era of temperance.
translation: 享乐主义时代正让位于一个注重节制的时代。

meaning: adj. 不适当的，不相称的；不合身的，不得体的
v. 断章取义；歪曲；混淆; n. 断章取义；混淆；篡改
example: You garble my words from their real meaning.
translation: 你曲解了我的话的真实含义。

meaning: adj. 有勇无谋的；蛮干的
example: It was foolhardy to have refused.
translation: 拒绝是极不明智的。

meaning: n. 弹性；弹力；灵活性
example: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
translation: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

meaning: n. 仪式；惯例；礼制; adj. 仪式的；例行的；礼节性的
example: What we see at Westminster is a tired old ritual.
translation: 我们在威斯敏斯特教堂看到的是一种经年不变的古旧仪式。

meaning: n. 绰号；昵称; v. 给……取绰号；叫错名字
example: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
translation: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

meaning: n. 行话；轻快脚步声；急速拍打声; v. 滴答地响；急速地说；发出急速轻拍声
example: Fran began her automatic patter about how Jon had been unavoidably detained.
translation: 弗兰开始不由自主地唠叨起乔恩是怎样无可避免地被扣留的。

meaning: n. 钟摆；摇锤；摇摆不定的事态
example: In education, the pendulum has swung back to traditional teaching methods.
translation: 教育界又恢复了传统教学法。

meaning: adj. 装正经的；过分规矩的
example: I'm not prudish but I think these photographs are obscene.
translation: 我并不是假正经的人，但我觉得这些照片非常淫秽。

meaning: adj. 引导的，介绍的；开端的
example: The chairman made a few introductory remarks.
translation: 会议主席说了几句开场白.

meaning: v. 泄露；暴露
example: I do not want to divulge where the village is.
translation: 我不想透露那个村庄在哪儿。

meaning: adj. 热情的；热心的；狂热的
example: Bob Dole seemed less than enthusiastic about the proposed move.
translation: 鲍勃·多尔似乎对提议的这项行动不太感兴趣。

meaning: adj. 警惕的；警醒的；注意的；警戒的
example: Christian Slater has a new movie coming out next month in which he plays a vigilante.
translation: 克里斯汀·史莱特有一部新片下月发行，他在片中扮演一个治安维持会成员。

meaning: v. 衬托；阻止，挡开；挫败；贴箔于; n. 箔，金属薄片；衬托，烘托；叶形片; abbr. 面向文件的翻译语言（file-Oriented interpretive language）
example: He thought of her serenity as a foil for his intemperance.
translation: 在他看来，她的平静反衬出了他的放纵。

meaning: adj. 刺状的；多刺的；尖尖的；难弄的
example: spinous process
translation: 棘突；神经突；脊柱棘突；棘状突起

meaning: n. 疲乏；懒散；厌倦
example: Symptoms of anaemia include general fatigue and lassitude.
translation: 贫血症状包括全身疲劳和困乏。

meaning: n. 词典编纂者
example: A lexicographer's job is to describe the language.
translation: 词典编纂者的工作就是对语言加以描述。

meaning: adj. 热的；热心的
example: He is a fervid orator.
translation: 他是个慷慨激昂的演说者。

meaning: adj. 无数的；种种的; n. 无数，极大数量；无数的人或物
example: Designs are available in a myriad of colours.
translation: 各种色彩的款式应有尽有。

meaning: n. 医务室；医院；养老院
example: Mrs Hardie had been taken to the infirmary in an ambulance.
translation: 哈迪夫人被救护车送到了医院。

meaning: adj. 移情作用的；同感的（等于empathic）
example: Smart people aren't confused , Empathetic people don't worry, Brave people aren't afraid.
translation: 知者不惑,仁者不忧, 勇者不惧.

meaning: v. 创新；改革；革新
example: innovate in
translation: 对…革新

meaning: adj. 痛苦的；剧烈的
example: Mr Morris said the victims had suffered from a very grievous mistake.
translation: 莫里斯先生说遇难者因为一个极其严重的失误而遭遇不幸。

meaning: v. 使蓬乱；使头发凌乱；弄乱
n. 新词；新义；新词的使用
example: The newspaper used the neologism "dinks", Double Income No Kids.
translation: 报纸使用了新词“丁克族”，即“双收入无子女”。

meaning: adj. 肮脏的，污秽的
example: Something was sticking from the pocket of the little man's grimy shorts.
translation: 小个子男人脏乎乎的短裤口袋里鼓鼓的，伸出来个什么东西。

meaning: adj. 吓呆的，惊骇的；吃惊的
example: Tania stared at him aghast, unable to speak.
translation: 塔妮娅吃惊地看着他，说不出话来。

meaning: adj. 有说服力的；劝诱的，劝说的
example: Michael Grade's persuasive powers overcame their objections.
translation: 迈克尔·格雷德能言善辩，驳倒了他们的反对意见。

meaning: n. 方面；侧面；旁边; v. 支持；赞助；偏袒; adj. 旁的，侧的
example: Tom pulled out his Sidearm and warily moved to the fallen aliens.
translation: 汤姆拔出他的手枪,警惕地向倒地的外星人移动.

meaning: n. 骚动；骚乱；吵闹；激动
example: Many soldiers were wounded in that tumultuary battle.
translation: 许多士兵在那场混乱的战斗中受了伤.

meaning: adj. 夜的；夜曲的；夜间发生的
example: The dormouse is a shy, nocturnal creature.
translation: 榛睡鼠是一种在夜间活动的胆小动物。

meaning: n. 欢喜；嬉戏
example: What calls for this merriment?
translation: 什么事值得这么高兴?

meaning: v. 解析；从语法上分析; n. 从语法上分析；分列
example: I simply couldn't parse what you just said.
translation: 我完全无法对你刚说的话作语法分析。

meaning: n. 搅拌；轰动; v. 搅拌；激起；惹起
example: I crammed my mouth with stirabout for fear I might give utterance to my anger.
translation: 我生怕自己会吐出气愤的声音,拼命往嘴里喂麦片粥.

meaning: v. 确立，牢固；用壕沟围住；挖掘
example: To hold on stubbornly, as to a position; entrench oneself.
translation: 固执地坚持立场; 稳固自己的地位.

meaning: vi. 枯萎；凋谢；干瘪; vt. 使凋谢；使枯萎；使干瘪; adj. 凋谢的；枯萎的
example: a wizened little man
translation: 干瘪的小老头

meaning: v. 使满足；使满意，使高兴
example: He did that to gratify his girlfriend's vanity.
translation: 他做那事是要满足他女友的虚荣心.

meaning: adj. 燃烧的；强烈的；发热的; n. 燃烧; vi. 燃烧（burn的现在分词）
example: Because you're not burning calories, everything you eat turns to fat.
translation: 由于没有消耗卡路里，你吃的所有东西都会变成脂肪。

meaning: adj. 显著的；显而易见的
example: You may feel tearful in situations where you feel conspicuous.
translation: 觉得自己身处众目睽睽之下时，你可能会有想哭的感觉。

meaning: v. 征服；使服从；克制
example: They have maintained their optimism in the face of desolating subjugation.
translation: 面对遭征服的悲惨命运，他们保持了乐观的态度。

meaning: n. 破裂；决裂；疝气; v. 破裂；发疝气
example: Sloshing liquids can rupture the walls of their containers.
translation: 晃动液体可以使容器壁破裂。

meaning: v. 啮合；摇动，摇曳；轻摇; n. 啮合；轻摇，摇动；榫接
example: " Oh, don't, Sid. Don't joggle me. "
translation: “ 啊, 希德, 不要这样,不要推我. ”

meaning: n. [数][计] 序列；顺序；续发事件; v. 按顺序排好
example: They are only available when playing a MIDI file by external sequencer!
translation: 他们只用时由外部音序演奏MIDI文件!

meaning: n. 抗议；规劝；谏书
example: She had abandoned all attempts at remonstrance with Thomas.
translation: 她已经放弃了一切劝戒托马斯的尝试.

meaning: adj. 非正式的；不拘礼节的；随便的；通俗的；日常使用的
example: Council members are due to have informal discussions later on today.
translation: 委员会成员定于今日晚些时候进行非正式讨论。

meaning: v. 互相影响；互相作用; n. 幕间剧；幕间休息
example: After initiation, the youths started to interact with the older members.
translation: 入会仪式后，这些小伙子与老成员开始互动。

meaning: v. 先于；前于; n. 比实际提前的日期
example: The cold weather antedate ed their departure.
translation: 寒冷的天气使他们提前离开.

meaning: v. 使迷惑；施魔法
example: Percy's enchant-ment with orchids dates back to 1951.
translation: 珀西对兰花的痴迷可以回溯到1951年。

meaning: adj. 精确的；明确的；严格的
example: Elgar supplied his works with precise indications of tempo.
translation: 埃尔加给自己的作品标上了精确的节奏标记。

meaning: n. 拱廊；（内设投角子电子游戏机等的）游乐场；有拱廊的街道; vt. 使有拱廊
example: We go to the amusement arcade on Saturdays to play the electronic games.
translation: 每个星期六我们去娱乐城玩电子游戏.

meaning: adj. 忧郁的；使人悲伤的; n. 忧郁；悲哀；愁思
example: He fixed me with those luminous, empty eyes and his melancholy smile.
translation: 他笑容忧郁地凝视着我，闪亮的眼睛里空无一物。

meaning: adj. 吵闹的；粗暴的; n. 粗暴的人；好吵闹的人
example: There were rowdy scenes inside parliament during the debate.
translation: 在争论的过程中，国会内部一片混乱。

meaning: adj. 谨慎的；小心的
example: She had meant to make a discreet entrance, but conversation stopped dead.
translation: 她本打算悄悄进去，但谈话却突然中断了。

meaning: n. 糖原；动物淀粉
example: After the animal is killed, glycogen falls apart into glucose.
translation: 动物被杀后, 肝糖元分解为葡萄糖.

meaning: n. 刚毅，大胆；厚颜；胆大无敌
example: Jack had the hardihood to deny what he has done.
translation: 杰克厚颜地否认了自己所干的事.

meaning: v. 反驳，驳斥；驳倒
example: Isabelle is quick to refute any suggestion of intellectual snobbery.
translation: 伊莎贝尔对于任何关于她恃才傲物的暗示都迅速予以否认。

meaning: adj. 组成的，构成的; n. 成分；组件；[电子] 元件
example: The menu is all-important. Every component of every meal should create contrasts.
translation: 饭菜的安排至关重要。每一顿饭的每一道菜都应该有所不同。

meaning: v. 使惊骇；使震惊
example: If we did all the things we are capable of doing, we would literally astound ourselves.
translation: 如果把我们能做到的都做了，最终连我们自己都会被吓到。

meaning: n. 推翻；倾覆；瓦解; v. 推翻；打倒；倾覆
example: These feelings are likely to make people attempt to overthrow the system.
translation: 这些情绪有可能促使人们想要推翻现行的体制。

meaning: n. 观点；远景；透视图; adj. 透视的
example: It's the collision of disparate ideas that alters one's perspective.
translation: 是迥然不同的观点之间的碰撞改变了人们的看法。

meaning: adj. 眼睛的；视觉的；目击的; n. [光] 目镜
example: Other ocular signs include involuntary rhythmic movement of the eyeball.
translation: 其他眼征包括眼球的无意识节奏运动。

meaning: n. 四边形; adj. 四边形的
example: A trapezoid is a quadrilateral with two parallel sides.
translation: 梯形是具有两平行边的四边形.

meaning: v. 使衰弱，使失去活力; adj. 衰弱的，无力的
n. 类似的音，谐音；类韵
example: Theand easy language of assonance word easy to read, make people pleased, the meaning colorful.
translation: 叠韵词语言浅显明快、琅琅上口, 令人心情愉悦, 并使语意内涵丰富多彩.

meaning: n. 显赫；卓越；高处
example: For those under 40 the pre-eminence of post-war US literature goes unquestioned.
translation: 对于那些不到40岁的人来说，战后的美国文学无疑是最杰出的。

meaning: v. 反驳；揭露；拒绝; n. 驳回；提出反证
example: He attempts to rebut the assertion made by the prosecution witness.
translation: 他试图反驳原告方证人所作的断言.

meaning: n. 光谱；频谱；范围；余象
n. 教师，教员；卖弄学问者
example: De Gaulle was a born pedagogue who used the public platform and the television screen to great effect.
translation: 戴高乐生来喜欢教育人，他充分利用了公共讲坛和电视荧屏。

meaning: v. 迫近；即将发生
example: Crucial events impend in Europe.
translation: 欧洲即将发生具有决定意义的事变.

meaning: v. 发出，表达；发射; adj. 完全的；彻底的；无条件的; n. (Utter)人名；(德、芬)乌特
example: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
translation: 他说的每句话都会被仔细审查。

meaning: adj. 难吃的；没有香味的；令人讨厌的
n. 枫树；淡棕色
example: Early settlers built frames of spruce, maple and pine.
translation: 早期的定居者用云杉木、枫木和松木建造屋架。

meaning: v. 识别；领悟，认识
example: Below the bridge we could just discern a narrow, weedy ditch.
translation: 我们仅能依稀辨出桥下一条杂草丛生的窄沟。

meaning: n. 市议员；总督；市府参事；高级市政官
example: After a full hearing, the alderman gave it as his opinion.
translation: 参事先生听了全部报告之后,说出了他的意见.

meaning: v. 使贬值；降低…的价值
example: They spread tales about her in an attempt to devalue her work.
translation: 他们散布一些有关她的流言，企图贬低她的工作。

meaning: n. 不受惩罚；无患；[法] 免罚
example: Mr Cook said future aggressors would be able to act with impunity if the objectives of the UN weren't met.
translation: 库克先生说如果联合国的目标无法达成，那么将来的侵略者就可能会逃脱惩罚。

meaning: adj. 矛盾的；诡论的；似非而是的
example: We were a team of individuals — as paradoxical as that sounds.
translation: 我们是一个保持了个体的团队——尽管这听起来自相矛盾。

meaning: v. 溢出；泛滥；充溢; n. 充满，洋溢；泛滥；超值；溢值
example: Tents have been set up next to hospitals to handle the overflow.
translation: 医院旁搭起了帐篷以安置容纳不下的人员。

meaning: adj. 粗糙的；天然的，未加工的；粗鲁的; n. 原油；天然的物质
example: Oil majors need not fear being unable to sell their crude.
translation: 大型石油公司无需担心原油销售不出去。

meaning: n. 演说者；演讲者；雄辩家；原告
example: Lenin was the great orator of the Russian Revolution.
translation: 列宁是俄国革命时期伟大的演说家。

meaning: adj. 义务的；必修的；被强制的; n. （花样滑冰、竞技体操等的）规定动作
example: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
translation: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

meaning: n. 编年史，年代记；记录; v. 记录；把…载入编年史
example: Before the Chronicle I used to take the Guardian.
translation: 在订阅《纪事报》以前，我看的是《卫报》。

meaning: adj. 不同的；不相干的；全异的; n. 无法相比的东西
example: It's the collision of disparate ideas that alters one's perspective.
translation: 是迥然不同的观点之间的碰撞改变了人们的看法。

meaning: n. 退化；降格，降级；堕落
example: They were sickened by the scenes of misery and degradation they found.
translation: 目睹困苦、潦倒的景象，他们感到心里极不舒服。

meaning: v. 细阅；作详细检查; n. 仔细或彻底检查
n. 提升，[劳经] 晋升；推销，促销；促进；发扬，振兴
example: The advertising campaign will be supported by a PR and below-the-line promotion.
translation: 广告宣传活动将采取公关和线下促销的形式。

meaning: adj. 合法的；正当的；合理的；正统的; v. 使合法；认为正当（等于legitimize）
example: Most doctors appear to recognize homeopathy as a legitimate form of medicine.
translation: 大多数医生似乎都接受顺势疗法是一种合理的医疗手段。

meaning: v. 颁布；制定法律；扮演；发生
example: The king could not enact laws without the sanction of Parliament.
translation: 未经议会批准，国王不能制定法律。

meaning: adj. 仁慈的；慈善的；亲切的
example: They believe that the country needs a benevolent dictator.
translation: 他们认为国家需要一位仁爱的独裁者。

meaning: n. 风景；风景画；景色；山水画；乡村风景画；地形；（文件的）横向打印格式; v. 对…做景观美化，给…做园林美化；从事庭园设计
example: Wind turbines are large and noisy and they disfigure the landscape.
translation: 风力涡轮机个头大、噪音响，还会破坏周边风景。

meaning: n. 分析；分解；验定
example: Throughout, she illustrates her analysis with excerpts from discussions.
translation: 自始至终，她摘引讨论内容来阐明她的分析。

meaning: n. 年金，养老金；年金保险；年金享受权
n. 梦魇；沉重的负担
example: Joyce regarded his US citizenship as a moral and political incubus.
translation: 乔伊斯把他的美国公民身份当做是一个道德和政治上的负担。

meaning: n. 法律体系；法学及其分支；法律知识；法院审判规程
example: a professor of jurisprudence
translation: 法学教授

meaning: n. 胆怯，胆小；羞怯
example: The little boy stepped forward timidly and shook Leo's hand.
translation: 小男孩羞怯地走上前去握了握利奥的手。

meaning: n. 庇护；收容所，救济院
example: Fewer than 7% of asylum seekers are accepted as political refugees.
translation: 寻求避难者中有不到7%的人被视作政治难民。

meaning: n. 雄辩；演讲术
example: The wedding will be at the Brompton Oratory next month.
translation: 婚礼将于下月在布朗普顿礼拜堂举行。

meaning: n. [化学] 臭氧；新鲜的空气
example: Ozone is a highly reactive form of oxygen gas.
translation: 臭氧是一种非常活跃的氧气形态。

meaning: n. 管理人；监护人；保管人
example: a self-appointed custodian of public morals
translation: 自封的公共道德的卫道士

meaning: n. 热望，贪欲；活动性
example: Philosophers have an avidity to know how we perceive objects.
translation: 哲学家渴望明了人类如何领悟事物之问题.

meaning: n. 争论；论战；辩论
example: Legislation to that effect created fierce controversy both in Parliament and outside.
translation: 那类立法在议会内外都引起了激烈的争论。

meaning: adj. 盲从的；合于逻辑的；缺乏独创性的
example: I loved this book was apage turner. I cannot wait to read the sequal.
translation: 非常喜欢这本书. 这本书让你欲罢不能,我迫不及待地想去读续集.

meaning: n. 感染；传染；影响；传染病
example: A cold is an infection of the upper respiratory tract.
translation: 感冒是上呼吸道的感染。

meaning: adj. 顽固的；顽强的；难处理的
example: Some interest rates have remained stubbornly high.
translation: 部分利率一直居高不下。

meaning: adj. 原始的；根本的；原生的
example: Twenty million years ago, Idaho was populated by dense primordial forest.
translation: 2,000万年前，爱达荷州到处都是茂密的原始森林。

meaning: v. 化脓；怨恨；发炎
example: You burrow and rankle in his heart!
translation: 你挖掘并折磨他的心灵!

meaning: v. 不信任；怀疑; n. 不信任；怀疑
example: I tended to mistrust my emotions and intellectualize everything.
translation: 我往往不相信自己的情感，倾向于把一切事物都理智化。

meaning: adj. 美味的，可口的；愉快的
example: Some of the dialogue has been changed to make it more palatable to an American audience.
translation: 有些对白有所修改以适应美国观众的口味。

meaning: adj. 恰当的；善于措辞的；幸福的
example: Her prose style is not always felicitous; she tends to repetition.
translation: 她的行文风格并非总是恰到好处，往往爱重复。

meaning: adj. 等边的；等面的; n. 等边形
example: Use your protractor to construct an equilateral triangle.
translation: 用量角器作一个等边三角形.

meaning: n. 担保；保证；保证人
adj. 理论的；理论上的；假设的；推理的
example: Theoretically, the price is supposed to be marked on the shelf.
translation: 照理说，价格应该标在货架上。

meaning: v. 注释；给…作注释或评注
example: Historians annotate, check and interpret the diary selections.
translation: 历史学家对日记选篇进行加注、核查以及阐释。

meaning: adj. 充满的；装满的; n. [昆] 贮蜜蚁
example: Replete, guests can then retire to the modern conservatory for coffee.
translation: 吃饱喝足后，宾客们可以到现代化的暖房里享受一杯咖啡。

meaning: adj. 纯洁的；贞洁的；有道德的；朴素的; n. (Chaste)人名；(法)沙斯特
example: He remained chaste.
translation: 他一直保持童贞之身。

meaning: adj. 赞美的；赞赏的；称赞的
example: The New York Times has this very laudatory article about your retirement.
translation: 《纽约时报》发文谈及你的隐退，文中对你大加赞扬。

meaning: n. 任期；占有; v. 授予…终身职位
example: land tenure
translation: 土地占有制

meaning: n. 白话，口语；口语体；方言用语
example: The writer aerateed his writing with a persuasive colloquialism.
translation: 作者用一种有说服力的口语体使他的文章显得生动.

meaning: v. 放弃；停止；对…断念
example: No one was prepared to forgo their lunch hour to attend the meeting.
translation: 谁都不愿意放弃午餐时间出席会议。

meaning: adj. 光辉的；华丽的
example: Bessie, resplendent in royal blue velvet, was hovering beside the table.
translation: 贝茜身穿华丽的深蓝色天鹅绒衣服，在桌旁徘徊。

meaning: adj. 永恒的；不朽的
example: The series chronicles the everyday adventures of two eternal bachelors.
translation: 这个系列剧按照时间顺序记述了两个老光棍每天的奇遇。

meaning: v. 充满；弥漫
example: He suffered from suffusion of blood on the brain.
translation: 他患脑溢血.

meaning: v. 使……失去；使……孤寂
example: Nothing can bereave us of such sweet memories.
translation: 没有什么东西可以夺去我们这样甜蜜的记忆.

meaning: adj. 隐性的；逆行的；后退的; n. 隐性性状
example: Sickle-cell anaemia is passed on through a recessive gene.
translation: 镰状细胞贫血通过隐性基因遗传给后代。

meaning: n. 大厅；休息室；会客室；游说议员的团体; v. 对……进行游说
example: The union has attacked the plan and threatened to lobby against it.
translation: 工会不但攻击该计划，而且还扬言要游说议员反对它。

meaning: adv. 顺时针方向地; adj. 顺时针方向的
example: He told the children to start moving clockwise around the room.
translation: 他让孩子们开始按顺时针方向绕着房间走。

meaning: v. 核实；查证
example: Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
translation: 我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要卖我了。

meaning: adj. 连续的；其次的；作为结果而产生的; n. 结果；相继发生的事
example: Mass for Saint Sebaldus: Introitus - Graduale - Alleluia - Sequentia - Offertorium - Communio .
translation: 圣塞巴都弥撒: 进台咏—升阶经—哈利路亚— 继叙 经 — 献祭经.

meaning: v. （使）音相谐，（使）成为准押韵
v. 包含；牵涉；使陷于；潜心于
example: The £85m programme will involve an extensive rebranding of the airline.
translation: 这个8,500万英镑的项目将包括全面重塑该航空公司的形象。

meaning: n. 核心，核子；原子核（nucleus的复数形式）
example: To free electrons, something has to make them whirl fast enough to break away from their nuclei.
translation: 为了释放电子, 必须使电子高速旋转而足以摆脱原子核的束缚.

meaning: v. 突出；强调；使显著；加亮; n. 最精彩的部分；最重要的事情；加亮区
example: Once again, the "Free Press" prefers not to highlight these facts.
translation: “自由新闻”组织再次故意不去突出强调这些事实。

meaning: v. 烧焦；烤焦; n. 烧焦；烤焦
example: Howard wanted to be a popular singer, but stage fright crippled him.
translation: 霍华德想成为流行歌手，但因怯场而心生畏惧。

meaning: n. 传感器
example: temperature sensor
translation: 温度传感器

meaning: adj. 夸张的；夸大的；大言不惭的
example: She attacked her colleagues for indulging in "grandiose and grandiloquent language".
translation: 她抨击同事“言辞浮夸做作”。

meaning: n. 真实性，确实性；可靠性
example: There are factors, however, that have cast doubt on the statue's authenticity.
translation: 然而，有些因素让人对该雕塑的真伪产生了怀疑。

meaning: n. [试剂] 试剂；反应物
example: It is like a chemical reagent.
translation: 这就像是一种化学试剂.

meaning: v. 加强；增强；（酒）的酒精含量；设防于
example: This country will fortify the coastal areas.
translation: 该国将加强沿海地区的防御.

meaning: adj. 不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的
example: Car firms are desperate to achieve economies of scale.
translation: 汽车厂商拼命想要实现规模经济。

meaning: n. 力学（用作单数）；结构；技术；机械学（用作单数）
example: The mechanics of the job, however, have changed little since then.
translation: 不过，工作流程从那以后就几乎没有任何变化。

meaning: v. 使无效，作废；取消
example: Judges were unwilling to nullify government decisions.
translation: 法官们不愿废止政府决定。

meaning: v. 走动；步行；移动
example: The patient was allowed to ambulate in the room.
translation: 允许病人在屋里走动.

meaning: n. 篇；曲调；长诗的篇章
example: It's the fourth canto of Byron's "Childe Harold".
translation: 这是拜伦长诗《恰尔德·哈罗尔德游记》的第四章。

meaning: v. 使隔离；使孤立；使绝缘; n. [生物] 隔离种群; adj. 隔离的；孤立的
example: Political influence is being used to shape public opinion and isolate critics.
translation: 政治影响正被用来左右公众舆论，使批评家们陷于孤立。

meaning: adj. 诊断的；特征的; n. 诊断法；诊断结论
example: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.
translation: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

meaning: v. 加快；促进；发出; adj. 畅通的；迅速的；方便的
example: We tried to help you expedite your plans.
translation: 我们尽力帮你加快实现你的计划。

meaning: n. 统治者，君主；有权势的人
example: City prayers were vain against the great rural potentate.
translation: 城市里的祈祷文对于乡村中这个了不起的有权有势的人竟然毫无用处.

meaning: v. 禁止，取缔; n. 禁令，禁忌
example: The Partial Test-Ban Treaty bans nuclear testing in the atmosphere.
translation: 《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止在大气层中进行核试验。

meaning: n. 转让；转移；传递；过户; v. 转让；转学；换车
example: One pre - condition for transferability is the pricing for such non - transferable shares.
translation: 解决全流通问题的前提是如何给 非 流通股定价.

meaning: v. 大量出现；充满; n. (Teem)人名；(英)蒂姆
example: For most of the year, the area is teeming with tourists.
translation: 一年中大部分时间里，这个地区游人如织。

meaning: v. 逃匿，潜逃；避债
example: Afterwards, they sell the ship and the goods and abscond.
translation: 然后, 他们卖掉船和货物,各自潜逃.

meaning: adj. 惊人的，异常的，奇妙的；巨大的
example: Laser discs can store prodigious amounts of information.
translation: 激光磁盘能够贮存大量信息。

meaning: v. 注定
example: You are a very kind person, but we have no predestine relationship.
translation: 你是个很好的人, 但是我们没有缘份.

meaning: v. 使腐坏；使混乱; adj. 腐坏的；糊涂的，昏乱的
example: The object is to addle and not to elucidate.
translation: 其目的是为了混淆而不是为了阐明.

meaning: n. 围攻；包围；围城；不断袭击；长期努力; vt. 围攻；包围
example: Siegfried cringed and shrank against the wall.
translation: 西格弗里德畏缩了，退避到墙根。

meaning: n. 指针；指示器；教鞭；暗示
example: Sunday's elections should be a pointer to the public mood.
translation: 从周日的选举可以看出公众的情绪。

meaning: n. 蔬菜；植物；植物人; adj. 蔬菜的；植物的
example: vegetable oil
translation: 植物油

meaning: v. 补偿，赔偿；抵消
example: The hospital staff were very apologetic but that couldn't really compensate.
translation: 医院的工作人员深表歉意，但这真的于事无补。

meaning: n. 新手，生手；初学者
example: Which one of Tyrol's deckhands recently got a big promotion?
translation: 泰罗尔的那个手下最近被升职了?

meaning: adj. 庞大的，巨大的
example: My gargantuan, pristine machine was good for writing papers and playing solitaire, and that was all.
translation: 我那庞大的 、 早期的计算机只适合写文章和玩纸牌游戏, 就这些.

meaning: n. 变迁；盛衰；变化无常；变迁兴衰
n. 贫血；贫血症
example: The doctors analyzed the blood sample for anemia.
translation: 医生们分析了贫血的血样.

meaning: v. 消灭；涂去；冲刷；忘掉
example: Their warheads are enough to obliterate the world several times over.
translation: 他们拥有的弹头足以将世界毁灭好几次。

meaning: adj. 热带的；热情的；酷热的
example: tropical fruit
translation: 热带水果

meaning: adj. 球根的；球根状的；由球根生长的（等于bulbaceous）
example: a bulbous red nose
translation: 蒜头红鼻子

meaning: n. 恳求，请求；辩解，辩护；借口，托辞
example: Her plea of guilty to manslaughter through provocation was rejected.
translation: 她因受到挑衅而过失杀人的有罪答辩被驳回。

meaning: adj. 植物的；植物人状态的，无所作为的；促使植物生长的；有生长力的
example: These are inherent and apparently permanent and can be propagated vegetatively.
translation: 这些具有内在的和明显的遗传性,并可以无性繁殖.

meaning: n. 小道传闻；随笔；爱说长道短的人; v. 闲聊；传播流言蜚语
example: It provided some juicy gossip for a few days.
translation: 这制造了一些非常八卦的流言蜚语，足够说上几天的。

meaning: v. 订阅；捐款；认购；赞成；签署
example: I have been a subscriber to Railway Magazine for many years.
translation: 我订阅《铁路杂志》已有很多年了。

meaning: adj. 无水的
example: Anhydrous nitric acid is dissociated.
translation: 无水硝酸是电离的.

meaning: v. 仲裁；公断
example: to arbitrate in a dispute
translation: 在一场纠纷中进行仲裁

meaning: n. 屁股；烟头；笑柄；靶垛；粗大的一端; v. 以头抵撞；碰撞
example: She would have liked to tell him to butt out.
translation: 她本想告诉他叫他别插手的。

meaning: adj. 吸水的；嗜酒的
example: He is a bibulous fellow.
translation: 他是个爱喝酒的家伙。

meaning: n. 层级；等级制度
example: The principle of hierarchy does not equate to totalitarian terror.
translation: 等级制度在原则上并不等同于极权主义恐怖。

meaning: n. 豌豆
example: green pea
translation: 嫩豌豆；青豌豆

meaning: v. 阻碍；妨碍；阻止
example: One shouldn't impede other's progress.
translation: 一个人不应该妨碍他人进步.

meaning: v. 超过；胜过
example: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day.
translation: 每天的饮酒量不应超过两个计量单位。

meaning: adj. 清晰的；易读的；易辨认的
example: Any word that's not legible will be counted as wrong.
translation: 任何无法辨认的词都将视为错字。

meaning: adj. 安静的；沉着的; v. 给…服镇静剂
example: He pulled sedately out of the short driveway.
translation: 他慢慢地把车开出了巴掌大的私人车道。

meaning: v. 排除；排斥；拒绝接纳；逐出
example: The first task was to fence the wood to exclude sheep.
translation: 第一项任务就是把树林围起来不让羊进去。

meaning: n. 大主教；总教主
example: He denounced the decision to invite his fellow archbishop to preach.
translation: 他痛斥了邀请其他大主教同仁布道的决定。

meaning: n. 天窗；煤桶；筐; v. 逃避；急促地跑
example: All this scuttlebutt was laughed off as nonsense.
translation: 这些小道消息被当做一派胡言.

meaning: adj. 兽性的，卑劣的；残忍的；野蛮的; n. 牛
example: A statement on Amman Radio spoke of bestial aggression and a horrible massacre.
translation: 安曼广播电台播放的一则声明提到了野蛮的侵略和骇人的大屠杀。

meaning: adj. 牧歌的；牧羊的；乡下风味的; n. 田园诗；农夫
example: Bucolic, conservative stuff, but nice and solid.
translation: 这是农村风味的保守的作品, 但是很好,很扎实.

meaning: v. 发掘；掘出; n. (Exhume)人名；(法)埃克叙姆
example: Cherish, enrich and exhume yourselves, and the world will identify with your value at last.
translation: 珍惜你自己, 不断充实,发掘自己, 最后世界才会认同你的价值.

meaning: adj. 可能的；想得到的，可想像的
example: Without their support the project would not have been conceivable.
translation: 如果没有他们的支持，这个项目根本就不可想象。

meaning: n. 推理；论证；评理; adj. 推理的; v. 推论；说服（reason的ing形式）
example: No amount of reasoning could shake him out of his conviction.
translation: 再怎样跟他讲道理都不能让他放弃自己认准的事。

meaning: n. 赦免；无罪开释；履行；尽职；（债务等的）清偿
example: The jury voted 8-to-4 in favor of acquittal.
translation: 陪审团以8比4的投票结果赞成无罪判决。

meaning: n. 狂热者，热心家
example: I must confess I'm not a great enthusiast for long political programmes.
translation: 我必须承认自己对时间很长的政治节目不是很热衷。

meaning: v. 用硫磺处理; n. 硫磺；硫磺色
example: sulfur dioxide
translation: 二氧化硫

meaning: adj. 流畅的；如蜜般的
example: I grew up around people who had wonderful, mellifluous voices.
translation: 从小到大，生活在我周围的人都有着悦耳动听的嗓音。

meaning: n. 力量；武力；军队；魄力; v. 促使，推动；强迫；强加
example: They used force to banish the natives from the more fertile land.
translation: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。

meaning: v. 石化；惊呆
example: Slogans petrify our thinking.
translation: 口号僵化了我们的思想.

meaning: n. 语言学
example: These ideas rapidly became the new orthodoxy in linguistics.
translation: 这些观点迅速成为语言学中新的正统观念。

meaning: n. 新词；旧词新义（等于neologism）
example: Neology is the embodiment of economical principle the outcome of self - adjustment in the lexical system.
translation: 旧词产生新义是经济原则在语言中的体现,是词汇系统内部 自我 调整的结果.

meaning: n. 责任，义务；负担
example: The onus is on employers to follow health and safety laws.
translation: 雇主有义务遵行健康安全法。

meaning: n. 罪行；犯罪
example: I was to blame in part for this misdeed.
translation: 对这个错误我要负部分责任.

meaning: n. 生态系统
example: The ecosystem will be thrown out of whack.
translation: 生态系统将会失去平衡。

meaning: v. 将…消毒
example: Chlorine is used to disinfect water.
translation: 氯用来给水消毒。

meaning: n. 微光；闪光；少许; v. 闪烁；发微光
example: She saw the occasional glimmer of a moth's wings.
translation: 她看见蛾子的翅膀偶尔会泛光。

meaning: n. 植被；植物，草木；呆板单调的生活
example: The harshness of the climate makes vegetative growth extremely slow.
translation: 恶劣的气候使植物生长特别缓慢。

meaning: n. [数] 余数，残余；剩余物；其余的人; adj. 剩余的；吃剩的; v. 廉价出售；削价出售
example: I spent the remainder of the day feeling terrible.
translation: 我那天余下的时间里心情都很糟糕。

meaning: adj. 富裕的；丰富的；流畅的; n. 支流；富人
example: The Strand is one of London's busiest and most affluent streets.
translation: 斯特兰德街是伦敦最繁华、最富足的街道之一。

meaning: adj. 准确的，精密的；精确的; v. 要求；强求；急需
example: The exact locations are being kept secret for reasons of security.
translation: 确切地点因为安全原因要保密。

meaning: v. 宣传，传播；散布
example: The agency would collect and disseminate information.
translation: 通讯社收集和传播讯息.

meaning: n. 融合；熔化；熔接；融合物；[物] 核聚变
example: the fusion of copper and zinc to produce brass
translation: 铜与锌熔合成黄铜

meaning: v. 重新排列；重新整理
example: You may cancel or rearrange the appointment.
translation: 你可以取消约会或是重新安排约会时间。

meaning: adj. 挑剔的；苛求的，难取悦的；（微生物等）需要复杂营养地
example: Be particularly fastidious about washing your hands before touching food.
translation: 接触食物前尤其对洗手不能有半点马虎。

meaning: v. 颠覆；推翻；破坏
adj. 可怜的；哀怨的；慈悲的
example: As they pass by, a piteous wailing is heard.
translation: 他们经过时，响起了令人哀怜的恸哭。

meaning: n. 黄昏；夕幕; v. 日落；天变黑（gloam的现在分词）
example: The square tower of a church loomed through the gloaming.
translation: 在薄暮中隐约可以看见一个教堂的方塔.

meaning: v. 分离；派遣；使超然
example: It helps them detach themselves from their problems and become more objective.
translation: 这有助于他们从所面临的问题中跳出来，变得更客观一些。

meaning: v. 授权；信任；委派；归因于
example: The president will accredit you as his assistant.
translation: 董事长将任命你做他的助理.

meaning: n. 附录，附件；补遗；附加物
example: This is an addendum to the book.
translation: 这是本书的附录

meaning: n. 守财奴；吝啬鬼；（石油工程上用的）凿井机
example: I'm married to a miser.
translation: 我嫁给了一个守财奴。

meaning: adj. 灰色的；苍白的
example: The survivors were ashen-faced and visibly shaken.
translation: 生还者们面色惨白，看起来仍然惊魂未定。

meaning: adj. 不守规矩的；任性的；难驾驭的
adj. 放荡的，不检点的；恣意挥霍的; n. 放荡者；享乐者
example: Their profligate lifestyle resulted in bankruptcy.
translation: 他们挥霍的生活方式导致的破产.

meaning: adj. 声名狼藉的，臭名昭著的
example: The accident happened on a notorious black spot on the A43.
translation: 事故发生在A43号公路上一个出了名的事故多发地段。

meaning: n. [农] 施肥；[胚] 受精；肥沃
example: the development of in vitro fertilization
translation: 体外受精的研究发展

meaning: n. 幼虫；幼体（larva的复数形式）
n. 憎恶，仇恨，敌意
example: Sir Geoffrey had no personal animosity towards the Prime Minister.
translation: 杰弗里爵士对首相并无私人恩怨。

meaning: v. 赚大钱；牟取暴利; n. [贸易] 奸商；牟取暴利的人
example: He tried to profiteer from this dirty deal.
translation: 他想在这笔肮脏的交易中捞一把.

meaning: v. 娇养；溺爱（等于mollycoddle）；用文火煮
example: This is also a small mouth opening to coddle the broken hand.
translation: 这也是从小饭来张口衣来伸手的娇惯坏了.

meaning: v. 不信；使……丢脸; n. 怀疑；无信用；名声的败坏
example: He says his accusers are trying to discredit government foreign-aid policies.
translation: 他说他的责难者试图使政府的对外援助政策名声扫地。

translation: 姐姐的脸就像圣诞树似的被点亮了. “ 耶! ” 她欢呼.

meaning: adj. 细心的，周到的；慎重的
example: The banks should have been more circumspect in their dealings.
translation: 那些银行在交易中本该更加谨慎的。

meaning: v. 隔离，使孤立；使绝缘，使隔热
example: He continues to insulate his country from the contagion of foreign ideas.
translation: 他继续使本国远离外来思想的侵袭。

meaning: adj. 可抢救的；可打捞的；可挽回的；能利用的
example: Tank wrecks found on maps are no longer salvageable.
translation: 地图上自带的坦克残骸将不能被轴心国工兵回收.

meaning: adj. 先天的，天生的；天赋的
example: When John was 17, he died of congenital heart disease.
translation: 约翰17岁时死于先天性心脏病。

meaning: adj. 敏捷的；聪明的；敏感的

translation: 他是个步伐敏捷的10岁男孩。

meaning: adj. 艰苦的；勤勉的；小心的; n. 辛苦；勤勉
example: Forensic experts carried out a painstaking search of the debris.
translation: 法医专家对残骸进行了极其仔细的搜索。

meaning: n. 声调，语调；语音的抑扬

translation: 英语中有些疑问句使用升调。

meaning: n. 忠告；法庭传票；宗教法庭的诫谕
n. 地方；住所；座位; v. 放置；任命；寄予
example: The United States plans to tighten the economic sanctions currently in place.
translation: 美国计划加大现有经济制裁的力度。

meaning: v. 严惩；苛评；矫正；修订
example: The principal castigate the student who have insult their teacher.
translation: 校长谴责对老师不敬的学生.

meaning: adj. 镇静的；沉着的; v. 组成；作曲（compose的过去分词）；著作
example: She quickly composed herself as the car started off.
translation: 车一上路，她就很快让自己平静了下来。

meaning: adj. 快活的；高兴的
example: A poet could not but be gay in such a jocund company.
translation: 一个诗人在这种兴高采烈的同伴中自然而然地会快乐.

meaning: adj. 不合时宜的；过早的; adv. 不合时宜地；过早地

translation: 多用踢马剌,骏马也变痴.

meaning: n. 缓解；暂缓；暂时的休息；缓期执行; v. 使缓解；使暂缓；使延期；缓期执行
example: The drug brought a brief respite from the pain.
translation: 药物暂时缓解了疼痛。

meaning: v. 逗弄；使干着急
example: This was my first tantalizing glimpse of the islands.
translation: 这是我第一眼看见的这些岛屿的动人美景.

meaning: n. [生理] 体内平衡；[自] 内稳态
example: Maintainance of internal homeostasis is an essential feature of a normal body.
translation: 内部稳态的维持是正常机体的本质特征。

meaning: v. 使熟悉；使认识
example: The proprietor was an old acquaint-ance of his.
translation: 业主是他的一位旧相识。

meaning: adj. 扭曲的，弯曲的；啰嗦的
example: The friction of the sheets against his skin was torture.
translation: 被单摩擦着他的皮肤，简直像是酷刑。

meaning: n. [高能] 强子（参与强相互作用的基本粒子）
example: Large Hadron Collider is so far the world's largest, highest - energy particle accelerator and the collider.
translation: 大型强子对撞机是迄今世界上最大 、 能量最高的粒子加速器和对撞机.

meaning: n. 猪鬃；刚毛; v. 发怒；竖起
example: It makes the hairs at the nape of the neck bristle.
translation: 这使人毛骨悚然。

meaning: adj. 可恶的；厌恶的；格格不入的
example: There are many people who still find the act of abortion abhorrent.
translation: 仍有很多人对堕胎行为表示厌恶。

meaning: v. 使平息；使满足；使和缓；对…让步
example: The move was widely seen as an attempt to appease critics of the regime.
translation: 普遍认为，这一举措是试图安抚批评政权的人。

meaning: n. 离题；脱轨
example: The audience cried the speaker down as soon as he started on a third digression.
translation: 当发言人第三次扯到题外去时听众发出喊声,使他讲不下去.

meaning: adj. 放纵的；宽容的；任性的
example: Why give publicity to this self-indulgent, adolescent oaf?
translation: 为什么要宣传报道这个行为任性、青春期未满的白痴呢？

meaning: n. 所有权；物主身份
example: Brazil says its constitution forbids the private ownership of energy assets.
translation: 巴西称其宪法禁止个人占有能源资产。

meaning: adj. 派生的；降落的；世袭的; n. 后裔；派生物
example: With no direct descendent, who will succeed to the title?
translation: 没有直系后裔, 谁来继承爵位 呢 ?

meaning: v. 蔑视；毁谤
example: I don't mean to disparage your achievements.
translation: 我并不想贬低你的成就。

meaning: n. 小写字；草写小字; adj. 极小的；用草写小字写的

translation: 这部电影仅用短短的17天便拍摄完毕。

meaning: adj. 易犯错误的；不可靠的
adj. 吹毛求疵的，苛评的
example: He would be courageous calm and self assured, but neither pompous nor hypercritical.
translation: 他勇敢、冷静、自信, 既不傲慢,也不虚为.

meaning: adj. 热心的，热情的，积极的; n. (Zealous)人名；(英)泽勒斯
n. 药方；指示；惯例; adj. 凭处方方可购买的
example: The prescription Ackerman gave me isn't doing any good.
translation: 阿克曼给我开的药没有任何疗效。

meaning: adj. 可理解的，可了解的
v. 刺激，使兴奋；激怒
example: Wear rubber gloves while chopping chillies as they can irritate the skin.
translation: 切辣椒时要戴橡胶手套，因为辣椒会刺激皮肤。

meaning: n. 大破坏；浩劫；蹂躏; vt. 严重破坏; vi. 损毁

translation: 冬天的突然降临让铁路和航空运输系统陷入混乱。

meaning: n. [无脊椎][中医] 蜈蚣
example: The creature is a tiny centipede, just 10 millimeters long.
translation: 那个生物是一只很小的蜈蚣，只有10毫米长。

meaning: adj. 目光敏锐的；有洞察力的; n. 有感知力的人
example: However Vermeer's eyes are so percipient that no instrument is able to substitute for them. "
translation: 但是,无论他使用了什么工具,画家那双具有鉴赏力的眼睛却是什么也无法替代的.

meaning: v. 枯萎；皱缩
adj. 至上的；完美的；圆满的; v. 完成；作成；使达到极点
n. [地质] 海侵；犯罪；违反；逸出
example: We expect the transgressor to make any atonement possible to him.
translation: 我们期待犯了过失的人有可能做到的赎罪行为.

meaning: v. 看见；发现；察看
example: I descry a sail on the horizon.
translation: 我看见在天水交接处的轮船.

meaning: n. 散布谣言；煽动行为；群众煽动
example: The argument about " conceding " numerical inequality was due either to a misunderstanding or to demagoguery.
translation: 所谓我们 “ 承认 ” 了数量的不平等,这不是出于误解就是想蛊惑人心.

meaning: adj. 不可改变的；不能取消的；不能挽回的
example: The bank has made out an irrevocable letter of credit.
translation: 银行开出了不可撤销的信用证[状].

meaning: adj. 有害的；有毒的；败坏道德的；讨厌的
example: Their behaviour was noxious.
translation: 他们的行为令人生厌。

meaning: v. 表示，指示
example: We often denote danger by red letters.
translation: 我们常常用红字表示危险.

meaning: v. 引导；感应；使…就职；征召入伍
example: Induct electric power cable , shell up the destine length.
translation: 引入电力电缆, 在预定长度剥开.

meaning: n. 论述；谈话；演讲; v. 演说；谈论；讲述

translation: 盖茨以一篇有关部署策略的鸿篇大论予以回应。

meaning: adj. 两党连立的；代表两党的
example: There was a bipartisan agreement on the need for discussions.
translation: 需要讨论这一点得到两党的同意.

meaning: v. 耽搁，延迟
example: While the inclination to procrastinate is common, one must fully consider the detrimental impact of unnecessary delays.
translation: 虽然拖延的倾向是普遍的, 但是人们应该充分考虑到不必要的延误造成的有害影响.

meaning: v. 促进；帮助；使容易
example: The new trade agreement should facilitate more rapid economic growth.
translation: 新贸易协定应当会加快经济发展。

meaning: v. 胜过，超越
example: The biggest happiness in life is realizing self - transcendence.
translation: 人生最大的幸福是实现对 自我 的超越.

meaning: adj. 歌唱的；声音的，有声的; n. 声乐作品；元音

translation: 声乐；通过口头传唱的音乐

meaning: n. 上皮，表皮
example: The external layer of skin is called the epidermis.
translation: 皮的外层叫表皮.

meaning: v. 诱导；引起；引诱；感应
example: He might decide that it is best to induce labour.
translation: 他也许决定最好引产。

meaning: v. 消减；削皮；剪；修掉（边等）; n. (Pare)人名；(英)佩尔；(法)帕尔
example: Pare the brown skin from the meat with a very sharp knife.
translation: 用一把非常锋利的刀将褐色的皮从肉上剥去。

meaning: adj. 有毒的，有害的
example: The cold weather had most deleterious consequences among the chrysanthemums.
translation: 寒冷的天气对菊花产生了极有害的影响.

meaning: adj. 模糊不清的；引起歧义的
example: The manifesto is long-winded, repetitious and often ambiguous or poorly drafted.
translation: 这份声明冗长繁复，多处存在歧义或行文拙劣。

meaning: adj. 合理的，公道的；通情达理的
example: They will need a reasonable amount of desk area and good light.
translation: 他们将需要一个面积较大的摆放办公桌的地方和充足的照明。

meaning: n. 领域；牧场；旷野；战场；运动场; v. 担任场外队员; adj. 扫描场；田赛的；野生的
example: He was the fastest thing I ever saw on a baseball field.
translation: 他是我在棒球场上见过的跑得最快的家伙。

meaning: v. 捏造；混合而制；调合；图谋

translation: 我教她配制一种新汤的诀窍.

meaning: adj. 光滑的；华而不实的；聪明的；熟练的；老套的; n. [机] 平滑器；[机] 修光工具；通俗杂志; adv. 灵活地；聪明地; v. 使光滑；使漂亮
example: The striated and polished surfaces are called slicken - sides.
translation: 有条痕的磨光面则称为擦痕面.

meaning: n. 情感；敏感性；感觉；识别力
adj. 卑劣的；可鄙的

translation: 从头到尾他的行为既卑鄙又可恶.

meaning: n. 自夸，吹牛；吹牛大王

translation: 人们讨厌他,因为他老是吹牛.

meaning: n. 线，弦，细绳；一串，一行
example: a string of
translation: 一系列，一串

meaning: v. 使垂直；探测，探索; n. 垂直；铅锤; adv. 恰恰，正；垂直地; adj. 垂直的
example: The hotel is set plumb in the middle of the high street.
translation: 宾馆正好坐落在商街的中段。

meaning: adj. 垂死的；停滞不前的; n. 垂死的人

translation: 这个不起作用的邮局顾问委员会已被替换.

meaning: adj. 现任的；依靠的；负有职责的; n. 在职者；现任者；领圣俸者
example: It is incumbent upon all of us to make an extra effort.
translation: 我们所有人都必须加倍努力。

meaning: n. 癌症；恶性肿瘤
example: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer.
translation: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

meaning: adj. 淫荡的；猥亵的；下流的
example: Drew spends all day eyeing up the women and making lewd comments.
translation: 德鲁整天就盯着女人看，说些下流话。

meaning: v. 向…抛媚眼；注视; n. 眉目传情；媚眼
example: What to do? Just to watch and ogle them from the other side of the ditch.
translation: 去干 什么 ?只是为了可以在壕沟的这边眺望她们,向她们眉目传情.

meaning: n. 赞成票；投赞成票者; adv. 赞成
example: "Do you remember your first day at school?" — "Oh aye. Yeah."
translation: “你还记得第一天上学吗？”“噢，是的，当然。”

meaning: n. 八边形，八角形
example: Various windows embellish the corridor, with the shape of square, circle, hexagon and octagon.
translation: 走廊的窗户形状各异，有方形，有圆形，有六角形，也有八角形。

meaning: n. 圆；循环；一回合；圆形物; adj. 圆的；完全的；大概的；肥胖的; adv. 在周围；迂回地；朝反方向；挨个; v. 完成；围捕；绕行；弄圆; prep. 附近；绕过；大约；在…周围
example: It was just then that I chanced to look round.
translation: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。

meaning: adv. 怀疑地；斜视地

translation: “你会下棋吗？”他斜睨着米格尔问道。

meaning: adv. 全部地；立刻地；率直地；一直向前；痛快地; adj. 完全的，彻底的；直率的；总共的
example: The resolution stopped short of an outright declaration of independence.
translation: 这项决议几乎成为公开的独立宣言。

meaning: adj. 刺耳的；不谐和的；不调和的
example: Death and decay is the result of an inherently dissonant biology.
translation: 死亡与腐烂是内在生物体不和谐的结果。

meaning: n. 视察，检查
example: After an inspection, the inspectors must publish a report.
translation: 在视察之后，视察者必须发表一份报告。

meaning: adj. 合格的，合适的；符合条件的；有资格当选的; n. 合格者；适任者；有资格者
example: Millions of householders are eligible to claim the new council tax benefit.
translation: 数百万房主都有资格申请新的市政税优惠。

meaning: adj. 有限的；限定的; n. 有限之物
example: The fossil fuels (coal and oil) are finite resources.
translation: 化石燃料（如煤和石油）属于有限资源。

meaning: v. 总计，合计；相当于；共计；产生…结果; n. 数量；总额，总数
example: They have only a vague idea of the amount of water available.
translation: 他们只是大概知道可用水的总量。

meaning: n. 顽童，淘气鬼；海胆；刺猬
example: Additionally, steam generator design requirement of ALWR - URD are introduced.
translation: 最后还介绍了ALWR-URD对蒸汽发生器设计的要求.

meaning: adj. 保守的; n. 保守派，守旧者
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: v. 恶化；使恼怒；激怒
example: Again and again passages in his essays exasperate or bewilder.
translation: 他的文章里使人忿然或困惑的章节屡见不鲜.

meaning: adj. 痉挛的，痉挛性的；间歇性的
n. 前情；先行词；祖先; adj. 先行的；前驱的；先前的
example: It was permissible to take account of antecedent legislation.
translation: 允许考虑先前的法律。

meaning: v. 使服从；主张；呈递
example: submit registration
translation: 提交登记表；提交注册

meaning: n. 甜言蜜语；诱骗；谄媚
example: Later by means of threats and cajolery, I finally got to the bottom of it.
translation: 后来我把这丫头带哄带吓, 算弄清楚了.

meaning: adj. 罪恶的；恶棍的；恶毒的；坏透的
example: The worst ogress couldn't have treated me more villainously.
translation: 最坏的女妖也不可能以更为恶劣的方式对待我了.

meaning: n. 印象；效果，影响；压痕，印记；感想；曝光（衡量广告被显示的次数。打开一个带有该广告的网页，则该广告的impression 次数增加一次）
example: My visit to India in 1986 left an indelible impression on me.
translation: 1986年的印度之行给我留下了难忘的印象。

meaning: adj. 愚笨的；昏庸的；发呆的；自满的
example: The Chief was left speechless by this fatuous remark.
translation: 这句傻话让主任一时说不出话来。

meaning: adj. 腐败的；腐烂的；令人厌恶的
example: the putrid smell of rotten meat
translation: 烂肉的臭味

meaning: adj. 明显的；公然的；蓄意的
example: Clothing doesn't need to be overt to be sensual.
translation: 衣着没有必要过于性感。

meaning: n. 投入；输入电路; v. [自][电子] 输入；将…输入电脑
example: The Ministry of Agriculture commissioned a study into low-input farming.
translation: 农业部委托对低投入耕作进行研究。

meaning: adj. 恶臭的；有害的
example: His noisome reputation for corruption had already begun to spread.
translation: 他贪污的恶名已经四处传播开了。

meaning: adj. 合唱的；合唱队的; n. 赞美诗；唱诗班
example: His collection of choral music from around the world is called "Voices".
translation: 他收录自世界各地的合唱音乐集取名为《声音》。

meaning: n. 分配；免除；豁免；天命
example: A special dispensation may be obtained from the domestic union concerned.
translation: 从国内相关的工会那儿或许能得到一项特许。

meaning: adj. 怀恨的；有报仇心的；惩罚的
example: grapes on the vine
translation: 藤上的葡萄

meaning: v. 使解脱；解救；使游离
adj. 熟练的；擅长…的; n. 内行；能手
example: The direct marketing industry has become adept at packaging special offers.
translation: 直接邮寄广告业在特卖品的包装方面已经变得非常熟练了。

meaning: v. 承认；答谢；报偿；告知已收到
example: You have to acknowledge that we live in a racist society.
translation: 你得承认我们生活在一个有种族偏见的社会中。

meaning: v. 赌博；孤注一掷；投机；打赌; n. 赌博；冒险；打赌
example: They are not prepared to gamble their careers on this matter.
translation: 他们不愿意把自己的事业押在这件事上。

meaning: adj. 古代的；陈旧的；古体的；古色古香的
example: And nothing was so irritating as the confident way he used archaic idiom.
translation: 没什么比他使用过时的方言时那种自负的神态更气人的了。

meaning: v. 废除；撤销；废止；放弃；否定; n. 废除；撤销
example: Next year will be the 60th anniversary of the repeal of Prohibition.
translation: 明年将是禁酒令废除60周年。

meaning: v. 反对；抨击；轻视；声明不赞成
example: As a lawyer, I would deprecate any sort of legal control on gene therapy at this stage.
translation: 作为律师，我会反对在现阶段对基因疗法进行任何形式的法律管制。

meaning: v. 勾引；引诱；对…说话；搭讪
example: He ruminated on his defenses before he should accost her father.
translation: 他在与她父亲搭话前,仔细地考虑着他的防范措施.

meaning: adj. 脾气坏的；爱吵架的；难相处的
